object.name: books
object.sql: CREATE TABLE books ( book_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, osis TEXT NOT NULL, eng_name TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, testament TEXT NOT NULL, chapters INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 )

object.name: verses
object.sql: CREATE TABLE verses ( book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, chapter INTEGER NOT NULL, verse INTEGER NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (book_id, chapter, verse) )

object.name: version
object.sql: CREATE TABLE version ( slug TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL )

object.name: idx_v_bc
object.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_v_bc ON verses(book_id, chapter)

object.name: indexing
object.sql: CREATE VIEW indexing AS SELECT b.book_id, b.osis, b.eng_name, b.name, b.testament, b.chapters, v.slug, v.label FROM books b, version v

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

column.name: text
column.value: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat {a son} in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

column.name: text
column.value: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

column.name: text
column.value: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

column.name: text
column.value: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

column.name: text
column.value: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

column.name: text
column.value: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

column.name: text
column.value: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

column.name: text
column.value: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

column.name: text
column.value: And Enoch walked with God: and he {was} not; for God took him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

column.name: text
column.value: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

column.name: text
column.value: And he called his name Noah, saying, This {same} shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bore Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And she again bore his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of its fat. And the LORD had respect to Abel and to his offering:

column.name: text
column.value: But to Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Cain, Why art thou angry? and why is thy countenance fallen?

column.name: text
column.value: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And to thee {shall be} his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Cain, Where {is} Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: {Am} I my brother's keeper?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth to me from the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And now {art} thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

column.name: text
column.value: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield to thee its strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cain said to the LORD, My punishment {is} greater than I can bear.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou hast driven me this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, {that} any one that findeth me shall slay me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Therefore whoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bore Enoch: and he built a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lamech took to him two wives: the name of the one {was} Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adah bore Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and {of such as have} cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brother's name {was} Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and flute.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zillah, she also bore Tubalcain, an instructor of every craftsman in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain {was} Naamah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken to my speech: for I have slain a man who wounded me, and a young man for hurting me.

column.name: text
column.value: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bore a son, and called his name Seth: For God, {said she}, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD had said to Abram, Depart from thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, to a land that I will show thee:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken to him; and Lot went with him: and Abram {was} seventy and five years old when he departed from Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went to go forth into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram passed through the land to the place of Sichem, to the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite {was} then in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to Abram, and said, To thy seed will I give this land: and there he built an altar to the LORD, who appeared to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he departed from there to a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, {having} Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he built an altar to the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to dwell there; for the famine {was} grievous in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had come near to enter into Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou {art} a fair woman to look upon:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This {is} his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Say, I pray thee, thou {art} my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when Abram had come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she {was} very fair.

column.name: text
column.value: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he treated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and male donkeys, and male and female servants, and female donkeys, and camels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What {is} this {that} thou hast done to me? why didst thou not tell me that she {is} thy wife?

column.name: text
column.value: Why saidst thou, She {is} my sister? so I might have taken her to me for a wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take {her}, and go thy way.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh commanded {his} men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

column.name: text
column.value: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and {there was} not a man to till the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God formed man {of} the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became into four heads.

column.name: text
column.value: The name of the first {is} Pison: which goest around the whole land of Havilah, where {there is} gold;

column.name: text
column.value: And the gold of that land {is} good: there {is} bdellium and the onyx stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the second river {is} Gihon: the same that goest around the whole land of Cush.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the third river {is} Hiddekel: which floweth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river {is} Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to tend it and to keep it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

column.name: text
column.value: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest of it thou shalt surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God said, {It is} not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought {them} to Adam to see what he would call them: and whatever Adam called every living creature, that {was} its name.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowls of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place;

column.name: text
column.value: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, he made a woman, and brought her to the man.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam said, This {is} now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman said to the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

column.name: text
column.value: But of the fruit of the tree which {is} in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the serpent said to the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

column.name: text
column.value: For God doth know that in the day ye eat of it, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the woman saw that the tree {was} good for food, and that it {was} pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make {one} wise, she took of its fruit, and ate, and gave also to her husband with her; and he ate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they {were} naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made for themselves aprons.

column.name: text
column.value: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God called to Adam, and said to him, Where {art} thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I {was} naked; and I hid myself.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Who told thee that thou {wast} naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

column.name: text
column.value: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest {to be} with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God said to the woman, What {is} this {that} thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I ate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God said to the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou {art} cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

column.name: text
column.value: To the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire {shall be} to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened to the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed {is} the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat {of} it all the days of thy life;

column.name: text
column.value: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

column.name: text
column.value: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou shalt return to the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou {art}, and to dust shalt thou return.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

column.name: text
column.value: For Adam also and for his wife the LORD God made coats of skins, and clothed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man hath become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he should put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

column.name: text
column.value: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way of the tree of life.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,

column.name: text
column.value: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they {were} fair; and they took them wives of all whom they chose.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also {is} flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

column.name: text
column.value: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men, and they bore {children} to them, the same {became} mighty men who {were} of old, men of renown.

column.name: text
column.value: And God saw that the wickedness of man {was} great in the earth, and {that} every imagination of the thoughts of his heart {was} only evil continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD repented that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for I repent that I have made them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man {and} perfect in his generations, {and} Noah walked with God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

column.name: text
column.value: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is the fashion} in which thou shalt make it: The length of the ark {shall be} three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in its side; {with} lower, second, and third {stories} shalt thou make it.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, in which {is} the breath of life, from under heaven; {and} every thing that {is} on the earth shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every {sort} shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep {them} alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

column.name: text
column.value: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every {sort} shall come to thee, to keep {them} alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And take thou to thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather {it} to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, come, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, come, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top {may reach} to heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we should be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men were building.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Behold, the people {is} one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be withheld from them, which they have imagined to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there upon the face of all the earth: and they stopped building the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD there confounded the language of all the earth: and from there did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the generations of Shem: Shem {was} an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

column.name: text
column.value: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

column.name: text
column.value: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

column.name: text
column.value: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

column.name: text
column.value: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

column.name: text
column.value: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

column.name: text
column.value: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

column.name: text
column.value: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

column.name: text
column.value: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

column.name: text
column.value: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife {was} Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

column.name: text
column.value: But Sarai was barren; she {had} no child.

column.name: text
column.value: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and dwelt there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and to them were sons born after the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

column.name: text
column.value: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: therefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and built Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same {is} a great city.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

column.name: text
column.value: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

column.name: text
column.value: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites dispersed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, to Gaza; as thou goest, to Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even to Lasha.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, {and} in their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: To Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were {children} born.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

column.name: text
column.value: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of one {was} Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name {was} Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these {were} the sons of Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest to Sephar a mount of the east.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth {on} the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: Every moving thing that liveth shall be food for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

column.name: text
column.value: But flesh with the life of it, {which is} its blood shall ye not eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke to Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

column.name: text
column.value: And with every living creature that {is} with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, This {is} the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that {is} with you, for perpetual generations:

column.name: text
column.value: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will remember my covenant, which {is} between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that {is} upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Noah, This {is} the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that {is} upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Noah, that went forth from the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham {was} the father of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: These three {were} the sons of Noah: and from them was the whole earth overspread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah began {to be} a farmer, and he planted a vineyard:

column.name: text
column.value: And he drank of the wine, and was drunk; and he was uncovered within his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren outside.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid {it} upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces {were} backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Cursed {be} Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be to his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that {are} not clean by two, the male and his female.

column.name: text
column.value: Of fowls of the air also by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive on the face of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living thing that I have made will I destroy from the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah did according to all that the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah {was} six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that {are} not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: There went in two and two to Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

column.name: text
column.value: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went in to Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, in which {is} the breath of life.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that entered, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bore up the ark, and it was lifted above the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark moved upon the face of the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that {were} under the whole heaven, were covered.

column.name: text
column.value: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

column.name: text
column.value: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

column.name: text
column.value: All in whose nostrils {was} the breath of life, of all that {was} on the dry {land}, died.

column.name: text
column.value: And every living thing was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained {alive}, and they that {were} with him in the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness {was} upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

column.name: text
column.value: And God saw the light, that {it was} good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which {were} under the firmament from the waters which {were} above the firmament: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together into one place, and let the dry {land} appear: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God called the dry {land} Earth; and the gathering together of the waters he called Seas: and God saw that {it was} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, {and} the fruit tree yielding fruit after its kind, whose seed {is} in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth brought forth grass, {and} herb yielding seed after its kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed {was} in itself, after its kind: and God saw that {it was} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

column.name: text
column.value: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: {he made} the stars also.

column.name: text
column.value: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that {it was} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl {that} may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And God created great sea creatures, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that {it was} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and the beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that {it was} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: So God created man in his {own} image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

column.name: text
column.value: And God blessed them, and God said to them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which {is} upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which {is} the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for food.

column.name: text
column.value: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, in which {is} life, {I have given} every green herb for food: and it was so.

column.name: text
column.value: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, {it was} very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

column.name: text
column.value: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that {were} with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters abated;

column.name: text
column.value: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters decreased continually till the tenth month: in the tenth {month}, on the first {day} of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, till the waters were dried from off the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

column.name: text
column.value: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned to him into the ark, for the waters {were} on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in to him into the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

column.name: text
column.value: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth {was} an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again to him any more.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first {month}, the first {day} of the month, the waters were dried from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke to Noah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go forth from the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring forth with thee every living thing that {is} with thee, of all flesh, of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

column.name: text
column.value: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, {and} whatever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went out of the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And Noah built an altar to the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart {is} evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every living thing, as I have done.

column.name: text
column.value: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I {am} thy shield, {and} thy exceeding great reward.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the heir of my house {is} this Eliezer of Damascus?

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is my heir.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the word of the LORD {came} to him, saying, This shall not be thy heir; but he that shall come forth out of thy own loins shall be thy heir.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if thou art able to number them: and he said to him, So shall thy seed be.

column.name: text
column.value: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, I {am} the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Lord GOD, by what shall I know that I shall inherit it?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a female goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took to him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds he did not divide.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Abram, Know certainly that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land {that is} not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

column.name: text
column.value: And also that nation, which they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the fourth generation they shall come here again: for the iniquity of the Amorites {is} not yet full.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when the sun had gone down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: In that same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, To thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

column.name: text
column.value: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram returned from Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram {was} very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai;

column.name: text
column.value: To the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram said to Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we {are} brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if {thou wilt take} the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if {thou wilt depart} to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it {was} well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, {even} as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest to Zoar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Lot chose for himself all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain, and pitched {his} tent toward Sodom.

column.name: text
column.value: But the men of Sodom {were} wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

column.name: text
column.value: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, {then} shall thy seed also be numbered.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abram removed {his} tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which {is} in Hebron, and built there an altar to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Abram was ninety and nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said to him, I {am} the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, behold, my covenant {is} with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thee exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come forth from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to thee, and to thy seed after thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give to thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land in which thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every male among you shall be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and you.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, who {is} not of thy seed.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the uncircumcised male whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah {shall} her name {be}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also by her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be {a mother} of nations; kings of people shall come from her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall {a child} be born to him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear?

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said to God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

column.name: text
column.value: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, {and} with his seed after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

column.name: text
column.value: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to thee at this set time in the next year.

column.name: text
column.value: And he finished talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham {was} ninety and nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ishmael his son {was} thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, {here} I {am}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Take now thy son, thy only {son} Isaac, whom thou lovest, and go into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and cut up the wood for the burnt offering, and rose, and went to the place which God had told him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said to his young men, Abide ye here with the donkey; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and return to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid {it} upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here {am} I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where {is} the lamb for a burnt offering?

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD called to him from heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing to him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld from me thy son, thy only {son}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind {him} a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said {to} this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven the second time,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thy only {son}:

column.name: text
column.value: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand which {is} on the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

column.name: text
column.value: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told to Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also borne children to thy brother Nahor;

column.name: text
column.value: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

column.name: text
column.value: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And his concubine, whose name {was} Reumah, she bore also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came two angels to Sodom at evening; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing {them} rose to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

column.name: text
column.value: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in to him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

column.name: text
column.value: But before they lay down, the men of the city, {even} the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

column.name: text
column.value: And they called to Lot, and said to him, Where {are} the men who came in to thee this night? bring them out to us, that we may know them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot went out at the door to them, and shut the door after him,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold now, I have two daughters who have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out to you, and do ye to them as {is} good in your eyes: only to these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Stand back. And they said {again}, This one {man} came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed hard upon the man, Lot, and came near to break the door.

column.name: text
column.value: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

column.name: text
column.value: And they smote the men that {were} at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men said to Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomever thou hast in the city, bring {them} out of this place:

column.name: text
column.value: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them hast become great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot went out, and spoke to his sons in law, who married his daughters, and said, Arise, depart from this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed to his sons in law as one that mocked.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, who are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful to him: and they brought him forth, and set him outside of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot said to them, O, not so, my Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shown to me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil should take me, and I die:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold now, this city {is} near to flee to, and it {is} a small one: O, let me escape there, ({is} it not a small one?) and my soul shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for which thou hast spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Haste thee, escape there; for I cannot do any thing till thou hast come there. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun had risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

column.name: text
column.value: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham rose early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Lot went up from Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And the firstborn said to the younger, Our father {is} old, and {there is} not a man on the earth to come in to us after the manner of all the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, Behold, I lay last night with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, {and} lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

column.name: text
column.value: And the firstborn bore a son, and called his name Moab: the same {is} the father of the Moabites to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the younger, she also bore a son, and called his name Benammi: the same {is} the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarah was an hundred and twenty and seven years old: {these were} the years of the life of Sarah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same {is} Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

column.name: text
column.value: Hear us, my lord: thou {art} a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke with them, saying, If it is your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

column.name: text
column.value: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which {is} in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the presence of the children of Heth, of all that entered the gates of his city, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I to thee, and the cave that {is} in it I give it to thee; in the presence of the sons of my people I give it to thee: bury thy dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham bowed himself before the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to Ephron in the presence of the people of the land, saying, But if thou {wilt give it}, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take {it} of me, and I will bury my dead there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

column.name: text
column.value: My lord, hearken to me: the land {is worth} four hundred shekels of silver; what {is} that between me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham hearkened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the presence of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current {money} with the merchant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the field of Ephron, which {was} in Machpelah, which {was} before Mamre, the field, and the cave which {was} in it, and all the trees that {were} in the field, that {were} in all the surrounding borders, were made sure

column.name: text
column.value: To Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that entered the gate of his city.

column.name: text
column.value: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same {is} Hebron in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the field, and the cave that {is} in it, were made sure to Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

column.name: text
column.value: And he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw {them}, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

column.name: text
column.value: Let a little water, I pray you, be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that you shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham hastened into the tent to Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead {it}, and make cakes upon the hearth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham ran to the herd, and brought a calf tender and good, and gave {it} to a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set {it} before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Where {is} Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I will certainly return to thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard {it} in the tent door, which {was} behind him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Abraham and Sarah {were} old {and} well advanced in years; {and} it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am become old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Abraham, Why did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I certainly bear a child, who am old?

column.name: text
column.value: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return to thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

column.name: text
column.value: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

column.name: text
column.value: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come to me; and if not, I will know.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men turned their faces from there, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

column.name: text
column.value: Suppose there are fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that {are} in it?

column.name: text
column.value: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I who {am} dust and ashes, have taken upon me to speak to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Suppose there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for {lack of} five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to him yet again, and said, Suppose there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do {it} for forty's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, O let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Suppose there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do {it}, if I find thirty there.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak to the Lord: Suppose there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy {it} for twenty's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, O let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Suppose ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy {it} for ten's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had finished speaking with Abraham: and Abraham returned to his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

column.name: text
column.value: {That these} made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that {were} with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Horites in their mount Seir, to Elparan, which {is} by the wilderness.

column.name: text
