column.value: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which {is} Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same {is} Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

column.name: text
column.value: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vale of Siddim {was full of} slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these {were} confederate with Abram.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained {servants}, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued {them} to Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And he divided his men against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them to Hobah, which {is} on the left hand of Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that {were} with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which {is} the king's dale.

column.name: text
column.value: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he {was} the priest of the most high God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed {be} Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed be the most high God, who hath delivered thy enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lifted my hand to the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

column.name: text
column.value: That I will not {take} from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that {is} thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

column.name: text
column.value: Except only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: For Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, {so that} all that hear will laugh with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah shall nurse children? for I have borne {him} a son in his old age.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the day that Isaac was weaned.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore she said to Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, {even} with Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said to thee, hearken to her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

column.name: text
column.value: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he {is} thy seed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave {it} to Hagar, putting {it} on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went, and sat her down apart from {him} a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat apart from {him}, and raised her voice, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said to her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he {is}.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.

column.name: text
column.value: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad a drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

column.name: text
column.value: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took for him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spoke to Abraham, saying, God {is} with thee in all that thou doest:

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore swear to me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: {but} according to the kindness that I have done to thee, thou shalt do to me, and to the land in which thou hast sojourned.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said, I will swear.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said, I know not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet have I heard {of it}, but to day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them to Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What {mean} these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, For {these} seven ewe lambs shalt thou take from my hand, that they may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they swore both of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech arose, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And {Abraham} planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham journeyed from there toward the south country, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She {is} my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

column.name: text
column.value: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou {art but} a dead man, on account of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she {is} a man's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou also slay a righteous nation?

column.name: text
column.value: Said he not to me, She {is} my sister? and she, even she herself said, He {is} my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore I allowed thee not to touch her.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore restore to the man {his} wife; for he {is} a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou shalt not restore {her}, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that {are} thine.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were greatly afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, What hast thou done to us? and how have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds to me that ought not to be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said to Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God {is} not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet indeed {she is} my sister; she {is} the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, This {is} thy kindness which thou shalt show to me; at every place where we shall come, say of me, He {is} my brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and male and female servants, and gave {them} to Abraham, and restored to him Sarah his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land {is} before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand {pieces} of silver: behold, he {is} to thee a covering of the eyes, to all that {are} with thee, and with all {other}: thus she was reproved.

column.name: text
column.value: So Abraham prayed to God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bore {children}.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had closed fast all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Sarai Abram's wife bore him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name {was} Hagar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarai said to Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in to my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarai said to Abram, My wrong {be} upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abram said to Sarai, Behold, thy maid {is} in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai afflicted her, she fled from her face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, from where didst thou come? and where wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to her, Behold, thou {art} with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will be a wild man; his hand {will be} against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And she called the name of the LORD that spoke to her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, {it is} between Kadesh and Bered.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hagar bore Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bore, Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abram {was} eighty and six years old, when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham was old, {and} well advanced in years: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said to his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt go to my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant said to him, It may be the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land: must I needs bring thy son again to the land from which you came?

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham said to him, Beware that thou bring not my son there again.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD God of heaven, who took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, To thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son there again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning that matter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master {were} in his hands: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made his camels to kneel down outside the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, the time when women go out to draw {water}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, prosper me this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I stand {here} by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

column.name: text
column.value: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will water thy camels also: {let the same be} she {that} thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and by that shall I know that thou hast shown kindness to my master.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, before he had finished speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

column.name: text
column.value: And the damsel {was} very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water from thy pitcher.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him a drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had finished giving him drink, she said, I will draw {water} for thy camels also, till they have finished drinking.

column.name: text
column.value: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw {water}, and drew for all his camels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her wrists of ten {shekels} weight of gold;

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Whose daughter {art} thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room {in} thy father's house for us to lodge in?

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, I {am} the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.

column.name: text
column.value: She said moreover to him, We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man bowed his head, and worshipped the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left my master destitute of his mercy and his truth: I {being} in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And the damsel ran, and told these things to her mother's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name {was} Laban: and Laban ran out to the man, to the well.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's wrists, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spoke the man to me; that he came to the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; why standest thou outside? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was set {food} before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told my errand. And he said, Speak on.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I {am} Abraham's servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and male and female servants, and camels, and donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old: and to him hath he given all that he hath.

column.name: text
column.value: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt go to my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to my master, It may be the woman will not follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou be clear from {this} my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee {one}, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

column.name: text
column.value: And I came this day to the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou dost prosper my way which I go:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw {water}, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

column.name: text
column.value: And she saith to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: {let} the same {be} the woman whom the LORD hath appointed for my master's son.

column.name: text
column.value: And before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down to the well, and drew {water}: and I said to her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her {shoulder}, and said, Drink, and I will water thy camels also: so I drank, and she watered the camels also.

column.name: text
column.value: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter {art} thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her wrists.

column.name: text
column.value: And I bowed my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter for his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak to thee bad or good.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, Rebekah {is} before thee, take {her}, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, {bowing himself} to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave {them} to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ate and drank, he and the men that {were} with him, and tarried all night; and they rose in the morning, and he said, Send me away to my master.

column.name: text
column.value: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us {a few} days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called Rebekah, and said to her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they blessed Rebekah, and said to her, Thou {art} our sister, be thou {the mother} of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those who hate them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at evening: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels {were} coming.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

column.name: text
column.value: For she {had} said to the servant, What man {is} this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant {had} said, It {is} my master: therefore she took a veil, and covered herself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's {death}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name {was} Keturah.

column.name: text
column.value: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these {were} the children of Keturah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred and seventy and five years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full {of years}; and was gathered to his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which {is} before Mamre;

column.name: text
column.value: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore to Abraham:

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

column.name: text
column.value: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

column.name: text
column.value: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Ishmael, and these {are} their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered to his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they dwelt from Havilah to Shur, that {is} before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: {and} he died in the presence of all his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah for a wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she {was} barren: and the LORD was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If {it is} so, why {am} I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to her, Two nations {are} in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be born of thee; and {the one} people shall be stronger than {the other} people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

column.name: text
column.value: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, {there were} twins in her womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first was born red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that his brother was born, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac {was} sixty years old when she bore them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the boys grew: and Esau was a skilful hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob {was} a plain man, dwelling in tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac loved Esau, because he ate of {his} venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob boiled pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he {was} faint:

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red {pottage}; for I {am} faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said, Sell to me this day thy birthright.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau said, Behold, I {am} at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright bring to me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he swore to him: and he sold his birthright to Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he ate and drank, and rose, and went his way: thus Esau despised {his} birthright.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines to Gerar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

column.name: text
column.value: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for to thee, and to thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham thy father;

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give to thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

column.name: text
column.value: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of the place asked {him} of his wife; and he said, She {is} my sister: for he feared to say, {She is} my wife; lest, {said he}, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she {was} fair to look upon.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac {was} sporting with Rebekah his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, surely she {is} thy wife: and how saidst thou, She {is} my sister? And Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I should die on her account.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said, What {is} this thou hast done to us? one of the people might lightly have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech charged all {his} people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man became great, and continued, and grew until he became very great:

column.name: text
column.value: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and very many servants: and the Philistines envied him.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac departed from there, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

column.name: text
column.value: And the herdmen of Gerar contended with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water {is} ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they dug another well, and contended for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he departed from there, and dug another well; and for that they did not contend: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up from there to Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, I {am} the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I {am} with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants dug a well.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac said to them, Why come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath between us, {even} between us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

column.name: text
column.value: That thou wilt do us no harm, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done to thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou {art} now the blessed of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early in the morning, and swore one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, We have found water.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city {is} Beersheba to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau was forty years old when he took for a wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

column.name: text
column.value: Who were a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said to him, My son: and he said to him, Behold, {here am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me {some} venison;

column.name: text
column.value: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring {it} to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt {for} venison, {and} to bring {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak to Esau thy brother, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Go now to the flock, and bring me from there two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring {it} to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother {is} a hairy man, and I {am} a smooth man:

column.name: text
column.value: My father perhaps will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: And his mother said to him, Upon me {be} thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go bring them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went, and took, and brought {them} to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah took the choicest raiment of her eldest son Esau, which was with her in the house, and put it upon Jacob her younger son:

column.name: text
column.value: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands, and on the smooth part of his neck:

column.name: text
column.value: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here {am} I; who {art} thou, my son?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to his father, I {am} Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac said to his son, How {is it} that thou hast found {it} so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought {it} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac said to Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou {art} my very son Esau or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob went near to Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice {is} Jacob's voice, but the hands {are} the hands of Esau.

column.name: text
column.value: And he knew him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, {Art} thou my very son Esau? And he said, I {am}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Bring {it} near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought {it} near to him, and he ate: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son {is} as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and wine:

column.name: text
column.value: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed {be} every one that curseth thee, and blessed {be} he that blesseth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had yet scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

column.name: text
column.value: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac his father said to him, Who {art} thou? And he said, I {am} thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac trembled exceedingly, and said, Who? where {is} he that hath taken venison, and brought {it} me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, {and} he shall be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceedingly bitter cry, and said to his father, Bless me, {even} me also, O my father.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thy brother came deceitfully, and hath taken away thy blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Is he not rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me twice: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac answered and said to Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with grain and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now to thee, my son?

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau said to his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, {even} me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac his father answered and said to him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

column.name: text
column.value: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as concerning thee, doth comfort himself, {purposing} to kill thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

column.name: text
column.value: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury shall turn away;

column.name: text
column.value: Till thy brother's anger shall turn away from thee, and he shall forget {that} which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and bring thee from there: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

column.name: text
column.value: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob shall take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these {who are} of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children to Leah, and to Rachel, and to the two handmaids.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph last {of all}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he passed on before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, till he came near to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who {are} those with thee? And he said, The children whom God hath graciously given to thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What {meanest} thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, {These are} to find grace in the sight of my lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep what thou hast to thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou hast been pleased with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, My lord knoweth that the children {are} tender, and the flocks and herds with young {are} with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on slowly, according as the cattle that go before me and the children are able to endure, until I come to my lord to Seir.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee {some} of the people that {are} with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

column.name: text
column.value: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built for himself an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which {is} in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And he bought the piece of land, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that {was} our father's; and of {that} which {was} our father's hath he obtained all this glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it {was} not toward him as before.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Jacob, Return to the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah into the field to his flock,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, I see your father's countenance, that it {is} not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

column.name: text
column.value: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God allowed him not to hurt me.

column.name: text
column.value: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bore speckled: and if he said thus, The striped shall be thy hire; then all the cattle bore striped.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given {them} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle {were} striped, speckled, and spotted.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of God spoke to me in a dream, {saying}, Jacob: And I said, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Lift up now thy eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle {are} striped, speckled, and spotted: for I have seen all that Laban doeth to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the God of Bethel, where thou didst anoint the pillar, {and} where thou didst vow to me a vow: now arise, depart from this land, and return to the land of thy kindred.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, {Is there} yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

column.name: text
column.value: Are we not counted by him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite consumed also our money.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that {is} ours, and our children's: now then, whatever God hath said to thee, do.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob arose, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gained, the cattle of his getting, which he had gained in Padanaram, to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that {were} her father's.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he was fleeing.

column.name: text
column.value: So he fled with all that he had; and he arose, and passed over the river, and set his face {toward} the mount Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives {taken} with the sword?

column.name: text
column.value: Why didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with timbrel, and with harp?

column.name: text
column.value: And hast not permitted me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in {so} doing.

column.name: text
column.value: It is in the power of my hand to do you harm: but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, {though} thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou didst earnestly long after thy father's house, {yet} why hast thou stolen my gods?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, It may be thou wouldest take thy daughters from me by force.

column.name: text
column.value: With whomever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what {is} thine with me, and take {it} to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found {them} not. Then he went out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's saddle, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found {them} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women {is} upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob was angry, and contended with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What {is} my trespass? what {is} my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

column.name: text
column.value: Though thou hast searched all my things, what hast thou found of all thy household things? set {it} here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge between us both.

column.name: text
column.value: These twenty years {have} I {been} with thee; thy ewes and thy female goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: That which was torn {by beasts} I brought not to thee; I bore the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, {whether} stolen by day, or stolen by night.

column.name: text
column.value: {Thus} I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

column.name: text
column.value: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst now sent me away empty. God hath seen my affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked {thee} last night.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, {These} daughters {are} my daughters, and {these} children {are} my children, and {these} cattle {are} my cattle, and all that thou seest {is} mine: and what can I do this day to these my daughters, or to their children which they have borne?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up {for} a pillar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they ate there upon the heap.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said, This heap {is} a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

column.name: text
column.value: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take {other} wives besides my daughters, no man {is} with us; see, God {is} witness between me and thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold {this} pillar, which I have cast between me and thee;

column.name: text
column.value: This heap {be} witness, and {this} pillar {be} witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the fear of his father Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they ate bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And early in the morning Laban arose, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned to his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This {is} God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother to the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak to my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there till now:

column.name: text
column.value: And I have oxen, and donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he is coming to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that {were} with him, and the flocks, and herds, and camels, into two bands;

column.name: text
column.value: And said, If Esau shall come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD who saidst to me, Return to thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

column.name: text
column.value: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shown to thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

column.name: text
column.value: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, {and} the mother with the children.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

column.name: text
column.value: Two hundred female goats, and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

column.name: text
column.value: Thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows, and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys, and ten foals.

column.name: text
column.value: And he delivered {them} into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said to his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space between drove and drove.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose {art} thou? and where goest thou? and whose {are} these before thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt say, {They are} thy servant Jacob's; it {is} a present sent to my lord Esau: and, behold, also he {is} behind us.

column.name: text
column.value: And so he commanded the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, In this manner shall ye speak to Esau, when ye find him.

column.name: text
column.value: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob {is} behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept of me.

column.name: text
column.value: So the present went over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose that night, and took his two wives, and his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that which he had.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, What {is} thy name? And he said, Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob asked {him}, and said, Tell {me}, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, why {is} it {that} thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he limped upon his thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the children of Israel eat not {of} the sinew which shrank, which {is} upon the hollow of the thigh, to this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from there of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

column.name: text
column.value: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land in which thou art a stranger, which God gave to Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

column.name: text
column.value: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from there; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

column.name: text
column.value: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Esau to Ishmael, and took to the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put {them for} his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set upon the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I {am} the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

column.name: text
column.value: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I {am} with thee, and will keep thee in all {places} where thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done {that} which I have promised to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful {is} this place! this {is} no other but the house of God, and this {is} the gate of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put {for} his pillows, and set it up {for} a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city {was called} Luz at the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

column.name: text
column.value: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

column.name: text
column.value: And this stone, which I have set {for} a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there {were} three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone {was} upon the well's mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in its place.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to them, My brethren, from where {are} ye? And they said, We {are} from Haran.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, {Is} he well? And they said, {He is} well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Lo, {it is} yet high day, neither {is it} time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go {and} feed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks are gathered together, and {till} they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And while he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob told Rachel that he {was} her father's brother, and that he {was} Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said to him, Surely thou {art} my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said to Jacob, Because thou {art} my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nothing? tell me, what {shall} thy wages {be}?

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder {was} Leah, and the name of the younger {was} Rachel.

column.name: text
column.value: Leah {was} tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said, {It is} better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed to him {but} a few days, for the love he had for her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to Laban, Give {me} my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban gave to his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid {for} an handmaid.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it {was} Leah: and he said to Laban, What {is} this thou hast done to me? did I not serve with thee for Rachel? why then hast thou deceived me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter for a wife also.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD saw that Leah {was} hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel {was} barren.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I {was} hated, he hath therefore given me this {son} also: and she called his name Simeon.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and said, Now this time will my husband love me, because I have borne him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived again, and bore a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and stopped bearing.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said to Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, {Am} I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in to her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid for a wife: and Jacob went in to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore she called his name Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: When Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zilpah Leah's maid bore Jacob a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zilpah Leah's maid bore Jacob a second son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her, {Is it} a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in to me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

column.name: text
column.value: And God hearkened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob the fifth son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah conceived again, and bore Jacob the sixth son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Leah said, God hath bestowed on me {with} a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterwards she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

column.name: text
column.value: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived, and bore a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

column.name: text
column.value: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

column.name: text
column.value: Give {me} my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said to him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, {tarry: for} I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle were with me.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it was} little which thou hadst before I {came}, and it is {now} increased to a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for my own house also?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed {and} keep thy flock:

column.name: text
column.value: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from there all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and {of such} shall be my hire.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that {is} not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be accounted stolen with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

column.name: text
column.value: And he removed that day the male goats that were striped and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had {some} white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave {them} into the hands of his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set three days' journey between himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob took to him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and peeled white stripes in them, and made the white appear which {was} in the rods.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the rods which he had peeled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle striped, speckled, and spotted.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the striped, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not with Laban's cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, whenever the stronger cattle conceived, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the cattle were feeble, he put {them} not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man increased exceedingly, and had many cattle, and female and male servants, and camels, and donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar to God, who appeared to thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all that {were} with him, Put away the foreign gods that {are} among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

column.name: text
column.value: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which {were} in their hand, and {the} earrings which {were} in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which {was} by Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was on the cities that {were} around them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jacob came to Luz, which {is} in the land of Canaan, that {is}, Bethel, he and all the people that {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.

column.name: text
column.value: And God appeared to Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to him, Thy name {is} Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to him, I {am} God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a multitude of nations shall spring from thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

column.name: text
column.value: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, {even} a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.

column.name: text
