column.value: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said to her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died ) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which {is} Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob set a pillar on her grave: that {is} the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard {it}. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these {are} the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Padanaram.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob came to Isaac his father to Mamre, to the city of Arbah, which {is} Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

column.name: text
column.value: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and eighty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered to his people, {being} old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

column.name: text
column.value: And his soul cleaved to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spoke kindly to the damsel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they had come.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jacob came from the field when they heard {it}: and the men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hamor spoke with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her to him for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And make ye marriages with us, give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye in it, and get you possessions in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shechem said to her father and to her brethren, Let me find favour in your eyes, and what ye shall say to me I will give.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say to me: but give me the damsel for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that {would be} a reproach to us:

column.name: text
column.value: But in this will we consent to you: If ye will be as we {are}, that every male of you shall be circumcised;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will we give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not hearken to us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

column.name: text
column.value: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he {was} more honourable than all the house of his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: These men {are} peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade in it; for the land, behold, {it is} large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Only on this {condition} will the men consent to us to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us shall be circumcised, as they {are} circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: {Shall} not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs {be} ours? only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Hamor and to Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their donkeys, and that which {was} in the city, and that which {was} in the field,

column.name: text
column.value: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives they took captive, and spoiled even all that {was} in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me odious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I {being} few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the generations of Esau, who {is} Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

column.name: text
column.value: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bore Reuel;

column.name: text
column.value: And Aholibamah bore Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these {are} the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had gained in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land where they were strangers could not sustain them because of their cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau {is} Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek: these {were} the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn {son} of Esau; chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Korah, chief Gatam, {and} chief Amalek: these {are} the chiefs {that came} of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these {were} the sons of Adah.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Reuel Esau's son; chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these {are} the chiefs {that came} of Reuel in the land of Edom; these {are} the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; chief Jeush, chief Jaalam, chief Korah: these {were} the chiefs {that came} of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Esau, who {is} Edom, and these {are} their chiefs.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these {are} the chiefs of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister {was} Timna.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Shobal {were} these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this {was that} Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Anah {were} these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Ezer {are} these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Dishan {are} these; Uz, and Aran.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the chiefs {that came} of the Horites; chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan: these {are} the chiefs {that came} of Hori, among their chiefs in the land of Seir.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city {was} Dinhabah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Avith.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth {by} the river reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Pau; and his wife's name {was} Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the chiefs {that came} of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Magdiel, chief Iram: these {are} the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he {is} Esau the father of the Edomites.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name {was} Hirah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name {was} Shuah; and he took her, and went in to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived, and bore a son; and he called his name Er.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she called his name Onan.

column.name: text
column.value: And she yet again conceived, and bore a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name {was} Tamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said to Onan, Go in to thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in to his brother's wife, that he wasted {it} on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: therefore he slew him also.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son shall be grown: for he said, Lest perhaps he die also, as his brethren {did}. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And she put off from her, her widow's garments, and covered her with a veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which {is} by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given to him for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: When Judah saw her, he thought her {to be} an harlot; because she had covered her face.

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned to her by the way, and said, Come, I pray thee, let me come in to thee; (for he knew not that she {was} his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in to me?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I will send {thee} a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give {me} a pledge, till thou sendest {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that {is} in thy hand. And he gave {them to} her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

column.name: text
column.value: And she arose, and went her way, and laid by her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive {his} pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where {is} the harlot, that {was} openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, {that} there was no harlot in this {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said, Let her take {it} to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told to Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she {is} with child by harlotry. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

column.name: text
column.value: When she {was} brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these {are, am} I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose {are} these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah acknowledged {them}, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins {were} in her womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that {the one} put out {his} hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? {this} breach {be} upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterwards came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob dwelt in the land in which his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the generations of Jacob. Joseph, {being} seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad {was} with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought to his father their bad report.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he {was} the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of {many} colours.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told {it} to his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, we {were} binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood around, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

column.name: text
column.value: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he told {it} to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said to him, What {is} this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed {the flock} in Shechem? come, and I will send thee to them. And he said to him, Here {am I}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him from the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain man found him, and, behold, {he was} wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed {their flocks}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man said, They have departed from here; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near to them, they conspired against him to slay him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer is coming.

column.name: text
column.value: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben heard {it}, and he delivered him from their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood, cast him into this pit that {is} in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might deliver him from their hands, to bring him back to his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Joseph had come to his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, {his} coat of {many} colours that {was} on him;

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit {was} empty, {there was} no water in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry {them} down to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said to his brethren, What profit {is it} if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

column.name: text
column.value: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he {is} our brother our flesh. And his brethren were content.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there passed by Midianites merchants; and they drew and lifted Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty {pieces} of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben returned to the pit; and, behold, Joseph {was} not in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned to his brethren, and said, The child {is} not; and I, where shall I go?

column.name: text
column.value: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent the coat of {many} colours, and they brought {it} to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it {is} thy son's coat or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he knew it, and said, {It is} my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave to my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, {and} captain of the guard.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites, who had brought him down there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

column.name: text
column.value: And his master saw that the LORD {was} with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all {that} he had he put into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass from the time {that} he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was on all that he had in the house, and in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he did not concern himself with any thing he had, except the bread which he ate. And Joseph was {a} handsome {person}, and well favoured.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

column.name: text
column.value: But he refused, and said to his master's wife, Behold, my master knoweth not what {is} with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} none greater in his house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou {art} his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not to her, to lie by her, {or} to be with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass about this time, that {Joseph} went into the house to do his work; and {there was} none of the men of the house there within.

column.name: text
column.value: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and went outside.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had fled outside,

column.name: text
column.value: That she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew to us to mock us; he came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he heard that I raised my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and went outside.

column.name: text
column.value: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

column.name: text
column.value: And she spoke to him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought to us, came in to me to mock me:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as I raised my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled outside.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners {were} bound: and he was there in the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that {were} in the prison; and whatever they did there, was done by him.

column.name: text
column.value: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing {that was} under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and {that} which he did, the LORD made {it} to prosper.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, {that} the butler of the king of Egypt and {his} baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh was furious with two {of} his officers, with the chief of the butlers, and with the chief of the bakers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph {was} bound.

column.name: text
column.value: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in custody.

column.name: text
column.value: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who {were} bound in the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph came to them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they {were} sad.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that {were} with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Why look ye {so} sad to day?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, We have dreamed a dream, and {there is} no interpreter of it. And Joseph said to them, {Do} not interpretations {belong} to God? tell me {them}, I pray you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine {was} before me;

column.name: text
column.value: And on the vine {were} three branches: and it {was} as though it budded, {and} its blossoms shot forth; and its clusters brought forth ripe grapes:

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh's cup {was} in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to him, This {is} the interpretation of it: The three branches {are} three days:

column.name: text
column.value: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee to thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

column.name: text
column.value: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness to me, I pray thee, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed I was stolen away from the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

column.name: text
column.value: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, I also {was} in my dream, and, behold, {I had} three white baskets on my head:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the uppermost basket {there was} of all manner of baked goods for Pharaoh; and the birds ate them out of the basket upon my head.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph answered and said, This {is} the interpretation of it: The three baskets {are} three days:

column.name: text
column.value: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the third day, {which was} Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast to all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And he restored the chief butler to his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

column.name: text
column.value: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the chief butler did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks {with} food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his grain money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when they had gone out of the city, {and} were not {yet} far off, Joseph said to his steward, Arise, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say to them, Why have ye rewarded evil for good?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not this {the cup} in which my lord drinketh, and by which indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he overtook them, and he spoke to them these same words.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Why saith my lord these words? Far be it from us that thy servants should do according to this thing:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again to thee from the land of Canaan: how then should we steal from thy lord's house silver or gold?

column.name: text
column.value: With whomever of thy servants it shall be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Now also {let} it {be} according to your words: he with whom it shall be found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

column.name: text
column.value: And he searched, {and} began at the eldest, and stopped at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they tore their clothes, and loaded every man his donkey, and returned to the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he {was} yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to them, What deed {is} this that ye have done? knew ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we {are} my lord's servants, both we, and {he} also with whom the cup is found.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Far be it from me that I should do so: the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, go in peace to your father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judah came near to him, and said, O my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thy anger burn against thy servant: for thou {art} even as Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

column.name: text
column.value: And we said to my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou saidst to thy servants, Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And we said to my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for {if} he should leave his father, {his father} would die.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou saidst to thy servants, Except your youngest brother shall come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass when we came to thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And our father said, Go again, buy us a little food.

column.name: text
column.value: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother shall be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother shall {be} with us.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy servant my father said to us, Ye know that my wife bore me two {sons}:

column.name: text
column.value: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I have not seen him since:

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye take this also from me, and harm shall befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad {is} not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

column.name: text
column.value: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad {is} not {with us}, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy servant became surety for the lad to my father, saying, If I bring him not to thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a slave to my lord; and let the lad return with his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: For how shall I return to my father, and the lad {be} not with me? lest perhaps I see the evil that shall come on my father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph could not control himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his brethren, I {am} Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I {am} Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me here: for God sent me before you to preserve life.

column.name: text
column.value: For these two years {hath} the famine {been} in the land: and yet {there are} five years, in which {there shall} neither {be} tillage nor harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And God sent me before you to preserve for you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

column.name: text
column.value: So now {it was} not you {that} sent me here, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Haste ye, and return to my father, and say to him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down to me, delay not:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near to me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

column.name: text
column.value: And there will I nourish thee; for yet {there are} five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, should come to poverty.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that {it is} my mouth that speaketh to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father here.

column.name: text
column.value: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the report of this was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to thy brethren, This do ye; load your beasts, and go, return to the land of Canaan;

column.name: text
column.value: And take your father and your households, and come to me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take for yourselves wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

column.name: text
column.value: Also regard not your possessions; for the good of all the land of Egypt {is} yours.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

column.name: text
column.value: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred {pieces} of silver, and five changes of raiment.

column.name: text
column.value: And to his father he sent after this {manner}; ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and food for his father by the way.

column.name: text
column.value: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said to them, See that ye contend not by the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went up from Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan to Jacob their father,

column.name: text
column.value: And told him, saying, Joseph {is} yet alive, and he {is} governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said, {It is} enough; Joseph my son {is} yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I {am} God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

column.name: text
column.value: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up {again}: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gained in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

column.name: text
column.value: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Leah, which she bore to Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters {were} thirty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, {even} sixteen souls.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bore to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Benjamin {were} Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls {were} fourteen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob: all the souls {were} seven.

column.name: text
column.value: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, who came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls {were} sixty and six;

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, {were} two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, {were} seventy.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to direct his face to Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself to him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou {art} yet alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his brethren, and to his father's house, I will go up, and show Pharaoh, and say to him, My brethren, and my father's house, who {were} in the land of Canaan, are come to me;

column.name: text
column.value: And the men {are} shepherds, for their occupation hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What {is} your occupation?

column.name: text
column.value: That ye shall say, The occupation of thy servants hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, {and} also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd {is} an abomination to the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the famine {was} severe in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they had consumed the grain which they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, Go again, buy us a little food.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah spoke to him, saying, The man did solemnly protest to us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother {be} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou wilt not send {him}, we will not go down: for the man said to us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother {be} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said, Why dealt ye {so} ill with me, {as} to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, The man asked us carefully concerning our state, and our kindred, saying, {Is} your father yet alive? have ye {another} brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said to Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, {and} also our little ones.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not to thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: For except we had delayed, surely now we had returned this second time.

column.name: text
column.value: And their father Israel said to them, If {it must be} so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down to the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

column.name: text
column.value: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks, carry {it} again in your hand; it may be it {was} an oversight:

column.name: text
column.value: Take also your brother, and arise, go again to the man:

column.name: text
column.value: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved {of my children}, I am bereaved.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and arose, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring {these} men home, and slaughter {a beast}, and make ready; for {these} men shall dine with me at noon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man did as Joseph commanded; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for slaves, and our donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they spoke with him at the door of the house,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O sir, we came down indeed at the first time to buy food:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, {every} man's money {was} in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Peace {be} to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave {them} water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their donkeys feed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made ready the present for Joseph's coming at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which {was} in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked them of {their} welfare, and said, {Is} your father well, the old man of whom ye spoke? {Is} he yet alive?

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered, Thy servant our father {is} in good health, he {is} yet alive. And they bowed their heads, and made obeisance.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, {Is} this your younger brother, of whom ye spoke to me? And he said, God be gracious to thee, my son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph made haste; for his heart yearned toward his brother: and he sought {where} to weep; and he entered into {his} chamber, and wept there.

column.name: text
column.value: And he washed his face, and went out, and controlled himself, and said, Set on bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, who ate with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that {is} an abomination to the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men wondered one at another.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took {and sent} messes to them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, have come from the land of Canaan; and, behold, they {are} in the land of Goshen.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took some of his brethren, {even} five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to his brethren, What {is} your occupation? And they said to Pharaoh, Thy servants {are} shepherds, both we, {and} also our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: They said moreover to Pharaoh, We have come to sojourn in the land; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine {is} severe in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren have come to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: The land of Egypt {is} before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest {any} able men among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, How old {art} thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage {are} an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, nor have they attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to {their} families.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there was} no bread in all the land; for the famine {was} very severe, so that the land of Egypt and {all} the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph gathered all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money hath failed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought their cattle to Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread {in exchange} for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

column.name: text
column.value: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, We will not hide from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

column.name: text
column.value: Why shall we die before thy eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh: and give {us} seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from {one} end of the borders of Egypt even to its {other} end.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion {assigned them} by Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them: therefore they sold not their lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph said to the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, {here is} seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in the harvest, that ye shall give the fifth {part} to Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt to this day, {that} Pharaoh should have the fifth {part}; except the land of the priests only, {which} became not Pharaoh's.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions in it, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred and forty and seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the time drew near that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Swear to me. And he swore to him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured cows and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, seven other cows came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the {other} cows upon the brink of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed cows ate up the seven well favoured and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of grain came up upon one stalk, fat and good.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, seven thin ears and parched with the east wind sprung up after them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven fat and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, {it was} a dream.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all its wise men: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but {there was} none that could interpret them to Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then spoke the chief butler to Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh was furious with his servants, and put me in custody in the captain of the guard's house, {both} me and the chief baker:

column.name: text
column.value: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there was} there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he interpreted.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored to my office, and him he hanged.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved {himself}, and changed his raiment, and came before Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and {there is} none that can interpret it: and I have heard it said of thee, {that} thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, {It is} not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came out of the river seven cows, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, seven other cows came out after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

column.name: text
column.value: And the lean and the ill favoured cows ate up the first seven fat cows:

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they {were} still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up on one stalk, full and good:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, {and} parched with the east wind, sprung up after them:

column.name: text
column.value: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told {this} to the magicians; but {there was} none that could make known {the meaning of it} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh {is} one: God hath showed Pharaoh what he {is} about to do.

column.name: text
column.value: The seven good cows {are} seven years; and the seven good ears {are} seven years: the dream {is} one.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven thin and ill favoured cows that came up after them {are} seven years; and the seven empty ears blighted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh: What God {is} about to do he showeth to Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

column.name: text
column.value: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of the famine following; for it {shall be} very grievous.

column.name: text
column.value: And for that the dream was doubled to Pharaoh twice; {it is} because the thing {is} established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Pharaoh do {this}, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

column.name: text
column.value: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And that food shall be for reserve for the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land may not perish through the famine.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to his servants, Can we find {such a man} as this {is}, a man in whom the Spirit of God {is}?

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shown thee all this, {there is} none so discreet and wise as thou {art}:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be over my house, and according to thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

column.name: text
column.value: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him {ruler} over all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I {am} Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him for a wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went over {all} the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph {was} thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which {was} surrounding every city, he laid up in the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph gathered grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he finished numbering; for {it was} without number.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bore to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, {said he}, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the famine was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, Go to Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

column.name: text
column.value: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold to the Egyptians; and the famine became severe in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy {grain}; because the famine was severe in all lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt: go down there, and buy for us from there; that we may live, and not die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy grain in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest perhaps harm shall befall him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Israel came to buy {grain} among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph {was} the governor over the land, {and} he {it was} that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed themselves before him {with} their faces to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange to them, and spoke roughly to them; and he said to them, Where do you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said to them, Ye {are} spies; to see the nakedness of the land have ye come.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, No, my lord, but to buy food have thy servants come.

column.name: text
column.value: We {are} all one man's sons; we {are} honest {men}, thy servants are no spies.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, No, but to see the nakedness of the land have ye come.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Thy servants {are} twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest {is} this day with our father, and one {is} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to them, That {is} what I spoke to you, saying, Ye {are} spies:

column.name: text
column.value: By this ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth from here, except your youngest brother shall come here.

column.name: text
column.value: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether {there is any} truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye {are} spies.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put them all together into prison three days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to them the third day, This do, and live; {for} I fear God:

column.name: text
column.value: If ye are honest {men}, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry grain for the famine of your houses:

column.name: text
column.value: But bring your youngest brother to me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, We {are} verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben answered them, saying, Did I not speak to you, saying, Do not sin against the young man; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

column.name: text
column.value: And they knew not that Joseph understood {them}; for he spoke to them by an interpreter.

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned himself away from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and spoke with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with grain, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they loaded their donkeys with the grain, and departed from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And as one of them opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the inn, he discovered his money; for, behold, it {was} in his sack's mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his brethren, My money is restored; and, see, {it is} even in my sack: and their heart failed {them}, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What {is} this {that} God hath done to us?

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Jacob their father to the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell them; saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The man, {who is} the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And we said to him, We {are} honest {men}; we are no spies:

column.name: text
column.value: We {are} twelve brethren, sons of our father; one {is} not, and the youngest {is} this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man, the lord of the country, said to us, By this shall I know that ye {are} honest {men}; leave one of your brethren {here} with me, and take {food for} the famine of your households, and depart:

column.name: text
column.value: And bring your youngest brother to me: then shall I know that ye {are} no spies, but {that} ye {are} honest {men: then} will I deliver to you your brother, and ye shall trade in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money {was} in his sack: and when they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob their father said to them, Me have ye bereaved: Joseph {is} not, and Simeon {is} not, and ye will take Benjamin {away}: all these things are against me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reuben spoke to his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if harm shall befall him by the way in which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those who are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have dug for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which {is} beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very grievous lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the threshingfloor of Atad, they said, This {is} a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: therefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which {is} beyond Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sons did to him according as he commanded them:

column.name: text
column.value: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph returned to Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will perhaps hate us, and will certainly repay us all the evil which we did to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent a messenger to Joseph, saying, Thy father commanded before he died, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: So shall ye say to Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did to thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we {are} thy servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to them, Fear not: for {am} I in the place of God?

column.name: text
column.value: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; {but} God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as {it is} this day, to save many people alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third {generation}: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from here.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joseph died, {being} an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob called to his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you {that} which shall befall you in the last days.

column.name: text
column.value: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken to Israel your father.

column.name: text
column.value: Reuben, thou {art} my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

column.name: text
