column.value: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then thou didst defile {it}: he went up to my couch.

column.name: text
column.value: Simeon and Levi {are} brethren; instruments of cruelty {are in} their habitations.

column.name: text
column.value: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; to their assembly, my honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} their anger, for {it was} fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah, thou {art he} whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand {shall be} on the neck of thy enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah {is} a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou hast gone up: he stooped down, he crouched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

column.name: text
column.value: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh shall come; and to him {shall be} the obedience of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Binding his foal to the vine, and his donkey's colt to the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

column.name: text
column.value: His eyes {shall be} red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

column.name: text
column.value: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he {shall be} for an haven of ships; and his border {shall be} to Zidon.

column.name: text
column.value: Issachar {is} a strong donkey crouching down between two burdens:

column.name: text
column.value: And he saw that rest {was} good, and the land that {it was} pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a slave at forced labour.

column.name: text
column.value: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

column.name: text
column.value: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of Asher his bread {shall be} fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

column.name: text
column.value: Naphtali {is} a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph {is} a fruitful bough, {even} a fruitful bough by a well; {whose} branches run over the wall:

column.name: text
column.value: The archers have bitterly attacked him, and shot {at him}, and hated him:

column.name: text
column.value: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty {God} of Jacob; (from there {is} the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth beneath, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

column.name: text
column.value: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Benjamin shall raven {as} a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {are} the twelve tribes of Israel: and this {is it} which their father spoke to them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them, and said to them, I am to be gathered to my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that {is} in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

column.name: text
column.value: In the cave that {is} in the field of Machpelah, which {is} before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

column.name: text
column.value: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

column.name: text
column.value: The purchase of the field and of the cave that {is} in it {was} from the children of Heth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he drew his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered to his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, that {one} told Joseph, Behold, thy father {is} sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh to thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob said to Joseph, God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee {for} an everlasting possession.

column.name: text
column.value: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born to thee in the land of Egypt before I came to thee into Egypt, {are} mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, {and} shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet {there was} but a little way to come to Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same {is} Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who {are} these?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his father, They {are} my sons, whom God hath given me in this {place}. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, to me, and I will bless them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, {so that} he could not see. And he brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said to Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shown me also thy seed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought {them} near to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid {it} upon Ephraim's head, who {was} the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands knowingly; for Manasseh {was} the firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God who hath fed me all my life long to this day,

column.name: text
column.value: The Angel who hath redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he lifted his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father: for this {is} the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father refused, and said, I know {it}, my son, I know {it}: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel said to Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

column.name: text
column.value: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the souls that descended from Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt {already}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and became exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who knew not Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel {are} more and mightier than we:

column.name: text
column.value: Come, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it shall come to pass, that, when war happeneth, they will join with our enemies, and fight against us, and depart from the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

column.name: text
column.value: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

column.name: text
column.value: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in mortar, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, in which they made them serve, {was} with rigour.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt spoke to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of one {was} Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see {them} upon the stools; if it {shall be} a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it {shall be} a daughter, then she shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the males alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said to them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the males alive?

column.name: text
column.value: And the midwives said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women {are} not as the Egyptian women; for they {are} lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and became very mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he gave them families.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and married a daughter of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman conceived, and bore a son: and when she saw him that he {was a} beautiful {child}, she hid him three months.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she could no longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it; and she laid {it} in the flags by the river's brink.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sister stood afar off, to know what would be done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash {herself} at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had opened {it}, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This {is one} of the Hebrews' children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give {thee} thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out to his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he saw an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that {there was} no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Why smitest thou thy companion?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou didst kill the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew {water}, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How {is it that} ye are come so soon to day?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us from the hand of the shepherds, and also drew {water} enough for us, and watered the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his daughters, And where {is} he? why {is} it {that} ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And she bore {him} a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God by reason of the bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God took notice of {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken to my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, What {is} that in thy hand? And he said, A rod.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Put forth thy hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said furthermore to him, Put now thy hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand {was} leprous as snow.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Put thy hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and drew it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his {other} flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken to thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour {it} upon the dry {land}: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry {land}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the LORD, O my Lord, I {am} not eloquent, neither before, nor since thou hast spoken to thy servant: but I {am} slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand {of him whom} thou wilt send.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, {Is} not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall speak for thee to the people: and he shall be, {even} he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take this rod in thy hand, with which thou shalt perform signs.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said to him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return to my brethren who {are} in Egypt, and see whether they are yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead who sought thy life.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou perform all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thy hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel {is} my son, {even} my firstborn:

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou shalt refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, {even} thy firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast {it} at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband {art} thou to me.

column.name: text
column.value: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband {thou art}, because of the circumcision.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron spoke all the words which the LORD had spoken to Moses, and performed the signs in the sight of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said, Who {is} the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice to the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt said to them, Why do ye, Moses and Aaron, loose the people from their works? go to your burdens.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now {are} many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as before: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the number of the bricks, which they made before, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish {any} of it: for they {are} idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go {and} sacrifice to our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Let more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour in it; and let them not regard vain words.

column.name: text
column.value: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye, get for yourselves straw where ye can find it: yet not any of your work shall be diminished.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

column.name: text
column.value: And the taskmasters hastened {them}, saying, Fulfil your works, {your} daily tasks, as when there was straw.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, {and} demanded, Why have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as before?

column.name: text
column.value: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, Why dealest thou thus with thy servants?

column.name: text
column.value: There is no straw given to thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants {are} beaten; but the fault {is} in thy own people.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, Ye {are} idle, {ye are} idle: therefore ye say, Let us go {and} sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Go therefore now, {and} work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the number of bricks.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers of the children of Israel saw {that} they {were} in trouble, after it was said, Ye shall not diminish {the number} of your bricks of your daily task.

column.name: text
column.value: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made us odious in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hands to slay us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, Lord, why hast thou {so} oppressed this people? why {is} it {that} thou hast sent me?

column.name: text
column.value: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them from his land.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke to Moses, and said to him, I {am} the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, by {the name of} God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, in which they were strangers.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to the children of Israel, I {am} the LORD, and I will bring you from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will deliver you from their bondage, and I will redeem you with outstretched arm, and with great judgments:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD your God, who bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring you into the land, concerning which I swore to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for an heritage: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke so to the children of Israel: but they hearkened not to Moses by reason of anguish of spirit, and cruel bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel depart from his land.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened to me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who {am} of uncircumcised lips?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a charge to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the heads of their father's houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these {are} the families of Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these {are} the families of Simeon.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi {were} an hundred and thirty and seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath {were} an hundred and thirty and three years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these {are} the families of Levi according to their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister for a wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram {were} an hundred and thirty and seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron took Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, for a wife; and she bore him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these {are} the families of the Korhites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar Aaron's son took {one} of the daughters of Putiel for a wife; and she bore to him Phinehas: these {are} the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} they who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these {are} that Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the day {when} the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD spoke to Moses, saying, I {am} the LORD: speak thou to Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I {am} of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken to me?

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, {even} to Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush {was} not consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called to him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Come not near here: put off thy shoes from thy feet, for the place on which thou standest {is} holy ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he said, I {am} the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people who {are} in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

column.name: text
column.value: And I am come down to deliver them from the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good land and a large, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come to me: and I have also seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

column.name: text
column.value: Come now therefore, and I will send thee to Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to God, Who {am} I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this {shall be} a token to thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to God, Behold, {when} I come to the children of Israel, and shall say to them, The God of your fathers hath sent me to you; and they shall say to me, What {is} his name? what shall I say to them?

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say to the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said moreover to Moses, Thus shalt thou say to the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me to you: this {is} my name for ever, and this {is} my memorial to all generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say to them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared to me, saying, I have surely visited you, and {seen} that which is done to you in Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, to a land flowing with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and ye shall say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in its midst: and after that he will let you go.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

column.name: text
column.value: But every woman shall ask of her neighbour, and of her that dwelleth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put {them} upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall plunder the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: But Pharaoh shall not hearken to you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I stretch forth my hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses {was} eighty years old, and Aaron eighty and three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: When Pharaoh shall speak to you, saying, Show a miracle for you: then thou shalt say to Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast {it} before Pharaoh, {and} it shall become a serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

column.name: text
column.value: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not to them; as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh's heart {is} hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

column.name: text
column.value: Go to Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out to the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink to meet him; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me to thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, until now thou wouldest not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that {is} in my hand upon the waters which {are} in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fish that {is} in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thy hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and {that} there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in {vessels of} wood, and in {vessels of} stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that {were} in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that {were} in the river were turned into blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fish that {was} in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken to them; as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Go to Pharaoh, and say to him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt refuse to let {them} go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

column.name: text
column.value: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thy house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

column.name: text
column.value: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, Say to Aaron, Stretch forth thy hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron stretched his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Entreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Command me: when shall I entreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, {that} they may remain in the river only?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, To morrow. And he said, {Be it} according to thy word: that thou mayest know that {there is} none like the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried to the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gathered them together in heaps: and the land stank.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not to them; as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, This {is} the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not to them; as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say to him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms {of flies} upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms {of flies}, and also the ground on which they {are}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms {of flies} shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I {am} the LORD in the midst of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm {of flies} into the house of Pharaoh, and {into} his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm {of flies}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, It is not proper so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

column.name: text
column.value: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: entreat for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will entreat the LORD that the swarms {of flies} may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and entreated the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms {of flies} from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Yet will I bring one plague {more} upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go from here: when he shall let {you} go, he shall surely thrust you out from here altogether.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man ask of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses {was} very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even to the firstborn of the maidservant that {is} behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there hath been none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

column.name: text
column.value: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all these thy servants shall come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, Depart thou, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will depart. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken to you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel depart from his land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: For if thou shalt refuse to let {them} go, and wilt hold them still,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which {are} in the field, upon the horses, upon the donkeys, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: {there shall be} a very grievous plague.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall make a difference between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all {that} belong to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD did that thing on the next day, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth {with} sores upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth {with} sores upon man, and upon beast.

column.name: text
column.value: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not to them; as the LORD had spoken to Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Rise early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thy heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that {there is} none like me in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And in very deed for this {cause} have I raised thee up, to show {in} thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: As yet dost thou exalt thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

column.name: text
column.value: Send therefore now, {and} gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; {for upon} every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

column.name: text
column.value: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch forth thy hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there had been none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that {was} in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel {were}, there was no hail.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, I have sinned this time: the LORD {is} righteous, and I and my people {are} wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Entreat the LORD (for {it is} enough ) that there be no {more} mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands to the LORD; {and} the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth {is} the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flax and the barley were smitten: for the barley {was} in the ear, and the flax {was} in bud.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wheat and the rye were not smitten: for they {were} not grown up.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands to the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, {both} of man and of beast: it {is} mine.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the people, Remember this day, when ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this {place}: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: This day in the month Abib, ye came out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he swore to thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day {shall be} a feast to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt show thy son in that day, saying, {This is done} because of that {which} the LORD did to me when I came forth out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be for a sign to thee upon thy hand, and for a memorial between thy eyes, that the LORD'S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in its season from year to year.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he swore to thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it to thee,

column.name: text
column.value: That thou shall set apart to the LORD all that openeth the womb, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males {shall be} the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: And every firstling of a donkey thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What {is} this? that thou shalt say to him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beasts: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be for a token upon thy hand, and for frontlets between thy eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not {through} the way of the land of the Philistines, although that {was} near; for God said, Lest the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: But God led the people about, {through} the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up armed from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had solemnly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones from here with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them in the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

column.name: text
column.value: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, {from} before the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Go in to Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might show these my signs before him:

column.name: text
column.value: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron came in to Pharaoh, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: Else, if thou shalt refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy land:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the rest of that which hath escaped, which remaineth to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth to this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh's servants said to him, How long shall this man be a snare to us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron were brought again to Pharaoh: and he said to them, Go, serve the LORD your God: {but} who {are} they that shall go?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we {must hold} a feast to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look {to it}; for evil {is} before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Not so: go now ye {that are} men, and serve the LORD; for that ye desired. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out thy hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, {even} all that the hail hath left.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all {that} night; {and} when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

column.name: text
column.value: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the land of Egypt: very grievous {were they}; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

column.name: text
column.value: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they ate every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing on the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and entreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out from Pharaoh, and entreated the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out thy hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness {which} may be felt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

column.name: text
column.value: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh called to Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be left behind: let your little ones also go with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for of them must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come there.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh said to him, Depart from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in {that} day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This month {shall be} to you the beginning of months: it {shall be} the first month of the year to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak ye to all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth {day} of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of {their} fathers, a lamb for an house:

column.name: text
column.value: And if the household shall be too small for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next to his house take {it} according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take {it} from the sheep, or from the goats:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take of the blood, and strike {it} on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, in which they shall eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened bread; {and} with bitter {herbs} they shall eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: Eat not of it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted {with} fire; its head with its legs, and with its inward parts.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall let nothing of it remain till the morning; and that which remaineth of it till the morning ye shall burn with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus shall ye eat it; {with} your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it {is} the LORD'S passover.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye {are}: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy {you}, when I smite the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And this day shall be to you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whoever eateth leavened bread from the first day till the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the first day {there shall be} an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, except what every man must eat, that only may be done by you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall observe {the feast of} unleavened bread; for in this same day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first {month}, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, ye shall eat unleavened bread, till the one and twentieth day of the month at evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he shall be a stranger, or born in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, Draw out and take for yourselves a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip {it} in the blood that {is} in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that {is} in the basin; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house till the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not permit the destroyer to come in to your houses to smite {you}.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall have come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say to you, What mean you by this service?

column.name: text
column.value: That ye shall say, It {is} the sacrifice of the LORD'S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive that {was} in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaoh rose in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for {there was} not a house where {there was} not one dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Arise, {and} depart from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.

column.name: text
column.value: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We {are} all dead {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they gave to them {such things as they requested}. And they plundered the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot {that were} men, besides children.

column.name: text
column.value: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, {even} very many cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought from Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were driven from Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any food.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, {was} four hundred and thirty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the same day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD departed from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} a night to be much observed to the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this {is} that night of the LORD to be observed by all the children of Israel in their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, This {is} the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat of it:

column.name: text
column.value: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry any of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone of it.

column.name: text
column.value: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and to the stranger that sojourneth among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same day, {that} the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, opposite Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They {are} entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow them; and I will be honoured over Pharaoh, and over all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I {am} the LORD. And they did so.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

column.name: text
column.value: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Egyptians pursued them, all the horses {and} chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Pharaoh drew near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were greatly afraid: and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Moses, Because {there were} no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why hast thou dealt thus with us, to bring us out of Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not this the word that we told thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For {it had been} better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will show to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Why criest thou to me? speak to the children of Israel, that they go forward:

column.name: text
column.value: But lift thou thy rod, and stretch out thy hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry {ground} through the midst of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour over Pharaoh, and over all his host, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I have gotten me honour over Pharaoh, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness {to them}, but it gave light by night {to these}: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go {back} by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry {land}, and the waters were divided.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry {ground}: and the waters {were} a wall to them on their right hand, and on their left.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, {even} all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked to the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

column.name: text
column.value: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drove them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Stretch out thy hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, {and} all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the children of Israel walked upon dry {land} in the midst of the sea; and the waters {were} a wall to them on their right hand, and on their left.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day from the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to the LORD, and spoke, saying, I will sing to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he {is} my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} a man of war: the LORD {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: The depths have covered them: they sank to the bottom as a stone.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the greatness of thy excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, {which} consumed them as stubble.

column.name: text
column.value: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, {and} the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

column.name: text
