column.value: Who {is} like thee, O LORD, among the gods? who {is} like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful {in} praises, doing wonders?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou didst stretch out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people {who} thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided {them} in thy strength to thy holy habitation.

column.name: text
column.value: The people shall hear, {and} be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the chiefs of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thy arm they shall be {as} still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, {whom} thou hast purchased.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thy inheritance, {in} the place, O LORD, {which} thou hast made for thee to dwell in, {in} the Sanctuary, O LORD, {which} thy hands have established.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry {land} in the midst of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

column.name: text
column.value: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they {were} bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried to the LORD; and the LORD showed him a tree, {which} he cast into the waters, {and} the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he tested them,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I {am} the LORD that healeth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Elim, where {were} twelve wells of water, and seventy palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which {is} between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departure from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel said to them, O that we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, {and} when we ate bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law, or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare {that} which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, At evening, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what {are} we, that ye murmur against us?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, {This shall be}, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what {are} we? your murmurings {are} not against us, but against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to Aaron, Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak to them, saying, At evening ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that at evening the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay around the host.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness {there lay} a small round thing, {as} small as the hoar frost on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Israel saw {it}, they said one to another, It {is} manna: for they knew not what it {was}. And Moses said to them, This {is} the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, {according to} the number of your persons; take ye every man for {them} who {are} in his tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they measured {it} with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: However they hearkened not to Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was angry with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun became hot, it melted.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one {man}: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, This {is that} which the LORD hath said, To morrow {is} the rest of the holy sabbath to the LORD: bake {that} which ye will bake {to day}, and boil that ye will boil; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses ordered: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day {is} a sabbath to the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, {which is} the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that some} of the people went out on the seventh day to gather, and they found none.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

column.name: text
column.value: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people rested on the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house of Israel called its name Manna: and it {was} like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it {was} like wafers {made} with honey.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, This {is} the thing which the LORD commanded, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread that I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they ate manna, until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now an omer {is} the tenth {part} of an ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and encamped in Rephidim: and {there was} no water for the people to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the people contended with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said to them, Why chide you with me? why do ye tempt the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Why {is} this {that} thou hast brought us out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, What shall I do to this people? they are almost ready to stone me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, with which thou smotest the river, take in thy hand, and go.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will stand before thee there on the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and water shall come out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the striving of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: But Moses' hands {were} heavy; and they took a stone, and put {it} under him, and he sat on it; and Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua overcame Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this {for} a memorial in a book, and rehearse {it} in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:

column.name: text
column.value: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn {that} the LORD {will have} war with Amalek from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, {and} that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

column.name: text
column.value: And her two sons; of which the name of the one {was} Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the other {was} Eliezer; for the God of my father, {said he, was} my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

column.name: text
column.value: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Moses, I thy father in law Jethro have come to thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of {their} welfare; and they came into the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, {and} all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and {how} the LORD delivered them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jethro said, Blessed {be} the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I know that the LORD {is} greater than all gods: for in the thing in which they dealt proudly {he was} above them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What {is} this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning to evening?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to his father in law, Because the people come to me to enquire of God:

column.name: text
column.value: When they have a matter, they come to me; and I judge between one and another, and I make {them} know the statutes of God, and his laws.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses' father in law said to him, The thing that thou doest {is} not good.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that {is} with thee: for this thing {is} too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken now to my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people toward God, that thou mayest bring the causes to God:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place {such} over them, {to be} rulers of thousands, {and} rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

column.name: text
column.value: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, {that} every great matter they shall bring to thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear {the burden} with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee {so}, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

column.name: text
column.value: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third month, when the children of Israel had gone forth from the land of Egypt, the same day they came {into} the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: For they had departed from Rephidim, and had come {to} the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and {how} I bore you on eagles' wings, and brought you to myself.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a special treasure to me above all people: for all the earth {is} mine:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These {are} the words which thou shalt speak to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Lo, I come to thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Go to the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

column.name: text
column.value: And be ready for the third day: for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set bounds to the people all around, saying, Take heed to yourselves, {that ye} go {not} up upon the mount, or touch the border of it: whoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

column.name: text
column.value: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether {it be} beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went down from the mount to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the people, Be ready for the third day: come not at {your} wives.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that {were} in the camp trembled.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the lower part of the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And mount Sinai was altogether in a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke of it ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount trembled greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

column.name: text
column.value: And let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou didst charge us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Away, go down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke all these words, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not make to thee any graven image, or any likeness {of any thing} that {is} in heaven above, or that {is} in the earth beneath, or that {is} in the water under the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God {am} a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth {generation} of them that hate me;

column.name: text
column.value: And showing mercy to thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

column.name: text
column.value: But the seventh day {is} the sabbath of the LORD thy God: {in it} thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy male servant, nor thy female servant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that {is} within thy gates:

column.name: text
column.value: For {in} six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that {is} in them, and rested the seventh day: therefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

column.name: text
column.value: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not kill.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not steal.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor any thing that {is} thy neighbour's.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw {it}, they trembled, and stood afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the people, Fear not: for God is come to test you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God {was}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Thus thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make to you gods of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: An altar of earth thou shalt make to me, and shalt sacrifice on it thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thy oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come to thee, and I will bless thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou shalt lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou go up by steps to my altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall depart free for nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: If he came in by himself, he shall depart by himself: if he was married, then his wife shall depart with him.

column.name: text
column.value: If his master hath given him a wife, and she hath borne him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall depart by himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not depart free:

column.name: text
column.value: Then his master shall bring him to the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or to the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall sell his daughter to be a female slave, she shall not depart as the male slaves do.

column.name: text
column.value: If she shall not please her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her to a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he hath betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall take him another {wife}; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall not perform these three {things} for her, then shall she depart free without money.

column.name: text
column.value: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall not lie in wait, but God shall deliver {him} into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place where he shall flee.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man shall come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from my altar, that he may die.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he shall be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And if men contend together, and one shall smite another with a stone, or with {his} fist, and he shall not die, but keepeth {to} {his} bed:

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote {him} be clear: only he shall pay {for} the loss of his time, and shall cause {him} to be thoroughly healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall smite his male or female servant, with a rod, and he shall die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if he shall continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he {is} his money.

column.name: text
column.value: If men shall contend, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit shall depart {from her}, and yet no harm follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges {determine}.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {any} harm shall follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

column.name: text
column.value: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

column.name: text
column.value: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall smite the eye of his male servant, or the eye of his female servant, that it shall perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall smite out his male servant's tooth, or his female servant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: If an ox shall gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox {shall be} clear.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the ox was accustomed to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not restrained him, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatever is laid upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Whether he hath gored a son, or hath gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: If the ox shall push a male or female servant; he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or a donkey shall fall into it;

column.name: text
column.value: The owner of the pit shall make payment, {and} give money to the owner of them; and the dead {beast} shall be his.

column.name: text
column.value: And if one man's ox shall hurt another's, that he shall die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead {ox} also they shall divide.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if it shall be known that the ox was accustomed to push in time past, and his owner hath not restrained him; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: If a thief shall be found breaking through, and be smitten that he die, {there shall} no blood {be shed} for him.

column.name: text
column.value: If the sun shall have risen upon him, {there shall be} blood {shed} for him; {for} he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

column.name: text
column.value: If the theft shall be certainly found in his hand alive, whether an ox, or donkey, or sheep; he shall restore double.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

column.name: text
column.value: If fire shall break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field, shall be consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall deliver to his neighbour money or goods to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief shall be found, let him pay double.

column.name: text
column.value: If the thief shall not be found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, {to see} whether he hath put his hand to his neighbour's goods.

column.name: text
column.value: For all manner of trespass, {whether it be} for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for raiment, {or} for any manner of lost thing, which {another} challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; {and} he whom the judges shall condemn, shall pay double to his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall deliver to his neighbour a donkey, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it shall die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing {it}:

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand to his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept {of it}, and he shall not make restitution.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it shall be stolen from him, he shall make restitution to the owner of it.

column.name: text
column.value: If it shall be torn in pieces, {then} let him bring it {for} witness, {and} he shall not make good that which was torn.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall borrow {any thing} from his neighbour, and it shall be hurt, or die, the owner of it {being} not with it, he shall surely make {it} good.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} if the owner of it shall {be} with it, he shall not make {it} good: if it {be} an hired {thing}, it came for his hire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: If her father shall utterly refuse to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not allow a witch to live.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: He that sacrificeth to {any} god, except to the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt afflict them in any way, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

column.name: text
column.value: And my wrath shall burn, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt lend money to {any of} my people {that is} poor among you, thou shalt not be to him as a money-lender, neither shalt thou charge him interest.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it to him by the setting of the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: For that {is} his only covering, it {is} his raiment for his skin: what shall he sleep in? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth to me, that I will hear; for I {am} gracious.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not revile the judges, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not delay {to offer} the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise shalt thou do with thy oxen, {and} with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be holy men to me: neither shall ye eat {any} flesh {that is} torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thy hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to {do} evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to turn aside after many to pervert {judgment}:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt meet thy enemy's ox or his donkey going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt see the donkey of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take no bribe: for the bribe blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in its fruits:

column.name: text
column.value: But the seventh {year} thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, {and} with thy oliveyard.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thy ox and thy donkey may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

column.name: text
column.value: And in all {things} that I have said to you be circumspect: and make no mention of the names of other gods, neither let it be heard from thy mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times thou shalt keep a feast to me in the year.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

column.name: text
column.value: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, {which is} in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in his mother's milk.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name {is} in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and an adversary to thy adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: For my Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in to the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: I will fulfil the number of thy days.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thy enemies turn their backs to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land should become desolate, and the beast of the field should multiply against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou shalt be increased, and inherit the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee to sin against me: for if thou shalt serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

column.name: text
column.value: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair},

column.name: text
column.value: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

column.name: text
column.value: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

column.name: text
column.value: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

column.name: text
column.value: According to all that I show thee, {after} the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all its furniture, even so shall ye make {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall make an ark {of} shittim wood: two cubits and a half {shall be} its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold around it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put {them} in its four corners; and two rings {shall be} in its one side, and two rings in its other side.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the staffs into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The staffs shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make a mercy seat {of} pure gold: two cubits and a half {shall be} its length, and a cubit and a half its breadth.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make two cherubim {of} gold, {of} beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

column.name: text
column.value: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: {even} of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubim on its two ends.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cherubim shall stretch forth {their} wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces {shall look} one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which {are} upon the ark of the testimony, of all {things} which I will give thee in commandment to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also make a table {of} shittim wood: its length {shall be} two cubits, and its breadth a cubit, and its height a cubit and a half.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make for it a crown of gold around it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make for it a border of an hand breadth around it, and thou shalt make a golden crown to its border around it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that {are} on its four feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Close to the border shall the rings be for places of the staffs to bear the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make its dishes, and its spoons, and its covers, and its bowls, to cover it with: {of} pure gold shalt thou make them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set upon the table showbread before me always.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make a lampstand {of} pure gold: {of} beaten work shall the lampstand be made: its shaft, and its branches, its bowls, its knobs, and its flowers, shall be of the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And six branches shall extend from the sides of it; three branches of the lampstand from the one side, and three branches of the lampstand from the other side:

column.name: text
column.value: Three bowls made like almonds, {with} a knob and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, {with} a knob and a flower: so in the six branches that go out from the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the lampstand {shall be} four bowls made like almonds, {with} their knobs and their flowers.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there shall be} a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that go out from the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: Their knobs and their branches shall be of the same: all of it {shall be} one beaten work {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make its seven lamps: and they shall light its lamps, that they may give light in front of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And its tongs, and its snuffdishes, {shall be of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And see that thou make {them} after their pattern, which was shown thee on the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took half of the blood, and put {it} in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the hearing of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled {it} on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And they saw the God of Israel: and {there was} under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in {its} clearness.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and ate and drank.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to me on the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses rose up, and his servant Joshua: and Moses went up upon the mount of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again to you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur {are} with you: if any man hath any matters to do, let him come to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went up upon the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sight of the glory of the LORD {was} like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and he went up to the mount: and Moses was on the mount forty days and forty nights.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle {with} ten curtains {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: {with} cherubim of skilful work shalt thou make them.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of one curtain {shall be} eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

column.name: text
column.value: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and {other} five curtains {shall be} coupled one to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of {another} curtain, in the coupling of the second.

column.name: text
column.value: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that {is} in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains together with the clasps: and it shall be one tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make curtains {of} goats' {hair} to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of one curtain {shall be} thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains {shall be all} of one measure.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the front of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain {that is} outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent {of} rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above {of} badgers' skins.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle {of} shittim wood standing up.

column.name: text
column.value: Ten cubits {shall be} the length of a board, and a cubit and a half {shall be} the breadth of one board.

column.name: text
column.value: Two tenons {shall there be} in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side {there shall be} twenty boards:

column.name: text
column.value: And their forty sockets {of} silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

column.name: text
column.value: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets {of} silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make bars {of} shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings {of} gold {for} places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to its fashion which was shown thee on the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make a veil {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of skilful work: with cherubim shall it be made:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim {wood} overlaid with gold: their hooks {shall be of} gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt hang the veil under the clasps, that thou mayest bring in these within the veil the ark of the testimony: and the veil shall divide to you between the holy {place} and the most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars {of} shittim {wood}, and overlay them with gold, {and} their hooks {shall be of} gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make an altar {of} shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and its height {shall be} three cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon its four corners: its horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its fleshhooks, and its firepans: all its vessels thou shalt make {of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network {of} brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in its four corners.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put it under the rim of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make staffs for the altar, staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And the staffs shall be put into the rings, and the staffs shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

column.name: text
column.value: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shown thee on the mount, so shall they make {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward {there shall be} hangings for the court {of} fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

column.name: text
column.value: And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets {shall be of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {shall be of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And likewise for the north side in length {there shall be} hangings of an hundred {cubits} long, and its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets {of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And {for} the breadth of the court on the west side {shall be} hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

column.name: text
column.value: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward {shall be} fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The hangings of one side {of the gate shall be} fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the other side {shall be} hangings fifteen {cubits}: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the gate of the court {shall be} an hanging of twenty cubits, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: {and} their pillars {shall be} four, and their sockets four.

column.name: text
column.value: All the pillars around the court {shall have} bands of silver; their hooks {shall be of} silver, and their sockets {of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of the court {shall be} an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits {of} fine twined linen, and their sockets {of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, {shall be of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring the pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

column.name: text
column.value: In the tabernacle of the congregation outside the veil, which {is} before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: {it shall be} a statute for ever to their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And take thou to thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest's office, {even} Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to all {that are} wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and an embroidered coat, a mitre, and a waistband: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall make the ephod {of} gold, {of} blue, and {of} purple, {of} scarlet, and fine twined linen, with skilful work.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall have its two shoulderpieces joined at its two edges; and {so} it shall be joined together.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beautifully woven band of the ephod, which {is} upon it, shall be of the same, according to its work; {even of} gold, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Six of their names on one stone, and {the} six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

column.name: text
column.value: With the work of an engraver in stone, {like} the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in settings of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod {for} stones of memorial to the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make settings {of} gold;

column.name: text
column.value: And two chains {of} pure gold at the ends; {of} braided work shalt thou make them, and fasten the braided chains to the settings.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with skilful work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; {of} gold, {of} blue, and {of} purple, and {of} scarlet, and {of} fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

column.name: text
column.value: Foursquare it shall be {being} doubled; a span {shall be} its length, and a span {shall be} its breadth.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, {even} four rows of stones: {the first} row {shall be} a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: {this shall be} the first row.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second row {shall be} an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, {like} the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends {of} braided work {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the two braided {chains} of gold in the two rings {which are} on the ends of the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And {the other} two ends of the two braided {chains} thou shalt fasten in the two settings, and put {them} on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in its border, which {is} in the side of the ephod inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And two {other} rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, opposite its {other} coupling, above the beautifully woven band of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that {it} may be above the beautifully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he entereth into the holy {place}, for a memorial before the LORD continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all {of} blue.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst of it: it shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as the hole of a coat of mail, that it be not rent.

column.name: text
column.value: And {beneath} upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates {of} blue, and {of} purple, and {of} scarlet, all around on its hem; and bells of gold between them all around:

column.name: text
column.value: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe around it.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in to the holy {place} before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he may not die.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make a plate {of} pure gold, and engrave upon it, {like} the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the front of the mitre it shall be.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre {of} fine linen, and thou shalt make the waistband {of} needlework.

column.name: text
column.value: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them waistbands, and headdresses shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and on his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they enter in to the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy {place}; that they bear not iniquity, and die: {it shall be} a statute for ever to him and to his seed after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

column.name: text
column.value: To make beautifully wrought works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

column.name: text
column.value: And in cutting of stones, to set {them}, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

column.name: text
column.value: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that {is} upon it, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: And the table and its furniture, and the pure lampstand with all its furniture, and the altar of incense,

column.name: text
column.value: And the altar of burnt offering with all its furniture, and the laver and its foot,

column.name: text
column.value: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

column.name: text
column.value: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy {place}: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak thou also to the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it {is} a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that {ye} may know that I {am} the LORD that doth sanctify you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it {is} holy to you: every one that profaneth it shall surely be put to death: for whoever doeth {any} work in it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh {is} the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whoever doeth {any} work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, {for} a perpetual covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for {in} six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Moses, when he finished speaking with him upon mount Sinai, he gave two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: {of} shittim wood shalt thou make it.

column.name: text
column.value: A cubit {shall be} its length, and a cubit its breadth; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits {shall be} its height: its horns {shall be} of the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, its top, and its sides all around, and its horns; and thou shalt make for it a crown of gold all around.

column.name: text
column.value: And two golden rings shalt thou make for it under its crown, by its two corners, upon its two sides shalt thou make {it}; and they shall be for places for the staffs to bear it with.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make the staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put it before the veil that {is} by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that {is} over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall burn on it sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at the evening, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in a year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it {is} most holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there may be no plague among them, when {thou} numberest them.

column.name: text
column.value: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel {is} twenty gerahs:) an half shekel {shall be} the offering of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when {they} give an offering to the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial to the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also make a laver {of} brass, and its foot {also of} brass, to wash {in}: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water in it.

column.name: text
column.value: For Aaron and their sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it:

column.name: text
column.value: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, {even} to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take thou also to thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred {shekels}, and of sweet cinnamon half as much, {even} two hundred and fifty {shekels}, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty {shekels},

column.name: text
column.value: And of cassia five hundred {shekels}, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil an hin:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the perfumer: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation with it, and the ark of the testimony,

column.name: text
column.value: And the table and all its vessels, and the lampstand and its vessels, and the altar of incense,

column.name: text
column.value: And the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its foot.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatever toucheth them shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that {they} may minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make {any other} like it, after the composition of it: it {is} holy, {and} it shall be holy to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever compoundeth {any} like it, or whoever putteth {any} of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; {these} sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like {weight}:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the perfumer, tempered together, pure {and} holy:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt beat {some} of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be to you most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to its composition: it shall be to thee holy for the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever shall make {any} like it, to smell it, shall even be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the thing that thou shalt do to them to hallow them, to minister to me in the priest's office: Take one young bull, and two rams without blemish,

column.name: text
column.value: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: {of} wheat flour shalt thou make them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the beautifully woven band of the ephod:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour {it} upon his head, and anoint him.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt gird them with waistbands, Aaron and his sons, and put the headdresses on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt cause a bull to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bull.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt kill the bull before the LORD, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
