column.value: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bull, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the fat {that is} above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, and burn {them} upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: But the flesh of the bull, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire outside the camp: it {is} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle {it} around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put {them} with his pieces, and with his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it {is} a burnt offering to the LORD: it {is} a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take of the blood that {is} upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle {it} upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the fat {above} the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, and the right shoulder; for it {is} a ram of consecration:

column.name: text
column.value: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that {is} before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt receive them from their hands, and burn {them} upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it {is} an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it {for} a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is offered, from the ram of the consecration, {even} of {that} which {is} for Aaron, and of {that} which is for his sons:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it {is} an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, {even} their heave offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed in it, and to be consecrated in them.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and boil his flesh in the holy place.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that {is} in the basket, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall eat those things by which the atonement was made, to consecrate {and} to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat {of them}, because they {are} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any of the flesh of the consecration, or of the bread, shall remain till the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it {is} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus shalt thou do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all {things} which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt offer every day a bull {for} a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this {is that} which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

column.name: text
column.value: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at evening:

column.name: text
column.value: And with the one lamb a tenth portion of flour mixed with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine {for} a drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at evening, and shalt do to it according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to its drink offering, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {This shall be} a continual burnt offering throughout your generations {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and {the tabernacle} shall be sanctified by my glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I {am} the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Depart, {and} go up from here, thou and the people which thou hast brought out of the land of Egypt, to the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, To thy seed will I give it:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

column.name: text
column.value: To a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou {art} a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man put on him his ornaments.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, Ye {are} a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, {that} every one who sought the LORD went out to the tabernacle of the congregation, which {was} outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Moses went out to the tabernacle, {that} all the people rose, and stood every man {at} his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he had gone into the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood {at} the door of the tabernacle, and {the LORD} talked with Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand {at} the tabernacle door: and all the people rose and worshipped, every man {in} his tent door.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaketh to his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the LORD, See, thou sayest to me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, show me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation {is} thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, My presence shall go {with thee}, and I will give thee rest.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, If thy presence go not {with me}, lead us not up from here.

column.name: text
column.value: For how then shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? {is it} not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that {are} upon the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I beseech thee, show me thy glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Behold, {there is} a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a cleft of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, These {are} the words which the LORD hath commanded, that {ye} should do them.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whoever doth work in it shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take ye from among you an offering to the LORD: whoever {is} of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,

column.name: text
column.value: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair},

column.name: text
column.value: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

column.name: text
column.value: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

column.name: text
column.value: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

column.name: text
column.value: The tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets,

column.name: text
column.value: The ark, and its staffs, {with} the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering,

column.name: text
column.value: The table, and its staffs, and all its vessels, and the showbread,

column.name: text
column.value: The lampstand also for the light, and its furniture, and its lamps, with the oil for the light,

column.name: text
column.value: And the incense altar, and its staffs, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: The altar of burnt offering, with its brasen grate, its staffs, and all its vessels, the laver and its foot,

column.name: text
column.value: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

column.name: text
column.value: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

column.name: text
column.value: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy {place}, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came, every one whose heart was stirred, and every one whom his spirit made willing, {and} they brought the LORD'S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, {and} brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and necklaces, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered {offered} an offering of gold to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' {hair}, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Every one that offered an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the women that were wise hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, {both} of blue, and of purple, {and} of scarlet, and of fine linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the women whose heart moved them in wisdom spun goats' {hair}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

column.name: text
column.value: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Israel brought a willing offering to the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

column.name: text
column.value: And to make beautifully wrought works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

column.name: text
column.value: And in the cutting of stones, to set {them}, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of skilful work.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, {both} he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath filled them with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the skilful workmen, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, {even} of them that do any work, and of those that make beautifully wrought work.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like the first: and I will write upon {these} tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou didst break.

column.name: text
column.value: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me on the top of the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hewed two tables of stone like the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

column.name: text
column.value: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear {the guilty}; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, to the third and to the fourth {generation}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it {is} a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thy inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do wonders, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou {art} shall see the work of the LORD: for it {is} a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

column.name: text
column.value: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name {is} Jealous, {is} a jealous God:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go astray after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and {one} call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

column.name: text
column.value: And thou take of their daughters to thy sons, and their daughters go astray after their gods, and make thy sons go astray after their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

column.name: text
column.value: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out of from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: All that openeth the womb {is} mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, {whether} ox or sheep, {that is male }.

column.name: text
column.value: But the firstling of a donkey thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou shalt not redeem {him}, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in time of plowing and in harvest thou shalt rest.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times in the year shall all your males appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will drive out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God three times in the year.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring to the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in his mother's milk.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses knew not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses called to them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him: and Moses talked with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward all the children of Israel came near: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And {till} Moses finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out. And he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel {that} which he was commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bezaleel made the ark {of} shittim wood: two cubits and a half {was} the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold for it all around.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cast for it four rings of gold, {to be set} by its four corners; even two rings upon its one side, and two rings upon its other side

column.name: text
column.value: And he made staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the staffs into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the mercy seat {of} pure gold: two cubits and a half {was} the length of it, and one cubit and a half the breadth of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made two cherubim {of} gold, beaten out of one piece he made them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

column.name: text
column.value: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the {other} end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubim on its two ends.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cherubim spread out {their} wings on high, {and} covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; {even} toward the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the table {of} shittim wood: two cubits {was} its length, and a cubit its breadth, and a cubit and a half its height:

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made for it a crown of gold all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he made for it a border of an handbreadth all around; and made a crown of gold for its border all around.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that {were} in its four feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Close to the border were the rings, the places for the staffs to bear the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the vessels which {were} upon the table, its dishes, and its spoons, and its bowls, and its covers to cover with, {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the lampstand {of} pure gold: {of} beaten work he made the lampstand; its shaft, and its branch, its bowls, its knobs, and its flowers, were of the same:

column.name: text
column.value: And six branches proceeding from its sides; three branches of the lampstand from the one side of it, and three branches of the lampstand from its other side:

column.name: text
column.value: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knob and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knob and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the lampstand {were} four bowls made like almonds, its knobs, and its flowers:

column.name: text
column.value: And a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, and a knob under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Their knobs and their branches were of the same: all of it {was} one beaten work {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuffdishes, {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} a talent of pure gold he made it, and all its vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the incense altar {of} shittim wood: the length of it {was} a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; {it was} foursquare; and two cubits {was} the height of it; the horns of it were of the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid it with pure gold, {both} the top of it, and its sides all around, and its horns: also he made for it a crown of gold all around.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made two rings of gold for it under its crown, by its two corners, upon its two sides, to be places for the staffs to bear it with.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the perfumer.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the altar of burnt offering {of} shittim wood: five cubits {was} the length of it, and five cubits the breadth of it; {it was} foursquare; and its height was three cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made its horns on its four corners; its horns were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, {and} the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels of it he made {of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under its rim beneath to the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, {to be} places for the staffs.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the staffs {of} shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the staffs into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with; he made the altar hollow with boards.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the laver {of} brass, and the foot of it {of} brass, of the lookingglasses of serving {women}, who served {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court {were of} fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

column.name: text
column.value: Their pillars {were} twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {were of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the north side {the hangings were} an hundred cubits, their pillars {were} twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the west side {were} hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: The hangings of the one side {of the gate were} fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, {were} hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

column.name: text
column.value: All the hangings of the court all around {were} of fine twined linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sockets for the pillars {were of} brass; the hooks of the pillars and their bands {of} silver; and the overlaying of their tops {of} silver; and all the pillars of the court had bands of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hanging for the gate of the court {was} needlework, {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits {was} the length, and the height in the breadth {was} five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

column.name: text
column.value: And their pillars {were} four, and their sockets {of} brass four; their hooks {of} silver, and the overlaying of their tops and their bands {of} silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court all around, {were of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the sum of the tabernacle, {even} of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, {for} the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And with him {was} Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skilful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

column.name: text
column.value: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the holy {place}, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation {was} an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and seventy and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

column.name: text
column.value: A bekah for every man, {that is}, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their tops, and made bands for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the brass of the offering {was} seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: And with this he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

column.name: text
column.value: And the sockets of the court all around, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court all around.

column.name: text
column.value: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, {even} every one whose heart moved him to come to the work to do it:

column.name: text
column.value: And they received from Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it {with}. And they brought yet to him free offerings every morning.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

column.name: text
column.value: For the things they had were sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

column.name: text
column.value: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: he made them {with} cherubim of skilful work.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of one curtain {was} twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains {were} all of one size.

column.name: text
column.value: And he coupled the five curtains one to another: and {the other} five curtains he coupled one to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the extremity of {another} curtain, in the coupling of the second.

column.name: text
column.value: Fifty loops he made in one curtain, and fifty loops he made in the edge of the curtain which {was} in the coupling of the second: the loops held one {curtain} to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so it became one tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made curtains {of} goats' {hair} for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of one curtain {was} thirty cubits, and four cubits {was} the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains {were} of one size.

column.name: text
column.value: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made fifty loops upon the outer edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made fifty clasps {of} brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made a covering for the tent {of} rams' skins dyed red, and a covering {of} badgers' skins above {that}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made boards for the tabernacle {of} shittim wood, standing up.

column.name: text
column.value: The length of a board {was} ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

column.name: text
column.value: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

column.name: text
column.value: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the other side of the tabernacle, {which is} toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

column.name: text
column.value: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

column.name: text
column.value: And two boards he made for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at its head, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were eight boards; and their sockets {were} sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

column.name: text
column.value: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings {of} gold {to be} places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made a veil {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: {with} cherubim he made it of skilful work.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made for it four pillars {of} shittim {wood}, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks {were of} gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

column.name: text
column.value: And its five pillars with their hooks: and he overlaid their tops and their bands with gold: but their five sockets {were of} brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy {place}, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the ephod {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

column.name: text
column.value: And they beat the gold into thin plates, and cut {it into} wires, to work {it} in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, {with} skilful work.

column.name: text
column.value: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple {it} together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beautifully woven band of his ephod, that {was} upon it, {was} of the same, according to its work; {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in settings of gold, engraved, as signets are engraved, with the names of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, {that they should be} stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the breastplate {of} skilful work, like the work of the ephod; {of} gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

column.name: text
column.value: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span {was} the length of it, and a span the breadth of it, {being} doubled.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set in it four rows of stones: {the first} row {was} a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this {was} the first row.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: {they were} inclosed in settings of gold in their inclosings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the stones {were} according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, {like} the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, {of} braided work {of} pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made two settings {of} gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the two ends of the two braided chains they fastened in the two settings, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made two rings of gold, and put {them} on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which {was} on the side of the ephod inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made two {other} golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, opposite its {other} coupling, above the beautifully woven band of the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And they bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the beautifully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the robe of the ephod {of} woven work, all {of} blue.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there was} an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of a coat of mail, {with} a band around the hole, that it should not rend.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates {of} blue, and purple, and scarlet, {and} twined {linen}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made bells {of} pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, around between the pomegranates;

column.name: text
column.value: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe to minister {in}; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made coats {of} fine linen {of} woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

column.name: text
column.value: And a mitre {of} fine linen, and goodly headdresses {of} fine linen, and linen breeches {of} fine twined linen,

column.name: text
column.value: And a waistband {of} fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, {of} needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made the plate of the holy crown {of} pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, {like} the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten {it} on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, and all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,

column.name: text
column.value: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the veil of the covering,

column.name: text
column.value: The ark of the testimony, and its staffs, and the mercy seat,

column.name: text
column.value: The table, {and} all its vessels, and the showbread,

column.name: text
column.value: The pure lampstand, {with} its lamps, {even with} the lamps to be set in order, and all its vessels, and the oil for light,

column.name: text
column.value: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

column.name: text
column.value: The brasen altar, and its grate of brass, its staffs, and all its vessels, the laver and its foot,

column.name: text
column.value: The hangings of the court, its pillars, and its sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, its cords, and its pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: The cloths of service to do service in the holy {place}, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses looked upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mount, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, Arise, make us gods, which shall go before us; for {as for} this Moses, the man that brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron said to them, Break off the golden earrings, which {are} in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring {them} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people broke off the golden earrings which {were} in their ears, and brought {them} to Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And he received {them} at their hand, and fashioned it with an engraving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These {are} thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Aaron saw {it}, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow {is} a feast to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early on the next morning, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Go, go down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted {themselves}:

column.name: text
column.value: They have turned aside quickly from the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, These {are} thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it {is} a stiffnecked people:

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may burn against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath burn against thy people, which thou hast brought forth from the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the Egyptians speak, and say, For evil did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou sworest by thine own self, and saidst to them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give to your seed, and they shall inherit {it} for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do to his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony {were} in his hand: the tables {were} written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other {were} they written.

column.name: text
column.value: And the tables {were} the work of God, and the writing {was} the writing of God, engraved upon the tables.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, {There is} a noise of war in the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, {It is} not the voice of {them that} shout for mastery, neither {is it} the voice of {them that} cry for being overcome: {but} the noise of {them that} sing do I hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as he came near to the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger burned, and he cast the tables from his hands, and broke them beneath the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt {it} in the fire, and ground {it} to powder, and scattered {it} upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink {of it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron, What did this people to thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord burn: thou knowest the people, that they {are set} on evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For they said to me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for {as for} this Moses, the man that brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, Whoever hath any gold, let them break {it} off. So they gave {it} to me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Moses saw that the people {were} naked; (for Aaron had made them naked to {their} shame among their enemies:)

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who {is} on the LORD'S side? {let him come} to me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, {and} go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I shall make an atonement for your sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses returned to the LORD, and said, O, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Whoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now go, lead the people to {the place} of which I have spoken to thee: behold, my angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD afflicted the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put in it the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the lampstand, and light its lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set up the court all around, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that {is} in it, and shalt hallow it, and all its vessels: and it shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all its vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its foot, and sanctify it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister to me in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister to me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first {day} of the month, {that} the tabernacle was reared up.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and reared up its pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staffs on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the lampstand in the tent of the congregation, opposite the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil:

column.name: text
column.value: And he burnt sweet incense on it; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set up the hanging {at} the door of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the altar of burnt offering {by} the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash {with}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet from it:

column.name: text
column.value: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near to the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he reared up the court all around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

column.name: text
column.value: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

column.name: text
column.value: For the cloud of the LORD {was} upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, If any man of you shall bring an offering to the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, {even} of the herd, and of the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: If his offering shall {be} a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall kill the bull before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood around upon the altar that {is by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into its pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that {is} on the fire which {is} upon the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, {to be} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his offering {be} of the flocks, {namely}, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that {is} on the fire which {is} upon the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring {it} all, and burn {it} upon the altar: it {is} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD shall {be} of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn {it} on the altar; and its blood shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall pluck away its crop with its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cleave it with its wings, {but} shall not divide {it} asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that {is} upon the fire: it {is} a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when any will offer a meat offering to the LORD, his offering shall be {of} fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense on it:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take from it his handful of its flour, and of its oil, with all of its frankincense; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, {to be} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant of the meat offering {shall be} Aaron's and his sons': {it is} a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt bring an oblation of a meat offering baked in the oven, {it shall be} unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy oblation shall {be} a meat offering {baked} in a pan, it shall be {of} fine flour unleavened, mixed with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil on it: it {is} a meat offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy oblation shall {be} a meat offering {baked} in the fryingpan, it shall be made {of} fine flour with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things to the LORD: and when it is presented to the priest, he shall bring it to the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial of it, and shall burn {it} upon the altar: {it is} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And that which is left of the meat offering {shall be} Aaron's and his sons': {it is} a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: No meat offering, which ye shall bring to the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them to the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

column.name: text
column.value: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou allow the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thy offerings thou shalt offer salt.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits to the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of grain dried by the fire, {even} grain beaten out of full ears.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense on it: it {is} a meat offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, {part} of its beaten grain, and {part} of its oil, with all its frankincense: {it is} an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his oblation shall {be} a sacrifice of peace offering, if he shall offer {it} of the herd; whether a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,

column.name: text
column.value: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} on them, which {is} by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which {is} upon the wood that {is} on the fire: {it is} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering to the LORD shall {be} of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood of it around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, {and} the whole rump, that shall he take off close to the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,

column.name: text
column.value: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, which {is} by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: {it is} the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his offering shall {be} a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer of it his offering, {even} an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,

column.name: text
column.value: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, which {is} by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: {it is} the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat {is} the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: {It shall be} a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which ought not to be done, and shall break any of them:

column.name: text
column.value: If the priest that is anointed shall sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bull without blemish to the LORD for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring the bull to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bull's head, and kill the bull before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bull's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall put {some} of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which {is} in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bull at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which {is at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bull for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that {is} upon the inwards,

column.name: text
column.value: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} upon them, which {is} by the flanks, and the fat above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away,

column.name: text
column.value: As it was taken off from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the skin of the bull, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

column.name: text
column.value: Even the whole bull shall he carry forth outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the whole congregation of Israel shall sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done {somewhat against} any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which should not be done, and are guilty;

column.name: text
column.value: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bull for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bull before the LORD: and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bull's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall dip his finger {in some} of the blood, and sprinkle {it} seven times before the LORD, {even} before the veil.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall put {some} of the blood upon the horns of the altar which {is} before the LORD, that {is} in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which {is at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn {it} upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall do with the bull as he did with the bull for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall carry forth the bull outside the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bull: it {is} a sin offering for the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: When a ruler hath sinned, and done {somewhat} through ignorance {against} any of the commandments of the LORD his God {concerning things} which should not be done, and is guilty;

column.name: text
column.value: Or if his sin, in which he hath sinned, shall come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it {is} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any one of the common people shall sin through ignorance, while he doeth {somewhat against} any of the commandments of the LORD {concerning things} which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

column.name: text
column.value: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, shall come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take of the blood of it with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all its blood at the bottom of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take away all its fat, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn {it} upon the altar for a sweet savour to the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood of it at the bottom of the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take away all its fat, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire to the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a soul shall sin, and hear the voice of an oath, and {be} a witness, whether he hath seen or known {of it}; if he doth not utter {it}, then he shall bear his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if a soul shall touch any unclean thing, whether a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and it shall be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he shall touch the uncleanness of man, whatever uncleanness {it may be} that a man shall be defiled with, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth {of it}, then he shall be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if a soul shall make an oath, pronouncing with {his} lips to do evil, or to do good, whatever {it may be} that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth {of it}, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these {things}, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that {thing}:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall not be able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring them to the priest, who shall offer {that} which {is} for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide {it} asunder:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it {is} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer the second {for} a burnt offering, according to the custom: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall not be able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put {any} frankincense on it: for it {is} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, {even} a memorial of it, and burn {it} on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire to the LORD: it {is} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and {the remnant} shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: If a soul shall commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass to the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add to it the fifth part, and give it to the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a soul shall sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he knew {it} not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance in which he erred and knew {it} not, and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: If a soul shall sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie to his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

column.name: text
column.value: Or hath found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning in it:

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took by force, or the thing which he obtained by deceit, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

column.name: text
