column.value: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add to it the fifth part more, {and} give it to him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This {is} the law of the burnt offering: It {is} the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning on it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which {is} upon the meat offering, and shall burn {it} upon the altar {for} a sweet savour, {even} the memorial of it, to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remainder of it shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it {to them for} their portion of my offerings made by fire; it {is} most holy, as {is} the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

column.name: text
column.value: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. {It shall be} a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half of it at night.

column.name: text
column.value: In a pan it shall be made with oil; {and when it is} baked, thou shalt bring it in: {and} the baked pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer {for} a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: {it is} a statute for ever to the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.

column.name: text
column.value: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This {is} the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it {is} most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever shall touch the flesh of it shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of its blood upon any garment, thou shalt wash that on which it was sprinkled in the holy place.

column.name: text
column.value: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken: and if it shall be boiled in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

column.name: text
column.value: All the males among the priests shall eat of it: it {is} most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And no sin offering, of which {any} of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to make atonement in the holy {place}, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise this {is} the law of the trespass offering: it {is} most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood of it shall he sprinkle around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer of it all its fat; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

column.name: text
column.value: And the two kidneys, and the fat that {is} on them, which {is} by the flanks, and the fat {that is} above the liver, with the kidneys, that shall he take away:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar {for} an offering made by fire to the LORD: it {is} a trespass offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Every male among the priests shall eat of it: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it {is} most holy.

column.name: text
column.value: As the sin offering {is}, so {is} the trespass offering: {there is} one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement with it shall have {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, {even} the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the meat offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.

column.name: text
column.value: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one {as much} as another.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides the cakes, he shall offer {for} his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation {for} an heave offering to the LORD, {and} it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the sacrifice of his offering shall {be} a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the next day also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

column.name: text
column.value: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {any} of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings shall be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed to him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean {thing} shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that shall be clean shall eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the soul that eateth {of} the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that {pertain} to the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean {thing, as} the uncleanness of man, or {any} unclean beast, or any abominable unclean {thing}, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which {pertain} to the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used for any other purpose: but ye shall by no means eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, even the soul that eateth {it} shall be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, {whether} of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever soul {it may be} that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings to the LORD shall bring his oblation to the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, that shall he bring, that the breast may be waved {for} a wave offering before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

column.name: text
column.value: And the right shoulder shall ye give to the priest {for} an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for {his} part.

column.name: text
column.value: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is the portion} of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day {when} he presented them to minister to the LORD in the priest's office;

column.name: text
column.value: Which the LORD commanded to be given to them by the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, {by} a statute for ever throughout their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

column.name: text
column.value: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations to the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bull for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

column.name: text
column.value: And gather thou all the congregation together to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the congregation, This {is} the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the waistband, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the beautifully woven band of the ephod, and bound {it} to him with it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, {even} upon his front, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that {was} in it, and sanctified them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sprinkled part of it upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, both the laver and its foot, to sanctify them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with waistbands, and put headdresses upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the bull for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bull for the sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew {it}; and Moses took the blood, and put {it} around upon the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took all the fat that {was} upon the inwards, and the fat {above} the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned {it} upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: But the bull, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire outside the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And he killed {it}; and Moses sprinkled the blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

column.name: text
column.value: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it {was} a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, {and} an offering made by fire to the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew {it}; and Moses took of its blood, and put {it} upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that {was} upon the inwards, and the fat {above} the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that {was} before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put {them} on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

column.name: text
column.value: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them {for} a wave offering before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt {them} on the altar upon the burnt offering: they {were} consecrations for a sweet savour: it {is} an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the breast, and waved it {for} a wave offering before the LORD: {for} of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which {was} upon the altar, and sprinkled {it} upon Aaron, {and} upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, {and} his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that {is} in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation {in} seven days, until the days of your consecration shall be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

column.name: text
column.value: As he hath done this day, {so} the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye abide {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the eighth day, {that} Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer {them} before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, {both} of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: Also a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mixed with oil: for to day the LORD will appear to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought {that} which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, This {is} the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron, Go to the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron therefore went to the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which {was} for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the fat above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled around upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And they presented the burnt offering to him, with the pieces of it, and the head: and he burnt {them} upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he washed the inwards and the legs, and burnt {them} upon the burnt offering on the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which {was} the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful of it, and burnt {it} upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: He slew also the bull and the ram {for} a sacrifice of peace offerings, which {was} for the people: and Aaron's sons presented to him the blood, which he sprinkled {it} around upon the altar,

column.name: text
column.value: And the fat of the bull and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth {the inwards}, and the kidneys, and the fat {above} the liver:

column.name: text
column.value: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved {for} a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came out a fire from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: {which} when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took each of them his censer, and put fire in it, and put incense on it, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses said to Aaron, This {is} what the LORD spoke, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD {is} upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: {it shall be} a statute for ever throughout your generations:

column.name: text
column.value: And that ye may make a difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

column.name: text
column.value: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken to them by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it {is} most holy:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it {is} thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for {they are} thy due, and thy sons' due, {which} are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave {it for} a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron {who were} left {alive}, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Why have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it {is} most holy, and {God} hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the blood of it was not brought within the holy {place}: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy {place}, as I commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron said to Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and {if} I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And when Moses heard {that}, he was content.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, These {are} the beasts which ye may eat among all the beasts that {are} on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, {and} cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he {is} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he {is} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he {is} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the swine, though he divideth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he {is} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they {are} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: These shall ye eat of all that {are} in the waters: whatever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that have not fins nor scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living creature which {is} in the waters, they {shall be} an abomination to you:

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be even an abomination to you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that {shall be} an abomination to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are they which} ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they {are} an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

column.name: text
column.value: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

column.name: text
column.value: Every raven after his kind;

column.name: text
column.value: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

column.name: text
column.value: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

column.name: text
column.value: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

column.name: text
column.value: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: All fowls that creep, going upon {all} four, {shall be} an abomination to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon {all} four, which have legs above their feet, to leap with upon the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} these of them ye may eat; the locust after its kind, and the bald locust after its kind, and the beetle after its kind, and the grasshopper after its kind.

column.name: text
column.value: But all {other} flying creeping things, which have four feet, {shall be} an abomination to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And for these ye shall be unclean: whoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever beareth {any} of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: {The carcases} of every beast which divideth the hoof, and {is} not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, {are} unclean to you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever goeth upon its paws, among all manner of beasts that go on {all} four, those {are} unclean to you: whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: they {are} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: These also {shall be} unclean to you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after its kind,

column.name: text
column.value: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} unclean to you among all that creep: whoever doth touch them, when they are dead, shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon whatever {any} of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether {it is} any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel {it is}, in which {any} work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening; so it shall be cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And every earthen vessel, into which {any} of them falleth, whatever {is} in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

column.name: text
column.value: Of all food which may be eaten, {that} on which {such} water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every {such} vessel shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And every {thing} on which {any part} of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; {whether} an oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: {for} they {are} unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, {in which there is} plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {any part} of their carcase shall fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it {shall be} clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if {any} water shall be put upon the seed, and {any part} of their carcase shall fall on it, it {shall be} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, shall die; he that toucheth its carcase shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that eateth of its carcase shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: he also that beareth its carcase shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth {shall be} an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever goeth upon the belly, and whatever goeth upon {all} four, or whatever hath many feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they {are} an abomination.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled by them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {am} the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I {am} holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {am} the LORD that bringeth you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I {am} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, {if} the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive {and} clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

column.name: text
column.value: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird {that was} killed over the running water:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth parts of fine flour {for} a meat offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest that maketh {him} clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take one male lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering {is} the priest's, {so is} the trespass offering: it {is} most holy:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take {some} of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take {some} of the log of oil, and pour {it} into the palm of his own left hand:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that {is} in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And of the rest of the oil that {is} in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant of the oil that {is} in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he {is} poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb {for} a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

column.name: text
column.value: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take {some} of the blood of the trespass offering, and put {it} upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger {some} of the oil that {is} in his left hand seven times before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall put of the oil that {is} in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the oil that {is} in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} such as he is able to get, the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law {of him} in whom {is} the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get {that which pertaineth} to his cleansing.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: When ye shall have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

column.name: text
column.value: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me {there is} as it were a plague in the house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest shall enter to see the plague, that all that {is} in the house may not be made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, {if} the plague {is} in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, which in sight {are} lower than the wall;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, {if} the plague is spread in the walls of the house;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague {is}, and they shall cast them into an unclean place outside the city:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within on all sides, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off outside the city into an unclean place:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take other stones, and put {them} in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the plague shall return, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, {if} the plague is spread in the house, it {is} a fretting leprosy in the house: it {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry {them} forth out of the city to an unclean place.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the priest shall come in, and look {upon it}, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

column.name: text
column.value: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

column.name: text
column.value: And for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

column.name: text
column.value: To teach when {it is} unclean, and when {it is} clean: this {is} the law of leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, {because of} his issue he {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh shall run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it {is} his uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: Every bed, on which he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, on which he sitteth, shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that sitteth on {any} thing on which he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he that hath the issue shall spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever saddle he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the evening: and he that beareth {any of} those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And whomever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth who hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer them, the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man's seed of copulation shall go from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And every garment, and every skin, on which is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman also with whom man shall lie {with} seed of copulation, they shall {both} bathe {themselves} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a woman shall have an issue, {and} her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it {be} on {her} bed, or on any thing on which she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man shall lie with her at all, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed on which he lieth shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a woman shall have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it shall run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she {shall be} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Every bed on which she lieth all the days of her issue shall be to her as the bed of her separation: and whatever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: But if she shall be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day she shall take to her two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that {is} among them.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of him that hath an issue, and {of him} whose seed goeth from him, and he is defiled by it;

column.name: text
column.value: And of her that is sick of her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a woman hath conceived seed, and borne a boy: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: But if she shall bear a girl, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying sixty and six days.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This {is} the law for her that hath borne a male or a female.

column.name: text
column.value: And if she shall not be able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Speak to Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy {place} within the veil before the mercy seat, which {is} upon the ark; that he may not die: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy {place}: with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen waistband, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these {are} holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and {so} put them on.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall offer his bull of the sin offering, which {is} for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him {for} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, {and} to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall bring the bull of the sin offering, which {is} for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which {is} for himself:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring {it} within the veil:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that {is} upon the testimony, that he may not die:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle {it} with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that {is} for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall make an atonement for the holy {place}, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy {place}, until he shall come out, and shall have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall go out to the altar that {is} before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bull, and of the blood of the goat, and put {it} upon the horns of the altar on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he hath finished making an atonement for the holy {place}, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send {him} away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

column.name: text
column.value: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities to a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy {place}, and shall leave them there:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bull {for} the sin offering, and the goat {for} the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy {place}, shall {one} carry forth outside the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And {this} shall be a statute for ever to you: {that} in the seventh month, on the tenth {day} of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, {whether it be} one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

column.name: text
column.value: For on that day shall {the priest} make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, {that} ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: It {shall be} a sabbath of rest to you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, {even} the holy garments:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And this shall be an everlasting statute to you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them; This {is} the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever man {there may be} of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth {it} outside of the camp,

column.name: text
column.value: And bringeth it not to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering to the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed to that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

column.name: text
column.value: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to the priest, and offer them {for} peace offerings to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices to demons, with which they have committed idolatry. This shall be a statute for ever to them throughout their generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to them, Whatever man {there may be} of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

column.name: text
column.value: And bringeth it not to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it to the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever man {there may be} of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: For the life of the flesh {is} in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it {is} the blood {that} maketh an atonement for the soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I said to the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever man {there may be} of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, who hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} the life of all flesh; the blood of it {is} for the life of it: therefore I said to the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh {is} its blood: whoever eateth it shall be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: And every soul that eateth that which died {of itself}, or that which was torn {with beasts, whether it is} one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe {himself} in water, and be unclean until the evening: then shall he be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he doth not wash {them}, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a swelling, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh {like} the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest, or to one of his sons the priests:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and {when} the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight {is} deeper than the skin of his flesh, it {is} a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: If the bright spot {is} white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight not deeper than the skin, and the hair of it not turned white; then the priest shall shut up {him that hath} the plague seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, {if} the plague in his sight is at a stay, {and} the plague spreadeth not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, {if} the plague {is} somewhat dark, {and} the plague spreadeth not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it {is but} a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the scab shall spread much in the skin, after he hath been seen by the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen by the priest again:

column.name: text
column.value: And {if} the priest shall see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} a leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall see {him}: and, behold, {if} the swelling {is} white in the skin, and it hath turned the hair white, and {there is} living raw flesh in the swelling;

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a leprosy shall break out in the skin, and the leprosy shall cover all the skin of {him that hath} the plague from his head even to his foot, wherever the priest looketh;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, {if} the leprosy hath covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce {him} clean {that hath} the plague: it is all turned white: he {is} clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: {for} the raw flesh {is} unclean: it {is} a leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if the raw flesh shall turn again, and be changed into white, he shall come to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, {if} the plague is turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce {him} clean {that hath} the plague: he {is} clean.

column.name: text
column.value: The flesh also, in which, {even} in the skin of it, was a boil, and is healed,

column.name: text
column.value: And in the place of the boil there shall be a white swelling, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be showed to the priest;

column.name: text
column.value: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it {is} in sight lower than the skin, and the hair of it is turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest shall look on it, and, behold, {there are} no white hairs in it, and {if} it {is} not lower than the skin, but somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And if it hath spread much in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} a plague.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the bright spot shall stay in its place, {and} not spread, it {is} a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Or if there is {any} flesh, in the skin of which {there is} a hot burning, and the live {flesh} that burneth hath a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, {if} the hair in the bright spot is turned white, and it {is in} sight deeper than the skin; it {is} a leprosy broken out of the burning: therefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} the plague of leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest shall look on it, and, behold, {there is} no white hair in the bright spot, and it {is} no lower than the {other} skin, but {is} somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: {and} if it is spread much in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} the plague of leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the bright spot shall stay in its place, {and} not spread in the skin, but {be} somewhat dark; it {is} a swelling of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it {is} an inflammation of the burning.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man or woman shall have a plague upon the head or the beard;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it {is} in sight deeper than the skin; {and there is} in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it {is} a dry scall, {even} a leprosy upon the head or beard.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the priest shall look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it {is} not in sight deeper than the skin, and no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up {him that hath} the plague of the scall seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, {if} the scall spreadeth not, and there is in it no yellow hair, and the scall {is} not in sight deeper than the skin;

column.name: text
column.value: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up {him that hath} the scall seven days more:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, {if} the scall is not spread in the skin, nor {is} in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the scall shall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall is spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the scall shall be in his sight at a stay, and there is black hair grown in it; the scall is healed, he {is} clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man also or a woman shall have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, {even} white bright spots;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, {if} the bright spots in the skin of their flesh {are} darkish white; it {is} a freckled spot {that} groweth in the skin; he {is} clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man whose hair hath fallen off his head, he {is} bald; {yet is} he clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he {is} forehead bald: {yet is} he clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And if there is in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it {is} a leprosy sprung up on his bald head, or his bald forehead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, {if} the swelling of the sore {is} white reddish on his bald head, or on his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

column.name: text
column.value: He is a leprous man, he {is} unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague {is} in his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And the leper in whom the plague {is}, his clothes shall be torn, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days in which the plague {shall be} in him he shall be defiled; he {is} unclean: he shall dwell alone; outside the camp {shall} his habitation {be}.

column.name: text
column.value: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, {whether} a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

column.name: text
column.value: Whether in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

column.name: text
column.value: And if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it {is} a plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up {that which hath} the plague seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague is spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, {or} in any work that is made of skin; the plague {is} an active leprosy; it {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, in which the plague is: for it {is} an active leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague is not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall command that they wash {the thing} in which the plague {is}, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall look on the plague, after it is washed: and, behold, {if} the plague hath not changed its colour, and the plague hath not spread; it {is} unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it eateth away inward, {whether} it {is} bare within or without.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague {is} somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

column.name: text
column.value: And if it shall appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it {is} a spreading {plague}: thou shalt burn that in which the plague {is} with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatever thing of skin {it is}, which thou shalt wash, if the plague hath departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, I am the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: After the doings of the land of Egypt, in which ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, where I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall perform my judgments, and keep my ordinances, to walk in them: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man doeth, he shall live in them: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover {their} nakedness: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she {is} thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it {is} thy father's nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, {whether} born at home, or born abroad, {even} their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, {even} their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs {is} thy own nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten by thy father, she {is} thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she {is} thy father's near kinswoman.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she {is} thy mother's near kinswoman.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she {is} thy aunt.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she {is} thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it {is} thy brother's nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; {for} they {are} her near kinswomen: it {is} wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex {her}, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life {time}.

column.name: text
column.value: Also thou shalt not approach to a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through {the fire} to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it {is} abomination.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself with it: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down with it: it {is} confusion.

column.name: text
column.value: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

column.name: text
column.value: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit its iniquity upon it, and the land itself spueth out her inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit {any} of these abominations; {neither} any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

column.name: text
column.value: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, who {were} before you, and the land is defiled;)

column.name: text
column.value: That the land may not spue you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that {were} before you.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit {them} shall be cut off from among their people.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye keep my ordinance, that {ye} commit not {any one} of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves in them: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say to them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God {am} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn ye not to idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the next day: and if any thing shall remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it shall be eaten at all on the third day, it {is} abominable; it shall not be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore {every one} that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

column.name: text
