column.value: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather {every} grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob {him}: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: {but} in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not go up and down {as} a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbour, and not allow sin upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle breed with another kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mixed seed: neither shall a garment of linen and woollen woven together come upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever lieth carnally with a woman, that {is} a slave, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, {even} a ram for a trespass offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count its fruit as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised to you: it shall not be eaten of.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy to praise the LORD {with}.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of its fruit, that it may yield to you its increase: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not eat {any thing} with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not shave around the sides of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks upon you: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be an harlot; lest the land should fall to harlotry, and the land become full of wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Regard not them that have mediums, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a stranger shall sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not oppress him.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be to you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in length, in weight, or in volume.

column.name: text
column.value: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I {am} the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Speak to the priests the sons of Aaron, and say to them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

column.name: text
column.value: But for his kin, that is near to him, {that is}, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

column.name: text
column.value: And for his sister a virgin, that is near to him, who hath had no husband; for her he may be defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} he shall not defile himself, {being} a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, {and} the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not take a wife {that is} an harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he {is} holy to his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy to thee: for I the LORD, who sanctifieth you, {am} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the daughter of any priest, if she shall profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he that is} the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God {is} upon him: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

column.name: text
column.value: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, {or} an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD sanctifieth him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron, saying, Whoever {he may be} of thy seed in their generations that hath {any} blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: For whatever man {he may be} that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

column.name: text
column.value: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

column.name: text
column.value: Or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or eczema, or scabs, or hath his stones broken;

column.name: text
column.value: No man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall eat the bread of his God, {both} of the most holy, and of the holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Only he shall not go in to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he may not profane my sanctuaries: for I the LORD sanctifieth them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses told {it} to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name {in those things} which they hallow to me: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, Whoever {he may be} of all your seed among your generations, that approacheth the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow to the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever man of the seed of Aaron {is} a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. And whoever toucheth any thing {that is} unclean {by} the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

column.name: text
column.value: Or whoever toucheth any creeping thing, by which he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he hath;

column.name: text
column.value: The soul who hath touched any such shall be unclean until evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he shall wash his flesh with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sun is set, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it {is} his food.

column.name: text
column.value: That which dieth of itself, or is torn {by beasts}, he shall not eat to defile himself with it: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall therefore keep my ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD sanctifieth them.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall no stranger eat {of} the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat {of} the holy thing.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest shall buy {any} person with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his food.

column.name: text
column.value: If the priest's daughter also shall be {married} to a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the priest's daughter shall be a widow, or divorced, and shall have no child, and have returned to her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's food: but there shall no stranger eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall eat {of} the holy thing unknowingly, then he shall put to it the fifth {part}, and shall give {it} to the priest with the holy thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: Or allow them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD sanctifieth them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, Whoever of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer to the LORD for a burnt offering;

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye shall offer} at your own will a male without blemish, of the cattle, of the sheep, or of the goats.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} whatever hath a blemish, {that} shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish {his} vow, or a freewill offering in cattle or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be in it no blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a running sore, or eczema, or scabs, ye shall not offer these to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Either a bull or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer {for} a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not offer to the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make {any offering of it} in your land.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption {is} in them, {and} blemishes {are} in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day on it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And {whether it is} cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, offer {it} at your own will.

column.name: text
column.value: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the next morning: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I {am} the LORD who doth hallow you,

column.name: text
column.value: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whoever {he be} of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth {any} of his seed to Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed to Molech, and kill him not:

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go astray after him, to commit harlotry with Molech, from among their people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the soul that turneth after such as have mediums, and after wizards, to go astray after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I {am} the LORD who sanctifieth you.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood {shall be} upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man that committeth adultery with {another} man's wife, {even he} that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood {shall be} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood {shall be} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man also shall lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood {shall be} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall take a wife and her mother, it {is} wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a woman shall approach to any beast, and lie down with it, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood {shall be} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it {is} a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it {is} an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, where I bring you to dwell in it, may not spue you out.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have said to you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I {am} the LORD your God, who have separated you from {other} people.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall therefore make a difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be holy to me: for I the LORD {am} holy, and have separated you from {other} people, that ye should be mine.

column.name: text
column.value: A man also or a woman that hath a medium, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood {shall be} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, {Concerning} the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim {to be} holy convocations, {even} these {are} my feasts.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day {is} the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work {in it}: it {is} the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the feasts of the LORD, holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourteenth {day} of the first month at evening {is} the LORD'S passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fifteenth day of the same month {is} the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days: in the seventh day {is} an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work {in it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye shall have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest to the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the next day after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf a male lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And its meat offering {shall be} two tenth parts of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD {for} a sweet savour: and its drink offering {shall be} of wine, the fourth {part} of an hin.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor roasted grain, nor new growth, until the same day that ye have brought an offering to your God: {it shall be} a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall count to you from the next day after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

column.name: text
column.value: Even to the next day after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth parts: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baked with leaven; {they are} the firstfruits to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bull, and two rams: they shall be {for} a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, {even} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits {for} a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall proclaim on the same day, {that} it may be an holy convocation to you: ye shall do no servile work {in it: it shall be} a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them to the poor, and to the stranger: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first {day} of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall do no servile work {in it}: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Also on the tenth {day} of this seventh month {there shall be} a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation to you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it {is} a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: For whatever soul {it may be} that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever soul {it may be} that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall do no manner of work: {it shall be} a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: It {shall be} to you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth {day} of the month at evening, from evening to evening, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month {shall be} the feast of tabernacles {for} seven days to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day {shall be} an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work {in it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation to you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD: it {is} a solemn assembly; {and} ye shall do no servile work {in it}.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim {to be} holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon its day:

column.name: text
column.value: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days: on the first day {shall be} a sabbath, and on the eighth day {shall be} a sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. {It shall be} a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

column.name: text
column.value: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses declared to the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command the children of Israel, that they bring to thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Outside the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening to the morning before the LORD continually: {it shall be} a statute for ever in your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall order the lamps upon the pure lampstand before the LORD continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth parts shall be in one cake.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six in a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon {each} row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, {even} an offering made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, {being taken} from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it {is} most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father {was} an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish {woman} and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

column.name: text
column.value: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name {of the LORD}, and cursed. And they brought him to Moses: (and his mother's name {was} Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

column.name: text
column.value: And they put him in custody, that the mind of the LORD might be shown to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Bring forth him that hath cursed outside the camp; and let all that heard {him} lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, Whoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, {and} all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name {of the LORD}, shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

column.name: text
column.value: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in its fruit;

column.name: text
column.value: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest to the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy untrimmed vine: {for} it is a year of rest to the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sabbath of the land shall be food for you; for thee, and for thy male servant, and for thy female servant, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

column.name: text
column.value: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that {are} in thy land, shall all the increase of it be food.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years to thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be to thee forty and nine years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth {day} of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout {all} the land to all its inhabitants: it shall be a jubilee to you; and ye shall return every man to his possession, and ye shall return every man to his family.

column.name: text
column.value: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be to you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather {the grapes} in it of thy untrimmed vine.

column.name: text
column.value: For it {is} the jubilee; it shall be holy to you: ye shall eat the increase of it out of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man to his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt sell any to thy neighbour, or buy {any thing} from thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

column.name: text
column.value: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, {and} according to the number of years of the fruits he shall sell to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price of it, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for {according} to the number {of the years} of the fruits doth he sell to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell in it in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of old fruit until the ninth year; until its fruits come in ye shall eat {of} the old {store}.

column.name: text
column.value: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land {is} mine; for ye {are} strangers and sojourners with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy brother shall have become poor, and have sold {some} of his possession, and if any of his kin shall come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the man shall have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

column.name: text
column.value: Then let him count the years of the sale of it, and restore the balance to the man to whom he sold it; that he may return to his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall not be able to restore {it} to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return to his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; {within} a full year may he redeem it.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it shall not be redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that {is} in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But the houses of the villages which have no walls around them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.

column.name: text
column.value: However the cities of the Levites, {and} the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in {the year of} jubilee: for the houses of the cities of the Levites {are} their possession among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the field of the common land of their cities may not be sold; for it {is} their perpetual possession.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy brother shall have become poor, and falleth into poverty among you; then thou shalt relieve him: {yea, though he may be} a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Take thou no interest of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor lend him thy food for increase.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, {and} to be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy brother {that dwelleth} by thee shall have become poor, and be sold to thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a slave:

column.name: text
column.value: {But} as an hired servant, {and} as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, {and} shall serve thee to the year of jubilee:

column.name: text
column.value: And {then} shall he depart from thee, {both} he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers shall he return.

column.name: text
column.value: For they {are} my servants, which I brought out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Both thy male and female slaves, which thou shalt have, {shall be} from the heathen that are around you; from them shall ye buy male and female slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover of the children of the strangers that sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that {are} with you, whom they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit {them for} a possession; they shall be your slaves for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a sojourner or a stranger shall become rich by thee, and thy brother {that dwelleth} by him shall become poor, and sell himself to the stranger {or} sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:

column.name: text
column.value: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

column.name: text
column.value: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or {any} that is near of kin to him of his family may redeem him; or if he is able, he may redeem himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him to the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

column.name: text
column.value: If {there shall be} yet many years {behind}, according to them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

column.name: text
column.value: And if there shall remain but few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, {and} according to his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: {and the other} shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall not be redeemed in these {years}, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, {both} he, and his children with him.

column.name: text
column.value: For to me the children of Israel {are} servants; they {are} my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up {any} image of stone in your land, to bow down to it: for I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: And your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make {you} afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will have respect to you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their slaves; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not hearken to me, and will not do all these commandments;

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul shall abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, {but} that ye break my covenant:

column.name: text
column.value: I also will do this to you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning fever, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken to me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

column.name: text
column.value: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye shall walk contrary to me, and will not hearken to me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your {high} ways shall be desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary to me;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I also walk contrary to you, and I will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of {my} covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when I have broke the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver {you} your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye will not for all this hearken to me, but walk contrary to me;

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will walk contrary to you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your remains upon the remains of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies who dwell in it shall be astonished at it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter you among the nations, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye {are} in your enemies' land; {even} then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon them that are left {alive} of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

column.name: text
column.value: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary to me;

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} I also have walked contrary to them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts shall be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

column.name: text
column.value: The land also shall be left by them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet for all that, when they shall be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I {am} the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When a man shall make a difficult vow, the persons {shall be} for the LORD by thy estimation.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even to sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it {shall be} a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} from five years old even to twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} from a month old even to five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation {shall be} three shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} from sixty years old and above; if a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} a beast, of which men bring an offering to the LORD, all that {any man} giveth of such to the LORD shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange of it shall be holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice to the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, {who art} the priest, so shall it be.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth {part} of it to thy estimation.

column.name: text
column.value: And when a man shall sanctify his house {to be} holy to the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth {part} of the money of thy estimation to it, and it shall be his.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall sanctify to the LORD {some part} of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed of it: an homer of barley seed {shall be valued} at fifty shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain, even to the year of the jubilee, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth {part} of the money of thy estimation to it, and it shall be assured to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he shall have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

column.name: text
column.value: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession of it shall be the priest's.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {a man} shall sanctify to the LORD a field which he hath bought, which {is} not of the fields of his possession;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of thy estimation, {even} to the year of the jubilee: and he shall give thy estimation in that day, {as} a holy thing to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return to him of whom it was bought, {even} to him to whom the possession of the land {belonged}.

column.name: text
column.value: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD'S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether ox, or sheep: it {is} the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: And if {it shall be} of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem {it} according to thy estimation, and shall add to it a fifth {part} of it: or if it shall be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

column.name: text
column.value: However no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to the LORD of all that he hath, {both} of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing {is} most holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: None devoted, which shall be devoted by men, shall be redeemed; {but} shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the tithe of the land, {whether} of the seed of the land, {or} of the fruit of the tree, {is} the LORD'S: {it is} holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man will at all redeem {any} of his tithes, he shall add to it the fifth {part} of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, {even} of whatever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he shall change it at all, then both it and its substitute shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first {day} of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of {their} names, every male by their polls;

column.name: text
column.value: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

column.name: text
column.value: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the men that shall stand with you: of {the tribe of} Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by {their} names:

column.name: text
column.value: And they assembled all the congregation on the first {day} of the second month, and they declared their genealogies after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

column.name: text
column.value: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Reuben, {were} forty and six thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Simeon, {were} fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Gad, {were} forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Judah, {were} seventy and four thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Issachar, {were} fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Zebulun, {were} fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Joseph, {namely}, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Ephraim, {were} forty thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Manasseh, {were} thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Benjamin, {were} thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Dan, {were} sixty and two thousand and seven hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Asher, {were} forty and one thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, {even} of the tribe of Naphtali, {were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, {being} twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had spoken to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all things that {belong} to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels; and they shall minister to it, and shall encamp around the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the tabernacle moveth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites shall encamp around the tabernacle of testimony, that there may be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Every man of the children of Israel shall encamp by his own standard, with the banner of their father's house: far off from the tabernacle of the congregation shall they encamp.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah encamp throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab {shall be} captain of the children of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} seventy and four thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that shall encamp next to him {shall be} the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar {shall be} captain of the children of Issachar.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon {shall be} captain of the children of Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah {were} an hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first move forward.

column.name: text
column.value: On the south side {shall be} the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben {shall be} Elizur the son of Shedeur.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty and six thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who encamp by him {shall be} the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon {shall be} Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad {shall be} Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben {were} an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall move forward in the second rank.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall move forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they move forward, every man in his place by their standards.

column.name: text
column.value: On the west side {shall be} the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim {shall be} Elishama the son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And by him {shall be} the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh {shall be} Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin {shall be} Abidan the son of Gideoni.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim {were} an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

column.name: text
column.value: The standard of the camp of Dan {shall be} on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan {shall be} Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} sixty and two thousand and seven hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that encamp by him {shall be} the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher {shall be} Pagiel the son of Ocran.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} forty and one thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali {shall be} Ahira the son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, {were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan {were} an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go last with their standards.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} those who were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts {were} six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they encamped by their standards, and so they moved forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: These also {are} the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day {that} the LORD spoke with Moses in mount Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons: they {are} wholly given to him out of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the womb among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

column.name: text
column.value: Because all the firstborn {are} mine; {for} on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine they shall be: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These {are} the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Gershon {was} the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these {are} the families of the Gershonites.

column.name: text
column.value: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {even} those that were numbered of them {were} seven thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the head of the house of the father of the Gershonites {shall be} Eliasaph the son of Lael.

column.name: text
column.value: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation {shall be} the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which {is} around the tabernacle, and the altar, and the cords of it for all the service of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Kohath {was} the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these {are} the families of the Kohathites.

column.name: text
column.value: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {were} eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the head of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites {shall be} Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: And their charge {shall be} the ark, and the table, and the lampstand, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary by which they minister, and the hanging, and all the service of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest {shall be} chief over the leaders of the Levites, {and have} the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Merari {was} the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these {are} the families of Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, {were} six thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And the head of the house of the father of the families of Merari {was} Zuriel the son of Abihail: {these} shall encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.

column.name: text
column.value: And {under} the custody and charge of the sons of Merari {shall be} the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and all the service concerning it,

column.name: text
column.value: And the pillars around the court, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

column.name: text
column.value: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, {even} before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, {shall be} Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, {were} twenty and two thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I {am} the LORD ) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and seventy and three.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and seventy and three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take {them}: (the shekel {is} twenty gerahs:)

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt give to Aaron and to his sons the money, by which the odd number of them is to be redeemed,

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money; a thousand three hundred and sixty and five {shekels}, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: This {shall be} the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, {about} the most holy things:

column.name: text
column.value: And when the camp moveth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering veil, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

column.name: text
column.value: And shall put on it the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over {it} a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staffs of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon the table of showbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put on it the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover with: and the continual bread shall be on it:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staffs of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its snuffdishes, and all its oil vessels, by which they serve it:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put {it} upon a bar.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to it its staffs:

column.name: text
