column.value: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, by which they minister in the sanctuary, and put {them} in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put {them} on a bar:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall put upon it all its vessels, by which they minister about it, {even} the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to it its staffs.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to move forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear {it}: but they shall not touch {any} holy thing, lest they die. These {things are} the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest {pertaineth} the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, {and} the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that {is} in it, in the sanctuary, and in its vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: But thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, its covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that {is} above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which {is} around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

column.name: text
column.value: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint to them in charge all their burdens.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge {shall be} under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,

column.name: text
column.value: And the pillars around the court, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and eighty.

column.name: text
column.value: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whoever is defiled by the dead:

column.name: text
column.value: Both male and female shall ye put out, outside the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst of which I dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out outside the camp: as the LORD spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person shall be guilty;

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal of it, and add to it the fifth {part} of it, and give {it} to {him} against whom he hath trespassed.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the man shall have no kinsman to recompense the trespass to, let the trespass be recompensed to the LORD, {even} to the priest; besides the ram of the atonement, by which an atonement shall be made for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, shall be his.

column.name: text
column.value: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatever any man giveth to the priest, it shall be his.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, If any man's wife shall go astray, and commit a trespass against him,

column.name: text
column.value: And a man shall lie with her carnally, and it shall be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept secret, and she be defiled, and {there be} no witness against her, neither she be taken {with the manner};

column.name: text
column.value: And the spirit of jealousy shall come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy shall come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the man bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth {part} of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense on it; for it {is} an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put {it} into the water:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which {is} the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say to the woman, If no man hath lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness {with another} instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou hast gone aside {to another} instead of thy husband, and if thou art defiled, and some man hath lain with thee besides thy husband:

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say to the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to perish, and thy belly to swell;

column.name: text
column.value: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make {thy} belly to swell, and {thy} thigh to perish: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot {them} out with the bitter water:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, {and become} bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, {even} the memorial of it, and burn {it} upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, {that}, if she is defiled, and hath done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, {and become} bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall perish: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the woman is not defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth astray {to another} instead of her husband, and is defiled;

column.name: text
column.value: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he is jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When either man or woman shall separate {themselves} to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate {themselves} to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: He shall separate {himself} from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days shall be fulfilled, in which he separateth {himself} to the LORD, he shall be holy, {and} shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days that he separateth {himself} to the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God {is} upon his head.

column.name: text
column.value: All the days of his separation he {is} holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man shall die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall consecrate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer his offering to the LORD, one male lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

column.name: text
column.value: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall bring {them} before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall offer the ram {for} a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put {it} in the fire which {is} under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put {them} upon the hands of the Nazarite, after {the hair of} his separation is shaven:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall wave them {for} a wave offering before the LORD: this {is} holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, {and of} his offering to the LORD for his separation, besides {that} which his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, In this way ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Aaron, and say to him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light opposite the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron did so; he lighted its lamps opposite the lampstand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And this work of the lampstand {was of} beaten gold, to its shaft, to the flowers of it, {was} beaten work: according to the pattern which the LORD had showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus shalt thou do to them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and {so} make themselves clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Then let them take a young bull with its meat offering, {even} fine flour mixed with oil, and another young bull shalt thou take for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD {for} an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls: and thou shalt offer the one {for} a sin offering, and the other {for} a burnt offering, to the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them {for} an offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that shall the Levites go in to perform the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them {for} an offering.

column.name: text
column.value: For they {are} wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, {even instead of} the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel {are} mine, {both} man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have given the Levites {as} a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there may be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them {as} an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that went the Levites in to perform their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This {is it} that {which pertaineth} to the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service {of it}, and shall serve no more:

column.name: text
column.value: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do to the Levites concerning their charge.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at its appointed season.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, ye shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all its rites, and according to all its ceremonies, shall ye keep it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at evening in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

column.name: text
column.value: And those men said to him, We {are} defiled by the dead body of a man: why are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or {be} in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourteenth day of the second month at evening they shall keep it, {and} eat it with unleavened bread and bitter {herbs}.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall leave none of it to the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man that {is} clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover to the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner of it, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the day that the tabernacle was erected the cloud covered the tabernacle, {namely}, the tent of the testimony: and at evening there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: So it was always: the cloud covered it {by day}, and the appearance of fire by night.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} it was, when the cloud abode from evening to the morning, and {that} the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether {it was} by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Or {whether it was} two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining above it, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all its instruments, both the altar and all its vessels, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

column.name: text
column.value: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who {were} the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take {it} of them, that they may be to perform the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

column.name: text
column.value: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging to them {was that} they should bear upon their shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: And the princes offered for dedicating the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: And his offering {was} one silver platter, the weight of which {was} an hundred and thirty {shekels}, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them {were} full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meat offering:

column.name: text
column.value: One spoon of ten {shekels} of gold, full of incense:

column.name: text
column.value: One young bull, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

column.name: text
column.value: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

column.name: text
column.value: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, five lambs of the first year: this {was} the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

column.value: This {was} the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve platters of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

column.name: text
column.value: Each platter of silver {weighing} an hundred and thirty {shekels}, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels {weighed} two thousand and four hundred {shekels}, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

column.name: text
column.value: The golden spoons {were} twelve, full of incense, {weighing} ten {shekels} apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons {was} an hundred and twenty {shekels}.

column.name: text
column.value: All the oxen for the burnt offering {were} twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings {were} twenty and four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This {was} the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Moses had entered into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking to him from off the mercy seat that {was} upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they blow {but} with one {trumpet}, then the princes, {who are} heads of the thousands of Israel, shall assemble themselves to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

column.name: text
column.value: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the twentieth {day} of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel took their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

column.name: text
column.value: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first {place} went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host {was} Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

column.name: text
column.value: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar {was} Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari moved forward, bearing the tabernacle.

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.value: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher {was} Pagiel the son of Ocran.

column.name: text
column.value: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali {was} Ahira the son of Enan.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus {were} the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they moved forward.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, I will give it to you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my kindred.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if thou wilt go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do to us, the same will we do to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to seek a resting place for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cloud of the LORD {was} upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the ark moved forward, that Moses said, Arise, LORD, and let thy enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, to the many thousands of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard {it}; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed {them that were} in the uttermost parts of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people cried to Moses; and when Moses prayed to the LORD, the fire was quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the mixed multitude that {was} among them fell to lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic:

column.name: text
column.value: But now our soul {is} dried away: {there is} nothing at all, besides this manna, {before} our eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And the manna {was} as coriander seed, and the colour of it as the colour of bdellium.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} the people went about, and gathered {it}, and ground {it} in mills, or beat {it} in a mortar, and baked {it} in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the LORD, Why hast thou afflicted thy servant? and why have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

column.name: text
column.value: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say to me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the nursing child, to the land which thou sworest to their fathers?

column.name: text
column.value: Where should I get flesh to give to all this people? for they weep to me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because {it is} too heavy for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou dealest thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the Spirit who {is} upon thee, and will put {it} upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou mayest not bear {it} thyself alone.

column.name: text
column.value: And say thou to the people, Sanctify yourselves for to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for {it was} well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

column.name: text
column.value: {But} even a whole month, until it shall come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome to you: because ye have despised the LORD who {is} among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, The people, among whom I {am}, {are} six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice for them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice for them?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Is the LORD'S hand shortened? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass to thee or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the spirit that {was} upon him, and gave {it} to the seventy elders: and it came to pass, {that}, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

column.name: text
column.value: But there remained two {of the} men in the camp, the name of the one {was} Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they {were} of them that were recorded, but went not out to the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, {one} of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to him, Enviest thou for my sake? O that all the LORD'S people were prophets, {and} that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses withdrew into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let {them} fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, around the camp, and as it were two cubits {high} upon the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people stood up all that day, and all {that} night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread {them} all abroad for themselves around the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And while the flesh {was} yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah to Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married: for he had married a Cushite woman.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the man Moses {was} very meek, above all the men who {were} upon the face of the earth.)

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, Come out ye three to the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood {in} the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Hear now my words: If there is a prophet among you, {I} the LORD will make myself known to him in a vision, {and} will speak to him in a dream.

column.name: text
column.value: My servant Moses {is} not so, who {is} faithful in all my house.

column.name: text
column.value: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: why then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam {became} leprous, {white} as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, {she was} leprous.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron said to Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received {again}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in {again}.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward the people departed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said to them, O that we had died in the land of Egypt! or if only we had died in this wilderness!

column.name: text
column.value: And why hath the LORD brought us to this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, {who were} of them that searched the land, tore their clothes:

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, {is} an exceeding good land.

column.name: text
column.value: If the LORD delighteth in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they {are} bread for us: their defence hast departed from them, and the LORD {is} with us: fear them not.

column.name: text
column.value: But all the congregation said to stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be before they believe me, for all the signs which I have shown among them?

column.name: text
column.value: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear {it}, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

column.name: text
column.value: And they will tell {it} to the inhabitants of this land: {for} they have heard that thou LORD {art} among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and {that} thy cloud standeth over them, and {that} thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {if} thou shalt kill {all} this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my LORD be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing {the guilty}, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth {generation}.

column.name: text
column.value: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

column.name: text
column.value: But {as} truly {as} I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because all those men who have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

column.name: text
column.value: Surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

column.name: text
column.value: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land into which he went; and his seed shall possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn ye, and pass into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: How long {shall I bear with} this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, {As truly as} I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:

column.name: text
column.value: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,

column.name: text
column.value: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, {concerning} which I swore to make you dwell in it, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

column.name: text
column.value: But {as for} you, your dead bodies, they shall fall in this wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your harlotries, until your dead bodies shall be wasted in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, {even} forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, {even} forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

column.name: text
column.value: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it to all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men, whom Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing a slander upon the land,

column.name: text
column.value: Even those men that brought the bad report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, {who were} of the men that went to search the land, lived {still}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses told these sayings to all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we {are here}, and will go up to the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, Why now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.

column.name: text
column.value: Go not up, for the LORD {is} not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites {are} there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But they presumed to go up to the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and smote them, {even} to Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye shall have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

column.name: text
column.value: And will make an offering by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he that offereth his offering to the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth part of flour mixed with the fourth {part} of an hin of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth {part} of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare {for} a meat offering two tenth parts of flour mixed with the third {part} of an hin of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third {part} of an hin of wine, {for} a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou preparest a bull {for} a burnt offering, or {for} a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he bring with a bull a meat offering of three tenth parts of flour mixed with half an hin of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, {for} an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall it be done for one bull, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

column.name: text
column.value: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

column.name: text
column.value: All that are born in the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a stranger shall sojourn with you, or whoever shall {be} among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.

column.name: text
column.value: One ordinance {shall be both} for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth {with you}, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye {are}, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye come into the land where I bring you,

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough {for} an heave offering: as {ye do} the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye offer it.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the first of your dough ye shall give to the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken to Moses,

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded {Moses}, and henceforward among your generations;

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, if {any thing} shall be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour to the LORD, with its meat offering, and its drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it {is} ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people {were} in ignorance.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any soul shall sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a female goat of the first year for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, {both for} him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the soul that doeth {any thing} presumptuously, {whether he be} born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity {shall be} upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put him in custody, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation brought him outside the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a cord of blue:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be to you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go astray:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of {their} fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod {shall be} for the head of the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt lay them in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, by which they murmur against you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, {even} twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron {was} among their rods.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses laid the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that on the next day Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi had budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a sign against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses did {so}: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever approacheth the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined to thee, and minister to thee: but thou and thy sons with thee {shall minister} before the tabernacle of witness.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come near the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be joined to thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come near to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you {they are} given {as} a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the veil; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office {to you} as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of my heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; to thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: This shall be thine of the most holy things, {reserved} from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, {shall be} most holy for thee and for thy sons.

column.name: text
column.value: In the most holy {place} shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them to thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer to the LORD, them have I given to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} whatever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring to the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thy house shall eat {of} it.

column.name: text
column.value: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

column.name: text
column.value: Every thing that openeth the womb in all flesh, which they bring to the LORD, {whether} of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thy estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which {is} twenty gerahs.

column.name: text
column.value: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they {are} holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat {for} an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

column.name: text
column.value: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, have I given to thee, and to thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it {is} a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD to thee and to thy seed with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I {am} thy part and thy inheritance among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, {even} the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come near the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: {it shall be} a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer {as} an heave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said to them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus speak to the Levites, and say to them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, {even} a tenth {part} of the tithe.

column.name: text
column.value: And {this} your heave offering shall be reckoned to you, as though {it were} the grain of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give of them the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best of it, {even} the hallowed part from it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt say to them, When ye have offered the best of it, then it shall be counted to the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it {is} your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have offered from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, in which {is} no blemish, {and} upon which never came a yoke:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall give her to Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth outside the camp, and {one} shall slay her before his face:

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast {it} into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man {that is} clean shall gather the ashes of the heifer, and lay {them} outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it {is} a purification for sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: and it shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he shall not purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness {is} yet upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that {is} in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And for an unclean {person} they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be added to them in a vessel:

column.name: text
column.value: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip {it} in the water, and sprinkle {it} upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

column.name: text
column.value: And the clean {person} shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be a perpetual statute to them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever the unclean {person} toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth {it} shall be unclean until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men {were} heads of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Joseph, {namely}, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up this {way} southward, and go up to the mountain:

column.name: text
column.value: And see the land, what it {is}; and the people that dwell in it, whether they {are} strong or weak, few or many;

column.name: text
column.value: And what the land {is} that they dwell in, whether it {is} good or bad; and what cities {they are} that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

column.name: text
column.value: And what the land {is}, whether it {is} rich or barren, whether there is wood in it, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time {was} the time of the firstripe grapes.

column.name: text
column.value: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went up by the south, and came to Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, {were}. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it between two upon a staff; and {they brought} of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

column.name: text
column.value: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they returned from searching the land after forty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told him, and said, We came to the land where thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this {is} the fruit of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the people {are} strong that dwell in the land, and the cities {are} walled, {and} very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

column.name: text
column.value: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the banks of the Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people; for they {are} stronger than we.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought an bad report of the land which they had searched to the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have passed to search it, {is} a land that eateth up its inhabitants; and all the people that we saw in it {are} men of a great stature.

column.name: text
column.value: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, {who come} of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took {men}:

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

column.name: text
column.value: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, {Ye take} too much upon you, seeing all the congregation {are} holy, every one of them, and the LORD {is} among them: why then do ye raise yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And when Moses heard {it}, he fell upon his face:

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will show who {are} his, and {who is} holy; and will cause {him} to come near to him: even {him} whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near to him.

column.name: text
column.value: This do; Take for yourselves censers, Korah, and all his company;

column.name: text
column.value: And put fire in them, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be {that} the man whom the LORD doth choose, he {shall be} holy: {ye take} too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

column.name: text
column.value: {Seemeth it but} a small thing to you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath brought thee near {to him}, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

column.name: text
