column.value: For which cause {both} thou and all thy company {are} gathered together against the LORD: and what {is} Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: who said, We will not come up:

column.name: text
column.value: {Is it} a small thing that thou hast brought us out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

column.name: text
column.value: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each {of you} his censer.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on them, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

column.name: text
column.value: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be angry with all the congregation?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the congregation, saying, Withdraw yourselves from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: So they withdrew from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said, by this ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for {I have} not {done them} of my own mind.

column.name: text
column.value: If these men shall die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; {then} the LORD hath not sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the LORD shall make a new thing, and the earth shall open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that {appertain} to them, and they go down alive into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he had finished speaking all these words, that the ground opened up that {was} under them:

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that {appertained} to Korah, and all {their} goods.

column.name: text
column.value: They, and all that {appertained} to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel that {were} around them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up {also}.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

column.name: text
column.value: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates {for} a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad {plates for} a covering of the altar:

column.name: text
column.value: {To be} a memorial to the children of Israel, that no stranger, who {is} not of the seed of Aaron, should come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he may not be as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Remove from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire in it from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly to the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel moved forward, and encamped in the plains of Moab on this side of Jordan {by} Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moab was greatly afraid of the people, because they {were} many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all {that are} around us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor {was} king of the Moabites at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent messengers therefore to Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which {is} by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there hast a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide opposite to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse for me this people; for they {are} too mighty for me: perhaps I shall prevail, {that} we may smite them, and {that} I may drive them out of the land: for I know that he whom thou blessest {is} blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

column.name: text
column.value: And God came to Balaam, and said, What men {are} these with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent to me, {saying},

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, {there hast} a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they {are} blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, Go back to your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming to me:

column.name: text
column.value: For I will promote thee to very great honour, and I will do whatever thou sayest to me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse this people for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say to me more.

column.name: text
column.value: And God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, If the men come to call thee, rise, {and} go with them; but yet the word which I shall say to thee, that shalt thou perform.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam rose in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his donkey, and his two servants {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the donkey turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the donkey, to turn her into the way.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall {being} on this side, and a wall on that side.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself against the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where {was} no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the donkey with a staff.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to the donkey, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the donkey said to Balaam, {Am} not I thy donkey, upon which thou hast rid ever since {I was} thine to this day? was I ever accustomed to do so to thee? And he said, Nay.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to him, Why hast thou smitten thy donkey these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because {thy} way is perverse before me:

column.name: text
column.value: And the donkey saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will return again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak to thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to a city of Moab, which {is} in the border of Arnon, which {is} in the utmost border.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to thee to call thee? why camest thou not to me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I have come to thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjathhuzoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up to the high places of Baal, that from there he might see the utmost {part} of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} king Arad the Canaanite, who dwelt in the south, heard that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took {some} of them prisoners.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to go around the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people spoke against God, and against Moses, Why have ye brought us out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for {there is} no bread, neither {is there any} water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of Israel died.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel moved forward, and encamped in Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from Oboth, and encamped at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which {is} before Moab, toward the sunrising.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they removed, and encamped in the valley of Zared.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they removed, and encamped on the other side of Arnon, which {is} in the wilderness that cometh out of the borders of the Amorites: for Arnon {is} the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

column.name: text
column.value: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And from there {they went} to Beer: that {is} the well of which the LORD spoke to Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel sung this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye to it:

column.name: text
column.value: The princes searched out the well, the nobles of the people dug it, by {the direction of} the lawgiver, with their staffs. And from the wilderness {they went} to Mattanah:

column.name: text
column.value: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

column.name: text
column.value: And from Bamoth {in} the valley, that {is} in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink {of} the waters of the well: {but} we will go along by the king's highway, until we have past thy borders.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sihon would not permit Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon to Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon {was} strong.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

column.name: text
column.value: For Heshbon {was} the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to Arnon.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

column.name: text
column.value: For there hast a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, {and} the lords of the high places of Arnon.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: We have shot at them; Heshbon hast perished even to Dibon, and we have laid them waste even to Nophah, which {reacheth} to Medeba.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its villages, and drove out the Amorites that {were} there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

column.name: text
column.value: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left to him alive: and they possessed his land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the children of Israel, {even} the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people strove with Moses, and spoke, saying, O that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: And why have ye brought the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

column.name: text
column.value: And why have ye made us come up from Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? it {is} no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither {is} there any water to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye to the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth its water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give water to the congregation and their beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts {also}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

column.name: text
column.value: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians afflicted us, and our fathers:

column.name: text
column.value: And when we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth from Egypt: and, behold, we {are} in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

column.name: text
column.value: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink {of} the water of the wells: we will go by the king's highway, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

column.name: text
column.value: And Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go by the highway: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without {doing} any thing {else}, go through on my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: therefore Israel turned away from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel, {even} the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came to mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Aaron shall be gathered to his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

column.name: text
column.value: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to mount Hor:

column.name: text
column.value: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered {to his people}, and shall die there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up to mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, {even} all the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding {in his tents} according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

column.name: text
column.value: He hath said, who heard the words of God, who saw the vision of the Almighty, falling {into a trance}, but having his eyes open:

column.name: text
column.value: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, {and} thy tabernacles, O Israel!

column.name: text
column.value: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, {and} as cedar trees beside the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed {shall be} in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: God brought him forth from Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce {them} through with his arrows.

column.name: text
column.value: He crouched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall rouse him? Blessed {is} he that blesseth thee, and cursed {is} he that curseth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said to Balaam, I called thee to curse my enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed {them} these three times.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee to great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not speak also to thy messengers whom thou sentest to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do {either} good or bad of my own mind; {but} what the LORD saith, that will I speak?

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, I go to my people: come {therefore}, I will advise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

column.name: text
column.value: He hath said, who heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, {who} saw the vision of the Almighty, falling {into a trance}, but having his eyes open:

column.name: text
column.value: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not near: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek {was} the first of the nations; but his latter end {shall be} that he shall perish for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

column.name: text
column.value: And ships {shall come} from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam arose, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on {every} altar a bull and a ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps the LORD will come to meet me: and whatever he showeth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

column.name: text
column.value: And God met Balaam: and he said to him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon {every} altar a bull and a ram.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned to him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, {saying}, Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, defy Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, {whom} the LORD hath not defied?

column.name: text
column.value: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth {part} of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak said to Balaam, What hast thou done to me? I took thee to curse my enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed {them} altogether.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak said to him, Come, I pray thee, with me to another place, from which thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and from there curse them for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on {every} altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet {the LORD} yonder.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again to Balak, and say thus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said to him, What hath the LORD spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise, Balak, and hear; hearken to me, thou son of Zippor:

column.name: text
column.value: God {is} not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do {it}? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have received {commandment} to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God {is} with him, and the shout of a king {is} among them.

column.name: text
column.value: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely {there is} no enchantment against Jacob, neither {is there} any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he shall eat {of} the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak said to Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

column.name: text
column.value: But Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did I not tell thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak said to Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee to another place; perhaps it will please God that thou mayest from there curse them for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.

column.name: text
column.value: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on {every} altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall vow a vow to the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: If a woman also shall vow a vow to the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, {being} in her father's house in her youth;

column.name: text
column.value: And her father shall hear her vow, and her bond by which she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond by which she hath bound her soul shall stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her father shall overrule her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds by which she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father overruled her.

column.name: text
column.value: And if she had an husband, when she vowed, or uttered any thing from her lips, by which she bound her soul;

column.name: text
column.value: And her husband heard {it,} and held his peace at her in the day that he heard {it}: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds by which she bound her soul shall stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband overruled her on the day that he heard {it}; then he shall make of no effect her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, by which she bound her soul: and the LORD shall forgive her.

column.name: text
column.value: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, by which they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

column.name: text
column.value: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

column.name: text
column.value: And her husband heard {it}, and held his peace at her, {and} overruled her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond by which she bound her soul shall stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard {them; then} whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

column.name: text
column.value: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

column.name: text
column.value: But if her husband altogether holds his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which {are} upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall in any way make them void after that he hath heard {them}; then he shall bear her iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, {being yet} in her youth in her father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {Take the sum of the people}, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, who went forth from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, {of whom cometh} the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This {is that} Dathan and Abiram, {who were} famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

column.name: text
column.value: However the children of Korah died not.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah {were} Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, seventy and six thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the sons of Issachar after their families: {of} Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, sixty and four thousand and three hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, sixty thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joseph after their families {were} Manasseh and Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead {come} the family of the Gileadites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Gilead: {of} Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

column.name: text
column.value: And {of} Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and {of} Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

column.name: text
column.value: And {of} Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and {of} Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad {were} Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These {are} the sons of Joseph after their families.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: {of Ard}, the family of the Ardites: {and} of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them {were} forty and five thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These {are} the families of Dan after their families.

column.name: text
column.value: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, {were} sixty and four thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the daughter of Asher {was} Sarah.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; {who were} fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them {were} forty and five thousand and four hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

column.name: text
column.value: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

column.name: text
column.value: However the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

column.name: text
column.value: According to the lot shall the possession of it be divided between many and few.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of Amram's wife {was} Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom {her mother} bore to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit harlotry with the daughters of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods: and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel joined himself to Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined to Baalpeor.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who {were} weeping {before} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw {it}, he rose from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

column.name: text
column.value: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say, Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, {even} the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, {even} that was slain with the Midianitish woman, {was} Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain {was} Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he {was} head over a people, {and} of a chief house in Midian.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Distress the Midianites, and smite them:

column.name: text
column.value: For they distress you with their wiles, by which they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these {are} the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, {by} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give to us {therefore} a possession among the brethren of our father.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The daughters of Zelophehad speak {what is} right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a man shall die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance to his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance to his father's brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And if his father shall have no brethren, then ye shall give inheritance to his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, go up to this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered to thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that {is} the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

column.name: text
column.value: Who may go out before them, and who may go in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom {is} the spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;

column.name: text
column.value: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt put {some} of thy honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask {counsel} for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, {both} he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place {was} a place for cattle;

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, {is} a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession, {and} bring us not over Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

column.name: text
column.value: And why discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he swore, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Surely none of the men that came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

column.name: text
column.value: Except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, ye have risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and he shall destroy all this people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

column.name: text
column.value: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of Jordan, or beyond; because our inheritance hath fallen to us on this side of Jordan eastward.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

column.name: text
column.value: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

column.name: text
column.value: And the land shall be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

column.name: text
column.value: Build for yourselves cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

column.name: text
column.value: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

column.name: text
column.value: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed for battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

column.name: text
column.value: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said to thy servants, so will we do.

column.name: text
column.value: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan {may be} ours.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave to them, {even} to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with its cities within the borders, {even} the cities of the surrounding country.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

column.name: text
column.value: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fortified cities: and folds for sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names to the cities which they built.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite who {was} in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its small towns, and called them Havothjair.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the journeys of the children of Israel, who went forth from the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these {are} their journeys according to their goings out.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Egyptians buried all {their} firstborn, whom the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel departed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which {is} in the edge of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Etham, and turned again to Pihahiroth, which {is} before Baalzephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim {were} twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from the desert of Sinai, and encamped at Kibrothhattaavah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Rithmah, and encamped at Rimmonparez.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and encamped in Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Libnah, and encamped at Rissah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they journeyed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shapher.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Tahath, and encamped at Tarah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Tarah, and encamped in Mithcah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went from Mithcah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Moseroth, and encamped in Benejaakan.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went from Horhagidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Eziongaber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin, which {is} Kadesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron the priest went up to mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel departed from the land of Egypt, in the first {day} of the fifth month.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aaron {was} an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Arad the Canaanite, who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Oboth, and encamped in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Iim, and encamped in Dibongad.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from Almondiblathaim, and encamped on the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And they encamped by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth {even} to Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their stone images, and destroy all their molten images, and destroy all their high places:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall dispossess {the inhabitants} of the land, and dwell in it: for I have given you the land to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's {inheritance} shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those whom ye let remain of them {shall be} pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall trouble you in the land in which ye dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover it shall come to pass, {that} I shall do to you, as I thought to do to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, My offering, {and} my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, {for} a sweet savour to me, shall ye observe to offer to me in their due season.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to them, This {is} the offering made by fire which ye shall offer to the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, {for} a continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening;

column.name: text
column.value: And a tenth {part} of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mixed with a fourth {part} of an hin of beaten oil.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And its drink offering {shall be} the fourth {part} of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy {place} shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured to the LORD {for} a drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening: as the meat offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, thou shalt offer {it}, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth parts of flour {for} a meat offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

column.name: text
column.value: {This is} the burnt offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD; two young bulls, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

column.name: text
column.value: And three tenth parts of flour {for} a meat offering, mixed with oil, for one bull; and two tenth parts of flour {for} a meat offering, mixed with oil, for one ram;

column.name: text
column.value: And a tenth part of flour mixed with oil {for} a meat offering to one lamb; {for} a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine to a bull, and the third {part} of an hin to a ram, and a fourth {part} of an hin to a lamb: this {is} the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fourteenth day of the first month {is} the passover of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fifteenth day of this month {is} the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: On the first day {shall be} an holy convocation; {in it} ye shall do no manner of servile work:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire {for} a burnt offering to the LORD; two young bulls, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be to you without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mixed with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bull, and two tenth parts for a ram;

column.name: text
column.value: A tenth part shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall offer these besides the burnt offering in the morning, which {is} for a continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the food of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering to the LORD, after your weeks {are ended}, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour to the LORD; two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering of flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to one bull, two tenth parts to one ram,

column.name: text
column.value: A tenth part to one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

column.name: text
column.value: {And} one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall offer {them} besides the continual burnt offering, and its meat offering, (they shall be to you without blemish ) and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command the children of Israel, that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give {also} to the Levites common lands for the cities around them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall have the cities to dwell in; and the common lands of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And the common lands of the cities, which ye shall give to the Levites, {shall reach} from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall measure from outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city {shall be} in the midst: this shall be to them the common lands of the cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And among the cities which ye shall give to the Levites {there shall be} six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee there: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: {So} all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites {shall be} forty and eight cities: them {shall ye give} with their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cities which ye shall give {shall be} of the possession of the children of Israel: from {them that have} many ye shall give many; but from {them that have} few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities to the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall appoint for you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee there, who killeth any person unintentionally.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be to you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer may not die, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall give three cities on this side of Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, {which} shall be cities of refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: These six cities shall be a refuge, {both} for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unintentionally may flee there.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he shall die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall smite him by throwing a stone, by which he may die, and he shall die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Or {if} he shall smite him with an hand weapon of wood, by which he may die, and he shall die, he {is} a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The avenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying in wait, that he die;

column.name: text
column.value: Or in enmity shall smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote {him} shall surely be put to death; {for} he {is} a murderer: the avenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall thrust him suddenly without enmity, or shall have cast upon him any thing without laying in wait,

column.name: text
column.value: Or with any stone, by which a man may die, seeing {him} not, and shall cast {it} upon him, that he die, and {was} not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

column.name: text
column.value: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these judgments:

column.name: text
column.value: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, where he had fled: and he shall abide in it to the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the slayer shall at any time come outside the border of the city of his refuge, where he had fled;

column.name: text
column.value: And the avenger of blood find him outside the borders of the city of his refuge, and the avenger of blood shall kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

column.name: text
column.value: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: So these {things} shall be for a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person {to cause him} to die.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, who {is} guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that hath fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: So ye shall not pollute the land in which ye {are}: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him that shed it.
