column.name: text
column.value: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, in which I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this {is} the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, {even} the land of Canaan with its borders:)

column.name: text
column.value: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the border of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

column.name: text
column.value: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: its border shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border shall form a circuit from Azmon to the river of Egypt, and the border of it shall be at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

column.name: text
column.value: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor:

column.name: text
column.value: From mount Hor ye shall mark out {your border} to the entrance of Hamath; and the edge of the border shall be at Zedad:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the border of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the border of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with its border on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This {is} the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

column.name: text
column.value: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received {their inheritance}; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

column.name: text
column.value: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side of Jordan {near} Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the names of the men who shall divide the land to you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the names of the men {are} these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

column.name: text
column.value: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are they} whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seventh month, on the first {day} of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour to the LORD; one young bull, one ram, {and} seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for a bull, {and} two tenth parts for a ram,

column.name: text
column.value: And one tenth part for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

column.name: text
column.value: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

column.name: text
column.value: Besides the burnt offering of the month, and its meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and its meat offering, and their drink offerings, according to their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall have on the tenth {day} of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: {in it} ye shall not do any work:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD {for} a sweet savour; one young bull, one ram, {and} seven lambs of the first year; they shall be to you without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to a bull, {and} two tenth parts to one ram,

column.name: text
column.value: A tenth part for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

column.name: text
column.value: One kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meat offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD; thirteen young bulls, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering {shall be of} flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts to each ram of the two rams,

column.name: text
column.value: And a tenth part to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

column.name: text
column.value: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the second day {ye shall offer} twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one kid of the goats {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, {and} fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: {in it} ye shall do no servile work:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

column.name: text
column.value: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, {shall be} according to their number, after the manner:

column.name: text
column.value: And one goat {for} a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meat offering, and its drink offering.

column.name: text
column.value: These {things} ye shall do to the LORD in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on the east side of Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite Zuph, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

column.name: text
column.value: ({There are} eleven days' {journey} from Horeb by the way of mount Seir to Kadeshbarnea.)

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first {day} of the month, {that} Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them;

column.name: text
column.value: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

column.name: text
column.value: On the east side of Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

column.name: text
column.value: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and to all {the places} near to it, in the plain, on the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and to Lebanon, to the great river, the river Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye {are} this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye {are}, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

column.name: text
column.value: How can I alone bear your weight, and your burden, and your strife?

column.name: text
column.value: Take for yourselves wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken {is} good {for us} to do.

column.name: text
column.value: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear {the causes} between your brethren, and judge righteously between {every} man and his brother, and the stranger {that is} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; {but} ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment {is} God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

column.name: text
column.value: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to you, Ye have come to the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up {and} possess {it}, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said to thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye came near to me each one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land for us, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

column.name: text
column.value: And they turned and went up to the mountain, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought {it} down to us, and brought us word again, and said, {It is} a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

column.name: text
column.value: However ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth from the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

column.name: text
column.value: Where can we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people {are} greater and taller than we; the cities {are} great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD your God who goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

column.name: text
column.value: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how the LORD thy God bore thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

column.name: text
column.value: Who went in the way before you, to search out for you a place to pitch your tents {in}, in fire by night, to show you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was angry, and swore, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: Except Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath walked upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in there.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} Joshua the son of Nun, who standeth before thee, he shall go in there: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in there, and to them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: But {as for} you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye answered and said to me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up to the hill.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Say to them, Go not up, neither fight; for I {am} not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: So I spoke to you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up to the hill.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Amorites, who dwelt on that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, {even} to Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear to you.

column.name: text
column.value: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according to the days that ye abode {there}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

column.name: text
column.value: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: All these cities {were} fortified with high walls, gates, and bars; besides unwalled towns a great number.

column.name: text
column.value: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

column.name: text
column.value: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that {was} on this side of Jordan, from the river of Arnon to mount Hermon;

column.name: text
column.value: ({Which} Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead {was} a bedstead of iron; {is} it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits {was} the length of it, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And this land, {which} we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which {is} by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, {being} the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

column.name: text
column.value: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob to the borders of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even to the river Jabbok, {which is} the border of the children of Ammon;

column.name: text
column.value: The plain also, and Jordan, and the border {of it}, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the plain, {even} the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all {that are} fit for the war.

column.name: text
column.value: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, ({for} I know that ye have many cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

column.name: text
column.value: Until the LORD shall have given rest to your brethren, as well as to you, and {until} they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and {then} shall ye return every man to his possession, which I have given you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thy eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done to these two kings: so shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where thou passest.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to show thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God {is there} in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

column.name: text
column.value: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that {is} beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said to me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more to me of this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up thy eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold with thy eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

column.name: text
column.value: So we abode in the valley opposite Bethpeor.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses called all Israel, and said to them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, {even} us, who {are} all of us here alive this day.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD talked with you face to face on the mount from the midst of the fire,

column.name: text
column.value: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up upon the mount;) saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not make for thee {any} graven image, {or} any likeness {of any thing} that {is} in heaven above, or that {is} on the earth beneath, or that {is} in the waters beneath the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God {am} a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth {generation} of them that hate me,

column.name: text
column.value: And showing mercy to thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold {him} guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

column.name: text
column.value: But the seventh day {is} the sabbath of the LORD thy God: {in it} thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy male servant, nor thy female servant, nor thy ox, nor thy donkey, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that {is} within thy gates; that thy male servant and thy female servant may rest as well as thou.

column.name: text
column.value: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and {that} the LORD thy God brought thee out from there with a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may be well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not kill.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou steal.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or any {thing} that {is} thy neighbour's.

column.name: text
column.value: These words the LORD spoke to all your assembly on the mount from the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near to me, {even} all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice from the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: For who {is there of} all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we {have}, and lived?

column.name: text
column.value: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou to us all that the LORD our God shall speak to thee; and we will hear {it}, and do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoke to thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

column.name: text
column.value: Go say to them, Return to your tents again.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak to thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do {them} in the land which I give them to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and {that it may be} well with you, and {that} ye may prolong {your} days in the land which ye shall possess.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye may do {them} in the land where ye go to possess it:

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do {it}; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God {is} one LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

column.name: text
column.value: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thy heart:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt teach them diligently to thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thy eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he swore to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou didst not build,

column.name: text
column.value: And houses full of all good {things}, which thou didst not fill, and dug wells, which thou didst not dig, vineyards and olive trees, which thou didst not plant; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} beware lest thou shouldest forget the LORD, who brought thee forth from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which {are} around you;

column.name: text
column.value: (For the LORD thy God {is} a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God should be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted {him} in Massah.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt do {that which is} right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD swore to thy fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: To cast out all thy enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when thy son shall ask thee in time to come, saying, What {mean} the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt say to thy son, We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD showed signs and wonders, great and terrible, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as {it is} at this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spoke to me: and we went around mount Seir many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have gone around this mountain long enough: turn northward.

column.name: text
column.value: And command thou the people, saying, Ye {are} to pass through the land of your brethren the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: therefore take ye good heed to yourselves:

column.name: text
column.value: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir to Esau {for} a possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall buy food of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God {hath been} with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land {for} a possession; because I have given Ar to the children of Lot {for} a possession.

column.name: text
column.value: The Emims dwelt in it in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

column.name: text
column.value: Who also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

column.name: text
column.value: The Horims also dwelt in Seir in times past; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now rise, {said I}, and pass over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

column.name: text
column.value: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we passed the brook Zered, {was} thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from among the host, as the LORD swore to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD spoke to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the border of Moab, this day:

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} thou comest near the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon {any} possession; because I have given it to the children of Lot {for} a possession.

column.name: text
column.value: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt there in times past; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

column.name: text
column.value: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

column.name: text
column.value: As he did to the children of Esau, who dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even to this day:

column.name: text
column.value: And the Avims who dwelt in Hazerim, {even} to Azzah, the Caphtorims, who came forth from Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

column.name: text
column.value: Arise ye, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thy hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess {it}, and contend with him in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations {that are} under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the highway, I will neither turn to the right hand nor to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

column.name: text
column.value: (As the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as {appeareth} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

column.name: text
column.value: Only the cattle we took for a prey to ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

column.name: text
column.value: From Aroer, which {is} by the brink of the river of Arnon, and {from} the city that {is} by the river, even to Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all to us:

column.name: text
column.value: Only to the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, {nor} to any place of the river Jabbok, nor to the cities on the mountains, nor to whatever the LORD our God forbad us.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land where thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, {and} utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give to his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take to thy son.

column.name: text
column.value: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

column.name: text
column.value: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou {art} an holy people to the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people to himself, above all people that {are} upon the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye {were} the fewest of all people:

column.name: text
column.value: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn to your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he {is} God, the faithful God, who keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

column.name: text
column.value: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep to thee the covenant and the mercy which he swore to thy fathers:

column.name: text
column.value: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy grain, and thy wine, and thy oil, the increase of thy cattle, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he swore to thy fathers to give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all {them} that hate thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver to thee; thy eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that {will be} a snare to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt say in thy heart, These nations {are} more than I; how can I dispossess them?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: {but} shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: The great temptations which thy eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do to all the people of whom thou art afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, shall be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not be terrified of them: for the LORD thy God {is} among you, a mighty God and terrible.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD thy God will drive out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them to thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall deliver their kings into thy hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou shalt have destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold {that is} on them, nor take {it} to thee, lest thou shouldest be snared in it: for it {is} an abomination to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thy house, lest thou shouldest be a cursed thing like it: {but} thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it {is} a cursed thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O Israel: Thou {art} to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fortified up to heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and {of whom} thou hast heard {it said}, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

column.name: text
column.value: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God {is} he who goeth over before thee; {as} a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak not thou in thy heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thy heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD swore to thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou {art} a stiffnecked people.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, {and} forget not, how thou didst provoke the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart from the land of Egypt, until ye came to this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

column.name: text
column.value: When I went up to the mount to receive the tables of stone, {even} the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither ate bread nor drank water:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD delivered to me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them {was written} according to all the words, which the LORD spoke with you in the mount from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, {that} the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, {even} the tables of the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Arise, go down quickly from here; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted {themselves}; they are quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it {is} a stiffnecked people:

column.name: text
column.value: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

column.name: text
column.value: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant {were} in my two hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, {and} had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly from the way which the LORD had commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I neither ate bread, nor drank water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, with which the LORD was angry with you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened to me at that time also.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, {and} ground {it} very small, {even} until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust of it into the brook that descended from the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down {at the first}; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

column.name: text
column.value: I prayed therefore to the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thy inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not to the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest the land from which thou hast brought us should say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they {are} thy people and thy inheritance, which thou hast brought out by thy mighty power and by thy outstretched arm.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD said to me, Hew thee two tables of stone like the first, and come up to me upon the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou didst break, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And I made an ark {of} shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like the first, and went up to the mount, having the two tables in my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you in the mount from the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they are, as the LORD commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: From there they journeyed to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD {is} his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened to me at that time also, {and} the LORD would not destroy thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Arise, take {thy} journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I swore to their fathers to give to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

column.name: text
column.value: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens belongeth to the LORD thy God, the earth {also}, with all that is in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, {even} you above all people, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God {is} God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, who regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

column.name: text
column.value: He executeth the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

column.name: text
column.value: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

column.name: text
column.value: He {is} thy praise, and he {is} thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thy eyes have seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, to the statutes and to the judgments, which I teach you, to do {them}, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish {any thing} from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye who held fast to the LORD your God {are} alive each one of you this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land where ye go to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep therefore and do {them}; for this {is} your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation {is} a wise and understanding people.

column.name: text
column.value: For what nation {is there so} great, which {hath} God {so} near to them, as the LORD our God {is} in all {things that} we call upon him {for}?

column.name: text
column.value: And what nation {is there so} great, that hath statutes and judgments {so} righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

column.name: text
column.value: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou shouldest forget the things which thy eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them to thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

column.name: text
column.value: {Especially} the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, Gather the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and {that} they may teach their children.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire to the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only {ye heard} a voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And he declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, {even} ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land where ye go over to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: Take ye therefore good heed to yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day {that} the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest ye corrupt {yourselves}, and make to you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

column.name: text
column.value: The likeness of any beast that {is} on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

column.name: text
column.value: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that {is} in the waters beneath the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: And lest thou shouldest lift up thy eyes to heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, {even} all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided to all nations under the whole heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, {even} from Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as {ye are} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not enter that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance:

column.name: text
column.value: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, {or} the likeness of any {thing}, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God {is} a consuming fire, {even} a jealous God.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt {yourselves}, and make a graven image, {or} the likeness of any {thing}, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

column.name: text
column.value: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from the land where ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong {your} days upon it, but shall be utterly destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, where the LORD shall lead you.

column.name: text
column.value: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

column.name: text
column.value: But if from there thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find {him}, if thou shalt seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things have come upon thee, {even} in the latter days, if thou shalt turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient to his voice;

column.name: text
column.value: (For the LORD thy God {is} a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he swore to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and {ask} from the one side of heaven to the other, whether there hath been {any such thing} as this great thing {is}, or hath been heard like it?

column.name: text
column.value: Did {ever} people hear the voice of God speaking from the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

column.name: text
column.value: Or hath God ever tried to go {and} take for himself a nation from the midst of {another} nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: To thee it was shown, that thou mightest know that the LORD he {is} God; {there is} none besides him.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he showed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words from the midst of the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out of Egypt; in his sight with his mighty power;

column.name: text
column.value: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou {art}, to bring thee in, to give thee their land {for} an inheritance, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Know therefore this day, and consider {it} in thy heart, that the LORD he {is} God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: {there is} none else.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may be well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong {thy} days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses set apart three cities on the side of Jordan toward the sunrising;

column.name: text
column.value: That the slayer might flee there, who should kill his neighbour unintentionally, and when he had not hated him in times past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

column.name: text
column.value: {Namely}, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, after they came forth from Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: On the {east} side of Jordan, in the valley opposite Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they had come forth from Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who {were} on the side of Jordan toward the sunrising;

column.name: text
column.value: From Aroer, which {is} by the bank of the river Arnon, even to mount Sion, which {is} Hermon,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the plain on the side of Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, always.

column.name: text
column.value: And know ye this day: for {I speak} not with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his outstretched arm,

column.name: text
column.value: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

column.name: text
column.value: And what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and {how} the LORD hath destroyed them to this day;

column.name: text
column.value: And what he did to you in the wilderness, until ye came to this place;

column.name: text
column.value: And what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that {was} in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, where ye go to possess it;

column.name: text
column.value: And that ye may prolong {your} days in the land, which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land, where thou goest in to possess it, {is} not as the land of Egypt, from which ye came out, where thou didst sow thy seed, and water {it} with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

column.name: text
column.value: But the land, where ye go to possess it, {is} a land of hills and valleys, {and} drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God {are} always upon it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently to my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

column.name: text
column.value: That I will give {you} the rain of your land in its due season, the former rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy grain, and thy wine, and thy oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

column.name: text
column.value: And {then} the LORD'S wrath shall be kindled against you, and he shall shut up the heaven, that there shall be no rain, and the land shall not yield its fruit; and {lest} ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thy house, and upon thy gates:

column.name: text
column.value: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give to them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave to him;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Every place on which the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the uttermost sea shall your border be.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall no man be able to stand before you: {for} the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

column.name: text
column.value: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

column.name: text
column.value: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside from the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in to the land where thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

column.name: text
column.value: {Are} they not on the other side of Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, who dwell in the plain opposite Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

column.name: text
column.value: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

column.name: text
column.value: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God hath led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, {and} to test thee, to know what {was} in thy heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he humbled thee, and allowed thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every {word} that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy raiment hath not become old upon thee, neither hath thy foot swelled, these forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also consider in thy heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, {so} the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

column.name: text
column.value: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil, and honey;

column.name: text
column.value: A land in which thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any {thing} in it; a land whose stones {are} iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest {when} thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt {in them};

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold are increased, and all that thou hast is increased;

column.name: text
column.value: Then thy heart shall be lifted up, and thou shalt forget the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

column.name: text
column.value: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, {with its} fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where {there was} no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

column.name: text
column.value: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might test thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say in thy heart, My power and the might of {my} hand hath gotten me this wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for {it is} he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to thy fathers, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if thou shalt at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

column.name: text
column.value: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient to the voice of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and give thee a sign or a wonder,

column.name: text
column.value: And the sign or the wonder shall come to pass, of which he spoke to thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not hearken to the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God testeth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn {you} away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you from the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou remove the evil from the midst of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, who {is} as thy own soul, shall entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: {Namely}, of the gods of the people who {are} around you, near to thee, or far off from thee, from {one} end of the earth even to the {other} end of the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not consent to him, nor hearken to him; neither shall thy eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt surely kill him; thy hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he shall die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt hear in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {Certain} men, corrupt men, have gone out from among you, and have seduced the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, {if it is} truth, {and} the thing certain, {that} such abomination is wrought among you;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that {is} in it, and its cattle, with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of its street, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil, every bit of it, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shalt not be built again.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall cleave nothing of the cursed thing to thy hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and show thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn to thy fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do {that which is} right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye {are} the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou {art} an holy people to the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a special people to himself, above all the nations that {are} upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

column.name: text
column.value: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

column.name: text
column.value: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, {and} cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; {therefore} they {are} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, {is} unclean to you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

column.name: text
column.value: These ye shall eat of all that {are} in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it {is} unclean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} all clean birds ye shall eat.

column.name: text
