column.value: But these {are they} of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

column.name: text
column.value: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

column.name: text
column.value: And every raven after his kind,

column.name: text
column.value: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

column.name: text
column.value: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

column.name: text
column.value: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

column.name: text
column.value: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

column.name: text
column.value: And every creeping thing that flieth {is} unclean to you: they shall not be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: {But of} all clean fowls ye may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not eat {of} any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it to the stranger that {is} in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it to an alien: for thou {art} an holy people to the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not boil a kid in his mother's milk.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy grain, of thy wine, and of thy oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the way is too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; {or} if the place is too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou turn {it} into money, and bind up the money in thy hand, and shalt go to the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatever thy soul desireth, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thy household,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levite that {is} within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thy increase the same year, and shalt lay {it} up within thy gates:

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, who {are} within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thy hand which thou doest.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of {every} seven years thou shalt make a release.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth {any thing} to his neighbour shall release {it}; he shall not exact {it} of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD'S release.

column.name: text
column.value: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact {it again}: but {that} which is thine with thy brother thy hand shall release;

column.name: text
column.value: Except when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance to possess it:

column.name: text
column.value: Only if thou shalt carefully hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God shall bless thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD the God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thy heart, nor shut thy hand from thy poor brother:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt open thy hand wide to him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, {in that} which he lacketh.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thy eye shall be evil against thy poor brother, and thou shalt give him nothing; and he shall cry to the LORD against thee, and it shall be sin to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt surely give him, and thy heart shall not be grieved when thou givest to him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thy hand to.

column.name: text
column.value: For the poor shall never cease from the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thy hand wide to thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, shall be sold to thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him depart empty:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: {of that} which the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if he shall say to thee, I will not leave thee; because he loveth thee and thy house, because he is well with thee;

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt take an awl, and thrust {it} through his ear into the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also to thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall not seem hard to thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been of double the worth of a hired servant {to thee}, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

column.name: text
column.value: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy herd, nor shear the firstling of thy flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt eat {it} before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

column.name: text
column.value: And if there is {any} blemish in it, {as if it is} lame, or blind, {or hath} any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean {person shall eat it} alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

column.name: text
column.value: Only thou shalt not eat its blood; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe the month Abib, and keep the passover to the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth from Egypt by night.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover to the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread with it, {even} the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth from the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth from the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy land seven days; neither shall there {any thing} of the flesh, which thou didst sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

column.name: text
column.value: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at evening, at the setting of the sun, at the time of thy departure from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt roast and eat {it} in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt return in the morning, and go to thy tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day {shall be} a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: {in it} thou shalt do no work.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven weeks shalt thou number to thee: begin to number the seven weeks from {the time when} thou beginnest {to put} the sickle to the grain.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks to the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thy hand, which thou shalt give {to the LORD thy God}, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy male, and female servant, and the Levite that {is} within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that {are} among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a slave in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy grain and thy wine:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy male servant, and thy female servant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that {are} within thy gates.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast to the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy increase, and in all the works of thy hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

column.name: text
column.value: Every man {shall give} as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not pervert judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a bribe: for a bribe doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near to the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou set thee up {any} image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, in which the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not do so to the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, {even} his habitation shall ye seek, and there thou shalt come:

column.name: text
column.value: And there ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

column.name: text
column.value: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand to, ye and your households, in which the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not do after all {the things} that we do here this day, every man whatever {is} right in his own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

column.name: text
column.value: But {when} ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and {when} he giveth you rest from all your enemies on every side, so that ye dwell in safety;

column.name: text
column.value: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; there shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your male and female servants, and the Levite that {is} within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

column.name: text
column.value: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

column.name: text
column.value: However thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatever thy soul desireth, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

column.name: text
column.value: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy grain, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thy hand:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy male servant, and thy female servant, and the Levite that {is} within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands to.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatever thy soul desireth.

column.name: text
column.value: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there shall be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatever thy soul desireth.

column.name: text
column.value: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat {of} them alike.

column.name: text
column.value: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood {is} the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may be well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do {that which is} right in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go to the place which the LORD shall choose:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may be well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest {that which is} good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, where thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they are destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not do so to the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done to their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever thing I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add to it, nor diminish from it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not sacrifice to the LORD thy God {any} bull, or sheep, in which is blemish, {or} any defect: for that {is} an abomination to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be told thee, and thou hast heard {of it}, and enquired diligently, and, behold, {it is} true, {and} the thing certain, {that} such abomination is wrought in Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou bring forth to thy gates that man or that woman, who have committed that wicked thing, {even} that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

column.name: text
column.value: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; {but} at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt remove the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, {being} matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and go up to the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt come to the priests the Levites, and to the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall show thee the sentence of judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall show thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

column.name: text
column.value: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall show thee, {to} the right hand, nor {to} the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken to the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or to the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt remove the evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell in it, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that {are} about me;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt surely set {him} king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: {one} from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, who {is} not thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said to you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart may turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of {that which is} before the priests the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be with him, and he shall read in it all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

column.name: text
column.value: That his heart may not be lifted above his brethren, and that he may not turn aside from the commandment, {to} the right hand, or {to} the left: to the end that he may prolong {his} days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests the Levites, {and} all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD {is} their inheritance, as he hath said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether ox or sheep; and they shall give to the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the stomach.

column.name: text
column.value: The firstfruit {also} of thy grain, of thy wine, and of thy oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a Levite shall come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind to the place which the LORD shall choose;

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites {do}, who stand there before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of their fathers' {estates}.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall not be found among you {any one} that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, {or} that useth divination, {or} an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

column.name: text
column.value: Or a charmer, or a consulter with mediums, or a wizard, or one who calls up the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For all that do these things {are} an abomination to the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened to observers of times, and to diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not permitted thee so {to do}.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD thy God will raise up to thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like me; to him ye shall hearken;

column.name: text
column.value: According to all that thou didst desire of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I may not die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, They have well {spoken of that} which they have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: I will raise up to them a Prophet from among their brethren, like thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} whoever will not hearken to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require {it} of him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the prophet, who shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt say in thy heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing doth not follow, nor come to pass, that {is} the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, {but} the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered to thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves for the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD on Midian.

column.name: text
column.value: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

column.name: text
column.value: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of {every} tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of {every} tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew the kings of Midian, besides the rest of them that were slain; {namely}, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel took {all} the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

column.name: text
column.value: And they burnt all their cities in which they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, {both} of men and of beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which {are} by Jordan {near} Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was angry with the officers of the host, {with} the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, who came from the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses said to them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But all the girls, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And do ye abide outside the camp seven days: whoever hath killed any person, and whoever hath touched any slain, purify {both} yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

column.name: text
column.value: And purify all {your} raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' {hair}, and all things made of wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, This {is} the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

column.name: text
column.value: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

column.name: text
column.value: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make {it} go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, {both} of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

column.name: text
column.value: And levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, {both} of the persons, and of the cattle, and of the donkeys, and of the sheep:

column.name: text
column.value: Take {it} of their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, {for} an heave offering of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them to the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the booty, {being} the rest of the prey which the men of war had taken, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: And seventy and two thousand cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: And sixty and one thousand donkeys,

column.name: text
column.value: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the half, {which was} the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and seventy and five.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cattle {were} thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And the donkeys {were} thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} sixty and one.

column.name: text
column.value: And the persons {were} sixteen thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute {was} thirty and two persons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave the tribute, {which was} the LORD'S heave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the half {that pertained to} the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand {and} seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

column.name: text
column.value: And thirty and six thousand cattle,

column.name: text
column.value: And thirty thousand donkeys and five hundred,

column.name: text
column.value: And sixteen thousand persons;)

column.name: text
column.value: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, {both} of man and of beast, and gave them to the Levites, who kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers who {were} over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war who {are} under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

column.name: text
column.value: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath obtained, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, {even} all wrought jewels.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the gold of the offering that they offered to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

column.name: text
column.value: ({For} the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, {for} a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt set apart three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the bounds of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee there.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the case of the slayer, who shall flee there, that he may live: Whoever killeth his neighbour unintentionally, whom he hated not in time past;

column.name: text
column.value: As when a man goeth into the forest with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand maketh a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and falleth upon his neighbour, that he dieth; he shall flee to one of these cities, and live:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest the avenger of blood shall pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; though he {was} not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt set apart three cities for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy land, as he hath sworn to thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give to thy fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, besides these three:

column.name: text
column.value: That innocent blood may not be shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance, and {so} blood be upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But if any man shall hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he dieth, and he shall flee into one of these cities:

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of his city shall send and bring him from there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy eye shall not pity him, but thou shall remove {the guilt of} innocent blood from Israel, that it may be well with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thy inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

column.name: text
column.value: If a false witness shall rise up against any man to testify against him {that which is} wrong;

column.name: text
column.value: Then both the men, between whom the controversy {is}, shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges, who shall be in those days;

column.name: text
column.value: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, {if} the witness {is} a false witness, {and} hath testified falsely against his brother;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall ye do to him, as he had thought to do to his brother: so shalt thou remove the evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And those who remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy eye shall not pity; {but} life {shall go} for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou goest out to battle against thy enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, {and} a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the LORD thy God {is} with thee, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when ye are come near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall say to them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day to battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD your God {is} he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers shall speak to the people, saying, What man {is there} that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he should die in the battle, and another man should dedicate it.

column.name: text
column.value: And what man {is he} that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not {yet} eaten of it? let him {also} go and return to his house, lest he should die in the battle, and another man should eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And what man {is there} that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return to his house, lest he should die in battle, and another man should take her.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, What man {is there that is} fearful and fainthearted? let him go and return to his house, lest his brethren's heart should faint as well as his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou comest near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if it shall make thee answer of peace, and open to thee, then it shall be, {that} all the people {that are} found in it shall be forced labourers to thee, and they shall serve thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD thy God hath delivered it into thy hands, thou shalt smite every male of it with the edge of the sword:

column.name: text
column.value: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, {even} all the spoil of it, shalt thou take to thyself; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thy enemies, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shalt thou do to all the cities {which are} very distant from thee, which {are} not of the cities of these nations.

column.name: text
column.value: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD thy God doth give thee {for} an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt utterly destroy them; {namely}, the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may not teach you to do after all their abominations, which they have done to their gods; so should ye sin against the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees of it by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field {is} man's {life}) to employ {them} in the siege:

column.name: text
column.value: Only the trees which thou knowest that they {are} not trees for food, thou shalt destroy and cut them down; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee, until it shall be subdued.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they shall be married to any of the sons of the {other} tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received: so it shall be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall the inheritance move from {one} tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

column.name: text
column.value: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father's brothers' sons:

column.name: text
column.value: {And} they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan {near} Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: If {one} shall be found slain in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, {and} it be not known who hath slain him:

column.name: text
column.value: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure to the cities which {are} around him that is slain:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, {that} the city {which is} next to the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take an heifer, which hath not been worked, {and} which hath not pulled the yoke;

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer to a rough valley, which is neither tilled nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the valley:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near; for them the LORD thy God hath chosen to minister to him, and to bless in the name of the LORD; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be {tried}:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the elders of that city, {that are} next to the slain {man}, shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Be merciful, O LORD, to thy people Israel, whom thou hast redeemed, and lay not innocent blood to the charge of thy people Israel. And the blood shall be forgiven them.

column.name: text
column.value: So shalt thou remove the {guilt of} innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do {that which is} right in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou goest forth to war against thy enemies, and the LORD thy God hath delivered them into thy hands, and thou hast taken them captive,

column.name: text
column.value: And thou seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire to her, that thou wouldest have her for thy wife;

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt bring her home to thy house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;

column.name: text
column.value: And she shall put off from her the raiment of her captivity, and shall remain in thy house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month: and after that thou shalt go in to her, and be her husband, and she shall be thy wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if thou shalt have no delight in her, then thou shalt let her go where she will; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money, thou shalt not make merchandise of her, because thou hast humbled her.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall have two wives, one beloved, and another hated, and they have borne him children, {both} the beloved and the hated; and {if} the firstborn son be hers that was hated:

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, when he maketh his sons to inherit {that} which he hath, {that} he may not prefer the son of the beloved firstborn before the son of the hated, {which is indeed} the firstborn:

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated {for} the firstborn, by giving him a double portion of all that he hath: for he {is} the beginning of his strength; the right of the firstborn {is} his.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall have a stubborn and rebellious son, who will not obey the voice of his father, or the voice of his mother, and {who}, when they have chastened him, will not hearken to them:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall his father and his mother lay hold on him, and bring him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place;

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall say to the elders of his city, This our son {is} stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; {he is} a glutton, and a drunkard.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of his city shall stone him with stones, that he may die: so shalt thou remove evil from among you; and all Israel shall hear, and fear.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man shall have committed a sin worthy of death, and he must be put to death, and thou shalt hang him on a tree:

column.name: text
column.value: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but thou shalt surely bury him that day; (for he that is hanged {is} accursed of God;) that thy land may not be defiled, which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not see thy brother's ox or his sheep go astray, and without thy help from them: thou shalt in any case bring them again to thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy brother shall not {be} near to thee, or if thou shalt not know him, then thou shalt bring it to thy own house, and it shall be with thee until thy brother shall seek after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again.

column.name: text
column.value: In like manner shalt thou do with his donkey; and so shalt thou do with his raiment; and with all lost things of thy brother's, which he hath lost, and thou hast found, shalt thou do likewise: thou mayest not without thy help.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not see thy brother's donkey or his ox fall down by the way, and without thy help from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift {them} up again.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman shall not wear that which pertaineth to a man, neither shall a man put on a woman's garment: for all that do so {are} abomination to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: If a bird's nest shall chance to be before thee in the way on any tree, or on the ground, {whether with} young ones, or eggs, and the dam sitting upon the young, or upon the eggs, thou shalt not take the dam with the young:

column.name: text
column.value: {But} thou shalt surely let the dam go, and take the young to thee; that it may be well with thee, and {that} thou mayest prolong {thy} days.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou buildest a new house, then thou shalt make a low wall for thy roof, that thou mayest not bring blood upon thy house, if any man shall fall from there.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with two kinds of seeds: lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown, and the fruit of thy vineyard, should be defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not wear a garment woven of woollen and linen together.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, with which thou coverest {thyself}.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man shall take a wife, and go in to her, and hate her,

column.name: text
column.value: And give occasions of speech against her, and bring an evil name upon her, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I found her not a maid:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the father of the damsel, and her mother, take and bring forth {the tokens of} the damsel's virginity to the elders of the city in the gate:

column.name: text
column.value: And the damsel's father shall say to the elders, I gave my daughter to this man for a wife, and he hateth her;

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, he hath given occasions of speech {against her}, saying, I found not thy daughter a maid; and yet these {are the tokens of} my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of that city shall take that man and chastise him;

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall fine him an hundred {shekels} of silver, and give {them} to the father of the damsel, because he hath brought an evil name upon a virgin of Israel: and she shall be his wife; he may not put her away all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: But if this thing shall be true, {and the tokens of} virginity be not found for the damsel:

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father's house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she may die: because she hath wrought folly in Israel, to play the harlot in her father's house: so shalt thou remove evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die, {both} the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou remove evil from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: If a damsel {that is} a virgin shall be betrothed to an husband, and a man shall find her in the city, and lie with her;

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and ye shall stone them with stones that they may die; the damsel, because she cried not, {being} in the city; and the man, because he hath humbled his neighbour's wife: so thou shalt remove evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man shall find a betrothed damsel in the field, and the man shall force her, and lie with her: then the man only that lay with her shall die:

column.name: text
column.value: But to the damsel thou shalt do nothing; {there is} in the damsel no sin {worthy} of death: for as when a man riseth against his neighbour, and slayeth him, even so {is} this matter:

column.name: text
column.value: For he found her in the field, {and} the betrothed damsel cried, and {there was} none to save her.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall find a damsel {that is} a virgin, who is not betrothed, and lay hold on her, and lie with her, and they be found;

column.name: text
column.value: Then the man that lay with her shall give to the damsel's father fifty {shekels} of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: A man shall not take his father's wife, nor uncover his father's skirt.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is wounded, or cut off in his secrets, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth from Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the LORD thy God would not hearken to Balaam; but the LORD thy God turned the curse into a blessing to thee, because the LORD thy God loved thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he {is} thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.

column.name: text
column.value: The children that are begotten by them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.

column.name: text
column.value: When the host goeth forth against thy enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth to him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash {himself} with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp {again}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt have a place also outside the camp, where thou shalt go forth abroad:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt have a shovel among thy weapons; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig with it, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thy enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he may see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not deliver to his master the servant who hath escaped from his master to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: He shall dwell with thee, {even} among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it pleaseth him best: thou shalt not oppress him.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be no harlot of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not bring the hire of an harlot, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these {are} abomination to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not lend upon interest to thy brother; interest of money, interest of food, interest of any thing that is lent upon interest:

column.name: text
column.value: To a stranger thou mayest lend upon interest; but to thy brother thou shalt not lend upon interest: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thy hand to in the land where thou goest to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou shalt vow a vow to the LORD thy God, thou shalt not defer to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: That which is uttered by thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; {even} a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed to the LORD thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, then thou mayest satisfy thy appetite with grapes at thy own pleasure; but thou shalt not put {any} in thy vessel.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou comest into the standing grain of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the heads with thy hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle to thy neighbour's standing grain.

column.name: text
column.value: When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it shall come to pass that she findeth no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give {it} in her hand, and send her out of his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she hath departed from his house, she may go and be another man's {wife}.

column.name: text
column.value: And {if} the latter husband shall hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and give {it} in her hand, and send her out of his house; or if the latter husband shall die, who took her {to be} his wife;

column.name: text
column.value: Her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that {is} abomination before the LORD: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: When a man hath newly taken a wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: {but} he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he hath taken.

column.name: text
column.value: No man shall take the lower or the upper millstone for a pledge: for he taketh {a man's} life for a pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall be found stealing {from} any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and shall make merchandise of him, or sell him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt remove evil from among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, {so} ye shall observe to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember what the LORD thy God did to Miriam by the way, after that ye had come forth from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to take his pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt stand outside, and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge outside to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the man {is} poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:

column.name: text
column.value: In any case thou shalt deliver to him the pledge again when the sun goeth down, that he may sleep in his own raiment, and bless thee: and it shall be righteousness to thee before the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant {that is} poor and needy, {whether he is} of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that {are} in thy land within thy gates:

column.name: text
column.value: At his day thou shalt give {him} his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he {is} poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he should cry against thee to the LORD, and it be sin to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, {nor} of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment for a pledge:

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a slave in Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee from there: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou cuttest down thy harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thy hands.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou beatest thy olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean {it} afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a slave in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be a controversy between men, and they come to judgment, that {the judges} may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if the wicked man {be} worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.

column.name: text
column.value: Forty stripes he may give him, {and} not exceed: lest, {if} he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out {the grain}.

column.name: text
column.value: If brethren shall dwell together, and one of them shall die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry outside {the family} to a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in to her, and take her to him for a wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, {that} the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother {who is} dead, that his name may not be blotted out from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the man shall not desire to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate to the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up to his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him: and {if} he shall stand {to it}, and say, I desire not to take her;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall his brother's wife come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done to that man that will not build up his brother's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.

column.name: text
column.value: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near to deliver her husband from the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thy eye shall not pity {her}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not have in thy bag differing weights, a great and a small.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not have in thy house differing measures, a great and a small.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For all that do such things, {and} all that do unrighteously, {are} an abomination to the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember what Amalek did to thee by the way, when ye had come forth from Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: How he met thee by the way, and smote those behind thee, {even} all {that were} feeble behind thee, when thou {wast} faint and weary; and he feared not God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD thy God hath given thee rest from all thy enemies on all sides, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance to possess it, {that} thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when thou {hast} come in to the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee {for} an inheritance, and dost possess it, and dwellest in it;

column.name: text
column.value: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put {it} in a basket, and shalt go to the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt go to the priest that shall be in those days, and say to him, I profess this day to the LORD thy God, that I have come to the country which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take the basket from thy hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish {was} my father, and he went down to Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians oppressed us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:

column.name: text
column.value: And when we cried to the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, {even} a land that floweth with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt rejoice in every good {thing} which the LORD thy God hath given to thee, and to thy house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that {is} among you.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou hast finished tithing all the tithes of thy increase the third year, {which is} the year of tithing, and hast given {it} to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of {my} house, and also have given them to the Levite, and to the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten {them}:

column.name: text
column.value: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I taken away {any} of it for {any} unclean {use}, nor given {any} of it for the dead: {but} I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, {and} have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou didst swear to our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

column.name: text
column.value: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to perform these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thy heart, and with all thy soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast proclaimed the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken to his voice:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hath proclaimed thee this day to be his special people, as he hath promised thee, and that {thou} shouldest keep all his commandments;

column.name: text
column.value: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people to the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan to the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaster them with plaster:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou hast passed over, that thou mayest enter in to the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall be when ye have gone over Jordan, {that} ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaster them with plaster.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shalt thou build an altar to the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up {any} iron {tool} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer on it burnt offerings to the LORD thy God:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses and the priests the Levites spoke to all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye have come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

column.name: text
column.value: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites shall speak, and say to all the men of Israel with a loud voice,

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} the man that maketh {any} graven or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth {it} in {a} secret {place}. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that dishonoureth his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} he that confirmeth not {all} the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently to the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe {and} to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {shalt} thou {be} in the city, and blessed {shalt} thou {be} in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {shall be} the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy cattle, and the flocks of thy sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {shall be} thy basket and thy store.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {shalt} thou {be} when thou comest in, and blessed {shalt} thou {be} when thou goest out.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall cause thy enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thy hand to; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people to himself, as he hath sworn to thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall make thee to abound in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD swore to thy fathers to give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall open to thee his good treasure, the heaven to give rain to thy land in its season, and to bless all the work of thy hand: and thou shalt lend to many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if thou shalt hearken to the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do {them}:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, {to} the right hand, or {to} the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {shalt} thou {be} in the city, and cursed {shalt} thou {be} in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {shall be} thy basket and thy store.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {shall be} the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy cattle, and the flocks of thy sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {shalt} thou {be} when thou comest in, and cursed {shalt} thou {be} when thou goest out.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thy hand to do, until thou shalt be destroyed, and until thou shalt perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, by which thou hast forsaken me.

column.name: text
