column.value: And the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephothmaim, {and} all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot to the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

column.name: text
column.value: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, {even} as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;

column.name: text
column.value: From Aroer, that {is} upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that {is} in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

column.name: text
column.value: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

column.name: text
column.value: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salcah;

column.name: text
column.value: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the children of Israel drove not out the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire {are} their inheritance, as he said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben {inheritance} according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their land was from Aroer, that {is} on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that {is} in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon, and all its cities that {are} in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

column.name: text
column.value: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, {who were} chiefs of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

column.name: text
column.value: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and its border. This {was} the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave {inheritance} to the tribe of Gad, {even} to the children of Gad according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their land was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that {is} before Rabbah;

column.name: text
column.value: And from Heshbon to Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

column.name: text
column.value: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and {its} border, {even} to the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side of Jordan eastward.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses gave {inheritance} to the half tribe of Manasseh: and {this} was {the possession} of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their land was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which {are} in Bashan, sixty cities:

column.name: text
column.value: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, {went} to the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, {even} to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are the countries} which Moses distributed for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side of Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave not {any} inheritance: the LORD God of Israel {was} their inheritance, as he said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, to the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,

column.name: text
column.value: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along to the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

column.name: text
column.value: And goeth down westward to the border of Japhleti, to the border of Bethhoron the lower, and to Gezer: and the ends of it are at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was {thus}: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, to Bethhoron the upper;

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward to Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

column.name: text
column.value: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and came out at Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the river Kanah; and the ends of it were at the sea. This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim {were} among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did not drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, and serve at forced labour.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are the countries} which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

column.name: text
column.value: By lot {was} their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and {for} the half tribe.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side of Jordan: but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

column.name: text
column.value: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell {in}, with their common lands for their cattle and for their substance.

column.name: text
column.value: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the children of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said to him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said to Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.

column.name: text
column.value: Forty years old {was} I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to spy the land; and I brought him word again as {it was} in my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses swore on that day, saying, Surely the land on which thy feet have trodden shall be thy inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spoke this word to Moses, while {the children of} Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I {am} this day eighty and five years old.

column.name: text
column.value: As yet I {am as} strong this day as {I was} in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength {was} then, even so {is} my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore give me this mountain, of which the LORD spoke in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims {were} there, and {that} the cities {were} great {and} fortified: if the LORD {will be} with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua blessed him, and gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite to this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of Hebron before {was} Kirjatharba; {which Arba was} a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

column.name: text
column.value: {This} then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; {even} to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward {was} the uttermost part of the south border.

column.name: text
column.value: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

column.name: text
column.value: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended on the south side to Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and turned about to Karkaa:

column.name: text
column.value: {From there} it passed toward Azmon, and went out to the river of Egypt; and the ends of that border were at the sea: this shall be your south border.

column.name: text
column.value: And the east border {was} the salt sea, {even} to the end of Jordan. And {their} border in the north quarter {was} from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that {is} before the ascent of Adummim, which {is} on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the borders of it were at Enrogel:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite; the same {is} Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that {lieth} before the valley of Hinnom westward, which {is} at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border extended from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah, which {is} Kirjathjearim:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border turned from Baalah westward to mount Seir, and passed along to the side of mount Jearim, which {is} Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went out to the side of Ekron northward: and the border extended to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out to Jabneel; and the ends of the border were at the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the west border {was} to the great sea, and its coast. This {is} the border of the children of Judah all around according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, {even} the city of Arba the father of Anak, which {city is} Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb drove from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before {was} Kirjathsepher.

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as she came {to him}, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she got off {her} donkey; and Caleb said to her, What wouldest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the lower springs.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

column.name: text
column.value: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

column.name: text
column.value: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, {and} Hezron, which {is} Hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,

column.name: text
column.value: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

column.name: text
column.value: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities {are} twenty and nine, with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: {And} in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,

column.name: text
column.value: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

column.name: text
column.value: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

column.name: text
column.value: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

column.name: text
column.value: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

column.name: text
column.value: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Ekron, with its towns and its villages:

column.name: text
column.value: From Ekron even to the sea, all that {lay} near Ashdod, with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Ashdod with its towns and its villages, Gaza with its towns and its villages, to the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and its border:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

column.name: text
column.value: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which {is} Debir,

column.name: text
column.value: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

column.name: text
column.value: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

column.name: text
column.value: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which {is} Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

column.name: text
column.value: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,

column.name: text
column.value: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Kirjathbaal, which {is} Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, {even} for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,

column.name: text
column.value: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the villages that {were} around these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the portion of the children of Judah {was} the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was to Sarid:

column.name: text
column.value: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that {is} before Jokneam;

column.name: text
column.value: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising to the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

column.name: text
column.value: And from there passeth along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went around it on the north side to Hannathon: and the ends of it are in the valley of Jiphthahel:

column.name: text
column.value: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

column.name: text
column.value: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

column.name: text
column.value: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;

column.name: text
column.value: And the border reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the ends of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

column.name: text
column.value: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;

column.name: text
column.value: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, {even} to great Zidon;

column.name: text
column.value: And {then} the border turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the border turneth to Hosah; and the ends of it are at the sea from the border to Achzib:

column.name: text
column.value: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, {even} for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And their land was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakum; and its ends were at Jordan:

column.name: text
column.value: And {then} the border turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from there to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fortified cities {are} Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

column.name: text
column.value: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

column.name: text
column.value: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,

column.name: text
column.value: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,

column.name: text
column.value: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

column.name: text
column.value: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,

column.name: text
column.value: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Japho.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border of the children of Dan went out {too little} for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt in it, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had finished dividing the land for inheritance by their borders, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

column.name: text
column.value: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, {even} Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt in it.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their common lands for our cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, {who were} of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the children of Kohath {had} by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Gershon {had} by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Merari by their families {had} out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their common lands, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are {here} mentioned by name,

column.name: text
column.value: Which the children of Aaron, {being} of the families of the Kohathites, {who were} of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which {city is} Hebron, in the hill {country} of Judah, with its common lands around it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with its common lands, {to be} a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jattir with its common lands, and Eshtemoa with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Holon with its common lands, and Debir with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ain with its common lands, and Juttah with its common lands, {and} Bethshemesh with its common lands; nine cities out of those two tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its common lands, Geba with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Anathoth with its common lands, and Almon with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, {were} thirteen cities with their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites who remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: For they gave them Shechem with its common lands in mount Ephraim, {to be} a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Kibzaim with its common lands, and Bethhoron with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with its common lands, Gibbethon with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Aijalon with its common lands, Gathrimmon with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with its common lands, and Gathrimmon with its common lands; two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities {were} ten with their common lands for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the {other} half tribe of Manasseh {they gave} Golan in Bashan with its common lands, {to be} a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with its common lands; two cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with its common lands, Dabareh with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Jarmuth with its common lands, Engannim with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its common lands, Abdon with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Helkath with its common lands, and Rehob with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its common lands, {to be} a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with its common lands, and Kartan with its common lands; three cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families {were} thirteen cities with their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its common lands, and Kartah with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Dimnah with its common lands, Nahalal with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its common lands, and Jahazah with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedemoth with its common lands, and Mephaath with its common lands; four cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its common lands, {to be} a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Heshbon with its common lands, Jazer with its common lands; four cities in all.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were {by} their lot twelve cities.

column.name: text
column.value: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel {were} forty and eight cities with their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: These cities were every one with their common lands surrounding them: thus {were} all these cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave them rest on all sides, according to all that he swore to their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: There failed nothing of any good thing which the LORD had spoken to the house of Israel; all came to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

column.name: text
column.value: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adonibezek said, seventy kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered {their food} under my table: as I have done, so God hath repaid me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt on the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before {was} Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

column.name: text
column.value: And from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before {was} Kirjathsepher:

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when she came {to him}, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she got off {her} donkey; and Caleb said to her, What wilt thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which {lieth} in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Judah took Gaza with its land, and Askelon with its land, and Ekron with its land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drove out {the inhabitants of} the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses said: and he drove out from there the three sons of Anak.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD {was} with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (Now the name of the city before {was} Luz.)

column.name: text
column.value: And the spies saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will show thee mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he showed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name of it Luz: which {is} its name to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Manasseh drive out {the inhabitants of} Bethshean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they subjected the Canaanites to forced labour, and did not utterly drive them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became forced labourers.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

column.name: text
column.value: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became forced labourers to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan to the mountain: for they would not allow them to come down to the valley:

column.name: text
column.value: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became forced labourers.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border of the Amorites {was} from the ascent to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the river of old, {even} Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor: and they served other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the river, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

column.name: text
column.value: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came to the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they cried to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

column.name: text
column.value: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, who dwelt on the other side of Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

column.name: text
column.value: But I would not hearken to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye went over Jordan, and came to Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, {even} the two kings of the Amorites; {but} not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the river, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it seemeth evil to you to serve the LORD, choose for yourselves this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that {were} on the other side of the river, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people answered and said, Be it far from us that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD our God, he {it is} that brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites who dwelt in the land: {therefore} will we also serve the LORD; for he {is} our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he {is} an holy God; he {is} a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you harm, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to the people, Ye {are} witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, {We are} witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore put away, {said he}, the foreign gods which {are} among you, and incline your heart to the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that {was} by the sanctuary of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spoke to us: it shall be therefore a witness to you, lest ye deny your God.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua let the people depart, every man to his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, {being} an hundred and ten years old.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which {is} in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and who had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought out of Egypt, they buried in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill {that pertained to} Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, How long {will} ye neglect to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

column.name: text
column.value: Pick out from among you three men for {each} tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come {again} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their land on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their land on the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall therefore describe the land {in} seven parts, and bring {the description} here to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD {is} their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men arose, and departed: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities in seven parts in a book, and came {again} to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the land of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the ends of it were at the wilderness of Bethaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which {is} Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that {lieth} on the south side of the lower Bethhoron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border extended {from there}, and went around the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that {lieth} before Bethhoron southward; and the ends of it were at Kirjathbaal, which {is} Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this {was} the west quarter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the south quarter {was} from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that {lieth} before the valley of the son of Hinnom, {and} which {is} in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,

column.name: text
column.value: And extended from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which {is} opposite the ascent of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

column.name: text
column.value: And passed along toward the side opposite Arabah northward, and went down to Arabah:

column.name: text
column.value: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the ends of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this {was} the south border.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This {was} the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by its borders all around, according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

column.name: text
column.value: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,

column.name: text
column.value: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

column.name: text
column.value: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

column.name: text
column.value: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which {is} Jerusalem, Gibeath, {and} Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This {is} the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest to Israel from all their enemies on all sides, that Joshua became old {and} advanced in years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua called for all Israel, {and} for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said to them, I am old {and} advanced in years:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done to all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God {is} he that hath fought for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have divided to you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea westward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD your God, he shall drive them out from before you, and drive them from your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside from it {to} the right hand or {to} the left;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear {by them}, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves to them:

column.name: text
column.value: But hold fast to the LORD your God, as ye have done to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but {as for} you, no man hath been able to stand before you to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he {it is} that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

column.name: text
column.value: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Else if ye do in any way go back, and follow after the remnant of these nations, {even} these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and associate with them, and they with you:

column.name: text
column.value: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out {any of} these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps to you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, this day I {am} going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you; all are come to pass to you, {and} not one thing hath failed of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall come to pass, {that} as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he hath destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

column.name: text
column.value: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also spoke to Joshua, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint for you cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: That the slayer that killeth {any} person unintentionally {and} unknowingly may flee there: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he that doth flee to one of those cities shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city to them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the avenger of blood shall pursue him, then they shall not deliver the slayer into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unknowingly, and had not hated him in times past.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall dwell in that city, until he shall stand before the congregation for judgment, {and} until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city from which he fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which {is} Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the other side of Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger sojourning among them, that whoever should kill {any} person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he {was} the firstborn of Joseph; {that is}, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: There was also {a lot} for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these {were} the male offspring of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these {are} the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

column.name: text
column.value: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which {were} on the other side of Jordan;

column.name: text
column.value: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that {lieth} before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand to the inhabitants of Entappuah.

column.name: text
column.value: {Now} Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh {belonged} to the children of Ephraim;

column.name: text
column.value: And the border descended to the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim {are} among the cities of Manasseh: the border of Manasseh also {was} on the north side of the river, and the ends of it were at the sea:

column.name: text
column.value: Southward {it was} Ephraim's, and northward {it was} Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns, {even} three countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out {the inhabitants of} those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel had become strong, that they subjected the Canaanites to forced labour; but did not utterly drive them out.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me {but} one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I {am} a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me until now?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua answered them, If thou {art} a great people, {then} go up to the forest, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim is too small for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, {both they} who {are} of Bethshean and its towns, and {they} who {are} of the valley of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, {even} to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou {art} a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot {only}:

column.name: text
column.value: But the mountain shall be thine; for it {is} a forest, and thou shalt cut it down: and the borders of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, {and} though they {are} strong.

column.name: text
column.value: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to depart from Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be {as thorns} in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man to his inheritance to possess the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, {being} an hundred and ten years old.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

column.name: text
column.value: And also all that generation were gathered to their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:

column.name: text
column.value: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that {were} around them, and bowed themselves to them, and provoked the LORD to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies around {them}, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn to them: and they were greatly distressed.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, who delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet they would not hearken to their judges, but they played the harlot with other gods, and bowed themselves to them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; {but} they did not so.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD raised up judges for them, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for the LORD repented because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and burdened them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, {that} they returned, and corrupted {themselves} more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down to them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened to my voice;

column.name: text
column.value: I also will not henceforth drive out from before them any of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

column.name: text
column.value: That through them I may test Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk in it, as their fathers kept {it}, or not.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out speedily; neither did he deliver them into the hand of Joshua.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, {even} as many {of Israel} as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

column.name: text
column.value: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing of it;

column.name: text
column.value: {Namely}, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt on mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon to the entrance of Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were to test Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken to the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

column.name: text
column.value: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgot the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, {even} Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered to him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

column.name: text
column.value: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the children of Israel cried to the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he girded it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon {was} a very fat man.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people that bore the tribute.

column.name: text
column.value: But he himself turned back at the quarries that {were} by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand to thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ehud came to him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God to thee. And he arose from {his} seat.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

column.name: text
column.value: And the handle also entered after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour {were} locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened {them}: and, behold, their lord lay dead on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped to Seirath.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Follow me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and permitted not a man to pass over.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all stout, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

column.name: text
column.value: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest eighty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, after Ehud was dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host {was} Sisera, who dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel cried to the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam from Kedeshnaphtali, and said to him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, {saying}, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

column.name: text
column.value: And I will draw to thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barak said to her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, {then} I will not go.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, I will surely go with thee: however the journey that thou takest shall not be for thy honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Heber the Kenite, {who was} of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had separated himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent to the plain of Zaanaim, which {is} by Kedesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And they showed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to mount Tabor.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, {even} nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that {were} with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles to the river of Kishon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Deborah said to Barak, Arise; for this {is} the day when the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thy hand: hath not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD destroyed Sisera, and all {his} chariots, and all {his} host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera came down from {his} chariot, and fled away on his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But Barak pursued the chariots, and the host, to Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; {and} there was not a man left.

column.name: text
column.value: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for {there was} peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in to her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he said to her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, Come, and I will show thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her {tent}, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail {was} in his temples.

column.name: text
column.value: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have not left your brethren these many days to this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now the LORD your God hath given rest to your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and go to your tents, {and} to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side of Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: But take diligent heed to perform the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to the {one} half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given {possession} in Bashan: but to their {other} half gave Joshua among their brethren on this side of Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also to their tents, then he blessed them,

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to them, saying, Return with much riches to your tents, and with very many cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which {is} in the land of Canaan, to go to the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, of which they had taken possession, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to the borders of Jordan, that {are} in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar in appearance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel heard it said, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar at the border of the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, on the side belonging to the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Israel heard {of it}, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one {was} an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass {is} this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have built you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, {seeing} ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: However, if the land of your possession {is} unclean, {then} pass ye over to the land of the possession of the LORD, in which the LORD'S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar besides the altar of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fall on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if {it is} in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)

column.name: text
column.value: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer on it burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings on it, let the LORD himself require {it};

column.name: text
column.value: And if we have not {rather} done it for fear of {this} thing, saying, In time to come your children may speak to our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.

column.name: text
