column.value: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

column.name: text
column.value: But {that} it {may be} a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we may do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they shall {so} say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it {is} a witness between us and you.

column.name: text
column.value: Far be it from us that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, besides the altar of the LORD our God that {is} before his tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel who {were} with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD {is} among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, from the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar {Ed}: for it {shall be} a witness between us that the LORD {is} God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, {even} I, will sing to the LORD; I will sing {praise} to the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou didst march out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens poured, the clouds also poured water.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains melted from before the LORD, {even} that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

column.name: text
column.value: {The inhabitants of} the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They chose new gods; then {was} war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: My heart {is} toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak, ye that ride on white donkeys, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

column.name: text
column.value: {They that are delivered} from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, {even} the righteous acts {toward the inhabitants} of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of Ephraim {was there} a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

column.name: text
column.value: And the princes of Issachar {were} with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben {there were} great thoughts of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben {there were} great searchings of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his inlets.

column.name: text
column.value: Zebulun and Naphtali {were} a people {that} jeoparded their lives to death in the high places of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: The kings came {and} fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

column.name: text
column.value: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

column.name: text
column.value: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

column.name: text
column.value: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly its inhabitants; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked water, {and} she gave {him} milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

column.name: text
column.value: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and struck through his temples.

column.name: text
column.value: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

column.name: text
column.value: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot {so} long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

column.name: text
column.value: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

column.name: text
column.value: Have they not found? have they {not} divided the spoil; to every man a damsel {or} two; to Sisera a spoil of dyed garments, a spoil of dyed garments of needlework, of dyed garments of needlework on both sides, for the necks of {them that take} the spoil?

column.name: text
column.value: So let all thy enemies perish, O LORD: but {let} them that love him {be} as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: {and} because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which {are} in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

column.name: text
column.value: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou comest to Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; {for} both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried to the LORD because of the Midianites,

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD sent a prophet to the children of Israel, who said to them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth from the house of bondage;

column.name: text
column.value: And I delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians, and from the hand of all that oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land;

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to you, I {am} the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which {was} in Ophrah, that {pertained} to Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide {it} from the Midianites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD appeared to him, and said to him, The LORD {is} with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said to him, O my Lord, if the LORD is with us, why then hath all this befallen us? and where {are} all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, O my Lord, how shall I save Israel? behold, my family {is} poor in Manasseh, and I {am} the least in my father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then show me a sign that thou talkest with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Depart not from here, I pray thee, until I come to thee, and bring forth my present, and set {it} before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou comest again.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought {it} out to him under the oak, and presented {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of God said to him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay {them} upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that {was} in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed from his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Gideon perceived that he {was} an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Peace {be} to thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: to this day it {is} yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said to him, Take thy father's young bull, even the second bull of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that {is} by it:

column.name: text
column.value: And build an altar to the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said to him: and {so} it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do {it} by day, that he did {it} by night.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that {was} by it, and the second bull was offered upon the altar {that was} built.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of the city said to Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that {was} by it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joash said to all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death by morning: if he {is} a god, let him plead for himself, because {one} hath cast down his altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was called after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was called after him: and he sent messengers to Asher, and to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said to God, If thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast said,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the floor; {and} if the dew shall be on the fleece only, and {it shall be} dry upon all the earth {besides}, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast said.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so: for he rose early on the next morning, and pressed the fleece, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said to God, Let not thy anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me make a test, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

column.name: text
column.value: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jerubbaal, who {is} Gideon, and all the people that {were} with him, rose early, and encamped beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people that {are} with thee {are} too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, My own hand hath saved me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whoever {is} fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Gideon, The people {are} yet {too} many; bring them down to the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, {that} of whom I say to thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomever I say to thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

column.name: text
column.value: So he brought down the people to the water: and the LORD said to Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And the number of them that lapped, {putting} their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thy hand: and let all the {other} people go every man to his place.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people took provisions in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all {the rest of} Israel every man to his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said to him, Arise, go down to the host; for I have delivered it into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou fearest to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thy hands be strengthened to go down to the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant to the outside of the armed men that {were} in the host.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels {were} without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Gideon had come, behold, {there was} a man that told a dream to his friend, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread rolled into the host of Midian, and came to a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay flat.

column.name: text
column.value: And his friend answered and said, This {is} nothing else except the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: {for} into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and its interpretation, that he worshipped, and returned to the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

column.name: text
column.value: And he divided the three hundred men {into} three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be {that}, as I do, so shall ye do.

column.name: text
column.value: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that {are} with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, {The sword} of the LORD, and of Gideon.

column.name: text
column.value: So Gideon, and the hundred men that {were} with him, came to the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and broke the pitchers that {were} in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and broke the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow {with}: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stood every man in his place around the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his companion, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, {and} to the border of Abelmeholah, to Tabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued the Midianites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters to Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters to Bethbarah and Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Ephraim said to him, Why hast thou done this to us, that thou didst call us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did contend with him sharply.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What have I done now in comparison of you? {Is} not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

column.name: text
column.value: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then, when he had said that, their anger toward him abated.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon came to Jordan, {and} passed over, he, and the three hundred men that {were} with him, faint, yet pursuing {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread to the people that follow me; for they {are} faint, and I am pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

column.name: text
column.value: And the princes of Succoth said, {Are} the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy army?

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up from there to Penuel, and spoke to them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Zebah and Zalmunna {were} in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand {men}, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and overcame all the host.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun {had risen},

column.name: text
column.value: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, {even} seventy and seven men.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye upbraided me, saying, {Are} the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thy hand, that we should give bread to thy men {that are} weary?

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men {were they} whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou {art}, so {were} they; each one resembled the children of a king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, They {were} my brethren, {even} the sons of my mother: {as} the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Jether his firstborn, Arise, {and} slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he {was} yet a youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man {is, so is} his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that {were} on their camels' necks.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said to them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon said to them, I would desire a request of you, that you would give me every man the earrings of his spoil. (For they had golden earrings, because they {were} Ishmaelites.)

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered, We will willingly give {them}. And they spread a garment, and cast into it every man the earrings of his spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred {shekels} of gold; besides ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that {was} on the kings of Midian, and besides the chains that {were} about their camels' necks.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon made of it an ephod, and put it in his city, {even} in Ophrah: and all Israel went there playing the harlot with it: which thing became a snare to Gideon, and to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they raised their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon had seventy sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

column.name: text
column.value: And his concubine that {was} in Shechem, she also bore him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went playing the harlot with Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither showed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, {namely}, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother's brethren, and talked with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Which {is} better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, {which are} seventy persons, should reign over you, or that one should reign over you? remember also that I {am} your bone and your flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And his mother's brethren spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He {is} our brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave him seventy {pieces} of silver out of the house of Baalberith, with which Abimelech hired worthless and light persons, who followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went to his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, {being} seventy persons, upon one stone: however Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that {was} in Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they told {it} to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said to them, Hearken to me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken to you.

column.name: text
column.value: The trees went forth {once} to anoint a king over them; and they said to the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

column.name: text
column.value: But the olive tree said to them, Should I leave my fatness, with which by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

column.name: text
column.value: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, {and} reign over us.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fig tree said to them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the trees to the vine, Come thou, {and} reign over us.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vine said to them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said all the trees to the bramble, Come thou, {and} reign over us.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bramble said to the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, {then} come {and} put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands;

column.name: text
column.value: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you from the hand of Midian:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, seventy persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he {is} your brother;)

column.name: text
column.value: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, {then} rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

column.name: text
column.value: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

column.name: text
column.value: That the cruelty {done} to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, who slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, who aided him in the killing of his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trod {the grapes}, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who {is} Abimelech, and who {is} Shechem, that we should serve him? {is} not {he} the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

column.name: text
column.value: And would that this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thy army, and come out.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent messengers to Abimelech deceitfully, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren are come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore rise up by night, thou and the people that {are} with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, {that} in the morning, as soon as the sun hath risen, thou shalt rise early, and rush upon the city: and, behold, {when} he and the people that {are} with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech rose, and all the people that {were} with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose, and the people that {were} with him, from lying in wait.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as {if they were} men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gaal spoke again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Zebul to him, Where {is} now thy mouth, with which thou saidst, Who {is} Abimelech, that we should serve him? {are} not these the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown {and} wounded, {even} to the entrance of the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people {had} come out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech, and the company that {was} with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city: and the two {other} companies ran upon all {the people} that {were} in the fields, and slew them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that {were} in it, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard {that}, they entered into a strong hold of the house of the god Berith.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech went up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that {were} with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid {it} on his shoulder, and said to the people that {were} with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, {and} do as I {have done}.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put {them} to the strong hold, and set the strong hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

column.name: text
column.value: But there was a strong tower within the city, and to there fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut {it} after them, and went up to the top of the tower.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abimelech came to the tower, and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and broke his skull.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called hastily to the young man his armourbearer, and said to him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man to his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

column.name: text
column.value: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty young donkeys, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair to this day, which {are} in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And that year they afflicted and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that {were} on the other side of Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which {is} in Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was greatly distressed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to the children of Israel, {Did} not {I deliver you} from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

column.name: text
column.value: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: therefore I will deliver you no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Go and cry to the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel said to the LORD, We have sinned: do thou to us whatever seemeth good to thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put away the foreign gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people {and} princes of Gilead said one to another, What man {is he} that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he {was} the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gilead's wife bore him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said to him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou {art} the son of a another woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered worthless men to Jephthah, and {they} went out with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, Did ye not hate me, and drive me out of my father's house? and why have ye come to me now when ye are in distress?

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, The LORD be a witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou hast come against me to fight in my land?

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of the children of Ammon answered to the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came out of Egypt, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and to Jordan: now therefore restore those {lands} again peaceably.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon:

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

column.name: text
column.value: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness to the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

column.name: text
column.value: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken {to it}. And in like manner they sent to the king of Moab: but he would not {consent}: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they went along through the wilderness, and went around the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and encamped on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon {was} the border of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land to my place.

column.name: text
column.value: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his land: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and encamped in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

column.name: text
column.value: And they possessed all the land of the Amorites, from Arnon even to Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

column.name: text
column.value: And now {art} thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

column.name: text
column.value: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that {are} along by the banks of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover {them} within that time?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not to the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over {to} the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into my hands,

column.name: text
column.value: Then it shall be, that whatever cometh out of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD'S, and I will offer it for a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jephthah passed over to the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou comest to Minnith, {even} twenty cities, and to the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh to his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she {was his} only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he tore his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth to the LORD, and I cannot go back.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, My father, {if} thou hast opened thy mouth to the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thy enemies, {even} of the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my companions.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Go. And he sent her away {for} two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned to her father, who did with her {according} to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: {That} the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said to Jephthah, Why didst thou pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thy house upon thee with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah said to them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I saw that ye delivered {me} not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: why then have ye come up to me this day, to fight against me?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites {are} fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, {and} among the Manassites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Gileadites took the fords of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was {so}, that when those Ephraimites who had escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said to him, {Art} thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce {it} right. Then they took him, and slew him at the fords of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in {one of} the cities of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, {whom} he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had forty sons and thirty grandsons, that rode on seventy young donkeys: and he judged Israel eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name {was} Manoah; and his wife {was} barren, and bore not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD appeared to the woman, and said to her, Behold now, thou {art} barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean {thing}:

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel from the hand of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came to me, and his countenance {was} like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not where he {was} from, neither did he tell me his name:

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean {thing}: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Manoah entreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God whom thou didst send come again to us, and teach us what we shall do to the child that shall be born.

column.name: text
column.value: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband {was} not with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman made haste, and ran, and showed her husband, and said to him, Behold, the man hath appeared to me, that came to me the {other} day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said to him, {Art} thou the man that didst speak to the woman? And he said, I {am}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and {how} shall we do to him?

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Of all that I said to the woman let her beware.

column.name: text
column.value: She may not eat of any {thing} that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean {thing}: all that I commanded her let her observe.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, Though thou shouldest detain me, I will not eat of thy food: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it to the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he {was} an angel of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, What {is} thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it {is} wonderful?

column.name: text
column.value: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered {it} upon a rock to the LORD: and {the angel} did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

column.name: text
column.value: For it came to pass, when the flame ascended toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on {it}, and fell on their faces to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he {was} an angel of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Manoah said to his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

column.name: text
column.value: But his wife said to him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have showed us all these {things}, nor would as at this time have told us {such things} as these.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman bore a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Then his father and his mother said to him, {Is there} not a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said to his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

column.name: text
column.value: But his father and his mother knew not that it {was} of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he tore him as he would have torn a kid, and {he had} nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

column.name: text
column.value: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, {there was} a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took of it in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they ate: but he told them not that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

column.name: text
column.value: So his father went down to the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said to them, I will now tell a riddle to you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find {it} out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye cannot declare {it} to me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said to him, Tell thy riddle, that we may hear it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Out of the eater came forth food, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said to Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare to us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take what we possess? {is it} not {so}?

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast told a riddle to the children of my people, and hast not told {it} to me. And he said to her, Behold, I have not told {it} to my father nor to my mother, and shall I tell {it} to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she pressed him so hard: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What {is} sweeter than honey? and what {is} stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments to them who expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: But Samson's wife was {given} to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass after a while, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not allow him to go in.

column.name: text
column.value: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: {is} not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them harm.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took torches, and turned tail to tail, and put a torch in the midst between two tails.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had lighted the torches, he let {them} go into the standing grain of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing grain, with the vineyards {and} olives.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said to them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

column.name: text
column.value: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Philistines went up, and encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Judah said, Why have ye come up against us? And they answered, We have come to bind Samson, to do to him as he hath done to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines {are} rulers over us? what {is} this {that} thou hast done to us? And he said to them, As they did to me, so have I done to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, We have come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Swear to me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to him, saying, No; but we will bind thee securely, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that {were} upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men with it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said, With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of a donkey have I slain a thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had finished speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was very thirsty, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die by thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

column.name: text
column.value: But God opened an hollow place that {was} in the jaw, and there came water out of it; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: therefore he called the name of it Enhakkore, which {is} in Lehi to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in to her.

column.name: text
column.value: {And it was told} the Gazites, saying, Samson is come here. And they surrounded {him}, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put {them} upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that {is} before Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name {was} Delilah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lords of the Philistines came to her, and said to her, Entice him, and see where his great strength {lieth}, and by what {means} we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred {pieces} of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, where thy great strength {lieth}, and how thou mayest be bound to afflict thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said to her, If they bind me with seven new cords that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lords of the Philistines brought to her seven new cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {there were} men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said to him, The Philistines {are} upon thee, Samson. And he broke the cords, as a string of a wick is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

column.name: text
column.value: And Delilah said to Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, how thou mayest be bound.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, If they bind me securely with new ropes that never were used, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

column.name: text
column.value: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him with them, and said to him, The Philistines {are} upon thee, Samson. And {there were} those lying in wait abiding in the chamber. And he broke them from off his arms like a thread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Delilah said to Samson, Until now thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me how thou mayest be bound. And he said to her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

column.name: text
column.value: And she fastened {it} with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines {are} upon thee, Samson. And he awoke from his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thy heart {is} not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me where thy great strength {lieth}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, {so} that his soul was vexed to death;

column.name: text
column.value: That he told her all his heart, and said to her, There hath not come a razor upon my head; for I {have been} a Nazarite to God from my mother's womb: if I be shaved, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any {other} man.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath showed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her, and brought money in their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, The Philistines {are} upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he knew not that the LORD had departed from him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

column.name: text
column.value: However the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, who slew many of us.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said to the lad that held him by the hand, Permit me to feel the pillars upon which the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines {were} there; and {there were} upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson called to the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it rested, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with {all his} might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that {were} in it. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than {they} which he slew in his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought {him} up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, when {there was} no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite dwelling on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Bethlehemjudah.

column.name: text
column.value: And his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him to her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.

column.name: text
column.value: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak kindly to her, {and} to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of donkeys: and she brought him into her father's house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father in law, the damsel's father, detained him; and he abode with him three days: so they ate and drank, and lodged there.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he arose to depart: and the damsel's father said to his son in law, Strengthen thy heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward depart.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sat down, and ate and drank both of them together: for the damsel's father had said to the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thy heart be merry.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the man rose to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Strengthen thy heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they ate both of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the man arose to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel's father, said to him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day is coming to an end, lodge here, that thy heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

column.name: text
column.value: But the man would not tarry that night, but he arose and departed, and came opposite Jebus, which {is} Jerusalem; and {there were} with him two donkeys saddled, his concubine also {was} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when they {were} by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in to this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And his master said to him, We will not turn aside here into the city of a stranger, that {is} not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them {when they were} by Gibeah, which {belongeth} to Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And they turned aside there, to go in {and} to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat down in a street of the city: for {there was} no man that took them into his house to lodge.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at evening, who {was} also of mount Ephraim; and he dwelt in Gibeah: but the men of the place {were} Benjamites.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Where goest thou? and where do you come from?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, We {are} passing from Bethlehemjudah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from there {am} I: and I went to Bethlehemjudah, but I {am now} going to the house of the LORD; and there {is} no man that receiveth me into {his} house.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet there is both straw and fodder for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man {which is} with thy servants: {there is} no want of any thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And the old man said, Peace {be} with thee; however {let} all thy wants {lie} upon me; only lodge not in the street.

column.name: text
column.value: So he brought him into his house, and gave fodder to the donkeys: and they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

column.name: text
column.value: {Now} as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain perverted men, beset the house on all sides, {and} beat at the door, and spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thy house, that we may know him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, Nay, my brethren, {nay}, I pray you, do not {so} wickedly; seeing that this man is come into my house, do not this folly.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, {here is} my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good to you: but to this man do not so vile a thing.

column.name: text
column.value: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth to them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord {was}, till it was light.

column.name: text
column.value: And her lord rose in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down {at} the door of the house, and her hands {were} upon the threshold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Rise, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her upon a donkey, and the man rose, and went to his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There hath been no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came from the land of Egypt to this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak {your minds}.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name {was} Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred {shekels} of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou didst curse, and spoke of also in my ears, behold, the silver {is} with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed {be thou} of the LORD, my son.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had restored the eleven hundred {shekels} of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he restored the money to his mother; and his mother took two hundred {shekels} of silver, and gave them to the silversmith, who made of it a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days {there was} no king in Israel, {but} every man did {that which was} right in his own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who {was} a Levite, and he sojourned there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find {a place}: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I {am} a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find {a place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micah said to him, Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten {shekels} of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy sustenance. So the Levite went in.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Micah, Now I know that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite for {my} priest.

column.name: text
