column.value: In those days {there was} no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought for themselves an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day {all their} inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their land, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said to them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

column.name: text
column.value: When they {were} by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in there, and said to him, Who brought thee here? and what makest thou in this {place}? and what hast thou here?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest said to them, Go in peace: before the LORD {is} your way in which ye go.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that {were} in it, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and {there was} no magistrate in the land, that might put {them} to shame in {any} thing; and they {were} far from the Zidonians, and had no business with {any} man.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said to them, What {say} ye?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it {is} very good: and {are} ye still? be not slothful to go, {and} to enter to possess the land.

column.name: text
column.value: When ye go, ye shall come to a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where {there is} no want of any thing that {is} on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went from there of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went up, and encamped in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: therefore they called that place Mahanehdan to this day: behold, {it is} behind Kirjathjearim.

column.name: text
column.value: And they passed from there to mount Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said to their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And they turned aside there, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, {even} to the house of Micah, and greeted him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, who {were} of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, {and} came in there, {and} took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men {that were} appointed with weapons of war.

column.name: text
column.value: And these went into Micah's house, and brought the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest to them, What do ye?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Hold thy peace, lay thy hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: {is it} better for thee to be a priest to the house of one man, or that thou shouldest be a priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the possessions before them.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that {were} in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried to the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said to Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye have gone away: and what have I more? and what {is} this {that} ye say to me, What aileth thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Dan said to him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows rush upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Dan departed: and when Micah saw that they {were} too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took {the things} which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came to Laish, to a people {that were} at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there was} no deliverer, because it {was} far from Zidon, and they had no business with {any} man; and it was in the valley that {lieth} by Bethrehob. And they built a city, and dwelt in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel: but the name of the city {was} Laish at the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set up for themselves Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter to Benjamin for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept bitterly;

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next morning, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel said, Who {is there} among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation to the LORD? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel repented for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

column.name: text
column.value: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters for wives?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, What one {is there} of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabeshgilead to the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: For the people were numbered, and, behold, {there were} none of the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the congregation sent there twelve thousand men of the most valiant, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which {is} in the land of Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole congregation sent {some} to speak to the children of Benjamin that {were} in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabeshgilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people repented for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, {There must be} an inheritance for them that have escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed {be} he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said, Behold, {there is} a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly {in a place} which {is} on the north side of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

column.name: text
column.value: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come to us to complain, that we will say to them, Be favourable to them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give to them at this time, {that} ye should be guilty.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took {them} wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned to their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went from there every man to his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days {there was} no king in Israel: every man did {that which was} right in his own eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to the LORD in Mizpeh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief of all the people, {even} of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell {us}, how was this wickedness?

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that {belongeth} to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house upon me by night, {and} thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, ye {are} all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any {of us} go to his tent, neither will we any {of us} turn into his house.

column.name: text
column.value: But now this {shall be} the thing which we will do to Gibeah; {we will go up} by lot against it;

column.name: text
column.value: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch provisions for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

column.name: text
column.value: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness {is} this that is done among you?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore deliver {us} the men, the perverted men, who {are} in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and remove the evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, besides the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

column.name: text
column.value: Among all this people {there were} seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair {breadth}, and not miss.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these {were} men of war.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah {shall go up} first.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel rose in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin came forth from Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

column.name: text
column.value: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came to the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD, and fasted that day until evening, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD, (for the ark of the covenant of God {was} there in those days,

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel set men in ambush around Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, {and} were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, {and} kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Benjamin said, They {are} smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city to the highways.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of Israel rose out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baaltamar: and those of Israel who were in ambush came forth out of their places, {even} out of the meadows of Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was fierce: but they knew not that evil {was} near them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted to the ones lying in ambush which they had set beside Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And those in ambush hastened, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the ones lying in ambush drew {themselves} along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the men in ambush, that they should make a great flame with smoke to ascend up from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite {and} kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as {in} the first battle.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the flame began to ascend up from the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil had come upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they turned {their backs} before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and those who {came} out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

column.name: text
column.value: {Thus} they inclosed the Benjamites on all sides, {and} chased them, {and} trod them down with ease opposite Gibeah toward the sunrising.

column.name: text
column.value: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these {were} men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them to Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

column.name: text
column.value: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these {were} men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness to the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of {every} city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Bethlehemjudah went to dwell in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the man {was} Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehemjudah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elimelech Naomi's husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took for themselves wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one {was} Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelt there about ten years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left without her two sons and her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them food.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore she went forth from the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return to the land of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi said to her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother's house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each {of you} in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to her, Surely we will return with thee to thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? {are} there yet {any more} sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

column.name: text
column.value: Turn again, my daughters, go {your way}; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, {if} I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

column.name: text
column.value: Would ye wait for them till they should be grown? would ye restrain yourselves from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD hast gone out against me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clung to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law hath gone back to her people, and to her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, {or} to turn away from following thee: for where thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people {shall be} my people, and thy God my God:

column.name: text
column.value: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, {if any thing} but death shall part thee and me.

column.name: text
column.value: When she saw that she was steadfastly resolved to go with her, then she finished speaking to her.

column.name: text
column.value: So they two went until they came to Bethlehem. And it came to pass, when they had come to Bethlehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, {Is} this Naomi?

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

column.name: text
column.value: I went out full, and the LORD hath brought me home again empty: why {then} call ye me Naomi, seeing the LORD hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

column.name: text
column.value: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, who returned from the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name {was} Boaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of grain after {him} in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said to her, Go, my daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and she happened to come to a part of the field {belonging} to Boaz, who {was} of the kindred of Elimelech.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, The LORD {be} with you. And they answered him, The LORD bless thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Boaz to his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel {is} this?

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It {is} the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi from the country of Moab:

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Boaz to Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from here, but abide here close by my maidens:

column.name: text
column.value: {Let} thy eyes {be} on the field that they are reaping, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink of {that} which the young men have drawn.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said to him, Why have I found grace in thy eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I {am} a stranger?

column.name: text
column.value: And Boaz answered and said to her, It hath fully been shown to me, all that thou hast done to thy mother in law since the death of thy husband: and {how} thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and hast come to a people which thou knewest not before.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou hast come to trust.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken kindly to thy handmaid, though I am not like one of thy handmaidens.

column.name: text
column.value: And Boaz said to her, At mealtime come thou here, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached for her roasted {grain}, and she ate, and was satisfied, and left.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had risen to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

column.name: text
column.value: And let fall also {some} of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave {them}, that she may glean {them}, and rebuke her not.

column.name: text
column.value: So she gleaned in the field until evening, and beat out that which she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

column.name: text
column.value: And she took {it} up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought out, and gave to her what she had reserved after she was satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: And her mother in law said to her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where hast thou laboured? blessed be he that took knowledge of thee. And she showed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day {is} Boaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi said to her daughter in law, Blessed {be} he of the LORD, who hath not withheld his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said to her, The man {is} near of kin to us, one of our next kinsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said to me also, Thou shalt keep close by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi said to Ruth her daughter in law, {It is} good, my daughter, that thou shouldest go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.

column.name: text
column.value: So she kept close by the maidens of Boaz to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Naomi her mother in law said to her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And now {is} not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

column.name: text
column.value: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and go down to the floor: {but} make not thyself known to the man, until he shall have finished eating and drinking.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her, All that thou sayest to me I will do.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went down to the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid herself down.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Who {art} thou? And she answered, I {am} Ruth thy handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thy handmaid; for thou {art} a near kinsman.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Blessed {be} thou of the LORD, my daughter: {for} thou hast shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou didst not follow young men, whether poor or rich.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou {art} a virtuous woman.

column.name: text
column.value: And now it is true that I {am thy} near kinsman: yet there is a kinsman nearer than I.

column.name: text
column.value: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, {that} if he will perform to thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, {as} the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came to the floor.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he said, Bring the veil that {thou hast} upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six {measures} of barley, and laid {it} on her: and she went into the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who {art} thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, These six {measures} of barley he gave me; for he said to me, Go not empty to thy mother in law.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou knowest how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he hath finished the thing this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Boaz went up to the gate, and sat down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by; to whom he said, Ho, such an one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the kinsman, Naomi, that hast come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which {was} our brother Elimelech's:

column.name: text
column.value: And I thought to tell thee, saying, Buy {it} before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem {it}, redeem {it}: but if thou wilt not redeem {it, then} tell me, that I may know: for {there is} none to redeem {it} besides thee; and I {am} after thee. And he said, I will redeem {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy {it} also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem {it} for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this {was the manner} in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for confirming all things; a man took off his shoe, and gave {it} to his neighbour: and this {was} a testimony in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the kinsman said to Boaz, Buy {it} for thyself. So he drew off his shoe.

column.name: text
column.value: And Boaz said to the elders, and {to} all the people, Ye {are} witnesses this day, that I have bought all that {was} Elimelech's, and all that {was} Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye {are} witnesses this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people that {were} in the gate, and the elders, said, {We are} witnesses. The LORD make the woman that hath come into thy house like Rachel and like Leah, which two built the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:

column.name: text
column.value: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.

column.name: text
column.value: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in to her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bore a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the women said to Naomi, Blessed {be} the LORD, who hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall be to thee a restorer of {thy} life, and a nourisher of thy old age: for thy daughter in law, who loveth thee, who is better to thee than seven sons, hath borne him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naomi took the child, and laid him in her bosom, and became his nurse.

column.name: text
column.value: And the women her neighbours gave him a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he {is} the father of Jesse, the father of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

column.name: text
column.value: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

column.name: text
column.value: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

column.name: text
column.value: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaimzophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name {was} Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

column.name: text
column.value: And he had two wives; the name of the one {was} Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

column.name: text
column.value: And this man went up from his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD, {were} there.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

column.name: text
column.value: But to Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had closed up her womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And her adversary also provoked her greatly, to make her fret, because the LORD had closed up her womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as} he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? {am} not I better to thee than ten sons?

column.name: text
column.value: So Hannah rose after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And she {was} in bitterness of soul, and prayed to the LORD, and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thy handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thy handmaid, but wilt give to thy handmaid a son, then I will give him to the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli observed her mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hannah, spoke in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eli said to her, How long wilt thou be drunk? put away thy wine from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I {am} a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Count not thy handmaid for a wicked woman: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I been speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant {thee} thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Let thy handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and ate, and her countenance was no more {sad}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it came to pass, when the time had arrived after Hannah had conceived, that she bore a son, and called his name Samuel, {saying}, Because I have asked him of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

column.name: text
column.value: But Hannah went not up; for she said to her husband, {I will not go up} until the child is weaned, and {then} I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD, and there abide for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elkanah her husband said to her, Do what seemeth to thee good; tarry until thou hast weaned him; only the LORD establish his word. So the woman abode, and nursed her son until she weaned him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child {was} young.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew a bull, and brought the child to Eli.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, O my lord, {as} thy soul liveth, my lord, I {am} the woman that stood by thee here, praying to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was rare in those days; {there was} no frequent vision.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli {was} lying down in his place, and his eyes began to grow dim, {that} he could not see;

column.name: text
column.value: And before the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God {was}, and Samuel was lying down {to sleep};

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he ran to Eli, and said, Here {am} I; for thou didst call me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here {am} I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here {am} I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he should call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day I will perform against Eli all {things} which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the LORD. And Samuel feared to tell Eli the vision.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What {is} the thing that {the LORD} hath said to thee? I pray thee hide {it} not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou shalt hide {any} thing from me of all the things that he said to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel told him every thing, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It {is} the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and let none of his words fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel {was} established {to be} a prophet of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, my horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over my enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} none holy as the LORD: for {there is} none besides thee: neither {is there} any rock like our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let {no} arrogance come out of your mouth: for the LORD {is} a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

column.name: text
column.value: The bows of the mighty men {are} broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

column.name: text
column.value: {They that were} full have hired out themselves for bread; and {they that were} hungry ceased: so that the barren hath borne seven; and she that hath many children is become feeble.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.

column.name: text
column.value: He raiseth the poor out of the dust, {and} lifteth the beggar from the dunghill, to set {them} among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth {are} the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

column.name: text
column.value: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child ministered to the LORD before Eli the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Eli {were} worthless men; they knew not the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests' custom with the people {was, that}, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was boiling, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

column.name: text
column.value: And he struck {it} into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites that came there.

column.name: text
column.value: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have boiled flesh of thee, but raw.

column.name: text
column.value: And {if} any man said to him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and {then} take {as much} as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, {Nay}; but thou shalt give {it to me} now: and if not, I will take {it} by force.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But Samuel ministered before the LORD, {being} a child, girded with a linen ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought {it} to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went to their own home.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bore three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did to all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled {at} the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Nay, my sons; for {it is} no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD'S people to transgress.

column.name: text
column.value: If one man shall sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man shall sin against the LORD, who shall plead for him? However they hearkened not to the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child Samuel continued to grow, and was in favour both with the LORD, and also with men.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a man of God to Eli, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Did I plainly appear to the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

column.name: text
column.value: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel {to be} my priest, to offer upon my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give to the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Why trample ye at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded {in my} habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed {that} thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thy arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt see an enemy {in my} habitation, in all {the wealth} which {God} shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thy house for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man of thine, {whom} I shall not cut off from my altar, {shall be} to consume thy eyes, and to grieve thy heart: and all the increase of thy house shall die in the flower of their age.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} a sign to thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, {that} shall do according to {that} which {is} in my heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before my anointed for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} every one that is left in thy house shall come {and} bow down to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests' offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer: and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Why hath the LORD smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of Shiloh to us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us from the hand of our enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts, who dwelleth {between} the cherubim: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, {were} there with the ark of the covenant of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth shook.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What {meaneth} the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the LORD had come into the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God hath come into the camp. And they said, Woe to us! for there hath not been such a thing before.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these {are} the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong, and acquit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye may not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you: acquit yourselves like men, and fight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ark of God was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes torn, and with earth upon his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the way side watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told {it}, all the city cried out.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, What {meaneth} the noise of this tumult? And the man came in hastily, and told Eli.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man said to Eli, I {am} he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?

column.name: text
column.value: And the messenger answered and said, Israel hath fled before the Philistines, and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people, and thy two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God is taken.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he made mention of the ark of God, that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate, and his neck broke, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. And he had judged Israel forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And his daughter in law, the wife of Phinehas, was with child, {near} to be delivered: and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken, and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed; for her pains came upon her.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said to her, Fear not; for thou hast borne a son. But she answered not, neither did she regard {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And she named the child Ichabod, saying, The glory hath departed from Israel: because the ark of God was taken, and because of her father in law and her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, The glory hath departed from Israel: for the ark of God is taken.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ark of the LORD was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, What shall we do to the ark of the LORD? tell us how we shall send it to its place.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel, send it not empty; but by all means return him a trespass offering: then ye shall be healed, and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they, What {shall be} the trespass offering which we shall return to him? They answered, Five golden haemorrhoids, and five golden mice, {according to} the number of the lords of the Philistines: for one plague {was} on you all, and on your lords.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ye shall make images of your haemorrhoids, and images of your mice that mar the land; and ye shall give glory to the God of Israel: perhaps he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

column.name: text
column.value: Why then do ye harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? when he had wrought wonderfully among them, did they not let the people go, and they departed?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore make a new cart, and take two milk cows, on which there hath come no yoke, and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them:

column.name: text
column.value: And take the ark of the LORD, and lay it upon the cart; and put the jewels of gold, which ye return to him {for} a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

column.name: text
column.value: And see, if it goeth up by the way of its own land to Bethshemesh, {then} he hath done us this great evil: but if not, then we shall know that {it is} not his hand {that} smote us: it {was} a chance {that} happened to us.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men did so; and took two milk cows, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid the ark of the LORD upon the cart, and the box with the mice of gold and the images of their haemorrhoids.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cows took the straight way to the way of Bethshemesh, {and} went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside {to} the right hand or {to} the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Bethshemesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And {they of} Bethshemesh {were} reaping their wheat harvest in the valley: and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cart came into the field of Joshua, a Bethshemite, and stood there, where {there was} a great stone: and they cut up the wood of the cart, and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD, and the box that {was} with it, in which {were} the jewels of gold, and put {them} on the great stone: and the men of Bethshemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen {it}, they returned to Ekron the same day.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the golden haemorrhoids which the Philistines returned {for} a trespass offering to the LORD; for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Askelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

column.name: text
column.value: And the golden mice, {according to} the number of all the cities of the Philistines {belonging} to the five lords, {both} of fortified cities, and of country villages, even to the great {stone of} Abel, on which they set down the ark of the LORD: {which stone remaineth} to this day in the field of Joshua, the Bethshemite.

column.name: text
column.value: And he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and seventy men: and the people lamented, because the LORD had smitten {many} of the people with a great slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Bethshemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? and to whom shall he go up from us?

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjathjearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD; come ye down, {and} bring it up to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: {they were} judges in Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after money, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel to Ramah,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken to the voice of the people in all that they say to thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.

column.name: text
column.value: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore hearken to their voice: yet protest solemnly to them, and show them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people that asked of him a king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint {them} for himself, for his chariots, and {to be} his horsemen; and {some} shall run before his chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and {will set them} to till his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will take your daughters {to be} perfumers, and {to be} cooks, and {to be} bakers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, {even} the best {of them}, and give {them} to his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And he will take your male servants, and your female servants, and your most choice young men, and your donkeys, and put {them} to his work.

column.name: text
column.value: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen for yourselves; and the LORD will not hear you in that day.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;

column.name: text
column.value: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he reported them in the ears of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken to their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said to the men of Israel, Go ye every man to his city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines took the ark of God, and brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon {had} fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they arose early on the next morning, behold, Dagon {had} fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the LORD; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands {were} cut off upon the threshold; only {the stump of} Dagon was left to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hand of the LORD was heavy upon them of Ashdod, and he destroyed them, and smote them with haemorrhoids, {even} Ashdod and its land.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of Ashdod saw that {it was} so, they said, The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us: for his hand is heavy upon us, and upon Dagon our god.

column.name: text
column.value: They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines to them, and said, What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel? And they answered, Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about to Gath. And they carried the ark of the God of Israel {there}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, that, after they had carried it there, the hand of the LORD was against the city with a very great destruction: and he smote the men of the city, both small and great, and they had haemorrhoids in their secret parts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And it came to pass, as the ark of God came to Ekron, that the Ekronites cried out, saying, They have brought about the ark of the God of Israel to us, to slay us and our people.

column.name: text
column.value: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go again to its own place, that it slay us not, and our people: for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city; the hand of God was very heavy there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men that died not were smitten with the haemorrhoids: and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Kirjathjearim came, and brought up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab on the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjathjearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return to the LORD with all your hearts, {then} put away the foreign gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts to the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the children of Israel put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gathered together at Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured {it} out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and there said, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpeh.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard {it}, they were afraid of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry to the LORD our God for us, that he will save us from the hand of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered {it for} a burnt offering wholly to the LORD: and Samuel cried to the LORD for Israel; and the LORD heard him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Samuel was offering the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and smote them; and they were smitten before Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until {they came} under Bethcar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel took a stone, and set {it} between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Thus far hath the LORD helped us.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the land of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and its land did Israel deliver from the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.

column.name: text
column.value: And his return {was} to Ramah; for there {was} his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this {condition} will I make {a covenant} with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it {for} a reproach upon all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of Jabesh said to him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers to all the land of Israel: and then, if {there is} no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What {aileth} the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent {them} throughout all the land of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say to the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by {the time} the sun is hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and told {it} to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out to you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so} on the next morning, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they who remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Samuel, Who {is} he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured {it} upon his head, and kissed him, and said, {Is it} not because the LORD hath anointed thee {to be} captain over his inheritance?

column.name: text
column.value: When thou hast departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say to thee, The donkeys which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath stopped caring for the donkeys, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou go on forward from there, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:

column.name: text
column.value: And they will greet thee, and give thee two {loaves} of bread; which thou shalt receive from their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where {is} the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou hast come there to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.

column.name: text
column.value: And let it be, when these signs have come to thee, {that} thou do as occasion shall serve thee; for God {is} with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down to thee, to offer burnt offerings, {and} to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and show thee what thou shalt do.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came there to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when all that knew him in times past saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What {is} this {that} hath come to the son of Kish? {Is} Saul also among the prophets?

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the same place answered and said, But who {is} their father? Therefore it became a proverb, {Is} Saul also among the prophets?

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul's uncle said to him and to his servant, Where went ye? And he said, To seek the donkeys: and when we saw that {they were} no where, we came to Samuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to his uncle, He told us plainly that the donkeys were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he told him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel called the people together to the LORD to Mizpeh;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, {and} of them that oppressed you:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said to him, {Nay}, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come there. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the baggage.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ran and brought him from there: and when he stood among the people, he was taller than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that {there is} none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote {it} in a book, and laid {it} up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.

column.name: text
column.value: But the worthless men said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name {was} Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had a son, whose name {was} Saul, a choice young man, and handsome: and {there was} not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he: from his shoulders and upward {he was} taller than any of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the donkeys of Kish Saul's father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found {them} not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and {there they were} not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found {them} not.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that {was} with him, Come, and let us return; lest my father stop {caring} for the donkeys, and be troubled for us.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Behold now, {there is} in this city a man of God, and {he is} an honourable man; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go there; perhaps he can show us our way that we should go.

column.name: text
