column.value: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, {if} we go, what shall we bring to the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and {there is} not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: {that} will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.

column.name: text
column.value: (In times past in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spoke, Come, and let us go to the seer: for {he that is} now {called} a Prophet was in times past called a Seer.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went to the city where the man of God {was}.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, Is the seer here?

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, {he is} before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for {there is} a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as ye shall enter the city, ye shall immediately find him, before he goeth up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he cometh, because he doth bless the sacrifice; {and} afterwards they eat that are invited. Now therefore go up; for about this time ye shall find him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went up into the city: {and} when they had come into the city, behold, Samuel came out meeting them, to go up to the high place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him {to be} captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people from the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry hast come to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said to him, Behold the man of whom I spoke to thee! this same shall reign over my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house {is}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I {am} the seer: go up before me to the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that {is} in thy heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for thy donkeys that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom {is} all the desire of Israel? {Is it} not on thee, and on all thy father's house?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul answered and said, {Am} not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? why then speakest thou so to me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chief place among them that were invited, who {were} about thirty persons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said to thee, Set it by thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cook took up the shoulder, and {that} which {was} upon it, and set {it} before Saul. And {Samuel} said, Behold that which is left! set {it} before thee, {and} eat: for to this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come down from the high place into the city, {Samuel} talked with Saul upon the top of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early: and it came to pass about the dawn of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Arise, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may show thee the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened to your voice in all that ye said to me, and have made a king over you.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons {are} with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, here I {am}: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose donkey have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or from whose hand have I received {any} bribe to blind my eyes with it? and I will restore it you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken any thing from any man's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, The LORD {is} witness against you, and his anointed {is} witness this day, that ye have not found any thing in my hand. And they answered, {He is} witness.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to the people, {It is} the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought forth your fathers from Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they forgot the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried to the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us from the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you from the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelt safe.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said to me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God {was} your king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, {and} whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as {it was} against your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is it} not wheat harvest to day? I will call to the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness {is} great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.

column.name: text
column.value: So Samuel called to the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people said to Samuel, Pray for thy servants to the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added to all our sins {this} evil, to ask us a king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;

column.name: text
column.value: And turn ye not aside: for {then should ye go} after vain {things}, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they {are} vain.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover as for me, Far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

column.name: text
column.value: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider what great {things} he hath done for you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.

column.name: text
column.value: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: Saul chose for himself three thousand {men} of Israel; {of which} two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that {was} in Geba, and the Philistines heard {of it}. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel heard it said {that} Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and {that} Israel also was held in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which {is} on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.

column.name: text
column.value: When the men of Israel saw that they were hedged in, (for the people were distressed,) then the people hid themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some of} the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he {was} yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel {had appointed}: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Bring here a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might bless him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and {that} thou camest not within the days appointed, and {that} the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said I, The Philistines will now come down upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication to the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him {to be} captain over his people, because thou hast not kept {that} which the LORD commanded thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel arose, and went up from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people {that were} present with him, about six hundred men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people {that were} present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

column.name: text
column.value: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way {that leadeth to} Ophrah, to the land of Shual:

column.name: text
column.value: And another company turned the way {to} Bethhoron: and another company turned {to} the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make {them} swords or spears:

column.name: text
column.value: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a charge of a third of a shekel for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

column.name: text
column.value: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that {were} with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.

column.name: text
column.value: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

column.name: text
column.value: Samuel also said to Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee {to be} king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou to the voice of the words of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember {that} which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid {wait} for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go, depart, withdraw yourselves from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye showed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up from Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah {until} thou comest to Shur, that {is} east of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all {that was} good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing {that was} vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD to Samuel, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I repent that I have set up Saul {to be} king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried to the LORD all night.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and hast gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said to him, Blessed {be} thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, What {meaneth} then this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice to the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel said to Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, When thou {wast} little in thy own sight, {wast} thou not {made} the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: Why then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice to the LORD thy God in Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD {as great} delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey {is} better than sacrifice, {and} to hearken than the fat of rams.

column.name: text
column.value: For rebellion {is as} the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness {is as} iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from {being} king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Samuel turned about to depart, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it tore.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to him, The LORD hath torn the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, {that is} better than thou.

column.name: text
column.value: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he {is} not a man, that he should repent.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, I have sinned: {yet} honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Samuel, Bring ye here to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came to him cheerfully. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man that bore his armour, Come, and let us go over to the garrison of the Philistines that {is} on the other side. But he told not his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul tarried at the edge of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which {is} in Migron: and the people that {were} with him {were} about six hundred men;

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD'S priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

column.name: text
column.value: And on each side of the pass, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the garrison of the Philistines, {there was} a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one {was} Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

column.name: text
column.value: The front of the one rose northward opposite Michmash, and the other southward opposite Gibeah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan said to the young man that bore his armour, Come, and let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for {there is} no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

column.name: text
column.value: And his armourbearer said to him, Do all that {is} in thy heart: turn thee; behold, I {am} with thee according to thy heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over to {these} men, and we will show ourselves to them.

column.name: text
column.value: If they say thus to us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they say thus, Come up to us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this {shall be} a sign to us.

column.name: text
column.value: And both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will show you something. And Jonathan said to his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, {which} a yoke {of oxen might plow}.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down {one another}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Saul to the people that {were} with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer {were} not {there}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to Ahiah, Bring here the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, while Saul talked to the priest, that the noise that {was} in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said to the priest, Withdraw thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul and all the people that {were} with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his companion, {and there was} a very great confusion.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the Hebrews {that} were with the Philistines before that time, who went up with them into the camp {from the} surrounding {country}, even they also {turned} to be with the Israelites that {were} with Saul and Jonathan.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, {when} they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over to Bethaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had solemnly charged the people, saying, Cursed {be} the man that eateth {any} food until evening, that I may be avenged on my enemies. So none of the people tasted {any} food.

column.name: text
column.value: And all {they of} the land came to a forest; and there was honey upon the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people had come into the forest, behold, the honey flowed; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: therefore he put forth the end of the rod that {was} in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed {be} the man that eateth {any} food this day. And the people were faint.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how my eyes have become bright, because I tasted a little of this honey.

column.name: text
column.value: How much better, if only the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

column.name: text
column.value: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew {them} on the ground: and the people ate {them} with the blood.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone to me this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say to them, Bring me here every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay {them} here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew {them} there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul built an altar to the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatever seemeth good to thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near to God here.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Come ye here, all the chief of the people: and know and see what this sin hath been this day.

column.name: text
column.value: For, {as} the LORD liveth, who saveth Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But {there was} not a man among all the people {that} answered him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do what seemeth good to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Saul said to the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect {lot}. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Cast {lots} between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that {was} in my hand, {and}, lo, I must die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? By no means: {as} the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

column.name: text
column.value: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and wherever he turned himself, he smote {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel from the hands of them that spoiled them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters {were these}; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of Saul's wife {was} Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host {was} Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Kish {was} the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner {was} the son of Abiel.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a fierce war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him to himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thy horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul shall hear {it}, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint to me {him} whom I name to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel did that which the LORD spoke, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Peaceably: I have come to sacrifice to the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they had come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD'S anointed {is} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for {the LORD seeth} not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.

column.name: text
column.value: And Samuel said to Jesse, Are here all {thy} children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and bring him: for we will not sit down till he hath come here.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he {was} ruddy, {and} also of a beautiful countenance, and a good appearance. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this {is} he.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day onward. So Samuel arose, and went to Ramah.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul's servants said to him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Let our lord now command thy servants, {who are} before thee, to seek a man, {who is} a skilful player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring {him} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, {that is} skilful in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a handsome person, and the LORD {is} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, Send to me David thy son, who {is} with the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesse took a donkey {laden} with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent {them} by David his son to Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the {evil} spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which {belongeth} to Judah, and encamped between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped by the valley of Elah, and they set the battle in array against the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and {there was} a valley between them.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out a champion from the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height {was} six cubits and a span.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he had} an helmet of brass upon his head, and he {was} armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat {was} five thousand shekels of brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he had} greaves of brass upon his legs, and a gorget of brass between his shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: And the staff of his spear {was} like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head {weighed} six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, Why have ye come out to set {your} battle in array? {am} not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose for yourselves a man for you, and let him come down to me.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I shall prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

column.name: text
column.value: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Now David {was} the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name {was} Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men {for} an old man in the days of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went {and} followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle {were} Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

column.name: text
column.value: And David {was} the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesse said to David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this roasted {grain}, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;

column.name: text
column.value: And carry these ten cheeses to the captain of {their} thousand, and see how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, {were} in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And David rose early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

column.name: text
column.value: And David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran into the army, and came and greeted his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, from the armies of the Philistines, and spoke according to the same words: and David heard {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were exceedingly afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that hath come up? surely to defy Israel hath he come: and it shall be, {that} the man who shall kill him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David spoke to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who {is} this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

column.name: text
column.value: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down here? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thy heart; for thou art come down that thou mayest see the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said, What have I now done? {Is there} not a cause?

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned from him toward another, and spoke after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the words were heard which David spoke, they reported {them} before Saul: and he sent for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou {art but} a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

column.name: text
column.value: And I went after him, and smote him, and delivered {it} out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught {him} by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

column.name: text
column.value: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he tried to go; for he had not proved {it}. And David said to Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved {them}. And David put them off from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a bag; and his sling {was} in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistine advanced and drew near to David; and the man that bore the shield {went} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistine said to David, {Am} I a dog, that thou comest to me with staffs? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh to the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

column.name: text
column.value: This day will the LORD deliver thee into my hand; and I will smite thee, and take thy head from thee; and I will give the dead bodies of the host of the Philistines this day to the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle {is} the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew near to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

column.name: text
column.value: And David put his hand in his bag, and took from there a stone, and slung it with his sling, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but {there was} no sword in the hand of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of its sheath, and slew him, and cut off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, to the entrance of the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath, and to Ekron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel returned from chasing the Philistines, and they plundered their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son {is} this youth? And Abner said, {As} thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling {is}.

column.name: text
column.value: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to him, Whose son {art} thou, {thou} young man? And David answered, I {am} the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had finished speaking to Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that {was} upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his belt.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went out wherever Saul sent him, {and} behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass as they came, when David had returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of music.

column.name: text
column.value: And the women spoke to {one another} as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul was very angry, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed to David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed thousands: and {what} can he have more but the kingdom?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul kept a jealous eye on David from that day and onward.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and {there was} a javelin in Saul's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall. And David escaped from his presence twice.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with him, and had departed from Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD {was} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

column.name: text
column.value: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee for a wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the LORD'S battles. For Saul said, Let not my hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Saul, Who {am} I? and what {is} my life, {or} my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given to Adriel the Meholathite for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in {the one of} the two.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul commanded his servants, {saying}, Speak with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul's servants spoke those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you {a} light {thing} to be a king's son in law, seeing that I {am} a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spoke David.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days had not expired.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul saw and knew that the LORD {was} with David, and {that} Michal Saul's daughter loved him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, {that} David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much esteemed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret {place}, and hide thyself:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou {art}, and I will talk with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works {have been} toward thee very good:

column.name: text
column.value: For he put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the LORD wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest {it}, and didst rejoice: why then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul hearkened to the voice of Jonathan: and Saul swore, {As} the LORD liveth, he shall not be slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the evil spirit from the LORD was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with {his} hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away from Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

column.name: text
column.value: Saul also sent messengers to David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou dost not save thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

column.name: text
column.value: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: And Michal took an image, and laid {it} in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' {hair} for his head, and covered {it} with a cloth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He {is} sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul sent the messengers {again} to see David, saying, Bring him to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the messengers had come in, behold, {there was} an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' {hair} for his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away my enemy, that he hast escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said to me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

column.name: text
column.value: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Saul, saying, Behold, David {is} at Naioth in Ramah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing {as} appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went also to Ramah, and came to a great well that {is} in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where {are} Samuel and David? And {one} said, Behold, {they are} at Naioth in Ramah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went there to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, {Is} Saul also among the prophets?

column.name: text
column.value: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what {is} my iniquity? and what {is} my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Far be it from thee; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will show it to me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it {is} not {so}.

column.name: text
column.value: And David swore moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thy eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he should be grieved: but truly {as} the LORD liveth, and {as} thy soul liveth, {there is} but a step between me and death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jonathan to David, Whatever thy soul desireth, I will even do {it} for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Jonathan, Behold, to morrow {is} the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at the table: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third {day} at evening.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy father shall at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked {leave} of me that he might run to Bethlehem his city: for {there is} a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall say thus, {It is} well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he shall be very angry, {then} be sure that evil is determined by him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: however, if there is in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil is determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what {if} thy father shall answer thee roughly?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan said to David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan said to David, O LORD God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, {or} the third {day}, and, behold, {if there be} good toward David, and I then send not to thee, and show it thee;

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it shall please my father {to do} thee evil, then I will show it to thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the LORD be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt not only while yet I live show me the kindness of the LORD, that I may not die:

column.name: text
column.value: But {also} thou shalt not withdraw thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the LORD hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jonathan made {a covenant} with the house of David, {saying}, Let the LORD even require {it} at the hand of David's enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow {is} the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} thou hast stayed three days, {then} thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was {in hand}, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will shoot three arrows on the side {of it}, as though I shot at a mark.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I will send a lad, {saying}, Go, find the arrows. If I expressly say to the lad, Behold, the arrows {are} on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for {there is} peace to thee, and no hurt; {as} the LORD liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I say thus to the young man, Behold, the arrows {are} beyond thee; go thy way: for the LORD hath sent thee away.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as to} the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the LORD {be} between thee and me for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon had come, the king sat down to eat food.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, {even} upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless Saul spoke not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he {is} not clean; surely he {is} not clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, {which was} the second {day} of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said to Jonathan his son, Why cometh not the son of Jesse to eat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked {leave} of me {to go} to Bethlehem:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me {to be there}: and now, if I have found favour in thy eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not to the king's table.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said to him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious {woman}, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thy own shame, and to the shame of thy mother's nakedness?

column.name: text
column.value: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the earth, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, Why shall he be slain? what hath he done?

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: by which Jonathan knew that it was determined by his father to slay David.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his lad, Run, find now the arrows which I shoot. {And} as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the lad had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, {Is} not the arrow beyond thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

column.name: text
column.value: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan gave his weapons to his lad, and said to him, Go, carry {them} to the city.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of {a place} toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, but David more so.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the LORD, saying, The LORD be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore departed from there, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard {it}, they went down there to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And every one {that was} in distress, and every one that {was} in debt, and every one {that was} discontented, resorted to him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said to the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, {and be} with you, till I know what God will do for me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the strong hold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prophet Gad said to David, Abide not in the strong hold; depart, and come into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

column.name: text
column.value: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that {were} with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants {were} standing about him;)

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul said to his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give each one of you fields and vineyards, {and} make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

column.name: text
column.value: That all of you have conspired against me, and {there is} none that showeth to me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and {there is} none of you that is sorry for me, or showeth to me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, who was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

column.name: text
column.value: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that {were} in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I {am}, my lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said to him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who {is so} faithful among all thy servants as David, who is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thy house?

column.name: text
column.value: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute {any} thing to his servant, {nor} to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the LORD; because their hand also {is} with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not show it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day eighty and five persons that wore a linen ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nob, the city of the priests, he smote with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abiathar showed David that Saul had slain the LORD'S priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Abiathar, I knew that day, when Doeg the Edomite {was} there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned {the death} of all the persons of thy father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou {shalt be} in safeguard.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the LORD said to David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

column.name: text
column.value: And David's men said to him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

column.name: text
column.value: Then David enquired of the LORD yet again. And the LORD answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, {that} he came down {with} an ephod in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

column.name: text
column.value: And David knew that Saul secretly devised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring here the ephod.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the LORD said, They will deliver {thee} up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David and his men, {who were} about six hundred, arose and departed from Keilah, and went wherever they could go. And it was told Saul that David had escaped from Keilah; and he did not go there.

column.name: text
column.value: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life: and David {was} in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next to thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which {is} on the south of Jeshimon?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part {shall be} to deliver him into the king's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul said, Blessed {be} ye of the LORD; for ye have compassion on me.

column.name: text
column.value: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, {and} who hath seen him there: for it is told to me {that} he dealeth very subtilly.

column.name: text
column.value: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he is in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men {were} in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

column.name: text
column.value: Saul also and his men went to seek {him}. And they told David: therefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard {that}, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men on all sides to take them.

column.name: text
column.value: But there came a messenger to Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David went up from there, and dwelt in strong holds at Engedi.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said to him, Why {art} thou alone, and no man with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said to me, Let no man know any thing of the business about which I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed {my} servants to such and such a place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore what is under thy hand? give {me} five {loaves of} bread in my hand, or what there is present.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest answered David, and said, {There is} no common bread under my hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

column.name: text
column.value: And David answered the priest, and said to him, Of a truth women {have been} kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and {the bread is} in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priest gave him hallowed {bread}: for there was no bread there but the showbread, that was taken from before the LORD, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul {was} there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name {was} Doeg, an Edomite, the chief of the herdmen that {belonged} to Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Ahimelech, And is there not here under thy hand a spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it {is here} wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take {it}: for {there is} no other except that here. And David said, {There is} none like that; give it to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants of Achish said to him, {Is} not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

column.name: text
column.value: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was greatly afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And he changed his behaviour before them, and pretended to be mad in their hands, and made marks on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Achish to his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: why {then} have ye brought him to me?

column.name: text
column.value: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this {fellow} to play the mad man in my presence? shall this {fellow} come into my house?

column.name: text
column.value: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: {there is} nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any part of Israel: so shall I escape from his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that {were} with him to Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, {even} David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Saul that David had fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Achish, If I have now found grace in thy eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag pertaineth to the kings of Judah to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

column.name: text
column.value: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those {nations were} of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the donkeys, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

column.name: text
column.value: And Achish said, Where have ye plundered to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

column.name: text
column.value: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring {tidings} to Gath, saying, Lest they should inform against us, saying, So did David, and so {will be} his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, {which is} before Jeshimon?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which {is} before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had come in very deed.

column.name: text
column.value: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had encamped: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people encamped around him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

column.name: text
