column.value: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put {them} in array against the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, If the Syrians shall be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon shall be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab and the people that {were} with him, drew near, to the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that {were} beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer {went} before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew {the men of} seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the kings {that were} servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent Nathan to David. And he came to him, and said to him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

column.name: text
column.value: The rich {man} had very many flocks and herds:

column.name: text
column.value: But the poor {man} had nothing, except one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it fed of his own food, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was to him as a daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a traveller to the rich man, and he was not willing to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to prepare for the wayfaring man that had come to him; but took the poor man's lamb, and prepared it for the man that had come to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, {As} the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this {thing} shall surely die:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nathan said to David, Thou {art} the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee from the hand of Saul;

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if {that had been} too little, I would moreover have given to thee such and such things.

column.name: text
column.value: Why hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife {to be} thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thy house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thy own house, and I will take thy wives before thy eyes, and give {them} to thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou didst {it} secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said to David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

column.name: text
column.value: But, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also {that is} born to thee shall surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nathan departed to his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bore to David, and he was very sick.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of his house arose, {and went} to him, to raise him from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spoke to him, and he would not hearken to our voice: how will he then be grieved, if we tell him that the child is dead?

column.name: text
column.value: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said to his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed {himself}, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set food before him, and he ate.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said his servants to him, What thing {is} this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, {while he was} alive; but after the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell {whether} GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

column.name: text
column.value: But now he is dead, why should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in to her, and lay with her: and she bore a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

column.name: text
column.value: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight of which {was} a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was {set} on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought forth the people that {were} in it, and put {them} under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus he did to all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name {was} Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she {was} a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.

column.name: text
column.value: But Amnon had a friend, whose name {was} Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab {was} a very subtil man.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Why {art} thou, {being} the king's son, pining from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said to him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonadab said to him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and pretend that thou art sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say to him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me food, and prepare the food in my sight, that I may see {it}, and eat {it} at her hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So Amnon lay down, and pretended that he was sick: and when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make for me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and prepare a meal for him.

column.name: text
column.value: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded {it}, and made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

column.name: text
column.value: And she took a pan, and poured {them} out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Send out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amnon said to Tamar, Bring the food into the chamber, that I may eat from thy hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought {them} into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had brought {them} to him to eat, he took hold of her, and said to her, Come lie with me, my sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, where shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak to the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: However he would not hearken to her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred with which he hated her {was} greater than the love with which he had loved her. And Amnon said to her, Arise, be gone.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, {There is} no cause: this evil in sending me away {is} greater than the other that thou didst to me. But he would not hearken to her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called his servant that ministered to him, and said, Put now this {woman} out from me, and bolt the door after her.

column.name: text
column.value: And {she had} a garment of {many} colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters {that were} virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and tore her garment of {many} colours that {was} on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom her brother said to her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he {is} thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.

column.name: text
column.value: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very angry.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom spoke to his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which {is} beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be burdensome to thee. And he pressed him: yet he would not go, but blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said to him, Why should he go with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: But Absalom pressed him, that he should let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say to you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have I not commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man rode upon his mule, and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that the report came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king arose, and tore his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose {that} they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came many people by the way of the hill side behind him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonadab said to the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as he had finished speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And {David} mourned for his son every day.

column.name: text
column.value: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

column.name: text
column.value: And {the soul of} king David longed to go forth to Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart {was} toward Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and brought from there a wise woman, and said to her, I pray thee, pretend to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

column.name: text
column.value: And come to the king, and speak in this manner to him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the woman of Tekoah spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I {am} indeed a widow woman, and my husband is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and {there was} none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the whole family hath risen against thy handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband {neither} name nor remainder upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to the woman, Go to thy house, and I will issue an order concerning thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman of Tekoah said to the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity {be} on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne {be} guiltless.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Whoever saith {any thing} to thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not permit the avenger of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, {As} the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman said, Let thy handmaid, I pray thee, speak {one} word to my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman said, Why then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one who is faulty, in that the king doth not bring home again his banished.

column.name: text
column.value: For we must needs die, and {are} as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect {any} person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not driven out from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore that I have come to speak of this thing to my lord the king, {it is} because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid from the hand of the man {that would} destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then thy handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comforting: for as an angel of God, so {is} my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king answered and said to the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, {Is not} the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, {As} thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from any thing that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he ordered me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thy handmaid:

column.name: text
column.value: To bring about this change of affairs hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord {is} wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all {things} that {are} on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.

column.name: text
column.value: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he cut {the hair of} his head, (for it was at every year's end that he cut {it}: because {the hair} was heavy on him, therefore he cut it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name {was} Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, that he might send him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he said to his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom to {his} house, and said to him, Why have thy servants set my field on fire?

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent to thee, saying, Come here, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Why am I come from Geshur? {it had been} good for me {had I been} there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there is {any} iniquity in me, let him kill me.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And when David was a little past the top {of the hill}, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of donkeys saddled, and upon them two hundred {loaves} of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The donkeys {are} for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as are faint in the wilderness may drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, And where {is} thy master's son? And Ziba said to the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore to me the kingdom of my father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine {are} all that {pertained} to Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee {that} I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

column.name: text
column.value: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, from there came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name {was} Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed continually as he came.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men {were} on his right hand and on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou worthless fellow:

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou {art taken} in thy mischief, because thou {art} a bloody man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah to the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said to him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Why hast thou done so?

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, who came forth from my own body, seeketh my life: how much more now {may this} Benjamite {do it}? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

column.name: text
column.value: It may be that the LORD will look on my affliction, and that the LORD will repay me good for his cursing this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side opposite him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king, and all the people that {were} with him, became weary, and refreshed themselves there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, had come to Absalom, that Hushai said to Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom said to Hushai, {Is} this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

column.name: text
column.value: And Hushai said to Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

column.name: text
column.value: And again, whom should I serve? {should I} not {serve} in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahithophel said to Absalom, Go in to thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred by thy father: then shall the hands of all that {are} with thee be strong.

column.name: text
column.value: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, {was} as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so {was} all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom rose early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was {so}, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, Of what city {art} thou? And he said, Thy servant {is} one of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom said to him, See, thy matters {are} good and right; but {there is} no man {deputed} by the king to hear thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Absalom said moreover, O that I were made judge in the land, that every man who hath any suit or cause might come to me, and I would do him justice!

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, that when any man came near {to him} to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And in this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said to the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed to the LORD, in Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: And with Absalom went two hundred men from Jerusalem, {that were} invited; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, {even} from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to all his servants that {were} with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not {else} escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he should overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king's servants said to the king, Behold, thy servants {are ready to do} whatever my lord the king shall appoint.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, {who were} concubines, to keep the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

column.name: text
column.value: And all his servants passed on by his side; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Why goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou {art} a stranger, and also an exile.

column.name: text
column.value: Though thou camest {but} yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go wherever I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth {be} with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ittai answered the king, and said, {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites {were} with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had passed out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and show me {both} it, and his habitation:

column.name: text
column.value: But if he shall thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, {here am} I, let him do to me as seemeth good to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The king said also to Zadok the priest, {Art not} thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until word shall come from you to inform me.

column.name: text
column.value: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went up by the ascent of {mount} Olivet, and wept as he went, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that {were} with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} told David, saying, Ahithophel {is} among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that {when} David had come to the top {of the mount}, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat torn, and earth upon his head:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom David said, If thou shalt pass on with me, then thou shalt be a burden to me:

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou shalt return to the city, and say to Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; {as} I {have been} thy father's servant to this time, so {will} I now also {be} thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

column.name: text
column.value: And {hast thou} not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, {that} whatever thing thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell {it} to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, {they have} there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's {son}, and Jonathan Abiathar's {son}; and by them ye shall send to me every thing that ye can hear.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will come upon him while he {is} weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that {are} with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring back all the people to thee: the man whom thou seekest {is} as if all returned: {so} all the people shall be in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do {after} his saying? if not; speak thou.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hushai said to Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given {is} not good at this time.

column.name: text
column.value: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they {are} mighty men, and they {are} chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father {is} a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some {other} place: and it will come to pass, when some of them are overthrown at the first, that whoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And he also {that is} valiant, whose heart {is} as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father {is} a mighty man, and {they} who {are} with him {are} valiant men.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I counsel that all Israel should be generally gathered to thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that {is} by the sea for multitude; and that thou shouldest go to battle in thy own person.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that {are} with him there shall not be left so much as one.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, if he shall have entered into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there is not one small stone found there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite {is} better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Hushai to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that {are} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a maidservant went and told them; and they went and told king David.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; into which they descended.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground grain on it; and the thing was not known.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where {is} Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said to them, They have gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find {them}, they returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, after they had departed, that they came out of the well, and went and told king David, and said to David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David arose, and all the people that {were} with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there was left not one of them that had not gone over Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled {his} donkey, and arose, and went home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa {was} a man's son, whose name {was} Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when David had come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

column.name: text
column.value: Brought beds, and basins, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and roasted {grain}, and beans, and lentiles, and roasted {seeds},

column.name: text
column.value: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of cows, for David, and for the people that {were} with him, to eat: for they said, The people {are} hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And David numbered the people that {were} with him, and set over them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.

column.name: text
column.value: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now {thou art} worth ten thousand of us: therefore now {it is} better that thou shouldest help us out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to them, What seemeth to you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, {Deal} gently for my sake with the young man, {even} with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim;

column.name: text
column.value: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught fast in the oak, and he was left hanging between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that {was} under him went away.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain man saw {it}, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab said to the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest {him}, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten {shekels} of silver, and a belt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man said to Joab, Though I should receive a thousand {shekels} of silver in my hand, {yet} would I not put forth my hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none {touch} the young man Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against my own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against {me}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three spears in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he {was} yet alive in the midst of the oak.

column.name: text
column.value: And ten young men that bore Joab's armour surrounded and smote Absalom, and slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing Israel: for Joab restrained the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and built for himself a pillar, which {is} in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called to this day, Absalom's place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and inform the king, how the LORD hath avenged himself of his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab said to him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But however, let me also, I pray thee, run after Cushi. And Joab said, Why wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

column.name: text
column.value: But however, {said he}, let me run. And he said to him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and outran Cushi.

column.name: text
column.value: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

column.name: text
column.value: And the watchman called, and told the king. And the king said, If he {is} alone, {there is} tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

column.name: text
column.value: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called to the porter, and said, Behold {another} man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the watchman said, I think the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He {is} a good man, and cometh with good news.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed {be} the LORD thy God, who hath delivered up the men that raised their hand against my lord the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and {me} thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what {it was}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said {to him}, Turn aside, {and} stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, May the enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do {thee} harm, be as {that} young man {is}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! O that I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And the victory that day was {turned} into mourning to all the people: for the people heard it said that day how the king was grieved for his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people withdrew by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, who this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

column.name: text
column.value: In that thou lovest thy enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak kindly to thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou shalt not go forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse to thee than all the evil that hath befallen thee from thy youth until now.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king rose, and sat in the gate. And they told to all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us from the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us from the hand of the Philistines; and now he hath fled out of the land for Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

column.name: text
column.value: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, {even} to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye {are} my brethren, ye {are} my bones and my flesh: why then are ye the last to bring back the king?

column.name: text
column.value: And say ye to Amasa, {Art} thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the place of Joab.

column.name: text
column.value: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as {the heart of} one man; so that they sent {this word} to the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, who {was} of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he came over Jordan;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity to me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I have come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?

column.name: text
column.value: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries to me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I {am} this day king over Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the king said to Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king swore to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither cared for his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came {again} in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said to him, Why didst thou not go with me, Mephibosheth?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me a donkey, that I may ride on it, and go to the king; because thy servant {is} lame.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath slandered thy servant to my lord the king; but my lord the king {is} as an angel of God: do therefore {what is} good in thy eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For all {of} my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that ate at thy own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more to the king?

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mephibosheth said to the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king hath come again in peace to his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, {even} eighty years old: and he had provided the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he {was} a very great man.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barzillai said to the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} this day eighty years old: {and} can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? why then should thy servant be yet a burden to my lord the king?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense me with such a reward?

column.name: text
column.value: Let thy servant, I pray thee, return again, that I may die in my own city, {and be buried} by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to thee: and whatever thou shalt require of me, {that} will I do for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king had come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to him, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king {is} near of kin to us: why then are ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all at the king's {cost}? or hath he given us any gift?

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more {right} in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, {It is} for Saul, and for {his} bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said to them; (now the Gibeonites {were} not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn to them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David said to the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and how shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And the Gibeonites said to him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, {that} will I do for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us {that} we should be destroyed from remaining within any border of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: Let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, {whom} the LORD chose. And the king said, I will give {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD'S oath that {was} between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

column.name: text
column.value: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD: and they fell {all} seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first {days}, in the beginning of barley harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until the rain poured on them from heaven, and allowed neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, who had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son they buried in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David became faint.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ishbibenob, who {was} of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred {shekels} of brass in weight, he being girded with a new {sword}, thought of slaying David.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, Thou shalt go out no more with us to battle, that thou mayest not put out the light of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, who {was} of the sons of the giant.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew {the brother of} Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear {was} like a weaver's beam.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of {great} stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And David spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day {that} the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, The LORD {is} my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

column.name: text
column.value: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: {he is} my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my preserver; thou savest me from violence.

column.name: text
column.value: I will call on the LORD, {who is} worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: When the waves of death surrounded me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

column.name: text
column.value: The sorrows of hell surrounded me; the snares of death seized me;

column.name: text
column.value: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry {entered} into his ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was angry.

column.name: text
column.value: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

column.name: text
column.value: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness {was} under his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And he rode upon a cherub, and flew: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made darkness pavilions around him, dark waters, {and} thick clouds of the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and smote them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were laid open, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

column.name: text
column.value: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: They fell upon me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my support.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For all his judgments {were} before me: and {as for} his statutes, I did not depart from them.

column.name: text
column.value: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from my iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

column.name: text
column.value: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful, {and} with the upright man thou wilt show thyself upright.

column.name: text
column.value: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; and with the perverse thou wilt contend.

column.name: text
column.value: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thy eyes {are} upon the haughty, {that} thou mayest bring {them} down.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou {art} my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} God, his way {is} perfect; the word of the LORD {is} tried: he {is} a shield to all them that trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For who {is} God, except the LORD? and who {is} a rock, except our God?

column.name: text
column.value: God {is} my strength {and} power: and he maketh my way perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: He maketh my feet like hinds' {feet}: and setteth me upon my high places.

column.name: text
column.value: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet have not slipped.

column.name: text
column.value: I have pursued my enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they have fallen under my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also given me the necks of my enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

column.name: text
column.value: They looked, but {there was} none to save; {even} to the LORD, but he answered them not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I stamped them as the mire of the street, {and} spread them abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me {to be} head of the heathen: a people {which} I knew not shall serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: Strangers shall submit themselves to me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall come trembling out of their fortresses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD liveth; and blessed {be} my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

column.name: text
column.value: And that bringeth me forth from my enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will give thanks to thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises to thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: {He is} the tower of salvation for his king: and he showeth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man {who was} raised on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the LORD spoke by me, and his word {was} on my tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, He that ruleth over men {must be} just, ruling in the fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he shall be} as the light of the morning, {when} the sun riseth, {even} a morning without clouds; {as} the tender grass {springing} out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

column.name: text
column.value: Although my house {is} not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all {things}, and sure: for {this is} all my salvation, and all {my} desire, although he maketh {it} not to grow.

column.name: text
column.value: But the worthless, all of them shall be as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

column.name: text
column.value: But the man {that} shall touch them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the {same} place.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same {was} Adino the Eznite: {he lifted up his spear} against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him {was} Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, {one} of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines {that} were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away:

column.name: text
column.value: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clung to the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to strip {the slain}.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him {was} Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

column.name: text
column.value: And three of the thirty leaders went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And David {was} then in a strong hold, and the garrison of the Philistines {was} then {in} Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And David longed, and said, O that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which {is} by the gate!

column.name: text
column.value: And the three mighty men broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that {was} by the gate, and took {it}, and brought {it} to David: nevertheless he would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: {is not this} the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, {and} slew {them}, and had the name among three.

column.name: text
column.value: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: yet he attained not to the {first} three.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many deeds, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew an Egyptian, a handsome man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

column.name: text
column.value: These {things} did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among three mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the {first} three. And David set him over his guard.

column.name: text
column.value: Asahel the brother of Joab {was} one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

column.name: text
column.value: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

column.name: text
column.value: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

column.name: text
column.value: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

column.name: text
column.value: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

column.name: text
column.value: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

column.name: text
column.value: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

column.name: text
column.value: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

column.name: text
column.value: And there happened to be there a worthless fellow, whose name {was} Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So every man of Israel withdrew from following David, followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah held fast to their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women {his} concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody, and fed them, but went not in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble to me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

column.name: text
column.value: So Amasa went to assemble {the men of} Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than {did} Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue him, lest he get for himself fortified cities, and escape us.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: When they {were} at the great stone which {is} in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded to him, and upon it a belt {with} a sword fastened upon his loins in its sheath; and as he went forth it fell out.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab said to Amasa, {Art} thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that {was} in Joab's hand: so he smote him in the fifth {rib}, and shed out his inward parts to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that {is} for David, {let him go} after Joab.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that {were} with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

column.name: text
column.value: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, to Joab, Come here, that I may speak with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was come near to her, the woman said, {Art} thou Joab? And he answered, I {am he}. Then she said to him, Hear the words of thy handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she spoke, saying, They were accustomed to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask {counsel} at Abel: and so they ended {the matter}.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am one of them that are} peaceable {and} faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: The matter {is} not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, {even} against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said to Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast {it} out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Joab {was} over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

column.name: text
column.value: And Adoram {was} over the forced labour: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud {was} recorder:

column.name: text
column.value: And Sheva {was} scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar {were} the priests:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, who {was} with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab said to the king, Now the LORD thy God add to the people, as many as they may be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see {it}: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

column.name: text
column.value: But the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they passed over Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that {lieth} in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,

column.name: text
column.value: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, {even} to Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab presented the sum of the number of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah {were} five hundred thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said to the LORD, I have sinned greatly in what I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

column.name: text
column.value: For when David had risen in the morning, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go and say to David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three {things}; choose thee one of them, that I may {do it} to thee.

column.name: text
