column.value: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said to him, Shall seven years of famine come upon thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thy enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now consider, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Gad, I am in deep distress: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies {are} great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thy hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And David spoke to the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gad came that day to David, and said to him, Go up, rear an altar to the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And Araunah said, Why is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar to the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Araunah said to David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what {seemeth} good to him: behold, {here are} oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and {other} instruments of the oxen for wood.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {things} did Araunah, {as} a king, give to the king. And Araunah said to the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy {it} of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And David built there an altar to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now king David was old {and} advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he could not get warm.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore his servants said to him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get warm.

column.name: text
column.value: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the land of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the damsel {was} very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also {was a} very handsome {man}; and {his mother} bore him after Absalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men who {belonged} to David, were not with Adonijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which {is} by Enrogel, and invited all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:

column.name: text
column.value: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth {it} not?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thy own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Go and enter in to king David, and say to him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear to thy handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, while thou art yet talking there with the king, I will also come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bathsheba went to the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance to the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to him, My lord, thou didst swear by the LORD thy God to thy handmaid, {saying}, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest {it} not:

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath invited all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not invited.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel {are} upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

column.name: text
column.value: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, while she was yet talking with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

column.name: text
column.value: For he hath gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath invited all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

column.name: text
column.value: But me, {even} me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not invited.

column.name: text
column.value: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shown {it} to thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

column.name: text
column.value: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king swore, and said, {As} the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

column.name: text
column.value: Even as I swore to thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Bathsheba bowed with {her} face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: The king also said to them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

column.name: text
column.value: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so {too}.

column.name: text
column.value: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so let him be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

column.name: text
column.value: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with the sound of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adonijah and all the guests that {were} with him heard {it} as they had finished eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Why {is this} noise of the city being in an uproar?

column.name: text
column.value: And while he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said to him, Come in; for thou {art} a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they have come from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. This {is} the noise that ye have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

column.name: text
column.value: And also thus said the king, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, who hath given {one} to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the guests that {were} with Adonijah were afraid, and arose, and went every man his way.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear to me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon said, If he will show himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said to him, Go to thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the days of David drew near that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man;

column.name: text
column.value: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and wherever thou turnest thyself:

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD may continue his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, {and} what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner, and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his belt that {was} about his loins, and in his shoes that {were} on his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his gray head go down to the grave in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, {thou hast} with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou {art} a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do to him; but his gray head do thou bring down to the grave with blood.

column.name: text
column.value: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And the days that David reigned over Israel {were} forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon was seated upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

column.name: text
column.value: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say to thee. And she said, Say on.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and {that} all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: but the kingdom is turned about, and hath become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said to him, Say on.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, to Solomon the king, (for he will not say to thee no,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; {I pray thee}, deny me not. And the king said to her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not deny thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon answered and said to his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he {is} my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah hath not spoken this word against his own life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, {as} the LORD liveth, who hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Abiathar the priest said the king, Depart to Anathoth, to thy own fields; for thou {art} worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou didst bear the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon removed Abiathar from being priest to the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled to the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to king Solomon that Joab had fled to the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, {he is} by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said to him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing {of it, that is}, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his stead over the army: and Zadok the priest the king put in the stead of Abiathar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth from there to any place whatever.

column.name: text
column.value: For it shall be, {that} on the day thou shalt go out, and pass over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thy own head.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shimei said to the king, The saying {is} good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away to Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants {are} in Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shimei arose, and saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had returned.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protest to thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest any where abroad, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst to me, The word {that} I have heard {is} good.

column.name: text
column.value: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

column.name: text
column.value: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thy heart is aware of, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thy own head;

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon {shall be} blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; who went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon allied himself with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and married Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had finished building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built to the name of the LORD, until those days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that {was} the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

column.name: text
column.value: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon said, Thou hast shown to thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I {am but} a little child: I know not {how} to go out or come in.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy servant {is} in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: Give therefore to thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

column.name: text
column.value: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thy enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there hath been none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like thee all thy days.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, {it was} a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came there two women, {that were} harlots, to the king, and stood before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we {were} together; {there was} no stranger with us in the house, except us two in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And this woman's child died in the night; because she lay on him.

column.name: text
column.value: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thy handmaid slept, and laid him in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead: but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, he was not my son, whom I bore.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living {is} my son, and the dead {is} thy son. And this said, No; but the dead {is} thy son, and the living {is} my son. Thus they spoke before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king, The one saith, This {is} my son that liveth, and thy son {is} the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son {is} the dead, and my son {is} the living.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then spoke the woman whose the living child {was} to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and by no means slay him. But the other said, Let he be neither mine nor thine, {but} divide {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and by no means slay him: she {is} his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God {was} in him, to do judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

column.name: text
column.value: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the army: and Zadok and Abiathar {were} the priests:

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah the son of Nathan {was} over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan {was} principal officer, {and} the king's friend:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahishar {was} over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda {was} over the forced labour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him {pertained} Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; who had Taphath the daughter of Solomon for a wife:

column.name: text
column.value: Baana the son of Ahilud; {to him pertained} Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which {is} by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, {even} to {the place that is} beyond Jokneam:

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him {pertained} the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which {are} in Gilead; to him {also pertained} the region of Argob, which {is} in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and brasen bars:

column.name: text
column.value: Ahinadab the son of Iddo {had} Mahanaim:

column.name: text
column.value: Ahimaaz {was} in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon for a wife:

column.name: text
column.value: Baanah the son of Hushai {was} in Asher and in Aloth:

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

column.name: text
column.value: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

column.name: text
column.value: Geber the son of Uri {was} in the country of Gilead, {in} the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and {he was} the only officer who {was} in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah and Israel {were} many, as the sand which {is} by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and sixty measures of meal,

column.name: text
column.value: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, besides harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowls.

column.name: text
column.value: For he had dominion over all {the region} on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side of the river: and he had peace on all sides around him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And those officers provided food for king Solomon, and for all that came to king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries they brought to the place where {the officers} were, every man according to his charge.

column.name: text
column.value: And God gave Solomon great wisdom and understanding, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that {is} on the sea shore.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the surrounding nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke of trees, from the cedar tree that {is} in Lebanon even to the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spoke also of beasts, and of fowls, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the stead of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house to the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, {so that there is} neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I purpose to build an house to the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spoke to David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy stead, he shall build an house to my name.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and to thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that {there is} not among us any that hast skill to hew timber like the Sidonians.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed {be} the LORD this day, who hath given to David a wise son over this great people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: {and} I will perform all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

column.name: text
column.value: My servants shall bring {them} down from Lebanon to the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats to the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive {them}: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees {according to} all his desire.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat {for} food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon raised forced labour out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, {and} two months at home: and Adoniram {was} over the forced labour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had seventy thousand that bore burdens, and eighty thousand hewers in the mountains;

column.name: text
column.value: Besides the chief of Solomon's officers who {were} over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, {and} hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew {them}, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month of Zif, which {is} the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length of it {was} sixty cubits, and the breadth of it twenty {cubits}, and the height of it thirty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits {was} the length of it, according to the breadth of the house; {and} ten cubits {was} the breadth of it before the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

column.name: text
column.value: And against the wall of the house he built chambers all around, {against} the walls of the house all around, {both} of the temple and of the inner sanctuary: and he made chambers all around:

column.name: text
column.value: The lowest chamber {was} five cubits broad, and the middle {was} six cubits broad, and the third {was} seven cubits broad: for around the outside {in the wall} of the house he made narrowed rests, that {the beams} should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought there: so that there was neither hammer nor axe {nor} any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

column.name: text
column.value: The door for the middle chamber {was} in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle {chamber}, and out of the middle into the third.

column.name: text
column.value: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

column.name: text
column.value: And {then} he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house {with} timber of cedar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {Concerning} this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spoke to David thy father:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built the walls {on the} inside of the house with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the panelling: {and} he covered {them} on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built {them} for it on the inside, {even} for the inner sanctuary, {even} for the most holy {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house, that {is}, the temple before it, was forty cubits {long}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cedar {on the} inside of the house {was} carved with gourds and open flowers: all {was} cedar; there was no stone seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inner sanctuary he prepared in the inside of the house, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inner sanctuary in the forepart {was} twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height of it: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and {so} covered the altar {which was of} cedar.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon overlaid the inside {of the} house with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the inner sanctuary; and he overlaid it with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that {was} by the inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And within the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim {of} olive tree, {each} ten cubits high.

column.name: text
column.value: And five cubits {was} the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the outmost part of the one wing to the outmost part of the other {were} ten cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other cherub {was} ten cubits: both the cherubim {were} of one measure and one size.

column.name: text
column.value: The height of the one cherub {was} ten cubits, and so {was it} of the other cherub.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the cherubim within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubim, so that the wing of the one touched the {one} wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carved all the walls around the house with carved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

column.name: text
column.value: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the entrance of the inner sanctuary he made doors {of} olive tree: the lintel {and} side posts {were} a fifth part {of the wall}.

column.name: text
column.value: The two doors also {were of} olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid {them} with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubim, and upon the palm trees.

column.name: text
column.value: So also he made for the door of the temple posts {of} olive tree, a fourth part {of the wall}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the two doors {were of} fir tree: the two leaves of the one door {were} folding, and the two leaves of the other door {were} folding.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carved {on it} cherubim and palm trees and open flowers: and covered {them} with gold fitted upon the carved work.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewn stone, and a row of cedar beams.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

column.name: text
column.value: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which {is} the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all its parts, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

column.name: text
column.value: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

column.name: text
column.value: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; its length {was} an hundred cubits, and its breadth fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: And {it was} covered with cedar above upon the beams, that {lay} on forty five pillars, fifteen {in} a row.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} windows {in} three rows, and light {was} against light {in} three rows.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the doors and posts {were} square, with the windows: and light {was} against light {in} three rows.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made a porch of pillars; its length {was} fifty cubits, and its breadth thirty cubits: and the porch {was} before them: and the {other} pillars and the thick beams {were} before them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, {even} the porch of judgment: and {it was} covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: And his house where he dwelt {had} another court within the porch, {which} was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had married, like this porch.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {were of} costly stones, according to the measures of hewn stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation to the coping, and {so} on the outside toward the great court.

column.name: text
column.value: And the foundation {was of} costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And above {were} costly stones, after the measures of hewn stones, and cedars.

column.name: text
column.value: And the great court all around {was} with three rows of hewn stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

column.name: text
column.value: He {was} a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father {was} a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and skill in working all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

column.name: text
column.value: For he cast two pillars of brass, each of eighteen cubits high: and a line of twelve cubits did surround each of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made two capitals {of} molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one capital {was} five cubits, and the height of the other capital {was} five cubits:

column.name: text
column.value: {And} nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the capitals which {were} upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the pillars, and two rows all around upon the one network, to cover the capitals that {were} upon the top, with pomegranates: and so he did for the other capital.

column.name: text
column.value: And the capitals that {were} upon the top of the pillars {were} of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And the capitals upon the two pillars {had pomegranates} also above, close to the enlargement which {was} by the network: and the pomegranates {were} two hundred in rows all around upon the other capital.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called its name Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called its name Boaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon the top of the pillars {was} lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: {it was} round in form, and its height {was} five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits surrounded it.

column.name: text
column.value: And under the brim of it all around {there were} gourds surrounding it, ten in a cubit, all the way around the sea: the gourds {were} cast in two rows, when it was cast.

column.name: text
column.value: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea {was set} above upon them, and all their hinder parts {were} inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And it {was} an hand breadth thick, and its brim was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits {was} the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth of it, and three cubits the height of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the work of the bases {was} in this {manner}: they had borders, and the borders {were} between the frames:

column.name: text
column.value: And on the borders that {were} between the frames {were} lions, oxen, and cherubim: and upon the frames {there was} a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen {were} certain additions made of thin work.

column.name: text
column.value: And every base had four brasen wheels, and axles of brass: and its four corners had supports: under the laver {were} molten supports at the side of every addition.

column.name: text
column.value: And the mouth of it within the capital and above {was} a cubit: but the mouth of it {was} round {after} the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it {were} carvings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

column.name: text
column.value: And under the borders {were} four wheels; and the axles of the wheels {were joined} to the base: and the height of a wheel {was} a cubit and half a cubit.

column.name: text
column.value: And the work of the wheels {was} like the work of a chariot wheel: their axles, and their hubs, and their rims, and their spokes, {were} all cast.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} four supports to the four corners of one base: {and} the supports {were} of the very base itself.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the top of the base {it was} perfectly round at a height of half a cubit: and on the top of the base its frames and its borders {were} of the same.

column.name: text
column.value: For on the plates of its frames, and on its borders, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions all around.

column.name: text
column.value: After this {manner} he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, {and} one size.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he made ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: {and} every laver was four cubits: {and} upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward toward the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he made for king Solomon for the house of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: The two pillars, and the {two} bowls of the capitals that {were} on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the capitals which {were} upon the top of the pillars;

column.name: text
column.value: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, {even} two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that {were} upon the pillars;

column.name: text
column.value: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

column.name: text
column.value: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

column.name: text
column.value: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basins: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, {were of} bright brass.

column.name: text
column.value: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon left all the vessels {unweighed}, because they were very many: neither was the weight of the brass known.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon made all the vessels that {pertained} to the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, upon which {was} the showbread,

column.name: text
column.value: And the lampstands of pure gold, five on the right {side}, and five on the left, before the inner sanctuary, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs {of} gold,

column.name: text
column.value: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers {of} pure gold; and the hinges {of} gold, {both} for the doors of the inner house, the most holy {place, and} for the doors of the house, {that is}, of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; {even} the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, he placed among the treasures of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to try him with hard questions.

column.name: text
column.value: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bore spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him of all that was in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon answered all her questions: there was not {any} thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,

column.name: text
column.value: And the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: However I believed not the words, until I came, and my eyes had seen {it}: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Happy {are} thy men, happy {are} these thy servants, who stand continually before thee, {and} that hear thy wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD thy God, who delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore he made thee king, to do judgment and justice.

column.name: text
column.value: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices a very great quantity, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor have they been seen to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides {that} which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty and six talents of gold,

column.name: text
column.value: Besides {what he had} of the merchants, and of the trade of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon made two hundred shields {of} beaten gold: six hundred {shekels} of gold went to one shield.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he made} three hundred shields {of} beaten gold; three pounds of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

column.name: text
column.value: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne {was} round behind: and {there were} arms on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the arms.

column.name: text
column.value: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels {were of} gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon {were of} pure gold; none {were of} silver: it was not considered as any thing in the days of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

column.name: text
column.value: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the earth consulted Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made silver {to be} in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars he made {to be} as the sycamore trees that {are} in the vale, for abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had horses brought from Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

column.name: text
column.value: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred {shekels} of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring {them} out by their means.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to perform,

column.name: text
column.value: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, {and} wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

column.name: text
column.value: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: {But} if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments {and} my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I cut off Israel from the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

column.name: text
column.value: And at this house, {which} is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus to this land, and to this house?

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers from the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,

column.name: text
column.value: ({Now} Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What cities {are} these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram sent to the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the reason of the forced labour which king Solomon raised; to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

column.name: text
column.value: {For} Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it {for} a present to his daughter, Solomon's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the lower,

column.name: text
column.value: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the store cities that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} all the people {that were} left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who {were} not of the children of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon raise forced labour to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no slaves: but they {were} men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the chief of the officers that {were} over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, who bore rule over the people that wrought in the work.

column.name: text
column.value: But Pharaoh's daughter came up from the city of David to her house which {Solomon} had built for her: then he built Millo.

column.name: text
column.value: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built to the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that {was} before the LORD. So he finished the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which {is} beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, sailors that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Ophir, and obtained from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought {it} to king Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers of the children of Israel, to king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which {is} Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves to king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which {is} the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that {were} in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled to him, {were} with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy {place, even} under the wings of the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: For the cherubim spread forth {their} two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its staffs above.

column.name: text
column.value: And they drew out the staffs, that the ends of the staffs were seen out in the holy {place} before the inner sanctuary, and they were not seen outside: and there they are to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: {There was} nothing in the ark except the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made {a covenant} with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy {place}, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then spoke Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel were standing;)

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled {it}, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel from Egypt, I have chosen no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be in it; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to David my father, Though it was in thy heart to build an house to my name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house to my name.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spoke, and I have risen in the stead of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have set there a place for the ark, in which {is} the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, LORD God of Israel, {there is} no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

column.name: text
column.value: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him: thou didst speak also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled {it} with thy hand, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; provided thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou didst speak to thy servant David my father.

column.name: text
column.value: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have built?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet have thou respect to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken to the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee this day:

column.name: text
column.value: That thy eyes may be open toward this house night and day, {even} toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken to the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

column.name: text
column.value: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man shall trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thy altar in this house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: When thy people Israel shall be smitten before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication to thee in this house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again to the land which thou gavest to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou mayest teach them the good way in which they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be in the land famine, if there shall be pestilence, blighting, mildew, locust, {or} if there shall be caterpiller; if their enemy shall besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague, whatever sickness {there shall be};

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever prayer and supplication shall be {made} by any man, {or} by all thy people Israel, who shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, {even} thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

column.name: text
column.value: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest to our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover concerning a stranger, that {is} not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;

column.name: text
column.value: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy outstretched arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

column.name: text
column.value: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as {do} thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have built, is called by thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, wherever thou shalt send them, and shall pray to the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and {toward} the house that I have built for thy name:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

column.name: text
column.value: If they shall sin against thee, (for {there is} no man that sinneth not,) and thou shalt be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives to the land of the enemy, far or near;

column.name: text
column.value: {Yet} if they shall take it to their hearts in the land where they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication to thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} return to thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, who led them away captive, and pray to thee toward their land, which thou gavest to their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

column.name: text
column.value: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

column.name: text
column.value: For they {are} thy people, and thy inheritance, which thou broughtest out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

column.name: text
column.value: That thy eyes may be open to the supplication of thy servant, and to the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken to them in all their supplications to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, {to be} thy inheritance, as thou didst speak by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the LORD, that hath given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

column.name: text
column.value: That he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And let these my words, with which I have made supplication before the LORD, be near to the LORD our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

column.name: text
column.value: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD {is} God, {and that there is} none else.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The same day did the king consecrate the middle of the court that {was} before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that {was} before the LORD {was} too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entrance into Hamath to the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, {even} fourteen days.

column.name: text
column.value: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard {of it}, (for he had fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

column.name: text
column.value: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Depart yet {for} three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant to this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that had grown up with him, {and} who stood before him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

column.name: text
column.value: And the young men that had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak to this people who spoke to thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou {it} lighter to us; thus shalt thou say to them, My little {finger} shall be thicker than my father's loins.

column.name: text
column.value: And now though my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;

column.name: text
column.value: And spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father {also} chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the king hearkened not to the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

column.name: text
column.value: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not to them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither {have we} inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thy own house, David. So Israel departed to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: But {as for} the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who {was} over the forced labour; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to enter his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: So Israel rebelled against the house of David to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come again, that they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

column.name: text
