column.value: And when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and eighty thousand chosen men, who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt in it; and went out from there, and built Penuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

column.name: text
column.value: If this people go up to offer sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again to their lord, {even} to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon which the king took counsel, and made two calves {of} gold, and said to them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other he placed in Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And this thing became a sin: for the people went {to worship} before the one, {even} to Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that {is} in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.

column.name: text
column.value: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, {even} in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast to the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

column.name: text
column.value: But king Solomon loved many foreign women, in addition to the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, {and} Hittites;

column.name: text
column.value: Of the nations {concerning} which the LORD said to the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in to you: {for} surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon held fast to these in love.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, {that} his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as {was} the heart of David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as {did} David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon built an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that {is} before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And likewise did he for all his foreign wives, who burnt incense and sacrificed to their gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

column.name: text
column.value: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD said to Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done by thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom away from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: However in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: {but} I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will not rend away all the kingdom; {but} will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD stirred up an adversary to Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he {was} of the king's seed in Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host had gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

column.name: text
column.value: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

column.name: text
column.value: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad {being} yet a little child.

column.name: text
column.value: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them from Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt; who gave him an house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him for a wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pharaoh said to him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thy own country? And he answered, Nothing: only let me go.

column.name: text
column.value: And God stirred him up {another} adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, who fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered men to him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them {of Zobah}: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt in it, and reigned in Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, besides the mischief that Hadad {did}: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name {was} Zeruah, a widow woman, even he raised {his} hand against the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {was} the cause why he raised {his} hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, {and} repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man Jeroboam {was} a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two {were} alone in the field:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahijah caught the new garment that {was} on him, and tore it {in} twelve pieces:

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom from the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do {that which is} right in my eyes, and {to keep} my statutes and my judgments, as {did} David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it to thee, {even} ten tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And to his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for me to put my name there.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken to all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, {are} they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

column.name: text
column.value: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel {was} forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD to Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This {is} the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be split apart, and the ashes that {are} upon it shall be poured out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, who had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it to him again.

column.name: text
column.value: The altar also was split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king answered and said to the man of God, Entreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored to him again, and became as {it was} before.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man of God said to the king, If thou wilt give me half thy house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

column.name: text
column.value: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken to the king, them they told also to their father.

column.name: text
column.value: And their father said to them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his sons, Saddle me the donkey. So they saddled him the donkey: and he rode on it,

column.name: text
column.value: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said to him, {Art} thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I {am}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

column.name: text
column.value: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to him, I {am} a prophet also as thou {art}; and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thy house, that he may eat bread and drink water. {But} he lied to him.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went back with him, and ate bread in his house, and drank water.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came to the prophet that brought him back:

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried to the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

column.name: text
column.value: But hast returned, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of which {the LORD} said to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy body shall not come to the sepulchre of thy fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the donkey, {that is}, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his body was cast in the way, and the donkey stood by it, the lion also stood by the body.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the body cast in the way, and the lion standing by the body: and they came and told {it} in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard {of it}, he said, It {is} the man of God, who was disobedient to the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him to the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to his sons, saying, Saddle me the donkey. And they saddled {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went and found his body cast in the way, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body: the lion had not eaten the body, nor torn the donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it upon the donkey, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, {saying}, Alas, my brother!

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spoke to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre in which the man of God {is} buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

column.name: text
column.value: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which {are} in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whoever would, he consecrated him, and he became {one} of the priests of the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And this thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut {it} off, and to destroy {it} from the face of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou mayest not be known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and go to Shiloh: behold, there {is} Ahijah the prophet, who told me that {I should be} king over this people.

column.name: text
column.value: And take with thee ten loaves, and cakes, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were dim by reason of his age.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he {is} sick: thus and thus shalt thou say to her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall pretend {to be} another {woman}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why pretendest thou {to be} another? for I {am} sent to thee {with} heavy {tidings}.

column.name: text
column.value: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: And tore the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it to thee: and {yet} thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do {that} only {which was} right in my eyes;

column.name: text
column.value: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam the males, {and} him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it is all gone.

column.name: text
column.value: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise thou therefore, depart to thy own house: {and} when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found {some} good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their idols, provoking the LORD to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall give up Israel because of the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned, and who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: {and} when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they {are} written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the days which Jeroboam reigned {were} two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam {was} forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD chose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name {was} Naamah an Ammonitess.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

column.name: text
column.value: For they also built for themselves high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were also sodomites in the land: {and} they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, {that} Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed {them} to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all {their} days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name {was} Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as I exalted thee from the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

column.name: text
column.value: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servant Zimri, captain of half {his} chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of {his} house in Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, {that} he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one male, neither of his kinsman, nor of his friends.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

column.name: text
column.value: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people {were} encamped against Gibbethon, which {belonged} to the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people {that were} encamped heard it said, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,

column.name: text
column.value: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

column.name: text
column.value: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that {were} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin which he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that {were} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took for a wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho: he laid the foundation of it in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates of it in his youngest {son} Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah the Tishbite, {who was} of the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab, {As} the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Depart from here, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that {is} before Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, {that} thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went and did according to the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that {is} before Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go to Zarephath, which {belongeth} to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman {was} there gathering sticks: and he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And as she was going to bring {it}, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, {As} the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I {am} gathering two sticks, that I may go in and prepare it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to her, Fear not; go {and} do as thou hast said: but make me of it a little cake first, and bring {it} to me, and afterward make for thee and for thy son.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not be used up, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day {that} the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, ate {many} days.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} the barrel of meal was not used up, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke by Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, {that} the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so grievous, that there was no breath left in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come to me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried to the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

column.name: text
column.value: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried to the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down from the chamber into the house, and delivered him to his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou {art} a man of God, {and} that the word of the LORD in thy mouth {is} truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Three years he reigned in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless for David's sake the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: Because David did {that which was} right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any {thing} that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa did {that which was} right in the eyes of the LORD, as {did} David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And he banished the sodomites from the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from {being} queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt {it} by the brook Kidron.

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold {that were} left in the treasuries of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} a league between me and thee, {and} between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent to thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

column.name: text
column.value: So Benhadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the captains of the armies which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelbethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard {of it}, that he stopped building Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none {was} exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built it; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin which he made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which {belonged} to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

column.name: text
column.value: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he reigned, {that} he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation with which he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass {after} many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, show thyself to Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. And {there was} a grievous famine in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab called Obadiah, who {was} the governor of {his} house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

column.name: text
column.value: For it was {so}, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Go into the land, to all fountains of water, and to all brooks: perhaps we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, {Art} thou that my lord Elijah?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered him, I {am}: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah {is here}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, How have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

column.name: text
column.value: {As} the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation nor kingdom, where my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, {He is} not {there}; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

column.name: text
column.value: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah {is here}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {as soon as} I have gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee where I know not; and {so} when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

column.name: text
column.value: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah {is here}: and he shall slay me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said, {As} the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him to day.

column.name: text
column.value: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, {Art} thou he that troubleth Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore send, {and} gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, who eat at Jezebel's table.

column.name: text
column.value: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to mount Carmel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah came to all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD {is} God, follow him: but if Baal, {then} follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Elijah to the people, I, {even} I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets {are} four hundred and fifty men.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay {it} on wood, and put no fire {under}: and I will prepare the other bull, and lay {it} on wood, and put no fire {under}:

column.name: text
column.value: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose one bull for yourselves, and prepare {it} first; for ye {are} many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire {under}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took the bull which was given them, and they prepared {it}, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But {there was} no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he {is} a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is on a journey, {or} perhaps he sleepeth, and must be awakened.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the {time} of the offering of the {evening} sacrifice, that {there was} neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to all the people, Come near to me. And all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD {that was} broken down.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

column.name: text
column.value: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces, and laid {him} on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour {it} on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Do {it} the second time. And they did {it} the second time. And he said, Do {it} the third time. And they did {it} the third time.

column.name: text
column.value: And the water ran around the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at {the time of} the offering of the {evening} sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou {art} God in Israel, and {that} I {am} thy servant, and {that} I have done all these things at thy word.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou {art} the LORD God, and {that} thou hast turned their heart back again.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that {was} in the trench.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the people saw {it}, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he {is} the God; the LORD, he {is} the God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to Ahab, Go up, eat and drink; for {there is} a sound of abundance of rain.

column.name: text
column.value: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, {There is} nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say to Ahab, Prepare {thy chariot}, and go down, that the rain may not hinder thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, So let the gods do {to me}, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw {that}, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which {belongeth} to Judah, and left his servant there.

column.name: text
column.value: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I {am} not better than my fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said to him, Arise {and} eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked, and, behold, {there was} a cake baked on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he ate and drank, and laid himself down again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise {and} eat; because the journey {is} too great for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb the mount of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came there to a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD {came} to him, and he said to him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thy altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and broke in pieces the rocks before the LORD; {but} the LORD {was} not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; {but} the LORD {was} not in the earthquake:

column.name: text
column.value: And after the earthquake a fire; {but} the LORD {was} not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when Elijah heard {it}, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. And, behold, {there came} a voice to him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thy altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael {to be} king over Syria:

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint {to be} king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint {to be} prophet in thy stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I have left to {me} seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: So he departed from there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who {was} plowing {with} twelve yoke {of oxen} before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and {then} I will follow thee. And he said to him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave to the people, and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after these things, {that} Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which {was} in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it {is} near to my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; {or}, if it seemeth good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab came into his house sad and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid himself down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no food.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no food?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it pleaseth thee, I will give thee {another} vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jezebel his wife said to him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, {and} eat food, and let thy heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

column.name: text
column.value: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed {them} with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles that {were} in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

column.name: text
column.value: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

column.name: text
column.value: And set two men, worthless men, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And {then} carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of his city, {even} the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent to them, {and} as it {was} written in the letters which she had sent to them.

column.name: text
column.value: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came in two men, worthless men, and sat before him: and the worthless men witnessed against him, {even} against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth blasphemed God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab arose to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who {is} in Samaria: behold, {he is} in the vineyard of Naboth, where he is gone down to possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak to him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak to him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O my enemy? And he answered, I have found {thee}: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab the males, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: And will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which thou hast provoked {me} to anger, and made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Jezebel also spoke the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But there was none like Ahab, who sold himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all {things} as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he tore his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: {but} in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together: and {there were} thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said to him, Thus saith Benhadad,

column.name: text
column.value: Thy silver and thy gold {is} mine; thy wives also and thy children, {even} the most comely, {are} mine.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I {am} thine, and all that I have.

column.name: text
column.value: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent to thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver to me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will send my servants to thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thy house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, {that} whatever is pleasant in thy eyes, they shall take {it} in their hand, and carry {it} away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this {man} seeketh mischief: for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the elders and all the people said to him, Hearken not {to him}, nor consent.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he said to the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benhadad sent to him, and said, The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell {him}, Let not him that girdeth on {his armour} boast himself as he that putteth it off.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when {Benhadad} heard this message, as he {was} drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said to his servants, Set {yourselves in array}. And they set {themselves in array} against the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came a prophet to Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thy hand this day; and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, {Even} by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty and two: and after them he numbered all the people, {even} all the children of Israel, {being} seven thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad {was} drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Whether they have come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they have come out for war, take them alive.

column.name: text
column.value: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said to him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, Their gods {are} gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

column.name: text
column.value: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their places:

column.name: text
column.value: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, {and} surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened to their voice, and did so.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a man of God, and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD {is} God of the hills, but he {is} not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thy hand, and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they encamped opposite one another seven days. And {so} it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

column.name: text
column.value: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and {there} a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men {that were} left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants said to him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel {are} merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: perhaps he will save thy life.

column.name: text
column.value: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and {put} ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, {Is} he yet alive? he {is} my brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the men diligently observed whether {any thing would come} from him, and did hastily catch {it}: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: And {Benhadad} said to him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then {said Ahab}, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou hast departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

column.name: text
column.value: And as the king passed by, he cried to the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man to me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he shall be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said to him, So {shall} thy judgment {be}; thyself hast decided {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel knew that he {was} of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of {thy} hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel went to his house sad and displeased, and came to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead {is} ours, and we {are} still, {and} take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramothgilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I {am} as thou {art}, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver {it} into the hand of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat said, {Is there} not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may enquire of him?

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, {There is} yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten {here} Micaiah the son of Imlah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a threshingfloor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou hast consumed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver {it} into the king's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets {declare} good to the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak {that which is} good.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, {As} the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith to me, that will I speak.

column.name: text
column.value: So he came to the king. And the king said to him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver {it} into the hand of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but {that which is} true in the name of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said in this manner, and another said in that manner.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, How? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade {him}, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this {man} in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, If thou shalt return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, each one of you.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely this {is} the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that he {was} not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a {certain} man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of his armour: therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, Turn thy hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the battle increased that day: and the king was held up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at evening: and the blood ran out of the wound into the inside of the chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the setting of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according to the word of the LORD which he spoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoshaphat {was} thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing {that which was} right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; {for} the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he warred, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he removed from the land.

column.name: text
column.value: {There was} then no king in Edom: a deputy {was} king.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab to Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

column.name: text
column.value: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of the prophets that {were} at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said to him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know {it}; hold ye your peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of the prophets that {were} at Jericho came to Elisha, and said to him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know {it}; hold ye your peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah said to him, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

column.name: text
column.value: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped {it} together, and smote the waters, and they were divided to the one side and to the other, so that they two went over on dry ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they had gone over, that Elijah said to Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I am taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: {nevertheless}, if thou shalt see me {when I am} taken from thee, it shall be so to thee; but if not, it shall not be {so}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, {there appeared} a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha saw {it}, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and its horsemen. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and tore them in two pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

column.name: text
