column.value: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where {is} the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted to the one side and to the other: and Elisha went over.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sons of the prophets who {were} looking on at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Behold now, there are with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest perhaps the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said to them, Did I not say to you, Go not?

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of the city said to Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city {is} pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water {is} bad, and the ground barren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt in it. And they brought {it} to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went forth to the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from there any more death or barren {land}.

column.name: text
column.value: So the waters were healed to this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spoke.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up from there to Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth youths out of the city, and mocked him, and said to him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tore forty and two youths of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went from there to mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that {was} in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said to them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover from this disease.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, {Is it} not because {there is} not a God in Israel, {that} ye go to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the messengers returned to him, he said to them, Why have ye now returned?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, There came up a man to meet us, and said to us, Go, return to the king that sent you, and say to him, Thus saith the LORD, {Is it} not because {there is} not a God in Israel, {that} thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What manner of man {was he} who came up to meet you, and told you these words?

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered him, {He was} an hairy man, and girt with a leather belt about his loins. And he said, It {is} Elijah the Tishbite.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spoke to him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I {am} a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: Again also he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said to him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elijah answered and said to them, If I {am} a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said to him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the LORD said to Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, {is it} not because {there is} no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria {in} the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless he cleaved to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin; he departed not from it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered to the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go: I {am} as thou {art}, my people as thy people, {and} my horses as thy horses.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they made a circuit of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the army, and for the cattle that followed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoshaphat said, {Is there} not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here {is} Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? go to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said to him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said, {As} the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is {but} a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall smite every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side {as} red as blood:

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, This {is} blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in {their} country.

column.name: text
column.value: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth they left the stones of it; but the slingers went about {it}, and smote it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through to the king of Edom: but they could not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took his eldest son that was to reign in his stead, and offered him {for} a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to {their own} land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance to Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, {but he was} a leper.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her mistress, I would that my lord {were} with the prophet that {is} in Samaria! for he would cure him of his leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that {is} of the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Syria said, Go, now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand {pieces} of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter hath come to thee, behold, {with it} I have sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest cure him of his leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he tore his clothes, and said, {Am} I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send to me to cure a man of his leprosy? therefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Why hast thou torn thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

column.name: text
column.value: But Naaman was furious, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and cure the leprosy.

column.name: text
column.value: {Are} not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants came near, and spoke to him, and said, My father, {if} the prophet had bid thee {do some} great thing, wouldest thou not have done {it}? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

column.name: text
column.value: Then he went down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that {there is} no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing from thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, {As} the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take {it}; but he refused.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, {that} when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

column.name: text
column.value: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, {as} the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat from him.

column.name: text
column.value: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw {him} running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, {Is} all well?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, All {is} well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there have come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid {them} upon two of his servants; and they bore {them} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to the tower, he took {them} from their hand, and bestowed {them} in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

column.name: text
column.value: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, From where {comest thou}, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went nowhere.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Went not my heart {with thee}, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? {Is it} a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and male and female servants?

column.name: text
column.value: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave to thee, and to thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper {as white} as snow.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too small for us.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us go, we pray thee, to Jordan, and take from there every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

column.name: text
column.value: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

column.name: text
column.value: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he showed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast {it} in there; and made the axe head float.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said he, Take {it} up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place {shall be} my camp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for there the Syrians have come down.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was greatly troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said to them, Will ye not show me which of us {is} for the king of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that {is} in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Go and spy where he {is}, that I may send and bring him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, {he is} in Dothan.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he sent there horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and surrounded the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the servant of the man of God had risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host surrounded the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered, Fear not: for they that {are} with us {are} more than they that {are} with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain {was} full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said to them, This {is} not the way, neither {is} this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when they had come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these {men}, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, {they were} in the midst of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite {them}? shall I smite {them}?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite {them}: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

column.name: text
column.value: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until a donkey's head was {sold} for eighty {pieces} of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five {pieces} of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman to him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, If the LORD doth not help thee, how shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said to me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

column.name: text
column.value: So we boiled my son, and ate him: and I said to her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he tore his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, {he had} sackcloth beneath upon his flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and {the king} sent a man from before him: but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away my head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: {is} not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

column.name: text
column.value: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down to him: and he said, Behold, this evil {is} from the LORD; why should I wait for the LORD any longer?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elisha spoke to the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thy household, and sojourn wherever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman arose, and did according to the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned from the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to appeal to the king for her house and for her land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, appealed to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this {is} the woman, and this {is} her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that {was} hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even till now.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told to him, saying, The man of God hath come here.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Hazael, Take a present in thy hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

column.name: text
column.value: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said to him, Go, say to him, Thou mayest certainly recover: but the LORD hath showed me that he shall surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: And he settled his countenance steadfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do to the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazael said, But what, {is} thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shown me that thou {shalt be} king over Syria.

column.name: text
column.value: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me {that} thou shouldest surely recover.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped {it} in water, and spread {it} on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat {being} then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him always a light, {and} to his children.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites who surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Two and twenty years old {was} Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as {did} the house of Ahab: for he {was} the son in law of the house of Ahab.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said to him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thy hand, and go to Ramothgilead:

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou comest there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and take him to an inner chamber;

column.name: text
column.value: Then take the box of oil, and pour {it} on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

column.name: text
column.value: So the young man, {even} the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host {were} sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, To which of us all? And he said, To thee, O captain.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, {even} over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

column.name: text
column.value: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab the males, both bound and free in Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

column.name: text
column.value: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and {there shall be} none to bury {her}. And he opened the door, and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and {one} said to him, {Is} all well? Why came this mad {fellow} to thee? And he said to them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, {It is} false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus he spoke to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put {it} under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

column.name: text
column.value: But king Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it is your minds, {then} let none go forth {nor} escape from the city to go to tell {it} in Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

column.name: text
column.value: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, {Is it} peace?

column.name: text
column.value: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, {Is it} peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he doth not return.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, {Is it} peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the watchman told, saying, He came even to them, and doth not return: and the driving {is} like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, {Is it} peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the harlotries of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts {are so} many?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, {There is} treachery, O Ahaziah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said {Jehu} to Bidkar his captain, Take up, {and} cast him into the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

column.name: text
column.value: Surely I saw yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will repay thee in this plot, saith the LORD. Now therefore take {and} cast him into the plot {of ground}, according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw {this}, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. {And they did so} at the ascent of Gur, which {is} by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard {of it}; and she painted her face, and adorned her head, and looked out at a window.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Jehu entered the gate, she said, {Had} Zimri peace, who slew his master?

column.name: text
column.value: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who {is} on my side? who? And there looked out to him two {or} three eunuchs.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and {some} of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trod her under foot.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come in, he ate and drank, and said, Go, see now this cursed {woman}, and bury her: for she {is} a king's daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of {her} hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This {is} the word of the LORD, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

column.name: text
column.value: And the dead body of Jezebel shall be as refuse upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; {so} that they shall not say, This {is} Jezebel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time {shall} a measure of fine flour {be sold} for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, {if} the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see {it} with thy eyes, but shalt not eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

column.name: text
column.value: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine {is} in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall to the army of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose in the twilight, to go to the camp of the Syrians: and when they had come to the edge of the camp of Syria, behold, {there was} no man there.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, {even} the noise of a great army: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it {was}, and fled for their life.

column.name: text
column.value: And when these lepers came to the edge of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, and carried from there silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid {it}; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried from there {also}, and went and hid {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day {is} a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.

column.name: text
column.value: So they came and called to the porter of the city: and they told him, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, {there was} no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and donkeys tied, and the tents as they {were}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the porters; and they told {it} to the king's house within.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king arose in the night, and said to his servants, I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we {are} hungry; therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of his servants answered and said, Let {some} take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they {are} as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, {I say}, they {are} even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

column.name: text
column.value: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went after them to Jordan: and, lo, all the way {was} full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people went out, and plundered the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was {sold} for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trod upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

column.name: text
column.value: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, {if} the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thy eyes, but shalt not eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And so it happened to him: for the people trod upon him in the gate, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets to Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant feared the LORD: and the creditor hath come to take to my two sons to be his slaves.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said to her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thy handmaid hath not any thing in the house, except a pot of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, {even} empty vessels; borrow not a few.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou hast come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

column.name: text
column.value: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought {the vessels} to her; and she poured out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said to her, {There is} not a vessel more. And the oil stopped {flowing}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children on the rest.

column.name: text
column.value: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where {was} a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And {so} it was, {that} as oft as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this {is} an holy man of God, who passeth by us continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, with walls; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a lampstand: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in there.

column.name: text
column.value: And it fell on a day, that he came there, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Say now to her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what {is} to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among my own people.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What then {is} to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, About this season, next year, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, {thou} man of God, do not lie to thy handmaid.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman conceived, and bore a son at that season that Elisha had said to her, according to the set time.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the child was grown, it happened on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and {then} died.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut {the door} upon him, and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: And she called to her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Why wilt thou go to him to day? {it is} neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, {It shall be} well.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not {thy} riding for me, except I bid thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So she went and came to the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, {yonder is} that Shunammite:

column.name: text
column.value: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say to her, {Is it} well with thee? {is it} well with thy husband? {is it} well with the child? And she answered, {It is} well.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul {is} sorrowful within her: and the LORD hath hid {it} from me, and hath not told me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she said, Did I ask a son from my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thy hand, and go thy way: and if thou shalt meet any man, greet him not; and if any shall greet thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

column.name: text
column.value: And the mother of the child said, {As} the LORD liveth, and {as} thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but {there was} neither voice, nor hearing. Therefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awakened.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, {and} laid upon his bed.

column.name: text
column.value: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them both, and prayed to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child became warm.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she had come in to him, he said, Take up thy son.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and {there was} a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets {were} sitting before him: and he said to his servant, Set on the great pot, and boil pottage for the sons of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered from it wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred {them} into the pot of pottage: for they knew {them} not.

column.name: text
column.value: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O {thou} man of God, {there is} death in the pot. And they could not eat {of it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast {it} into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of grain in its husk. And he said, Give to the people, that they may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servant said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall have {some} left.

column.name: text
column.value: So he set {it} before them, and they ate, and left {some}, according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's {children}, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons {are} with you, and {there are} with you chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armour;

column.name: text
column.value: Choose the best and most fit of your master's sons, and set {him} on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

column.name: text
column.value: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

column.name: text
column.value: And he that {was} over the house, and he that {was} over the city, the elders also, and those who brought up {the children}, sent to Jehu, saying, We {are} thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou {that which is} good in thy eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye {are} mine, and {if} ye will hearken to my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, {being} seventy persons, {were} with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent {them} to him to Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye {are} righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

column.name: text
column.value: Know now that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spoke concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done {that} which he spoke by his servant Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsmen, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. {And} as he {was} at the shearing house in the way,

column.name: text
column.value: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who {are} ye? And they answered, We {are} the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, {even} two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had departed from there, he came upon Jehonadab the son of Rechab {coming} to meet him: and he greeted him, and said to him, Is thy heart right, as my heart {is} with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it is, give {me} thy hand. And he gave {him} his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained to Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spoke to Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little; {but} Jehu shall serve him much.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be missing: for I have a great sacrifice {to do} to Baal; whoever shall be missing, he shall not live. But Jehu did {it} deceitfully, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him that {was} over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said to the worshippers of Baal, Search, and see that there are here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed eighty men without, and said, {If} any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, {he that letteth him go}, his life {shall be} for the life of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, {and} slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast {them} out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they broke down the image of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a place of refuse to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet {from} the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, {that is}, the golden calves that {were} in Bethel, and that {were} in Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing {that which is} right in my eyes, {and} hast done to the house of Ahab according to all that {was} in my heart, thy children of the fourth {generation} shall sit on the throne of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the LORD began to cut off parts of Israel: and Hazael smote them in all the land of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which {is} by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria {was} twenty and eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons {who were} slain; and they hid him, {even} him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah reigned over the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and took the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and showed them the king's son.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded them, saying, This {is} the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;

column.name: text
column.value: And a third part {shall be} at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

column.name: text
column.value: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall surround the king on all sides, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranks, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

column.name: text
column.value: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all {things} that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the captains over hundreds the priest gave king David's spears and shields, that {were} in the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, around the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, {along} by the altar and the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and {gave him} the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard {and} of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner {was}, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah tore her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said to them, Have her forth beyond the ranks: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD'S people; between the king also and the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and broke it down; his altars and his images they broke wholly in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword {beside} the king's house.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven years old {was} Jehoash when he began to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Zibiah of Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD, {even} the money of every one that passeth {the account}, the money of every man's assessment, {and} all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the priests take {it} to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wherever any breach shall be found.

column.name: text
column.value: But it was {so, that} in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the {other} priests, and said to them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no {more} money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests consented to receive no {more} money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put in it all the money {that was} brought into the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was {so}, when they saw that {there was} much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and counted the money that was found in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave the money, being counted, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they paid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money {that was} brought into the house of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired with it the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

column.name: text
column.value: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests'.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold {that was} found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD, and in the king's house, and sent {it} to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

column.name: text
column.value: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, {and reigned} seventeen years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin; he departed not from it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all {their} days.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened to him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

column.name: text
column.value: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as in times past.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, {but} walked in them: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, {and he reigned} sixteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: {but} he walked in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Elisha had fallen sick of his disease of which he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and its horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha said to him, Take bow and arrows. And he took to him bow and arrows.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thy hand upon the bow. And he put his hand {upon it}: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened {it}. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD'S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou hast consumed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took {them}. And he said to the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote three times, and stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: And the man of God was angry with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed {it}: though now thou shalt smite Syria {but} three times.

column.name: text
column.value: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band {of men}; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood on his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and had respect to them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither did he cast them from his presence as yet.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again from the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken from the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times Joash smote him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not taken away: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants who had slain the king his father.

column.name: text
column.value: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, in which the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

column.name: text
column.value: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that {was} in Lebanon sent to the cedar that {was} in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son for a wife: and there passed by a wild beast that {was} in Lebanon, and trod down the thistle.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thy heart hath lifted thee up: glory {of this}, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to {thy} harm, that thou shouldest fall, {even} thou, and Judah with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which {belongeth} to Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah was smitten by Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Bethshemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasuries of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who {was} sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

column.name: text
column.value: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, {and reigned} forty and one years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: He restored the land of Israel from the entering of Hamath to the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spoke by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, who {was} of Gathhepher.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, {that it was} very bitter: for {there was} not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, {which belonged} to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, {even} with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

column.name: text
column.value: Except that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and dwelt in a separate house. And Jotham the king's son {was} over the house, judging the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they {are} written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: This {was} the word of the LORD which he spoke to Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth {generation}. And so it came to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they {are} written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that {were} there, and its land from Tirzah: because they opened not {to him}, therefore he smote {it; and} all the women there that were with child he ripped up.

column.name: text
column.value: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, {and reigned} ten years in Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, {even} of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
