column.value: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, {and reigned} two years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they {are} written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, {and reigned} twenty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they {are} written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard {it}, that he tore his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent Eliakim, who {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day {is} a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children have come to the birth, and {there is} not strength to bring forth.

column.name: text
column.value: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: therefore lift up {thy} prayer for the remnant that are left.

column.name: text
column.value: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said to them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Cush, Behold, he hath come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

column.name: text
column.value: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; {as} Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden who {were} in Thelasar?

column.name: text
column.value: Where {is} the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, who dwellest {between} the cherubim, thou art the God, {even} thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, bow down thy ear, and hear: open, LORD, thy eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent him to reproach the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they {were} no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou {art} the LORD God, {even} thou only.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, {That} which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, {and} mocked thee; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted {thy} voice, and lifted up thy eyes on high? {even} against the Holy {One} of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down its tall cedar trees, {and} its choice fir trees: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, {and into} the forest of his Carmel.

column.name: text
column.value: I have dug and drank strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

column.name: text
column.value: Hast thou not heard long ago {how} I have done it, {and} of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fortified cities {in} ruinous heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were {as} the grass of the field, and {as} the green herb, {as} the grass on the housetops, and {as grain} blighted before it is grown up.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} a sign to thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant that hath escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape from mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD {of hosts } shall do this.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

column.name: text
column.value: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will defend this city, to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred and eighty and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they {were} all dead bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days was Hezekiah sick {and near} death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thy house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done {that which is} good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept grievously.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, before Isaiah had gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Return, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will add to thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid {it} on the boil, and he recovered.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What {shall be} the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah the prophet cried to the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down on the dial of Ahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah hearkened to them, and showed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and {all} the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasuries: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Isaiah the prophet to king Hezekiah, and said to him, What said these men? and from where came they to thee? And Hezekiah said, They have come from a far country, {even} from Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All {the things} that {are} in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, that all that {is} in thy house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store to this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good {is} the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, {Is it} not {good}, if peace and truth shall be in my days?

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

column.name: text
column.value: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him tribute.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no tribute to the king of Assyria, as {he had done} year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

column.name: text
column.value: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor {by} the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

column.name: text
column.value: For {so} it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

column.name: text
column.value: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel did secretly things that {were} not right against the LORD their God, and they built for themselves high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set up for themselves images and groves on every high hill, and under every green tree:

column.name: text
column.value: And there they burnt incense on all the high places, as {did} the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

column.name: text
column.value: For they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, Ye shall not do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, {and by} all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments {and} my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: However they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that {were} around them, {concerning} whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made for themselves molten images, {even} two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: For he tore Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drove Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

column.name: text
column.value: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria brought {men} from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed {them} in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in its cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, {that} they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew {some} of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Take there one of the priests whom ye brought from there; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet every nation made gods of their own, and put {them} in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they dwelt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

column.name: text
column.value: So they feared the LORD, and made to themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

column.name: text
column.value: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from there.

column.name: text
column.value: To this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

column.name: text
column.value: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Twenty years old {was} Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

column.name: text
column.value: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and have dwelt there to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I {am} thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me from the hand of the king of Syria, and from the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasuries of the king's house, and sent {it for} a present to the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria hearkened to him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried {the people of} it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that {was} at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made {it} before king Ahaz came from Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought also the brasen altar, which {was} before the LORD, from the front of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire {by}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that {were} under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And the covered place for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entrance outside, he took from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, {that} Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.

column.name: text
column.value: He removed the high places, and broke the images, and cut down the groves, and broke in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for till those days the children of Israel burnt incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

column.name: text
column.value: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor {any} that were before him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he clung to the LORD, {and} departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was with him; {and} he prospered wherever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

column.name: text
column.value: He smote the Philistines, {even} to Gaza, and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which {was} the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, {that} Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the end of three years they took it: {even} in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that {is} the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria carried away Israel to Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor {by} the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, {and} all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear {them}, nor do {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and took them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; withdraw from me: that which thou puttest on me I will bear. And the king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah gave {him} all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasuries of the king's house.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time did Hezekiah cut off {the gold from} the doors of the temple of the LORD, and {from} the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great army against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which {is} in the highway of the fuller's field.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rabshakeh said to them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence {is} this in which thou trustest?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou sayest, (but {they are but} vain words,) {I have} counsel and strength for the war. Now in whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

column.name: text
column.value: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, {even} upon Egypt, on which if a man leaneth, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so {is} Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust on him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: {is} not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou shalt be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

column.name: text
column.value: Have I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, to Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand {it}: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that {are} on the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: But Rabshakeh said to them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? {hath he} not {sent me} to the men who sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own urine with you?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spoke, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make {an agreement} with me by a present, and come out to me, and {then} eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

column.name: text
column.value: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not to Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

column.name: text
column.value: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

column.name: text
column.value: Where {are} the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where {are} the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Who {are} they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with {their} clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

column.name: text
column.value: Manasseh {was} twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Hephzibah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with mediums and wizards: he committed much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke {him} to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

column.name: text
column.value: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, {and} hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who {were} before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I {am} bringing {such} evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as {a man} wipeth a dish, wiping {it}, and turning {it} upside down.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have done {that which was} evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; besides his sin which he made Judah to sin, in doing evil in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Amon {was} twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

column.name: text
column.value: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Josiah {was} eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, {that} the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered from the people:

column.name: text
column.value: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which {is} in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,

column.name: text
column.value: To carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

column.name: text
column.value: But there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shaphan the scribe showed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he tore his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great {is} the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter;) and they talked with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon its inhabitants, {even} all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the king of Judah who sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, {concerning} the words which thou hast heard;

column.name: text
column.value: Because thy heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spoke against this place, and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast torn thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard {thee}, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold therefore, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thy eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all {their} heart and all {their} soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people joined in the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them to Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places around Jerusalem; them also that burned incense to Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped {it} small to powder, and cast the powder of it upon the graves of the children of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And he broke down the houses of the sodomites, that {were} by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burnt incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and broke down the high places of the gates that {were} in the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which {were} on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they ate of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he defiled Topheth, which {is} in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entrance of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which {was} in the common lands, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the altars that {were} on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and broke {them} down from there, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the high places that {were} before Jerusalem, which {were} on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

column.name: text
column.value: And he broke in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the altar that {was} at Bethel, {and} the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he broke down, and burned the high place, {and} stamped {it} small to powder, and burned the grove.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Josiah turned himself, he espied the sepulchres that {were} there on the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned {them} upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, What title {is} that which I see? And the men of the city told him, {It is} the sepulchre of the man of God, who came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the houses also of the high places that {were} in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke {the LORD} to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew all the priests of the high places that {were} there upon the altars, and burnt men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover to the LORD your God, as {it is} written in the book of this covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely there was not held such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, {when} this passover was held to the LORD in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the mediums, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And like him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there {any} like him.

column.name: text
column.value: However the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations by which Manasseh had provoked him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoahaz {was} twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaohnechoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and subjected the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the stead of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold from the people of the land, from every one according to his assessment, to give {it} to Pharaohnechoh.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiakim {was} twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came {this} upon Judah, to remove {them} out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

column.name: text
column.value: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt to the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiachin {was} eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name {was} Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants besieged it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, {even} ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, except the poorest sort of the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, {those} carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men of might, {even} seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all {that were} strong {and} apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah {was} twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

column.name: text
column.value: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

column.name: text
column.value: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

column.name: text
column.value: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

column.name: text
column.value: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

column.name: text
column.value: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

column.name: text
column.value: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

column.name: text
column.value: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

column.name: text
column.value: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

column.name: text
column.value: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one {was} Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name {was} Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these {were} the sons of Joktan.

column.name: text
column.value: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

column.name: text
column.value: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

column.name: text
column.value: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

column.name: text
column.value: Abram; the same {is} Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

column.name: text
column.value: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

column.name: text
column.value: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these {are} the sons of Keturah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna {was} Lotan's sister.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, {and} Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before {any} king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city {was} Dinhabah.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Avith.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city {was} Pai; and his wife's name {was} Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

column.name: text
column.value: Hadad died also. And the chiefs of Edom were; chief Timnah, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

column.name: text
column.value: Chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These {are} the chiefs of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

column.name: text
column.value: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: {these} three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah {were} five.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons also of Hezron, that were born to him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

column.name: text
column.value: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

column.name: text
column.value: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose sisters {were} Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abigail bore Amasa: and the father of Amasa {was} Jether the Ishmaelite.

column.name: text
column.value: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat {children} of Azubah {his} wife, and of Jerioth: her sons {are} these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took to him Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he {was} sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

column.name: text
column.value: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and its towns, {even} sixty cities. All these {belonged to} the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bore him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, {and} Ahijah.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name {was} Atarah; she {was} the mother of Onam.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the wife of Abishur {was} Abihail, and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name {was} Jarha.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant for a wife; and she bore him Attai.

column.name: text
column.value: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

column.name: text
column.value: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

column.name: text
column.value: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel {were}, Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son of Shammai {was} Maon: and Maon {was} the father of Bethzur.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

column.name: text
column.value: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber, and Tirhanah.

column.name: text
column.value: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb {was} Achsah.

column.name: text
column.value: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,

column.name: text
column.value: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, {and} half of the Manahethites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, {and} Suchathites. These {are} the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth {day} of the month, {that} Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And the city was besieged to the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the ninth {day} of the {fourth} month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war {fled} by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which {is} by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees {were} against the city on all sides:) and {the king} went the way toward the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: And the army of the Chaldees pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

column.name: text
column.value: So they took the king, and brought him to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they pronounced sentence upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fifth month, on the seventh {day} of the month, which {is} the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, to Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great {man's} house he burnt with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the army of the Chaldees, that {were with} the captain of the guard, broke down the walls of Jerusalem on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the people {that were} left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.

column.name: text
column.value: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land {to be} vinedressers and farmers.

column.name: text
column.value: And the pillars of brass that {were} in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that {was} in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass by which they ministered, they took away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the firepans, and the basins, {and} such things as {were} of gold, {in} gold, and of silver, {in} silver, the captain of the guard took away.

column.name: text
column.value: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was beyond weight.

column.name: text
column.value: The height of the one pillar {was} eighteen cubits, and the capital upon it {was} brass: and the height of the capital three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the capital around, all of brass: and like these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

column.name: text
column.value: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, who were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land {that were} found in the city:

column.name: text
column.value: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Gedaliah swore to them, and to their men, and said to them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth {day} of the month, {that} Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that {were} with him in Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: And changed his prison garments: and he ate his food daily before him all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: And his allowance {was} a daily allowance given him by the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

column.name: text
column.value: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: {These} six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

column.name: text
column.value: And these were born to him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:

column.name: text
column.value: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

column.name: text
column.value: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

column.name: text
column.value: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

column.name: text
column.value: {These were} all the sons of David, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon's son {was} Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Josiah {were}, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Pedaiah {were}, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

column.name: text
column.value: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed, five.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Elioenai {were}, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

column.name: text
column.value: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These {are} the families of the Zorathites.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were of} the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister {was} Hazelelponi:

column.name: text
column.value: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These {are} the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These {were} the sons of Naarah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Helah {were}, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, O that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my land, and that thy hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep {me} from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

column.name: text
column.value: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, who {was} the father of Eshton.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These {are} the men of Rechah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

column.name: text
column.value: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ezra {were}, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bore Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

column.name: text
column.value: And his wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these {are} the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of {his} wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

column.name: text
