column.value: And the sons of Shimon {were}, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi {were}, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah {were}, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And {these are} ancient records.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Simeon {were}, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, {and} Shaul:

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like the children of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These {were} their cities to the reign of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And their villages {were}, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

column.name: text
column.value: And all their villages that {were} around the same cities, to Baal. These {were} their habitations, and their genealogy.

column.name: text
column.value: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

column.name: text
column.value: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

column.name: text
column.value: These mentioned by {their} names {were} princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, {even} to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found rich pasture and good, and the land {was} wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for {they} of Ham had dwelt there of old.

column.name: text
column.value: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly to this day, and dwelt in their stead: because {there was} pasture there for their flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of them, {even} of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

column.name: text
column.value: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that had escaped, and have dwelt there to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he {was} the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

column.name: text
column.value: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him {came} the chief ruler; but the birthright {was} Joseph's:)

column.name: text
column.value: The sons, {I say}, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel {were}, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away {captive}: he {was} prince of the Reubenites.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, {were} the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baalmeon:

column.name: text
column.value: And eastward he inhabited to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east {land} of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Gad dwelt opposite them, in the land of Bashan to Salcah:

column.name: text
column.value: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren of the house of their fathers {were}, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

column.name: text
column.value: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the common lands of Sharon, upon their borders.

column.name: text
column.value: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear shield and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, {were} four and forty thousand seven hundred and sixty, that went out to the war.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that {were} with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated by them; because they put their trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: For there fell down many slain, because the war {was} of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baalhermon and Senir, and to mount Hermon.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, {and} heads of the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and played the harlot with the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the sons of Issachar {were}, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, {that is}, of Tola: {they were} valiant men of might in their generations; whose number {was} in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

column.name: text
column.value: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, {were} bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand {men}: for they had many wives and sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar {were} valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies eighty and seven thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: {The sons} of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of {their} fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these {are} the sons of Becher.

column.name: text
column.value: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, {was} twenty thousand and two hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

column.name: text
column.value: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, {were} seventeen thousand and two hundred {soldiers}, fit to go out for war {and} battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, {and} Hushim, the sons of Aher.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bore: ({but} his Syrian concubine bore Machir the father of Gilead:

column.name: text
column.value: And Machir took for a wife {the sister} of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name {was} Maachah;) and the name of the second {was} Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And Maachah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother {was} Sheresh; and his sons {were} Ulam and Rakem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These {were} the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sister Hammoleketh bore Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath {that were} born in {that} land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

column.name: text
column.value: (And his daughter {was} Sherah, who built Bethhoron the lower, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)

column.name: text
column.value: And Rephah {was} his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And their possessions and habitations {were}, Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with its towns, Shechem also and its towns, to Gaza and its towns:

column.name: text
column.value: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who {is} the father of Birzavith.

column.name: text
column.value: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These {are} the children of Japhlet.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

column.name: text
column.value: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {were} the children of Asher, heads of {their} father's house, choice {and} mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were fit for war {and} for battle {was} twenty and six thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

column.name: text
column.value: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

column.name: text
column.value: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:

column.name: text
column.value: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he carried them captive, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shaharaim begat {children} in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara {were} his wives.

column.name: text
column.value: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These {were} his sons, heads of the father's {houses}.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with its towns:

column.name: text
column.value: Beriah also, and Shema, who {were} heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

column.name: text
column.value: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

column.name: text
column.value: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

column.name: text
column.value: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

column.name: text
column.value: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

column.name: text
column.value: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

column.name: text
column.value: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

column.name: text
column.value: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

column.name: text
column.value: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} heads of the father's {houses}, by their generations, chief {men}. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name {was} Maachah:

column.name: text
column.value: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

column.name: text
column.value: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, opposite them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son of Jonathan {was} Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Micah {were}, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

column.name: text
column.value: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha {was} his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

column.name: text
column.value: And Azel had six sons, whose names {are} these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these {were} the sons of Azel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Eshek his brother {were}, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these {are} of the sons of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

column.name: text
column.value: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

column.name: text
column.value: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

column.name: text
column.value: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

column.name: text
column.value: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he {it is} that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

column.name: text
column.value: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehozadak went {into captivity}, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Kohath {were}, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these {are} the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are they} whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and {then} they waited on their office according to their order.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, {even} Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren the sons of Merari {stood} on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: Their brethren also the Levites {were} appointed to all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, {and were appointed} for all the work of the {place} most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

column.name: text
column.value: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} their dwelling places throughout their castles in their land, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its common lands around it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, {namely}, Hebron, {the city} of refuge, and Libnah with its common lands, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hilen with its common lands, Debir with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ashan with its common lands, and Bethshemesh with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with its common lands, and Alemeth with its common lands, and Anathoth with its common lands. All their cities throughout their families {were} thirteen cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the sons of Kohath, {who were} left of the family of that tribe, {were cities given} out of the half tribe, {namely, out of} the half {tribe} of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families {were given} out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Merari {were given} by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites {these} cities with their common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by {their} names.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their land out of the tribe of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave to them, {of} the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with its common lands; {they gave} also Gezer with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Jokmeam with its common lands, and Bethhoron with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Aijalon with its common lands, and Gathrimmon with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with its common lands, and Bileam with its common lands, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

column.name: text
column.value: To the sons of Gershom {were given} out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its common lands, and Ashtaroth with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with its common lands, Daberath with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ramoth with its common lands, and Anem with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with its common lands, and Abdon with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Hukok with its common lands, and Rehob with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with its common lands, and Hammon with its common lands, and Kirjathaim with its common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: To the rest of the children of Merari {were given} out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with its common lands, Tabor with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And on the other side of Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, {were given them} out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with its common lands, and Jahzah with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: Kedemoth also with its common lands, and Mephaath with its common lands:

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with its common lands, and Mahanaim with its common lands,

column.name: text
column.value: And Heshbon with its common lands, and Jazer with its common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the battle prevailed against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded by the archers.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through with it; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was greatly afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

column.name: text
column.value: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the men of Israel that {were} in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent {messengers} around into the land of the Philistines, to carry tidings to their idols, and to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

column.name: text
column.value: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, {even} against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking {counsel} of a medium, to enquire {of it};

column.name: text
column.value: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, Behold, we {are} thy bone and thy flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou {wast} he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which {is} Jebus; where the Jebusites {were}, the inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come here. Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion, which {is} the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said, Whoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was chief.

column.name: text
column.value: And David dwelt in the strong hold; therefore they called it the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built the city all around, even from Millo all around: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: So David became greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts {was} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: These also {are} the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, {and} with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted his spear against three hundred slain {by him} at one time.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him {was} Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who {was one} of the three mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set themselves in the midst of {that} parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved {them} by a great deliverance.

column.name: text
column.value: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And David {was} then in the strong hold, and the Philistines' garrison {was} then at Bethlehem.

column.name: text
column.value: And David longed, and said, O that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that {is} at the gate!

column.name: text
column.value: And the three broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that {was} by the gate, and took {it}, and brought {it} to David: but David would not drink {of} it, but poured it out to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with {the jeopardy of} their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting his spear against three hundred, he slew {them}, and had a name among the three.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: but he attained not to the {first} three.

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many deeds; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

column.name: text
column.value: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of {great} stature, five cubits tall; and in the Egyptian's hand {was} a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

column.name: text
column.value: These {things} did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the {first} three: and David set him over his guard.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the valiant men of the armies {were}, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

column.name: text
column.value: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,

column.name: text
column.value: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

column.name: text
column.value: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, {that pertained} to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

column.name: text
column.value: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

column.name: text
column.value: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

column.name: text
column.value: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

column.name: text
column.value: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

column.name: text
column.value: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

column.name: text
column.value: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

column.name: text
column.value: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

column.name: text
column.value: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

column.name: text
column.value: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

column.name: text
column.value: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

column.name: text
column.value: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they {were} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, {who} were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first inhabitants that {dwelt} in their possessions in their cities {were}, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

column.name: text
column.value: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

column.name: text
column.value: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men {were} heads of the father's {houses} in the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

column.name: text
column.value: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

column.name: text
column.value: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

column.name: text
column.value: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

column.name: text
column.value: And the porters {were}, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum {was} the chief;

column.name: text
column.value: Who until then {waited} in the king's gate eastward: they {were} porters in the camp of the children of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, {were} over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, {being} over the host of the LORD, {were} keepers of the entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, {and} the LORD {was} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah {was} porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {who were} chosen to be porters in the gates {were} two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their charge.

column.name: text
column.value: So they and their children {had} the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, {namely}, the house of the tabernacle, by watch.

column.name: text
column.value: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren, {who were} in their villages, {were} to come after seven days from time to time with them.

column.name: text
column.value: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in charge of the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they lodged about the house of God, because the charge {was} upon them, and the opening of it every morning {pertained} to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And {certain} of them had the charge of the vessels of service, that they should bring them in and out by number.

column.name: text
column.value: {Some} of them also {were} appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mattithiah, {one} of the Levites, who {was} the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

column.name: text
column.value: And {others} of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, {were} over the showbread, to prepare {it} every sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the singers, heads of the fathers of the Levites, {who remaining} in the chambers {were} free: for they were employed in {that} work day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: These chief fathers of the Levites {were} leaders throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name {was} Maachah:

column.name: text
column.value: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

column.name: text
column.value: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, opposite their brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son of Jonathan {was} Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Micah {were}, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, {and Ahaz}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

column.name: text
column.value: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Azel had six sons, whose names {are} these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these {were} the sons of Azel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, {and} with every leader.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to all the congregation of Israel, If {it seemeth} good to you, and {that it is} of the LORD our God, let us send abroad to our brethren every where, {that are} left in all the land of Israel, and with them {also} to the priests and Levites {who are} in their cities {and} common lands, that they may assemble to us:

column.name: text
column.value: And let us bring again to us the ark of our God: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even to the entrance of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, {that is}, to Kirjathjearim, which {belonged} to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth {between} the cherubim, whose name is called {on it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

column.name: text
column.value: And David and all Israel played before God with all {their} might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

column.name: text
column.value: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

column.name: text
column.value: And David was displeased, because the LORD had broken forth upon Uzza: therefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God {home} to me?

column.name: text
column.value: So David brought not the ark to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} they that came to David to Ziklag, while he could not move about freely because of Saul the son of Kish: and they {were} among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

column.name: text
column.value: {They were} armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in {hurling} stones and {shooting} arrows from a bow, {even} of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief {was} Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

column.name: text
column.value: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

column.name: text
column.value: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

column.name: text
column.value: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Gadites there separated themselves to David in the strong hold in the wilderness men of might, {and} men of war {fit} for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces {were like} the faces of lions, and {were} as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

column.name: text
column.value: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

column.name: text
column.value: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

column.name: text
column.value: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

column.name: text
column.value: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least {was} over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all {them} of the valleys, {both} toward the east, and toward the west.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the strong hold to David.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If ye have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit to you: but if {ye have come} to betray me to my enemies, seeing {there is} no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers look {on it}, and rebuke {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, {who was} chief of the captains, {and he said}, Thine {are we}, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace {be} to thee, and peace {be} to thy helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

column.name: text
column.value: And there fell {some} of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to {the jeopardy of} our heads.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that {were} of Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And they helped David against the band {of the rovers}: for they {were} all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

column.name: text
column.value: For at {that} time day by day there came to David to help him, until {it was} a great host, like the host of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the numbers of the bands {that were} ready armed to the war, {and} came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Judah that bore shield and spear {were} six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed for war.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for war, seven thousand and one hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiada {was} the leader of the Aaronites, and with him {were} three thousand and seven hundred;

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for to this time the greatest part of them had kept the guard of the house of Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of Issachar, {who were men} that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them {were} two hundred; and all their brethren {were} at their command.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, who could keep rank: {they were} not of double heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel {were} of one heart to make David king.

column.name: text
column.value: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had made preparation for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover they that were near them, {even} to Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, {and} provisions, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for {there was} joy in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

column.name: text
column.value: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was exalted on high, because of his people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the names of {his} children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

column.name: text
column.value: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

column.name: text
column.value: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard {of it}, and went out against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into my hand? And the LORD said to him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said to him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then thou shalt go out to battle: for God hath gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And {David} built houses for himself in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister to him for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place, which he had prepared for it.

column.name: text
column.value: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren eighty:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Ye {are} the heads of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, {both} ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to {the place that} I have prepared for it.

column.name: text
column.value: For because ye {did it} not at the first, the LORD our God broke forth upon us, for that we sought him not after the proper way.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staffs on it, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brethren {to be} the singers with instruments of music, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

column.name: text
column.value: And with them their brethren of the second {degree}, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.

column.name: text
column.value: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, {were appointed} to sound with cymbals of brass;

column.name: text
column.value: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

column.name: text
column.value: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to lead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Chenaniah, leader of the Levites, {was} for song: he instructed about the song, because he {was} skilful.

column.name: text
column.value: And Berechiah and Elkanah {were} doorkeepers for the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah {were} doorkeepers for the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obededom with joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bulls and seven rams.

column.name: text
column.value: And David {was} clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also {had} upon him an ephod of linen.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {as} the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: So they brought the ark of God, and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon {of wine}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he appointed {certain} of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then on that day David delivered first {this psalm} to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to him, sing psalms to him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

column.name: text
column.value: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

column.name: text
column.value: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

column.name: text
column.value: He {is} the LORD our God; his judgments {are} in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word {which} he commanded to a thousand generations;

column.name: text
column.value: {Even of the covenant} which he made with Abraham, and of his oath to Isaac;

column.name: text
column.value: And which he confirmed to Jacob for a law, {and} to Israel {for} an everlasting covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, To thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

column.name: text
column.value: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} they went from nation to nation, and from {one} kingdom to another people;

column.name: text
column.value: He permitted no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

column.name: text
column.value: {Saying}, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, all the earth; show forth from day to day his salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: For great {is} the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also {is} to be feared above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the gods of the people {are} idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Glory and honour {are} in his presence; strength and gladness {are} in his place.

column.name: text
column.value: Give to the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give to the LORD glory and strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Give to the LORD the glory {due} to his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let {men} say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the sea roar, and all it containeth: let the fields rejoice, and all that {is} in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the trees of the wood sing at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: O give thanks to the LORD; for {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, {and} glory in thy praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

column.name: text
column.value: And Obededom with their brethren, sixty and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah {to be} porters:

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that {was} at Gibeon,

column.name: text
column.value: To offer burnt offerings to the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and {to do} according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy {endureth} for ever;

column.name: text
column.value: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun {were} porters.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said, I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters to thee? are not his servants come to thee to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there went {certain}, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards are grown, and {then} return.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.

column.name: text
column.value: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and encamped before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And when David heard {of it}, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that had come {were} by themselves in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose from all the best of Israel, and put {them} in array against the Syrians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the people he delivered to the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set {themselves} in array against the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, If the Syrians shall be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon shall be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do {that which is} good in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joab and the people that {were} with him drew near before the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that {were} beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer {went} before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set {the battle} in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand {men who fought in} chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were smote before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, {and} brought tribute.

column.name: text
column.value: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also hamstrung all the chariot {horses}, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David put {garrisons} in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, {and} brought tribute. Thus the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

column.name: text
column.value: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, David brought very much brass, with which Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

column.name: text
column.value: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had warred with Tou;) and {with him} all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

column.name: text
column.value: Them also king David dedicated to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all {these} nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

column.name: text
column.value: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab the son of Zeruiah {was} over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, {were} the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

column.name: text
column.value: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada {was} over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David {were} chief about the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that after the year had ended, at the time that kings go out {to battle}, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

column.name: text
column.value: And David took the crown of their king from his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and {there were} precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also a great quantity of spoil out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought out the people that {were} in it, and cut {them} with saws, and with instruments of iron, and with axes. Even so David dealt with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, {that was} of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear's shaft {was} like a weaver's beam.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of {great} stature, whose fingers and toes {were} four and twenty, six {on each hand}, and six {on each foot}: and he also was the son of the giant.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD {remaineth} under curtains.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nathan said to David, Do all that {is} in thy heart; for God {is} with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

column.name: text
column.value: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from {one} tabernacle {to another}.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever I have walked with all Israel, have I spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore thus shalt thou say to my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepfold, {even} from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And I have been with thee wherever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thy enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that {are} in the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

column.name: text
column.value: And since the time that I commanded judges {to be} over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thy enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when thy days shall be ended that thou must go {to be} with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, who shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall build me an house, and I will establish his throne for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took {it} from {him} that was before thee:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak to David.

column.name: text
column.value: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who {am} I, O LORD God, and what {is} my house, that thou hast brought me thus far?

column.name: text
column.value: And {yet} this was a small thing in thy eyes, O God; for thou hast {also} spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

column.name: text
column.value: What can David {speak} more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thy own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all {these} great things.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, {there is} none like thee, neither {is there any} God besides thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

column.name: text
column.value: And what one nation in the earth {is} like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem {to be} his own people, to make thee a name by great and terrible things, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

column.name: text
column.value: For thy people Israel didst thou make thy own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

column.name: text
column.value: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts {is} the God of Israel, {even} a God to Israel: and {let} the house of David thy servant {be} established before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found {in his heart} to pray before thee.
