column.name: text
column.value: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness to thy servant:

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and {it shall be} blessed for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Satan stood up against Israel, and tempted David to number Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times more than they {are}: but, my lord the king, {are} they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people to David. And all {they of} Israel were a million and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah {was} four hundred and seventy thousand men that drew sword.

column.name: text
column.value: But Levi and Benjamin he counted not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

column.name: text
column.value: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Gad, David's seer, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three {things}: choose thee one of them, that I may do {it} to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So Gad came to David, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee

column.name: text
column.value: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while the sword of thy enemies overtaketh {thee}; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the land of Israel. Now therefore consider thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great {are} his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thy hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders {of Israel, who were} clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to God, {Is it} not I {that} commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but {as for} these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and build an altar to the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

column.name: text
column.value: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with {his} face to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of {this} threshingfloor, that I may build an altar in it to the LORD: thou shalt grant it to me for the full price: that the plague may be restrained from the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ornan said to David, Take {it} to thee, and let my lord the king do {that which is} good in his eyes: lo, I give {thee} the oxen {also} for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

column.name: text
column.value: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take {that} which {is} thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

column.name: text
column.value: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

column.name: text
column.value: And David built there an altar to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into its sheath.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

column.name: text
column.value: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, {were} at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

column.name: text
column.value: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David said, This {is} the house of the LORD God, and this {is} the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David commanded to gather the strangers that {were} in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance beyond weight;

column.name: text
column.value: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said, Solomon my son {is} young and tender, and the house {that is} to be built for the LORD {must be} very magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will {therefore} now make preparation for it. So David made abundant preparation before his death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house to the name of the LORD my God:

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house to my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I {will be} his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou shalt take heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a million talents of silver; and of brass and iron beyond weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover {there are} workmen with thee in great numbers, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of skilful men for every manner of work.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, {there is} no number. Arise {therefore}, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, {saying},

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not the LORD your God with you? and hath he {not} given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Of which, twenty and four thousand {were} to oversee the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand {were} officers and judges:

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover four thousand {were} porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, {said David}, to praise {with them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And David divided them into divisions among the sons of Levi, {namely}, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Gershonites {were}, Laadan, and Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Laadan; the chief {was} Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These {were} the heads of the father's {houses} of Laadan.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Shimei {were}, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four {were} the sons of Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to {their} father's house.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {concerning} Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Moses {were}, Gershom, and Eliezer.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel {was} the chief.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Eliezer {were}, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had no other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

column.name: text
column.value: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; {even} the heads of the father's {houses}, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.

column.name: text
column.value: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest to his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: And also to the Levites; they shall no {more} carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for its service.

column.name: text
column.value: For by the last words of David the Levites {were} numbered from twenty years old and above:

column.name: text
column.value: Because their office {was} to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for {that which is baked in} the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all measures of volume and size;

column.name: text
column.value: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at evening;

column.name: text
column.value: And to offer all burnt sacrifices to the LORD on the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded to them, continually before the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy {place}, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {these are} the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

column.name: text
column.value: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and {thus} were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar {there were} sixteen chief men of the house of {their} fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors {of the house} of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, {one} of the Levites, recorded them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and {before} the heads of the father's {houses} of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and {one} taken for Ithamar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

column.name: text
column.value: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

column.name: text
column.value: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

column.name: text
column.value: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

column.name: text
column.value: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

column.name: text
column.value: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

column.name: text
column.value: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

column.name: text
column.value: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

column.name: text
column.value: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their custom, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the sons of Levi {were these}: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first {was} Isshiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons {of Hebron}; Jeriah {the first}, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

column.name: text
column.value: The brother of Michah {was} Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari {were} Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Mahli {came} Eleazar, who had no sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish {was} Jerahmeel.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These {were} the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the father's {houses} of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers even as their younger brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, {and} Mahazioth:

column.name: text
column.value: All these {were} the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {were} under the hands of their father to sing {in} the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

column.name: text
column.value: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, {even} all that were skilful, was two hundred and eighty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cast lots, for their duties, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The third to Zaccur, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth to Izri, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth to Nethaniah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth to Bukkiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh to Jesharelah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The eighth to Jeshaiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The ninth to Mattaniah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The tenth to Shimei, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The eleventh to Azareel, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The twelfth to Hashabiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The thirteenth to Shubael, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The sixteenth to Hananiah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The eighteenth to Hanani, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The nineteenth to Mallothi, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The twentieth to Eliathah, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The one and twentieth to Hothir, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve:

column.name: text
column.value: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, {he}, his sons, and his brethren, {were} twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites {was} Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of Meshelemiah {were}, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

column.name: text
column.value: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the sons of Obededom {were}, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

column.name: text
column.value: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they {were} mighty men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren {were} strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

column.name: text
column.value: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, {were} sixty and two of Obededom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for {though} he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

column.name: text
column.value: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah {were} thirteen.

column.name: text
column.value: Among these {were} the divisions of the porters, {even} among the chief men, {having} duties like one another, to minister in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

column.name: text
column.value: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

column.name: text
column.value: To Shuppim and Hosah {the lot came forth} westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the way of the ascent, watch against watch.

column.name: text
column.value: Eastward {were} six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two {and} two.

column.name: text
column.value: At Parbar westward, four at the highway, {and} two at Parbar.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Levites, Ahijah {was} over the treasuries of the house of God, and over the treasuries of the dedicated things.

column.name: text
column.value: {As concerning} the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, {even} of Laadan the Gershonite, {were} Jehieli.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, {who were} over the treasuries of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Amramites, {and} the Izharites, the Hebronites, {and} the Uzzielites:

column.name: text
column.value: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, {was} ruler of the treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

column.name: text
column.value: Which Shelomith and his brethren {were} over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; {and} whoever had dedicated {any thing, it was} under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons {were} for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, {were} officers among them of Israel on this side of Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Among the Hebronites {was} Jerijah the chief, {even} among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren, men of valour, {were} two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the children of Israel after their number, {that is}, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Over the first course for the first month {was} Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Perez {was} the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: And over the course of the second month {was} Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course {was} Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The third captain of the host for the third month {was} Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is that} Benaiah, {who was} mighty {among} the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course {was} Ammizabad his son.

column.name: text
column.value: The fourth {captain} for the fourth month {was} Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth captain for the fifth month {was} Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The sixth {captain} for the sixth month {was} Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The seventh {captain} for the seventh month {was} Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The eighth {captain} for the eighth month {was} Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The ninth {captain} for the ninth month {was} Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The tenth {captain} for the tenth month {was} Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The eleventh {captain} for the eleventh month {was} Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: The twelfth {captain} for the twelfth month {was} Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course {were} twenty and four thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites {was} Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Judah, Elihu, {one} of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

column.name: text
column.value: Of the half {tribe} of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

column.name: text
column.value: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These {were} the princes of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

column.name: text
column.value: And over the king's treasuries {was} Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, {was} Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

column.name: text
column.value: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground {was} Ezri the son of Chelub:

column.name: text
column.value: And over the vineyards {was} Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars {was} Zabdi the Shiphmite:

column.name: text
column.value: And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that {were} in the low plains {was} Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil {was} Joash:

column.name: text
column.value: And over the herds that fed in Sharon {was} Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds {that were} in the valleys {was} Shaphat the son of Adlai:

column.name: text
column.value: Over the camels also {was} Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the donkeys {was} Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

column.name: text
column.value: And over the flocks {was} Jaziz the Hagerite. All these {were} the rulers of the substance which {was} king David's.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni {was} with the king's sons:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahithophel {was} the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite {was} the king's companion:

column.name: text
column.value: And after Ahithophel {was} Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army {was} Joab.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God {was} with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the heads of the father's {houses}.

column.name: text
column.value: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that {was} at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: But the ark of God David had brought up from Kirjathjearim to {the place which} David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought for it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon went up there to the brasen altar before the LORD, which {was} at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: In that night God appeared to Solomon, and said to him, Ask what I shall give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon said to God, Thou hast shown great mercy to David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise to David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy great people?

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thy heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thy enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom and knowledge {are} granted to thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that {have been} before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon came {from his journey} to the high place that {was} at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem {as plenteous} as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycamore trees that {are} in the vale for abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

column.name: text
column.value: And they fetched up, and brought out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred {shekels} of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so they brought out {horses} for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon numbered out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell in, {even so deal with me}.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate {it} to him, {and} to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual showbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This {is an ordinance} for ever to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house which I build {is} great: for great {is} our God above all gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who {am} I then, that I should build him an house, except only to burn sacrifice before him?

column.name: text
column.value: Send me now therefore a man skilful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that hath skill to engrave with the skilful men that {are} with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

column.name: text
column.value: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants have skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants {shall be} with thy servants,

column.name: text
column.value: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build {shall be} great and wonderful.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Huram said moreover, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that may build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I have sent a skilful man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father {was} a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to engrave any manner of engraving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy skilful men, and with the skilful men of my lord David thy father.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send to his servants:

column.name: text
column.value: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou mayest convey it to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that {were} in the land of Israel, after the numbering which David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set seventy thousand of them {to be} bearers of burdens, and eighty thousand {to be} hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people to work.

column.name: text
column.value: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David the king stood upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: {As for me}, I {had} in my heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou {hast been} a man of war, and hast shed blood.

column.name: text
column.value: However the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah {to be} the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make {me} king over all Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him {to be} my son, and I will be his father.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he shall be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave {it} for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou shalt seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou shalt forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses of it, and of its treasuries, and of its upper chambers, and of its inner parlours and of the place of the mercy seat,

column.name: text
column.value: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the surrounding chambers, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

column.name: text
column.value: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {He gave} of gold by weight for {things} of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; {silver also} for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

column.name: text
column.value: Even the weight for the lampstands of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every lampstand, and for its lamps: and for the lampstands of silver by weight, {both} for the lampstand, and {also} for its lamps, according to the use of every lampstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And by weight {he gave} gold for the tables of showbread, for every table; and {likewise} silver for the tables of silver:

column.name: text
column.value: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basins {he gave gold} by weight for every basin; and {likewise silver} by weight for every basin of silver:

column.name: text
column.value: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubim, that spread out {their wings}, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All {this, said David}, the LORD made me understand in writing by {his} hand upon me, {even} all the works of this pattern.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do {it}: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, {even} my God, {will be} with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, {even they shall be with thee} for all the service of the house of God: and {there shall be} with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people {will be} wholly at thy command.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore David the king said to all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, {is yet} young and tender, and the work {is} great: for the palace {is} not for man, but for the LORD God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for {things to be made} of gold, and the silver for {things} of silver, and the brass for {things} of brass, the iron for {things} of iron, and wood for {things} of wood; onyx stones, and {stones} to be set, glittering stones, and of various colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of my own possessions, of gold and silver, {which} I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses:

column.name: text
column.value: The gold for {things} of gold, and the silver for {things} of silver, and for all manner of work {to be made} by the hands of craftsmen. And who {then} is willing to consecrate his service this day to the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: Then the heads of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king's work, offered willingly,

column.name: text
column.value: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: And they with whom {precious} stones were found gave {them} to the treasury of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed {be} thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thine, O LORD, {is} the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all {that is} in the heaven and on the earth {is thine}; thine {is} the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.

column.name: text
column.value: Both riches and honour {come} from thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thy hand {is} power and might; and in thy hand {it is} to make great, and to give strength to all.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

column.name: text
column.value: But who {am} I, and what {is} my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things {come} from thee, and of thy own have we given thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For we {are} strangers before thee, and sojourners, as {were} all our fathers: our days on the earth {are} as a shadow, and {there is} no abiding.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD our God, all this abundance that we have prepared to build thee an house for thy holy name {cometh} from thy hand, and {is} all thy own.

column.name: text
column.value: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, who are present here, to offer willingly to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: And give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all {these things}, and to build the palace, {for} which I have made provision.

column.name: text
column.value: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD, and offered burnt offerings to the LORD, on the day following that day, {even} a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, {and} a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed {him} to the LORD {to be} the chief governor, and Zadok {to be} priest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him {such} royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the time that he reigned over Israel {was} forty years; seven years he reigned in Hebron, and thirty and three {years} he reigned in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

column.name: text
column.value: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where {the LORD} appeared to David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began to build in the second {day} of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are the things in which} Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure {was} sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And the porch that {was} in the front {of the house}, the length {of it was} according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height {was} an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the greater house he panelled with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set on it palm trees and chains.

column.name: text
column.value: And he adorned the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold {was} gold of Parvaim.

column.name: text
column.value: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls of it, and the doors of it, with gold; and engraved cherubim on the walls.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the most holy house, the length of which {was} according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth of it twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, {amounting} to six hundred talents.

column.name: text
column.value: And the weight of the nails {was} fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wings of the cherubim {were} twenty cubits long: one wing {of the one cherub was} five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing {was likewise} five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} wing of the other cherub {was} five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing {was} five cubits {also}, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

column.name: text
column.value: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces {were} inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made the veil {of} blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubim on it.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the capital that {was} on the top of each of them {was} five cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made chains, {as} in the inner sanctuary, and put {them} on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put {them} on the chains.

column.name: text
column.value: And he erected the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in {all} the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, he put in the treasuries of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the city of David, which {is} Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king in the feast which {was} in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that {were} in the tabernacle, these did the priests {and} the Levites bring up.

column.name: text
column.value: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled to him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place, to the inner sanctuary of the house, into the most holy {place, even} under the wings of the cherubim:

column.name: text
column.value: For the cherubim spread forth {their} wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staffs of it above.

column.name: text
column.value: And they drew out the staffs {of the ark}, that the ends of the staffs were seen from the ark before the inner sanctuary; but they were not seen without. And there it is to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: {There was} nothing in the ark except the two tables which Moses put {in it} at Horeb, when the LORD made {a covenant} with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy {place}: (for all the priests {that were} present were sanctified, {and} did not {then} wait by course:

column.name: text
column.value: Also the Levites {who were} the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, {being} arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

column.name: text
column.value: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers {were} as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up {their} voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the LORD, {saying}, For {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever: that {then} the house was filled with a cloud, {even} the house of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Blessed {be} the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled {that} which he spoke with his mouth to my father David, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Since the day that I brought forth my people from the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thy heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thy heart:

column.name: text
column.value: However thou shalt not build the house; but thy son who shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am raised up in the stead of David my father, and am seated on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And in it have I put the ark, in which {is} the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

column.name: text
column.value: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O LORD God of Israel, {there is} no God like thee in the heaven, nor on the earth; who keepest covenant, and {showest} mercy to thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and hast spoken with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled {it} with thy hand, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; provided thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken to thy servant David.

column.name: text
column.value: But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

column.name: text
column.value: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken to the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

column.name: text
column.value: That thy eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place of which thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken to the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken therefore to the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, {even} from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man shall sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath shall come before thy altar in this house;

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by punishing the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy people Israel are defeated by the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again to the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; {yet} if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, in which they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: If there shall be famine in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blighting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies shall besiege them in the cities of their land; whatever calamity or whatever sickness {there be}:

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} whatever prayer {or} whatever supplication shall be made by any man, or by all the people of Israel, when every one shall know his own calamity and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render to every man according to all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

column.name: text
column.value: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest to our fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover concerning the stranger, who is not of thy people Israel, but hath come from a distant country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy outstretched arm; if they come and pray in this house;

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from the heavens, {even} from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as {do} thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray to thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

column.name: text
column.value: If they sin against thee, (for {there is} no man who sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before {their} enemies, and they carry them away captives to a land far off or near;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet {if} they take it to their hearts in the land where they are carried captive, and turn and pray to thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

column.name: text
column.value: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest to their fathers, and {toward} the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

column.name: text
column.value: Then hear thou from the heavens, {even} from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people who have sinned against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thy eyes be open, and {let} thy ears {be} attentive to the prayer {that is made} in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thy anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length of it, and twenty cubits the breadth of it, and ten cubits the height of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape, and five cubits the height of it; and a line of thirty cubits around it.

column.name: text
column.value: And under it {was} the similitude of oxen, which surrounded it: ten in a cubit, surrounding the sea. Two rows of oxen {were} cast, when it was cast.

column.name: text
column.value: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea {was set} above upon them, and all their back parts {were} inward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thickness of it {was} an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; {and} it received and held three thousand baths.

column.name: text
column.value: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea {was} for the priests to wash in.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made ten lampstands of gold according to their form, and set {them} in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: He made also ten tables, and placed {them} in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basins of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, toward the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

column.name: text
column.value: {That is}, the two pillars, and the bowls, and the capitals {which were} on the top of the two pillars, and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals which {were} on the top of the pillars;

column.name: text
column.value: And four hundred pomegranates on the two networks; two rows of pomegranates on each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals which {were} upon the pillars.

column.name: text
column.value: He made also bases, and lavers he made upon the bases;

column.name: text
column.value: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

column.name: text
column.value: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.

column.name: text
column.value: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be known.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon made all the vessels that {were for} the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables on which the showbread {was set};

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the lampstands with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

column.name: text
column.value: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, {made he of} gold, {and} that perfect gold;

column.name: text
column.value: And the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers, {of} pure gold: and the entrance of the house, its inner doors for the most holy {place}, and the doors of the house of the temple, {were of} gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Solomon had finished praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, {saying}, For {he is} good; for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests stood at their posts: the Levites also with instruments of music of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy {endureth} for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that {was} before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

column.name: text
column.value: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entrance of Hamath to the river of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shown to David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

column.name: text
column.value: If my people, who are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now my eyes shall be open, and my ears attentive to the prayer {that is made} in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I establish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man {to be} ruler in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it {to be} a proverb and a byword among all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus to this land, and to this house?

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,

column.name: text
column.value: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

column.name: text
column.value: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} all the people {that were} left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who {were} not of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: {But} of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon force to pay tribute until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they {were} men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} the chief of king Solomon's officers, {even} two hundred and fifty, that bore rule over the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh from the city of David to the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because {the places are} holy, where the ark of the LORD hath come.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,

column.name: text
column.value: As the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, {even} in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed not from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared to the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. {So} the house of the LORD was perfected.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Huram sent to him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took from there four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought {them} to king Solomon.

column.name: text
