column.value: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to try Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bore spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him of all that was in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon answered her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

column.name: text
column.value: And the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said to the king, {It was} a true report which I heard in my own land of thy acts, and of thy wisdom:

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I believed not their words, until I came, and my eyes had seen {it}: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told to me: {for} thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Happy {are} thy men, and happy {are} these thy servants, who stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed be the LORD thy God, who delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, {to be} king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore he made thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

column.name: text
column.value: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made {of} the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides {that} which she had brought to the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty and six talents of gold;

column.name: text
column.value: Besides {that which} traders and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon made two hundred shields {of} beaten gold: six hundred {shekels} of beaten gold went to one shield.

column.name: text
column.value: And three hundred shields {made he of} beaten gold: three hundred {shekels} of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, {which were} fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

column.name: text
column.value: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon {were of} gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon {were of} pure gold: none {were of} silver; it was {not} considered as any thing in the days of Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: once every three years came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, armour, and spices, horses, and mules, at a {certain} rate year by year.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees he made as the sycamore trees that {are} in the low plains in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought to Solomon horses from Egypt, and from all lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, {are} they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem had all Israel come to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who {was} in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard {it}, that Jeroboam returned from Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Come again to me after three days. And the people departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye {me} to return answer to this people?

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to him, saying, If thou wilt be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father put upon us?

column.name: text
column.value: And the young men that were brought up with him spoke to him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spoke to thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou {it} somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say to them, My little {finger} shall be thicker than my father's thighs.

column.name: text
column.value: For though my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I {will chastise you} with scorpions.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king appointed, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

column.name: text
column.value: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it: my father chastised you with whips, but I {will chastise you} with scorpions.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king hearkened not to the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all Israel {saw } that the king would not hearken to them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and {we have} no inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: {and} now, David, see to thy own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

column.name: text
column.value: But {as for} the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that {was} over the forced labour; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get into {his} chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Israel rebelled against the house of David to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and eighty thousand chosen {men}, who were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done by me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

column.name: text
column.value: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

column.name: text
column.value: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which {are} in Judah and in Benjamin fortified cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of food, and of oil and wine.

column.name: text
column.value: And in every single city {he put} shields and spears, and made them very strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests and the Levites that {were} in all Israel resorted to him from all their land.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Levites left their common lands and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office to the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And he appointed him priests for the high places, and for the demons, and for the calves which he had made.

column.name: text
column.value: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice to the LORD God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam took to himself Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David for a wife, {and} Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

column.name: text
column.value: Who bore him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

column.name: text
column.value: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; who bore him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and sixty concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and sixty daughters.)

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, {to be} ruler among his brethren: for {he thought} to make him king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he dealt wisely, and distributed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city: and he gave them food in abundance. And he desired many wives.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, {even} four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, {being} mighty men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijah stood upon mount Zemaraim, which {is} in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, {even} to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, hath risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And there are gathered to him worthless men, base fellows, and {they} have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

column.name: text
column.value: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye {are} a great multitude, and {there are} with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have appointed priests after the manner of the nations of {other} lands? so that whoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams, {the same} may be a priest of {them that are} no gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for us, the LORD {is} our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, who minister to the LORD, {are} the sons of Aaron, and the Levites {wait} upon {their} business:

column.name: text
column.value: And they burn to the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the showbread also {they set in order} upon the pure table; and the lampstand of gold with its lamps, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, God himself {is} with us for {our} captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambush {was} behind them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle {was} before and behind: and they cried to the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the children of Israel were subdued at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its towns, and Jeshanah with its towns, and Ephrain with its towns.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abijah became mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, {are} written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out to meet Asa, and said to him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD {is} with you, while ye are with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

column.name: text
column.value: Now for a long season Israel {hath been} without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they in their trouble returned to the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

column.name: text
column.value: And in those times {there was} no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations {were} upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: And nation was destroyed by nation, and city by city: for God troubled them with all adversity.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and repaired the altar of the LORD, that {was} before the porch of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they resorted to him out of Israel in multitudes, when they saw that the LORD his God {was} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

column.name: text
column.value: And they offered to the LORD at the same time, of the spoil {which} they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

column.name: text
column.value: That whoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

column.name: text
column.value: And they swore to the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them: and the LORD gave them rest on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And also {concerning} Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from {being} queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped {it}, and burnt {it} at the brook Kidron.

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was no {more} war until the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: With twelve hundred chariots, and sixty thousand horsemen: and the people {were} without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Cushites.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the fortified cities which {pertained} to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and {to} the princes of Judah, that were gathered together at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon which the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD {is} righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; {therefore} I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed {them} to the hands of the captains of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and conveyed them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy {him} altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

column.name: text
column.value: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam {was} one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name {was} Naamah an Ammonitess.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, {are} they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And {there were} wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa did {that which was} good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

column.name: text
column.value: For he took away the altars of the strange {gods}, and the high places, and broke down the images, and cut down the groves:

column.name: text
column.value: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built fortified cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he said to Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about {them} walls, and towers, gates, and bars, {while} the land {is} yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought {him}, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa had an army {of men} that bore shields and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bore shields and drew bows, two hundred and eighty thousand: all these {were} mighty men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came out against them Zerah the Cushite with an host of a million, and three hundred chariots; and came to Mareshah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa cried to the LORD his God, and said, LORD, {it is} nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou {art} our God; let not man prevail against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So the LORD smote the Cushites before Asa, and before Judah; and the Cushites fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa and the people that {were} with him pursued them to Gerar: and the Cushites were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: And they smote all the cities about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they smote all the cities; for there was very much spoil in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not to Baalim;

column.name: text
column.value: But sought to the {LORD} God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD established the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat tribute; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, {even} to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And with them {he sent} Levites, {even} Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And they taught in Judah, and {had} the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that {were} around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

column.name: text
column.value: Also {some} of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred male goats.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat became exceedingly great; and he built in Judah fortresses, and cities of store.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, {were} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him {was} Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him {was} Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

column.name: text
column.value: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him {was} Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and eighty thousand ready prepared for the war.

column.name: text
column.value: These waited on the king, besides {those} whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: And after {certain} years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that {he had} with him, and persuaded him to go up {with him} to Ramothgilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I {am} as thou {art}, and my people as thy people; and {we will be} with thee in the war.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said to them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver {it} into the king's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoshaphat said, {Is there} not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we may enquire of him?

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, {There is} yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesieth good to me, but always evil: the same {is} Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel called for one {of his} officers, and said, Bring quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat each of them on his throne, clothed in {their} robes, and they sat in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they shall be consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver {it} into the hand of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets {declare} good to the king with one consent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, {As} the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come to the king, the king said to him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return {therefore} every man to his house in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee {that} he would not prophesy good to me, but evil?

column.name: text
column.value: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and {on} his left.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spoke saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said to him, How?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And {the LORD} said, Thou shalt entice {him}, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do {even} so.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this {man} in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Micaiah said, If thou shalt certainly return in peace, {then} hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that {were} with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, except only with the king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It {is} the king of Israel. Therefore they surrounded him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them {to depart} from him.

column.name: text
column.value: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a {certain} man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the armour: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thy hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the battle increased that day: yet the king of Israel held {himself} in {his} chariot against the Syrians until the evening: and about the time of the sun setting he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the wicked, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore {is} wrath upon thee from before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thy heart to seek God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who {is} with you in the judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do {it}: for {there is} no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and {of} the priests, and of the heads of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever cause shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and {so} wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest {is} over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites {shall be} officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these {were} the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah: but the kingdom he gave to Jehoram; because he {was} the firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jehoram had risen to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and {others} also of the princes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoram {was} thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab for a wife: and he wrought {that which was} evil in the eyes of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites who surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. The same time {also} did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the harlot, and compelled Judah to {do the same}.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the harlot, like the harlotries of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, {who were} better than thyself:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou {shalt have} great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that {were} near the Cushites:

column.name: text
column.value: And they came up into Judah, and broke into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was not a son left to him, except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of grievous diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Yet they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

column.name: text
column.value: It came to pass after this also, {that} the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them {others} besides the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side of Syria; and, behold, they {are} in Hazazontamar, which {is} Engedi.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask {help} of the LORD: even from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, {art} not thou God in heaven? and rulest thou {not} over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thy hand {is there not} power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

column.name: text
column.value: {Art} not thou our God, {who} didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and give it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

column.name: text
column.value: And they dwelt in it, and have built thee a sanctuary in it for thy name, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: If, {when} evil cometh upon us, {as} the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name {is} in this house,) and cry to thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came from the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, {I say, how} they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

column.name: text
column.value: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes {are} upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD to you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle {is} not yours, but God's.

column.name: text
column.value: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall not {need} to fight in this {battle}: set yourselves, stand ye {still}, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD {will be} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with {his} face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers to the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy {endureth} for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushes against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, who were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

column.name: text
column.value: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy {them}: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked to the multitude, and, behold, they {were} dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering the spoil, it was so much.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place hath been called, The valley of Berachah, to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of {those} countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: {he was} thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

column.name: text
column.value: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts to the God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who {is} mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And after this Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

column.name: text
column.value: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongeber.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

column.name: text
column.value: Forty and two years old {was} Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

column.name: text
column.value: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

column.name: text
column.value: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And the destruction of Ahaziah was from God by coming to Joram: for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he {is} the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to retain the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.

column.name: text
column.value: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa brought silver and gold out of the treasuries of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} a league between me and thee, as {there was} between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Benhadad hearkened to king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard {it}, that he stopped building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber of it, with which Baasha was building; and he built with it Geba and Mizpah.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore hath the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Were not the Cushites and the Lubims a huge army, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of {them} whose heart {is} perfect toward him. In this thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for {he was} in a rage with him because of this {thing}. And Asa oppressed {some} of the people the same time.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease {was} very {grievous}: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and various kinds {of spices} prepared by the perfumers' art: and they made a very great burning for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Amaziah {was} twenty and five years old {when} he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

column.name: text
column.value: But he slew not their children, but {did} as {it is} written in the law of the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of {their} fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice {men, able} to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

column.name: text
column.value: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD {is} not with Israel, {that is, with} all the children of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou wilt go, do {it}, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah separated them, {that is}, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And {other} ten thousand {left} alive the children of Judah carried away captive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they were all broken in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: But the soldiers of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even to Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up {to be} his gods, and bowed himself before them, and burned incense to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet, who said to him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thy hand?

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that {the king} said to him, Art thou made of the king's council? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet stopped, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened to my counsel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that {was} in Lebanon sent to the cedar that {was} in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son for a wife: and there passed by a wild beast that {was} in Lebanon, and trod down the thistle.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thy heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to {thy} harm, that thou shouldest fall, {even} thou, and Judah with thee?

column.name: text
column.value: But Amaziah would not hear; for it {came} from God, that he might deliver them into the hand {of their enemies}, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they looked one another in the face, {both} he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which {belongeth} to Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah was smote before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he took} all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, {are} they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Now after the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said to them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, {shall be} porters of the doors;

column.name: text
column.value: And a third part {shall be} at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people {shall be} in the courts of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But let none come into the house of the LORD, except the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they {are} holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whoever {else} cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go {out} on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that {had been} king David's, which {were} in the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and {gave him} the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entrance, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of music, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said to them, Have her forth between the ranks: and whoever followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So they laid hands on her; and when she had come to the entrance of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD'S people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and broke it down, and broke his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as {it is} written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, {as it was ordained} by David.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none {who was} unclean in any thing should enter.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Jotham {was} twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: yet he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.

column.name: text
column.value: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

column.name: text
column.value: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay to him, both the second year, and the third.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, see, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who {was} sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

column.name: text
column.value: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after the king slept with his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Sixteen years old {was} Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gurbaal, and the Mehunims.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad {even} to the entrance of Egypt; for he strengthened {himself} exceedingly.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning {of the wall}, and fortified them.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he built towers in the desert, and dug many wells: for he had many cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: farmers {also}, and vinedressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved the soil.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, {one} of the king's captains.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole number of the heads of the father's {houses} of the mighty men of valour {were} two thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And under their hand {was} an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the army shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, and slings {to cast} stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by skilful men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to {his} destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of the LORD, {that were} valiant men:

column.name: text
column.value: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said to him, {It appertaineth} not to thee, Uzziah, to burn incense to the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither {shall it be} for thy honour from the LORD God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Uzziah was angry, and {had} a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he {was} leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from there; yea, himself hastened also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and dwelt in a separate house, {being} a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son {was} over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, were written by Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

column.name: text
column.value: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which {belonged} to the kings; for they said, He {is} a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Joash {was} seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also {was} Zibiah of Beersheba.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joash did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after this, {that} Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather from all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. But the Levites hastened {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, {according to the commandment} of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

column.name: text
column.value: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD they bestowed upon Baalim.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection {that} Moses the servant of God {laid} upon Israel in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had finished.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, that at the time the chest was brought to the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that {there was} much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and assembled money in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in order, and strengthened it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had finished {it}, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, of which were made vessels for the house of the LORD, {even} vessels to minister, and to offer {with}, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jehoiada grew old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old {was he} when he died.

column.name: text
column.value: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again to the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people, and said to them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon {it}, and require {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of the year, {that} the army of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them to the king of Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {concerning} his sons, and the greatness of the burdens {laid} upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they {are} written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Ahaz {was} twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:

column.name: text
column.value: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought {them} to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, {who were} all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah {that was} next to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
