column.name: text
column.value: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name {was} Oded: and he went out before the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was angry with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage {that} reacheth to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And now ye purpose to bring into bondage for yourselves the children of Judah and Jerusalem for male and female slaves: {but are there} not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

column.name: text
column.value: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD {is} upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Ye shall not bring in the captives here: for though we have offended against the LORD {already}, ye intend to add {more} to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and {there is} fierce wrath against Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men who were mentioned by name arose, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them food and drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time king Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

column.name: text
column.value: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

column.name: text
column.value: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with its villages, and Timnah with its villages, Gimzo also and its villages: and they dwelt there.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and greatly transgressed against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came to him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

column.name: text
column.value: For Ahaz took away a portion from the house of the LORD, and from the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave {it} to the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the time of his distress he trespassed yet more against the LORD: this {is that} king Ahaz.

column.name: text
column.value: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, {therefore} will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz gathered the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made for himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And in every single city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, {even} in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover to the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

column.name: text
column.value: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover to the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done {it} of a long {time in the manner} as it was written.

column.name: text
column.value: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again to the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, who trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, {who} therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

column.name: text
column.value: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers {were, but} yield yourselves to the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye turn again to the LORD, your brethren and your children {shall find} compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall return into this land: for the LORD your God {is} gracious and merciful, and will not turn away {his} face from you, if ye return to him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even to Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless some from Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And there assembled at Jerusalem many people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: And they arose and took away the altars that {were} in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense they took away, and cast {them} into the brook Kidron.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth {day} of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stood in their place after their custom, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, {which they received} from the hand of the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there were} many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one {that was} not clean, to sanctify {them} to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For a multitude of the people, {even} many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

column.name: text
column.value: {That} prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though {he is} not {cleansed} according to the purification of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, {singing} with loud instruments to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah encouraged all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they ate throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept {other} seven days with gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came from the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

column.name: text
column.value: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel {there was} not the like in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer ascended to his holy dwelling place, {even} to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and broke the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the camp of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {He appointed} also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, {that is}, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as {it is} written in the law of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of grain, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all {things} they brought in abundantly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated to the LORD their God, and laid {them} by heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished {them} in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since {the people} began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left {is} this great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared {them},

column.name: text
column.value: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated {things} faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite {was} ruler, and Shimei his brother {was} the next.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, {were} overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, {was} over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.

column.name: text
column.value: And under him {were} Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in {their} set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

column.name: text
column.value: Besides their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, {even} to every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

column.name: text
column.value: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

column.name: text
column.value: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

column.name: text
column.value: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, {who were} in the fields of the common lands of their cities, in every single city, the men that were mentioned by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and performed {that which was} good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

column.name: text
column.value: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did {it} with all his heart, and prospered.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things, and their establishment, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fortified cities, and thought to win them for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which {were} outside the city: and they helped him.

column.name: text
column.value: So there was gathered many people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

column.name: text
column.value: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised {it} up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo {in} the city of David, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and encouraged them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that {is} with him: for {there are} more with us than with him:

column.name: text
column.value: With him {is} an arm of flesh; but with us {is} the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: After this Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (but he {himself laid siege} against Lachish, and all his power with him,) to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah that {were} at Jerusalem, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, On what do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

column.name: text
column.value: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

column.name: text
column.value: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done to all the people of {other} lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Who {was there} among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you in this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom hath been able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants spoke yet {more} against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: He wrote also letters to rail at the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of {other} lands have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech to the people of Jerusalem that {were} on the wall, to make them afraid, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, the work of the hands of man.

column.name: text
column.value: And for this {cause} Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he had come into the house of his god, they that came forth from his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all {others}, and guided them on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: And many brought gifts to the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that from then on he was magnified in the sight of all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near to death, and he prayed to the LORD: and he spoke to him, and he gave him a sign.

column.name: text
column.value: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit {done} to him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: However Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, {both} he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah had very great riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

column.name: text
column.value: Storehouses also for the increase of grain, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and sheepfolds for flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance in great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

column.name: text
column.value: But in {the business of} the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to enquire of the wonder that was {done} in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all {that was} in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they {are} written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, {and} in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chief of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Hezekiah began to reign {when he was} five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

column.name: text
column.value: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them in the east street,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: For our fathers have trespassed, and done {that which was} evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned {their} backs.

column.name: text
column.value: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy {place} to the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the wrath of the LORD hath been upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives {are} in captivity for this.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {it is} in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

column.name: text
column.value: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister to him, and burn incense.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they assembled their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse {it}, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took {it}, to carry {it} out abroad into the brook Kidron.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they began on the first {day} of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and the showbread table, with all its vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they {are} before the altar of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and assembled the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought seven bulls, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer {them} on the altar of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled {it} on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought forth the male goats {for} the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded {that} the burnt offering and the sin offering {should be made} for all Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for {so was} the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began {also} with the trumpets, and with the instruments {ordained} by David king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: {and} all {this continued} until the burnt offering was finished.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had finished offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise to the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves to the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was seventy bulls, an hundred rams, {and} two hundred lambs: all these {were} for a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the consecrated things {were} six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: therefore their brethren the Levites helped them, till the work was ended, and until the {other} priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites {were} more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And also the burnt offerings {were} in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for {every} burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was {done} suddenly.

column.name: text
column.value: Manasseh {was} twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: But did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, like the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a medium, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from the land which I have appointed for your fathers; provided they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, {and} to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: And prayed to him: and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he {is} God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after this he built a wall outside the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate, and surrounded Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fortified cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast {them} out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed on it peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places, {yet} to the LORD their God only.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers that spoke to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they {are written} in the book of the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: His prayer also, and {how God} was entreated by him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they {are} written among the sayings of the seers.

column.name: text
column.value: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Amon {was} two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: But he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed to all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

column.name: text
column.value: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

column.name: text
column.value: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Josiah {was} eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined {neither} to the right hand, nor to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

column.name: text
column.value: And they broke down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that {were} on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he broke in pieces, and made dust {of them}, and scattered {it} upon the graves of them that had sacrificed to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so did he} in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, with their surrounding ruins.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had assembled from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and from all the remnant of Israel, and from all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put {it} in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and restore the house:

column.name: text
column.value: Even to the craftsmen and builders they gave {it}, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them {were} Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to oversee {it}; and {others of} the Levites, all that had skill in instruments of music.

column.name: text
column.value: Also {they were} over the bearers of burdens, and {were} overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites {there were} scribes, and officers, and porters.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of the LORD {given} by Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they are doing.

column.name: text
column.value: And they have gathered the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he tore his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great {is} the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hilkiah, and {they} that the king {had appointed}, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter:) and they spoke to her to that {effect}.

column.name: text
column.value: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon its inhabitants, {even} all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel {concerning} the words which thou hast heard;

column.name: text
column.value: Because thy heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou didst hear his words against this place, and against its inhabitants, and didst humble thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard {thee} also, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thy eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king sent and gathered all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king went into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

column.name: text
column.value: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand {to it}. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that {pertained} to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, {even} to serve the LORD their God. {And} all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoahaz {was} twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt deposed him at Jerusalem, and imposed a fine on the land of an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiakim {was} twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: Jehoiachin {was} eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the year had ended, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the precious vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah {was} one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the sight of the LORD his God, {and} humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet {speaking} from the mouth of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning to the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up early, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

column.name: text
column.value: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till {there was} no remedy.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave {them} all into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all {these} he brought to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they burnt the house of God, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all its precious vessels.

column.name: text
column.value: And them that had escaped from the sword he carried away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

column.name: text
column.value: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths: {for} as long as it lay desolate it kept sabbath, to fulfil seventy years.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD {spoken} by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and {put it} also in writing, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which {is} in Judah. Who {is there} among you of all his people? The LORD his God {be} with him, and let him go up.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover Josiah kept a passover to the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth {day} of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the Levites that taught all Israel, who were holy to the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built; {it shall} not {be} a burden upon {your} shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: And prepare {yourselves} by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

column.name: text
column.value: And stand in the holy {place} according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and {after} the division of the families of the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that {they} may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand cattle: these {were} of the king's substance.

column.name: text
column.value: And his princes gave willingly to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred {small cattle}, and three hundred oxen.

column.name: text
column.value: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave to the Levites for passover offerings five thousand {small cattle}, and five hundred oxen.

column.name: text
column.value: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled {the blood} from their hands, and the Levites flayed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer to the LORD, as {it is} written in the book of Moses. And so {did they} with the oxen.

column.name: text
column.value: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the {other} holy {offerings} they boiled in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided {them} speedily among all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterwards they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron {were busied} in offering burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: And the singers the sons of Asaph {were} in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters {waited} at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was no passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

column.name: text
column.value: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? {I come} not against thee this day, but against the house with which I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from {meddling with} God, who {is} with me, that he may not destroy thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not to the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

column.name: text
column.value: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Take me away; for I am grievously wounded.

column.name: text
column.value: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in {one of} the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women have spoken of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they {are} written in the lamentations.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to {that which was} written in the law of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they {are} written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the children of the province that went up from the captivity, of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and came again to Jerusalem and Judah, every one to his city;

column.name: text
column.value: Who came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred and seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Arah, seven hundred and seventy and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua {and} Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Zattu, nine hundred and forty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bani, six hundred and forty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred and twenty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty and six.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Adin, four hundred and fifty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Hashum, two hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Anathoth, an hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Kirjatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred and twenty and one.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Magbish, an hundred and fifty and six.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred and thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred and forty and seven.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, {in} all an hundred and thirty and nine.

column.name: text
column.value: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, {were} three hundred and ninety and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} they who went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, {and} Immer: but they could not show their father's house, and their seed, whether they {were} of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

column.name: text
column.value: These sought their family record {among} those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Tirshatha said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole congregation together {was} forty and two thousand three hundred {and} sixty,

column.name: text
column.value: Besides their male and female servants, of whom {there were} seven thousand three hundred and thirty and seven: and {there were} among them two hundred men and women singers.

column.name: text
column.value: Their horses {were} seven hundred and thirty and six; their mules, two hundred and forty and five;

column.name: text
column.value: Their camels, four hundred and thirty and five; {their} donkeys, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of the heads of the fathers' {houses}, when they came to the house of the LORD which {is} at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in its place:

column.name: text
column.value: They gave after their ability into the treasury of the work sixty and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pounds of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests, and the Levites, and {some} of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel {were} in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as {it is} written in the law of Moses the man of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set the altar upon its bases; for fear {was} upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings on it to the LORD, {even} burnt offerings morning and evening.

column.name: text
column.value: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as {it is} written, and {offered} the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward {offered} the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not {yet} laid.

column.name: text
column.value: They gave money also to the masons, and to the carpenters; and food, and drink, and oil, to them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the second year of their coming to the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then stood Jeshua {with} his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, {with} their sons and their brethren the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks to the LORD; because {he is} good, for his mercy {endureth} for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

column.name: text
column.value: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of the fathers' {houses}, old men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

column.name: text
column.value: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of the joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and {put it} also in writing, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which {is} in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is there} among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which {is} in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he {is} the God,) who {is} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, besides the freewill offering for the house of God that {is} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then arose the heads of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all {them} whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which {is} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And all they that {were} about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, besides all {that} was willingly offered.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought from Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

column.name: text
column.value: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the number of them: thirty platters of gold, a thousand platters of silver, nine and twenty knives,

column.name: text
column.value: Thirty basins of gold, silver basins of a second {sort} four hundred and ten, {and} other vessels a thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: All the vessels of gold and of silver {were} five thousand and four hundred. All {these} did Sheshbazzar bring with {them of} the captivity that were brought from Babylon to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews that {were} in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, {even} to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which {is} at Jerusalem: and with them {were} the prophets of God helping them.

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side of the river, and Shetharboznai, and their companions, and said thus to them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said we to them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

column.name: text
column.value: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this {matter}.

column.name: text
column.value: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side of the river, and Shetharboznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, who {were} on this side of the river, sent to Darius the king:

column.name: text
column.value: They sent a letter to him, in which was written thus; To Darius the king, all peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Be it known to the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work proceedeth quickly, and prospereth in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we asked those elders, {and} said to them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to finish these walls?

column.name: text
column.value: We asked their names also, to inform thee, that we might write the names of the men that {were} the chief of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and set up.

column.name: text
column.value: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon {the same} king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that {was} in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to {one}, whose name {was} Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that {is} in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, {and} laid the foundation of the house of God which {is} in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and {yet} it is not finished.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, if {it seemeth} good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which {is} there at Babylon, whether it is {so}, that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

column.name: text
column.value: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

column.name: text
column.value: This Ezra went from Babylon; and he {was} a scribe skilled in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went {some} of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which {was} in the seventh year of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: For upon the first {day} of the first month he began to go from Babylon, and on the first {day} of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do {it}, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this {is} the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, {even} a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect {peace}, and now.

column.name: text
column.value: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and {of} his priests and Levites, in my realm, who are disposed of their own freewill to go to Jerusalem, go with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as thou art sent by the king, and by his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which {is} in thy hand;

column.name: text
column.value: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation {is} in Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which {is} in Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bulls, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which {is} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and gold, that do after the will of your God.

column.name: text
column.value: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, {those} deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow {it} out of the king's treasure house.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, {even} I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers who {are} beyond the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

column.name: text
column.value: To an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing {how much}.

column.name: text
column.value: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

column.name: text
column.value: Also we inform you, that concerning any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that {is} in thy hand, set magistrates and judges, who may judge all the people that {are} beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know {them} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether {it be} to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the LORD God of our fathers, who hath put {such a thing} as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which {is} in Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: And hath extended mercy to me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God {was} upon me, and I gathered out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the books, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that {is} in the province of the Medes, a scroll, and in it {was} a record thus written:

column.name: text
column.value: In the first year of Cyrus the king {the same} Cyrus the king made a decree {concerning} the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be built, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations of it be strongly laid; the height of it sixty cubits, {and} the breadth of it sixty cubits;

column.name: text
column.value: {With} three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:

column.name: text
column.value: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which {is} at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, be restored, and brought again to the temple which {is} at Jerusalem, {every one} to its place, and place {them} in the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {therefore}, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who {are} beyond the river, keep away from there:

column.name: text
column.value: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, {even} of the tribute beyond the river, expenses be given immediately to these men, that they be not hindered.

column.name: text
column.value: And that which they have need of, both young bulls, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests who {are} at Jerusalem, let it be given to them day by day without fail:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I have made a decree, that whoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

column.name: text
column.value: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall try to alter {the decree and} to destroy this house of God which {is} at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

column.name: text
column.value: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built, and finished {it}, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

column.name: text
column.value: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, who {is} at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth {day} of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them {were} pure, and they killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of Israel, who had returned from captivity, and all such as had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, ate,

column.name: text
column.value: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

column.name: text
