column.value: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building the temple to the LORD God of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of the fathers, and said to them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye {do}; and we sacrifice to him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, who brought us up here.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of the fathers of Israel, said to them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

column.name: text
column.value: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote {to him} an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter {was} written in the Syrian language, and interpreted in the Syrian language.

column.name: text
column.value: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

column.name: text
column.value: Then {wrote} Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, {and} the Elamites,

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest {that are} on this side of the river, and now.

column.name: text
column.value: this {is} the copy of the letter that they sent to him, {even} to Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side of the river, and now.

column.name: text
column.value: let it be known to the king, that the Jews who came from thee to us are come to Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the evil city, and have set up the walls, and joined the foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: Be it known now to the king, that, if this city shall be built, and the walls set up {again, then} they will not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and {so} thou shalt diminish the revenue of the kings.

column.name: text
column.value: Now because we have maintenance from {the king's} palace, and it was not good for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and informed the king;

column.name: text
column.value: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city {is} a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same from of old: for which cause was this city destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: We inform the king that, if this city shall be built {again}, and the walls set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and {to} Shimshai the scribe, and {to} the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and {to} the rest beyond the river, Peace, and now.

column.name: text
column.value: the letter which ye sent to us hath been plainly read before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city from of old hath made insurrection against kings, and {that} rebellion and sedition have been made in it.

column.name: text
column.value: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all {countries} beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not built, until {another} commandment shall be given from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the harm of the kings?

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter {was} read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

column.name: text
column.value: Then ceased the work of the house of God which {is} at Jerusalem. So it ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} now the heads of their fathers' {houses}, and {this is} the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him eighty males.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and sixty males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names {are} these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gathered them at the river that runneth to Ahava; and there we abode in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: And I sent them with commandment to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say to Iddo, {and} to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

column.name: text
column.value: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

column.name: text
column.value: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were mentioned by name.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

column.name: text
column.value: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God {is} upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath {is} against all them that forsake him.

column.name: text
column.value: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was entreated by us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

column.name: text
column.value: And weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, {even} the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel {there} present, had offered:

column.name: text
column.value: I even weighed to their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, {and} of gold an hundred talents;

column.name: text
column.value: Also twenty basins of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, Ye {are} holy to the LORD; the vessels {are} holy also; and the silver and the gold {are} a freewill offering to the LORD God of your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch ye, and keep {them}, until ye weigh {them} before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring {them} to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth {day} of the first month, to go to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

column.name: text
column.value: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him {was} Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them {was} Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

column.name: text
column.value: By number {and} by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: {Also} the children of those that had been carried away, who had come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve male goats {for} a sin offering: all {this was} a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they delivered the king's commissions to the king's satraps, and to the governors on this side of the river: and they helped the people, and the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, {doing} according to their abominations, {even} of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mixed themselves with the people of {those} lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been first in this trespass.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down appalled.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were assembled to me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat appalled until the evening sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the evening sacrifice I arose from my heaviness; and having torn my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over {our} head, and our trespass is grown up to the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Since the days of our fathers {have} we {been} in a great trespass to this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, {and} our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And now for a little moment grace hath been {shown} from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may enlighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: For we {were} slaves; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations of it, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

column.name: text
column.value: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, where ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore give not your daughters to their sons, neither take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave {it} for an inheritance to your children for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And after all that hath come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities {deserve}, and hast given us {such} deliverance as this;

column.name: text
column.value: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in marriage with the people of these abominations? wouldest thou not be angry with us till thou hadst consumed {us}, so that {there should be} no remnant nor escaping?

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD God of Israel, thou {art} righteous: for we having escaped, remain yet, as {it is} this day: behold, we {are} before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

column.name: text
column.value: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and {certain} men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province {are} in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also {is} broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned {certain} days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

column.name: text
column.value: Let thy ear now be attentive, and thy eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou didst command thy servant Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou didst command thy servant Moses, saying, {If} ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

column.name: text
column.value: But {if} ye turn to me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you driven to the uttermost part of the heaven, {yet} will I gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thy ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled to him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, {one} of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken foreign wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise; for {this} matter {belongeth} to thee: we also {will be} with thee: be of good courage, and do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they swore.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ezra arose from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and {when} he came there, he ate no bread, nor drank water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather at Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: And that whoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem within three days. It {was} the ninth month, and the twentieth {day} of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of {this} matter, and for the great rain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said to them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken foreign wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore make confession to the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the foreign wives.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

column.name: text
column.value: But the people {are} many, and {it is} a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand abroad, neither {is this} a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them who have taken foreign wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter shall be turned from us.

column.name: text
column.value: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this {matter}: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, {with} certain heads of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by {their} names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

column.name: text
column.value: And they finished with all the men that had taken foreign wives by the first day of the first month.

column.name: text
column.value: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken foreign wives: {namely}, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and {being} guilty, {they offered} a ram of the flock for their trespass.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

column.name: text
column.value: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same {is} Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, {and} Athlai.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the sons of Pahathmoab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And {of} the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

column.name: text
column.value: Benjamin, Malluch, {and} Shemariah.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, {and} Shimei.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

column.name: text
column.value: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

column.name: text
column.value: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

column.name: text
column.value: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

column.name: text
column.value: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

column.name: text
column.value: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

column.name: text
column.value: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

column.name: text
column.value: Shallum, Amariah, {and} Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: All these had taken foreign wives: and {some} of them had wives by whom they had children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliashib the high priest arose with his brethren the priests, and they built the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even to the tower of Meah they sanctified it, to the tower of Hananeel.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him built the men of Jericho. And next to them built Zaccur the son of Imri.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who {also} laid its beams, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next to them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next to them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its locks, and its bars.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, to the throne of the governor on this side of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: Next to him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next to him also repaired Hananiah the son of {one of} the perfumers, and they fortified Jerusalem to the broad wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, opposite his house. And next to him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

column.name: text
column.value: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars, and a thousand cubits on the wall to the dung gate.

column.name: text
column.value: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Bethhaccerem; he built it, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars.

column.name: text
column.value: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its locks, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and to the stairs that descend from the city of David.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, to {the place} opposite the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next to him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece opposite the ascent to the armoury at the turning {of the wall}.

column.name: text
column.value: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning {of the wall} to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub opposite their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah to the turning {of the wall}, even to the corner.

column.name: text
column.value: Palal the son of Uzai, opposite the turning {of the wall}, and the projecting tower from the king's upper house, that {was} by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, to {the place} opposite the water gate toward the east, and the projecting tower.

column.name: text
column.value: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, opposite the great projecting tower, even to the wall of Ophel.

column.name: text
column.value: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one opposite his house.

column.name: text
column.value: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer opposite his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah opposite his chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son to the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, opposite the gate Miphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.

column.name: text
column.value: And between the ascent of the corner to the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, {that} wine {was} before him: and I took up the wine, and gave {it} to the king. Now I had not {in times past} been sad in his presence.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the king said to me, Why {is} thy countenance sad, seeing thou {art} not sick? this {is} nothing but sorrow of heart. Then I was very greatly afraid,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, {lieth} waste, and its gates are consumed with fire?

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to the king, If it should please the king, and if thy servant hath found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I said to the king, If it should please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may let me pass through till I come into Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: And a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which {is near} to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

column.name: text
column.value: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard {of it}, it grieved them exceedingly that there had come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

column.name: text
column.value: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I {any} man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither {was there any} beast with me, except the beast that I rode upon.

column.name: text
column.value: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and their gates were consumed with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but {there was} no place for the beast {that was} under me to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and {so} returned.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rulers knew not where I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told {it} to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I to them, Ye see the distress that we {are} in, how Jerusalem {lieth} waste, and its gates are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we may be no more a reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken to me. And they said, Let us rise and build. So they strengthened their hands for {this} good {work}.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard {it}, they mocked, and despised us, and said, What {is} this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

column.name: text
column.value: Then I answered them, and said to them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, {are} many: therefore we take up grain {for them}, that we may eat, and live.

column.name: text
column.value: {Some} also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy grain, because of the famine.

column.name: text
column.value: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tax, {and that upon} our lands and vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet now our flesh {is} as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and {some} of our daughters are brought to bondage {already}: neither {is it} in our power {to redeem them}; for other men have our lands and vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said to them, Ye exact interest, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, who were sold to the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold to us? Then they held their peace, and found nothing {to answer}.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I said, That {is} not good which ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

column.name: text
column.value: I likewise, my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and grain: I pray you, let us stop charging interest.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth {part} of the money, and of the grain, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they, We will restore {them}, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, {that is}, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: But the former governors that {had been} before me had laid a burden upon the people, and had taken of them food and wine, besides forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bore rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants {were} gathered there to the work.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover {there were} at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, besides those that came to us from among the heathen that {were} about us.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {that} which was prepared {for me} daily {was} one ox {and} six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days an abundance of all sorts of wine: yet for all this I required not the food of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

column.name: text
column.value: Think upon me, my God, for good, {according} to all that I have done for this people.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and felt great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they finish in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

column.name: text
column.value: Now Tobiah the Ammonite {was} by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox should go up, he would even break down their stone wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a spoil in the land of captivity:

column.name: text
column.value: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked {thee} to anger before the builders.

column.name: text
column.value: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to the half of it: for the people had a mind to work.

column.name: text
column.value: But it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were set up, {and} that the breaches began to be closed, then they were very angry,

column.name: text
column.value: And conspired all of them together to come {and} to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is failing, and {there is} much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that when the Jews who dwelt by them came, they said to us ten times, From all places where ye shall return to us {they will be upon you}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I set in the lower places behind the wall, {and} on the higher places, I even set the people according to their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and arose, and said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be ye not afraid of them: remember the Lord, {who is} great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one to his work.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass from that time forth, {that} the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers {were} behind all the house of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: They who built on the wall, and they that bore burdens, burdened themselves, {every one} with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other {hand} held a weapon.

column.name: text
column.value: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and {so} built. And he that sounded the trumpet {was} by me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work {is} great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

column.name: text
column.value: In what place {therefore} ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye there to us: our God shall fight for us.

column.name: text
column.value: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise at the same time said I to the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour in the day.

column.name: text
column.value: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me, none of us put off our clothes, {except that} every one put them off for washing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and {that} there was no breach left in it; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

column.name: text
column.value: That Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us meet together in {some one of} the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

column.name: text
column.value: And I sent messengers to them, saying, I {am} doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, while I leave it, and come down to you?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they sent to me four times in this way; and I answered them after the same manner.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

column.name: text
column.value: In which {was} written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith {it, that} thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou hast also appointed prophets to proclaim concerning thee at Jerusalem, saying, {There is} a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I sent to him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou maketh up them out of thy own heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it may not be done. Now therefore, {O God}, strengthen my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward I came to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who {was} shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who {is there}, that, {being} as I {am}, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore {was} he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and {that} they might have {matter} for a bad report, that they might reproach me.

column.name: text
column.value: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

column.name: text
column.value: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth {day} of {the month} Elul, in fifty and two days.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard {of it}, and all the heathen that {were} about us saw {these things}, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought by our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and {the letters} of Tobiah came to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there were} many in Judah sworn to him, because he {was} the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. {And} Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

column.name: text
column.value: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he {was} a faithful man, and feared God above many.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun shall be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar {them}: and appoint soldiers of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one {to be} opposite his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the city {was} large and great: but the people in it {were} few, and the houses {were} not built.

column.name: text
column.value: And my God put into my heart to gather the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a family record of the genealogy of them who came up at the first, and found written in it,

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one to his city;

column.name: text
column.value: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, {I say}, of the men of the people of Israel {was this};

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred and seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Arah, six hundred and fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred {and} eighteen.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Zattu, eight hundred and forty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Binnui, six hundred and forty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred and twenty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty and seven.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty and seven.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Adin, six hundred and fifty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Hashum, three hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred and eighty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Anathoth, an hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Kirjathjearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty and one.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred and twenty and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred and fifty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty and five.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty and one.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy and three.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred and forty and seven.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, {and} of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

column.name: text
column.value: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred and forty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred and thirty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, {were} three hundred and ninety and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {were} they who went up {also} from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not show their father's house, nor their seed, whether they {were} of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and forty and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, who took {one} of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite for a wife, and was called after their name.

column.name: text
column.value: These sought their family record {among} those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Tirshatha said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there should stand {up} a priest with Urim and Thummim.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole congregation together {was} forty and two thousand three hundred and sixty,

column.name: text
column.value: Besides their male and female servants, of whom {there were} seven thousand three hundred and thirty and seven: and they had two hundred and forty and five men and women singers.

column.name: text
column.value: Their horses, seven hundred and thirty and six: their mules, two hundred and forty and five:

column.name: text
column.value: {Their} camels, four hundred and thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty donkeys.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of the heads of the fathers' {houses} gave to the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury a thousand drams of gold, fifty basins, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of the heads of the fathers' {houses} gave to the treasury of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} which the rest of the people gave {was} twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty and seven priests' garments.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and {some} of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel {were} in their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man in the street that {was} before the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: And he read in it before the street that {was} before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people {were attentive} to the book of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, {and} Meshullam.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

column.name: text
column.value: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with {their} faces to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people {stood} in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused {them} to understand the reading.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nehemiah, who {is} the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said to all the people, This day {is} holy to the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions to them for whom nothing is prepared: for {this} day {is} holy to our Lord: neither be ye sad; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

column.name: text
column.value: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day {is} holy; neither be ye grieved.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the second day were gathered together the heads of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, to Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

column.name: text
column.value: And that they should declare and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth to the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as {it is} written.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people went forth, and brought {them}, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the congregation of them that had returned from the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day {was} a solemn assembly, according to the manner.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God {one} fourth part of the day; and {another} fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then stood upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, {and} Chenani, and cried with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, {and} Pethahiah, said, Stand up {and} bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou, {even} thou, {art} LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all {things} that {are} in it, the seas, and all that {is} in them, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou {art} the LORD the God, who chose Abram, and broughtest him forth from Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

column.name: text
column.value: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give {it, I say}, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou {art} righteous:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou sawest the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

column.name: text
column.value: And didst show signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as {it is} this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

column.name: text
column.value: And madest known to them thy holy sabbath, and didst command them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

column.name: text
column.value: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and didst promise them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

column.name: text
column.value: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

column.name: text
column.value: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst perform among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou {art} a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This {is} thy God that brought thee out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet thou in thy great mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou gavest also thy good Spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, {so that} they lacked nothing; their clothes did not wear out, and their feet swelled not.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

column.name: text
column.value: Their children also didst multiply thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou didst promise to their fathers, that they should go in to possess {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou didst subdue before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took strong cities, and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all goods, dug wells, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they ate, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets who testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou didst deliver them into the hand of their enemies, who distressed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried to thee, thou heardest {them} from heaven; and according to thy great mercies thou gavest them deliverers, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore thou leftest them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried to thee, thou heardest {them} from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

column.name: text
column.value: And didst testify against them, that thou mightest bring them again to thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not to thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man doeth, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet many years didst thou forbear over them, and didst testify against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not listen: therefore thou gavest them into the hand of the people of the lands.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou {art} a gracious and merciful God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou {art} just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened to thy commandments and thy testimonies, with which thou didst testify against them.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and rich land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we {are} servants this day, and {for} the land that thou gavest to our fathers to eat the fruit of it and the good of it, behold, we {are} servants in it:

column.name: text
column.value: And it yieldeth much increase to the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we {are} in great distress.

column.name: text
column.value: And because of all this we make a sure {covenant}, and write {it}; and our princes, Levites, {and} priests, set their seals {to it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now those that set their seal {were}, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

column.name: text
column.value: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

column.name: text
column.value: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

column.name: text
column.value: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

column.name: text
column.value: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these {were} the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

column.name: text
column.value: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

column.name: text
column.value: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,

column.name: text
column.value: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

column.name: text
column.value: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

column.name: text
column.value: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,

column.name: text
column.value: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

column.name: text
column.value: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

column.name: text
column.value: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

column.name: text
column.value: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

column.name: text
column.value: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

column.name: text
column.value: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

column.name: text
column.value: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

column.name: text
column.value: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

column.name: text
column.value: They joined with their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

column.name: text
column.value: And that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

column.name: text
column.value: And {if} the people of the land should bring wares or any food on the sabbath day to sell, {that} we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and {that} we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

column.name: text
column.value: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

column.name: text
column.value: For the showbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy {things}, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and {for} all the work of the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring {it} into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as {it is} written in the law:

column.name: text
column.value: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, to the house of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as {it is} written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests that minister in the house of our God:

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, to the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tenth of the tithes to the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

column.name: text
column.value: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the grain, of the new wine, and the oil, to the chambers, where {are} the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts {to dwell} in {other} cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, {that is}, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And at Jerusalem dwelt {certain} of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

column.name: text
column.value: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem {were} four hundred and sixty and eight valiant men.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty and eight.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joel the son of Zichri {was} their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah {was} second over the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

column.name: text
column.value: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, {was} the ruler of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren that performed the work of the house {were} eight hundred and twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren, heads of the fathers' {houses}, two hundred and forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

column.name: text
column.value: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred and twenty and eight: and their overseer {was} Zabdiel, the son of {one of} the great men.

column.name: text
column.value: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

column.name: text
column.value: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, {had} the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, {was} the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

column.name: text
column.value: All the Levites in the holy city {were} two hundred and eighty and four.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, {were} an hundred and seventy and two.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of Israel, of the priests, {and} the Levites, {were} in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa {were} over the Nethinims.

column.name: text
column.value: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem {was} Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers {were} over the business of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it was} the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, as every day required.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, {was} at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And for the villages, with their fields, {some} of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and {in} its villages, and at Dibon, and {in} its villages, and at Jekabzeel, and {in} its villages,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and {in} its villages,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in its villages,

column.name: text
column.value: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

column.name: text
column.value: Zanoah, Adullam, and {in} their villages, at Lachish, and its fields, at Azekah, and {in} its villages. And they dwelt from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

column.name: text
column.value: The children also of Benjamin from Geba {dwelt} at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and {in} their villages,

column.name: text
column.value: {And} at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

column.name: text
column.value: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

column.name: text
column.value: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the Levites {were} divisions {in} Judah, {and} in Benjamin.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

column.name: text
column.value: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

column.name: text
column.value: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

column.name: text
column.value: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

column.name: text
column.value: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

column.name: text
column.value: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

column.name: text
column.value: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These {were} the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

column.name: text
