column.value: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, {and} Mattaniah, {who was} over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, {stood} opposite them in the watches.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

column.name: text
column.value: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the heads of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

column.name: text
column.value: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

column.name: text
column.value: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

column.name: text
column.value: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, {were} recorded heads of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons of Levi, the heads of the fathers, {were} written in the book of the chronicles, even till the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren opposite them, to praise {and} to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, division side by side with division.

column.name: text
column.value: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, {were} porters keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, {with} cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country around Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

column.name: text
column.value: Also from the house of Gilgal, and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had built them villages around Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great {companies of them that gave} thanks, {of which one} went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

column.name: text
column.value: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

column.name: text
column.value: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

column.name: text
column.value: And {certain} of the priests' sons with trumpets; {namely}, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

column.name: text
column.value: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the fountain gate, which was opposite them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even to the water gate eastward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other {company of them that gave} thanks went to meet {them}, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even to the broad wall;

column.name: text
column.value: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even to the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

column.name: text
column.value: So stood the two {companies of them that gave} thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, {and} Hananiah, with trumpets;

column.name: text
column.value: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah {their} overseer.

column.name: text
column.value: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

column.name: text
column.value: And both the singers and the porters kept the charge of their God, and the charge of the purification, according to the commandment of David, {and} of Solomon his son.

column.name: text
column.value: For in the days of David and Asaph of old {there were} leaders of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified {holy things} to the Levites; and the Levites sanctified {them} to the children of Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this {is} Ahasuerus who reigned, from India even to Cush, {over} an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

column.name: text
column.value: {That} in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which {was} in Shushan the palace,

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast to all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, {being} before him:

column.name: text
column.value: When he showed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, {even} an hundred and eighty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And when these days had ended, the king made a feast for all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both for great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;

column.name: text
column.value: {Where were} white, green, and blue, {hangings}, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the couches {were of} gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave {them} drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels differing one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the drinking {was} according to the law; none constrained: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women {in} the royal house which {belonged} to king Ahasuerus.

column.name: text
column.value: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

column.name: text
column.value: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to show the people and the princes her beauty: for she {was} fair to look on.

column.name: text
column.value: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by {his} chamberlains: therefore was the king very angry, and his anger burned in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times, (for so {was} the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: And the next to him {was} Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, {and} Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king's face, {and} who sat in the first place in the kingdom;)

column.name: text
column.value: What shall we do to the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

column.name: text
column.value: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that {are} in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

column.name: text
column.value: For {this} deed of the queen shall become known to all women, so that they shall look with contempt upon their husbands, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

column.name: text
column.value: {Likewise} shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day to all the king's princes, who have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus {shall there arise} too much contempt and wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: If it pleaseth the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another that is better than she.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be proclaimed throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

column.name: text
column.value: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

column.name: text
column.value: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing of it, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that {it} should be proclaimed in the language of every people.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and in it was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

column.name: text
column.value: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: but our God turned the curse into a blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, {was} allied to Tobiah:

column.name: text
column.value: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where before they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded {to be given} to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

column.name: text
column.value: But in all this {time} I was not at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I came to the king, and after certain days I obtained leave of the king:

column.name: text
column.value: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing for him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it grieved me greatly: therefore I cast forth all the household goods of Tobiah out of the chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and there I brought again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

column.name: text
column.value: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given {them}: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, had fled every one to his field.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil to the treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them {was} Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were accounted faithful, and their office {was} to distribute to their brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its offices.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days I saw in Judah {some} treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and putting {them} on donkeys; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all {manner of} burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified {against them} in the day when they sold food.

column.name: text
column.value: There dwelt men of Tyre also in {the city}, who brought fish, and all kinds of wares, and sold on the sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, What evil thing {is} this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

column.name: text
column.value: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and I set {some} of my servants at the gates, {that} there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of wares lodged outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I testified against them, and said to them, Why lodge ye before the wall? if ye do {so} again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth they came no {more} on the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and {that} they should come {and} keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, {concerning} this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days also I saw Jews {that} had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, {and} of Moab:

column.name: text
column.value: And their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

column.name: text
column.value: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, {saying}, Ye shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters to your sons, or for yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did foreign women cause to sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall we then hearken to you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying foreign women?

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, {was} son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I drove him away from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus I cleansed them from all strangers, and appointed the duties of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

column.name: text
column.value: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king's servants that ministered to him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

column.name: text
column.value: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather all the fair young virgins to Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, into the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given {them}:

column.name: text
column.value: And let the maiden who pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

column.name: text
column.value: {Now} in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name {was} Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

column.name: text
column.value: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought up Hadassah, that {is}, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid {was} fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: So it came to pass, when the king's commandment and his decree were heard, and when many maidens were gathered at Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also to the king's house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

column.name: text
column.value: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven choice maidens, to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids to the best {place} of the house of the women.

column.name: text
column.value: Esther had not revealed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not make {it} known.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when every maid's turn had come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the law for the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, {that is}, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with {other} things for the purifying of the women;)

column.name: text
column.value: Then thus came {every} maiden to the king; whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women to the king's house.

column.name: text
column.value: In the evening she went, and on the next morning she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, who kept the concubines: she came in to the king no more, except that the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, had come to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

column.name: text
column.value: So Esther was taken to king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which {is} the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king made a great feast to all his princes and his servants, {even} Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the bounty of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Esther had not {yet} revealed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther performed the commandment of Mordecai, as when she was brought up with him.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those who kept the door, were angry, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

column.name: text
column.value: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told {it} to Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king {of it} in Mordecai's name.

column.name: text
column.value: And when enquiry was made of the matter, it was discovered; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things king Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that {were} with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the king's servants, that {were} in the king's gate, bowed, and paid honour to Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did pay {him} honour.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king's servants, who {were} in the king's gate, said to Mordecai, Why dost thou transgress the king's commandment?

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he hearkened not to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's reason would stand: for he had told them that he {was} a Jew.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did pay him honour, then was Haman full of wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: And he disdained to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had made known to him the people of Mordecai: therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that {were} throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, {even} the people of Mordecai.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first month, that {is}, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that {is}, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, {to} the twelfth {month}, that {is}, the month Adar.

column.name: text
column.value: And Haman said to king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws {are} different from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it {is} not for the king's profit to allow them {to remain}.

column.name: text
column.value: If it shall please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring {it} into the king's treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Haman, The silver {is} given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded to the king's satraps, and to the governors that {were} over every province, and to the princes of every people of every province according to the writing of it, and {to} every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

column.name: text
column.value: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, {even} upon the thirteenth {day} of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder them for spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was proclaimed to all people, that they should be ready for that day.

column.name: text
column.value: The posts departed, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

column.name: text
column.value: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

column.name: text
column.value: And came even before the king's gate: for none {might} enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

column.name: text
column.value: And in every province, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, {there was} great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told {it} to her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he accepted {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then called Esther for Hatach, {one} of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to learn what it {was}, and why it {was}.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai to the street of the city, which {was} before the king's gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mordecai told him all that had happened to him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to show {it} to Esther, and to tell {it} to her, and to charge her that she should go in to the king, to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

column.name: text
column.value: Again Esther spoke to Hatach, and gave him commandment to Mordecai;

column.name: text
column.value: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whoever, whether man or woman, shall come to the king into the inner court, who is not called, {there is} one law of his to put {him} to death, except him to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: For if thou shalt altogether hold thy peace at this time, {then} shall there relief and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou hast come to the kingdom for {such} a time as this?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Esther told {them} return Mordecai {this answer},

column.name: text
column.value: Go, gather all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in to the king, which {is} not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

column.name: text
column.value: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

column.name: text
column.value: In that night the king could not sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was found written, that Mordecai had informed on Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been bestowed upon Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered to him, There is nothing done for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said, Who {is} in the court? Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king's house, to speak to the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king's servants said to him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

column.name: text
column.value: So Haman came in. And the king said to him, What shall be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

column.name: text
column.value: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king {useth} to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

column.name: text
column.value: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, {and} take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Haman took the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

column.name: text
column.value: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every {thing} that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife to him, If Mordecai {is} of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they {were} yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on {her} royal {apparel}, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, opposite the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, opposite the entrance of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, {that} she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that {was} in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king to her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what {is} thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esther answered, If {it shall seem} good to the king, let the king and Haman come this day to the banquet that I have prepared for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, What {is} thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what {is} thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request {is};

column.name: text
column.value: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it shall please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor trembled before him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all {the things} in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow I am invited to her also with the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends to him, Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou to the king that Mordecai may be hanged on it: then go thou in merrily with the king to the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What {is} thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what {is} thy request? and it shall be performed, {even} to the half of the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it shall please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

column.name: text
column.value: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not compensate for the king's loss.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said to Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that dared presume in his heart to do so?

column.name: text
column.value: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy {is} this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath {went} into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen upon the couch on which Esther {was}. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

column.name: text
column.value: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him on it.

column.name: text
column.value: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the king Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman the Jews' enemy to Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he {was} to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

column.name: text
column.value: And Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plot that he had devised against the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, If it shall please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing {shall seem} right before the king, and I {am} pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who {are} in all the king's provinces:

column.name: text
column.value: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come to my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Write ye also for the Jews, as it pleaseth you, in the king's name, and seal {it} with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, no man may reverse.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that {is}, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth {day} of it; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the satraps, and the governors and princes of the provinces which {are} from India to Cush, an hundred and twenty and seven provinces, to every province according to the writing of it, and to every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

column.name: text
column.value: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed {it} with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, {and} riders on mules, camels, {and} young dromedaries:

column.name: text
column.value: In which the king granted the Jews who {were} in every city to gather themselves together, and to defend their lives, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, {both} little ones and women, and to plunder them for spoil,

column.name: text
column.value: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, {namely}, upon the thirteenth {day} of the twelfth month, which {is} the month Adar.

column.name: text
column.value: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province {was} proclaimed to all people, and that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: {So} the posts that rode upon mules {and} camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

column.name: text
column.value: And in every province, and in every city, wherever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the twelfth month, that {is}, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their harm: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the princes of the provinces, and the satraps, and the governors, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: For Mordecai {was} great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai became greater and greater.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would to those that hated them.

column.name: text
column.value: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

column.name: text
column.value: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

column.name: text
column.value: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

column.name: text
column.value: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

column.name: text
column.value: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, they slew; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king said to Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what {is} thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what {is} thy request further? and it shall be done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Esther, If it shall please the king, let it be granted to the Jews who {are} in Shushan to do to morrow also according to this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Jews that {were} in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the spoil they laid not their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: But the other Jews that {were} in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and defended their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the spoil,

column.name: text
column.value: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews that {were} at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth {day} of the month, and on the fourteenth of it; and on the fifteenth {day} of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar {a day of} gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews that {were} in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, {both} near and far,

column.name: text
column.value: To establish {this} among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

column.name: text
column.value: As the days in which the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written to them;

column.name: text
column.value: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that {is}, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

column.name: text
column.value: But when {Esther} came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plot, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and {of that} which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come to them,

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves to them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their {appointed} time every year;

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} these days {should be} remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and {that} these days of Purim should not fail {to be observed} among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent the letters to all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, {with} words of peace and truth,

column.name: text
column.value: To confirm these days of Purim in their times {appointed}, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had established for them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their lamentations.

column.name: text
column.value: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and {upon} the isles of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, {are} they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

column.name: text
column.value: For Mordecai the Jew {was} next to king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted by the multitude of his brethren, seeking the welfare of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

column.name: text
column.value: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, From where comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that {there is} none like him on the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou didst move me against him, to destroy him without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, even, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

column.name: text
column.value: But put forth thy hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, Behold, he {is} in thy hand; but save his life.

column.name: text
column.value: So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with severe boils from the sole of his foot to his crown.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took a potsherd to scrape himself with; and he sat down among the ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said his wife to him, Dost thou still retain thy integrity? curse God, and die.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that had come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they raised their voice, and wept; and they tore every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word to him: for they saw that {his} grief was very great.

column.name: text
column.value: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed his day.

column.name: text
column.value: And Job spoke, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: Let the day perish when I was born, and the night {in which} it was said, There is a man child conceived.

column.name: text
column.value: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

column.name: text
column.value: As {for} that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined to the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

column.name: text
column.value: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the stars of its twilight be dark; let it look for light, but {have} none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

column.name: text
column.value: Because it shut not up the doors of my {mother's} womb, nor hid sorrow from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Why died I not from the womb? {why} did I {not} give up the ghost when I came out of the womb?

column.name: text
column.value: Why did the knees receive me? or why the breasts that I should be nursed?

column.name: text
column.value: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

column.name: text
column.value: With kings and counsellors of the earth, who built desolate places for themselves;

column.name: text
column.value: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

column.name: text
column.value: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants {which} never saw light.

column.name: text
column.value: There the wicked cease {from} troubling; and there the weary are at rest.

column.name: text
column.value: {There} the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

column.name: text
column.value: The small and great are there; and the servant {is} free from his master.

column.name: text
column.value: Why is light given to him that is in misery, and life to the bitter {in} soul;

column.name: text
column.value: Who long for death, but it {cometh} not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

column.name: text
column.value: Who rejoice exceedingly, {and} are glad, when they can find the grave?

column.name: text
column.value: {Why is light given} to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

column.name: text
column.value: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: For the thing which I greatly feared hath come upon me, and that which I feared hath come to me.

column.name: text
column.value: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

column.name: text
column.value: {If} we try to speak with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can restrain from speaking?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy words have upheld him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

column.name: text
column.value: But now it hath come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not {this} thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, I pray thee, who {ever} perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

column.name: text
column.value: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

column.name: text
column.value: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

column.name: text
column.value: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and my ear received a whisper of it.

column.name: text
column.value: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

column.name: text
column.value: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

column.name: text
column.value: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

column.name: text
column.value: It stood still, but I could not discern its form: an image {was} before my eyes, {there was} silence, and I heard a voice, {saying},

column.name: text
column.value: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

column.name: text
column.value: How much less {in} them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation {is} in the dust, {who} are crushed before the moth?

column.name: text
column.value: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Doth not their excellency {which is} in them depart? they die, even without wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name {was} Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and turned away from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

column.name: text
column.value: And his sons went and feasted {in their} houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was so, when the days of {their} feasting were ended, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings {according} to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, From where comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro on the earth, and from walking up and down upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that {there is} none like him on the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and turneth away from evil?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

column.name: text
column.value: But put forth thy hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, Behold, all that he hath {is} in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thy hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters {were} eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a messenger to Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them:

column.name: text
column.value: And the Sabeans fell {upon them}, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only have escaped alone to tell thee.

column.name: text
column.value: While he {was} yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God hath fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only have escaped alone to tell thee.

column.name: text
column.value: While he {was} yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only have escaped alone to tell thee.

column.name: text
column.value: While he {was} yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters {were} eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only have escaped alone to tell thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Job arose, and tore his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell upon the ground, and worshipped,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Naked came I from my mother's womb, and naked shall I return there: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

column.name: text
column.value: But Job answered and said,

column.name: text
column.value: O that my grief were thoroughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

column.name: text
column.value: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

column.name: text
column.value: For the arrows of the Almighty {are} within me, the poison of which drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Doth the wild donkey bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

column.name: text
column.value: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there {any} taste in the white of an egg?

column.name: text
column.value: The things {that} my soul refused to touch {are} as my loathsome food.

column.name: text
column.value: O that I might have my request; and that God would grant {me} the thing that I long for!

column.name: text
column.value: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

column.name: text
column.value: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

column.name: text
column.value: What {is} my strength, that I should hope? and what {is} my end, that I should prolong my life?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} my strength the strength of stones? or {is} my flesh of brass?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

column.name: text
column.value: To him that is afflicted pity {should be shown} from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, {and} as the stream of brooks they pass away;

column.name: text
column.value: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, {and} in which the snow is hid:

column.name: text
column.value: In the time when they become warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

column.name: text
column.value: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

column.name: text
column.value: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

column.name: text
column.value: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came there, and were ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: For now ye are nothing; ye see {my} casting down, and are afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Did I say, Bring to me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

column.name: text
column.value: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

column.name: text
column.value: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand how I have erred.

column.name: text
column.value: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

column.name: text
column.value: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, {which are} as wind?

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig {a pit} for your friend.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for {it is} evident to you if I lie.

column.name: text
column.value: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness {is} in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

column.name: text
column.value: Call now, if there is any that will answer thee; and to which of the holy ones wilt thou turn?

column.name: text
column.value: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

column.name: text
column.value: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither {is there} any to deliver {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

column.name: text
column.value: Although affliction cometh not forth from the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

column.name: text
column.value: I would seek to God, and to God would I commit my cause:

column.name: text
column.value: Who doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

column.name: text
column.value: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

column.name: text
column.value: To set on high those that are low; that those who mourn may be exalted to safety.

column.name: text
column.value: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform {their} enterprise.

column.name: text
column.value: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

column.name: text
column.value: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope at noon as in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, happy {is} the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

column.name: text
column.value: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

column.name: text
column.value: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle {shall be} in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt know also that thy seed {shall be} great, and thy offspring as the grass of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt come to {thy} grave in a full age, as a shock of grain cometh in in its season.

column.name: text
column.value: Lo this, we have searched it, so it {is}; hear it, and know thou {it} for thy good.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: How long wilt thou speak these {things}? and {how long shall} the words of thy mouth {be like} a strong wind?

column.name: text
column.value: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

column.name: text
column.value: If thy children have sinned against him, and he hath cast them away for their transgression;

column.name: text
column.value: If thou wouldest seek to God early, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

column.name: text
column.value: If thou {wert} pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

column.name: text
column.value: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

column.name: text
column.value: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

column.name: text
column.value: (For we {are but of} yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth {are} a shadow:)

column.name: text
column.value: Shall they not teach thee, {and} tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

column.name: text
column.value: Can the rush grow without mire? can the flag grow without water?

column.name: text
column.value: While it {is} still green, {and} not cut down, it withereth before any {other} herb.

column.name: text
column.value: So {are} the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose confidence shall be cut off, and whose trust {shall be} a spider's web.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

column.name: text
column.value: He {is} green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

column.name: text
column.value: His roots are wrapped about the heap, {and} seeth the place of stones.

column.name: text
column.value: If he shall be destroyed from his place, then {it} shall deny him, {saying}, I have not seen thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, this {is} the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect {man}, neither will he help the evildoers:

column.name: text
column.value: Till he shall fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

column.name: text
column.value: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is there} not an appointed time to man upon earth? {are not} his days also like the days of an hireling?

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: If they obey and serve {him}, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

column.value: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

column.name: text
column.value: They die in youth, and their life {is} among the sodomites.

column.value: Even so would he have removed thee out of distress {into} a broad place, where {there is} no restraint; and that which should be set on thy table {should be} full of fatness.

column.value: Because {there is} wrath, {beware} lest he take thee away with {his} stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

column.value: Will he esteem thy riches? {no}, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

column.value: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath directed him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God {is} great, and we know {him} not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

column.name: text

column.value: Also can {any} understand the spreadings of the clouds, {or} the noise of his tabernacle?

column.name: text
column.value: For by them he judgeth the people; he giveth food in abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it {not to shine} by {the cloud} that cometh between.

column.name: text
column.value: The noise of it showeth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

column.name: text
column.value: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of its place.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound {that} goeth out of his mouth.

column.name: text

column.value: For he saith to the snow, Be thou {on} the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

column.name: text

column.value: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

column.name: text
column.value: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

column.name: text
column.value: How thy garments {are} warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south {wind}?

column.value: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, {which is} strong, {and} as a molten looking glass?

column.value: Teach us what we shall say to him; {for} we cannot order {our speech} by reason of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man shall speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

column.name: text
column.value: And now {men} see not the bright light which {is} in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

column.value: Fair weather cometh from the north: with God {is} terrible majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} the Almighty, we cannot find him out: {he is} excellent in power, and in judgment, and in abundance of justice: he will not afflict.

column.name: text
column.value: Men therefore fear him: he respecteth not any {that are} wise of heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Elihu spoke moreover, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: Thinkest thou this to be right, {that} thou saidst, My righteousness {is} more than God's?

column.value: If thou art righteous, what givest thou to him? or what receiveth he from thy hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy wickedness {may hurt} a man as thou {art}; and thy righteousness {may profit} the son of man.

column.value: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make {the oppressed} to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

column.name: text
column.value: But none saith, Where {is} God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

column.name: text
column.value: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

column.name: text
column.value: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, {yet} judgment {is} before him; therefore trust thou in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, because {it is} not {so}, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth {it} not in great extremity:

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: And broke up for it my decreed {place}, and set bars and doors,

column.value: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? {or} canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

column.value: {Gavest thou} the goodly wings to the peacocks? or wings and feathers to the ostrich?

column.name: text

column.value: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

column.name: text
column.value: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils {is} terrible.

column.name: text
column.value: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

column.value: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that {it is} the sound of the trumpet.

column.name: text

column.value: Deck thyself now {with} majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.

column.name: text

column.value: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

column.value: Behold, he drinketh up a river, {and} hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

column.value: He taketh it with his eyes: {his} nose pierceth through snares.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers.

column.value: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: I know that thou canst do every {thing}, and {that} no thought can be withheld from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore take to you now seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you {after your} folly, in that ye have not spoken of me {the thing which is} right, like my servant Job.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came there to him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and ate bread with him in his house: and they mourned with him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

column.name: text

column.value: Who can uncover the face of his garment? {or} who can come {to him} with his double bridle?

column.value: {His} scales {are his} pride, shut together {as with} a close seal.
