column.name: text
column.value: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish {from} the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed {are} all they that put their trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.} Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me {when I was} in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: O ye sons of men, how long {will ye turn} my glory into shame? {how long} will ye love vanity, {and} seek after falsehood? Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {There are} many that say, Who will show us {any} good? LORD, lift thou upon us the light of thy countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time when their grain and their wine increased.

column.name: text
column.value: I will both lie down in peace, and sleep: for thou only, LORD, makest me dwell in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: {A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.} LORD, how are they multiplied that trouble me! many {are} they that rise up against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Many {there are} who say of my soul, {There is} no help for him in God. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, O LORD, {art} a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

column.name: text
column.value: I cried to the LORD with my voice, and he heard me from his holy hill. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: I laid me down and slept; I awoke; for the LORD sustained me.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set {themselves} against me on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all my enemies {upon} the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

column.name: text
column.value: Salvation {belongeth} to the LORD: thy blessing {is} upon thy people. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.} Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken to the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for to thee will I pray.

column.name: text
column.value: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct {my prayer} to thee, and will look up.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou {art} not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt destroy them that speak falsehood: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, I will come {into} thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: {and} in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of my enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there is} no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part {is} very wickedness; their throat {is} an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

column.name: text
column.value: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou surround him as {with} a shield.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.} O LORD, rebuke me not in thy anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

column.name: text
column.value: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I {am} weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul is also greatly troubled: but thou, O LORD, how long?

column.name: text
column.value: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: O save me for thy mercies' sake.

column.name: text
column.value: For in death {there is} no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

column.name: text
column.value: I am weary with my groaning; all the night I make my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

column.name: text
column.value: My eye is consumed because of grief; it groweth old because of all my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled: let them return {and} be suddenly ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: {Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.} O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending {it} in pieces, while {there is} none to deliver.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there is iniquity in my hands;

column.name: text
column.value: If I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is my enemy:)

column.name: text
column.value: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take {it}; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD, in thy anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of my enemies: and awake for me {to} the judgment {that} thou hast commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall the congregation of the people surround thee: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity {that is} in me.

column.name: text
column.value: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

column.name: text
column.value: My defence {is} from God, who saveth the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry {with the wicked} every day.

column.name: text
column.value: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: He made a pit, and dug it, and hath fallen into the ditch {which} he made.

column.name: text
column.value: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon the crown of his head.

column.name: text
column.value: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.} O LORD our Lord, how excellent {is} thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thy enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

column.name: text
column.value: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

column.name: text
column.value: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all {things} under his feet:

column.name: text
column.value: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

column.name: text
column.value: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, {and whatever} passeth through the paths of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD our Lord, how excellent {is} thy name in all the earth!

column.name: text
column.value: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? {why} hidest thou {thyself} in times of trouble?

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked in {his} pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

column.name: text
column.value: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, {whom} the LORD abhorreth.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek {after God}: God {is} not in all his thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments {are} far above out of his sight: {as for} all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for {I shall} never {be} in adversity.

column.name: text
column.value: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue {is} mischief and vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are secretly set against the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

column.name: text
column.value: He croucheth, {and} humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thy hand: forget not the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Why doth the wicked despise God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast seen {it}; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to repay {it} with thy hand: the poor committeth himself to thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

column.name: text
column.value: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil {man}: seek out his wickedness {till} thou shalt find none.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} King for ever and ever: the heathen have perished out of his land.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thy ear to hear:

column.name: text
column.value: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.} Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

column.name: text
column.value: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: {with} flattering lips {and} with a double heart do they speak.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, {and} the tongue that speaketh proud things:

column.name: text
column.value: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips {are} our own: who {is} lord over us?

column.name: text
column.value: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set {him} in safety {from him that} puffeth at him.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of the LORD {are} pure words: {as} silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.} In the LORD I put my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee {as} a bird to your mountain?

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, the wicked bend {their} bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may secretly shoot at the upright in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne {is} in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: {this shall be} the portion of their cup.

column.name: text
column.value: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance beholdeth the upright.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.} How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

column.name: text
column.value: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, {having} sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider {and} hear me, O LORD my God: enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep the {sleep of} death;

column.name: text
column.value: Lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; {and} those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will sing to the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David.} The fool hath said in his heart, {There is} no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, {there is} none that doeth good.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, {and} seek God.

column.name: text
column.value: They are all gone aside, they are {all} together become filthy: {there is} none that doeth good, no, not one.

column.name: text
column.value: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people {as} they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: There were they in great fear: for God {is} in the generation of the righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD {is} his refuge.

column.name: text
column.value: O that the salvation of Israel {were come} out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, {and} Israel shall be glad.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.} I will praise {thee}, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.

column.name: text
column.value: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

column.name: text
column.value: When my enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest on the throne judging right.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial hath perished with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

column.name: text
column.value: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble {which I suffer} from them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

column.name: text
column.value: That I may show forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: The heathen are sunk down in the pit {that} they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is known {by} the judgment {which} he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked shall be turned into hell, {and} all the nations that forget God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall {not} perish for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Put them in fear, O LORD: {that} the nations may know themselves {to be but} men. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: {Michtam of David.} Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

column.name: text
column.value: {O my soul}, thou hast said to the LORD, Thou {art} my Lord: my goodness {extendeth} not to thee;

column.name: text
column.value: {But} to the saints that {are} in the earth, and {to} the excellent, in whom {is} all my delight.

column.name: text
column.value: Their sorrows shall be multiplied {that} hasten {after} another {god}: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take their names into my lips.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

column.name: text
column.value: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant {places}; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night season.

column.name: text
column.value: I have set the LORD always before me: because {he is} at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou permit thy Holy One to see corruption.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou wilt show me the path of life: in thy presence {is} fulness of joy; at thy right hand {are} pleasures for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: {A Prayer of David.} Hear the right, O LORD, attend to my cry, give ear to my prayer, {that goeth} not out of deceitful lips.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thy eyes behold the things that are equal.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited {me} in the night; thou hast tried me, {and} shalt find nothing; I have purposed {that} my mouth shall not transgress.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept {me from} the paths of the destroyer.

column.name: text
column.value: Uphold my goings in thy paths, {that} my footsteps slip not.

column.name: text
column.value: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thy ear to me, {and hear } my speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them who put their trust {in thee} from those that rise up {against them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

column.name: text
column.value: From the wicked that oppress me, {from} my deadly enemies, {who} surround me.

column.name: text
column.value: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

column.name: text
column.value: They have now surrounded us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Like as a lion {that} is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, {who is} thy sword:

column.name: text
column.value: From men {who are} thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, {who have} their portion in {this} life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid {treasure}: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their {substance} to their babes.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David, the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day {that} the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said,} I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, {and} my high tower.

column.name: text
column.value: I will call upon the LORD, {who is worthy} to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The sorrows of death surrounded me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: The sorrows of hell surrounded me: the snares of death seized me.

column.name: text
column.value: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, {even} into his ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was angry.

column.name: text
column.value: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

column.name: text
column.value: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness {was} under his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And he rode upon a cherub, and flew: yea, he flew upon the wings of the wind.

column.name: text
column.value: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion around him {was} dark waters {and} thick clouds of the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: At the brightness {that was} before him his thick clouds passed, hail {stones} and coals of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail {stones} and coals of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

column.name: text
column.value: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them who hated me: for they were too strong for me.

column.name: text
column.value: They came upon me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought me forth also in a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

column.name: text
column.value: For all his judgments {were} before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

column.name: text
column.value: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt show thyself upright;

column.name: text
column.value: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; and with the perverse thou wilt contend.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou wilt light my lamp: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} God, his way {is} perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he {is} a buckler to all those that trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For who {is} God except the LORD? or who {is} a rock except our God?

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: He maketh my feet like hinds' {feet}, and setteth me upon my high places.

column.name: text
column.value: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath held me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

column.name: text
column.value: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they have fallen under my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also given me the necks of my enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

column.name: text
column.value: They cried, but {there was} none to save {them: even} to the LORD, but he answered them not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; {and} thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people {whom} I have not known shall serve me.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.

column.name: text
column.value: The strangers shall fade away, and come trembling out of their fortresses.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD liveth; and blessed {be} my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

column.name: text
column.value: He delivereth me from my enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I give thanks to thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises to thy name.

column.name: text

column.name: text

column.value: His going forth {is} from the end of the heaven, and his circuit to its ends: and there is nothing hid from his heat.

column.value: Who can understand {his} errors? cleanse thou me from secret {faults}.

column.value: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous {sins}; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.

column.value: {To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.} The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

column.name: text
column.value: Some {trust} in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: They are brought down and fallen: but we are raised, and stand upright.

column.name: text
column.value: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.} The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

column.name: text
column.value: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: He asked life of thee, {and} thou gavest {it} to him, {even} length of days for ever and ever.

column.value: His glory {is} great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

column.value: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy hand shall find out all thy enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thy anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

column.name: text
column.value: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

column.name: text
column.value: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, {which} they are not able {to perform}.

column.name: text
column.value: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thy own strength: {so} will we sing and praise thy power.

column.name: text
column.value: {A Psalm of David.} LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

column.name: text
column.value: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

column.value: {He that} backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: In whose eyes a vile person is despised; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. {He that} sweareth to {his own} hurt, and changeth not.

column.name: text
column.value: {He that} putteth not out his money to interest, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these {things} shall never be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: {A Psalm of David.} The LORD {is} my shepherd; I shall not want.

column.name: text
column.value: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.} My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? {why art thou so} far from helping me, {and from} the words of my roaring?

column.value: But thou {art} he that brought me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope {when I was} upon my mother's breasts.

column.value: Be not far from me; for trouble {is} near; for {there is} none to help.

column.value: Many bulls have surrounded me: strong {bulls} of Bashan have beset me {all} round.

column.value: They gaped upon me {with} their mouths, {as} a ravening and a roaring lion.

column.value: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted within me.

column.value: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

column.value: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

column.value: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn to the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

column.value: For the kingdom {is} the LORD'S: and he {is} the governor among the nations.

column.value: All the prosperous of the earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

column.value: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

column.value: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, that he hath done {this}.

column.value: {A Psalm of David.} The earth {is} the LORD'S, and all it containeth; the world, and they that dwell in it.

column.value: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

column.value: Who shall ascend upon the hill of the LORD? and who shall stand in his holy place?

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

column.value: Who {is} this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift {them} up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he {is} the King of glory. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: {{A Psalm} of David.} To thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

column.value: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed who transgress without cause.

column.value: Show me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

column.value: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they {have been} ever of old.

column.value: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.

column.value: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon my iniquity; for it {is} great.

column.value: What man {is} he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way {that} he shall choose.

column.value: The secret of the LORD {is} with them that fear him; and he will show them his covenant.

column.value: My eyes {are} ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

column.value: Turn thee to me, and have mercy upon me; for I {am} desolate and afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: {O} bring thou me out of my distresses.

column.value: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

column.value: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

column.value: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

column.name: text
column.value: {{A Psalm} of David.} Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in my integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; {therefore} I shall not slide.

column.value: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {{A Psalm} of David.} To thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, {if} thou shouldest be silent to me, I should become like them that go down into the pit.

column.value: The LORD {is} their strength, and he {is} the saving strength of his anointed.

column.name: text

column.value: {{A Psalm} of David.} The LORD {is} my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD {is} the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

column.name: text
column.value: {A Psalm {and} Song {at} the dedication of the house of David.} I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

column.value: Bow down thy ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

column.value: For thou {art} my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

column.value: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.

column.value: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, {yea}, my soul and my body.

column.name: text
column.value: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

column.name: text
column.value: {{A Psalm} of David, Maschil.} Blessed {is he whose} transgression {is} forgiven, {whose} sin {is} covered.

column.value: {{A Psalm} of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.} I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise {shall} continually {be} in my mouth.

column.value: {To the chief Musician, {A Psalm} of David the servant of the LORD.} The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, {that there is} no fear of God before his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: I behaved myself as though {he had been} my friend {or} brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth {for his} mother.

column.name: text
column.value: But in my adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: {yea}, the smiters gathered themselves together against me, and I knew {it} not; they did tear {me}, and ceased not:

column.value: {{A Psalm} of David.} Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

column.value: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

column.value: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, {and} to slay such as are of upright conduct.

column.value: A little that a righteous man hath {is} better than the riches of many wicked.

column.value: I have been young, and {now} am old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he {was} not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

column.name: text
column.value: Mark the perfect {man}, and behold the upright: for the end of {that} man {is} peace.

column.value: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

column.value: But the salvation of the righteous {is} of the LORD: {he is} their strength in the time of trouble.

column.value: For my loins are filled with a loathsome {disease}: and {there is} no soundness in my flesh.

column.value: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my affliction; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

column.value: They also that seek after my life lay snares {for me}: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

column.value: But I, as a deaf {man}, heard not; and {I was} as a dumb man {that} openeth not his mouth.

column.name: text

column.value: For I {am} ready to halt, and my sorrow {is} continually before me.

column.value: But my enemies {are} lively, {and} they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, {even} to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.} I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

column.value: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, {even} from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

column.value: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: {then} I spoke with my tongue,

column.name: text

column.value: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I {am} a stranger with thee, {and} a sojourner, as all my fathers {were}.

column.value: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I depart, and be no more.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.} Blessed {is} he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in the time of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

column.name: text
column.value: And if he cometh to see {me}, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; {when} he goeth abroad, he telleth {it}.

column.value: Many, O LORD my God, {are} thy wonderful works {which} thou hast done, and thy thoughts {which are} toward us: they cannot be reckoned up in order to thee: {if} I would declare and speak {of them}, they are more than can be numbered.

column.value: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; my ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

column.value: {To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.} As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so my soul panteth after thee, O God.

column.name: text
column.value: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually say to me, Where {is} thy God?

column.name: text
column.value: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, {who is} the health of my countenance, and my God.

column.value: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

column.value: For thou {art} the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

column.value: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, {who is} the health of my countenance, and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.} We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, {what} work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

column.name: text
column.value: {How} thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and didst plant them; {how} thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

column.value: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

column.name: text

column.value: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

column.name: text

column.value: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.} My heart is overflowing with a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made concerning the king: my tongue {is} the pen of a skilful writer.

column.value: Thy throne, O God, {is} for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom {is} a sceptre of justice.

column.value: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he {is} thy Lord; and worship thou him.

column.value: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

column.value: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

column.value: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck {it} out of thy bosom.

column.value: {To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.} I cried to God with my voice, {even} to God with my voice; and he gave ear to me.

column.value: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

column.value: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: {he is} terrible to the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, {A Psalm} of David.} Save me, O God; for the waters are come in to {my} soul.

column.name: text
column.value: I sink in deep mire, where {there is} no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

column.name: text
column.value: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: they that would destroy me, {being} my enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored {that} which I took not away.

column.name: text
column.value: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

column.name: text
column.value: I am become a stranger to my brethren, and an alien to my mother's children.

column.value: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee have fallen upon me.

column.value: When I wept, {and chastened} my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

column.value: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

column.value: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I {was} the song of the drunkards.

column.value: But as for me, my prayer {is} to thee, O LORD, {in} an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

column.value: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

column.value: Draw near to my soul, {and} redeem it: deliver me because of my enemies.

column.value: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries {are} all before thee.

column.value: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked {for some} to take pity, but {there was} none; and for comforters, but I found none.

column.value: They gave me also gall for my food; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

column.value: Let their table become a snare before them: and {that which should have been} for {their} welfare, {let it become} a trap.

column.value: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

column.value: {This} also shall please the LORD better than an ox {or} bull that hath horns and hoofs.

column.value: {To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm {or} Song of Asaph.} To thee, O God, do we give thanks, {to thee} do we give thanks: for {that} thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

column.value: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; {but} the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

column.value: {A Psalm of Asaph.} O God, the heathen have come into thy inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

column.value: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given {to be} food to the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints to the beasts of the earth.

column.value: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

column.value: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

column.name: text
column.value: {To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.} Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest {between} the cherubim, shine forth.

column.value: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come {and} save us.

column.value: Restore us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

column.value: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

column.value: The hills were covered with its shadow, and its boughs {were like} the goodly cedars.

column.value: Why hast thou {then} broke down her hedges, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck her?

column.value: And the vineyard which thy right hand planted, and the branch {that} thou madest strong for thyself.

column.value: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man {whom} thou madest strong for thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: So will we not go back from thee: revive us, and we will call upon thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Restore us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

column.value: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock I should have satisfied thee.

column.value: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

column.value: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

column.name: text
column.value: My son, forget not my law; but let thy heart keep my commandments:

column.name: text
column.value: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:

column.value: Happy {is} the man {that} findeth wisdom, and the man {that} getteth understanding.

column.value: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thy hand to do {it}.

column.value: {One} generation passeth away, and {another} generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun also riseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

column.name: text
column.value: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about to the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to its circuits.

column.name: text
column.value: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea {is} not full; to the place from which the rivers come, there they return again.

column.name: text
column.value: All things {are} full of labour; man cannot utter {it}: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

column.name: text
column.value: The thing that hath been, it {is that} which shall be; and that which is done {is} that which shall be done: and {there is} no new {thing} under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: Is there {any} thing of which it may be said, See, this {is} new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} no remembrance of former {things}; neither shall there be {any} remembrance of {things} that are to come with {those} that shall come after.

column.name: text
column.value: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all {things} that are done under heaven: this grievous labour hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised with it.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all {is} vanity and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: {That which is} crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is lacking cannot be numbered.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke to my own heart, saying, Lo, I have come to great estate, and have gained more wisdom than all {they} that have been before me in Jerusalem: and my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For in much wisdom {is} much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: I said in my heart, Come now, I will test thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also {is} vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: I said of laughter, {It is} mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

column.name: text
column.value: I sought in my heart to give myself to wine, yet acquainting my heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what {was} that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

column.name: text
column.value: I made for myself great works; I built houses; I planted vineyards:

column.name: text
column.value: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all {kind of} fruits:

column.name: text
column.value: I made me pools of water, to water with them the wood that bringeth forth trees:

column.name: text
column.value: I procured {me} male and female servants, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of herds and flocks above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

column.name: text
column.value: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the special treasure of kings and of the provinces: I procured me male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men, {as} musical instruments, and of all sorts.

column.name: text
column.value: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever my eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all {was} vanity and vexation of spirit, and {there was} no profit under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what {can} the man {do} that cometh after the king? {even} that which hath been already done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: The wise man's eyes {are} in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also {is} vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there is} no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now {is} in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise {man}? as the fool.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun {is} grievous to me: for all {is} vanity and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it to the man that shall be after me.

column.name: text
column.value: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise {man} or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour in which I have laboured, and in which I have showed myself wise under the sun. This {is} also vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: For there is a man whose labour {is} in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured in it shall he leave it {for} his portion. This also {is} vanity and a great evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, in which he hath laboured under the sun?

column.name: text
column.value: For all his days {are} sorrows, and his labour grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} nothing better for a man, {than} that he should eat and drink, and {that} he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it {was} from the hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For who can eat, or who else can hasten {to it}, more than I?

column.name: text
column.value: For {God} giveth to a man who {is} good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth toil, to gather and to store up {wealth}, that he may give to {him that is} good before God. This also {is} vanity and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

column.name: text
column.value: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

column.name: text
column.value: Give not thy strength to women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} not for kings, O Lemuel, {it is} not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: Give strong drink to him that is ready to perish, and wine to those that are of heavy hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price {is} far above rubies.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

column.name: text
column.value: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

column.name: text
column.value: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

column.name: text
column.value: She is like the merchant ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

column.name: text
column.value: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth food to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

column.name: text
column.value: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

column.name: text
column.value: She perceiveth that her merchandise {is} good: her lamp goeth not out by night.

column.name: text
column.value: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

column.name: text
column.value: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

column.name: text
column.value: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household {are} clothed with scarlet.

column.name: text
column.value: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing {is} silk and purple.

column.name: text
column.value: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: She maketh fine linen, and selleth {it}; and delivereth waistbands to the merchant.

column.name: text
column.value: Strength and honour {are} her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

column.name: text
column.value: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and on her tongue {is} the law of kindness.

column.name: text
column.value: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

column.name: text
column.value: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; her husband {also}, and he praiseth her.

column.name: text
column.value: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Favour {is} deceitful, and beauty {is} vain: {but} a woman {that} feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.

column.name: text
column.value: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

column.name: text
column.value: To every {thing there is} a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up {that which is} planted;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

column.name: text
column.value: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: What profit hath he that worketh in that in which he laboureth?

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen the labour, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath made every {thing} beautiful in its time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that {there is} no good in them, but for {a man} to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

column.name: text
column.value: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it {is} the gift of God.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that, whatever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be added to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth {it}, that {men} should fear before him.

column.name: text
column.value: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

column.name: text
column.value: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, {that} wickedness {was} there; and the place of righteousness, {that} iniquity {was} there.

column.name: text
column.value: I said in my heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for {there is} a time there for every purpose and for every work.

column.name: text
column.value: I said in my heart concerning the state of the sons of men, that God might surely test them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all {is} vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: All go to one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I perceive that {there is} nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that {is} his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

column.name: text
column.value: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thy heart be hasty to utter {any} thing before God: for God {is} in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

column.name: text
column.value: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice {is known} by a multitude of words.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou vowest a vow to God, defer not to pay it; for {he hath} no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

column.name: text
column.value: Better {is it} that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.

column.name: text
column.value: Permit not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it {was} an error: why should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thy hands?

column.name: text
column.value: For in the multitude of dreams and many words {there are} also {many} vanities: but fear thou God.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, wonder not at the matter: for {he that is} higher than the highest regardeth; and {there are} higher than they.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king {himself} is served by the field.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this {is} also vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good {is there} to the owners of them, except the beholding {of them} with their eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: The sleep of a labouring man {is} sweet, whether he eateth little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a grievous evil {which} I have seen under the sun, {namely}, riches kept for the owners of them to their hurt.

column.name: text
column.value: But those riches perish by evil labour: and he begetteth a son, and {there is} nothing in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: As he came of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And this also {is} a grievous evil, {that} in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?

column.name: text
column.value: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and {he hath} much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold {that} which I have seen: {it is} good and proper {for one} to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it {is} his portion.

column.name: text
column.value: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this {is} the gift of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth {him} in the joy of his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: A good name {is} better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that {is} the end of all men; and the living will lay {it} to his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Sorrow {is} better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart of the wise {is} in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools {is} in the house of mirth.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so {is} the laughter of the fool: this also {is} vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Better {is} the end of a thing than its beginning: {and} the patient in spirit {is} better than the proud in spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

column.name: text
column.value: Say not thou, What is {the cause} that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom {is} good with an inheritance: and {by it there is} profit to them that see the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: For wisdom {is} a defence, {and} money {is} a defence: but the excellency of knowledge {is, that} wisdom giveth life to them that have it.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the work of God: for who can make {that} straight, which he hath made crooked?

column.name: text
column.value: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath appointed the one as well as the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

column.name: text
column.value: All {things} have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just {man} that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked {man} that prolongeth {his life} in his wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?

column.name: text
column.value: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thy hand: for he that feareth God shall escape from them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty {men} who are in the city.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there is} not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

column.name: text
column.value: Also take no heed to all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:

column.name: text
column.value: For often also thy own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

column.name: text
column.value: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it {was} far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: That which is far off, and exceedingly deep, who can find it out?

column.name: text
column.value: I applied my heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason {of things}, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness {and} madness:

column.name: text
column.value: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart {is} snares and nets, {and} her hands {as} bands: whoever pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, {counting} one by one, to find out the account:

column.name: text
column.value: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

column.name: text
column.value: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many devices.

column.name: text
column.value: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it {is} common among men:

column.name: text
column.value: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he lacketh nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat of it, but a stranger eateth it: this {is} vanity, and it {is} an evil disease.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man begetteth an hundred {children}, and liveth many years, so that the days of his years are many, and his soul is not filled with good, and also {that} he hath no burial; I say, {that} an untimely birth {is} better than he.

column.name: text
column.value: For he cometh with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known {any thing}: this hath more rest than the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, though he liveth a thousand years twice {told}, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

column.name: text
column.value: All the labour of man {is} for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

column.name: text
column.value: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

column.name: text
column.value: Better {is} the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this {is} also vanity and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it {is} man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing there are many things that increase vanity, what {is} man the better?

column.name: text
column.value: For who knoweth what {is} good for man in {this} life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is} as the wise {man}? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

column.name: text
column.value: I {counsel thee} to keep the king's commandment, and {that} in regard of the oath of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatever pleaseth him.

column.name: text
column.value: Where the word of a king {is, there is} power: and who may say to him, What doest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: He who keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man {is} great upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither {hath he} power in the day of death: and {there is} no discharge in {that} war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

column.name: text
column.value: All this have I seen, and applied my heart to every work that is done under the sun: {there is} a time in which one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

column.name: text
column.value: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this {is} also vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Though a sinner doeth evil an hundred times, and his {days} are prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, who fear before him:

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong {his} days, {which are} as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

column.name: text
column.value: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there are just {men}, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked {men}, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also {is} vanity.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also {there is that} neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)

column.name: text
column.value: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man may labour to seek {it} out, yet he shall not find {it}; yea further; though a wise {man} thinketh to know {it}, yet shall he not be able to find {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of {such as were} oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors {there was} power; but they had no comforter.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I praised the dead who are already dead more than the living who are yet alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, better {is he} than both they, who hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, I considered all labour, and every right work, that for this a man is envied by his neighbour. This {is} also vanity and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Better {is} an handful {with} quietness, than both the hands full {with} toil and vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one {alone}, and {there is} not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet {is there} no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither {saith he}, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This {is} also vanity, yea, it {is} a grievous labour.

column.name: text
column.value: Two {are} better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

column.name: text
column.value: For if they fall, the one will lift up his companion: but woe to him {that is} alone when he falleth; for {he hath} not another to help him to rise.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm {alone}?

column.name: text
column.value: And if one prevaileth against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Better {is} a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no longer be admonished.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of prison he cometh to reign; though also {he that is} born in his kingdom becometh poor.

column.name: text
column.value: I considered all the living who walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

column.value: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand {is} stretched out still.
