column.value: For the people turn not to him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

column.name: text
column.value: The ancient and honourable, he {is} the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he {is} the tail.

column.name: text
column.value: For the leaders of this people cause {them} to err; and {they that are} led by them {are} destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one {is} an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand {is} stretched out still.

column.name: text
column.value: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up {like} the rising of smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

column.name: text
column.value: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: {and} they together {shall be} against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand {is} stretched out still.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thy anger is turned away, and thou didst comfort me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, God {is} my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH {is} my strength and {my} song; he also is become my salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this {is} known in all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great {is} the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

column.name: text
column.value: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

column.name: text
column.value: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: And righteousness shall be the belt of his loins, and faithfulness the belt of his reins.

column.name: text
column.value: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nursing child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the den of the adder.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the isles of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not distress Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make {men} go over dryshod.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; as it was to Israel in the day that he came up from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness {which} they have prescribed;

column.name: text
column.value: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and {that} they may rob the fatherless!

column.name: text
column.value: And what will ye do in the day of punishment, and in the desolation {which} shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

column.name: text
column.value: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand {is} stretched out still.

column.name: text
column.value: O Assyrian, the rod of my anger, and the staff in their hand is my indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I command him, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but {it is} in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

column.name: text
column.value: For he saith, {Are} not my princes altogether kings?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not Calno as Carchemish? {is} not Hamath as Arpad? {is} not Samaria as Damascus?

column.name: text
column.value: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images excelled them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it shall come to pass, {that} when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

column.name: text
column.value: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done {it}, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant {man}:

column.name: text
column.value: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs {that are} left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth with it? {or} shall the saw magnify itself against him that moveth it? as if the rod should shake {itself} against them that lift it, {or} as if the staff should lift {itself, as if it were} no wood.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the remnant of Israel, and such as have escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again lean upon him that smote them; but shall lean upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: The remnant shall return, {even} the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

column.name: text
column.value: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, {yet} a remnant of them shall return: the full end decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a full end, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and my anger in their destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD of hosts shall raise up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and {as} his rod {was} upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

column.name: text
column.value: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath attended to his carriages:

column.name: text
column.value: They have gone over the pass: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul hath fled.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard to Laish, O poor Anathoth.

column.name: text
column.value: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

column.name: text
column.value: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand {against} the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature {shall be} hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forests with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the LORD said to me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took to me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And I went to the prophetess; and she conceived, and bore a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.

column.name: text
column.value: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD spoke also to me again, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, {even} the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach {even} to the neck; and the spread of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

column.name: text
column.value: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God {is} with us.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD spoke thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all {them to} whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and {let} him {be} your fear, and {let} him {be} your dread.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a trap and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be ensnared, and be taken.

column.name: text
column.value: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me {are} for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, who dwelleth in mount Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they shall say to you, Seek to them that are mediums, and to wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek to their God? for the living to the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, {it is} because {there is} no light in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall pass through it, distressed and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall be enraged, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall look to the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and {they shall be} driven to darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall unite with the house of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage in which thou wast made to serve,

column.name: text
column.value: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, {and} the sceptre of the rulers.

column.name: text
column.value: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, {and} none hindereth.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole earth is at rest, {and} is quiet: they break forth into singing.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, {and} the cedars of Lebanon, {saying}, Since thou art laid down, no woodsman is come up against us.

column.name: text
column.value: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet {thee} at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, {even} all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: All they shall speak and say to thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like us?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, {and} the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

column.name: text
column.value: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! {how} art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast said in thy heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

column.name: text
column.value: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, {and} consider thee, {saying, Is} this the man that made the earth to tremble, that shook kingdoms;

column.name: text
column.value: {That} made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed its cities; {that} opened not the house of his prisoners?

column.name: text
column.value: All the kings of the nations, {even} all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, {and as} the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a dead body trodden under feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, {and} slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they may not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will arise against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, {so} shall it stand:

column.name: text
column.value: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this {is} the hand that is stretched over all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall frustrate {it}? and his hand {is} stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

column.name: text
column.value: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice not thou, all Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth an adder, and his fruit {shall be} a fiery flying serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, O gate; cry, O city; thou, all Palestina, {art} dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none {shall be} alone in his appointed times.

column.name: text
column.value: What shall {one} then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from {being} a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities of Aroer {are} forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make {them} afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day it shall come to pass, {that} the glory of Jacob shall be diminished, and the fatness of his flesh shall become lean.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be as when the reaper gathereth the grain, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two {or} three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four {or} five in the outmost fruitful branches of it, saith the LORD God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect {that} which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

column.name: text
column.value: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: {but} the harvest {shall be} a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the multitude of many people, {who} make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, {that} make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

column.name: text
column.value: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but {God} shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold at the time of evening trouble; {and} before the morning he {is} not. This {is} the portion of them that plunder us, and the lot of them that rob us.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, {and} brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, {and} brought to silence;

column.name: text
column.value: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall wail over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads {shall be} baldness, {and} every beard shorn.

column.name: text
column.value: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall wail, weeping abundantly.

column.name: text
column.value: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard {even} to Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous to him.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives {shall flee} to Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for they shall go up the ascent of Luhith with weeping for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise a cry of destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the herb is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the abundance they have gained, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

column.name: text
column.value: For the cry hath gone around the borders of Moab; its wailing to Eglaim, and its howling to Beerelim.

column.name: text
column.value: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which {is} beyond the rivers of Cush:

column.name: text
column.value: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, {saying}, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and stripped, to a people terrible from their beginning to this time; a nation powerful and oppressive, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

column.name: text
column.value: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

column.name: text
column.value: For so the LORD said to me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, {and} like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: For before the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away {and} cut down the branches.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be left together to the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: In that time shall the present be brought to the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and stripped, and from a people terrible from their beginning to this time; a nation powerful and oppressive, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice to them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

column.name: text
column.value: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for my anger, {even} them that rejoice in my highness.

column.name: text
column.value: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, {even} the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail ye; for the day of the LORD {is} at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces {shall be as} flames.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy its sinners out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the stars of heaven and its constellations shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will punish the world for {their} evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make a man more rare than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one to his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined {to them} shall fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be plundered, and their wives ravished.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not regard silver; and {as for} gold, they shall not delight in it.

column.name: text
column.value: {Their} bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

column.name: text
column.value: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

column.name: text
column.value: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wild beasts of the isles shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in {their} pleasant palaces: and her time {is} near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

column.name: text
column.value: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, to the mount of the daughter of Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: For it shall be, {that}, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, {so} the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

column.name: text
column.value: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; discover not him that wandereth.

column.name: text
column.value: Let my outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and swiftly executing righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: We have heard of the pride of Moab; {he is} very proud: {even} of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: {but} his lies {shall} not {be} so.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, every one shall wail: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely {they are} stricken.

column.name: text
column.value: For the fields of Heshbon languish, {and} the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down its principal plants, they have come {even} to Jazer, they wandered {through} the wilderness: her branches are extended, they have gone over the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

column.name: text
column.value: And gladness is taken away, and joy from the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in {their} presses; I have made {their vintage} shouting to cease.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart shall sound like an harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kirharesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

column.name: text
column.value: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be despised, with all that great multitude; and the remnant {shall be} very small {and} feeble.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, {and} kingdom against kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of her; and I will destroy its counsel: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to the mediums, and to the wizards.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the rivers shall be wasted and dried up.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall turn the rivers far away; {and} the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

column.name: text
column.value: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no {more}.

column.name: text
column.value: The fishermen also shall mourn, and all they that cast a line into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave fine cloths, shall be confounded.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be broken in its purposes, all that make sluices {and} ponds for fish.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the princes of Zoan {are} fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become stupid: how say ye to Pharaoh, I {am} the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

column.name: text
column.value: Where {are} they? where {are} thy wise {men}? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

column.value: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, {even they that are} the support of its tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst of it: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work of it, as a drunken {man} staggereth in his vomit.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall there be {any} work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may perform.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall Egypt be like women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land of Judah shall be a terror to Egypt, every one that maketh mention of it shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at its border to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry to the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall offer sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow to the LORD, and perform {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal {it}: and they shall return {even} to the LORD, and he shall be entreated by them, and shall heal them.

column.value: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, {even} a blessing in the midst of the land:

column.value: And the LORD said, As my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years {for} a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Cush;

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Cush their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such {is} our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

column.value: Thou that art full of shoutings, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain {men are} not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

column.value: And he saw a chariot {with} a couple of horsemen, a chariot of donkeys, {and} a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they met with their bread him that fled.

column.name: text
column.value: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remainder of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text

column.value: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.

column.value: The earth mourneth {and} fadeth away, the world languisheth {and} fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

column.name: text
column.value: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

column.value: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

column.value: {There is} a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

column.value: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

column.value: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, {are} upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

column.value: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is all dissolved, the earth is exceedingly moved.

column.value: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression of it shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones {that are} on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

column.value: And they shall be gathered together, {as} prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of Tyre. Wail, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

column.value: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

column.value: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, {is} her revenue; and she is a market of nations.

column.value: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, {even} the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish young men, {nor} bring up virgins.

column.value: As at the report concerning Egypt, {so} shall they be greatly pained at the report of Tyre.

column.value: Pass ye over to Tarshish; wail, ye inhabitants of the isle.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} this your joyous {city}, whose antiquity {is} of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her far off to sojourn.

column.value: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: {there is} no more strength.

column.name: text

column.value: Wail, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, thou {art} my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful {things; thy} counsels of old {are} faithfulness {and} truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this {is} our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this {is} the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

column.value: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth {his hands} to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the LORD shall gather from the channel of the river to the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
