column.value: The way of the just {is} uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of {our} soul {is} to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments {are} in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Let favour be shown to the wicked, {yet} he will not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, {when} thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: {but} they shall see, and be ashamed for {their} envy at the people; yea, the fire of thy enemies shall devour them.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD our God, {other} lords beside thee have had dominion over us: {but} by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: {They are} dead, they shall not live; {they are} deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed {it} far {to} all the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer {when} thy chastening {was} upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: As a woman with child, {that} draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, {and} crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy dead {men} shall live, {together with} my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew {is as} the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation shall be past.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city {where} David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be to me as Ariel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will encamp against thee all around, and will lay siege against thee with a mound, and I will raise forts against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt be brought down, {and} shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, like a medium, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones {shall be} as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be visited by the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her strong hold, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall even be as when an hungry {man} dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, {he is} faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunk, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vision of all is become to you as the words of a book that is sealed, which {men} deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it {is} sealed:

column.name: text
column.value: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near {me} with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, {even} a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise {men} shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent {men} shall be hid.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing formed say of him that formed it, He had no understanding?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: The meek also shall increase {their} joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the mocker is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

column.name: text
column.value: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now become pale.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he seeth his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty {is} a fading flower, who {are} on the head of the rich valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, {who} as a tempest of hail {and} a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

column.name: text
column.value: And the glorious beauty, which {is} on the head of the rich valley, shall be a fading flower, {and} as the early fruit before the summer; which {when} he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, to the remnant of his people,

column.name: text
column.value: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are overwhelmed with wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble {in} judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: For all tables are full of vomit {and} filthiness, {so that there is} no place {clean}.

column.name: text
column.value: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? {them that are} weaned from the milk, {and} drawn from the breasts.

column.name: text
column.value: For precept {must be} upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, {and} there a little:

column.name: text
column.value: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

column.name: text
column.value: To whom he said, This {is} the rest {which} ye may cause the weary to rest; and this {is} the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the LORD was to them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, {and} there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people who {are} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we in agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not reach us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner {stone}, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

column.name: text
column.value: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

column.name: text
column.value: And your covenant with death shall be broken, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

column.name: text
column.value: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only {to} understand the report.

column.name: text
column.value: For the bed is shorter than that {a man} can stretch himself {on it}: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself {in it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD shall rise as {on} mount Perazim, he shall be angry as {in} the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a destruction, even determined upon the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

column.name: text
column.value: When he hath made even the face of it, doth he not cast abroad the black cummin, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the wheat in rows and the appointed barley and the rye in their place?

column.name: text
column.value: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, {and} doth teach him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the black cummin are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the black cummin are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

column.name: text
column.value: Bread {grain} is ground; because he will not always be threshing it, nor break {it with} the wheel of his cart, nor grind it {with} his horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, {who} is wonderful in counsel, {and} excellent in wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not from me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

column.name: text
column.value: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt {your} confusion.

column.name: text
column.value: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

column.name: text
column.value: They were all ashamed of a people {that} could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from which {come} the young and the old lion, the viper and flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures upon the humps of camels, to a people {that} shall not profit {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength {is} to sit still.

column.name: text
column.value: Now go, write it before them in a tablet, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

column.name: text
column.value: That this {is} a rebellious people, lying children, children {that} will not hear the law of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not to us right things, speak to us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

column.name: text
column.value: Withdraw from the way, turn aside from the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and relied on them:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potter's vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a piece to take fire from the hearth, or to take water out of the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

column.name: text
column.value: One thousand {shall flee} at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

column.name: text
column.value: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious to you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD {is} a God of judgment: blessed {are} all they that wait for him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious to thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And {though} the Lord shall give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thy eyes shall see thy teachers:

column.name: text
column.value: And thy ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This {is} the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a polluted cloth; thou shalt say to it, Be gone from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, with which thou shalt sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

column.name: text
column.value: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that plow the ground shall eat cured fodder, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers {and} streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning {with} his anger, and the burden {of it is} heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

column.name: text
column.value: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and {there shall be} a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing {them} to err.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall have a song, as in the night {when} a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come upon the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall show the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of {his} anger, and {with} the flame of a devouring fire, {with} scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

column.name: text
column.value: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, {who} smote with a rod.

column.name: text
column.value: And {in} every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, {it} shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

column.name: text
column.value: For Tophet {is} ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made {it} deep {and} large: the pile of it {is} fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and rely on horses, and trust in chariots, because {they are} many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not to the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he also {is} wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Egyptians {are} men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is helped shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus hath the LORD spoken to me, As the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, {he} will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for its hill.

column.name: text
column.value: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver {it; and} passing over he will preserve it.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn ye to {him from} whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

column.name: text
column.value: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made to you {for} a sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall become forced labourers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire {is} in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as streams of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

column.name: text
column.value: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

column.name: text
column.value: The vile person shall be no more called noble, nor the churl said {to be} bountiful.

column.name: text
column.value: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

column.name: text
column.value: The instruments also of the churl {are} evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

column.name: text
column.value: But the noble deviseth noble things; and by noble things shall he stand.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear to my speech.

column.name: text
column.value: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

column.name: text
column.value: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip ye, and make you bare, and gird {sackcloth} upon {your} loins.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall lament for the breasts, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns {and} briers; also, upon all the houses of joy {in} the joyous city:

column.name: text
column.value: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;

column.name: text
column.value: Until the spirit shall be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness shall be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be counted for a forest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

column.name: text
column.value: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

column.name: text
column.value: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth {there} the feet of the ox and the donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is in it; the world, and all things that spring from it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the indignation of the LORD {is} upon all nations, and {his} fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their foul odour shall come up from their dead bodies, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their hosts shall fall down, as the leaf falleth from the vine, and as a falling {fig} from the fig tree.

column.name: text
column.value: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, {and} with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

column.name: text
column.value: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the young bulls with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} the day of the LORD'S vengeance, {and} the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: And its streams shall be turned into pitch, and its dust into brimstone, and its land shall become burning pitch.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke of it shall ascend for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none {shall be} there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in its fortresses: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, {and} a court for owls.

column.name: text
column.value: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the isle, and the satyr shall cry to his companion; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall lack her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it to them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, {and} the excellency of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them {that are} of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come {with} vengeance, {even} God {with} a recompence; he will come and save you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the lame {man} leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb shall sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

column.name: text
column.value: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, {shall be} grass with reeds and rushes.

column.name: text
column.value: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it {shall be} for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err {in it}.

column.name: text
column.value: No lion shall be there, nor {any} ravenous beast shall go up on it, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk {there}:

column.name: text
column.value: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, {that} Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah, and took them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem against king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came forth to him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.

column.name: text
column.value: And Rabshakeh said to them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence {is} this in which thou trustest?

column.name: text
column.value: I say, {sayest thou}, (but {they are but} vain words ) {I have} counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

column.name: text
column.value: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; on which if a man lean, it will enter his hand, and pierce it: so {is} Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thou shalt say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: {is it} not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou canst on thy part set riders upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

column.name: text
column.value: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah to Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand {it}: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that {are} on the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? {hath he} not {sent me} to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may devour their own dung, and drink their own urine with you?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make {an agreement} with me {by} a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

column.name: text
column.value: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

column.name: text
column.value: {Beware} lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

column.name: text
column.value: Where {are} the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where {are} the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: Who {are they} among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

column.name: text
column.value: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with {their} clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to thee that layest waste, and thou {wast} not laid waste; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to lay waste, thou shalt be wasted; {and} when thou shalt make an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, be gracious to us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

column.name: text
column.value: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: And your spoil shall be gathered {like} the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, {and} strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD {is} his treasure.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry outside: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth mourneth {and} languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed {and} hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off {their fruits}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, {as} fire, shall devour you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people shall be {as} the burnings of lime: {as} thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye {that are} far off, hear what I have done; and, ye {that are} near, acknowledge my might.

column.name: text
column.value: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

column.name: text
column.value: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that keepeth his hands from accepting of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

column.name: text
column.value: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence {shall be} the strong holds of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters {shall be} sure.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy heart shall meditate terror. Where {is} the scribe? where {is} the receiver? where {is} he that counted the towers?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, {that thou canst} not understand.

column.name: text
column.value: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thy eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle {that} shall not be taken down; not one of its stakes shall ever be removed, neither shall any of its cords be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: But there the glorious LORD {will be} to us a place of broad rivers {and} streams; in which shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass through it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD {is} our judge, the LORD {is} our lawgiver, the LORD {is} our king; he will save us.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

column.name: text
column.value: And the inhabitants shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell in it {shall be} forgiven {their} iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard {it}, that he tore his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent Eliakim, who {was} over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day {is} a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and {there is} not strength to bring forth.

column.name: text
column.value: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: therefore lift up {thy} prayer for the remnant that is left.

column.name: text
column.value: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Isaiah said to them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send a wind upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

column.name: text
column.value: And he heard it said concerning Tirhakah king of Cush, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard {it}, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

column.name: text
column.value: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, {as} Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden who {were} in Telassar?

column.name: text
column.value: Where {is} the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up to the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest {between} the cherubim, thou {art} the God, {even} thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Incline thy ear, O LORD, and hear; open thy eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, who hath sent to reproach the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

column.name: text
column.value: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they {were} no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou {art} the LORD, {even} thou only.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Though thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, {and} mocked thee; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted {thy} voice, and lifted thy eyes on high? {even} against the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots have I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down its tall cedars, {and} its choice fir trees: and I will enter into the height of its border, {and} the forest of his Carmel.

column.name: text
column.value: I have dug, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

column.name: text
column.value: Hast thou not heard long ago, {how} I have done it; {and} of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fortified cities {into} ruinous heaps.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore their inhabitants {were} of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were {as} the grass of the field, and {as} the green herb, {as} the grass on the housetops, and {as grain} blighted before it is grown up.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} a sign to thee, Ye shall eat {this} year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant that hath escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

column.name: text
column.value: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape from mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a mount against it.

column.name: text
column.value: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will defend this city to save it for my own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred and eighty and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they {were} all dead bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days was Hezekiah sick {and near} death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thy house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed to the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done {that which is} good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add to thy days fifteen years.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will deliver thee and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} a sign to thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which hath gone down on the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it had gone down.

column.name: text
column.value: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered from his sickness:

column.name: text
column.value: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the rest of my years.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, I shall not see the LORD, {even} the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

column.value: My age hath departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day {even} to night wilt thou make an end of me.

column.name: text
column.value: I reckoned till morning, {that}, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day {even} to night wilt thou make an end of me.

column.value: Like a crane {or} a swallow, so I chattered: I mourned as a dove: my eyes fail {with looking} upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

column.value: What shall I say? he hath both spoken to me, and himself hath done {it}: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

column.value: O Lord, by these {things men} live, and in all these {things is} the life of my spirit: so wilt thou restore me, and make me to live.

column.name: text
column.value: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I {do} this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

column.value: The LORD {was ready} to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay {it} for a plaster upon the boil, and he shall recover.

column.name: text
column.value: Hezekiah also had said, What {is} the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasuries: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah did not show them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Isaiah the prophet to king Hezekiah, and said to him, What said these men? and from where came they to thee? And Hezekiah said, They have come to me, from a far country, {even} from Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he, What have they seen in thy house? And Hezekiah answered, All that {is} in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, that all that {is} in thy house, and {that} which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

column.value: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good {is} the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

column.name: text
column.value: Keep silence before me, O isles; and let the people renew {their} strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Who raised up the righteous {man} from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made {him} rule over kings? he gave {them} as the dust to his sword, {and} as driven stubble to his bow.

column.name: text
column.value: He pursued them, {and} passed safely; {even} by the way {that} he had not gone with his feet.

column.value: Who hath wrought and done {it}, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I {am} he.

column.name: text
column.value: The isles saw {it}, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

column.name: text
column.value: They helped every one his neighbour; and {every one} said to his brother, Be of good courage.

column.name: text
column.value: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, {and} he that smootheth {with} the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It {is} ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, {that} it should not be moved.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, Israel, {art} my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

column.name: text
column.value: {Thou} whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from its chief men, and said to thee, Thou {art} my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear thou not; for I {am} with thee: be not dismayed; for I {am} thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, {even} them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, {and} ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, {and} shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: {When} the poor and needy seek water, and {there is} none, {and} their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, the pine, and the box tree together:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

column.name: text
column.value: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong {reasons}, saith the King of Jacob.

column.value: Let them bring {them} forth, and show us what shall happen: let them show the former things, what they {are}, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare to us things to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Show the things that are to come after this, that we may know that ye {are} gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold {it} together.

column.value: Behold, ye {are} of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination {is he that} chooseth you.

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and in times past, that we may say, {He is} righteous? verily, {there is} none that showeth, verily, {there is} none that declareth, verily, {there is} none that heareth your words.

column.name: text
column.value: The first {shall say} to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, they {are} all vanity; their works {are} nothing: their molten images {are} wind and confusion.

column.value: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; my elect, {in whom} my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment to truth.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath to the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk in it:

column.name: text
column.value: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thy hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

column.name: text
column.value: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, {and} them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD: that {is} my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the former things have come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD a new song, {and} his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is in it; the isles, and their inhabitants.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wilderness and its cities lift up {their voice}, the villages {that} Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

column.value: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the isles.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: I have long time held my peace; I have been still, {and} restrained myself: {now} will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers isles, and I will dry up the pools.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring the blind by a way {that} they knew not; I will lead them in paths {that} they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do for them, and not forsake them.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye {are} our gods.

column.name: text

column.value: For my own sake, {even} for my own sake, will I do {it}: for how should {my name} be profaned? and I will not give my glory to another.

column.value: Hearken to me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I {am} he; I {am} the first, I also {am} the last.

column.name: text
column.value: My hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spread out the heavens: {when} I call to them, they stand up together.

column.name: text
column.value: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; who among them hath declared these {things}? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm {shall be on} the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: I, {even} I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

column.name: text
column.value: Come ye near to me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there {am} I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I {am} the LORD thy God who teacheth thee to profit, who leadeth thee by the way {that} thou shouldest go.

column.name: text
column.value: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

column.name: text
column.value: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy body like its gravel; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it {even} to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And they thirsted not {when} he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he split the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} no peace, saith the LORD, to the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Listen, to me O isles; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the body of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to me, Thou {art} my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing, and in vain: {yet} surely my judgment {is} with the LORD, and my work with my God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb {to be} his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation to the end of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, {and} his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, {and} the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that {are} in darkness, Show yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures {shall be} in all high places.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

column.name: text
column.value: Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet I will not forget thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of {my} hands; thy walls {are} continually before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up thy eyes all around, and behold: all these gather themselves together, {and} come to thee. {As} I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them {on thee}, as a bride {doeth}.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too small by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

column.name: text
column.value: The children who thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thy ears, The place {is} too small for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou say in thy heart, Who hath begotten these for me, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and moving to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where {have} they {been}?

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up my hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in {their} arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon {their} shoulders.

column.name: text
column.value: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow to thee with {their} face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

column.name: text
column.value: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunk with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD {am} thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Where {is} the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or whom of my creditors {is it} to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

column.name: text
column.value: Why, when I came, {was there} no man? when I called, {was there} none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because {there is} no water, and dieth for thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to {him that is} weary: he awakeneth morning by morning, he awakeneth my ear to hear as the learned.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD opened my ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned backward.

column.name: text
column.value: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: {He is} near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who {is} my adversary? let him come near to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who {is} he {that} shall condemn me? lo, they all shall grow old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is} among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh {in} darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and rely upon his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that surround {yourselves} with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks {that} ye have kindled. This shall ye have of my hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look to the rock {from which} ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit {from which} ye are dug.

column.name: text
column.value: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah {that} bore you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found in it, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken to me, my people; and give ear to me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: My righteousness {is} near; my salvation is gone forth, and my arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on my arm shall they trust.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall become old like a garment, and its inhabitants shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken to me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart {is} my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

column.name: text
column.value: For the moth shall eat them like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake, put on thy strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. {Art} thou not that which hath cut Rahab, {and} wounded the dragon?

column.name: text
column.value: {Art} thou not that which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy {shall be} upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

column.name: text
column.value: I, {even} I, {am} he that comforteth you: who {art} thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man {that} shall die, and of the son of man {who} shall be made {as} grass;

column.name: text
column.value: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where {is} the fury of the oppressor?

column.name: text
column.value: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

column.name: text
column.value: But I {am} the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and have covered thee in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, Thou {art} my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drank the dregs of the cup of trembling, {and} wrung {them} out.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} none to guide her among all the sons {whom} she hath brought forth; neither {is there any} that taketh her by the hand of all the sons {that} she hath brought up.

column.name: text
column.value: These two {things} have come to thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunk, but not with wine:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith thy Lord Jehovah, and thy God {that} pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thy hand the cup of trembling, {even} the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; who have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, {there is} no beauty that we should desire him.

column.name: text
column.value: He is despised and rejected by men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were {our} faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten by God, and afflicted.

column.name: text
column.value: But he {was} wounded for our transgressions, {he was} bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement for our peace {was} upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

column.name: text
column.value: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

column.name: text
column.value: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opened not his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off from the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither {was any} deceit in his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put {him} to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see {his} seed, he shall prolong {his} days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall see of the travail of his soul, {and} shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I divide him {a portion} with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul to death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing, O barren, thou {that} didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou {that} didst not travail with child: for more {are} the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them extend the curtains of thy habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

column.name: text
column.value: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy Maker {is} thy husband; the LORD of hosts {is} his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

column.name: text
column.value: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.

column.name: text
column.value: For this {is as} the waters of Noah to me: for {as} I have sworn that the waters of Noah shall no more overflow the earth; so have I sworn that I will not be angry with thee, nor rebuke thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

column.name: text
column.value: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, {and} not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

column.name: text
column.value: And all thy children {shall be} taught from the LORD; and great {shall be} the peace of thy children.

column.name: text
column.value: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, they shall surely gather together, {but} not by me: whoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue {that} shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This {is} the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness {is} from me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do ye spend money for {that which is} not bread? and your labour for {that which} satisfieth not? hearken diligently to me, and eat ye {that which is} good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

column.name: text
column.value: Incline your ear, and come to me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, {even} the sure mercies of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have given him {for} a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou shalt call a nation {that} thou knowest not, and nations {that} knew not thee shall run to thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

column.name: text
column.value: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

column.name: text
column.value: For my thoughts {are} not your thoughts, neither {are} your ways my ways, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For {as} the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not there, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

column.name: text
column.value: So shall my word be that proceedeth from my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper {in the thing} for which I sent it.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap {their} hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign {that} shall not be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation {is} near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} the man {that} doeth this, and the son of man {that} layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither let the son of the foreigner, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I {am} a dry tree.

column.name: text
