column.value: For thus saith the LORD to the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose {the things} that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: Even to them will I give in my house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the sons of the foreigner, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices {shall be} accepted upon my altar; for my house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, Yet will I gather {others} to him, besides those that are gathered to him.

column.name: text
column.value: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, {yea}, all ye beasts in the forest.

column.name: text
column.value: His watchmen {are} blind: they are all ignorant, they {are} all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, {they are} greedy dogs {which} can never have enough, and they {are} shepherds {that} cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

column.name: text
column.value: Come ye, {say they}, I will bring wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, {and} much more abundant.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, {and} sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nothing; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down in times past into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nothing? they that rule over them make them to wail, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day {is} blasphemed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore {they shall know} in that day that I {am} he that doth speak: behold, {it is} I.

column.name: text
column.value: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that proclaimeth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that proclaimeth salvation; that saith to Zion, Thy God reigneth!

column.name: text
column.value: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from there, touch no unclean {thing}; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel {will be} your rear guard.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

column.name: text
column.value: As many were astonished at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

column.name: text
column.value: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for {that} which had not been told them shall they see; and {that} which they had not heard shall they consider.

column.name: text
column.value: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth {it} to heart: and merciful men {are} taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil {to come}.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, {each one} walking {in} his uprightness.

column.name: text
column.value: But come here, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

column.name: text
column.value: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, {and} stick out the tongue? {are} ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

column.name: text
column.value: Inflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clefts of the rocks?

column.name: text
column.value: Among the smooth {stones} of the stream {is} thy portion; they, they {are} thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

column.name: text
column.value: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even there thou wentest up to offer sacrifice.

column.name: text
column.value: Behind the doors also and the door posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast uncovered {thyself to another} than me, and hast gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee {a covenant} with them; thou didst love their bed where thou sawest {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase {thyself even} to hell.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; {yet} saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thy hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

column.name: text
column.value: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid {it} to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

column.name: text
column.value: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take {them}: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name {is} Holy; I dwell in the high and holy {place}, with him also {that is} of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always angry: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls {whom} I have made.

column.name: text
column.value: For the iniquity of his covetousness I was angry, and smote him: I hid myself, and was angry, and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

column.name: text
column.value: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to {him that is} far off, and to {him that is} near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wicked {are} like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

column.name: text
column.value: Why have we fasted, {say they}, and thou seest not? {why} have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as {ye do this} day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

column.name: text
column.value: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? {is it} to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes {under him}? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

column.name: text
column.value: {Is it} not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou shouldest bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou shouldest cover him; and that thou shouldest not hide thyself from thy own flesh?

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rear guard.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I {am}. If thou shalt take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

column.name: text
column.value: And {if} thou shalt draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness {be} as the noonday:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

column.name: text
column.value: And {they that shall be} of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt turn away thy foot from the sabbath, {from} doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thy own ways, nor finding thy own pleasure, nor speaking {thy own} words:

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

column.name: text
column.value: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid {his} face from you, that he will not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath uttered perverseness.

column.name: text
column.value: None calleth for justice, nor {any} pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: They hatch eggs of an adder, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

column.name: text
column.value: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works {are} works of iniquity, and the act of violence {is} in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts {are} thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction {are} in their paths.

column.name: text
column.value: The way of peace they know not; and {there is} no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whoever goeth in it shall not know peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, {but} we walk in darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if {we had} no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; {we are} in desolate places as dead {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: We all roar like bears, and mourn bitterly like doves: we look for judgment, but {there is} none; for salvation, {but} it is far from us.

column.name: text
column.value: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions {are} with us; and {as for} our iniquities, we know them;

column.name: text
column.value: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, truth faileth; and he {that} departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw {it}, and it displeased him that {there was} no judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saw that {there was} no man, and wondered that {there was} no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance {for} clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

column.name: text
column.value: According to {their} deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the isles he will repay recompence.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and to them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, this {is} my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that {is} upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the Lord GOD {is} upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings to the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to {them that are} bound;

column.name: text
column.value: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

column.name: text
column.value: To appoint to them that mourn in Zion, to give to them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: And foreigners shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien {shall be} your plowmen and your vinedressers.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: {men} shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: For your shame {ye shall have} double; and {for} confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they {are} the seed {which} the LORD hath blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh {himself} with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth {herself} with her jewels.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up thy eyes around, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at {thy} side.

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thy heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted to thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall show forth the praises of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together to thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to thee: they shall come up with acceptance on my altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {are} these {that} fly as a cloud, and as doves to their windows?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, to the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sons of foreigners shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister to thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that {men} may bring to thee the forces of the Gentiles, and {that} their kings {may be} brought.

column.name: text
column.value: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, {those} nations shall be utterly wasted.

column.name: text
column.value: The glory of Lebanon shall come to thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

column.name: text
column.value: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending to thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Though thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through {thee}, I will make thee an everlasting pride, a joy of many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD {am} thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thy exactors righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light to thee: but the LORD shall be to thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thy everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy people also {shall be} all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in its time.

column.name: text
column.value: For Zion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until its righteousness shall go forth as brightness, and its salvation as a lamp {that} burneth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

column.name: text
column.value: For {as} a young man marrieth a virgin, {so} shall thy sons marry thee: and {as} the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, {so} shall thy God rejoice over thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, {which} shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,

column.name: text
column.value: And give him no rest, till he shall establish, and till he shall make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy grain {to be} food for thy enemies; and the sons of the foreigner shall not drink thy wine, for which thou hast laboured:

column.name: text
column.value: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed to the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward {is} with him, and his work before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

column.name: text
column.value: O that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

column.name: text
column.value: As {when} the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thy adversaries, {that} the nations may tremble at thy presence!

column.name: text
column.value: When thou didst terrible things {which} we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

column.name: text
column.value: For since the beginning of the world {men} have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, besides thee, {what} he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, {those that} remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art angry; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: But we are all as an unclean {thing}, and all our righteousnesses {are} as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there is} none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, O LORD, thou {art} our father; we {are} the clay, and thou our potter; and we all {are} the work of thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not very angry, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we {are} all thy people.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt thou restrain thyself for these {things}, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and grievously afflict us?

column.name: text
column.value: I am sought by {them that} asked not {for me}; I am found by {them that} sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, to a nation {that} was not called by my name.

column.name: text
column.value: I have spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walketh in a way {that is} not good, after their own thoughts;

column.name: text
column.value: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

column.name: text
column.value: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable {things is in} their vessels;

column.name: text
column.value: Who say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These {are} a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, {it is} written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

column.name: text
column.value: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, who have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and {one} saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing {is} in it: so will I do for my servants' sake, that I may not destroy them all.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and my elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

column.name: text
column.value: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye {are} they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering to that number.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spoke, ye did not hear; but did evil before my eyes, and did choose {that} in which I delighted not.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall wail for vexation of spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall leave your name for a curse to my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

column.name: text
column.value: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

column.name: text
column.value: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever {in that} which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be no more there an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner {being} an hundred years old shall be accursed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall build houses, and inhabit {them}; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree {are} the days of my people, and my elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they {are} the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

column.name: text
column.value: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox: and dust {shall be} the serpent's food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is} this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this {that is} glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

column.name: text
column.value: Why {art thou} red in thy apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winepress?

column.name: text
column.value: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people {there was} none with me: for I will tread them in my anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

column.name: text
column.value: For the day of vengeance {is} in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and {there was} none to help; and I wondered that {there was} none to uphold: therefore my own arm brought salvation to me; and my fury, it upheld me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will tread down the people in my anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, {and} the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: For he said, Surely they {are} my people, children {that} will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

column.name: text
column.value: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

column.name: text
column.value: But they rebelled, and vexed his Holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, {and} he fought against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, {and} his people, {saying}, Where {is} he that brought them out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where {is} he that put his Holy Spirit within him?

column.name: text
column.value: That led {them} by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

column.name: text
column.value: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, {that} they should not stumble?

column.name: text
column.value: As a beast goeth down in the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

column.name: text
column.value: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where {is} thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy heart and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

column.name: text
column.value: Doubtless thou {art} our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, {art} our father, our redeemer; thy name {is} from everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, {and} hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thy inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of thy holiness have possessed {it} but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: We are {thine}: thou never didst bear rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, The heaven {is} my throne, and the earth {is} my footstool: where {is} the house that ye build to me? and where {is} the place of my rest?

column.name: text
column.value: For all these {things} hath my hand made, and all these {things} have been, saith the LORD: but to this {man} will I look, {even} to {him that is} poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

column.name: text
column.value: He that killeth an ox {is as if} he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, {as if} he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, {as if he offered} swine's blood; he that burneth incense, {as if} he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spoke, they did not hear: but they did evil before my eyes, and chose {that} in which I delighted not.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? {or} shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut {the womb}? saith thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may nurse, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may draw milk, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye be nursed, ye shall be borne upon {her} sides, and be dandled upon {her} knees.

column.name: text
column.value: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye see {this}, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and {his} indignation toward his enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.

column.name: text
column.value: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one {tree} in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {know} their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them to the nations, {to} Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, {to} Tubal, and Javan, {to} the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bring all your brethren {for} an offering to the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will also take of them for priests {and} for Levites, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall go forth, and look upon the dead bodies of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorrence to all flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that {were} in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

column.name: text
column.value: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Before I formed thee in the womb I knew thee; and before thou wast born I sanctified thee, {and} I ordained thee a prophet to the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I {am} a child.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD said to me, Say not, I {am} a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatever I command thee thou shalt speak.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not afraid of their faces: for I {am} with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said to me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a boiling pot; and its face {is} toward the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls on every side, and against all the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak to them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, I have made thee this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I {am} with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thy espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land {that was} not sown.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel {was} holiness to the LORD, {and} the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and have become vain?

column.name: text
column.value: Neither said they, Where {is} the LORD that brought us out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

column.name: text
column.value: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit of it and the goodness of it but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests said not, Where {is} the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after {things that} do not profit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.

column.name: text
column.value: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there is such a thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Hath a nation changed {their} gods, which {are} yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for {that which} doth not profit.

column.name: text
column.value: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, {and} hewed out for themselves cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} Israel a servant? {is} he a homeborn {slave}? why is he laid waste?

column.name: text
column.value: The young lions roared upon him, {and} yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

column.name: text
column.value: Hast thou not procured this to thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?

column.name: text
column.value: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that {it is} an evil {thing} and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear {is} not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, {and} burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine to me?

column.name: text
column.value: For though thou shalt wash thee with lye, and take thee much soap, {yet} thy iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: {thou art} a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

column.name: text
column.value: A wild donkey used to the wilderness, {that} snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

column.name: text
column.value: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

column.name: text
column.value: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying to a stock, Thou {art} my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned {their} back to me, and not {their} face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

column.name: text
column.value: But where {are} thy gods that thou hast made for thyself? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for {according to} the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Why will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In vain have I smitten your children; they have received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

column.name: text
column.value: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? a land of darkness? why say my people, We are lords; we will come no more to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Can a maid forget her ornaments, {or} a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

column.name: text
column.value: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

column.name: text
column.value: Why dost thou go about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thy hands upon thy head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They say, If a man shall put away his wife, and she shall go from him, and become another man's, shall he return to her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up thy eyes to the high places, and see where thou hast not been lain with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy harlotry and with thy wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst an harlot's forehead, thou didst refuse to be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt thou not from this time cry to me, My father, thou {art} the guide of my youth?

column.name: text
column.value: Will he retain {his anger} for ever? will he keep {it} to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said also to me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen {that} which backsliding Israel hath done? she hath gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said after she had done all these {things}, Turn thou to me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw, when for all the causes by which backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass through the lightness of her harlotry, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned to me with her whole heart, but deceitfully, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; {and} I will not cause my anger to fall upon you: for I {am} merciful, saith the LORD, {and} I will not keep {anger} for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Only acknowledge thy iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married to you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they miss {it}; neither shall {that} be done any more.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together from the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance to your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a beautiful heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely {as} a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping {and} supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, {and} they have forgotten the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: Return, ye backsliding children, {and} I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come to thee; for thou {art} the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly in vain {is salvation hoped for} from the hills, {and from} the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God {is} the salvation of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return to me: and if thou wilt put away thy abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not be removed.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench {it}, because of the evil of your doings.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare ye in Judah, and proclaim in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, confirm, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities.

column.name: text
column.value: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: For this gird yourselves with sackcloth, lament and wail: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, {that} the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; though the sword reacheth to the soul.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} a full wind from those {places} shall come to me: now also will I give sentence against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots {shall be} as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! for we are laid waste.

column.name: text
column.value: O Jerusalem, wash thy heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

column.name: text
column.value: For a voice declareth from Dan, and proclaimeth affliction from mount Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, proclaim against Jerusalem, {that} watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: As keepers of a field, they are against her on all sides; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy way and thy doings have procured these {things} to thee; this {is} thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth to thy heart.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart, my heart! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

column.name: text
column.value: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is laid waste: suddenly are my tents ruined, {and} my curtains in a moment.

column.name: text
column.value: How long shall I see the standard, {and} hear the sound of the trumpet?

column.name: text
column.value: For my people {are} foolish, they have not known me; they {are} silly children, and they have no understanding: they {are} wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld the earth, and, lo, {it was} without form, and void; and the heavens, and they {had} no light.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld, and, lo, {there was} no man, and all the fowls of the heavens had fled.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place {was} a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of the LORD, {and} by his fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

column.name: text
column.value: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken {it}, I have purposed {it}, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

column.name: text
column.value: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city {shall be} forsaken, and not a man dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when} thou {art} laid waste, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou enlarge thy eyes with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; {thy} lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, {and} the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, {that} bewaileth herself, {that} spreadeth her hands, {saying}, Woe {is} me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

column.name: text
column.value: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in her broad places, if ye can find a man, if there is {any} that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, {are} not thy eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, {but} they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I said, Surely these {are} poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, {nor} the judgment of their God.

column.name: text
column.value: I will go to the great men, and will speak to them; for they have known the way of the LORD, {and} the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, {and} burst the bonds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore a lion from the forest shall slay them, {and} a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out from there shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, {and} their backslidings are increased.

column.name: text
column.value: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by {them that are} no gods: when I had fed them to the full, then they committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.

column.name: text
column.value: They were {as} fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not punish for these {things}? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they {are} not the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They have denied the LORD, and said, {It is} not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

column.name: text
column.value: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word {is} not in them: thus shall it be done to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

column.name: text
column.value: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it {is} a mighty nation, it {is} an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

column.name: text
column.value: Their quiver {is} as an open sepulchre, they {are} all mighty men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread, {which} thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish with the sword thy fortified cities, in which thou didst trust.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Why doeth the LORD our God all these {things} to us? then shalt thou answer them, As ye have forsaken me, and served foreign gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land {that is} not yours.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and proclaim it in Judah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; who have eyes, and see not; who have ears, and hear not:

column.name: text
column.value: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand {for} the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though its waves toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

column.name: text
column.value: But this people have a revolting and a rebellious heart; they have revolted and gone.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in its season: he reserveth to us the appointed weeks of harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Your iniquities have turned away these {things}, and your sins have withheld good {things} from you.

column.name: text
column.value: For among my people are found wicked {men}: they lie in wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

column.name: text
column.value: As a cage is full of birds, so {are} their houses full of deceit: therefore they have become great, and have grown rich.

column.name: text
column.value: They have become fat, they shine: yea, they exceed the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not punish for these {things}? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

column.name: text
column.value: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

column.name: text

column.value: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for to thee have I revealed my cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, {even} the year of their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: Righteous {art} thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me speak with thee of {thy} judgments: Why doth the way of the wicked prosper? {why} are they all happy that deal very treacherously?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou {art} near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried my heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell in it? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and {if} in the land of peace, {in which} thou didst trust, {they wearied thee}, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

column.name: text
column.value: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I have forsaken my house, I have left my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: My heritage is to me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

column.name: text
column.value: My heritage {is} to me {as} a speckled bird, the birds on every side {are} against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

column.name: text
column.value: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: They have made it desolate, {and being} desolate it mourneth to me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth {it} to heart.

column.name: text
column.value: The spoilers have come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the {one} end of the land even to the {other} end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

column.name: text
column.value: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, {but} shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD against all my evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, after I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah mourneth, and her gates languish; they are black to the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

column.name: text
column.value: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, {and} found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Because the ground is parched, for there was no rain on the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook {it}, because there was no grass.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wild donkeys stood in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes failed, because {there was} no grass.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou {it} for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: O the hope of Israel, his saviour in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man {that} turneth aside to tarry for a night?

column.name: text
column.value: Why shouldest thou be as a man dismayed, as a mighty man {that} cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, {art} in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD to this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not restrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and punish their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me, Pray not for this people for {their} good.

column.name: text
column.value: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say to them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the LORD said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I have not sent them, neither have I commanded them, neither spoken to them: they prophesy to you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt say this word to them; Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

column.name: text
column.value: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

column.name: text
column.value: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul abhorred Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and {there is} no healing for us? we looked for peace, and {there is} no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

column.name: text
column.value: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, {and} the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not abhor {us}, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

column.name: text
column.value: Are there {any} among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? {art} not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these {things}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD to me, Go and purchase a linen waistband, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

column.name: text
column.value: So I bought a waistband according to the word of the LORD, and put {it} on my loins.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me the second time, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take the waistband that thou hast bought, which {is} upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.

column.name: text
column.value: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said to me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the waistband from there, which I commanded thee to hide there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went to Euphrates, and dug, and took the waistband from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the waistband was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this waistband, which is good for nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the waistband cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave to me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be to me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt speak to them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say to thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou say to them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he shall cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he shall turn it into the shadow of death, {and} make {it} gross darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for {your} pride; and my eye shall weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because the LORD'S flock is carried away captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Say to the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, {even} the crown of your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open {them}: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where {is} the flock {that} was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

column.name: text
column.value: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them {to be} captains, {and} as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

column.name: text
column.value: And if thou shalt say in thy heart, Why come these things upon me? For the greatness of thy iniquity are thy skirts uncovered, {and} thy heels made bare.

column.name: text
column.value: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? {then} may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I uncover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen thy adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy harlotry, {and} thy abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe to thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when {shall it} once {be}?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, {yet} my mind {could} not {be} toward this people: cast {them} out of my sight, and let them go forth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if they say to thee, Where shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as {are} for death, to death; and such as {are} for the sword, to the sword; and such as {are} for the famine, to the famine; and such as {are} for the captivity, to the captivity.

column.name: text
