column.value: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for {that} which he did in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask concerning thy welfare?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave {them} of children, I will destroy my people, {since} they return not from their ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Their widows are multiplied to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused {him} to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

column.name: text
column.value: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath breathed her last; her sun is gone down while {it was} yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the remnant of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on interest, nor have men lent to me on interest; {yet} every one of them doth curse me.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee {well} in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and {that} for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make {thee} to pass with thy enemies into a land {which} thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in my anger, {which} shall burn upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy words were found, and I ate them; and thy word was to me the joy and rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, {which} refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether to me as a liar, {and as} waters {that} fail?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou shalt return, then will I bring thee again, {and} thou shalt stand before me: and if thou shalt separate the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return to thee; but return not thou to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thee to this people a fortified brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I {am} with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will deliver thee from the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee from the hand of the terrible.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came also to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons nor daughters in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bore them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

column.name: text
column.value: They shall die by grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; {but} they shall be as refuse upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their dead bodies shall be food for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, {even} lovingkindness and mercies.

column.name: text
column.value: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall {men} lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall {men} tear {themselves} for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall {men} give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou shalt not go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt show this people all these words, and they shall say to thee, Why hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what {is} our iniquity? or what {is} our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou say to them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, {neither} ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not show you favour.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: But, The LORD liveth, that brought the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands where he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send for many fishermen, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and afterwards will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

column.name: text
column.value: For my eyes {are} upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled my inheritance with the dead bodies of their detestable and abominable things.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come to thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and {things} in which {there is} no profit.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall a man make gods to himself, and they {are} no gods?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name {is} The LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The sin of Judah {is} written with a pen of iron, {and} with the point of a diamond: {it is} graven upon the tablet of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

column.name: text
column.value: While their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

column.name: text
column.value: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance {and} all thy treasures to the spoil, {and} thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, even thyself, shall discontinue from thy heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thy enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in my anger, {which} shall burn for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed {be} the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, {in} a salt land and not inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and {that} spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be anxious in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: The heart {is} deceitful above all {things}, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

column.name: text
column.value: I the LORD search the heart, {I} try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, {and} according to the fruit of his doings.

column.name: text
column.value: {As} the partridge sitteth {on eggs}, and hatcheth {them} not; {so} he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

column.name: text
column.value: A glorious high throne from the beginning {is} the place of our sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, {and} they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.

column.name: text
column.value: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou {art} my praise.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, they say to me, Where {is} the word of the LORD? let it come now.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, I have not hastened from {being} a shepherd to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which was uttered by my lips was {right} before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not a terror to me: thou {art} my hope in the day of evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus said the LORD to me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: And say to them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter by these gates:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring {it} in by the gates of Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken to me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work in it;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, to the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not hearken to me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as it seemed good to the potter to make {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay {is} in the potter's hand, so {are} ye in my hand, O house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: {At what} instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy {it};

column.name: text
column.value: If that nation, against which I have pronounced, shall turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And {at what} instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant {it};

column.name: text
column.value: If it shall do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, with which I said I would benefit them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore come, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plot against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Will {a man} leave the snow of Lebanon {which cometh} from the rock of the field? {or} shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

column.name: text
column.value: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways {from} the ancient paths, to walk in paths, {in} a way not cast up;

column.name: text
column.value: To make their land desolate, {and} a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shake his head.

column.name: text
column.value: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

column.name: text
column.value: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, {and} to turn away thy wrath from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore deliver their children to the famine, and pour out their {blood} by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and {be} widows; and let their men be put to death; {let} their young men {be} slain by the sword in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have dug a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay {me}: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal {thus} with them in the time of thy anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and {take} of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

column.name: text
column.value: And go forth to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which {is} by the entrance of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, which whoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

column.name: text
column.value: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire {for} burnt offerings to Baal, which I commanded not, nor spoke {it}, neither came {it} into my mind:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their dead bodies will I give to be food for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth by it shall be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and distress, with which their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall distress them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

column.name: text
column.value: And shalt say to them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as {one} breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury {them} in Tophet, till {there be} no place to bury.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I do to this place, saith the LORD, and to its inhabitants, and {even} make this city as Tophet:

column.name: text
column.value: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense to all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD'S house; and said to all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who {was} also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pashur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that {were} in the high gate of Benjamin, which {was} by the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah to him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magormissabib.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thy eyes shall behold {it}: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all its labours, and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, who shall plunder them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thy house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

column.name: text
column.value: For since I spoke, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach to me, and a derision, daily.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But {his word} was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not {refrain}.

column.name: text
column.value: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, {say they}, and we will report it. All my friends watched for my fall, {saying}, Perhaps he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD {is} with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: {their} everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

column.name: text
column.value: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, {and} seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for to thee have I opened my cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Sing to the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} the day when I was born: let not the day when my mother bore me be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: Cursed {be} the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A son is born to thee; making him very glad.

column.name: text
column.value: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noon;

column.name: text
column.value: Because he slew me not in the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb {to be} always great {with me}.

column.name: text
column.value: Why was I brought out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

column.name: text
column.value: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; it may be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jeremiah to them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that {are} in your hands, with which ye fight against the king of Babylon, and {against} the Chaldeans, who besiege you outside the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

column.name: text
column.value: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die by a great pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: And to this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

column.name: text
column.value: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prize.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning the house of the king of Judah, {say}, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver {him that is} made desolate out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench {it}, because of the evil of your doings.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I {am} against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, {and} rock of the plain, saith the LORD; who say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

column.name: text
column.value: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in its forest, and it shall devour all things on every side of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter by these gates:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver him that is laid waste out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD to the king's house of Judah; Thou {art} Gilead to me, {and} the head of Lebanon: {yet} surely I will make thee a wilderness, {and} cities {which} are not inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast {them} into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Why hath the LORD done thus to this great city?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

column.name: text
column.value: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: {but} weep bitterly for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD concerning Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, who went forth from this place; He shall not return there any more:

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall die in the place where they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; {that} useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

column.name: text
column.value: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and {it is} panelled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

column.name: text
column.value: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest {thyself} in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, {and} then {it was} well with him?

column.name: text
column.value: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then {it was} well {with him: was} not this to know me? saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But thy eyes and thy heart {are} only for thy covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, {saying}, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, {saying}, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

column.name: text
column.value: He shall be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passes: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke to thee in thy prosperity; {but} thou saidst, I will not hear. This {hath been} thy manner from thy youth, that thou didst obey not my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: The wind shall eat up all thy shepherds, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee from there;

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand {of them} whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bore thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the land where they desire to return, there shall they not return.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} this man Coniah a despised broken idol? {is he} a vessel in which {is} no pleasure? why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

column.name: text
column.value: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man {that} shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe be to the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the shepherds that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will gather the remnant of my flock from all countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set shepherds over them who shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell in safety: and this {is} his name by which he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, who brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: But, The LORD liveth, who brought and who led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries where I have driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

column.name: text
column.value: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force {is} not right.

column.name: text
column.value: For both prophet and priest are profane; even, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore their way shall be to them as slippery {paths} in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall in it: for I will bring evil upon them, {even} the year of their punishment, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not to the words of the prophets that prophesy to you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, {and} not from the mouth of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They say still to them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say to every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he shall have executed, and till he shall have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

column.name: text
column.value: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

column.name: text
column.value: {Am} I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?

column.name: text
column.value: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

column.name: text
column.value: How long shall {this} be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, {they are} prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

column.name: text
column.value: Who think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What {is} the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} not my word like a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer {that} breaketh the rock in pieces?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I {am} against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I {am} against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I {am} against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their reckless boasting; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What {is} the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say to them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent to you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave to you and your fathers, {and cast you} out of my presence:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD showed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs {were} set before the temple of the LORD, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: One basket {had} very good figs, {even} like the figs {that are} first ripe: and the other basket {had} very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for {their} good.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will set my eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull {them} down; and I will plant them, and not pluck {them} up.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I {am} the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return to me with their whole heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And as the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so bad; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for {their} hurt, {to be} a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD'S house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD'S house, all the words that I command thee to speak to them; diminish not a word:

column.name: text
column.value: It may be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent of the evil, which I purpose to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

column.name: text
column.value: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you, both rising early, and sending {them}, but ye have not hearkened;

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had finished speaking all that the LORD had commanded {him} to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

column.name: text
column.value: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house to the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entrance of the new gate of the LORD'S {house}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, This man {is} worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

column.name: text
column.value: As for me, behold, I {am} in your hand: do with me as it seemeth good and right to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, upon this city, and upon its inhabitants: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the princes and all the people to the priests and to the prophets; This man {is} not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then arose certain of the elders of the land, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed {like} a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

column.name: text
column.value: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? did he not fear the LORD, and beseech the LORD, and the LORD repented of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

column.name: text
column.value: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, {namely}, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and {certain} men with him into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought forth Urijah from Egypt, and brought him to Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the burial place of the common people.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that {was} the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: Which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even to this day, that {is} the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD hath sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending {them}; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

column.name: text
column.value: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given to you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

column.name: text
column.value: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye have not hearkened to me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own harm.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations on every side, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an horror, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

column.name: text
column.value: And this whole land shall be a desolation, {and} an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, {that} I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, {even} all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: For many nations and great kings shall be served by them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel to me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall drink, and be moved, and go mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I took the cup at the LORD'S hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom the LORD had sent me:

column.name: text
column.value: {That is}, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to make them a desolation, an horror, an hissing, and a curse; as {it is} this day;

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

column.name: text
column.value: And all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

column.name: text
column.value: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which {are} beyond the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all {that are} in the utmost corners,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people that dwell in the desert,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

column.name: text
column.value: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which {are} upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunk, and vomit, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thy hand to drink, then shalt thou say to them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say to them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread {the grapes}, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: A noise shall come {even} to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them {that are} wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised from the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from {one} end of the earth even to the {other} end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be refuse upon the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves {in the ashes}, ye chief of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the chief of the flock to escape.

column.name: text
column.value: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and a wailing of the chief of the flock, {shall be heard}: for the LORD hath laid waste their pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make for thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

column.name: text
column.value: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: And command them to say to their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to your masters;

column.name: text
column.value: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that {are} upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it to whom it seemed right to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

column.name: text
column.value: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land shall come: and then many nations and great kings shall bring him into subjection.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hearken ye not to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: For they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

column.name: text
column.value: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: I spoke also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

column.name: text
column.value: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hearken not to the words of the prophets that speak to you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD'S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken not to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: why should this city be laid waste?

column.name: text
column.value: But if they are prophets, and if the word of the LORD is with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and {in} the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that remain in this city,

column.name: text
column.value: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain {in} the house of the LORD, and {in} the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

column.name: text
column.value: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, {and} in the fifth month, {that} Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, who {was} of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD'S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD'S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless now hear thou this word that I speak in thy ears, and in the ears of all the people;

column.name: text
column.value: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: The prophet who prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, {then} shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and broke it.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the prophet Jeremiah to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the rest of the elders who were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: (After Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, had departed from Jerusalem;)

column.name: text
column.value: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, to all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem to Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: Build ye houses, and dwell {in them}; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

column.name: text
column.value: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

column.name: text
column.value: And seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray to the LORD for it: for in the peace of it ye shall have peace.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that are in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

column.name: text
column.value: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years shall be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray to me, and I will hearken to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall seek me, and find {me}, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will be found by you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place from which I caused you to be carried away captive.

column.name: text
column.value: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised up for us prophets in Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: {Know} that thus saith the LORD concerning the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and concerning all the people that dwelleth in this city, {and} concerning your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so bad.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an horror, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations where I have driven them:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent to them by my servants the prophets, rising early and sending {them}; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah who {are} in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

column.name: text
column.value: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbour's wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and {am} a witness, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {Thus} shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name to all the people that {are} at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man {that is} mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, who maketh himself a prophet to you?

column.name: text
column.value: For therefore he sent to us {in} Babylon, saying, This {captivity is} long: build ye houses, and dwell {in them}; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because Shemaiah hath prophesied to you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time, saith the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, The people {who were} left by the sword found grace in the wilderness; {even} Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD appeared of old to me, {saying}, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat {them} as common things.

column.name: text
column.value: For there shall be a day, {that} the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion to the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: proclaim ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the ends of the earth, {and} with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return there.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, in which they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim {is} my firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare {it} in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd {doth} his flock.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of {him that was} stronger than he.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for grain, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will abundantly satisfy the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, {and} bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they {were} not.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Restrain thy voice from weeping, and thy eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And there is hope in thy end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.

column.name: text
column.value: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself {thus}; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bull unaccustomed {to the yoke}: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou {art} the LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely after I was turned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I smote upon {my} thigh: I was ashamed, and even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} Ephraim my dear son? {is he} a pleasant child? for since I spoke against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my heart is troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thy heart toward the highway, {even} the way {which} thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

column.name: text
column.value: How long wilt thou wander about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall encompass a man.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall bring again their captives; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, mountain of holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all its cities together, farmers, and they {that} go forth with flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have abundantly satisfied the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon this I awoke, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.

column.name: text
column.value: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day {that} I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they broke, although I was an husband to them, saith the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: But this {shall be} the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them, saith the LORD: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD, who giveth the sun for a light by day, {and} the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who divideth the sea when its waves roar; The LORD of hosts {is} his name:

column.name: text
column.value: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, {then} the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel to the gate of the corner.

column.name: text
column.value: And the measuring line shall yet go forth straight forward over the hill Gareb, and shall turn toward Goath.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook of Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, {shall be} holy to the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write for thee all the words that I have spoken to thee in a book.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captives of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? Why do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

column.name: text
column.value: Alas! for that day {is} great, so that none {is} like it: it {is} even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, {that} I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more bring him into subjection:

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and quiet, and none shall make {him} afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {am} with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations where I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise {is} incurable, {and} thy wound {is} grievous.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

column.name: text
column.value: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thy iniquity; {because} thy sins were increased.

column.name: text
column.value: Why criest thou over thy affliction? thy sorrow {is} incurable for the multitude of thy iniquity: {because} thy sins were increased, I have done these things to thee.
