column.value: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove {that} maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness, and his arrogance, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but {it shall} not {be} so; his lies shall not so effect {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I wail for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; {my heart} shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.

column.name: text
column.value: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants have gone over the sea, they reach {even} to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler hath fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

column.name: text
column.value: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; {their} shouting {shall be} no shouting.

column.name: text
column.value: From the cry of Heshbon {even} to Elealeh, {and even} to Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar {even} to Horonaim, {as} an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches {that} he hath gotten have perished.

column.name: text
column.value: For every head {shall be} bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands {shall be} cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

column.name: text
column.value: {There shall be} lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets: for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which {is} no pleasure, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall wail, {saying}, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moab shall be destroyed from {being} a people, because he hath magnified {himself} against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, {shall be} upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, {even} upon Moab, the year of their punishment, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe be to thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far {is} the judgment of Moab.

column.name: text
column.value: The word that the LORD spoke against Babylon {and} against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare ye among the nations, and proclaim, and set up a standard; proclaim, {and} conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of the north there cometh a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell in it: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces toward it, {saying}, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant {that} shall not be forgotten.

column.name: text
column.value: My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away {on} the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

column.name: text
column.value: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth from the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from there she shall be taken: their arrows {shall be} as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Chaldea shall be a prey: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of my heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

column.name: text
column.value: Your mother shall be greatly confounded; she that bore you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations {shall be} a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

column.name: text
column.value: Put yourselves in array against Babylon on every side: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Shout against her on every side: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it {is} the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do to her.

column.name: text
column.value: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Israel {is} a scattered sheep; the lions have driven {him} away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and {there shall be} none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up against the land of Merathaim, {even} against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

column.name: text
column.value: A sound of battle {is} in the land, and of great destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

column.name: text
column.value: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this {is} the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

column.name: text
column.value: Slay all her bulls; let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them! for their day is come, the time of their punishment.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of them that flee and escape from the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, encamp against it on every side; let none of them escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do to her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore her young men shall fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I {am} against thee, {O thou} most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time {that} I will punish thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all around him.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah {were} oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: Their Redeemer {is} strong; the LORD of hosts {is} his name: he shall thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword {is} upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword {is} upon the liars; and they shall become fools: a sword {is} upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

column.name: text
column.value: A sword {is} upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mixed people that {are} in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword {is} upon her treasuries; and they shall be robbed.

column.name: text
column.value: A drought {is} upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it {is} the land of graven images, and they are mad over {their} idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the isles shall dwell {there}, and the owls shall dwell in it: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbour {cities}, saith the LORD; {so} shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they {are} cruel, and will not show mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, {every one} put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands became feeble: anguish took hold of him, {and} pangs as of a woman in travail.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan to the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who {is} a chosen {man, that} I may appoint over her? for who {is} like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who {is} that shepherd that will stand before me?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make {their} habitation desolate with them.

column.name: text
column.value: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why {then} doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir to them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird yourselves with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, {and} his priests and his princes together.

column.name: text
column.value: Why gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, {saying}, Who shall come to me?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that are about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward I will bring again the captives of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; {Is} wisdom no more in Teman? hath counsel perished from the prudent? hath their wisdom vanished?

column.name: text
column.value: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time {that} I will punish him.

column.name: text
column.value: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave {some} gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is laid waste, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he {is} not.

column.name: text
column.value: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve {them} alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment {was} not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunk; and {art} thou he {that} shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink {of it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all its cities shall be perpetual wastes.

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent to the heathen, {saying}, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, {and} despised among men.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, {and} the pride of thy heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from there, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all its plagues.

column.name: text
column.value: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbour {cities}, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who {is} a chosen {man, that} I may appoint over her? for who {is} like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who {is} that shepherd that will stand before me?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise of it was heard in the Red sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; {there is} sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

column.name: text
column.value: Damascus hath become feeble, {and} turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on {her}: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

column.name: text
column.value: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and lay waste the men of the east.

column.name: text
column.value: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry to them, Fear {is} on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee, go far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go up to the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, {which} dwell alone.

column.name: text
column.value: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them {that are} in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides of it, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, {and} a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor {any} son of man dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation where the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, {even} my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there the king and the princes, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, {that} I will bring again the captives of Elam, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

column.name: text
column.value: And will send to Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: Against {him that} bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against {him that} lifteth himself up in his coat of mail: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and {they that are} thrust through in her streets.

column.name: text
column.value: For Israel {hath} not {been} forsaken, nor Judah by his God, by the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee from the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this {is} the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render to her a recompence.

column.name: text
column.value: Babylon {hath been} a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunk: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

column.name: text
column.value: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: wail for her; take balm for her pain, it may be she may be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth to heaven, and is lifted {even} to the skies.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

column.name: text
column.value: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his purpose {is} against Babylon, to destroy it; because it {is} the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.

column.name: text
column.value: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spoke against the inhabitants of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thy end is come, {and} the measure of thy covetousness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, {saying}, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall raise a shout against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: When he uttereth {his} voice, {there is} a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries.

column.name: text
column.value: Every man is stupid by {his} knowledge; every goldsmith is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image {is} falsehood, and {there is} no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They {are} vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their punishment they shall perish.

column.name: text
column.value: The portion of Jacob {is} not like them; for he {is} the one who formed of all things: and {Israel is} the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou {art} my battle axe {and} weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

column.name: text
column.value: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and its rider;

column.name: text
column.value: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

column.name: text
column.value: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the farmer and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will render to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I {am} against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

column.name: text
column.value: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of Media, their captains, and all their rulers, and all the land of his dominion.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they have remained in {their} strong holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

column.name: text
column.value: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken at {one} end,

column.name: text
column.value: And that the fords are seized, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are terrified.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon {is} like a threshingfloor, {it is} time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicacies, he hath cast me out.

column.name: text
column.value: The violence done to me and to my flesh {be} upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

column.name: text
column.value: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an horror, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.

column.name: text
column.value: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

column.name: text
column.value: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an horror among the nations!

column.name: text
column.value: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of its waves.

column.name: text
column.value: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land in which no man dwelleth, neither doth {any} son of man pass by it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed: and the nations shall not flow together any more to him: even the wall of Babylon shall fall.

column.name: text
column.value: My people, depart from the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And lest your heart should faint, and ye should fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come {one} year, and after that in {another} year {shall come} a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will execute judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that {is} in them, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come to her from the north, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: As Babylon {hath caused} the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

column.name: text
column.value: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for foreigners are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD'S house.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will execute judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

column.name: text
column.value: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, {yet} from me shall spoilers come to her, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: A sound of a cry {cometh} from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

column.name: text
column.value: Because the LORD hath laid waste Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

column.name: text
column.value: Because the spoiler is come upon her, {even} upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely repay.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise {men}, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name {is} the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the people in the fire, and they shall be weary.

column.name: text
column.value: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And {this} Seraiah {was} a quiet prince.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, {even} all these words that are written against Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou shalt come to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when thou hast finished reading this book, {that} thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far {are} the words of Jeremiah.

column.name: text
column.value: Zedekiah {was} one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name {was} Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did {that which was} evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

column.name: text
column.value: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth {day} of the month, {that} Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it, and built forts against it on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fourth month, in the ninth {day} of the month, the famine was great in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth from the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which {was} by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans {were} by the city on all sides:) and they went by the way of the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took the king, and carried him to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth {day} of the month, which {was} the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, {who} served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great {men}, he burned with fire:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that {were} with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive {certain} of the poor of the people, and the rest of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left {certain} of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for farmers.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the pillars of brass that {were} in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that {was} in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans broke, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass by which they ministered, they took away.

column.name: text
column.value: And the basins, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the lampstands, and the spoons, and the cups; {that} which {was} of gold {in} gold, and {that} which {was} of silver {in} silver, the captain of the guard took away.

column.name: text
column.value: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that {were} under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

column.name: text
column.value: And {concerning} the pillars, the height of one pillar {was} eighteen cubits; and a band of twelve cubits surrounded it; and the thickness of it {was} four fingers: {it was} hollow.

column.name: text
column.value: And a capital of brass {was} upon it; and the height of one capital {was} five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the capitals around, all {of} brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates {were} like these.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; {and} all the pomegranates upon the network {were} an hundred on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

column.name: text
column.value: He took also out of the city an eunuch, who had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, who were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty and two persons:

column.name: text
column.value: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred and forty and five persons: all the persons {were} four thousand and six hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth {day} of the month, {that} Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the {first} year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him out of prison,

column.name: text
column.value: And spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that {were} with him in Babylon,

column.name: text
column.value: And changed his prison garments: and he continually ate bread before him all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: And {for} his food, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the man {that} hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath led me, and brought {me into} darkness, but not {into} light.

column.name: text
column.value: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand {against me} all the day.

column.name: text
column.value: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath besieged me, and surrounded {me} with gall and travail.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath set me in dark places, as {they that are} dead of old.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

column.name: text
column.value: He {was} to me {as} a bear lying in wait, {and as} a lion in secret places.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

column.name: text
column.value: I was a derision to all my people; {and} their song all the day.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunk with wormwood.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgot prosperity.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, My strength and my hope hath perished from the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Remembering my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

column.name: text
column.value: My soul hath {them} still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

column.name: text
column.value: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is of} the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

column.name: text
column.value: {They are} new every morning: great {is} thy faithfulness.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {is} good to them that wait for him, to the soul {that} seeketh him.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} good that {a man} should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} good for a man that he should bear the yoke in his youth.

column.name: text
column.value: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne {it} upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if there may be hope.

column.name: text
column.value: He giveth {his} cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: But though he causeth grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

column.name: text
column.value: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

column.name: text
column.value: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

column.name: text
column.value: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is} he {that} saith, and it cometh to pass, {when} the Lord commandeth {it} not?

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

column.name: text
column.value: Why doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

column.name: text
column.value: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us lift up our heart with {our} hands to God in the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that {our} prayer should not pass through.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast made us {as} the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: My eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: My eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

column.name: text
column.value: Till the LORD shall look down, and behold from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: My eye affecteth my heart because of all the daughters of my city.

column.name: text
column.value: My enemies chased me hard, like a bird, without cause.

column.name: text
column.value: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Waters flowed over my head; {then} I said, I am cut off.

column.name: text
column.value: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thy ear at my breathing, at my cry.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou drewest near in the day {that} I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast seen all their vengeance {and} all their imaginations against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, {and} all their imaginations against me;

column.name: text
column.value: The lips of those that rose up against me, and they plot against me all the day.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I {am} their music.

column.name: text
column.value: Render to them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, {and} cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought {them} down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and its princes.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath cut off in {his} fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, {which} devoureth on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all {that were} pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as {if it were of} a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and in the indignation of his anger hath despised the king and the priest.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

column.name: text
column.value: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes {are} among the Gentiles: the law {is} no {more}; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, {and} keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: My eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: They say to their mothers, Where {is} grain and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.

column.name: text
column.value: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach {is} great like the sea: who can heal thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not revealed thy iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

column.name: text
column.value: All that pass by clap {their} hands at thee; they hiss and shake their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, {saying, Is} this the city that {men} call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

column.name: text
column.value: All thy enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed {her} up: certainly this {is} the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath done {that} which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused {thy} enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thy adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: Their heart cried to the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thy eye cease.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thy heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

column.name: text
column.value: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword; thou hast slain {them} in the day of thy anger; thou hast killed, {and} not pitied.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors on every side, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath my enemy consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: How doth the city sit desolate, {that was} full of people! {how} is she become as a widow! she {that was} great among the nations, {and} princess among the provinces, {how} is she become a forced labourer!

column.name: text
column.value: She weepeth bitterly in the night, and her tears {are} on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort {her}: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her in the midst of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she {is} in bitterness.

column.name: text
column.value: Her adversaries are the head, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty hath departed: her princes are become like harts {that} find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none helped her: the adversaries saw her, {and} mocked at her sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

column.name: text
column.value: Her filthiness {is} in her skirts; she remembereth not her latter end; therefore she hath been marvellously abased: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified {himself}.

column.name: text
column.value: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen {that} the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command {that} they should not enter into thy congregation.

column.name: text
column.value: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for food to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is it} nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which hath fallen upon me, which the LORD hath afflicted {me} in the day of his fierce anger.

column.name: text
column.value: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate {and} faint all the day.

column.name: text
column.value: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are knit together, {and} come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into {their} hands, {from whom} I am not able to rise.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty {men} in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, {as} in a winepress.

column.name: text
column.value: For these {things} I weep; my eye, my eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, {and there is} none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, {that} his adversaries {should be} around him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: I called for my lovers, {but} they deceived me: my priests and my elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their food to relieve their souls.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, O LORD; for I {am} in distress: my heart is troubled; my heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home {there is} as death.

column.name: text
column.value: They have heard that I sigh: {there is} none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done {it}: thou wilt bring the day {that} thou hast called, and they shall be like me.

column.name: text
column.value: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do to them, as thou hast done to me for all my transgressions: for my sighs {are} many, and my heart {is} faint.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

column.name: text
column.value: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers {are} as widows.

column.name: text
column.value: We drank our water for money; our wood is sold to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Our necks {are} under persecution: we labour, {and} have no rest.

column.name: text
column.value: We have given the hand {to} the Egyptians, {and to} the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers have sinned, {and are} not; and we have borne their iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: Servants have ruled over us: {there is} none that doth deliver {us} out of their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: We got our bread with {the peril of} our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

column.name: text
column.value: They ravished the women in Zion, {and} the maids in the cities of Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: Princes are hanged by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

column.name: text
column.value: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.

column.name: text
column.value: The joy of our heart hath ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

column.name: text
column.value: The crown is fallen {from} our head: woe to us, that we have sinned!

column.name: text
column.value: For this our heart is faint; for these {things} our eyes are dim.

column.name: text
column.value: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Why dost thou forget us for ever, {and} forsake us so long time?

column.name: text
column.value: Turn thou us to thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very angry with us.

column.name: text
column.value: How is the gold become dim! {how} is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

column.name: text
column.value: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

column.name: text
column.value: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they nurse their young ones: the daughter of my people {is become} cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: The tongue of the nursing child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, {and} no man breaketh {it} to them.

column.name: text
column.value: They that fed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

column.name: text
column.value: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, with no hands laid on her.

column.name: text
column.value: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing {was} of sapphire:

column.name: text
column.value: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

column.name: text
column.value: {They that are} slain with the sword are better than {they that are} slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for {lack of} the fruits of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: The hands of the tenderhearted women have boiled their own children: they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured its foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sins of her prophets, {and} the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

column.name: text
column.value: They have wandered {as} blind {men} in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: They cried to them, Depart ye; {it is} unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn {there}.

column.name: text
column.value: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no longer regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation {that} could not save {us}.

column.name: text
column.value: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

column.name: text
column.value: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through to thee: thou shalt be drunk, and shalt make thyself naked.

column.name: text
column.value: The punishment of thy iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thy iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will disclose thy sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth {month}, in the fifth {day} of the month, as I {was} among the captives by the river of Chebar, {that} the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

column.name: text
column.value: In the fifth {day} of the month, which {was} the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness {was} about it, and from the midst of it as the colour of amber, from the midst of the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Also from the midst of it {came} the likeness of four living beings. And this {was} their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

column.name: text
column.value: And their feet {were} straight feet; and the sole of their feet {was} like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

column.name: text
column.value: And {they had} the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: Their wings {were} joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus {were} their faces: and their wings {were} stretched upward; two {wings} of every one {were} joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went every one straight forward: wherever the spirit was to go, they went; {and} they turned not when they went.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the likeness of the living beings, their appearance {was} like burning coals of fire, {and} like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living beings; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: And the living beings ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as I beheld the living beings, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living beings, with his four faces.

column.name: text
column.value: The appearance of the wheels and their work {was} like the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work {was} as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: When they went, they went upon their four sides: {and} they turned not when they went.

column.name: text
column.value: As for their rims, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rims {were} full of eyes all around them four.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the living beings went, the wheels went by them: and when the living beings were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

column.name: text
column.value: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went, there {was their} spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up together with them: for the spirit of the living being {was} in the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: When those went, {these} went; and when those stood, {these} stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up together with them: for the spirit of the living being {was} in the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living being {was} as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

column.name: text
column.value: And under the firmament {were} their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a voice from the firmament that {was} over their heads, when they stood, {and} had let down their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: And above the firmament that {was} over their heads {was} the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne {was} the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire around within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness on all sides.

column.name: text
column.value: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so {was} the appearance of the brightness all around. This {was} the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw {it}, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spoke to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, {even} to this very day.

column.name: text
column.value: For {they are} impudent children and obstinate in heart. I send thee to them; and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they {are} a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns {are} with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they {are} most rebellious.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, son of man, hear what I say to thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that which I give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I looked, behold, an hand {was} sent to me; and, lo, a scroll {was} in it;

column.name: text
column.value: And he spread it before me; and it {was} written within and without: and {there was} written in it lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he said to me, Son of man, eat what thou findest; eat this scroll, and go speak to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that scroll.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, cause thy stomach to eat, and fill thy body with this scroll that I give thee. Then did I eat {it}; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, depart, go to the house of Israel, and speak with my words to them.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou {art} not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, {but} to the house of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But the house of Israel will not hearken to thee; for they will not hearken to me: for all the house of Israel {are} impudent and hardhearted.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he said to me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak to thee receive in thy heart, and hear with thy ears.

column.name: text
column.value: And depart, go to them of the captivity, to the children of thy people, and speak to them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, {saying}, Blessed {be} the glory of the LORD from his place.

column.name: text
column.value: {I heard} also the noise of the wings of the living beings that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, and the noise of a great rushing.

column.name: text
column.value: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there overwhelmed among them seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman to the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked {man} shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if thou shalt warn the wicked, and he will not turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, When a righteous {man} doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless if thou shalt warn the righteous {man}, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said to me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spoke with me, and said to me, Go, shut thyself within thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put cords upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and portray upon it the city, {even} Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mound against it; set the camp also against it, and set {battering} rams against it on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover take thou to thee an iron pan, and set it {for} a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This {shall be} a sign to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: {according} to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thy arm {shall be} uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I will lay cords upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

column.name: text
column.value: Take thou also to thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread of them, {according} to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy food which thou shalt eat {shall be} by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt eat it {as} barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, where I will drive them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither hath abominable flesh come into my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he said to me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and in horror:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may lack bread and water, and be appalled one with another, and pine away for their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause {it} to pass upon thy head and upon thy beard: then take to thee balances to weigh, and divide the {hair}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, {and} smite about it with a sword: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt also take of them a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

column.name: text
column.value: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; from which a fire shall come forth into all the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This {is} Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries {that are} around her.

column.name: text
column.value: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that {are} around her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that {are} around you, {and} have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that {are} around you;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, {am} against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

column.name: text
