column.value: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and the like of which I will not do any more, because of all thy abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thy abominations, therefore I will also diminish {thee}; neither shall my eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

column.name: text
column.value: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword around thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall my anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken {it} in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that {are} around thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

column.name: text
column.value: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an horror to the nations that {are} around thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for {their} destruction, {and} which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

column.name: text
column.value: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD to the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {is} the end {come} upon thee, and I will send my anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thy abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And my eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thy abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

column.name: text
column.value: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.

column.name: text
column.value: The morning is come upon thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble {is} near, and not the joyful shouting upon the mountains.

column.name: text
column.value: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish my anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thy abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thy abominations {that} are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD that smiteth.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

column.name: text
column.value: Violence hath risen into a rod of wickedness: none of them {shall remain}, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither {shall there be} wailing for them.

column.name: text
column.value: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath {is} upon all their multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision {is} concerning their whole multitude, {who} shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

column.name: text
column.value: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath {is} upon all their multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: The sword {is} without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that {is} in the field shall die with the sword; and he that {is} in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

column.name: text
column.value: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak {as} water.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also gird {themselves} with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame {shall be} upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their stomachs: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations {and} of their detestable things in it: therefore have I set it far from them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

column.name: text
column.value: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret {place}: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

column.name: text
column.value: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and {there shall be} none.

column.name: text
column.value: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do to them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth {month}, in the fifth {day} of the month, {as} I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where {was} the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel {was} there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Son of man, lift up thy eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entrance.

column.name: text
column.value: He said furthermore to me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? {even} the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should withdraw from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had dug in the wall, behold a door.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

column.name: text
column.value: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around upon the wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: He said also to me, Turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD'S house which {was} toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Hast thou seen {this}, O son of man? turn thee yet again, {and} thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD'S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, {were} about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, Hast thou seen {this}, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I also deal in fury: my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, {yet} I will not hear them.

column.name: text
column.value: He cried also in my ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man {with} his destroying weapon in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them {was} clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub, on which he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, who {had} the writer's inkhorn by his side;

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that are done in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the others he said in my hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:

column.name: text
column.value: Slay utterly old {and} young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom {is} the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the elders who {were} before the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy the whole remnant of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah {is} exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.

column.name: text
column.value: And as for me also, my eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, {but} I will recompense their way upon their head.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, who {had} the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubim there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, {even} under the cherub, and fill thy hand with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter {them} over the city. And he entered in my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, {and stood} over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD'S glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sound of the cherubim's wings was heard {even} to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubim; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that {was} between the cherubim, and took {of it}, and put {it} into the hands of {him that was} clothed with linen: who took {it}, and went out.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man's hand under their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubim, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels {was} as the colour of a beryl stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

column.name: text
column.value: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, {were} full of eyes on every side, {even} the wheels that they four had.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the wheels, it was cried to them in my hearing, O wheel.

column.name: text
column.value: And every one had four faces: the first face {was} the face of a cherub, and the second face {was} the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cherubim were lifted up. This {is} the living being that I saw by the river of Chebar.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

column.name: text
column.value: When they stood, {these} stood; and when they were lifted up, {these} lifted up themselves {also}: for the spirit of the living being {was} in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also {were} beside them, and {every one} stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD'S house; and the glory of the God of Israel {was} over them above.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the living being that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they {were} the cherubim.

column.name: text
column.value: Every one had four faces each, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man {was} under their wings.

column.name: text
column.value: And the likeness of their faces {was} the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, {even} I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

column.name: text
column.value: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain {men} before your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones about your altars.

column.name: text
column.value: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

column.name: text
column.value: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have {some} that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations where they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their adulterous heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the harlot with their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD, {and that} I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thy hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is far off shall die by the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall ye know that I {am} the LORD, when their slain {men} shall be among their idols all around their altars, upon every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they offered sweet savour to all their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD also came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee {thy} baggage for captivity, and move by day in their sight; and thou shalt move from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they {are} a rebellious house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shalt thou bring forth thy baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for captivity: and thou shalt go forth at evening in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry {them} out through it.

column.name: text
column.value: In their sight shalt thou bear {it} upon {thy} shoulders, {and} carry {it} forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou mayest not see the ground: for I have set thee {for} a sign to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my baggage by day, as baggage for captivity, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand; I brought {it} forth in the twilight, {and} I bore {it} upon {my} shoulder in their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning came the word of the LORD to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to thee, What doest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: Say thou to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden {concerneth} the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that {are} among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Say, I {am} your sign: as I have done, so shall it be done to them: they shall move {and} go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince that {is} among them shall bear upon {his} shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry {them} out through it: he shall cover his face, that he may not see the ground with {his} eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon {to} the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter toward every wind all that {are} about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen where they come; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and anxious care;

column.name: text
column.value: And say to the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, {and} of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with anxious care, and drink their water with horror, that her land may be desolate from all that is in it, because of the violence of all them that dwell in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, what {is} that proverb {that} ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

column.name: text
column.value: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say to them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

column.name: text
column.value: For there shall no more be any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {am} the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall no more be prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, behold, {they of} the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth {is} for many days {to come}, and he prophesieth of the times {that are} distant.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be further deferred, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me to the east gate of the LORD'S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Son of man, these {are} the men that plot mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

column.name: text
column.value: Who say, {It is} not near; let us build houses: this {city is} the caldron, and we {are} the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: And the spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said to me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, {every one of} them.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled its streets with the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they {are} the flesh, and this {city is} the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring you out of the midst of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This {city} shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst of it; {but} I will judge you in the border of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I {am} the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that {are} around you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, thy brethren, {even} thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, {are} they to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Go far from the LORD: to us is this land given in possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall come there, and they shall take away from there all its detestable things and all its abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: But {as for them} whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the cherubim raised their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel {was} over them above.

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which {is} on the east side of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I spoke to them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shown me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou to them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

column.name: text
column.value: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made {others} to hope that they would confirm the word.

column.name: text
column.value: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, though ye say, The LORD saith {it}; although I have not spoken?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I {am} against you, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And my hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and {there was} no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered {mortar}:

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them who daub {it} with untempered {mortar}, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Lo, when the wall hath fallen, shall it not be said to you, Where {is} the daubing with which ye have daubed {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend {it} with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in {my} fury to consume {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered {mortar}, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation shall be made bare, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst of it: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered {mortar}, and will say to you, The wall {is} no {more}, neither they that daubed it;

column.name: text
column.value: {That is}, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and {there is} no peace, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the {women} that sew {magic} charms on all wrists, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive {that come} to you?

column.name: text
column.value: And will ye profane me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear {your} lies?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against your {magic} charms, by which ye there hunt the souls to make {them} fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, {even} the souls that ye hunt to make {them} fly.

column.name: text
column.value: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall no more be in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came certain of the elders of Israel to me, and sat before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore speak to them, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

column.name: text
column.value: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn {yourselves} from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the foreigner that sojourneth in Israel, who separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh {to him};

column.name: text
column.value: That the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break the staff of its bread, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

column.name: text
column.value: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver their own souls only by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they lay it waste, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

column.name: text
column.value: {Though} these three men {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: Or {if} I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

column.name: text
column.value: Though these three men {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Or {if} I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

column.name: text
column.value: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, {were} in it, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall deliver their own souls only by their righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four grievous judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet, behold, in it shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, {both} sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth to you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, {even} concerning all that I have brought upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, {or than} a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

column.name: text
column.value: Shall wood be taken of it to do any work? or will {men} take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the middle of it is burned. Is it fit for {any} work?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, when it was whole, it was fit for no work: how much less then shall it be fit for {any} work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from {one} fire, and {another} fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I set my face against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD to Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity {is} of the land of Canaan; thy father {was} an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to cleanse {thee}; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

column.name: text
column.value: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these to thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thy own blood, I said to thee {when thou wast} in thy blood, Live; yea, I said to thee {when thou wast} in thy blood, Live.

column.name: text
column.value: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and become great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: {thy} breasts are fashioned, and thy hair is grown, though thou {wast} naked and bare.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time {was} the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I swore to thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I washed thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

column.name: text
column.value: I clothed thee also with embroidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

column.name: text
column.value: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

column.name: text
column.value: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thy ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment {was of} fine linen, and silk, and embroidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it {was} perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou didst trust in thy own beauty, and didst play the harlot because of thy renown, and didst pour out thy harlotries on every one that passed by; his it was.

column.name: text
column.value: And of thy garments thou didst take, and didst deck thy high places with various colours, and didst play the harlot upon them: {the like things} shall not come, neither shall it be {so}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and hast made to thyself images of men, and hast committed harlotry with them,

column.name: text
column.value: And hast taken thy embroidered garments, and didst cover them: and thou hast set my oil and my incense before them.

column.name: text
column.value: My food also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, {with which} I fed thee, thou hast even set before them for a sweet savour: and {thus} it was, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne to me, and these hast thou sacrificed to them to be devoured. {Is this} of thy harlotries a small matter,

column.name: text
column.value: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through {the fire} for them?

column.name: text
column.value: And in all thy abominations and thy harlotries thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, {and} wast polluted in thy blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe to thee! saith the Lord GOD;)

column.name: text
column.value: {That} thou hast also built to thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast offered thyself to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy harlotries.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast also committed harlotry with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy harlotry, to provoke me to anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thy ordinary {food}, and delivered thee to the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of thy lewd way.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast not satisfied; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy harlotry in the land of Canaan to Chaldea; and yet with this thou wast not satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these {things}, the work of an imperious harlot;

column.name: text
column.value: In that thou buildest thy eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thy high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

column.name: text
column.value: {But as} a wife that committeth adultery, {who} taketh strangers instead of her husband!

column.name: text
column.value: They give gifts to all harlots: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come to thee on every side for thy harlotry.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou art the opposite from {other} women in thy harlotries, though none followeth thee to commit harlotries: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given to thee, therefore thou art the opposite.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy harlotries with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give to them;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all {them} that thou hast loved, with all {them} that thou hast hated; I will even gather them on every side against thee, and will uncover thy nakedness to them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thy eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

column.name: text
column.value: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast provoked me in all these {things}; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon {thy} head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thy abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use {this} proverb against thee, saying, As {is} the mother, {so is} her daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou {art} thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou {art} the sister of thy sisters, who lothed their husbands and their children: your mother {was} an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

column.name: text
column.value: And thy elder sister {is} Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, {is} Sodom and her daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as {if that were} a very little {thing}, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw {good}.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thy abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thy abominations which thou hast done.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou also, who hast judged thy sisters, bear thy own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then {will I bring again} the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest bear thy own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort to them.

column.name: text
column.value: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former state, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former state.

column.name: text
column.value: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

column.name: text
column.value: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of {thy} reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all {that are} around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise thee on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thy abominations, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish to thee an everlasting covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thy elder and thy younger: and I will give them to thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had many colours, came to Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

column.name: text
column.value: He cropped off the top of its young twigs, and carried it into a land of trade; he set it in a city of merchants.

column.name: text
column.value: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed {it} by great waters, {and} set it {as} a willow tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

column.name: text
column.value: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

column.name: text
column.value: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a well favoured vine.

column.name: text
column.value: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up its roots, and cut off its fruit, that it may wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by its roots.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, behold, {being} planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these {things mean}? tell {them}, Behold, the king of Babylon hath come to Jerusalem, and hath taken its king, and its princes, and led them with him to Babylon;

column.name: text
column.value: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath from him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

column.name: text
column.value: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, {but} that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such {things}? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place {where} the king {dwelleth} that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, {even} with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall Pharaoh with {his} mighty army and great company help him in the war, by casting up siege mounds, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these {things}, he shall not escape.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; {As} I live, surely my oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even that will I recompense upon his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

column.name: text
column.value: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set {it}; I will crop off from the top of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant {it} upon an high mountain and eminent:

column.name: text
column.value: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a well favoured cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of its branches shall they dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have {occasion} any more to use this proverb in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man is just, and doeth that which is lawful and right,

column.name: text
column.value: {And} hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a polluted woman,

column.name: text
column.value: And hath not oppressed any, {but} hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath stripped none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

column.name: text
column.value: He {that} hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, {that} hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

column.name: text
column.value: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he {is} just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: If he begetteth a son {that is} a robber, a shedder of blood, and {that} doeth the like {any} one of these {things},

column.name: text
column.value: And that doeth not any of those {duties}, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,

column.name: text
column.value: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath stripped by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

column.name: text
column.value: Hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, lo, {if} he begetteth a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not likewise,

column.name: text
column.value: {That} hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,

column.name: text
column.value: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withheld the pledge, neither hath stripped by violence, {but} hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

column.name: text
column.value: {That} hath taken off his hand from the poor, {that} hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} his father, because he cruelly oppressed, stripped his brother by violence, and did {that} which {is} not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, {and} hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

column.name: text
column.value: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned to him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: {and} not that he should return from his ways, and live?

column.name: text
column.value: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, {and} doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked {man} doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

column.name: text
column.value: When a righteous {man} turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, when a wicked {man} turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

column.name: text
column.value: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn {yourselves} from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: Cast away from you all your transgressions, by which ye have transgressed; and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: therefore turn {ye}, and live.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth {month}, the tenth {day} of the month, {that} certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge {them}? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

column.name: text
column.value: And say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up my hand to the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up my hand to them, saying, I {am} the LORD your God;

column.name: text
column.value: In the day {that} I lifted up my hand to them, to bring them forth from the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which {is} the glory of all lands:

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I to them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken to me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned before the heathen, among whom they {were}, in whose sight I made myself known to them, in bringing them forth from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I caused them to go forth from the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave them my statutes, and showed them my judgments, which {if} a man doeth, he shall even live in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I {am} the LORD that sanctify them.

column.name: text
column.value: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which {if} a man doeth, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly profaned: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

column.name: text
column.value: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet also I lifted up my hand to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given {them}, flowing with milk and honey, which {is} the glory of all lands;

column.name: text
column.value: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but profaned my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless my eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said to their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

column.name: text
column.value: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I {am} the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: However the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which {if} a man doeth, he shall even live in them; they profaned my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

column.name: text
column.value: I lifted up my hand to them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

column.name: text
column.value: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I gave them also statutes {that were} not good, and judgments by which they should not live;

column.name: text
column.value: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through {the fire} all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

column.name: text
column.value: {For} when I had brought them into the land, {for} which I lifted up my hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said to them, What {is} the high place to which ye go? And its name is called Bamah to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye harlotry after their abominations?

column.name: text
column.value: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even to this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.

column.name: text
column.value: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries in which ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I enter into judgment with you face to face.

column.name: text
column.value: As I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I enter into judgment with you, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and after this {also}, if ye will not hearken to me: but profane ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

column.name: text
column.value: For on my holy mountain, on the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

column.name: text
column.value: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries in which ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country {for} which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, in which ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop {thy word} toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

column.name: text
column.value: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the blazing flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop {thy word} toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I {am} against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth from its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

column.name: text
column.value: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn my sword out of its sheath: it shall not return any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with breaking heart; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, when they say to thee, Why sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak {as} water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also polished:

column.name: text
column.value: It is sharpened to make a grievous slaughter; it is polished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it despiseth the rod of my son, {as} every tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath given it to be polished, that it may be handled: the sword is sharpened, and it is polished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

column.name: text
column.value: Cry and wail, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it {shall be} upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon {thy} thigh.

column.name: text
column.value: Because {it is} a trial, and what if {the sword} despise even the rod? it shall be no {more}, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite {thy} hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it {is} the sword of the great {men that are} slain, which entereth into their private chambers.

column.name: text
column.value: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that {their} heart may faint, and {their} ruins be multiplied: ah! {it is} made bright, {it is} sharpened for the slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Go thee one way or other, {either} on the right hand, {or} on the left, wherever thy face {is} set.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also smite my hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou son of man, mark two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both {ways} shall come forth from one land: and choose thou a place, choose {it} at the head of the way to the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Mark a way, that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made {his} arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

column.name: text
column.value: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint {battering} rams against the gates, to cast a siege mound, {and} to build a fort.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be to them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, {I say}, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity {shall have} an end,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this {shall} not {be} the same: exalt {him that is} low, and abase {him that is} high.

column.name: text
column.value: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no {more}, until he cometh whose right it is; and I will give it {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword {is} drawn: for the slaughter {it is} polished, to consume because of the glittering:

column.name: text
column.value: While they see vanity to thee, while they divine a lie to thee, to bring thee upon the necks of {them that are} slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity {shall have} an end.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I cause {it} to return into its sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will pour out my indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of cruel men, {and} skilful to destroy.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no {more} remembered: for I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, What {is} thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

column.name: text
column.value: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

column.name: text
column.value: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when she saw that she had waited, {and} her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, {and} made him a young lion.

column.name: text
