column.value: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, {and} devoured men.

column.name: text
column.value: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and all it containeth, by the noise of his roaring.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

column.name: text
column.value: And they put him in custody in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into strong holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy mother {is} like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bore rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

column.name: text
column.value: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And now she {is} planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And fire hath gone out of a rod of her branches, {which} hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod {to be} a sceptre to rule. This {is} a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt show her all her abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself by thy idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come {even} to thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach to the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

column.name: text
column.value: {Those that are} near, and {those that are} far from thee, shall mock thee, {who art} infamous {and} much troubled.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

column.name: text
column.value: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they oppressed the fatherless and the widow.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast despised my holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

column.name: text
column.value: In thee have they uncovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

column.name: text
column.value: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken interest and increase, and thou hast greedily gained from thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I have smitten my hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Can thy heart endure, or can thy hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken {it}, and will do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take thy inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they {are} brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are {even} the dross of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: {As} they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt {it}; so will I gather {you} in my anger and in my fury, and I will leave {you there}, and melt you.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst of it; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, say to her, Thou {art} the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst of her, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst of her.

column.name: text
column.value: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned my holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shown {difference} between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

column.name: text
column.value: Her princes in the midst of her {are} like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, {and} to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

column.name: text
column.value: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered {mortar}, seeing vanity, and divining lies to them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have oppressed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

column.name: text
column.value: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore have I poured out my indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth {day} of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, write for thee the name of the day, {even} of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

column.name: text
column.value: And utter a parable to the rebellious house, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set {it} on, and also pour water into it:

column.name: text
column.value: Gather its pieces into it, {even} every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill {it} with the choice bones.

column.name: text
column.value: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, {and} make it boil well, and let them boil its bones in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum {is} in it, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

column.name: text
column.value: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

column.name: text
column.value: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

column.name: text
column.value: Then set it empty upon its coals, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and {that} the filthiness of it may be melted in it, {that} the scum of it may be consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: She hath wearied {herself} with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum {shall be} in the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: In thy filthiness {is} lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I the LORD have spoken {it}: it shall come to pass, and I will do {it}; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thy eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

column.name: text
column.value: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind thy turban upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not {thy} lips, and eat not the bread of men.

column.name: text
column.value: So I spoke to the people in the morning: and at evening my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people said to me, Wilt thou not tell us what these {things are} to us, that thou doest {so}?

column.name: text
column.value: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover {your} lips, nor eat the bread of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And your turbans {shall be} upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Ezekiel is to you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou son of man, {shall it} not {be} in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

column.name: text
column.value: {That} he that escapeth in that day shall come to thee, to cause {thee} to hear {it} with {thy} ears?

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him who hath escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign to them; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

column.name: text
column.value: And they committed harlotries in Egypt; they committed harlotries in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

column.name: text
column.value: And the names of them {were} Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bore sons and daughters. Thus {were} their names; Samaria {is} Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

column.name: text
column.value: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians {her} neighbours,

column.name: text
column.value: {Who were} clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus she committed her harlotries with them, with all them {that were} the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither left she her harlotries {brought} from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their lust upon her.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

column.name: text
column.value: These uncovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became a byword among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

column.name: text
column.value: And when her sister Aholibah saw {this}, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her harlotries more than her sister in {her} harlotries.

column.name: text
column.value: She doted upon the Assyrians {her} neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I saw that she was defiled, {that} they {took} both one way,

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} she increased her harlotries: for when she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

column.name: text
column.value: Girded with belts upon their loins, flowing turbans upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their immorality, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

column.name: text
column.value: So she revealed her harlotries, and uncovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, as my mind was alienated from her sister.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet she multiplied her harlotries, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, when she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh {is as} the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue {is like} the issue of horses.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus thou didst call to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the breasts of thy youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

column.name: text
column.value: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, {and} all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, {which} shall commit against thee buckler and shield and helmet on every side: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thy ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy remnant shall be devoured by the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall also strip thee of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy harlotry {brought} from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thy eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand {of them} whom thou hatest, into the hand {of them} from whom thy mind is alienated:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall deal with thee in hatred, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy harlotries shall be uncovered, both thy lewdness and thy harlotries.

column.name: text
column.value: I will do these {things} to thee, because thou hast played the harlot with the heathen, {and} because thou art polluted with their idols.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed at and had in derision; it containeth much.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of horror and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt even drink it and drain it, and thou shalt break its pieces, and pluck off thy own breasts: for I have spoken {it}, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy harlotries.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said moreover to me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare to them their abominations;

column.name: text
column.value: That they have committed adultery, and blood {is} in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass for them through {the fire}, to devour {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of my house.

column.name: text
column.value: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, to whom a messenger {was} sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, didst paint thy eyes, and didst deck thyself with ornaments,

column.name: text
column.value: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, upon which thou hast set my incense and my oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And a voice of a multitude being at ease {was} with her: and with the men of the common sort {were} brought Sabeans from the wilderness, who put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I to {her that was} old in adulteries, Will they now commit harlotries with her, and she {with them}?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they went in to her, as they go in to a woman that playeth the harlot: so they went in to Aholah and to Aholibah, the lewd women.

column.name: text
column.value: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they {are} adulteresses, and blood {is} in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and plundered.

column.name: text
column.value: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first {day} of the month, {that} the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken {that was} the gates of the people: she is turned to me: I shall be replenished, {now} she is laid waste:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth its waves to come up.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be {a place for} the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken {it}, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And her daughters who {are} in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and many people.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a siege mound against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

column.name: text
column.value: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city in which is made a breach.

column.name: text
column.value: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be {a place} to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken {it}, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyre; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their embroidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at {every} moment, and be astonished at thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, {that wast} inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who cause their terror {to be} on all that dwelt in it!

column.name: text
column.value: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that {are} in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

column.name: text
column.value: I will make thee a terror, and thou {shalt be} no {more}: though thou shalt be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

column.name: text
column.value: And say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped {thy} hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I will stretch out my hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah {is} like all the heathen;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities {which are} on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,

column.name: text
column.value: To the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out my hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy {it} for the old hatred;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre;

column.name: text
column.value: And say to Tyre, O thou that dwelleth at the entrance of the sea, {which art} a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyre, thou hast said, I {am} of perfect beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy borders {are} in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: They have made all thy {ship} planks of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of} the oaks of Bashan have they made thy oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches {of} ivory, {brought} out of the isles of Chittim.

column.name: text
column.value: Fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise {men}, O Tyre, {that} were in thee, were thy pilots.

column.name: text
column.value: The ancients of Gebal and her wise {men} were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to exchange thy merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thy army, thy men of war: they hung the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Arvad with thy army {were} upon thy walls on all sides, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hung their shields upon thy walls on every side; they have made thy beauty perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: Tarshish {was} thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all {kind of} riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

column.name: text
column.value: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they {were} thy merchants: they traded in the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

column.name: text
column.value: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Dedan {were} thy merchants; many isles {were} the merchandise of thy hand: they brought thee {for} a present horns of ivory and ebony.

column.name: text
column.value: Syria {was} thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they traded in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

column.name: text
column.value: Judah, and the land of Israel, they {were} thy merchants: they traded in thy market in wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

column.name: text
column.value: Damascus {was} thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

column.name: text
column.value: Dan also and Javan going to and fro traded in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

column.name: text
column.value: Dedan {was} thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

column.name: text
column.value: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they traded with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these {were they} thy merchants.

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they {were} thy merchants: they traded in thy fairs with the best of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

column.name: text
column.value: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, {and} Chilmad, {were} thy merchants.

column.name: text
column.value: These {were} thy merchants in all sorts {of things}, in blue clothes, and embroidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the traders of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that {are} in thee, and in all thy company which {is} in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

column.name: text
column.value: The waves shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, {and} all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird themselves with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart {and} bitter wailing.

column.name: text
column.value: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, {saying}, What {city is} like Tyre, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

column.name: text
column.value: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou didst fill many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: In the time {when} thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

column.name: text
column.value: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be terribly afraid, they shall be troubled in {their} countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never {shalt be} any more.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy heart {is} lifted up, and thou hast said, I {am} a God, I sit {in} the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou {art} a man, and not God, though thou settest thy heart as the heart of God:

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, thou {art} wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

column.name: text
column.value: With thy wisdom and with thy understanding thou hast gained for thee riches, and hast gained gold and silver into thy treasuries:

column.name: text
column.value: By thy great wisdom {and} by thy merchandise hast thou increased thy riches, and thy heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thy heart as the heart of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of {them that are} slain in the midst of the seas.

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I {am} God? but thou {shalt be} a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken {it}, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre, and say to him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone {was} thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou {art} the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee {so}: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou {wast} perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thy iniquities, by the iniquity of thy merchandise; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

column.name: text
column.value: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never {shalt} thou {be} any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no more a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor {any} grieving thorn of all {that are} around them, that despised them; and they shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall dwell safely in it, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them around them; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD their God.

column.name: text
column.value: In the tenth year, in the tenth {month}, in the twelfth {day} of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river {is} my own, and I have made {it} for myself.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick to thy scales, and I will bring thee out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick to thy scales.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will leave thee {thrown} into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for food to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I {am} the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou didst break, and make all their loins quake.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD: because he hath said, The river {is} mine, and I have made {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, therefore I {am} against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste {and} desolate, from the tower of Syene even to the border of Cush.

column.name: text
column.value: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries {that are} desolate, and her cities among the cities {that are} laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people among whom they were scattered:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring again the captives of Egypt, and will cause them to return {into} the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth {their} iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I {am} the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first {month}, in the first {day} of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head {was} made bald, and every shoulder {was} rubbed raw: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyre, for the service that he had served against it:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given him the land of Egypt {for} his labour which he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Wail ye, Alas the day!

column.name: text
column.value: For the day {is} near, even the day of the LORD {is} near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Cush, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

column.name: text
column.value: Cush, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries {that are} desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities {that are} wasted.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and {when} all her helpers shall be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Cushites afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is in it, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause {their} images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph {shall have} distresses daily.

column.name: text
column.value: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these {cities} shall go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first {month}, in the seventh {day} of the month, {that} the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a bandage to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded {man}.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third {month}, in the first {day} of the month, {that} the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the Assyrian {was} a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shady cover, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

column.name: text
column.value: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running around his plants, and sent out her little rivers to all the trees of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

column.name: text
column.value: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

column.name: text
column.value: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; not any tree in the garden of God was like him in his beauty.

column.name: text
column.value: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that {were} in the garden of God, envied him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

column.name: text
column.value: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth have gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

column.name: text
column.value: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its floods, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

column.name: text
column.value: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: They also went down into hell with him to {them that are} slain with the sword; and {they that were} his arm, {that} dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with {them that are} slain by the sword. This {is} Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say to them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman:

column.name: text
column.value: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he shall blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

column.name: text
column.value: Then whoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword will come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

column.name: text
column.value: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the watchman will see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword will come, and take {any} person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman to the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

column.name: text
column.value: When I say to the wicked, O wicked {man}, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked {man} shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, if thou shalt warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he will not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak to the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins {are} upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked should turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, thou son of man, say to the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall by it in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his {righteousness} in the day that he sinneth.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall say to the righteous, {that} he shall surely live; if he will trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, when I say to the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he will turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

column.name: text
column.value: {If} the wicked will restore the pledge, give again that which he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

column.name: text
column.value: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned to him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

column.name: text
column.value: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, for that he shall even die.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the wicked will turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, for that he shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth {month}, in the fifth {day} of the month, {that} one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, The city is smitten.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, before he that had escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we {are} many; the land is given to us for inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?

column.name: text
column.value: Say thou thus to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; {As} I live, surely they that {are} in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that {is} in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that {are} in the forts and in the caves shall die by the pestilence.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they know that I {am} the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they come to thee as the people come, and they sit before thee {as} my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they show much love, {but} their heart goeth after their covetousness.

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, thou {art} to them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do not perform them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD to the shepherds; Woe {be} to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe yourselves with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: {but} ye feed not the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: The diseased ye have not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up {that which was} broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were scattered, because {there is} no shepherd: and they became food to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek {for them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: {As} I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became food to every beast of the field, because {there was} no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, {even} I, will both search for my sheep, and seek them out.

column.name: text
column.value: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep {that are} scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

column.name: text
column.value: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and {in} a rich pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up {that which was} broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the male goats.

column.name: text
column.value: {Seemeth it} a small thing to you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the rest of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the rest with your feet?

column.name: text
column.value: And {as for} my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD to them; Behold, I, {even} I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, {even} my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that subjected them to service.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make {them} afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God {am} with them, and {that} they, {even} the house of Israel, {are} my people, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, {are} men, {and} I {am} your God, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

column.name: text
column.value: And say to it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I {am} against thee, and I will stretch out my hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed {the blood of} the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time {that their} iniquity {had} an end:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee to blood, and blood shall pursue thee: since thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will fill his mountains with his slain {men}: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; though the LORD was there:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, {as} I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thy anger, and according to thy envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt know that I {am} the LORD, {and that} I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do to thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, {even} all of it: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Also, thou son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy had said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made {you} desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession to the rest of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and {are} an infamy of the people:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the rest of the heathen that {are} on every side;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the rest of the heathen, and against all Edom, who have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all {their} heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

column.name: text
column.value: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up my hand, Surely the heathen that {are} about you, they shall bear their shame.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are soon to come.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, I {am} for you, and I will turn to you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, {even} all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be built:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you according to your old estates, and will do better {to you} than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, {even} my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them {of men}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say to you, Thou {land} devourest men, and hast bereaved thy nations;

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither will I cause {men} to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a defiled woman.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols {with which} they had polluted it:

column.name: text
column.value: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they entered among the heathen, where they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These {are} the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.

column.name: text
column.value: But I had pity for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, where they went.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not {this} for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for my holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, where ye went.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I {am} the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

column.name: text
column.value: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that {were} not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: Not for your sakes do I {this}, saith the Lord GOD, be it known to you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause {you} to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be built.

column.name: text
column.value: And the desolate land shall be tilled, though it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities {are become} fortified, {and} are inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the heathen that are left around you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined {places, and} plant that which was desolate: I the LORD have spoken {it}, and I will do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet {for} this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do {it} for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

column.name: text
column.value: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first {day} of the month, {that} the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou {art} as a whale in the seas: and thou didst come forth with thy rivers, and didst trouble the waters with thy feet, and didst foul their rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I leave thee upon the land, and I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also water with thy blood the land in which thou swimmest, {even} to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make its stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

column.name: text
column.value: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, I will make many people astonished at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at {every} moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall lay waste the pomp of Egypt, and all its multitude shall be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: I will destroy also all its beasts from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that of which it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell in it, then shall they know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the lamentation which they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, {even} for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth {day} of the month, {that} the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, {even} her, and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall fall in the midst of {them that are} slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

column.name: text
column.value: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Assyria {is} there and all her company: his graves {are} about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is around her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: There {is} Elam and all her multitude around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

column.name: text
