column.value: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves {are} around him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of {them that are} slain.

column.name: text
column.value: There {is} Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves {are} around him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not lie with the mighty {that are} fallen of the uncircumcised, who are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though {they were} the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with {them that are} slain with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: There {is} Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who with their might are laid by {them that were} slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: There {are} the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, who are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with {them that are} slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, {even} Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with {them that are} slain with the sword, {even} Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which {was} full of bones,

column.name: text
column.value: And caused me to pass by them on every side: and, behold, {there were} very many in the open valley; and, lo, {they were} very dry.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he said to me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say to them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD to these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but {there was} no breath in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

column.name: text
column.value: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off on our part.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore prophesy and say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I {am} the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you out of your graves,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken {it}, and performed {it}, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and {for} all the house of Israel his companions:

column.name: text
column.value: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thy hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the children of thy people shall speak to thee, saying, Wilt thou not show us what thou {meanest} by these?

column.name: text
column.value: Say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which {is} in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions, and will put them with him, {even} with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sticks on which thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And say to them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, where they are gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And David my servant {shall be} king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell in it, {even} they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David {shall be} their prince for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD sanctifieth Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

column.value: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thy army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts {of armour, even} a great company {with} bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

column.value: Persia, Cush, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

column.name: text
column.value: Gomer, and all his troops; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his troops: {and} many people with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled to thee, and be thou a guard to them.

column.name: text
column.value: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land {that is} brought back from the sword, {and is} gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall all dwell in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy troops, and many people with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, {that} at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

column.name: text
column.value: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thy hand upon the desolate places {that are now} inhabited, and upon the people {that are} gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

column.value: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, shall say to thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt come against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; {Art} thou he of whom I have spoken of old by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days {many} years that I would bring thee against them?

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, {that} my fury shall come up in my face.

column.name: text
column.value: For in my jealousy {and} in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

column.name: text
column.value: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that {are} upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be overturned, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will enter into judgment against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his troops, and upon the many people that {are} with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I {am} against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will strike thy bow out of thy left hand, and I will cause thy arrows to fall from thy right hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy troops, and the people that {are} with thee: I will give thee to the ravenous birds of every sort, and {to} the beasts of the field to be devoured.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken {it}, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell securely in the isles: and they shall know that I {am} the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not {let them} profane my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I {am} the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this {is} the day of which I have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the javelins, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

column.name: text
column.value: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down {any} out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall lay waste those that wasted them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} I will give to Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the travellers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the {noses} of the travellers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call {it} The valley of Hamongog.

column.value: And seven months shall the house of Israel be in burying them, that they may cleanse the land.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury {them}; and it shall be to them a renown in the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: And {as} travellers pass through the land, when {any} seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.

column.name: text
column.value: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak to every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, {even} a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: So the house of Israel shall know that I {am} the LORD their God from that day and forward.

column.name: text
column.value: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore I hid my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so they all fell by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done to them, and hidden my face from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

column.name: text
column.value: After they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made {them} afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of the lands of their enemies, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they know that I {am} the LORD their God, who caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them to their own land, and have left none of them there any more.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text

column.value: And {it was} made with cherubim and palm trees, so that a palm tree {was} between a cherub and a cherub; and {every} cherub had two faces;

column.name: text
column.value: So that the face of a man {was} toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: {it was} made through all the house all around.

column.name: text
column.value: From the ground to above the door {were} cherubim and palm trees made, and {on} the wall of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: The posts of the temple {were} squared, {and} the face of the sanctuary; the appearance {of the one} as the appearance {of the other}.

column.name: text
column.value: The altar of wood {was} three cubits high, and its length {was} two cubits; and its corners, and its length, and its walls, {were} of wood: and he said to me, This {is} the table that {is} before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

column.name: text
column.value: And the doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves; two {leaves} for the one door, and two leaves for the other {door}.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubim and palm trees, as {were} made upon the walls; and {there were} thick planks upon the face of the porch outside.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there were} narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and {upon} the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that {was} opposite the separate place, and which {was} before the building toward the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Before the length of an hundred cubits {was} the north door, and the breadth {was} fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: Opposite the twenty {cubits} which {were} for the inner court, and opposite the pavement which {was} for the outer court, {was} gallery against gallery in three {stories}.

column.name: text
column.value: And before the chambers {was} a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the upper chambers {were} narrower: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middle ones of the building.

column.name: text
column.value: For they {were} in three {stories}, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore {the upper chambers} were set back more than the lower and the middle ones from the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wall that {was} outside by the side of the chambers, toward the outer court on the forepart of the chambers, the length of it {was} fifty cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: For the length of the chambers that {were} in the outer court {was} fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple {were} an hundred cubits.

column.name: text
column.value: And from under these chambers {was} the entrance on the east side, as one goeth into them from the outer court.

column.name: text
column.value: The chambers {were} in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, opposite the separate place, and opposite the building.

column.name: text
column.value: And the way before them {was} like the appearance of the chambers which {were} toward the north, as long as they, {and} as broad as they: and all their exits {were} both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

column.name: text
column.value: And according to the doors of the chambers that {were} toward the south {was} a door in the head of the way, {even} the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, The north chambers {and} the south chambers, which {are} before the separate place, they {are} holy chambers, where the priests that approach to the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place {is} holy.

column.name: text
column.value: When the priests enter in it, then shall they not go out of the holy {place} into the outer court, but there they shall lay their garments in which they minister; for they {are} holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to {those things} which {are} for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect {is} toward the east, and measured it all around.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

column.name: text
column.value: He turned about to the west side, {and} measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

column.name: text
column.value: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall all around, five hundred {reeds} long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the common place.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward he brought me to the gate, {even} the gate that looketh toward the east:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice {was} like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And {it was} according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, {even} according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions {were} like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect {is} toward the east.

column.name: text
column.value: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard {him} speaking to me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, {neither} they, nor their kings, by their harlotry, nor by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places.

column.name: text
column.value: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Now let them put away their harlotry, and the dead bodies of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

column.name: text
column.value: And if they will be ashamed of all that they have done, show them the form of the house, and the fashion of it, and its exits, and its entrances, and all its forms, and all its ordinances, and all its forms, and all its laws: and write {it} in their sight, that they may keep its whole form, and all its ordinances, and do them.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain its whole limit all around {shall be} most holy. Behold, this {is} the law of the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit {is} a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom {shall be} a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border of it by its edge on every side {shall be} a span: and this {shall be} the higher place of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the bottom {upon} the ground {even} to the lower ledge {shall be} two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the smaller ledge {even} to the greater ledge {shall be} four cubits, and the breadth {one} cubit.

column.name: text
column.value: So the altar {shall be} four cubits; and from the altar and upward {shall be} four horns.

column.name: text
column.value: And the altar {shall be} twelve {cubits} long, twelve broad, square in its four sides.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ledge {shall be} fourteen {cubits} long and fourteen broad in its four sides; and the border about it {shall be} half a cubit; and the bottom of it {shall be} a cubit about; and its stairs shall look toward the east.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These {are} the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that are of the seed of Zadok, who approach to me, to minister to me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bull for a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt take of his blood, and put {it} on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and upon the border on every side: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt take the bull also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed {it} with the bull.

column.name: text
column.value: When thou hast finished cleansing {it}, thou shalt offer a young bull without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them {for} a burnt offering to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat {for} a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bull, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And when these days are fulfilled, it shall be, {that} upon the eighth day, and {so} onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outer sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it {was} shut.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of {that} gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thy eyes, and hear with thy ears all that I say to thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit from the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, {even} to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

column.name: text
column.value: In that ye have brought {into my sanctuary} strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, {even} my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have not kept the charge of my holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that {is} among the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Levites that have gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, {having} charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not come near to me, to do the office of a priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy {place}: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all its service, and for all that shall be done in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister to me, and they shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:

column.name: text
column.value: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my charge.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall have linen headdresses upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird {themselves} with any thing that causeth sweat.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they go forth into the outer court, {even} into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor allow their locks to grow long; they shall only cut {the hair of} their heads.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall teach my people {the difference} between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; {and} they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall come near no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, to the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be to them for an inheritance: I {am} their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I {am} their possession.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first of all the firstfruits of all {things}, and every oblation of all, of every {sort} of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give to the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether of fowl or beast.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation to the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length {shall be} the length of five and twenty thousand {reeds}, and the breadth {shall be} ten thousand. This {shall be} holy in all its borders on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred {in length}, with five hundred {in breadth}, square on every side; and fifty cubits on every side for its common lands.

column.name: text
column.value: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary {and} the most holy {place}.

column.name: text
column.value: The holy {portion} of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, who shall come near to minister to the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, beside the oblation of the holy {portion}: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And a {portion shall be} for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy {portion}, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy {portion}, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length {shall be} the same as one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

column.name: text
column.value: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and {the rest of} the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

column.name: text
column.value: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure of it shall be after the homer.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shekel {shall be} twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, {ye shall offer} the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, {which is} an homer of ten baths; for ten baths {are} an homer:

column.name: text
column.value: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the rich pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be the prince's part {to give} burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first {month}, in the first {day} of the month, thou shalt take a young bull without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

column.name: text
column.value: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put {it} upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

column.name: text
column.value: And so thou shalt do the seventh {day} of the month for every one that erreth, and for {him that is} simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first {month}, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull {for} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily {for} a sin offering.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventh {month}, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do likewise in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward he brought me again to the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the front of the house {stood toward} the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south {side} of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way outside to the outer gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters {were} to the ankles.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters {were} to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters {were} to the loins.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward he measured a thousand; {and it was} a river that I could not pass over: for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Son of man, hast thou seen {this}? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river {were} very many trees on the one side and on the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: {which being} brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} every thing that liveth, which moveth, wherever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come there: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live where the river cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} the fishermen shall stand upon it from Engedi even to Eneglaim; they shall be a {place} to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, very many.

column.name: text
column.value: But its miry places and its marshes shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the river upon its bank, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for food, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall its fruit be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to its months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and its fruit shall be for food, and its leaf for medicine.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This {shall be} the border, by which ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph {shall have two} portions.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: {concerning} which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers: and this land shall fall to you for inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

column.name: text
column.value: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which {is} between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazarhatticon, which {is} by the border of Hauran.

column.name: text
column.value: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And {this is} the north side.

column.name: text
column.value: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel {by} Jordan, from the border to the east sea. And {this is} the east side.

column.name: text
column.value: And the south side southward, from Tamar {even} to the waters of strife {in} Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And {this is} the south side southward.

column.name: text
column.value: The west side also {shall be} the great sea from the border, till a man cometh opposite Hamath. This {is} the west side.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall ye divide this land to you according to the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, who shall beget children among you: and they shall be to you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give {him} his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of {that} gate from outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

column.name: text
column.value: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer to the LORD in the sabbath day {shall be} six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: And the meat offering {shall be} an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the day of the new moon {it shall be} a young bull without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall be able, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of {that} gate, and he shall go forth by the way of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go forth opposite it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bull, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily to the LORD, {one} shall then open to him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth {one} shall shut the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering to the LORD {of} a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning {for} a continual burnt offering.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince shall give a gift to any of his sons, the inheritance of it shall be to his sons'; it {shall be} their possession by inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he will give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; afterward it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be to his sons for them.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; {but} he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not dispossessed every man from his possession.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward he brought me through the entrance, which {was} at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there {was} a place on the two sides westward.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, This {is} the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear {them} not out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court {there was} a court.

column.name: text
column.value: In the four corners of the court {there were} courts joined of forty {cubits} long and thirty broad: these four corners {were} of one measure.

column.name: text
column.value: And {there was} a row {of building} all around in them, around the four of them, and {it was} made with boiling places under the rows on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, These {are} the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now these {are} the names of the tribes. From the north end to the border of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the border of Hamath; for these are his sides east {and} west; a {portion for} Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, a {portion for} Asher.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, a {portion for} Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, a {portion for} Manasseh.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, a {portion for} Ephraim.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, a {portion for} Reuben.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, a {portion for} Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand {reeds in} breadth, and {in} length as one of the {other} parts, from the east side to the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The oblation that ye shall offer to the LORD {shall be} of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

column.name: text
column.value: And for them, {even} for the priests, shall be {this} holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand {in length}, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: {It shall be} for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; who have kept my charge, who went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

column.name: text
column.value: And {this} oblation of the land that is offered shall be to them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

column.name: text
column.value: And next to the border of the priests the Levites {shall have} five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length {shall be} five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for {it is} holy to the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth next to the five and twenty thousand, shall be a common {place} for the city, for dwelling, and for common lands: and the city shall be in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {shall be} the measures of it; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And the common lands of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remainder in length next to the oblation of the holy {portion shall be} ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be next to the oblation of the holy {portion}; and its increase shall be for food to them that serve the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: All the oblation {shall be} five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remainder {shall be} for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, next to the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward next to the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, next to the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house {shall be} in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, {being} in the midst {of that} which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

column.name: text
column.value: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west side, Benjamin {shall have} a {portion}.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon {shall have} a {portion}.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar a {portion}.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun a {portion}.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad a {portion}.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar {to} the waters of strife {in} Kadesh, {and} to the river toward the great sea.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the land which ye shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these {are} their portions, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And these {are} the exits of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.

column.name: text
column.value: And the gates of the city {shall be} after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

column.name: text
column.value: And the west side four thousand and five hundred, {with} their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

column.name: text
column.value: The circumference {was} eighteen thousand {measures}: and the name of the city from {that} day {shall be}, The LORD {is} there.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Jerusalem, and besieged it.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king spoke to Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring {certain} of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;

column.name: text
column.value: Children in whom {was} no blemish, but of good appearance, and skilful in all wisdom, and possessing knowledge, and understanding science, and such as {had} ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king's food, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end of which they might stand before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now among these were of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names: for he gave to Daniel {the name} of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.

column.name: text
column.value: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king's food, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and compassion with the prince of the eunuchs.

column.name: text
column.value: And the prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your food and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse looking than the children who {are} of your age? then shall ye make {me} endanger my head to the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Daniel to Melzar, whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,

column.name: text
column.value: Test thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat, and water to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee, and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king's food: and as thou seest, deal with thy servants.

column.name: text
column.value: So he consented to them in this matter, and tried them ten days.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children who ate the portion of the king's food.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their food, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them vegetables.

column.name: text
column.value: As for these four children, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king talked with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore they stood before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: And in all matters of wisdom {and} understanding, that the king enquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians {and} astrologers that {were} in all his realm.

column.name: text
column.value: And Daniel continued {even} to the first year of king Cyrus.

column.name: text
column.value: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which {was} in Jerusalem; that the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, might drink in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which {was} at Jerusalem; and the king, and his princes, his wives, and his concubines, drank in them.

column.name: text
column.value: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote opposite the lampstand upon the plaster of the wall of the king's palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king's countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.

column.name: text
column.value: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. {And} the king spoke, and said to the wise {men} of Babylon, Whoever shall read this writing, and show me the interpretation of it, shall be clothed with scarlet, and {have} a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came in all the king's wise {men}: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was the king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were confused.

column.name: text
column.value: {Now} the queen, by reason of the words of the king and his lords, came into the banquet house: {and} the queen spoke and said, O king, live for ever: let not thy thoughts trouble thee, nor let thy countenance be changed:

column.name: text
column.value: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom {is} the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, {I say}, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, {and} soothsayers;

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, the interpreting of dreams, and declaring of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. {And} the king spoke and said to Daniel, {Art} thou that Daniel, who {art} of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

column.name: text
column.value: I have even heard of thee, that the spirit of the gods {is} in thee, and {that} light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And now the wise {men}, the astrologers, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me the interpretation of it: but they could not show the interpretation of the thing:

column.name: text
column.value: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation of it, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and {have} a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel answered and said before the king, Let thy gifts be to thyself, and give thy rewards to another; yet I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: O thou king, the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom, and majesty, and glory, and honour:

column.name: text
column.value: And for the majesty that he gave him, all people, nations, and languages, trembled and feared before him: whom he would he slew; and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he set up; and whom he would he put down.

column.name: text
column.value: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he was driven from the sons of men; and his heart was made like the beasts, and his dwelling {was} with the wild donkeys: they fed him with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven; till he knew that the most high God ruleth in the kingdom of men, and {that} he appointeth over it whomever he will.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thy heart, though thou knewest all this;

column.name: text
column.value: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee, and thou, and thy lords, thy wives, and thy concubines, have drunk wine in them; and thou hast praised the gods of silver, and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which see not, nor hear, nor know: and the God in whose hand thy breath {is}, and whose {are} all thy ways, thou hast not glorified:

column.name: text
column.value: Then was the part of the hand sent from him; and this writing was written.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {is} the writing that was written, MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God hath numbered thy kingdom, and finished it.

column.name: text
column.value: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.

column.name: text
column.value: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

column.name: text
column.value: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and {put} a chain of gold about his neck, and made a proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, {being} about sixty and two years old.

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height {was} sixty cubits, {and} the breadth of it six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

column.name: text
column.value: {That} at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of music, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of music, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down {and} worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: They spoke and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever falleth not down and worshippeth, {that} he shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuchadnezzar in {his} rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said to them, {Is it} true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, do ye not serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

column.name: text
column.value: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of music, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; {well}: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who {is} that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?

column.name: text
column.value: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we {are} not careful to answer thee in this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: If it is {so}, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver {us} out of thy hand, O king.

column.name: text
column.value: But if not, be it known to thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: {therefore} he spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was heated before.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the most mighty men that {were} in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, {and} to cast {them} into the burning fiery furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: Then these men were bound in their coats, their trousers, and their turbans, and their {other} garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore because the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire killed those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

column.name: text
column.value: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished, and rose up in haste, {and} spoke, and said to his counsellors, Did we not cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said to the king, True, O king.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, {and} spoke, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come {here}. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, came forth from the midst of the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor had the smell of fire passed upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: {Then} Nebuchadnezzar spoke, and said, Blessed {be} the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king's word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a refuse heap: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes, who should be over the whole kingdom;

column.name: text
column.value: And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel {was} first: that the princes might give accounts to them, and the king should suffer no loss.

column.name: text
column.value: Then this Daniel was preferred above the presidents and princes, because an excellent spirit {was} in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom; but they could find no occasion nor fault; forasmuch as he {was} faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find {it} against him concerning the law of his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then these presidents and princes assembled to the king, and said thus to him, King Darius, live for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

column.name: text
column.value: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it may not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

column.name: text
column.value: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask {a petition} of any god or man within thirty days, except of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing {is} true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they answered and said before the king, That Daniel, who {is} of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king, when he heard {these} words, was much displeased with himself, and set {his} heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the setting of the sun to deliver him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then these men assembled to the king, and said to the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians {is}, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast {him} into the den of lions. {Now} the king spoke and said to Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of music brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice to Daniel: {and} the king spoke and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Daniel to the king, O king, live for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel out of the den. So Daniel was taken out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast {them} into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they came to the bottom of the den.

column.name: text
column.value: Then king Darius wrote to all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied to you.

column.name: text
column.value: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he {is} the living God, and steadfast for ever, and his kingdom {that} which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion {shall be even} to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and on earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

column.name: text
column.value: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams, by which his spirit was troubled, and his sleep broke from him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the astrologers, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to show the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.

column.name: text
