column.value: And the king said to them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit was troubled to know the dream.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Syrian, O king, live for ever: tell thy servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if ye will not make known to me the dream, with the interpretation of it, ye shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a refuse heap.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye shall show the dream, and the interpretation of it, ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore show me the dream, and the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the time, because ye see the thing is gone from me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye will not make known to me the dream, {there is but} one decree for you: for ye have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, till the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that ye can show me the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man upon the earth that can reveal the king's matter: therefore {there is} no king, lord, nor ruler, {that} hath asked such things of any magician, or astrologer, or Chaldean.

column.name: text
column.value: And {it is} a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is no other that can reveal it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise {men} of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the decree went forth that the wise {men} should be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, who had gone forth to slay the wise {men} of Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why {is} the decree {so} hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would give him time, and that he would show the king the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

column.name: text
column.value: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions should not perish with the rest of the wise {men} of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was the secret revealed to Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Daniel answered and said, Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever: for wisdom and might are his:

column.name: text
column.value: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

column.name: text
column.value: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what {is} in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank thee, and praise thee, O thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might, and hast made known to me now what we desired of thee: for thou hast {now} made known to us the king's matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise {men} of Babylon: he went and said thus to him; Destroy not the wise {men} of Babylon: bring me in before the king, and I will reveal to the king the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus to him, I have found a man of the captives of Judah, that will make known to the king the interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name {was} Belteshazzar, Art thou able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and the interpretation of it?

column.name: text
column.value: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, The secret which the king hath demanded the wise {men}, the astrologers, the magicians, the soothsayers, cannot reveal to the king;

column.name: text
column.value: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets, and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Thy dream, and the visions of thy head upon thy bed, are these;

column.name: text
column.value: As for thee, O king, thy thoughts came {into thy mind} upon thy bed, what should come to pass after this: and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for {any} wisdom that I have more than any living, but for {their} sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king, and that thou mayest know the thoughts of thy heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou, O king, sawest, and behold a great image. This great image, whose brightness {was} excellent, stood before thee; and its form {was} terrible.

column.name: text
column.value: The head of this image {was} of fine gold, his breast and his arms of silver, his belly and his thighs of brass,

column.name: text
column.value: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou sawest till a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet {that were} of iron and clay, and broke them to pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the dream; and we will tell the interpretation of it before the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou, O king, {art} a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever the children of men dwell, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thy hand, and hath made thee ruler over them all. Thou {art} this head of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all {things}: and as iron that breaketh all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

column.name: text
column.value: And though thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters' clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with the miry clay.

column.name: text
column.value: And {as} the toes of the feet {were} part of iron, and part of clay, {so} the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

column.name: text
column.value: And though thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not join one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, {but} it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass after this: and the dream {is} certain, and the interpretation of it sure.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The king answered to Daniel, and said, Of a truth {it is}, that your God {is} the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief of the governors over all the wise {men} of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel {sat} in the gate of the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied to you.

column.name: text
column.value: I thought it good to show the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me.

column.name: text
column.value: How great {are} his signs! and how mighty {are} his wonders! his kingdom {is} an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion {is} from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace:

column.name: text
column.value: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I made a decree to bring in all the wise {men} of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came in the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known to me the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name {is} Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom {is} the spirit of the holy gods: and before him I told the dream, {saying},

column.name: text
column.value: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods {is} in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation of it.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus {were} the visions of my head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and its height {was} great.

column.name: text
column.value: The tree grew, and was strong, and its height reached to heaven, and the sight of it to the end of all the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: Its leaves {were} fair, and its fruit abundant, and in it {was} food for all: the beasts of the field had shade under it, and the fowls of heaven dwelt among its boughs, and all flesh was fed from it.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;

column.name: text
column.value: He cried aloud, and said thus, Hew down the tree, and cut off its branches, shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit: let the beasts escape from under it, and the fowls from its branches:

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and {let} its portion {be} with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: Let his heart be changed from man's, and let a beast's heart be given to him; and let seven times pass over him.

column.name: text
column.value: This matter {is} by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men.

column.name: text
column.value: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen. Now thou, O Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation of it, forasmuch as all the wise {men} of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation: but thou {art} able; for the spirit of the holy gods {is} in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Daniel, whose name {was} Belteshazzar, was appalled for one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. The king spoke, and said, Belteshazzar, let not the dream, or the interpretation of it, trouble thee. Belteshazzar answered and said, My lord, the dream {be} to them that hate thee, and the interpretation of it to thy enemies.

column.name: text
column.value: The tree that thou sawest, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the heaven, and the sight of it to all the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: Whose leaves {were} fair, and the fruit of it abundant, and in it {was} food for all; under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and upon whose branches the fowls of heaven had their habitation:

column.name: text
column.value: It {is} thou, O king, that art grown and become strong: for thy greatness is grown, and reacheth to heaven, and thy dominion to the end of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven, and saying, Hew the tree down, and destroy it; yet leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and {let} its portion {be} with the beasts of the field, till seven times shall pass over him;

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the interpretation, O king, and this {is} the decree of the most High, which is come upon my lord the king:

column.name: text
column.value: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou shalt know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomever he will.

column.name: text
column.value: And though they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots; thy kingdom shall be sure to thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thy iniquities by showing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.

column.name: text
column.value: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

column.name: text
column.value: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: The king spoke, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?

column.name: text
column.value: While the word {was} in the king's mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, {saying}, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom hath departed from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling {shall be} with the beasts of the field: they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and seven times shall pass over thee, until thou shalt know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomever he will.

column.name: text
column.value: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and ate grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' {feathers}, and his nails like birds' {claws}.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me, and I blessed the most High, and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever, whose dominion {is} an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom {is} from generation to generation:

column.name: text
column.value: And all the inhabitants of the earth {are} reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and {among} the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say to him, What doest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time my reason returned to me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my honour and brightness returned to me; and my counsellors and my lords sought to me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent majesty was added to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven, all whose works {are} truth, and his ways judgment: and those that walk in pride he is able to abase.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, {and} told the sum of the matters.

column.name: text
column.value: Daniel spoke and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of heaven strove upon the great sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And four great beasts came up from the sea, different one from another.

column.name: text
column.value: The first {was} like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand upon the feet as a man, and a man's heart was given to it.

column.name: text
column.value: And behold another beast, a second, like a bear, and it raised itself on one side, and {it had} three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus to it, Arise, devour much flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

column.name: text
column.value: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the remainder with its feet: and it {was} different from all the beasts that {were} before it; and it had ten horns.

column.name: text
column.value: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn {were} eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment {was} white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne {was like} the fiery flame, {and} his wheels {as} burning fire.

column.name: text
column.value: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered to him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke: I beheld {even} till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

column.name: text
column.value: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, {one} like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion {is} an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom {that} which shall not be destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of {my} body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

column.name: text
column.value: I came near to one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

column.name: text
column.value: These great beasts, which are four, {are} four kings, {which} shall arise out of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth {were of} iron, and his nails {of} brass; {which} devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the remainder with his feet;

column.name: text
column.value: And of the ten horns that {were} in his head, and {of} the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even {of} that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke very great things, whose look {was} more stout than his fellows.

column.name: text
column.value: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

column.name: text
column.value: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be different from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ten horns out of this kingdom {are} ten kings {that} shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be different from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall speak {great} words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

column.name: text
column.value: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy {it} to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom {is} an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: Here {is} the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

column.name: text
column.value: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, concerning which the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

column.name: text
column.value: And I prayed to the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

column.name: text
column.value: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither have we hearkened to thy servants the prophets, who spoke in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, righteousness {belongeth} to thee, but to us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, {that are} near, and {that are} far off, through all the countries to which thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, to us {belongeth} confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: To the Lord our God {belong} mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that {is} written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven it hath not been done as it hath been done upon Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: As {it is} written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet we have not made our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God {is} righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we have not obeyed his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast made thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thy anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people {have become} a reproach to all {that are} about us.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: O my God, incline thy ear, and hear; open thy eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

column.name: text
column.value: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thy own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: And while I {was} speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, while I {was} speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he informed {me}, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

column.name: text
column.value: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to show {thee}; for thou {art} greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

column.name: text
column.value: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

column.name: text
column.value: Know therefore and understand, {that} from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem to the Messiah the Prince {shall be} seven weeks, and sixty and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

column.name: text
column.value: And after sixty and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and its end {shall be} with a flood, and to the end of the war desolations are determined.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make {it} desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, {even to} me Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I {was} at Shushan {in} the palace, which {is} in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had {two} horns: and the {two} horns {were} high; but one {was} higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither {was there any} that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

column.name: text
column.value: And as I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat {had} a notable horn between his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to the ram that had {two} horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran to him in the fury of his power.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and smote the ram, and broke his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the male goat became very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and in its stead came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which became exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant {land}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it grew great, {even} to the host of heaven; and it cast down {some} of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, he magnified {himself} even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily {sacrifice} was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

column.name: text
column.value: And an host was given {him} against the daily {sacrifice} by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it continued, and prospered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said to that certain {saint} who spoke, How long {shall be} the vision {concerning} the daily {sacrifice}, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Until two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when I, {even} I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me {one having} the appearance of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a man's voice between {the banks of} Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this {man} to understand the vision.

column.name: text
column.value: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said to me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end {shall be} the vision.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end {shall be}.

column.name: text
column.value: The ram which thou sawest having {two} horns {are} the kings of Media and Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rough goat {is} the king of Greece: and the great horn that {is} between his eyes {is} the first king.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that being broken, though four stood up in its place, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

column.name: text
column.value: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and continue, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

column.name: text
column.value: And through his policy also he shall cause deceit to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify {himself} in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told {is} true: therefore shut thou up the vision; for it {shall be} for many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick {certain} days; afterward I rose, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing {was} true, but the time appointed {was} long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

column.name: text
column.value: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which {is} Hiddekel;

column.name: text
column.value: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins {were} girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

column.name: text
column.value: His body also {was} like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I heard the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then I was in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and {upon} the palms of my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to thee, and stand upright: for to thee I am now sent. And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thy heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

column.name: text
column.value: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I have come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision {is} for {many} days.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had spoken such words to me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, {one} like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spoke, and said to him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

column.name: text
column.value: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there came again and touched me {one} like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace {be} to thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken to me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he, Knowest thou for what cause I come to thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Greece shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will show thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and {there is} none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, {even} I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

column.name: text
column.value: And now will I show thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than {they} all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.

column.name: text
column.value: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of the south shall be strong, and {one} of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion {shall be} a great dominion.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in {these} times.

column.name: text
column.value: But out of a branch of her roots shall {one} stand up in his estate, who shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

column.name: text
column.value: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, {and} with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue {more} years than the king of the north.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of the south shall come into {his} kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and {one} shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, {even} to his fortress.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king of the south shall be moved with anger, and shall come forth and fight with him, {even} with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down {many} ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened {by it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

column.name: text
column.value: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

column.name: text
column.value: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a bank, and take the most fortified cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither {shall there be any} strength to withstand.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand {on his side}, neither be for him.

column.name: text
column.value: After this shall he turn his face to the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause {it} to turn upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he shall turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes {in} the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

column.name: text
column.value: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflowed from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the league {made} with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall enter peaceably even upon the best places of the province; and he shall do {that} which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: {yea}, and he shall plot against the strong holds, even for a time.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall plot against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his food shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

column.name: text
column.value: And both these kings' hearts {shall be} to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end {shall be} at the time appointed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart {shall be} against the holy covenant; and he shall do {exploits}, and return to his own land.

column.name: text
column.value: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

column.name: text
column.value: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And forces shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily {sacrifice}, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that know their God shall be strong, and do {exploits}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, {many} days.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they shall fall, they shall be helped with a little help: but many shall join with them with flatteries.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make {them} white, {even} to the time of the end: because {it is} yet for a time appointed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that which is determined shall be done.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

column.name: text
column.value: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus shall he do in the strongest fortresses with a foreign god, whom he shall acknowledge {and} increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass through.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many {countries} shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, {even} Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Cushites {shall be} at his steps.

column.name: text
column.value: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to sweep away many.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

column.name: text
column.value: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation {even} to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

column.name: text
column.value: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame {and} everlasting contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that are wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, {even} to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood two others, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} said to the man clothed in linen, who {was} above the waters of the river, How long {shall it be to} the end of these wonders?

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who {was} above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him that liveth for ever that {it shall be} for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished the breaking up of the power of the holy people, all these {things} shall be finished.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what {shall be} the end of these {things}?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words {are} closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the time {that} the daily {sacrifice} shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, {there shall be} a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

column.name: text
column.value: But go thou thy way till the end: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, {and} Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take to thee a wife of harlotry and children of harlotry: for the land hath committed great harlotry, {departing} from the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; who conceived, and bore him a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little {while}, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And {God} said to him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said {God}, Call his name Loammi: for ye {are} not my people, and I will not be your {God}.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, {that} in the place where it was said to them, Ye {are} not my people, {there} it shall be said to them, {Ye are} the sons of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up from the land: for great {shall be} the day of Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: Say ye to your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.

column.name: text
column.value: Contend with your mother, contend: for she {is} not my wife, neither {am} I her husband: let her therefore put away her harlotry out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

column.name: text
column.value: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they {are} the children of harlotry.

column.name: text
column.value: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give {me} my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

column.name: text
column.value: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find {them}: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then {was it} better with me than now.

column.name: text
column.value: For she did not know that I gave her grain, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, {which} they prepared for Baal.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore will I return, and take away my grain in its time, and my wine in its season, and I will recover my wool and my flax {given} to cover her nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And now will I uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, of which she hath said, These {are} my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will judge her for the days of Baalim, in which she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgot me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak kindly to her.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give her her vineyards there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came from the land of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, {that} thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and {with} the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down in safety.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will betroth thee to me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee to me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

column.name: text
column.value: I will even betroth thee to me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth shall hear the grain, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to {them who were} not my people, Thou {art} my people; and they shall say, {Thou art} my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD to me, Go yet, love a woman beloved by {her} friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

column.name: text
column.value: So I bought her to me for fifteen {pieces} of silver, and {for} an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for {another} man: so {will} I also {be} for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and {without} teraphim:

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment {is} toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

column.name: text
