column.value: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, {and} joy and gladness from the house of our God?

column.name: text
column.value: The seed hath perished under their clods, the storehouses are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the grain is withered.

column.name: text
column.value: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: The beasts of the field cry also to thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for {it is} near at hand;

column.name: text
column.value: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, {even} to the years of many generations.

column.name: text
column.value: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land {is} as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

column.name: text
column.value: The appearance of them {is} as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

column.name: text
column.value: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

column.name: text
column.value: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and {when} they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

column.name: text
column.value: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp {is} very great: for {he is} strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD {is} great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye {even} to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

column.name: text
column.value: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn to the LORD your God: for he {is} gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth of the evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Who knoweth {if} he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; {even} a meat offering and a drink offering to the LORD your God?

column.name: text
column.value: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

column.name: text
column.value: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that nurse at the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, and the bride out of her room.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thy heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: why should they say among the people, Where {is} their God?

column.name: text
column.value: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD will answer and say to his people, Behold, I will send you grain, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied with it: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will remove far from you the northern {army}, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his rear toward the west sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth its fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

column.name: text
column.value: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first {month}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I {am} in the midst of Israel, and {that} I {am} the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass afterward, {that} I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

column.name: text
column.value: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} whoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will judge them there for my people and {for} my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and divided my land.

column.name: text
column.value: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly {and} speedily I will return your recompence upon your own head;

column.name: text
column.value: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my precious things:

column.name: text
column.value: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold to the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will raise them out of the place where ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

column.name: text
column.value: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I {am} strong.

column.name: text
column.value: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together all around: there cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the heathen be awakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen on every side.

column.name: text
column.value: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, go down; for the press is full, the vats overflow; for their wickedness {is} great.

column.name: text
column.value: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD {is} near in the valley of decision.

column.name: text
column.value: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD {will be} the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall ye know that I {am} the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

column.name: text
column.value: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence {against} the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

column.name: text
column.value: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will cleanse their blood {that} I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away {its punishment}; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, {and} with the sound of the trumpet:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cut off the judge from the midst of it and will slay all its princes with him, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away {their punishment}; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after which their fathers have walked:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away {their punishment}; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

column.name: text
column.value: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in to the {same} maid, to profane my holy name:

column.name: text
column.value: And they lay {themselves} down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned {in} the house of their god.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height {was} like the height of the cedars, and he {was} strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I brought you from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

column.name: text
column.value: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. {Is it} not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed {that is} full of sheaves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and {he that is} swift of foot shall not deliver {himself}: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And {he that is} courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away its {punishment}; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.

column.name: text
column.value: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away its {punishment}; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver {them} up to Edom:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour its palaces:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn my hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away its {punishment}; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, which shall devour its palaces.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away its {punishment}; because he pursued his brother with the sword, and cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away {their punishment}; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

column.name: text
column.value: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

column.name: text
column.value: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word, ye cows of Bashan, that {are} in the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every {cow at that which is} before her; and ye shall cast {them} into the palace, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, {and} your tithes after three years:

column.name: text
column.value: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim {and} declare the free offerings: for this pleaseth you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And also I have withheld the rain from you, when {there were} yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece on which it rained not withered.

column.name: text
column.value: So two {or} three cities wandered to one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I have smitten you with blighting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured {them}: yet have ye not returned to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up to your nostrils: yet have ye not returned to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I have overthrown {some} of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus will I do to thee, O Israel: {and} because I will do this to thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth to man what {is} his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, {even} a lamentation, O house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; {there is} none to raise her up.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out {by} a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth {by} an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD to the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

column.name: text
column.value: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour {it}, and {there be} none to quench {it} in Bethel.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: {Seek him} that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD {is} his name:

column.name: text
column.value: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

column.name: text
column.value: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch therefore as your treading {is} upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know your many transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate {from their right}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it {is} an evil time.

column.name: text
column.value: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing {shall be} in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the farmer to mourning, and such as are skilful in lamentation to wailing.

column.name: text
column.value: And in all vineyards {shall be} wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end {is} it for you? the day of the LORD {is} darkness, and not light.

column.name: text
column.value: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

column.name: text
column.value: {Shall} not the day of the LORD {be} darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

column.name: text
column.value: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not take delight in your solemn assemblies.

column.name: text
column.value: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept {them}: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

column.name: text
column.value: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy harps.

column.name: text
column.value: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

column.name: text
column.value: Have ye offered to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Molech and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name {is} The God of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them {that are} at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, {who are} named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

column.name: text
column.value: Pass ye to Calneh, and see; and from there go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: {are they} better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

column.name: text
column.value: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat lambs from the flock, and calves from the midst of the stall;

column.name: text
column.value: That chant to the sound of the harp, {and} invent to themselves instruments of music, like David;

column.name: text
column.value: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore I will deliver up the city with all its abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, they shall die.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring the bones out of the house, and shall say to him that {is} inside of the house, {Is there} yet {any} with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall horses run upon the rock? will {one} plow {there} with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

column.name: text
column.value: Ye who rejoice in a thing of nought, who say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

column.name: text
column.value: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the river of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus hath the Lord GOD shown to me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, {it was} the latter growth after the king's mowings.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} when they had stopped eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he {is} small.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus hath the Lord GOD shown to me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and ate up a part.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he {is} small.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus he showed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall {made} by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

column.name: text
column.value: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

column.name: text
column.value: Also Amaziah said to Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

column.name: text
column.value: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it {is} the king's sanctuary, and it {is} the king's court.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I {was} no prophet, neither {was} I a prophet's son; but I {was} an herdman, and a gatherer of sycamore fruit:

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said to me, Go, prophesy to my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not {thy word} against the house of Isaac.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go from his land into captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: Can two walk together, except they are agreed?

column.name: text
column.value: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he hath taken nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no trap {is} for him? shall {one} take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

column.name: text
column.value: Shalt a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret to his servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?

column.name: text
column.value: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst of it, and the oppressed in the midst of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary {there shall be} even on every side the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be plundered.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus {in} a couch.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,

column.name: text
column.value: That in the day that I shall judge the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also judge the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus hath the Lord GOD shown to me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD to me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

column.name: text
column.value: And the songs of the temple shall be wailing in that day, saith the Lord GOD: {there shall be} many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast {them} forth with silence.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

column.name: text
column.value: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; and even sell the refuse of the wheat?

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth in it? and it shall rise up wholly as a river; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as {by} the river of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only {son}, and the end of it as a bitter day.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: Though they dig into hell, from there shall my hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, from there will I bring them down:

column.name: text
column.value: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they are hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, from there will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

column.name: text
column.value: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, there will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set my eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord GOD of hosts {is} he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell in it shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a river; and shall be drowned, as {by} the river of Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} he that buildeth his chambers in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: {Are} ye not as children of the Cushites to me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel from the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD {are} upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as {grain} is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the smallest grain fall upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, The evil shall not overtake nor fall upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up its breaches; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

column.name: text
column.value: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, who are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit {them}; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine of them; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

column.name: text
column.value: The pride of thy heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation {is} high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

column.name: text
column.value: Though thou shalt exalt {thyself} as the eagle, and though thou shalt set thy nest among the stars, from there will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave {some} grapes?

column.name: text
column.value: How are {the things} of Esau searched out! {how} are his hidden things sought!

column.name: text
column.value: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee {even} to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, {and} prevailed against thee; {they that eat} thy bread have laid a trap under thee: {there is} no understanding in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise {men} out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

column.name: text
column.value: And thy mighty {men}, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: For {thy} violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou {wast} as one of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid {hands} on their substance in the day of their calamity;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that escaped; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that remained in the day of distress.

column.name: text
column.value: For the day of the LORD {is} near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done to thee: thy reward shall return upon thy own head.

column.name: text
column.value: For as ye drank upon my holy mountain, {so} shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

column.name: text
column.value: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be {any} remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And {they of} the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and {they of} the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin {shall possess} Gilead.

column.name: text
column.value: And the captives of this host of the children of Israel {shall possess} that of the Canaanites, {even} to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, which {is} in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And deliverers shall come upon mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jonah arose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was in danger of being broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man to his god, and cast the wares that {were} in the ship into the sea, to lighten {it} of them. But Jonah had gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: So the shipmaster came to him, and said to him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, it may be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said every one to another, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil {is} upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil {is} upon us; What {is} thy occupation? and from where comest thou? what {is} thy country? and of what people {art} thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, I {am} an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who hath made the sea and the dry {land}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said to him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, What shall we do to thee, that the sea may be calm to us? for the sea raged, and was tempestuous.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Take me, and cast me into the sea; so shall the sea be calm to you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest {is} upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring {it} to the land; but they could not: for the sea raged, and was tempestuous against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they cried to the LORD, and said, We beseech thee, O LORD, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So they took Jonah, and cast him into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice to the LORD, and made vows.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, I cried by reason of my affliction to the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, {and} thou heardest my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods surrounded me: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: The waters surrounded me, {even} to the soul: the depth inclosed me on every side, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

column.name: text
column.value: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars {was} about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.

column.name: text
column.value: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came to thee, into thy holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will sacrifice to thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay {that} which I have vowed. Salvation {is} of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry {land}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Jonah the second time, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the preaching that I bid thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

column.name: text
column.value: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

column.name: text
column.value: For word came to the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered {himself} with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he caused {it} to be proclaimed and declared through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

column.name: text
column.value: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily to God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that {is} in their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Who can tell {if} God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

column.name: text
column.value: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do to them; and he did {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

column.name: text
column.value: And he prayed to the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, {was} not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before to Tarshish: for I knew that thou {art} a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest of the evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for {it is} better for me to die than to live.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry?

column.name: text
column.value: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made {it} to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

column.name: text
column.value: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the sun rose, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, {It is} better for me to die than to live.

column.name: text
column.value: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, {even} to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for which thou hast not laboured, neither made it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

column.name: text
column.value: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than an hundred and twenty thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and {also} many cattle?

column.name: text
column.value: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, {and} Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that is in it: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth from his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the mountains shall be melted under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, {and} as the waters {that are} poured down a steep place.

column.name: text
column.value: For the transgression of Jacob {is} all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What {is} the transgression of Jacob? {is it} not Samaria? and what {are} the high places of Judah? {are they} not Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, {and} as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down her stones into the valley, and I will lay bare her foundations.

column.name: text
column.value: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her hires shall be burned with the fire, and all her idols will I lay desolate: for she gathered {it} from the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will wail and weep, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

column.name: text
column.value: For her wound {is} incurable; for it is come to Judah; he is come to the gate of my people, {even} to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Declare ye {it} not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

column.name: text
column.value: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Bethezel; he shall receive from you his standing.

column.name: text
column.value: For the inhabitant of Maroth became weak waiting for good: but evil came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she {is} the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moreshethgath: the houses of Achzib {shall be} a lie to the kings of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet will I bring an heir to thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come to Adullam the glory of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Make thee bald, and cut off the hair of thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; {Is it} not for you to know judgment?

column.name: text
column.value: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from them, and their flesh from off their bones;

column.name: text
column.value: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they cry to the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore night {shall be} to you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark to you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for {there is} no answer of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

column.name: text
column.value: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Her heads judge for reward, and her priests teach for hire, and her prophets divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, {Is} not the LORD among us? no evil can come upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed {as} a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they covet fields, and take {them} by violence; and houses, and take {them} away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time {is} evil.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall {one} take up a parable against you, and lament with a grievous lamentation, {and} say, We are utterly wasted: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed {it} from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Prophesy ye not, {say they to them that} prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, {that} they shall not take shame.

column.name: text
column.value: O {thou that art} named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD shortened? {are} these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

column.name: text
column.value: Even of late my people hath risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse to war.

column.name: text
column.value: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise ye, and depart; for this {is} not {your} rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy {you}, even with a grievous destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood doth lie, {saying}, I will prophesy to thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

column.name: text
column.value: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of {the multitude of} men.

column.name: text
column.value: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and have gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But in the last days it shall come to pass, {that} the mount of the house of the LORD shall be established on the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow to it.

column.name: text
column.value: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make {them} afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day, saith the LORD, I will assemble her that is lame, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

column.name: text
column.value: And I will make her that limped a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, who have performed his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hidden in the day of the LORD'S anger.

column.name: text
column.value: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted out.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD {is} against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sea coast shall be dwellings {and} cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed there: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

column.name: text
column.value: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, by which they have reproached my people, and magnified {themselves} against their border.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore {as} I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, {even} the place possessed of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the remainder of my people shall lay them waste, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

column.value: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified {themselves} against the people of the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD {will be} terrible to them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and {men} shall worship him, every one from his place, {even} all the isles of the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye Cushites also, ye {shall be} slain by my sword.

column.value: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, {and} dry like a wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in her upper lintels; {their} voice shall sing in the windows; desolation {shall be} in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the rejoicing city that dwelt in security, that said in her heart, I {am}, and {there is} none besides me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, {and} shake his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

column.name: text
column.value: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, {and} was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

column.name: text
column.value: And {his} brightness was as the light; he had horns {coming} out of his hand: and there {was} the hiding of his power.

column.name: text
column.value: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways {are} everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: {and} the curtains of the land of Midian trembled.

column.name: text
column.value: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? {was} thy anger against the rivers? {was} thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thy horses {and} thy chariots of salvation?

column.name: text
column.value: Thy bow was made quite naked, {according} to the oaths of the tribes, {even thy} word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

column.name: text
column.value: The mountains saw thee, {and} they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, {and} lifted up his hands on high.

column.value: The sun {and} moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thy arrows they went, {and} at the shining of thy glittering spear.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, {even} for salvation with thy anointed; thou didst wound the head out of the house of the wicked, by laying bare the foundation to the neck. Selah.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou didst strike through with his staffs the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing {was} as to devour the poor secretly.

column.value: Thou didst walk through the sea with thy horses, {through} the mire of great waters.

column.value: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up to the people, he will invade them with his troops.

column.name: text
column.value: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither {shall} fruit {be} in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no food; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and {there shall be} no herd in the stalls:

column.value: The LORD God {is} my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' {feet}, and he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

column.name: text
column.value: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.

column.name: text
column.value: Her princes within her {are} roaring lions; her judges {are} evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the next morning.

column.name: text
column.value: Her prophets {are} light {and} treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

column.name: text
column.value: The just LORD {is} in the midst of her; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

column.name: text
column.value: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is no inhabitant.

column.name: text
column.value: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, however I punished them: but they rose early, {and} corrupted all their doings.

column.value: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.

column.name: text
column.value: From beyond the rivers of Cush my suppliants, {even} the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring my offering.

column.value: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make {them} afraid.

column.value: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee {is} mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

column.name: text
column.value: I will gather {them that are} sorrowful for the solemn assembly, {who} are of thee, {to whom} the reproach of it {was} a burden.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time will I bring you {again}, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: In the seventh {month}, in the one and twentieth {day} of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,

column.value: Who {is} left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? {is it} not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

column.name: text
column.value: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I {am} with you, saith the LORD of hosts:

column.name: text
column.value: {According to} the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it {is} a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry {land};

column.value: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.value: The silver {is} mine, and the gold {is} mine, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: In the four and twentieth {day} of the ninth {month}, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

column.name: text

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Haggai, If {one that is} unclean by a dead body shall touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Haggai, and said, So {is} this people, and so {is} this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so {is} every work of their hands; and that which they offer there {is} unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:

column.value: Since those {days} were, when {one} came to an heap of twenty {measures}, there were {but} ten: when {one} came to the winepress to draw out fifty {vessels} out of the press, there were {but} twenty.

column.value: I smote you with blighting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye {turned} not to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth {month, even} from the day that the foundation of the LORD'S temple was laid, consider {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless {you}.

column.name: text
column.value: And again the word of the LORD came to Haggai in the four and twentieth {day} of the month, saying,

column.value: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

column.value: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD'S house should be built.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: {Is it} time for you, O ye, to dwell in your panelled houses, and this house {lie} waste?

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe yourselves, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages {to put it} into a bag with holes.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye looked for much, and, lo, {it came} to little; and when ye brought {it} home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of my house that {is} waste, and ye run every man to his own house.

column.value: Therefore the heavens over you withhold the dew, and the earth withholdeth her fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the grain, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon {that} which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then spoke Haggai the LORD'S messenger in the LORD'S message to the people, saying, I {am} with you, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,

column.name: text
column.value: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

column.name: text
column.value: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD hath been very angry with your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore say thou to them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye to me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn to you, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye not as your fathers, to whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and {from} your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken to me, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Your fathers, where {are} they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

column.name: text
column.value: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, As the LORD of hosts thought to do to us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which {is} the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that {were} in the bottom; and behind him {were there} red horses, speckled, and white.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, O my lord, what {are} these? And the angel that talked with me said to me, I will show thee what these {are}.

column.value: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These {are they} whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these seventy years?

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me {with} good words {and} comforting words.

column.value: And I said to the angel that talked with me, What {are} these? And he answered me, These {are} the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

column.value: And the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

column.value: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spoke, saying, These {are} the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head: but these are come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted {their} horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

column.value: And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: {is} not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

column.value: And I said, Let them set a clean mitre upon his head. So they set a clean mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.

column.value: Then I answered, and said to him, What {are} these two olive trees upon the right {side} of the lampstand and upon its left {side}?

column.value: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these {are}? And I said, No, my lord.

column.value: Then said he to me, This {is} the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off {as} on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off {as} on that side according to it.

column.value: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind {was} in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

column.value: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Where do these bear the ephah?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, To build for it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

column.name: text
column.value: And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains {were} mountains of brass.

column.name: text
column.value: In the first chariot {were} red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

column.name: text
column.value: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot spotted and bay horses.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I answered and said to the angel that talked with me, What {are} these, my lord?

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel answered and said to me, These {are} the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The black horses which {are} in it go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the spotted go forth toward the south country.

column.name: text
column.value: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Go from here, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he cried upon me, and spoke to me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Take of {them of} the captivity, {even} of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, who are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

column.name: text
column.value: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set {them} upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;

column.name: text
column.value: And speak to him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name {is} The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

column.name: text
