column.value: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And they {that are} far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me to you. And {this} shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, {that} the word of the LORD came to Zechariah in the fourth {day} of the ninth month, {even} in Chisleu;

column.name: text
column.value: When they had sent to the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,

column.name: text
column.value: {And} to speak to the priests who {were} in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Speak to all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh {month}, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast to me, {even} to me?

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye ate, and when ye drank, did ye not eat {for yourselves}, and drink {for yourselves}?

column.name: text
column.value: {Should ye} not {hear} the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around it, when {men} inhabited the south and the plain?

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

column.name: text
column.value: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But they refused to hearken, and withdrew the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, they made their hearts {as} an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore it is come to pass, {that} as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:

column.name: text
column.value: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus {shall be} the rest of it: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, {shall be} toward the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And Hamath also shall border by it; Tyre, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

column.name: text
column.value: And Tyre built herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the LORD will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Ashkelon shall see {it}, and fear; Gaza also {shall see it}, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, {shall be} for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will encamp about my house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh to thee: he {is} just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon a donkey, and upon a colt the foal of a donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace to the heathen: and his dominion {shall be} from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit in which {is} no water.

column.name: text
column.value: Return to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare {that} I will render double to thee;

column.name: text
column.value: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue the sling stones; and they shall drink, {and} make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, {and} as the corners of the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they {shall be as} the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

column.name: text
column.value: For how great {is} his goodness, and how great {is} his beauty! Grain shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came {to me}, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD; I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

column.name: text
column.value: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it is marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in my eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, who {were} in the day {when} the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

column.name: text
column.value: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither {was there any} peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: But now I {will} not {be} to the remnant of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: For the seed {shall be} prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these {things}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, let your hands be strong.

column.name: text
column.value: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:

column.name: text
column.value: So again have I thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

column.name: text
column.value: These {are} the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

column.name: text
column.value: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these {are things} that I hate, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth {month}, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; {It shall} yet {come to pass}, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

column.name: text
column.value: And the inhabitants of one {city} shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.

column.name: text
column.value: And many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days {it shall come to pass}, that ten men out of all languages of the nations, shall take hold, shall even take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard {that} God {is} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; {so} the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

column.name: text
column.value: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because {there was} no shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his majestic horse in the battle.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be as mighty {men}, who tread down {their enemies} in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD {is} with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I {am} the LORD their God, and will hear them.

column.name: text
column.value: And {they of} Ephraim shall be like a mighty {man}, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see {it}, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

column.name: text
column.value: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and {place} shall not be found for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

column.name: text
column.value: Wail, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are laid waste: wail, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} a voice of the wailing of the shepherds; for their glory is destroyed: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is laid waste.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

column.name: text
column.value: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed {be} the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, {even} you, O poor of the flock. And I took to me two staffs; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, I will not feed you: that which dieth, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took my staff, {even} Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it {was} the word of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to them, If ye think good, give {me} my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty {pieces} of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Cast it to the potter: a magnificent price that I was valued at by them. And I took the thirty {pieces} of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I cut asunder my other staff, {even} Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD said to me, Take to thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, {who} shall not visit those that are cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the idle shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword {shall be} upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be wholly dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, who stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling to all the surrounding people, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah {and} against Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered against it.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open my eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem {shall be} my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the surrounding people, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, {even} in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem may not magnify {themselves} against Judah.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David {shall be} as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for {his} only {son}, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for {his} firstborn.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

column.name: text
column.value: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

column.name: text
column.value: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, {that} I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say to him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall say, I {am} no prophet, I {am} a farmer; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: And {one} shall say to him, What {are} these wounds in thy hands? Then he shall answer, {Those} with which I was wounded {in} the house of my friends.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man {that is} my companion, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn my hand upon the little ones.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts in it shall be cut off {and} die; but the third shall be left in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It {is} my people: and they shall say, The LORD {is} my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which {is} before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst of it toward the east and toward the west, {and there shall be} a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall flee {to} the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azal: yea, ye shall flee, as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, {and} all the saints with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} the light shall not be clear, {nor} dark:

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, {that} at evening it shall be light.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be in that day, {that} living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

column.name: text
column.value: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.

column.name: text
column.value: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and {from} the tower of Hananeel to the king's winepresses.

column.name: text
column.value: And {men} shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

column.name: text
column.value: And this shall be the plague with which the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in that day, {that} a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen on every side shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

column.name: text
column.value: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the donkey, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall be, {that} whoever will not come up of {all} the families of the earth to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the family of Egypt shall not go up, and shall not come, that {have} no {rain}; there shall be the plague, with which the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day there shall be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS TO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness to the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and boil in them: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

column.name: text
column.value: But to you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do {this}, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, {with} the statutes and judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and terrible day of the LORD:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O ye priests, this commandment {is} for you.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay {it} to heart, to give glory to my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay {it} to heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, {even} the dung of your solemn feasts; and {one} shall take you away with it.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him {for} the fear which he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

column.name: text
column.value: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and turned many away from iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he {is} the messenger of the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

column.name: text
column.value: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

column.name: text
column.value: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD whom he loved, and hath married the daughter of a foreign god.

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering to the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth {it} with good will at your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye say, Why? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet {is} she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

column.name: text
column.value: And did he not make one? Yet had he the remnant of the spirit. And why one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

column.name: text
column.value: For the LORD, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for {one} covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, How have we wearied {him}? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil {is} good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where {is} the God of judgment?

column.name: text
column.value: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

column.name: text
column.value: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, How hast thou loved us? {Was} not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,

column.name: text
column.value: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: Though Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: A son honoureth {his} father, and a servant his master: if then I {am} a father, where {is} my honour? and if I {am} a master, where {is} my fear? saith the LORD of hosts to you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, How have we despised thy name?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye offer polluted bread upon my altar; and ye say, How have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD {is} contemptible.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, {is it} not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, {is it} not evil? offer it now to thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious to us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your person? saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is there} even among you that would shut the doors {for nought}? neither do ye kindle {fire} on my altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

column.name: text
column.value: For from the rising of the sun even to the setting of the same my name {shall be} great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense {shall be} offered to my name, and a pure offering: for my name {shall be} great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD {is} polluted; and the fruit of it, {even} his food, {is} contemptible.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness {is it}! and ye have sneered at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought {that which was} torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this from your hand? saith the LORD.

column.name: text
column.value: But cursed {be} the deceiver, who hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth to the Lord a corrupt thing: for I {am} a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name {is} terrible among the heathen.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he {is} like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall sit {as} a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer to the LORD an offering in righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant to the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in {his} wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger {from his right}, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: For I {am} the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

column.name: text
column.value: Even from the days of your fathers ye have gone away from my ordinances, and have not kept {them}. Return to me, and I will return to you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, How shall we return?

column.name: text
column.value: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, How have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye {are} cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, {even} this whole nation.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open for you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that {there shall} not {be room} enough {to receive it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken {so much} against thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have said, It {is} vain to serve God: and what profit {is it} that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?

column.name: text
column.value: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; even {they that} tempt God are delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they that feared the LORD spoke often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard {it}, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

column.name: text
column.value: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

column.name: text
column.value: And Judah begat Pharez and Zarah of Tamar; and Pharez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;

column.name: text
column.value: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;

column.name: text
column.value: And Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her {that had been the wife} of Uriah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Solomon begat Rehoboam; and Rehoboam begat Abijah; and Abijah begat Asa;

column.name: text
column.value: And Asa begat Jehoshaphat; and Jehoshaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Uzziah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Uzziah begat Jotham; and Jotham begat Ahaz; and Ahaz begat Hezekiah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Hezekiah begat Manasseh; and Manasseh begat Amon; and Amon begat Josiah;

column.name: text
column.value: And Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

column.name: text
column.value: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jeconiah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;

column.name: text
column.value: And Zerubbabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

column.name: text
column.value: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

column.name: text
column.value: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

column.name: text
column.value: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: So all the generations from Abraham to David {are} fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon {are} fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon to Christ {are} fourteen generations.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was in this manner: When his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph her husband, being a just {man}, and not willing to make her a public example, purposed to put her away secretly.

column.name: text
column.value: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take to thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken from the Lord by the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took to him his wife:

column.name: text
column.value: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

column.name: text
column.value: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leather belt about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region about Jordan,

column.name: text
column.value: And were baptized by him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said to them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

column.name: text
column.value: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance:

column.name: text
column.value: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for {our} father: for I say to you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And now also the axe is laid to the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: I indeed baptize you with water to repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit, and {with} fire:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose fan {is} in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his floor, and gather his wheat into the barn; but he will burn the chaff with unquenchable fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

column.name: text
column.value: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized by thee, and comest thou to me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to him, Permit {it to be so} now: for thus it is befitting for us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he allowed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up immediately out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

column.name: text
column.value: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was Jesus led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou art the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in {their} hands they shall uphold, thee, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the devil taketh him up upon an exceeding high mountain, and showeth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith Jesus to him, Away with thee, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

column.name: text
column.value: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali:

column.name: text
column.value: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The land of Zebulun, and the land of Naphtali, {by} the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

column.name: text
column.value: The people who sat in darkness saw great light; and to them who sat in the region and shadow of death light hath shone.

column.name: text
column.value: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they immediately left {their} nets, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And going on from there, he saw other two brethren, James {the son} of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And his fame spread throughout all Syria: and they brought to him all sick people that were sick with various diseases and torments, and those who were possessed with demons, and those who were lunatic, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and {from} Decapolis, and {from} Jerusalem, and {from} Judaea, and {from} beyond Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and have come to worship him.

column.name: text
column.value: When Herod the king had heard {these things}, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he enquired of them where the Christ should be born.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

column.name: text
column.value: And thou Bethlehem, {in} the land of Judah, art not the least among the princes of Judah: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Herod, when he had secretly called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found {him}, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

column.name: text
column.value: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented to him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

column.name: text
column.value: And being warned by God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

column.name: text
column.value: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

column.name: text
column.value: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken from the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceeding angry, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all its surrounding lands, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: In Ramah was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping {for} her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead who sought the young child's life.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judaea in the place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there: however, being warned by God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

column.name: text
column.value: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing the multitudes, he went up to a mountain: and when he was seated, his disciples came to him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} they who hunger and thirst for righteousness: for they shall be filled.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} the peacemakers: for they shall be called children of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} they who are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are ye, when {men} shall revile you, and persecute {you}, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great {is} your reward in heaven: for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt hath lost its savour, how shall it be salted? it is then good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot by men.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither do men light a lamp, and put it under a basket, but on a lampstand; and it giveth light to all that are in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

column.name: text
column.value: For verily I say to you, Till heaven and earth shall pass away, one jot or one tittle shall by no means pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whoever shall do and teach {them}, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, That except your righteousness shall exceed {the righteousness} of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no way enter into the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That whoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if thou shalt bring thy gift to the altar, and there remember that thy brother hath any thing against thee;

column.name: text
column.value: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

column.name: text
column.value: Agree with thy adversary quickly, while thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to thee, Thou shalt by no means come out from there, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard that it was said to them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That whoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy right eye shall cause thee to sin, pluck it out, and cast {it} from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not {that} thy whole body should be cast into hell.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy right hand shall cause thee to sin, cut it off, and cast {it} from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not {that} thy whole body should be cast into hell.

column.name: text
column.value: It hath been said, Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That whoever shall put away his wife, except for the cause of immorality, causeth her to commit adultery: and whoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said to them of old time, Thou shalt not swear falsely, but shalt perform to the Lord thy oaths:

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

column.name: text
column.value: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

column.name: text
column.value: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatever is more than these cometh of evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That ye resist not evil: but whoever shall strike thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have {thy} cloke also.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall compel thee to go one mile, go with him two.

column.name: text
column.value: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thy enemy.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them who despitefully use you, and persecute you;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may be the children of your Father who is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye love them who love you, what reward have ye? do not even the tax collectors the same?

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye greet your brethren only, what do ye more {than others}? do not even the tax collectors so?

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father who is in heaven is perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen by them: otherwise ye have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when thou doest {thy} alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory from men. Verily I say to you, They have their reward.

column.name: text
column.value: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

column.name: text
column.value: That thy alms may be in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

column.name: text
column.value: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites {are}: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Verily I say to you, They have their reward.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father who is in secret; and thy Father who seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

column.name: text
column.value: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen {do}: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, be ye not like them: for your Father knoweth what things ye need, before ye ask him.

column.name: text
column.value: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as {it is} in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Give us this day our daily bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

column.name: text
column.value: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear to men to fast. Verily I say to you, They have their reward.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thy head, and wash thy face;

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest not appear to men to fast, but to thy Father who is in secret: and thy Father, who seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

column.name: text
column.value: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

column.name: text
column.value: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

column.name: text
column.value: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

column.name: text
column.value: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thy eye is clear, thy whole body shall be full of light.

column.name: text
column.value: But if thy eye is bad, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee is darkness, how great {is} that darkness!

column.name: text
column.value: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and riches.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than food, and the body than raiment?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

column.name: text
column.value: Which of you by being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

column.name: text
column.value: And why are ye anxious for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

column.name: text
column.value: And yet I say to you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if God so clotheth the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, {shall he} not much more {clothe} you, O ye of little faith?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be not anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?

column.name: text
column.value: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be not anxious for to morrow: for to morrow will be anxious for the things of itself. Sufficient to the day {is} its own evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

column.name: text
column.value: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with the measure which ye measure with, it shall be measured to you again.

column.name: text
column.value: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thy own eye?

column.name: text
column.value: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thy eye; and, behold, a beam {is} in thy own eye?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thy own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

column.name: text
column.value: Give not that which is holy to dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you:

column.name: text
column.value: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: Or what man is there of you, who if his son shall ask bread, will give him a stone?

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he shall ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

column.name: text
column.value: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more shall your Father who is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore all things whatever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Enter ye in at the narrow gate: for wide {is} the gate, and broad {is} the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there are who go in by it:

column.name: text
column.value: Because small {is} the gate, and narrow {is} the way, which leadeth to life, and few there are that find it.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

column.name: text
column.value: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth bad fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: A good tree cannot bring forth bad fruit, neither {can} a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

column.name: text
column.value: Not every one that saith to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out demons? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

column.name: text
column.value: And then will I profess to them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore whoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house upon a rock:

column.name: text
column.value: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened to a foolish man, who built his house upon the sand:

column.name: text
column.value: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was its fall.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

column.name: text
column.value: For he taught them as {one} having authority, and not as the scribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished commanding his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and to preach in their cities.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, Go and show John again those things which ye hear and see:

column.name: text
column.value: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed is {he}, who shall not be offended because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they departed, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

column.name: text
column.value: But what went ye out to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft {clothing} are in kings' houses.

column.name: text
column.value: But what went ye out to see? A prophet? yea, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is {he}, concerning whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: however he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

column.name: text
column.value: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye will receive {it}, this is Elijah, who was to come.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: But to what shall I liken this generation? It is like children sitting in the markets, and calling to their companions,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, We have piped to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not lamented.

column.name: text
column.value: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a demon.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners. But wisdom is justified by her children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he began to upbraid the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they repented not:

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to thee, Chorazin! woe to thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which had been done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to babes.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: All things are delivered to me by my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, except the Son, and {he} to whomever the Son will reveal {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: Come to me, all {ye} that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest to your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: For my yoke {is} easy, and my burden is light.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had called to {him} his twelve disciples, he gave them power {against} unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James {the son} of Zebedee, and John his brother;

column.name: text
column.value: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the tax collector; James {the son} of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

column.name: text
column.value: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

column.name: text
column.value: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and enter ye not into {any} city of the Samaritans:

column.name: text
column.value: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons: freely ye have received, freely give.

column.name: text
column.value: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

column.name: text
column.value: Nor bag for {your} journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor staffs: for the workman is worthy of his food.

column.name: text
column.value: And into whatever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye come into an house, greet it.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart from that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

column.name: text
column.value: But beware of men: for they will deliver you to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given to you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaketh in you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against {their} parents, and cause them to be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be hated by all {men} for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say to you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man shall have come.

column.name: text
column.value: The disciple is not above {his} teacher, nor the servant above his lord.

column.name: text
column.value: It is enough for the disciple that he should be as his teacher, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more {shall they call} them of his household?

column.name: text
column.value: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

column.name: text
column.value: What I tell you in darkness, {that} speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, {that} proclaim upon the housetops.

column.name: text
column.value: And fear not them who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

column.name: text
column.value: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and not one of them shall fall on the ground without your Father.

column.name: text
column.value: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

column.name: text
column.value: And a man's foes {shall be} they of his own household.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

column.name: text
column.value: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

column.name: text
column.value: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold {water} only in the name of a disciple, verily I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus put forth {his} hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to him, See thou tell no man; but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus had entered into Capernaum, there came to him a centurion, beseeching him,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick with the palsy, grievously tormented.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to him, I will come and heal him.

column.name: text
column.value: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this {man}, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard {it}, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say to you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, That many shall come from the east and the west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, {so} be it done to thee. And his servant was healed in the very same hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus had come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying, and sick with a fever.

column.name: text
column.value: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered to them.

column.name: text
