column.value: When the evening was come, they brought to him many that were possessed with demons: and he cast out the spirits with {his} word, and healed all that were sick:

column.name: text
column.value: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, He himself took our infirmities, and bore {our} sicknesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart to the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain scribe came, and said to him, Master, I will follow thee wherever thou goest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air {have} nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay {his} head.

column.name: text
column.value: And another of his disciples said to him, Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had entered into a boat, his disciples followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the boat was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples came to {him}, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

column.name: text
column.value: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with demons, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come here to torment us before the time?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

column.name: text
column.value: So the demons besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of swine.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Go. And when they had come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that kept them fled, and went away into the city, and told every thing, and what had befallen to the {ones} possessed with demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought {him} that he would depart out of their region.

column.name: text
column.value: And he entered into a boat, and passed over, and came into his own city.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick with the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said to the sick with the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins are forgiven thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This {man} blasphemeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Why think ye evil in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: For which is easier, to say, {Thy} sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

column.name: text
column.value: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick with the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go to thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and departed to his house.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the multitudes saw {it}, they marvelled, and glorified God, who had given such power to men.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Jesus passed on from there, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the tax office: and he saith to him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat {eating} in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Pharisees saw {it}, they said to his disciples, Why eateth your Master with tax collectors and sinners?

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus heard {that}, he said to them, They that are well need not a physician, but they that are sick.

column.name: text
column.value: But go ye and learn what {that} meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but thy disciples fast not?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then they shall fast.

column.name: text
column.value: No man putteth a piece of new cloth to an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the tear is made worse.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was speaking these things to them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and {so did} his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, a woman, who was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind {him}, and touched the hem of his garment:

column.name: text
column.value: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus turned himself about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee well. And the woman was healed from that hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed at him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fame of this went abroad into all that land.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus departed from there, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on us.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith to them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yea, Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus sternly charged them, saying, See {that} no man know {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But they, when they had departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

column.name: text
column.value: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a demon.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the demon was cast out, the dumb spoke: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out demons through the prince of the demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they were faint, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to his disciples, The harvest truly {is} plentiful, but the labourers {are} few;

column.name: text
column.value: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath through the grain fields; and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the heads of grain, and to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Pharisees saw {it}, they said to him, Behold, thy disciples do that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, and they that were with him;

column.name: text
column.value: How he entered into the house of God, and ate the showbread, which it was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them who were with him, but only for the priests?

column.name: text
column.value: Or have ye not read in the law, that on the sabbath the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That in this place is {one} greater than the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye had known what {this} meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had departed from there, he went into their synagogue:

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there was a man who had {his} hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath? that they might accuse him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it shall fall into a pit on the sabbath, will he not lay hold on it, and lift {it} out?

column.name: text
column.value: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Therefore it is lawful to do good on the sabbath days.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to the man, Stretch out thy hand. And he stretched {it} out; and it was restored as whole, as the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus knew {it}, he withdrew himself from there: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

column.name: text
column.value: And charged them that they should not make him known:

column.name: text
column.value: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall show justice to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall not quarrel, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

column.name: text
column.value: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he shall send forth justice to victory.

column.name: text
column.value: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was brought to him one possessed with a demon, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spoke and saw.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Pharisees heard {it}, they said, This {man} doth not cast out demons, but by Beelzebub the prince of the demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

column.name: text
column.value: And if Satan casteth out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then shall his kingdom stand?

column.name: text
column.value: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your children cast {them} out? therefore they shall be your judges.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I cast out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and seize his goods, except he shall first bind the strong man? and then he will plunder his house.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men: but the blasphemy {against} the {Holy} Spirit shall not be forgiven to men.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whoever speaketh against the Holy Spirit, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the {world} to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by {its} fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

column.name: text
column.value: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That for every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account for it in the day of judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh for a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah:

column.name: text
column.value: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and, behold, a greater than Jonah {is} here.

column.name: text
column.value: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon {is} here.

column.name: text
column.value: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and he findeth none.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he saith, I will return into my house from which I came out; and when he is come, he findeth {it} empty, swept, and garnished.

column.name: text
column.value: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last {state} of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also to this wicked generation.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was yet speaking to the people, behold, {his} mother and his brethren stood outside, desiring to speak with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one said to him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand outside, desiring to speak with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

column.name: text
column.value: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall do the will of my Father who is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

column.name: text
column.value: The same day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

column.name: text
column.value: And great multitudes were gathered together to him, so that he went into a boat, and sat down; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke many things to them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

column.name: text
column.value: And when he sowed, some {seeds} fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them:

column.name: text
column.value: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and immediately they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sun had risen, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

column.name: text
column.value: But others fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples came, and said to him, Why speakest thou to them in parables?

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to them, Because it is given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that which he hath.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I speak to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

column.name: text
column.value: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

column.name: text
column.value: For this people's heart has become dull, and {their} ears are hard of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with {their} eyes, and hear with {their} ears, and should understand with {their} heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

column.name: text
column.value: But blessed {are} your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For verily I say to you, That many prophets and righteous {men} have desired to see {the things} which ye see, and have not seen {them}; and to hear {the things} which ye hear, and have not heard {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

column.name: text
column.value: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth {it} not, then cometh the wicked {one}, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he who received seed by the way side.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and immediately with joy receiveth it;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet he hath not root in himself, but endureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, immediately he is offended.

column.name: text
column.value: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth {it}; who also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

column.name: text
column.value: Another parable he put forth to them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened to a man who sowed good seed in his field:

column.name: text
column.value: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the blade had sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

column.name: text
column.value: So the servants of the householder came and said to him, Sir, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? how then hath it tares?

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said to him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

column.name: text
column.value: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

column.name: text
column.value: Another parable he put forth to them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

column.name: text
column.value: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge on its branches.

column.name: text
column.value: Another parable he spoke to them; The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

column.name: text
column.value: All these things Jesus spoke to the multitude in parables; and without a parable he spoke not to them:

column.name: text
column.value: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came to him, saying, Make known to us {the meaning of} the parable of the tares of the field.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

column.name: text
column.value: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked {one};

column.name: text
column.value: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

column.name: text
column.value: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them who do iniquity;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hid in a field; which when a man hath found, he hideth, and from joy over it goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant man, seeking fine pearls:

column.name: text
column.value: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

column.name: text
column.value: Which, when it was full, they drew to the shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast away the bad.

column.name: text
column.value: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, Have ye understood all these things? They say to him, Yea, Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to them, Therefore every scribe {who is} instructed concerning the kingdom of heaven is like a man {that is} an householder, who bringeth forth out of his treasure {things} new and old.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, How hath this {man} this wisdom, and {these} mighty works?

column.name: text
column.value: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

column.name: text
column.value: And his sisters, are they not all with us? How then hath this {man} all these things?

column.name: text
column.value: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honour, except in his own country, and in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he hath risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do show forth themselves in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put {him} in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: For John had said to him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she would ask.

column.name: text
column.value: And she, being before instructed by her mother, said, Give me here the head of John the Baptist on a platter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the sake of the oath and them who sat eating with him, he commanded {it} to be given {her}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: And his head was brought on a platter, and given to the girl: and she brought {it} to her mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard {of it}, he departed from there in a boat into a desert place by himself: and when the people had heard {of it}, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now late; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And they say to him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: He said, Bring them here to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and broke, and gave the loaves to {his} disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate, and were satisfied: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a boat, and to go before him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up to a mountain by himself to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

column.name: text
column.value: But the boat was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went to them, walking on the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a ghost; and they cried out for fear.

column.name: text
column.value: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it is thou, bid me come to thee on the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Jesus stretched forth {his} hand, and caught him, and said to him, O thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt?

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come into the boat, the wind ceased.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they that were in the boat came and worshipped him, saying, In truth thou art the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all the surrounding country, and brought to him all that were diseased;

column.name: text
column.value: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly well.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees also and the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would show them a sign from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to them, When it is evening, ye say, {It will be} fair weather: for the sky is red.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning, {It will be} foul weather to day: for the sky is red and threatening. O {ye} hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not {discern} the signs of the times?

column.name: text
column.value: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh for a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah. And he left them, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his disciples had come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

column.name: text
column.value: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, {It is} because we have taken no bread.

column.name: text
column.value: {Which} when Jesus perceived, he said to them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

column.name: text
column.value: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

column.name: text
column.value: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

column.name: text
column.value: How is it that ye do not understand that I spoke not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they understood that he did not warn {them} against the leaven of bread, but against the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I the Son of man am?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Some {say that thou art} John the Baptist: some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to them, But who say ye that I am?

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed {it} to thee, but my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say also to thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give to thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he charged his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: From that time forth Jesus began to show to his disciples, that he must go to Jerusalem, and suffer many things from the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But he turned, and said to Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence to me: for thou savourest not the things that are of God, but those that are of men.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to his disciples, If any {man} will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever will save his life shall lose it: and whoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

column.name: text
column.value: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, There are some standing here, who shall not taste death, till they shall see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up upon an high mountain by themselves,

column.name: text
column.value: And he was transfigured before them: and his face shone as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there appeared to them Moses and Elijah talking with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Peter, and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was yet speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the disciples heard {it}, they fell on their face, and were greatly afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, except Jesus only.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they came down the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man is risen from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elijah must first come?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, Elijah truly shall first come, and restore all things.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That Elijah is come already, and they knew him not, but have done to him whatever they desired. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer by them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them concerning John the Baptist.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to the multitude, there came to him a {certain} man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatic, and greatly distressed: for often he falleth into the fire, and often into the water.

column.name: text
column.value: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him here to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus rebuked the demon; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the disciples to Jesus privately, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say to you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say to this mountain, Move from here to yonder place; and it shall move; and nothing shall be impossible to you.

column.name: text
column.value: However this kind goeth not out except by prayer and fasting.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceedingly sorrowful.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to Capernaum, they that received tribute {money} came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

column.name: text
column.value: He saith, Yes. And when he had come into the house, Jesus spoke to him first, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? from whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? from their own children, or from strangers?

column.name: text
column.value: Peter saith to him, From strangers. Jesus saith to him, Then are the children free.

column.name: text
column.value: However, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: take that, and give to them for me and thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, who were of Jerusalem, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said to them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

column.name: text
column.value: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye say, Whoever shall say to {his} father or {his} mother, {It is} a gift, by whatever thou mightest be profited by me;

column.name: text
column.value: And honour not his father or his mother, {he shall be free}. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of no effect by your tradition.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} hypocrites, well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: This people draweth near to me with their mouth, and honour me with {their} lips; but their heart is far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: But in vain they do worship me, teaching {for} doctrines the commandments of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called the multitude, and said to them, Hear, and understand:

column.name: text
column.value: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came his disciples, and said to him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted out.

column.name: text
column.value: Let them alone: they are blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind leadeth the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Peter and said to him, Make known to us {the meaning of} this parable.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

column.name: text
column.value: Do ye not yet understand, that whatever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the stomach, and is cast out into the draught?

column.name: text
column.value: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

column.name: text
column.value: These are {the things} which defile a man: but to eat with unwashed hands defileth not a man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went from there, and departed into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same region, and cried to him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, {thou} Son of David; my daughter is grievously afflicted with a demon.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said, I am not sent but to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said, It is not good to take the children's bread, and to cast {it} to dogs.

column.name: text
column.value: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus answered and said to her, O woman, great {is} thy faith: be it to thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and went up on a mountain, and sat down there.

column.name: text
column.value: And great multitudes came to him, having with them {those that were} lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and laid them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

column.name: text
column.value: So that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus called his disciples {to him}, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples say to him, Where should we get so much bread in the wilderness, as to satisfy so great a multitude?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and broke {them}, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate, and were filled: and they took up of the broken pieces that were left seven baskets full.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that had eaten were four thousand men, besides women and children.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent away the multitude, and got into a boat, and came into the region of Magdala.

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time came the disciples to Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus called a little child to him, and set him in the midst of them,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Verily I say to you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever shall cause one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it were better for him that a millstone were hung about his neck, and {that} he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if thy hand or thy foot causeth thee to sin, cut them off, and cast {them} from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life lame or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy eye causeth thee to sin, pluck it out, and cast {it} from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say to you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

column.name: text
column.value: How think ye? if a man hath an hundred sheep, and one of them is gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and go to the mountains, and seek that which is gone astray?

column.name: text
column.value: And if so be that he findeth it, verily I say to you, he rejoiceth more over that {sheep}, than over the ninety and nine which went not astray.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

column.name: text
column.value: But if he will not hear {thee, then} take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell {it} to the church: but if he shall neglect to hear the church, let him be to thee as an heathen and a tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Whatever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Again I say to you, That if two of you shall agree on earth concerning any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, I say not to thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened to a certain king, who would take account of his servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought to him, who owed him ten thousand talents.

column.name: text
column.value: But as he had nothing with which to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

column.name: text
column.value: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

column.name: text
column.value: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, who owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took {him} by the throat, saying, Pay me what thou owest.

column.name: text
column.value: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

column.name: text
column.value: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

column.name: text
column.value: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then his lord, having called him, said to him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou didst beg me:

column.name: text
column.value: Shouldest thou not also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And his lord was angry, and delivered him to the torturers, till he should pay all that was due to him.

column.name: text
column.value: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also to you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the region of Judaea beyond Jordan;

column.name: text
column.value: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees also came to him, tempting him, and saying to him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, Have ye not read, that he who made {them} at the beginning made them male and female,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they two shall be one flesh?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they are no more two, but one flesh. Therefore what God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts permitted you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, Whoever shall put away his wife, except for immorality, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoever marrieth her who is put away committeth adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples say to him, If the case of the man is so with {his} wife, it is not good to marry.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, All {men} cannot receive this saying, except {they} to whom it is given.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are some eunuchs, who were so born from {their} mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, who were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, who have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive {it}, let him receive {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were brought to him little children, that he should put {his} hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, Permit {the} little children, and forbid them not, to come to me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he laid {his} hands on them, and departed from there.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, one came and said to him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Why callest thou me good? {there is} none good but one, {that is}, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

column.name: text
column.value: Honour thy father and {thy} mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: The young man saith to him, All these things have I kept from my youth: what lack I yet?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, If thou wilt be perfect, go {and} sell what thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come {and} follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to his disciples, Verily I say to you, That it is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And again I say to you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: When his disciples heard {it}, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus beheld {them}, and said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Peter and said to him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Verily I say to you, That ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

column.name: text
column.value: But many {that are} first shall be last; and the last {shall be} first.

column.name: text
column.value: For the kingdom of heaven is like a man {that is} an householder, who went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you. And they went.

column.name: text
column.value: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith to them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith to them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatever is right, {that} shall ye receive.

column.name: text
column.value: So when evening was come, the lord of the vineyard saith to his steward, Call the labourers, and give them {their} hire, beginning from the last to the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came that {were hired} about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the first came, they supposed that they should receive more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had received {it}, they murmured against the master of the house,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, These last have worked {but} one hour, and thou hast made them equal to us, who have borne the burden and heat of the day.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst thou not agree with me for a penny?

column.name: text
column.value: Take {that} which {is} thine, and go thy way: I will give to this last, even as to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with my own? Is thy eye evil, because I am good?

column.name: text
column.value: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many are called, but few chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples aside in the way, and said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed to the chief priests and to the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify {him}: and the third day he shall rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping {him}, and desiring a certain thing of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, What wilt thou? She saith to him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say to him, We are able.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but {it shall be given to them} for whom it is prepared by my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the ten heard {it}, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called them {to him}, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall not be so among you: but whoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

column.name: text
column.value: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, {thou} Son of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude rebuked them, that they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, {thou} Son of David.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do to you?

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus had compassion {on them}, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and spoke to them again by parables, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage for his son,

column.name: text
column.value: And sent his servants to call them that were invited to the wedding: and they would not come.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, he sent other servants, saying, Tell them who are invited, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and {my} fatlings {are} killed, and all things {are} ready: come to the marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: But they made light of {it}, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant took his servants, and treated {them} spitefully, and slew {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the king heard {of it}, he was angry: and he sent his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he saith to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they who were invited were not worthy.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, invite to the marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who had not a wedding garment:

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to him, Friend, how camest thou in here not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast {him} into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: For many are called, but few {are} chosen.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in {his} talk.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent out to him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any {man}: for thou regardest not the person of men.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, {ye} hypocrites?

column.name: text
column.value: Show me the tribute money. And they brought to him a penny.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Whose {is} this image and superscription?

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, Caesar's. Then saith he to them, Render therefore to Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and to God the things that are God's.

column.name: text
column.value: When they had heard {these words}, they marvelled, and left him, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: The same day came to him the Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were with us seven brothers: and the first, when he had married a wife, died, and, having no issue, left his wife to his brother:

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

column.name: text
column.value: And last of all the woman died also.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But as concerning the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the multitude heard {this}, they were astonished at his doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together about him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of them, {who was} a lawyer, asked {him a question}, tempting him, and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Master, which {is} the great commandment in the law?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the first and great commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second {is} like it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, {The Son} of David.

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thy enemies thy footstool?

column.name: text
column.value: If David then calleth him Lord, how is he his son?

column.name: text
column.value: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither dared any {man} from that day forth ask him any more {questions}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to {him} to show him the buildings of the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, See ye not all these things? verily I say to you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what {shall be} the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

column.name: text
column.value: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all {these things} must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

column.name: text
column.value: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in various places.

column.name: text
column.value: All these {are} the beginning of sorrows.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated by all nations for my name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

column.name: text
column.value: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall become cold.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that shall endure to the end, the same shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a testimony to all nations; and then shall the end come.

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoever readeth, let him understand:)

column.name: text
column.value: Then let them who are in Judaea flee to the mountains:

column.name: text
column.value: Let him who is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither let him who is in the field return back to take his clothes.

column.name: text
column.value: And woe to them that are with child, and to them that nurse infants in those days!

column.name: text
column.value: But pray ye that your flight may not be in the winter, neither on the sabbath:

column.name: text
column.value: For then shall be great tribulation, such as hath not been since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

column.name: text
column.value: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

column.name: text
column.value: Then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here {is} Christ, or there; believe {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: For false Christs will arise, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; so that, if {it were} possible, they would deceive the very elect.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I have told you before.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if they shall say to you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, {he is} in the secret chambers; believe {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even to the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

column.name: text
column.value: For wherever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

column.name: text
column.value: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

column.name: text
column.value: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When its branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer {is} near:

column.name: text
column.value: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, {even} at the doors.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things shall be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: But of that day and hour knoweth no {man}, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

column.name: text
column.value: But as the days of Noah {were}, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

column.name: text
column.value: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark,

column.name: text
column.value: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so also will be the coming of the Son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: Two {women shall be} grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: But know this, that if the master of the house knew in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season?

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall begin to beat {his} fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

column.name: text
column.value: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for {him}, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint {him} his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they drew near to Jerusalem, and had come to Bethphage, to the mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying to them, Go into the village opposite you, and immediately ye shall find a donkey tied, and a colt with her: loose {them}, and bring {them} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any {man} shall say any thing to you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and immediately he will send them.

column.name: text
column.value: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Tell ye the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy King cometh to thee, meek, and sitting upon a donkey, and a colt the foal of a donkey.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

column.name: text
column.value: And brought the donkey, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set {him} on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and spread {them} in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were greatly displeased,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith to them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

column.name: text
column.value: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he was hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing on it, but leaves only, and said to it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforth for ever. And immediately the fig tree withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the disciples saw {it}, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, Verily I say to you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this {which is done} to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say to this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And all things, whatever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: The baptism of John, where was it from? from heaven, or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why then did ye not believe him?

column.name: text
column.value: But if we shall say, From men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: But what think ye? A {certain} man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I {go}, sir: and went not.

column.name: text
column.value: Which of the two did the will of {his} father? They say to him, The first. Jesus saith to them, Verily I say to you, That the tax collectors and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

column.name: text
column.value: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the tax collectors and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen {it}, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

column.name: text
column.value: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, who planted a vineyard, and hedged around it, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to vinedressers, and went into a far country:

column.name: text
column.value: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers, that they might receive its fruits.

column.name: text
column.value: And the vinedressers took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did to them in like manner.

column.name: text
column.value: But last of all he sent to them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: And they caught him, and cast {him} out of the vineyard, and slew {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore the lord of the vineyard cometh, what will he do to those vinedressers?

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out {his} vineyard to other vinedressers, who shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

column.name: text
