column.value: Therefore I say to you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke of them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they regarded him as a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus spoke to the multitude, and to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in the seat of Moses:

column.name: text
column.value: All therefore whatever they bid you observe, {that} observe and do; but do not ye according to their works: for they say, and do not.

column.name: text
column.value: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay {them} on men's shoulders; but they {themselves} will not move them with one of their fingers.

column.name: text
column.value: But all their works they do to be seen by men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

column.name: text
column.value: And love the uppermost places at feasts, and the best seats in the synagogues,

column.name: text
column.value: And greetings in the markets, and to be called by men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

column.name: text
column.value: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, {even} Christ; and all ye are brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And call no {man} your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, {even} Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in {yourselves}, neither allow ye them that are entering to go in.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye travel sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, {ye} blind guides, who say, Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} fools and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

column.name: text
column.value: And, Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is bound.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} fools and blind: for which {is} greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth in it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier {matters} of the law, justice, mercy, and faith: these ye ought to have done, and not to leave the others undone.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

column.name: text
column.value: {Thou} blind Pharisee, cleanse first that {which is} within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like whitewashed sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead {men's} bones, and of all uncleanness.

column.name: text
column.value: Thus ye also outwardly appear righteous to men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

column.name: text
column.value: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore ye are witnesses against yourselves, that ye are the children of them who killed the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} serpents, {ye} generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and {some} of them ye shall kill and crucify; and {some} of them ye shall scourge in your synagogues, and persecute {them} from city to city:

column.name: text
column.value: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, {thou} that killest the prophets, and stonest them who are sent to thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under {her} wings, and ye would not!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened to ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

column.name: text
column.value: And five of them were wise, and five {were} foolish.

column.name: text
column.value: They that {were} foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

column.name: text
column.value: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

column.name: text
column.value: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

column.name: text
column.value: And the foolish said to the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wise answered, saying, {Not so}; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they were going to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

column.name: text
column.value: But he answered and said, Verily I say to you, I know you not.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour when the Son of man cometh.

column.name: text
column.value: For {the kingdom of heaven is} as a man travelling into a far country, {who} called his own servants, and delivered to them his goods.

column.name: text
column.value: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his own ability; and immediately took his journey.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and gained other five talents.

column.name: text
column.value: And likewise he that {had received} two, he also gained other two.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that had received one went and dug in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

column.name: text
column.value: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou didst deliver to me five talents: behold, I have gained besides them five talents more.

column.name: text
column.value: His lord said to him, Well done, {thou} good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

column.name: text
column.value: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou didst deliver to me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents besides them.

column.name: text
column.value: His lord said to him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he who had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not scattered seed:

column.name: text
column.value: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, {there} thou hast {what is} thine.

column.name: text
column.value: His lord answered and said to him, {Thou} wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I have not sown, and gather where I have not scattered seed:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money in the bank, and {then} at my coming I should have received my own with interest.

column.name: text
column.value: Take therefore the talent from him, and give {it} to him who hath ten talents.

column.name: text
column.value: For to every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

column.name: text
column.value: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

column.name: text
column.value: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth {his} sheep from the goats:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the King say to them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

column.name: text
column.value: For I was hungry, and ye gave me food: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

column.name: text
column.value: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed {thee}? or thirsty, and gave {thee} drink?

column.name: text
column.value: When saw we thee a stranger, and took {thee} in? or naked, and clothed {thee}?

column.name: text
column.value: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And the King shall answer and say to them, Verily I say to you, Inasmuch as ye have done {it} to one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done {it} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he say also to them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

column.name: text
column.value: For I was hungry, and ye gave me no food: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

column.name: text
column.value: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say to you, Inasmuch as ye did {it} not to one of the least of these, ye did {it} not to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Ye know that after two days is the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: Then assembled the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, in the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

column.name: text
column.value: And consulted that they might take Jesus by guile, and kill {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: But they said, Not on the feast {day}, lest there be an uproar among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

column.name: text
column.value: There came to him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he was eating.

column.name: text
column.value: But when his disciples saw {it}, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose {is} this waste?

column.name: text
column.value: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus understood {it}, he said to them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

column.name: text
column.value: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did {it} for my burial.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Wherever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, {there} shall also this, what this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him to you? And they agreed with him for thirty pieces of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the first {day} of the {feast of} unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say to him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the evening was come, he sat down with the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were eating, he said, Verily I say to you, that one of you shall betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say to him, Lord, is it I?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said, He that dippeth {his} hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of man goeth as it is written concerning him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said to him, Thou hast said.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed {it}, and broke {it}, and gave {it} to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave {it} to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

column.name: text
column.value: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out to the mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith Jesus to them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter answered and said to him, Though all {men} shall be offended because of thee, {yet} will I never be offended.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, Verily I say to thee, That this night, before the cock shall crow, thou shalt deny me three times.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Then cometh Jesus with them to a place called Gethsemane, and saith to the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go yonder, and pray.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even to death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou {wilt}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cometh to the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith to Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

column.name: text
column.value: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed {is} willing, but the flesh {is} weak.

column.name: text
column.value: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

column.name: text
column.value: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he cometh to his disciples, and saith to them, Sleep on now, and take {your} rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: And while he was yet speaking, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staffs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Friend, why art thou come? Then they came, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, one of them who were with Jesus stretched out {his} hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to him, Put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword shall perish by the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

column.name: text
column.value: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

column.name: text
column.value: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staffs to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

column.name: text
column.value: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led {him} away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter followed him from afar off to the high priest's courtyard, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false testimony against Jesus, to put him to death;

column.name: text
column.value: But found none: and, though many false witnesses came, {yet} found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, This {man} said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

column.name: text
column.value: And the high priest arose, and said to him, Answerest thou nothing? what {is it which} these testify against thee?

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said to him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou art the Christ, the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say to you, After this shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest tore his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

column.name: text
column.value: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they spat in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote {him} with the palms of their hands,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Prophesy to us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Now Peter sat outside in the courtyard: and a maid came to him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied before {them} all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gone out into the porch, another {maid} saw him, and said to them that were there, This {man} was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

column.name: text
column.value: And after a while came to {him} they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art {one} of them; for thy speech betrayeth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then began he to curse and to swear, {saying}, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, who said to him, Before the cock shall crow, thou shalt deny me three times. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first {day} of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

column.name: text
column.value: And for fear of him the keepers shook, and became as dead {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel answered and said to the women, Fear ye not: for I know that ye seek Jesus, who was crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

column.name: text
column.value: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and ran to bring word to his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and showed to the chief priests all the things that had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him {away} while we slept.

column.name: text
column.value: And if this shall come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

column.name: text
column.value: So they took the money, and did as they were instructed: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, to a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, All authority is given to me in heaven and upon earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: Teaching them to observe all things whatever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, {even} to the end of the world. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had bound him, they led {him} away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Judas, who had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed innocent blood. And they said, What {is that} to us? see thou {to that}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore that field was called, The field of blood, to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

column.name: text
column.value: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, Thou sayest.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith Pilate to him, Hearest thou not how many things they testify against thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered to him never a word; so that the governor marvelled greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at {that} feast the custom of the governor was to release to the people a prisoner, whom they would.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom will ye that I release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

column.name: text
column.value: When he was seated on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: The governor answered and said to them, Which of the two will ye that I release to you? They said, Barabbas.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate saith to them, What shall I do then with Jesus who is called Christ? {They} all say to him, Let him be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate saw that he could not prevail at all, but {that} rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed {his} hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye {to it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood {be} on us, and on our children.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he released Barabbas to them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered {him} to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered to him the whole band {of soldiers}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put {it} upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

column.name: text
column.value: And they spat upon him, and took the reed, and struck him on the head.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

column.name: text
column.value: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted {it}, he would not drink.

column.name: text
column.value: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture they cast lots.

column.name: text
column.value: And sitting down they watched him there;

column.name: text
column.value: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest {it} in three days, save thyself. If thou art the Son of God, come down from the cross.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also the chief priests mocking {him}, with the scribes and elders, said,

column.name: text
column.value: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he is King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

column.name: text
column.value: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: The thieves also, who were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land to the ninth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

column.name: text
column.value: Some of them that stood there, when they heard {that}, said, This {man} calleth for Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled {it} with vinegar, and put {it} on a reed, and gave him to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: The rest said, Forbear, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth shook, and the rocks were split;

column.name: text
column.value: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of saints who slept were raised,

column.name: text
column.value: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared to many.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And many women were there beholding from afar off, who followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him:

column.name: text
column.value: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

column.name: text
column.value: When the evening was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was a disciple of Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

column.name: text
column.value: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made secure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say to the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate said to them, Ye have a watch: go, make {it} as secure as ye can.

column.name: text
column.value: So they went, and having sealed the stone, made the sepulchre secure, with a watch.

column.name: text
column.value: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

column.name: text
column.value: John was baptizing in the wilderness, and preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out to him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized by him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a leather belt around his loins; and he ate locusts and wild honey;

column.name: text
column.value: And preached, saying, There cometh after me one mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and loose.

column.name: text
column.value: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth to Galilee, and was baptized by John in Jordan.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a voice from heaven, {saying}, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as he was walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately they forsook their nets, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gone a little further from there, he saw James the {son} of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending their nets.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went into Capernaum; and immediately on the sabbath he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Let {us} alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine {is} this? for with authority he commandeth even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region surrounding Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

column.name: text
column.value: But the mother of Simon's wife lay sick with a fever, and immediately they tell him of her.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And at evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

column.name: text
column.value: And he healed many that were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons; and permitted not the demons to speak, because they knew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning, rising a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had found him, they said to him, All {men} seek for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for this purpose have I come.

column.name: text
column.value: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying to him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth {his} hand, and touched him, and saith to him, I will; be thou clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he strictly charged him, and immediately sent him away;

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go, show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But he went out, and began to proclaim {it} freely, and to blaze abroad the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he entered into Capernaum after {some} days; and it was heard that he was in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no room to receive {them}, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they come to him, bringing one sick with the palsy, who was borne by four.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they could not come near to him by reason of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken {it} up, they let down the bed on which the sick with the palsy lay.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the sick with the palsy, Son, thy sins are forgiven thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

column.name: text
column.value: Why doth this {man} thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said to them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier to say to the sick with the palsy, {Thy} sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

column.name: text
column.value: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick with the palsy,)

column.name: text
column.value: I say to thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go into thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted to him, and he taught them.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the {son} of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office, and said to him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus was eating in his house, many tax collectors and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eating with tax collectors and sinners, they said to his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with tax collectors and sinners?

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard {it}, he saith to them, They that are well have no need of a physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say to him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

column.name: text
column.value: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then they shall fast in those days.

column.name: text
column.value: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the tear is made worse.

column.name: text
column.value: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that he went through the grain fields on the sabbath; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the heads of grain.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees said to him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath that which is not lawful?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry, he, and they that were with him?

column.name: text
column.value: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the showbread, which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them who were with him?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there who had a withered hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And they watched him, to see whether he would heal him on the sabbath; that they might accuse him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to the man who had the withered hand, Stand forth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had looked around on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched {it} out: and his hand was restored as whole as the other.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees went forth, and immediately took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

column.name: text
column.value: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and {from} beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to his disciples, that a small boat should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

column.name: text
column.value: For he had healed many; so that they pressed upon him to touch him, as many as had afflictions.

column.name: text
column.value: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he strictly charged them that they should not make him known.

column.name: text
column.value: And he goeth up upon a mountain, and calleth {to him} whom he would: and they came to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he appointed twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

column.name: text
column.value: And to have authority to heal sicknesses, and to cast out demons:

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

column.name: text
column.value: And James the {son} of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

column.name: text
column.value: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the {son} of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his friends heard {of it}, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the demons he casteth out demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called them {to him}, and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

column.name: text
column.value: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

column.name: text
column.value: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

column.name: text
column.value: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and plunder his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, All sins shall be forgiven to the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they shall blaspheme:

column.name: text
column.value: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never hath forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

column.name: text
column.value: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude sat about him, and they said to him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked around on them who sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered to him a great multitude, so that he entered into a boat, and sat on the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And he taught them many things by parables, and said to them in his doctrine,

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken; Behold, a sower went out to sow:

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it.

column.name: text
column.value: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

column.name: text
column.value: But when the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: And other fell on good ground, and yielded fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, To you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but to them that are outside, all {these} things are done in parables:

column.name: text
column.value: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and {their} sins should be forgiven them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

column.name: text
column.value: The sower soweth the word.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are they likewise who are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

column.name: text
column.value: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they fall away.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are they who are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

column.name: text
column.value: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

column.name: text
column.value: And these are they who are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive {it}, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket, or under a bed? and not to be set on a lampstand?

column.name: text
column.value: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be revealed; neither hath any thing been kept secret, but that it should come to light.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Take heed what ye hear: with the measure which ye measure, it shall be measured to you: and to you that hear shall more be given.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

column.name: text
column.value: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

column.name: text
column.value: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of itself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the ripe grain in the head.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, To what shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that are in the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under its shadow.

column.name: text
column.value: And with many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But without a parable he spoke not to them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And the same day, when the evening was come, he saith to them, Let us pass over to the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the boat. And there were also with him other little boats.

column.name: text
column.value: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the boat, so that it was now full.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was in the stern of the boat, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say to him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

column.name: text
column.value: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

column.name: text
column.value: And they came over to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come out of the boat, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: Who had {his} dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

column.name: text
column.value: For he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any {man} tame him.

column.name: text
column.value: And always, night and day, he was on the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

column.name: text
column.value: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, {thou} Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

column.name: text
column.value: For he said to him, Come out of the man, {thou} unclean spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked him, What {is} thy name? And he answered, saying, My name {is} Legion: for we are many.

column.name: text
column.value: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was there near to the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the demons besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that fed the swine fled, and told {it} in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

column.name: text
column.value: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the demon, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that saw {it} told them how it befell him that was possessed with the demon, and {also} concerning the swine.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to beseech him to depart out of their region.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into the boat, he that had been possessed with the demon begged him that he might be with him.

column.name: text
column.value: However Jesus permitted him not, but saith to him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them what great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he departed, and began to proclaim in Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him: and all {men} marvelled.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus had passed over again in a boat to the other side, many people gathered to him: and he was near to the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

column.name: text
column.value: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: {I pray thee}, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: And {Jesus} went with him; and many people followed him, and thronged him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain woman, who had an issue of blood twelve years,

column.name: text
column.value: And had suffered many things from many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

column.name: text
column.value: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the crowd behind, and touched his garment.

column.name: text
column.value: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be made well.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in {her} body that she was healed of that affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that power had gone out of him, turned him about in the crowd, and said, Who touched my clothes?

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples said to him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked around to see her that had done this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee well; go in peace, and be healed of thy affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was yet speaking, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's {house certain} who said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith to the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

column.name: text
column.value: And he permitted no man to follow him, except Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come in, he saith to them, Why make ye this tumult, and weep? the child is not dead, but sleepeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laughed at him. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the child, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the child was lying.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the child by the hand, and said to her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Little girl, I say to thee, arise.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the child arose, and walked; for she was {of the age} of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them strictly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out from there, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sabbath was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing {him} were astonished, saying, From where hath this {man} these things? and what wisdom {is} this which is given to him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

column.name: text
column.value: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kindred, and in his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he could there do no mighty work, except that he laid his hands upon a few sick people, and healed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went around the villages, teaching.

column.name: text
column.value: And he calleth {to him} the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them authority over unclean spirits;

column.name: text
column.value: And commanded them that they should take nothing for {their} journey, except a staff only; no bag, no bread, no money in {their} purse:

column.name: text
column.value: But {be} shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, In whatever place ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart from there, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, than for that city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

column.name: text
column.value: And they cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And king Herod heard {of him}; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist has risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do show forth themselves in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Others said, That it is Elijah. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Herod heard {of him}, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he hath risen from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

column.name: text
column.value: For John had said to Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

column.name: text
column.value: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

column.name: text
column.value: And when a convenient day had come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief {men} of Galilee;

column.name: text
column.value: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said to the girl, Ask of me whatever thou wilt, and I will give {it} thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he swore to her, Whatever thou shalt ask of me, I will give {it} thee, to the half of my kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And she went forth, and said to her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

column.name: text
column.value: And she came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou shouldest give me immediately on a platter the head of John the Baptist.

column.name: text
column.value: And the king was exceeding sorry; {yet} for his oath's sake, and for their sakes who sat with him, he would not reject her.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

column.name: text
column.value: And brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl: and the girl gave it to her mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his disciples heard {of it}, they came and took up his dead body, and laid it in a tomb.

column.name: text
column.value: And the apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Come ye yourselves aside into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed into a desert place in a boat by themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran on foot there out of all cities, and went before them, and came together to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, when he came out, saw many people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came to him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time {is} far passed:

column.name: text
column.value: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to them, Give ye them to eat. And they say to him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and broke the loaves, and gave {them} to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes he divided among them all.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all ate, and were satisfied.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that ate of the loaves were about five thousand men.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he constrained his disciples to get into the boat, and to go to the other side before to Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had dismissed them, he departed to a mountain to pray.

column.name: text
column.value: And when evening was come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary to them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh to them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

column.name: text
column.value: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith to them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went up to them into the boat; and the wind ceased: and they were greatly amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

column.name: text
column.value: For they considered not {the miracle} of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come out of the boat, immediately they knew him,

column.name: text
column.value: And ran through that whole surrounding region, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made well.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came together to him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, who came from Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashed, hands, they found fault.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash {their} hands often, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: And {when they come} from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there are, which they have received to hold, {as} the washing of cups, and pots, and of brasen vessels, and tables.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashed hands?

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said to them, Well hath Isaiah prophesied concerning you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with {their} lips, but their heart is far from me.

column.name: text
column.value: But in vain do they worship me, teaching {for} doctrines the commandments of men.

column.name: text
column.value: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, {as} the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoever curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

column.name: text
column.value: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, {It is} Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatever thou mightest be profited by me; {he shall be free}.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye permit him no more to do any thing for his father or his mother;

column.name: text
column.value: Making the word of God of no effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things ye do.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had called all the people {to him}, he said to them, Hearken to me each one {of you}, and understand:

column.name: text
column.value: There is nothing from outside of a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Are ye so void of understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatever thing from outside entereth into the man, {it} cannot defile him;

column.name: text
column.value: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the stomach, and goeth out into the draught, purging all foods?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

column.name: text
column.value: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

column.name: text
column.value: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

column.name: text
column.value: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

column.name: text
column.value: And from there he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know {it}: but he could not be hid.

column.name: text
column.value: For a {certain} woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

column.name: text
column.value: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the demon out of her daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to her, Let the children first be satisfied: for it is not good to take the children's bread, and to cast {it} to the dogs.

column.name: text
column.value: And she answered and said to him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, For this saying go thy way; the demon is gone out of thy daughter.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had come to her house, she found the demon had gone out, and her daughter lying upon the bed.

column.name: text
column.value: And again, departing from the region of Tyre and Sidon, he came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the region of Decapolis.

column.name: text
column.value: And they bring to him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

column.name: text
column.value: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith to him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spoke plain.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they proclaimed {it};

column.name: text
column.value: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Verily I say to you, That there are some of them that stand here, who shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

column.name: text
column.value: And after six days Jesus taketh {with him} Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up upon an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can make them white.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared to them Elijah with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew not what to say; for they were greatly afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly, when they had looked around, they saw no man any more, except Jesus only with themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
