column.name: text
column.value: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elijah must first come?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and told them, Elijah verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written concerning the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be treated with contempt.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, That Elijah is indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, as it is written concerning him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to {his} disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to {him} greeted him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought to thee my son, who hath a dumb spirit;

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spoke to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I bear with you? bring him to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought him to him: and when he saw him, immediately the spirit tore him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked his father, How long is it since this came to him? And he said, From a child.

column.name: text
column.value: And often it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, If thou canst believe, all things {are} possible to him that believeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou my unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying to him, {Thou} dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

column.name: text
column.value: And {the spirit} cried, and tore him violently, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; so that many said, He is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from there, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For he taught his disciples, and said to them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

column.name: text
column.value: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who {should be} the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith to them, If any man desireth to be first, {the same} shall be last of all, and servant of all.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man who shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that is not against us is for us.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall cause one of {these} little ones that believe in me to stumble it is better for him that a millstone were hung about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy hand causeth thee to stumble, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

column.name: text
column.value: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy foot causeth thee to stumble, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter lame into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

column.name: text
column.value: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: And if thy eye causeth thee to stumble, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

column.name: text
column.value: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

column.name: text
column.value: Salt {is} good: but if the salt hath lost its saltness, how will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

column.name: text
column.value: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples, and saith to them,

column.name: text
column.value: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

column.name: text
column.value: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for some of them came from far.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples answered him, From where can a man satisfy these {men} with bread here in the wilderness?

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and broke, and gave to his disciples to set before {them}; and they set {them} before the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: So they ate, and were satisfied: and they took up of the fragments {of food} that were left, seven baskets.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he entered into a boat with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek for a sign? verily I say to you, There shall no sign be given to this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he left them, and entering into the boat again departed to the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: Now {the disciples} had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the boat with them more than one loaf.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and {of} the leaven of Herod.

column.name: text
column.value: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, {It is} because we have no bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus knew {it}, he saith to them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

column.name: text
column.value: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

column.name: text
column.value: When I broke the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say to him, Twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, How is it that ye do not understand?

column.name: text
column.value: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man to him, and besought him to touch him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw any thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

column.name: text
column.value: After that he put {his} hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell {it} to any in the town.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying to them, Who do men say that I am?

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some {say}, Elijah; and others, One of the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, But who say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith to him, Thou art the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, and the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that are of God, but the things that are of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had called the people {to him} with his disciples also, he said to them, Whoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever wishes to save his life shall lose it; but whoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

column.name: text
column.value: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

column.name: text
column.value: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose from there, and cometh into the region of Judaea by the other side of Jordan: and the people resort to him again; and, as he was accustomed, he taught them again.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away {his} wife? tempting him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, What did Moses command you?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Moses permitted to write a bill of divorcement, and to put {her} away.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

column.name: text
column.value: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

column.name: text
column.value: And they two shall be one flesh: so then they are no more two, but one flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man separate.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same {matter}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Whoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and {his} disciples rebuked those that brought {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus saw {it}, he was much displeased, and said to them, Permit the little children to come to me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Whoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took them up in his arms, put {his} hands upon them, and blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Why callest thou me good? {there is} none good but one, {that is}, God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said to him, One thing thou lackest: go, sell whatever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus looked around, and saith to his disciples, How hard it shall be for them that have riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith to them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were astonished beyond measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men {it is} impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter began to say to him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said, Verily I say to you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: But many {that are} first shall be last; and the last first.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen to him,

column.name: text
column.value: {Saying}, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered to the chief priests, and to the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come to him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatever we shall desire.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What would ye that I should do for you?

column.name: text
column.value: They said to him, Grant to us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, We can. And Jesus said to them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized with shall ye be baptized:

column.name: text
column.value: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but {it shall be given to them} for whom it is prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the ten heard {it}, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called them, and saith to them, Ye know that they who are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

column.name: text
column.value: But so it shall not be among you: but whoever would be great among you, shall be your minister:

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever of you would be the chief, shall be servant of all.

column.name: text
column.value: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered to, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the way side begging.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, {thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.

column.name: text
column.value: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying to him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to him, What wilt thou that I should do to thee? The blind man said to him, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Go; thy faith hath made thee well. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to them, Go into the village opposite you: and as soon as ye have entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, on which never man sat; loose him, and bring {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man shall say to you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and immediately he will send him here.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went away, and found the colt tied by the door outside in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

column.name: text
column.value: And certain of them that stood there said to them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off trees, and spread {them} in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked around upon all things, it being now evening had come, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the next day, when they had come from Bethany, he was hungry:

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if perhaps he might find any thing on it: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs had not {yet come}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to it, Let no man eat fruit of thee after this for ever. And his disciples heard {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

column.name: text
column.value: And would not allow that any man should carry {any} vessel through the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: And he taught, saying to them, Is it not written, My house shall be called by all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribes and chief priests heard {it}, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people were astonished at his doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: And when evening had come, he went out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter calling to remembrance saith to him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou didst curse is withered away.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering saith to them, Have faith in God.

column.name: text
column.value: For verily I say to you, That whoever shall say to this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that the things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatever he saith.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to you, Whatever things ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive {them}, and ye shall have {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have any thing against any: that your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

column.name: text
column.value: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

column.name: text
column.value: And say to him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: The baptism of John, was {it} from heaven, or from men? answer me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

column.name: text
column.value: But if we shall say, From men; they feared the people: for all {men} counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered and said to Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began to speak to them by parables. A {certain} man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about {it}, and dug {a place for} the winepress, and built a tower, and let it out to vinedressers, and went into a far country.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the season he sent to the vinedressers a servant, that he might receive from the vinedressers of the fruit of the vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: And they caught {him}, and beat him, and sent {him} away empty.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he sent to them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded {him} in the head, and sent {him} away shamefully handled.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

column.name: text
column.value: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last to them, saying, They will reverence my son.

column.name: text
column.value: But those vinedressers said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him, and killed {him}, and cast {him} out of the vineyard.

column.name: text
column.value: What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the vinedressers, and will give the vineyard to others.

column.name: text
column.value: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

column.name: text
column.value: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went away.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sent to him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in {his} words.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come, they say to him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

column.name: text
column.value: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought {it}. And he saith to them, Whose {is} this image and superscription? And they said to him, Caesar's.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then come to him the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Master, Moses wrote to us, If a man's brother shall die, and leave {his} wife, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

column.name: text
column.value: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

column.name: text
column.value: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels who are in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And concerning the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spoke to him, saying, I {am} the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

column.name: text
column.value: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments {is}, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this {is} the first commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second {is} like, {namely} this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is no other commandment greater than these.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribe said to him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is no other but he:

column.name: text
column.value: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love {his} neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said to him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that dared ask him {any question}.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

column.name: text
column.value: For David himself said by the Holy Spirit, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thy enemies thy footstool.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and how is he {then} his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, who love to go in long clothing, and {love} greetings in the marketplaces,

column.name: text
column.value: And the best seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost places at feasts:

column.name: text
column.value: Who devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater condemnation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus sat opposite the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called his disciples, and saith to them, Verily I say to you, That this poor widow hath cast in more than all they who have cast into the treasury:

column.name: text
column.value: For all {they} cast in of their abundance; but she of her want cast in all that she had, {even} all her living.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he was going out of the temple, one of his disciples saith to him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings {are here}!

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

column.name: text
column.value: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what {shall be} the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any {man} deceive you:

column.name: text
column.value: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am {Christ}; and shall deceive many.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for {such things} must needs be; but the end {shall} not {be} yet.

column.name: text
column.value: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in various places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these {are} the beginnings of sorrows.

column.name: text
column.value: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the gospel must first be proclaimed among all nations.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they shall lead {you}, and deliver you up, be not anxious beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against {their} parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be hated by all {men} for my name's sake: but he that shall endure to the end, the same shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that are in Judaea flee to the mountains:

column.name: text
column.value: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter {it}, to take any thing out of his house:

column.name: text
column.value: And let him that is in the field not turn back again to take up his garment.

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that nurse infants in those days!

column.name: text
column.value: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

column.name: text
column.value: For {in} those days shall be affliction, such as hath not been from the beginning of the creation which God created to this time, neither shall be.

column.name: text
column.value: And except the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

column.name: text
column.value: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here {is} Christ; or, lo, {he is} there; believe {him} not:

column.name: text
column.value: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall show signs and wonders, to seduce, if {it were} possible, even the elect.

column.name: text
column.value: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

column.name: text
column.value: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

column.name: text
column.value: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: And then they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And then he shall send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When its branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

column.name: text
column.value: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is near, {even} at the doors.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things shall be done.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: But of that day and {that} hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

column.name: text
column.value: {For the Son of man is} as a man taking a long journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at evening, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest coming suddenly he should find you sleeping.

column.name: text
column.value: And what I say to you I say to all, Watch.

column.name: text
column.value: After two days was {the feast of} the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put {him} to death.

column.name: text
column.value: But they said, Not on the feast {day}, lest there should be an uproar of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat eating, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she broke the box, and poured {it} on his head.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

column.name: text
column.value: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye have the poor with you always, and whenever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

column.name: text
column.value: She hath done what she could: she is come beforehand to anoint my body for the burial.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Wherever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, {this} also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went to the chief priests, to betray him to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard {it}, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said to him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

column.name: text
column.value: And he sendeth two of his disciples, and saith to them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

column.name: text
column.value: And wherever he shall go in, say ye to the master of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I may eat the passover with my disciples?

column.name: text
column.value: And he will show you a large upper room furnished {and} prepared: there make ready for us.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples went, and came into the city, and found as he had said to them: and they made ready the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Verily I say to you, One of you who eateth with me shall betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say to him one by one, {Is} it I? and another {said, Is} it I?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, {It is} one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written concerning him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and broke {it}, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave {it} to them: and they all drank of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out to the mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

column.name: text
column.value: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said to him, Although all shall be offended, yet {will} not I.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus saith to him, Verily I say to thee, That this day, {even} in this night, before the cock shall crow twice, thou shalt deny me three times.

column.name: text
column.value: But he spoke the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any way. Likewise also said they all.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

column.name: text
column.value: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be greatly amazed, and to be very heavy;

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful to death: tarry ye here, and watch.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Abba, Father, all things {are} possible to thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith to Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

column.name: text
column.value: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly {is} ready, but the flesh {is} weak.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he went away, and prayed, and spoke the same words.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither knew they what to answer him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cometh the third time, and saith to them, Sleep on now, and take {your} rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

column.name: text
column.value: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately, while he was yet speaking, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staffs, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, Whomever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead {him} away safely.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as he was come, he goeth immediately to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to them, Have ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and {with} staffs to take me?

column.name: text
column.value: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all forsook him, and fled.

column.name: text
column.value: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about {his} naked {body}; and the young men laid hold on him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

column.name: text
column.value: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the courtyard of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and all the council sought for testimony against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

column.name: text
column.value: For many bore false testimony against him, but their testimony agreed not together.

column.name: text
column.value: And there arose certain, and bore false testimony against him, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

column.name: text
column.value: But neither so did their testimony agree together.

column.name: text
column.value: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what {is it which} these testify against thee?

column.name: text
column.value: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said to him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest tore his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

column.name: text
column.value: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say to him, Prophesy: and the soldiers struck him with the palms of their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Peter was down in the courtyard, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

column.name: text
column.value: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither do I understand what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is {one} of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art {one} of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech showeth {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But he began to curse and to swear, {saying}, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second time the cock crowed. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said to him, Before the cock shall crow twice, thou shalt deny me three times. And when he thought about it, he wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried {him} away, and delivered {him} to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said to him, Thou sayest {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they testify against thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

column.name: text
column.value: Now at {that} feast he released to them one prisoner, whom they desired.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was {one} named Barabbas, {who lay} bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire {him to do} as he had ever done to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release to you the King of the Jews?

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests stirred up the people, that he should rather release Barabbas to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate answered and said again to them, What will ye then that I shall do {to him} whom ye call the King of the Jews?

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate said to them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

column.name: text
column.value: And {so} Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas to them, and having scourged Jesus, delivered him to be crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

column.name: text
column.value: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his {head},

column.name: text
column.value: And began to greet him, Hail, King of the Jews!

column.name: text
column.value: And they struck him on the head with a reed, and spit upon him, and bowing {their} knees worshipped him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they compelled one Simon a Cyrenian, who was passing by, coming from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

column.name: text
column.value: And they bring him to the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received {it} not.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest {it} in three days,

column.name: text
column.value: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

column.name: text
column.value: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them that stood by, when they heard {it}, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.

column.name: text
column.value: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar, and put {it} on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let {him} alone; let us see whether Elijah will come to take him down.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

column.name: text
column.value: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the centurion, who stood in front of him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

column.name: text
column.value: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered to him;) and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And now when the evening was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

column.name: text
column.value: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, who also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly to Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate wondered if he was already dead: and calling the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he knew {it} from the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone to the door of the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary Magdalene and Mary {the mother} of Joses beheld where he was laid.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the {mother} of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

column.name: text
column.value: And very early in the morning the first {day} of the week, they came to the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll away for us the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

column.name: text
column.value: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

column.name: text
column.value: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were amazed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Be not amazed: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

column.name: text
column.value: But go, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any {man}; for they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when {Jesus} was risen early the first {day} of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven demons.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

column.name: text
column.value: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, believed not.

column.name: text
column.value: After that he appeared in another form to two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went and told {it} to the rest: neither believed they them.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward he appeared to the eleven as they sat eating, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them who had seen him after he was risen.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

column.name: text
column.value: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

column.name: text
column.value: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak in new tongues;

column.name: text
column.value: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

column.name: text
column.value: So then after the Lord had spoken to them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with {them}, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

column.name: text
column.value: Even as they delivered them to us, who from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

column.name: text
column.value: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write to thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

column.name: text
column.value: That thou mayest know the certainty of those things, in which thou hast been instructed.

column.name: text
column.value: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abijah: and his wife {was} of the daughters of Aaron, and her name {was} Elisabeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had no child, because Elisabeth was barren, and they both were {well} advanced in years.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

column.name: text
column.value: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the time of incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared to him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Zacharias saw {him}, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel said to him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zacharias said to the angel, How shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well advanced in years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel answering said to him, I am Gabriel, who stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak to thee, and to show thee these glad tidings.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came out, he could not speak to them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he made signs to them, and remained speechless.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days when he looked on {me}, to take away my reproach among men.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

column.name: text
column.value: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name {was} Mary.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel came to her, and said, Hail, {thou that art} highly favoured, the Lord {is} with thee: blessed {art} thou among women.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she saw {him}, she was troubled at his saying, and considered in her mind what manner of greeting this should be.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give to him the throne of his father David:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Mary to the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel answered and said to her, The Holy Spirit shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshdow thee: therefore also that holy thing who shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

column.name: text
column.value: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah;

column.name: text
column.value: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and greeted Elisabeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: And she spoke with a loud voice, and said, Blessed {art} thou among women, and blessed {is} the fruit of thy womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And why {is} this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

column.name: text
column.value: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy greeting sounded in my ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed {is} she that believed: that there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

column.name: text
column.value: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy {is} his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And his mercy {is} on them that fear him from generation to generation.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath shown strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath put down the mighty from {their} seats, and exalted them of low degree.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent away empty.

column.name: text
column.value: He hath helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of {his} mercy;

column.name: text
column.value: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

column.name: text
column.value: And her neighbours and her cousins heard that the Lord had shown great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And his mother answered and said, Not {so}; but he shall be called John.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

column.name: text
column.value: And he asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they all marvelled.

column.name: text
column.value: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue {loosed}, and he spoke, and praised God.

column.name: text
column.value: And fear came on all that dwelt around them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

column.name: text
column.value: And all they that had heard {them} laid {them} up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

column.name: text
column.value: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

column.name: text
column.value: As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been since the world began:

column.name: text
column.value: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

column.name: text
column.value: To perform the mercy {promised} to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: The oath which he swore to our father Abraham,

column.name: text
column.value: That he would grant to us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

column.name: text
column.value: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

column.name: text
column.value: To give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

column.name: text
column.value: Through the tender mercy of our God; with which the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

column.name: text
column.value: To give light to them that sit in darkness and {in} the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew, and became strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his showing to Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

column.name: text
column.value: ({And} this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

column.name: text
column.value: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

column.name: text
column.value: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

column.name: text
column.value: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them: and they were in great fear.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

column.name: text
column.value: For to you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, who is Christ the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {shall be} a sign to you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even to Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known to us.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had seen {it}, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

column.name: text
column.value: And all they that heard {it} wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

column.name: text
column.value: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered {them} in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, who was so named by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present {him} to the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

column.name: text
column.value: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name {was} Simeon; and the same man {was} righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was revealed to him by the Holy Spirit, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

column.name: text
column.value: For my eyes have seen thy salvation,

column.name: text
column.value: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

column.name: text
column.value: A light to enlighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken concerning him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary his mother, Behold, this {child} is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

column.name: text
column.value: (And, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

column.name: text
column.value: And she {was} a widow of about eighty and four years, who departed not from the temple, but served {God} with fastings and prayers night and day.

column.name: text
column.value: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise to the Lord, and spoke of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the child grew, and became strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not {of it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But they, supposing him to be in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among {their} kinsfolk and acquaintance.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they found him not, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said to him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, How is it that ye sought me? knew ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

column.name: text
column.value: And they understood not the saying which he spoke to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

column.name: text
column.value: And saw two boats standing by the lake: but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing {their} nets.

column.name: text
column.value: And he entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the boat.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon answering said to him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had done this, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net broke.

column.name: text
column.value: And they beckoned to {their} partners, who were in the other boat, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.

column.name: text
column.value: When Simon Peter saw {it}, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

column.name: text
column.value: And so {was} also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had brought their boats to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on {his} face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put forth {his} hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But so much the more a fame of him went abroad: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

column.name: text
column.value: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was {present} to heal them.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man who was sick with the palsy: and they sought {means} to bring him in, and to lay {him} before him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they could not find by what {way} they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with {his} couch into the midst before Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw their faith, he said to him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this who speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said to them, Why reason ye in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: Which is easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Rise and walk?

column.name: text
