column.value: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority upon earth to forgive sins, (he said to the sick with the palsy,) I say to thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he arose before them, and took up what he had been laying on, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

column.name: text
column.value: And after these things he went forth, and saw a tax collector, named Levi, sitting at the tax office: and he said to him, Follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of tax collectors and of others that sat down with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to them, They that are well need not a physician; but they that are sick.

column.name: text
column.value: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise {the disciples } of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

column.name: text
column.value: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then they shall fast in those days.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke also a parable to them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if so, then both the new maketh a tear, and the piece that was {taken} out of the new agreeth not with the old.

column.name: text
column.value: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

column.name: text
column.value: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

column.name: text
column.value: No man also having drunk old {wine} immediately desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

column.name: text
column.value: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came to John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

column.name: text
column.value: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways {shall be} made smooth;

column.name: text
column.value: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized by him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

column.name: text
column.value: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham for {our} father: for I say to you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And now also the axe is laid to the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

column.name: text
column.value: He answereth and saith to them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath food, let him do likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came also tax collectors to be baptized, and said to him, Master, what shall we do?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the soldiers likewise asked him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said to them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse {any} falsely; and be content with your wages.

column.name: text
column.value: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts concerning John, whether he was the Christ, or not;

column.name: text
column.value: John answered, saying to {them} all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to loose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose fan {is} in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

column.name: text
column.value: And many other things in his exhortation he preached to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him on account of Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

column.name: text
column.value: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

column.name: text
column.value: And the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed ) the son of Joseph, who was {the son} of Heli,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Matthat, who was {the son} of Levi, who was {the son} of Melchi, who was {the son} of Janna, who was {the son} of Joseph,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Mattathias, who was {the son} of Amos, who was {the son} of Nahum, who was {the son} of Esli, who was {the son} of Nagge,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Maath, who was {the son} of Mattathias, who was {the son} of Semei, who was {the son} of Joseph, who was {the son} of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Joanna, who was {the son} of Rhesa, who was {the son} of Zerubbabel, who was {the son} of Shealtiel, who was {the son} of Neri,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Melchi, who was {the son} of Addi, who was {the son} of Cosam, who was {the son} of Elmodam, who was {the son} of Er,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Joshua, who was {the son} of Eliezer, who was {the son} of Jorim, who was {the son} of Matthat, who was {the son} of Levi,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Simeon, who was {the son} of Judas, who was {the son} of Joseph, who was {the son} of Jonan, who was {the son} of Eliakim,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Melea, who was {the son} of Menan, who was {the son} of Mattatha, who was {the son} of Nathan, who was {the son} of David,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Jesse, who was {the son} of Obed, who was {the son} of Boaz, who was {the son} of Salmon, who was {the son} of Nahshon,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Amminadab, who was {the son} of Ram, who was {the son} of Hezron, who was {the son} of Perez, who was {the son} of Judah,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Jacob, who was {the son} of Isaac, who was {the son} of Abraham, who was {the son} of Terah, who was {the son} of Nahor,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Serug, who was {the son} of Reu, who was {the son} of Peleg, who was {the son} of Eber, who was {the son} of Shelah,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Cainan, who was {the son} of Arphaxad, who was {the son} of Shem, who was {the son} of Noah, who was {the son} of Lamech,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Methuselah, who was {the son} of Enoch, who was {the son} of Jared, who was {the son} of Mahalaleel, who was {the son} of Cainan,

column.name: text
column.value: Who was {the son} of Enos, who was {the son} of Seth, who was {the son} of Adam, who was {the son} of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus being full of the Holy Spirit returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

column.name: text
column.value: Being forty days tempted by the devil. And in those days he ate nothing: and when they were ended, he was afterward hungry.

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil said to him, If thou art the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil, taking him up upon an high mountain, showed to him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil said to him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered to me; and to whomever I will I give it.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down from here:

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

column.name: text
column.value: And in {their} hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the surrounding region.

column.name: text
column.value: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath, and stood up to read.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was delivered to him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

column.name: text
column.value: The Spirit of the Lord {is} upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

column.name: text
column.value: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And he closed the book, and he gave {it} again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began to say to them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

column.name: text
column.value: And all bore him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Ye will surely say to me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Verily I say to you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you in truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

column.name: text
column.value: But to none of them was Elijah sent, except to Zarephath, {a city} of Sidon, to a woman {that was} a widow.

column.name: text
column.value: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, except Naaman the Syrian.

column.name: text
column.value: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

column.name: text
column.value: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

column.name: text
column.value: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

column.name: text
column.value: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the synagogue there was a man, who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Let {us} alone; what have we to do with thee, Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the demon had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed, and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word {is} this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fame of him went out into every place in the surrounding country.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And the mother of Simon's wife was sick with a high fever; and they besought him for her.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking {them} did not allow them to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came to him, and would have restrained him, that he should not depart from them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

column.name: text
column.value: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through grain fields; and his disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing {them} in {their} hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And certain of the Pharisees said to them, Why do ye that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was hungry, and they who were with him;

column.name: text
column.value: How he went into the house of God, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might find an accusation against him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man who had the withered hand, Arise, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: And looking around upon them all, he said to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored well as the other.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were filled with rage; and conferred one with another what they might do to Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out to a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was day, he called {to him} his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

column.name: text
column.value: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, and Philip and Bartholomew,

column.name: text
column.value: Matthew and Thomas, James the {son} of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas {the brother} of James, and Judas Iscariot, who also was the traitor.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

column.name: text
column.value: And they that were tormented with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went power out of him, and healed {them} all.

column.name: text
column.value: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed {are ye} poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are ye} that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed {are ye} that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you {from their company}, and shall reproach {you}, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward {is} great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers to the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe to you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you who hear, Love your enemies, do good to them who hate you,

column.name: text
column.value: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them who despitefully use you.

column.name: text
column.value: And to him that smiteth thee on the {one} cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not {to take thy} coat also.

column.name: text
column.value: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask {them} not again.

column.name: text
column.value: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: For if ye love them who love you, what thanks have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye do good to them who do good to you, what thanks have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye lend {to them} from whom ye hope to receive, what thanks have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much in return.

column.name: text
column.value: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind to the unthankful and {to} the evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

column.name: text
column.value: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

column.name: text
column.value: Give, and it shall be given to you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye measure it shall be measured to you again.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke a parable to them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

column.name: text
column.value: The disciple is not above his teacher: but every one that is perfect shall be as his teacher.

column.name: text
column.value: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thy own eye?

column.name: text
column.value: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thy eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thy own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thy own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

column.name: text
column.value: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: For every tree is known by its own fruit. For from thorns men do not gather figs, nor from a bramble bush do they gather grapes.

column.name: text
column.value: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for from the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

column.name: text
column.value: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will show you to whom he is like:

column.name: text
column.value: He is like a man who built an house, and dug deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house on the earth; against which the stream beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and showing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve {were} with him,

column.name: text
column.value: And certain women, who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven demons,

column.name: text
column.value: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered to him of their substance.

column.name: text
column.value: And when many people were gathered together, and had come to him out of every city, he spoke by a parable:

column.name: text
column.value: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

column.name: text
column.value: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

column.name: text
column.value: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

column.name: text
column.value: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bore fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples asked him, saying, What doth this parable mean?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: They on the rock {are they}, who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, who for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

column.name: text
column.value: And that which fell among thorns are they, who, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of {this} life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

column.name: text
column.value: But that on the good ground are they, who in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep {it}, and bring forth fruit with patience.

column.name: text
column.value: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth {it} under a bed; but setteth {it} on a lampstand, that they who enter in may see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: For nothing is secret, that shall not become evident; neither {any thing} hid, that shall not be known and come to light.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whoever hath, to him shall be given; and whoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came to him {his} mother and his brethren, and could not come near to him for the crowd.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was told to him {by certain} who said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand outside, desiring to see thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, My mother and my brethren are these who hear the word of God, and do it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a boat with his disciples: and he said to them, Let us go over to the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

column.name: text
column.value: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled {with water}, and were in jeopardy.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid marvelled, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, who had demons a long time, and wore no clothes, neither abode in {any} house, but in the tombs.

column.name: text
column.value: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, {thou} Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

column.name: text
column.value: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For often it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he broke the bands, and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.)

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many demons had entered into him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would allow them to enter into them. And he permitted them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the demons went out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

column.name: text
column.value: When they that fed {them} saw what was done, they fled, and went and told {it} in the city and in the country.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the demons had departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: They also who saw {it} told them by what means he that was possessed by the demons was healed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the whole multitude of the country of the surrounding region of the Gadarenes besought him to depart from them; for they were seized with great fear: and he went into the boat, and returned back again.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the man out of whom the demons had departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Return to thy own house, and show what great things God hath done to thee. And he went away, and proclaimed throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus had returned, the people {gladly} received him: for they were all waiting for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at the feet of Jesus, and besought him that he would come into his house:

column.name: text
column.value: For he had one daughter only, about twelve years of age, and she lay dying. But as he was going the people thronged him.

column.name: text
column.value: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, who had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed by any,

column.name: text
column.value: Came behind {him}, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stopped.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press {thee}, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that power hath gone out of me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared to him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee well; go in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was yet speaking, there cometh one from the house of the ruler of the synagogue, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jesus heard {it}, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made well.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came into the house, he allowed no man to go in, except Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

column.name: text
column.value: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

column.name: text
column.value: And her spirit came again, and she arose immediately: and he commanded to give her {something} to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, where he himself would come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said he to them, The harvest truly {is} great, but the labourers {are} few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

column.name: text
column.value: Carry neither purse, nor sack, nor shoes: and greet no man by the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And into whatever house ye enter, first say, Peace {be} to this house.

column.name: text
column.value: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

column.name: text
column.value: And into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

column.name: text
column.value: And heal the sick that are in it, and say to them, The kingdom of God is come near to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go out into the streets of the same, and say,

column.name: text
column.value: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: however be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come near to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I say to you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to thee, Chorazin! woe to thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

column.name: text
column.value: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to hell.

column.name: text
column.value: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us through thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I give to you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

column.name: text
column.value: However in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject to you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

column.name: text
column.value: All things are delivered to me by my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and {he} to whom the Son will reveal {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned himself to {his} disciples, and said privately, Blessed {are} the eyes which see the things that ye see:

column.name: text
column.value: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see the things which ye see, and have not seen {them}; and to hear the things which ye hear, and have not heard {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

column.name: text
column.value: He said to him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

column.name: text
column.value: But he, wishing to justify himself, said to Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said, A certain {man} went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, who stripped him of his raiment, and wounded {him}, and departed, leaving {him} half dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked {on him}, and passed by on the other side.

column.name: text
column.value: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion {on him},

column.name: text
column.value: And went to {him}, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the next day when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave {them} to the host, and said to him, Take care of him; and whatever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour to him that fell among the thieves?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, He that showed mercy on him. Then said Jesus to him, Go, and do thou likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: Now it came to pass, as they were going, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

column.name: text
column.value: And she had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

column.name: text
column.value: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said to her, Martha, Martha, thou art worried and troubled about many things:

column.name: text
column.value: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Take nothing for {your} journey, neither staffs, nor bag, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever house ye enter into, there abide, and from there depart.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said by some, that John had risen from the dead;

column.name: text
column.value: And by some, that Elijah had appeared; and by others, that one of the ancient prophets had risen again.

column.name: text
column.value: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the apostles, when they had returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people, when they knew {it}, followed him: and he received them, and spoke to them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the day began to decline, then came the twelve, and said to him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding towns and country, and lodge, and get food: for we are here in a deserted place.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more than five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy food for all this people.

column.name: text
column.value: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and broke, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: And they ate, and were all satisfied: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Who say the people that I am?

column.name: text
column.value: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some {say}, Elijah; and others {say}, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, But who say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he strictly charged them, and commanded {them} to tell no man that thing;

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised the third day.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to {them} all, If any {man} will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever will save his life shall lose it: but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

column.name: text
column.value: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and {in that of his} Father, and of the holy angels.

column.name: text
column.value: But I tell you truly, there are some standing here, who shall not taste death, till they see the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass about eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up upon a mountain to pray.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he prayed, the appearance of his countenance was altered, and his raiment {was} white {and} shining.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there talked with him two men, who were Moses and Elijah:

column.name: text
column.value: Who appeared in glory, and spoke of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said.

column.name: text
column.value: While he was thus speaking, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept {it} close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, many people met him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is my only child.

column.name: text
column.value: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and put up with you? Bring thy son here.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he was yet coming, the demon threw him down, and tore {him}. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they were all amazed at all things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

column.name: text
column.value: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him concerning that saying.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Whoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

column.name: text
column.value: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out demons in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Forbid {him} not: for he that is not against us is for us.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when his disciples James and John saw {this}, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elijah did?

column.name: text
column.value: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save {them}. And they went to another village.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as they were going in the way, a certain {man} said to him, Lord, I will follow thee wherever thou goest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air {have} nests; but the Son of man hath no where to lay {his} head.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go and bid them farewell, who are at my house.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, No man, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: In the mean time, when there was gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, so that they trampled one upon another, he began to say to his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

column.name: text
column.value: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore whatever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, who after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say to you, Fear him.

column.name: text
column.value: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

column.name: text
column.value: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

column.name: text
column.value: Also I say to you, Whoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

column.name: text
column.value: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but to him that blasphemeth against the Holy Spirit it shall not be forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they bring you to the synagogues, and {before} magistrates, and powers, be not anxious how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

column.name: text
column.value: For the Holy Spirit shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the company said to him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

column.name: text
column.value: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no place where to store my fruits?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I store all my fruits and my goods.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast many goods laid up for many years; take thy ease, eat, drink, {and} be merry.

column.name: text
column.value: But God said to him, {Thou} fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

column.name: text
column.value: So {is} he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his disciples, Therefore I say to you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

column.name: text
column.value: The life is more than food, and the body {is more} than raiment.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

column.name: text
column.value: And which of you by being anxious can add to his stature one cubit?

column.name: text
column.value: If ye then are not able to do that thing which is least, why are ye anxious for the rest?

column.name: text
column.value: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say to you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

column.name: text
column.value: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more {will he clothe} you, O ye of little faith?

column.name: text
column.value: And seek ye not what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

column.name: text
column.value: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Sell what ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which become not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

column.name: text
column.value: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your loins be girt, and {your} lamps burning;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye yourselves like men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open to him immediately.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say to you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to eat, and will come forth and serve them.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find {them} so, blessed are those servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And this know, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have allowed his house to be broken into.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said to him, Lord, speakest thou this parable to us, or even to all?

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom {his} lord shall make ruler over his household, to give {them their} portion of food in due season?

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly I say to you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

column.name: text
column.value: But if that servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the male and female servants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunk;

column.name: text
column.value: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for {him}, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

column.name: text
column.value: And that servant, who knew his lord's will, and prepared not {himself}, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many {stripes}.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that knew not, and committed things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few {stripes}. For to whomever much is given, of him shall much be required: and to whom men have committed much, from him they will ask the more.

column.name: text
column.value: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it is already kindled?

column.name: text
column.value: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I constrained till it shall be accomplished!

column.name: text
column.value: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

column.name: text
column.value: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

column.name: text
column.value: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rising in the west, immediately ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

column.name: text
column.value: And when {ye see} the south wind blowing, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

column.name: text
column.value: When thou goest with thy adversary to the magistrate, {as thou art} in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he drag thee before the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart from there, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, When ye pray, say, Our Father who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so on earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Give us day by day our daily bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go to him at midnight, and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

column.name: text
column.value: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

column.name: text
column.value: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

column.name: text
column.value: I say to you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

column.name: text
column.value: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if {he shall ask} a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

column.name: text
column.value: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

column.name: text
column.value: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children: how much more shall {your} heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

column.name: text
column.value: And he was casting out a demon, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb spoke; and the people marvelled.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them said, He casteth out demons through Beelzebub the chief of the demons.

column.name: text
column.value: And others, tempting {him}, sought from him a sign from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house {divided} against a house falleth.

column.name: text
column.value: If Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons through Beelzebub.

column.name: text
column.value: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast {them} out? therefore shall they be your judges.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I with the finger of God cast out demons, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

column.name: text
column.value: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

column.name: text
column.value: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour in which he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

column.name: text
column.value: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return to my house from which I came out.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he cometh, he findeth {it} swept and garnished.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he goeth, and taketh {to him} seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last {state} of that man is worse than the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he spoke these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said to him, Blessed {is} the womb that bore thee, and the breasts which nourished thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, Yea rather, blessed {are} they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people were thickly gathered together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also shall the Son of man be to this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon {is} here.

column.name: text
column.value: The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and, behold, a greater than Jonah {is} here.

column.name: text
column.value: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth {it} in a secret place, neither under a basket, but on a lampstand, that they who come in may see the light.

column.name: text
column.value: The lamp of the body is the eye: therefore when thy eye is clear, thy whole body also is full of light; but when {thy eye} is bad, thy body also {is} full of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: If thy whole body therefore {be} full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp doth give thee light.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he was speaking, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Pharisee saw {it}, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said to him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of greed and wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: {Ye} fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

column.name: text
column.value: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over justice and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the others undone.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, Pharisees! for ye love the best seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over {them} are not aware {of them}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said to him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Woe to you also, {ye} lawyers! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and {some} of them they shall slay and persecute:

column.name: text
column.value: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

column.name: text
column.value: From the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say to you, It shall be required of this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye have not entered in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to oppose {him} vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

column.name: text
column.value: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something from his mouth, that they might accuse him.

column.name: text
column.value: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

column.name: text
column.value: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke also this parable; A certain {man} had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit on it, and found none.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answering said to him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung {it}:

column.name: text
column.value: And if it shall bear fruit, {well}: and if not, {then} after that thou shalt cut it down.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no way raise {herself}.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus saw her, he called {her to him}, and said to her, Woman, thou art loosed from thy infirmity.

column.name: text
column.value: And he laid {his} hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because Jesus had healed on the sabbath, and said to the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord then answered him, and said, {Thou} hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or {his} donkey from the stall, and lead {him} away to watering?

column.name: text
column.value: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, to be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he, To what is the kingdom of God like? and to what shall I compare it?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and became a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in its branches.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he said, To what shall I liken the kingdom of God?

column.name: text
column.value: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said one to him, Lord, are there few that are saved? And he said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: Strive to enter in at the narrow gate: for many, I say to you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

column.name: text
column.value: When once the master of the house hath risen up, and hath shut the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us; and he shall answer and say to you, I know you not where ye are from:

column.name: text
column.value: Then ye shall begin to say, We ate and drank in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

column.name: text
column.value: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not where ye are from; depart from me, all {ye} workers of iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you {yourselves} thrust out.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall come from the east, and {from} the west, and from the north, and {from} the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there are last who shall be first, and there are first who shall be last.

column.name: text
column.value: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying to him, Go away, and depart from here: for Herod will kill thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out demons, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third {day} I shall be perfected.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the {day} following: for it cannot be that a prophet should perish out of Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent to thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen {gathereth} her brood under {her} wings, and ye would not!

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, your house is left to you desolate: and verily I say to you, Ye shall not see me, until {the time} shall come when ye shall say, Blessed {is} he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick, and ready to die.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent to him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him earnestly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

column.name: text
column.value: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore neither thought I myself worthy to come to thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say to one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned himself about, and said to the people that followed him, I say to you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant well that had been sick.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and many people.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and many people of the city were with her.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, Weep not.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bore {him} stood still. And he said, Young man, I say to thee, Arise.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet hath risen among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

column.name: text
column.value: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the surrounding region.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples of John reported to him of all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And John calling two of his disciples sent {them} to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

column.name: text
column.value: When the men had come to him, they said, John the Baptist hath sent us to thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

column.name: text
column.value: And in that same hour he cured many of {their} infirmities and afflictions, and of evil spirits; and to many {that were} blind he gave sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus answering said to them, Go, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; that the blind see, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

column.name: text
column.value: And blessed is {he}, who shall not be offended because of me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the messengers of John had departed, he began to speak to the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

column.name: text
column.value: But what went ye out to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they who are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

column.name: text
column.value: But what went ye out to see? A prophet? Yea, I say to you, and much more than a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: This is {he}, concerning whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way before thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people that heard {him}, and the tax collectors, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized by him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, To what then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

column.name: text
column.value: They are like children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped to you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

column.name: text
column.value: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a demon.

column.name: text
column.value: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!

column.name: text
column.value: But wisdom is justified by all her children.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, a woman in the city, who was a sinner, when she knew that {Jesus} was eating in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

column.name: text
column.value: And stood at his feet behind {him} weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and wiped {them} with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed {them} with the ointment.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw {it}, he spoke within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman {this is} that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to him, Simon, I have somewhat to say to thee. And he saith, Master, say it.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a certain creditor who had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

column.name: text
column.value: Simon answered and said, I suppose that {he}, to whom he forgave most. And he said to him, Thou hast rightly judged.

column.name: text
column.value: And he turned to the woman, and said to Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thy house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped {them} with the hairs of her head.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

column.name: text
column.value: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I say to thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, {the same} loveth little.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to her, Thy sins are forgiven.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that were eating with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
