column.name: text
column.value: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said also to his disciples, There was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and the same was accused to him that he had wasted his goods.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called him, and said to him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; I am ashamed to beg.

column.name: text
column.value: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am removed from the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

column.name: text
column.value: So he called every one of his lord's debtors, and said to the first, How much owest thou to my lord?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said to him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said to him, Take thy bill, and write eighty.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

column.name: text
column.value: And I say to you, Make to yourselves friends by the riches of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

column.name: text
column.value: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous riches, who will commit to your trust the true {riches}?

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

column.name: text
column.value: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and riches.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they mocked him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Ye are they who justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: The law and the prophets {were} until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

column.name: text
column.value: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than one tittle of the law to fail.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whoever marrieth her that is put away from {her} husband committeth adultery.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a certain rich man, who was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, who was laid at his gate, full of sores,

column.name: text
column.value: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

column.name: text
column.value: And in hell he lifted up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

column.name: text
column.value: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime didst receive thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

column.name: text
column.value: And besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they who would pass from here to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that {would come} from there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

column.name: text
column.value: For I have five brethren; that he may testify to them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

column.name: text
column.value: Abraham saith to him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went to them from the dead, they will repent.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then drew near to him all the tax collectors and sinners to hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke this parable to them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he loseth one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he findeth it?

column.name: text
column.value: And when he hath found {it}, he layeth {it} on his shoulders, rejoicing.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he cometh home, he calleth together {his} friends and neighbours, saying to them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

column.name: text
column.value: I say to you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine righteous persons, who need no repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she loseth one piece, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she findeth {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: And when she hath found {it}, she calleth {her} friends and {her} neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, I say to you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

column.name: text
column.value: And the younger of them said to {his} father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth {to me}. And he divided to them {his} living.

column.name: text
column.value: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was longing to fill his belly with the husks that the swine ate: and no man gave to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father have bread enough and to spare, and I am perishing with hunger!

column.name: text
column.value: I will arise and go to my father, and will say to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

column.name: text
column.value: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the son said to him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

column.name: text
column.value: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put {it} on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on {his} feet:

column.name: text
column.value: And bring here the fatted calf, and kill {it}; and let us eat, and be merry:

column.name: text
column.value: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

column.name: text
column.value: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore his father came out, and entreated him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answering said to {his} father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither have I at any time transgressed thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

column.name: text
column.value: But as soon as this thy son had come, who hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

column.name: text
column.value: It was right that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath, that they watched him.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, there was a certain man before him who had the dropsy.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath?

column.name: text
column.value: And they held their peace. And he took {him}, and healed him, and let him go;

column.name: text
column.value: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have a donkey or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day?

column.name: text
column.value: And they could not answer him again to these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And he put forth a parable to those who were invited, when he marked how they chose out the best places; saying to them,

column.name: text
column.value: When thou art invited by any {man} to a wedding, sit not down in the best place; lest a more honourable man than thou be invited by him;

column.name: text
column.value: And he that invited thee and him shall come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest place.

column.name: text
column.value: But when thou art invited, go and sit down in the lowest place; that when he that invited thee cometh, he may say to thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have honour in the presence of them that sit eating with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he also to him that invited him, When thou givest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor {thy} rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But when thou givest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

column.name: text
column.value: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

column.name: text
column.value: And when one of them that sat eating with him heard these things, he said to him, Blessed {is} he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to him, A certain man gave a great supper, and invited many:

column.name: text
column.value: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were invited, Come; for all things are now ready.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all with one {consent} began to make excuse. The first said to him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

column.name: text
column.value: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to try them out: I pray thee have me excused.

column.name: text
column.value: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

column.name: text
column.value: So that servant came, and showed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in here the poor, and the maimed, and the lame, and the blind.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

column.name: text
column.value: And the lord said to the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel {them} to come in, that my house may be filled.

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, That none of those men who were invited shall taste my supper.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said to them,

column.name: text
column.value: If any {man} cometh to me, and hateth not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he hath {sufficient} to finish {it}?

column.name: text
column.value: Lest perhaps, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish {it}, all that behold {it} begin to mock him,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

column.name: text
column.value: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

column.name: text
column.value: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth a delegation, and desireth conditions of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: So likewise, whoever he is of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: Salt {is} good: but if the salt hath lost its savour, how shall it be seasoned?

column.name: text
column.value: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; {but} men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe {to him}, by whom they come!

column.name: text
column.value: It were better for him that a millstone were hung about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother shall trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he shall repent, forgive him.

column.name: text
column.value: And if he tresspasses against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turns again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

column.name: text
column.value: And the apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say to this mulberry tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

column.name: text
column.value: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say to him immediately, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: And will not rather say to him, Make ready something that I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunk; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

column.name: text
column.value: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.

column.name: text
column.value: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded to you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, who stood afar off:

column.name: text
column.value: And they lifted up {their} voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he saw {them}, he said to them, Go show yourselves to the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they were going, they were cleansed.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

column.name: text
column.value: And fell down on {his} face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where {are} the nine?

column.name: text
column.value: There are not found returning to give glory to God, except this stranger.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee well.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was asked by the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to his disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after {them}, nor follow {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the lightning, that lighteneth from the one {part} under heaven, shineth to the other {part} under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

column.name: text
column.value: But first he must suffer many things, and be rejected by this generation.

column.name: text
column.value: And as it was in the days of Noah, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

column.name: text
column.value: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed {them} all.

column.name: text
column.value: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: In that day, he who shall be upon the housetop, and his furniture in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember Lot's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, in that night there shall be two {men} in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

column.name: text
column.value: Two {women} shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: Two {men} shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered and said to him, Where, Lord? And he said to them, Wherever the body {is}, there will the eagles be gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke a parable to them {to this end}, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, There was in a city a judge, who feared not God, neither regarded man:

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a widow in that city; and she came to him, saying, Avenge me of my adversary.

column.name: text
column.value: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

column.name: text
column.value: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

column.name: text
column.value: And shall not God avenge his own elect, who cry day and night to him, though he beareth long with them?

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke this parable to certain who trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

column.name: text
column.value: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men {are}, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this tax collector.

column.name: text
column.value: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

column.name: text
column.value: And the tax collector, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as {his} eyes to heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

column.name: text
column.value: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified {rather} than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought to him also infants, that he would touch them: but when {his} disciples saw {it}, they rebuked them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus called them {to him}, and said, Permit {the} little children to come to me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, Whoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall by no means enter into it.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Why callest thou me good? none {is} good, except one, {that is}, God.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said to him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hard it is for them that have riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

column.name: text
column.value: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that heard {it} said, Who then can be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Verily I say to you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall not receive much more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he took the twelve, and said to them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall be delivered to the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully treated, and spitted on:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall scourge {him}, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that as he had come near to Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

column.name: text
column.value: And hearing the multitude passing by, he asked what it meant.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried, saying, Jesus, {thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they who went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, {Thou} Son of David, have mercy on me.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought to him: and when he had come near, he asked him,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do to thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw {it}, gave praise to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And {Jesus} entered and passed through Jericho.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, {there was} a man named Zacchaeus, who was the chief among the tax collectors, and he was rich.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.

column.name: text
column.value: And he ran before, and climbed up upon a sycamore tree to see him: for he was to pass that {way}.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said to him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they saw {it}, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

column.name: text
column.value: And Zacchaeus stood, and said to the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore {him} fourfold.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, This day is salvation come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they heard these things, he added and spoke a parable, because he was near to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

column.name: text
column.value: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

column.name: text
column.value: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said to them, Occupy till I come.

column.name: text
column.value: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this {man} to reign over us.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that when he had returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called to him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

column.name: text
column.value: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, {here is} thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

column.name: text
column.value: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up what thou didst not lay down, and reapest what thou didst not sow.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to him, Out of thy own mouth will I judge thee, {thou} wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up what I laid not down, and reaping what I did not sow:

column.name: text
column.value: Why then gavest thou not my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required my own with interest?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give {it} to him that hath ten pounds.

column.name: text
column.value: (And they said to him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, That to every one who hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even what he hath shall be taken away from him.

column.name: text
column.value: But those my enemies, who would not that I should reign over them, bring here, and slay {them} before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, going up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, when he had come near to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called {the mount} of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Go ye into the village opposite {you}; in which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, on which yet never man sat: loose him, and bring {him here}.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man shall ask you, Why do ye loose {him}? thus shall ye say to him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that were sent went, and found even as he had said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were loosing the colt, its owners said to them, Why loose ye the colt?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come near, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Blessed {be} the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said to him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things {which belong} to thy peace! but now they are hid from thy eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: For the days shall come upon thee, that thy enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and surround thee, and keep thee in on every side,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold in it, and them that bought;

column.name: text
column.value: Saying to them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

column.name: text
column.value: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

column.name: text
column.value: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, {that} on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon {him} with the elders,

column.name: text
column.value: And spoke to him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

column.name: text
column.value: And he answered and said to them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

column.name: text
column.value: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?

column.name: text
column.value: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

column.name: text
column.value: But if we say, From men; all the people will stone us: for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: And they answered, that they could not tell where {it was} from.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he began to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it out to vinedressers, and went into a far country for a long time.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the season he sent a servant to the vinedressers, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the vinedressers beat him, and sent {him} away empty.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and treated {him} shamefully, and sent {him} away empty.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he sent the third: and they wounded him also, and cast {him} out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be when they see him they will reverence {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the vinedressers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

column.name: text
column.value: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed {him}. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do to them?

column.name: text
column.value: He shall come and destroy these vinedressers, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard {it}, they said, may that never be.

column.name: text
column.value: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they watched {him}, and sent forth spies, who pretended to be righteous men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him to the power and authority of the governor.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person {of any}, but teachest the way of God truly:

column.name: text
column.value: Is it lawful for us to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

column.name: text
column.value: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, Why tempt ye me?

column.name: text
column.value: Show me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Render therefore to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's.

column.name: text
column.value: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came to {him} certain of the Sadducees, who deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Master, Moses wrote to us, If any man's brother should die, having a wife, and he should die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: There were therefore seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second took her for a wife, and he died childless.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

column.name: text
column.value: Last of all the woman died also.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her for a wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answering said to them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

column.name: text
column.value: But they who shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal to the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that they dared not ask him any {question at all}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

column.name: text
column.value: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

column.name: text
column.value: Till I make thy enemies thy footstool.

column.name: text
column.value: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

column.name: text
column.value: Then in the hearing of all the people he said to his disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of the scribes, who desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

column.name: text
column.value: Who devour widows' houses, and for a show make long prayers: the same shall receive greater condemnation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he looked up, and saw rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in there two mites.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Truly I say to you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

column.name: text
column.value: For all these have of their abundance cast in to the offerings of God: but she of her poverty hath cast in all the living that she had.

column.name: text
column.value: And as some spoke of the temple, that it was adorned with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

column.name: text
column.value: {As for} these things which ye behold, the days will come, in which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign {will there be} when these things shall come to pass?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am {Christ}; and the time draweth near: therefore go ye not after them.

column.name: text
column.value: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end {is} not yet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

column.name: text
column.value: And great earthquakes shall be in various places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute {you}, delivering {you} up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: Settle {it} therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

column.name: text
column.value: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to speak against nor withstand.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsmen, and friends; and {some} of you shall they cause to be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall be hated by all {men} for my name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

column.name: text
column.value: In your patience possess ye your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: And when ye shall see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that her desolation is near.

column.name: text
column.value: Then let them who are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them who are in the midst of it depart from it; and let not them that are in the countries enter into it.

column.name: text
column.value: For these are the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that nurse infants, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles shall be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

column.name: text
column.value: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for expectation of those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

column.name: text
column.value: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth near.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

column.name: text
column.value: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now near at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know that the kingdom of God is near at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily I say to you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with dissipation, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and {so} that day come upon you unawares.

column.name: text
column.value: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called {the mount} of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, to hear him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew near, which is called the Passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Satan entered into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went his way, and conferred with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

column.name: text
column.value: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him to them in the absence of the multitude.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare for us the passover, that we may eat.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Behold, when ye have entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall say to the master of the house, The Master saith to thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I may eat the passover with my disciples?

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went, and found as he had said to them: and they made ready the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, I have earnestly desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, I will not any more eat of it, until it shall be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and share {it} among yourselves:

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and broke {it}, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup {is} the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

column.name: text
column.value: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me {is} with me on the table.

column.name: text
column.value: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe to that man by whom he is betrayed!

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye {shall} not {be} so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

column.name: text
column.value: For who {is} greater, he that eateth, or he that serveth? {is} not he that eateth? but I am among you as he that serveth.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are they who have continued with me in my temptations.

column.name: text
column.value: And I appoint to you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed to me;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired {to have} you, that he may sift {you} as wheat:

column.name: text
column.value: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before thou shalt three times deny that thou knowest me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, When I sent you without purse, and sack, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he to them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take {it}, and likewise {his} sack: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

column.name: text
column.value: For I say to you, that this which is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Lord, behold, here {are} two swords. And he said to them, It is enough.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came out, and went, as he was accustomed, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was at the place, he said to them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Father, if thou art willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, strengthening him.

column.name: text
column.value: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he rose up from prayer, and had come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

column.name: text
column.value: And while he was yet speaking, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near to Jesus to kiss him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus said to him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

column.name: text
column.value: When they who were about him saw what would follow, they said to him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered and said, Permit ye even this. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, who had come to him, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staffs?

column.name: text
column.value: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took him, and led {him}, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the courtyard, and were seated together, Peter sat down among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Surely this {man} also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he was yet speaking, the cock crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said to him, Before the cock shall crow, thou wilt deny me three times.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

column.name: text
column.value: And many other things blasphemously they spoke against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said to them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

column.name: text
column.value: And if I also ask {you}, ye will not answer me, nor let {me} go.

column.name: text
column.value: After this shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said to them, Ye say that I am.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, What need have we of any further testimony? for we ourselves have heard from his own mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this {fellow} perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and {to} the people, I find no fault in this man.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Judaea, beginning from Galilee to this place.

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man was a Galilaean.

column.name: text
column.value: And as soon as he knew that he belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself was also at Jerusalem at that time.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he had been for a long time, desirous to see him, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to see some miracle done by him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Herod with his soldiers treated him with contempt, and mocked {him}, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

column.name: text
column.value: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

column.name: text
column.value: Said to them, Ye have brought this man to me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined {him} before you, have found no fault in this man concerning those things of which ye accuse him:

column.name: text
column.value: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done to him.

column.name: text
column.value: I will therefore chastise him, and release {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: (For of necessity he must release one to them at the feast.)

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this {man}, and release to us Barabbas:

column.name: text
column.value: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spoke again to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But they cried, saying, Crucify {him}, crucify him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let {him} go.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were insistent with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

column.name: text
column.value: And he released to them him that for sedition and murder had been cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear {it} after Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, who also bewailed and lamented him.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus turning to them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

column.name: text
column.value: For, behold, the days are coming, in which they shall say, Blessed {are} the barren, and the wombs that never bore, and the breasts which never nursed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

column.name: text
column.value: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

column.name: text
column.value: And two others, who were malefactors, were led with him to be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them mocked {him}, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he is Christ, the chosen of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, If thou art the king of the Jews, save thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the malefactors who were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou art Christ, save thyself and us.

column.name: text
column.value: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

column.name: text
column.value: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Verily I say to thee, This day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in the midst.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

column.name: text
column.value: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, {there was} a man named Joseph, a counsellor; {and he was} a good man, and a just:

column.name: text
column.value: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) {he was} of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: This {man} went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, where man was never before laid.

column.name: text
column.value: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

column.name: text
column.value: And the women also, who came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

column.name: text
column.value: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested on the sabbath according to the commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: Now upon the first {day} of the week, very early in the morning, they came to the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain {others} with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were afraid, and bowed down {their} faces to the earth, they said to them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spoke to you when he was yet in Galilee,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: And they remembered his words,

column.name: text
column.value: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

column.name: text
column.value: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary {the mother} of James, and other {women that were} with them, who told these things to the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter arose, and ran to the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which had come to pass.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem {about} sixty furlongs.

column.name: text
column.value: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, while they communed {together} and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But their eyes were restrained that they should not know him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What manner of communications {are} these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said to him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which have come to pass there in these days?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, What things? And they said to him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

column.name: text
column.value: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we hoped that it had been he who should have redeemed Israel: and besides all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, who were early at the sepulchre;

column.name: text
column.value: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And certain of them who were with us went to the sepulchre, and found {it} even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he said to them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

column.name: text
column.value: Ought not Christ to suffer these things, and to enter into his glory?

column.name: text
column.value: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And they drew near to the village, where they were going: and he made as though he would go further.

column.name: text
column.value: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as he sat eating with them, he took bread, and blessed {it}, and broke, and gave to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

column.name: text
column.value: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

column.name: text
column.value: And they told what things {were done} in the way, and how he was known to them in breaking of bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were thus speaking, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith to them, Peace {be} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But they were terrified and trembled, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, he showed them {his} hands and {his} feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said to them, Have ye here any thing to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took {it}, and ate before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, These {are} the words which I spoke to you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and {in} the prophets, and {in} the psalms, concerning me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he opened their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

column.name: text
column.value: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye are witnesses of these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye are endued with power from on high.

column.name: text
column.value: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

column.name: text
column.value: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

column.name: text
column.value: The same was in the beginning with God.

column.name: text
column.value: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

column.name: text
column.value: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a man sent from God, whose name {was} John.

column.name: text
column.value: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all {men} through him might believe.

column.name: text
column.value: He was not that Light, but {was sent} to bear witness of that Light.

column.name: text
column.value: {That} was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

column.name: text
column.value: He came to his own, and his own received him not.

column.name: text
column.value: But as many as received him, to them he gave power to become the sons of God, {even} to them that believe on his name:

column.name: text
column.value: Who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

column.name: text
column.value: John bore witness concerning him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spoke, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And of his fulness have we all received, and grace for grace.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law was given by Moses, {but} grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the witness of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

column.name: text
column.value: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elijah? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

column.name: text
column.value: He said, I {am} the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Isaiah.

column.name: text
column.value: And they who were sent were of the Pharisees.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked him, and said to him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou art not that Christ, nor Elijah, neither that prophet?

column.name: text
column.value: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

column.name: text
column.value: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe latchet I am not worthy to loose.

column.name: text
column.value: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

column.name: text
column.value: The next day John seeth Jesus coming to him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, who taketh away the sin of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man who is preferred before me: for he was before me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

column.name: text
column.value: And John bore witness, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and he abode upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said to me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizeth with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw, and bore witness that this is the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

column.name: text
column.value: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

column.name: text
column.value: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith to them, What seek ye? They said to him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: One of the two who heard John {speak}, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith to him, We have found the Messiah, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jonah: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

column.name: text
column.value: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith to him, Follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith to him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and also the prophets, wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: And Nathanael said to him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith to him, Come and see.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

column.name: text
column.value: Nathanael saith to him, How knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said to him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Nathanael answered and said to him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, dost thou believe? thou shalt see greater things than these.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to him, Verily, verily, I say to you, After this ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus also was invited, and his disciples, to the marriage.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith to him, They have no wine.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? my hour is not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: His mother saith to the servants, Whatever he saith to you, do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them to the brim.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to them, Draw out now, and bear to the governor of the feast. And they bore {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not where it was from: (but the servants who drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

column.name: text
column.value: And saith to him, Every man at the beginning serveth the good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: {but} thou hast kept the good wine until now.

column.name: text
column.value: This beginning of miracles Jesus performed in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

column.name: text
column.value: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them that sold doves, Take these things away; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thy house hath eaten me up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered the Jews and said to him, What sign showest thou to us, seeing that thou doest these things?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?

column.name: text
column.value: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

column.name: text
