column.value: When therefore he had risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this to them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had spoken.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast {day}, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus did not commit himself to them, because he knew all {men},

column.name: text
column.value: And needed not that any should testify concerning man: for he knew what was in man.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

column.name: text
column.value: The same came to Jesus by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, Verily, verily, I say to thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus saith to him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say to thee, Except a man be born of water and {of} the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Marvel not that I said to thee, Ye must be born again.

column.name: text
column.value: The wind bloweth where it will, and thou hearest the sound of it, but canst not tell where it cometh from, and where it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus answered and said to him, How can these things be?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, Art thou a teacher of Israel, and knowest not these things?

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to thee, We speak what we know, and testify what we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

column.name: text
column.value: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you heavenly things?

column.name: text
column.value: And no man hath ascended to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, {even} the Son of man who is in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

column.name: text
column.value: That whoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

column.name: text
column.value: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men have loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: For John was not yet cast into prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there arose a question between {some} of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came to John, and said to him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all {men} come to him.

column.name: text
column.value: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, who standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: He must increase, but I {must} decrease.

column.name: text
column.value: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

column.name: text
column.value: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

column.name: text
column.value: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for {to him} God giveth not the Spirit by measure.

column.name: text
column.value: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

column.name: text
column.value: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

column.name: text
column.value: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he must needs go through Samaria.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he cometh to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with {his} journey, sat thus on the well: {and} it was about the sixth hour.

column.name: text
column.value: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith to her, Give me to drink.

column.name: text
column.value: (For his disciples had gone away to the city to buy food.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith the woman of Samaria to him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, who am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked him, and he would have given thee living water.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman saith to him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from where then hast thou that living water?

column.name: text
column.value: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, and his children, and his cattle?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to her, Whoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman saith to him, Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, neither come here to draw.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Go, call thy husband, and come here.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

column.name: text
column.value: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that thou hast spoken truth.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman saith to him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is from the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

column.name: text
column.value: God {is} a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship {him} in spirit and in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: The woman saith to him, I know that Messiah cometh, who is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, I that speak to thee am {he}.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

column.name: text
column.value: The woman then left her waterpot, and went into the city, and saith to the men,

column.name: text
column.value: Come, see a man, who hath told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they went out of the city, and came to him.

column.name: text
column.value: In the mean while his disciples urged him, saying, Master, eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But he said to them, I have food to eat that ye know not of.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him {any thing} to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, My food is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

column.name: text
column.value: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and {then} cometh harvest? behold, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit to life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

column.name: text
column.value: And in this {case} is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent you to reap that on which ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye have entered into their labours.

column.name: text
column.value: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, who testified, He told me all that ever I did.

column.name: text
column.value: So when the Samaritans had come to him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

column.name: text
column.value: And many more believed because of his own word;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard {him} ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Now after two days he departed from there, and went into Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when he had come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went to the feast.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water {into} wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judaea into Galilee, he went to him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: The nobleman saith to him, Sir, come down before my child dieth.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken to him, and he departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told {him}, saying, Thy son liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he enquired of them the hour when he began to get better. And they said to him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

column.name: text
column.value: So the father knew that {it was} at the same hour, in which Jesus said to him, Thy son liveth: and he himself believed, and his whole house.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} again the second miracle {that} Jesus performed, when he had come from Judaea into Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep {market} a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

column.name: text
column.value: In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

column.name: text
column.value: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was healed of whatever disease he had.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain man was there, who had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus saw him lying {there}, and knew that he had been now a long time {in that case}, he saith to him, Wilt thou be healed?

column.name: text
column.value: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the man was healed, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews therefore said to him that was cured, It is the sabbath: it is not lawful for thee to carry {thy} bed.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered them, He that healed me, the same said to me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they asked him, What man is that who said to thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

column.name: text
column.value: And he that was healed knew not who it was: for Jesus had withdrawn himself, a multitude being in {that} place.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said to him, Behold, thou art cured: sin no more, lest a worse thing come to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, who had healed him.

column.name: text
column.value: And therefore the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh until now, and I work.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Jesus and said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son can do nothing by himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for whatever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Father loveth the Son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and he will show him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the Father raiseth the dead, and giveth life to {them}; even so the Son giveth life to whom he will.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment to the Son:

column.name: text
column.value: That all {men} should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father who hath sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but hath passed from death to life.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

column.name: text
column.value: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

column.name: text
column.value: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall come forth; they that have done good, to the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, to the resurrection of damnation.

column.name: text
column.value: I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father who hath sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: If I bear witness concerning myself, my witness is not true.

column.name: text
column.value: There is another that beareth witness concerning me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth concerning me is true.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye sent to John, and he bore witness to the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye may be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have greater witness than {that} of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness concerning me, that the Father hath sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Father himself, who hath sent me, hath borne witness concerning me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

column.name: text
column.value: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.

column.name: text
column.value: I receive not honour from men.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

column.name: text
column.value: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

column.name: text
column.value: How can ye believe, who receive honour one from another, and seek not the honour that {cometh} from God only?

column.name: text
column.value: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is {one} that accuseth you, {even} Moses, in whom ye trust.

column.name: text
column.value: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote concerning me.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is {the sea} of Tiberias.

column.name: text
column.value: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he performed on them that were diseased.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus went up on a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus then lifted up {his} eyes, and saw a great company come to him, he saith to Philip, Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

column.name: text
column.value: And this he said to test him: for he himself knew what he would do.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

column.name: text
column.value: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith to him,

column.name: text
column.value: There is a lad here, who hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were sitting down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

column.name: text
column.value: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, Gather the fragments that remain, that nothing may be lost.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they gathered {them} up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above to them that had eaten.

column.name: text
column.value: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus performed, said, This is truly that prophet that should come into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again to a mountain himself alone.

column.name: text
column.value: And when evening had {now} come, his disciples went down to the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: And entered into a boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat: and they were afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: But he saith to them, It is I; be not afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they willingly received him into the boat: and immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

column.name: text
column.value: The day following, when the people who stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except that one into which his disciples had entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but {that} his disciples had gone away alone;

column.name: text
column.value: (However there came other boats from Tiberias near to the place where they ate bread, after the Lord had given thanks:)

column.name: text
column.value: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, Rabbi, when camest thou here?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say to you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye ate of the loaves, and were filled.

column.name: text
column.value: Labour not for the food which perisheth, but for that food which endureth to everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give to you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, What shall we do, that we may work the works of God?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

column.name: text
column.value: They said therefore to him, What sign showest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers ate manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: For the bread of God is he who cometh down from heaven, and giveth life to the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said to you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

column.name: text
column.value: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will by no means cast out.

column.name: text
column.value: For I came down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the Father's will who hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise them up again at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one who seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus therefore answered and said to them, Murmur not among yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: No man can come to me, except the Father who hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught from God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned from the Father, cometh to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that any man hath seen the Father, except he who is from God, he hath seen the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

column.name: text
column.value: I am that bread of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Your fathers ate manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat of it, and not die.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man shall eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews therefore {began} to dispute among themselves, saying, How can this man give us {his} flesh to eat?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

column.name: text
column.value: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

column.name: text
column.value: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers ate manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: These things he said in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

column.name: text
column.value: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard {this}, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said to them, Doth this offend you?

column.name: text
column.value: {What} if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

column.name: text
column.value: It is the spirit that giveth life; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak to you, {they} are spirit, and {they} are life.

column.name: text
column.value: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who he was that would betray him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Therefore I said to you, that no man can come to me, except it were given to him by my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: From that {time} many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to the twelve, Will ye also go away?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

column.name: text
column.value: He spoke of Judas Iscariot {the son} of Simon: for it was he that was to betray him, being one of the twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judaea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: His brethren therefore said to him, Depart from here, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there is} no man {that} doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou doest these things, show thyself to the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, My time is not yet come: but your time is always ready.

column.name: text
column.value: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify concerning it, that its works are evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Go ye up to this feast: I go not up yet to this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had said these words to them, he abode {still} in Galilee.

column.name: text
column.value: But when his brethren had gone up, then he went also to the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet no man spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man will do his will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is from God, or {whether} I speak from myself.

column.name: text
column.value: He that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Did not Moses give you the law, and {yet} none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

column.name: text
column.value: The people answered and said, Thou hast a demon: who goeth about to kill thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

column.name: text
column.value: Moses therefore gave to you circumcision; (not because it is from Moses, but from the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath circumcise a man.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man on the sabbath receiveth circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have restored a man to sound health on the sabbath?

column.name: text
column.value: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

column.name: text
column.value: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing to him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

column.name: text
column.value: But we know this man where he is from: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth where he is from.

column.name: text
column.value: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know where I am from: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this {man} hath done?

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them, Yet a little while am I with you, and {then} I go to him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find {me}: and where I am, {there} ye cannot come.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews among themselves, Where will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go to the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

column.name: text
column.value: What {manner of} saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find {me}: and where I am, {there} ye cannot come?

column.name: text
column.value: In the last day, that great {day} of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirsteth, let him come to me, and drink.

column.name: text
column.value: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his heart shall flow rivers of living water.

column.name: text
column.value: (But this he spoke of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Spirit was not yet {given}; because Jesus was not yet glorified.)

column.name: text
column.value: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, In truth this is the Prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

column.name: text
column.value: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh from the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

column.name: text
column.value: So there was a division among the people because of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, Why have ye not brought him?

column.name: text
column.value: The officers answered, Never man spoke like this man.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Pharisees answered them, Are ye also deceived?

column.name: text
column.value: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

column.name: text
column.value: But this people who know not the law are cursed.

column.name: text
column.value: Nicodemus saith to them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

column.name: text
column.value: Doth our law judge {any} man, before it heareth him, and knoweth what he doeth?

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, Art thou also from Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: And every man went to his own house.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus went to the mount of Olives.

column.name: text
column.value: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him; and he sat down, and taught them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scribes and Pharisees brought to him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

column.name: text
column.value: They say to him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with {his} finger wrote on the ground, {as though he heard them not }.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they continued asking him, he raised himself, and said to them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

column.name: text
column.value: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: And they who heard {it}, being convicted by {their own} conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, {even} to the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had raised himself, and saw none but the woman, he said to her, Woman, where are those thy accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

column.name: text
column.value: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said to her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus spoke again to them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees therefore said to him, Thou barest witness concerning thyself; thy witness is not true.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to them, Though I witness concerning myself, {yet} my witness is true: for I know from where I came, and where I go; but ye cannot tell from where I come, and where I go.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

column.name: text
column.value: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

column.name: text
column.value: I am one that bear witness concerning myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness concerning me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

column.name: text
column.value: These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus again to them, I am going away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: where I go, ye cannot come.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Where I go, ye cannot come.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: I said therefore to you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am {he}, ye shall die in your sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith to them, Even {the same} that I said to you from the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard from him.

column.name: text
column.value: They understood not that he spoke to them concerning the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am {he}, and {that} I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

column.name: text
column.value: As he spoke these words, many believed on him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to those Jews who believed on him, If ye continue in my word, ye are my disciples indeed;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

column.name: text
column.value: They answered him, We are Abraham's offspring, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say to you, Whoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: {but} the Son abideth for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: I know that ye are Abraham's offspring; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith to them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard from God: this did not Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We are not born of fornication; we have one Father, {even} God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: Why do ye not understand my speech? {even} because ye cannot hear my word.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are of {your} father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And because I tell {you} the truth, ye believe me not.

column.name: text
column.value: Which of you convicteth me of sin? And if I speak the truth, why do ye not believe me?

column.name: text
column.value: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear {them} not, because ye are not of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered the Jews, and said to him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honour my Father, and ye dishonour me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I seek not my own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, If a man shall keep my saying, he shall never see death.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews to him, Now we know that thou hast a demon. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man shall keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

column.name: text
column.value: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

column.name: text
column.value: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw {it}, and was glad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews to him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, Verily, verily, I say to you, Before Abraham was, I am.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

column.name: text
column.value: And as {Jesus} passed by, he saw a man who was blind from {his} birth.

column.name: text
column.value: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who sinned, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be revealed in him.

column.name: text
column.value: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

column.name: text
column.value: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went away therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

column.name: text
column.value: The neighbours therefore, and they who before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

column.name: text
column.value: Some said, This is he: others {said}, He is like him: {but} he said, I am {he}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they said to him, How were thy eyes opened?

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed my eyes, and said to me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said they to him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

column.name: text
column.value: They brought to the Pharisees him that before was blind.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was the sabbath when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said to them, He put clay upon my eyes, and I washed, and do see.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not from God, because he keepeth not the sabbath. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

column.name: text
column.value: They say to the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thy eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

column.name: text
column.value: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

column.name: text
column.value: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

column.name: text
column.value: These {words} his parents spoke, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man confessed that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then again they called the man that was blind, and said to him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said, Whether he is a sinner, I know not: one thing I know, that, though I was blind, now I see.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they said to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thy eyes?

column.name: text
column.value: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: Why would ye hear {it} again? will ye also be his disciples?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that God spoke to Moses: {as for} this {man}, we know not where he is from.

column.name: text
column.value: The man answered and said to them, Why here is a marvellous thing, that ye know not where he is from, and {yet} he hath opened my eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man is a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

column.name: text
column.value: Since the world began hath it not been heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

column.name: text
column.value: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said to him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

column.name: text
column.value: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I may believe on him?

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said to him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they who see not may see; and that they who see may be made blind.

column.name: text
column.value: And {some} of the Pharisees who were with him heard these words, and said to him, Are we blind also?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that entereth by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

column.name: text
column.value: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

column.name: text
column.value: This parable spoke Jesus to them: but they understood not what things they were which he spoke to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them again, Verily, verily, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the door: by me if any man shall enter, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

column.name: text
column.value: The thief cometh not, but to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they may have life, and that they may have {it} more abundantly.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the good shepherd, and know my {sheep}, and am known by mine.

column.name: text
column.value: As the Father knoweth me, even so I know the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, {and} one shepherd.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

column.name: text
column.value: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received from my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

column.name: text
column.value: And many of them said, He hath a demon, and is mad; why hear ye him?

column.name: text
column.value: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?

column.name: text
column.value: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the Jews around him, and said to him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou art the Christ, tell us plainly.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness concerning me.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

column.name: text
column.value: And I give to them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any pluck them out of my hand.

column.name: text
column.value: My Father, who gave {them to} me, is greater than all; and no {man} is able to pluck {them} out of my Father's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I and {my} Father are one.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shown you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

column.name: text
column.value: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

column.name: text
column.value: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

column.name: text
column.value: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father {is} in me, and I in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped from their hand,

column.name: text
column.value: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

column.name: text
column.value: And many resorted to him, and said, John performed no miracle: but all things that John spoke of this man were true.

column.name: text
column.value: And many believed on him there.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a certain {man} was sick, {named} Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

column.name: text
column.value: (It was {that} Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore his sisters sent to him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus heard {that}, he said, This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified by it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore he had heard that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after that he saith to {his} disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

column.name: text
column.value: {His} disciples say to him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou there again?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walketh in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

column.name: text
column.value: But if a man walketh in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

column.name: text
column.value: These things he said: and after that he saith to them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleepeth, he shall do well.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus spoke of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking rest in sleep.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Thomas, who is called Didymus, to his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had {lain} in the grave four days already.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Bethany was near to Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

column.name: text
column.value: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat in the house.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Martha to Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

column.name: text
column.value: But I know, that even now, whatever thou wilt ask of God, God will give {it} thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Thy brother shall rise again.

column.name: text
column.value: Martha saith to him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

column.name: text
column.value: She saith to him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon as she heard {that}, she arose quickly, and came to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus had not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews then who were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth to the grave to weep there.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when Mary had come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said to him, Lord, come and see.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus wept.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith to him, Lord, by this time his body smelleth: for he hath been {dead} four days.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Said I not to thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took away the stone {from the place} where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up {his} eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people who stand by I said {it}, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a cloth. Jesus saith to them, Loose him, and let him go.

column.name: text
column.value: Then many of the Jews who came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

column.name: text
column.value: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What do we? for this man performeth many miracles.

column.name: text
column.value: If we let him thus alone, all {men} will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of them, {named} Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said to them, Ye know nothing at all,

column.name: text
column.value: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

column.name: text
column.value: And this he spoke not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

column.name: text
column.value: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

column.name: text
column.value: Then from that day forth they took counsel together to put him to death.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went from there to a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Jews' passover was near at hand: and many went out of the country to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they sought for Jesus, and spoke among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

column.name: text
column.value: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he was, he should show {it}, that they might take him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Mary took a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's {son}, who was to betray him,

column.name: text
column.value: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

column.name: text
column.value: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bore what was put in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: for the day of my burial hath she kept this.

column.name: text
column.value: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.

column.name: text
column.value: Many people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

column.name: text
column.value: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day many people that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

column.name: text
column.value: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed {is} the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, when he had found a young donkey, sat on it; as it is written,

column.name: text
column.value: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on a donkey's colt.

column.name: text
column.value: These things his disciples understood not at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written concerning him, and {that} they had done these things to him.

column.name: text
column.value: The people therefore that were with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bore witness.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

column.name: text
column.value: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

column.name: text
column.value: The same came therefore to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it to life eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will {my} Father honour.

column.name: text
column.value: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause I came to this hour.

column.name: text
column.value: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, {saying}, I have both glorified {it}, and will glorify {it} again.

column.name: text
column.value: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard {it}, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spoke to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

column.name: text
column.value: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, if I shall be lifted up from the earth, will draw all {men} to me.

column.name: text
column.value: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

column.name: text
column.value: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus said to them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not where he goeth.

column.name: text
column.value: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spoke Jesus, and departed, and was hidden from them.

column.name: text
column.value: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

column.name: text
column.value: That the saying of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they could not believe, because that Isaiah said again,

column.name: text
column.value: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with {their} eyes, nor understand with {their} heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

column.name: text
column.value: These things said Isaiah, when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess {him}, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

column.name: text
column.value: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am come a light into the world, that whoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

column.name: text
column.value: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have not spoken from myself; but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

column.name: text
column.value: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatever I speak therefore, even as the Father said to me, so I speak.

column.name: text
column.value: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's {son}, to betray him;

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he had come from God, and was going to God;

column.name: text
column.value: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

column.name: text
column.value: After that he poured water into a basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe {them} with the towel with which he was girded.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he cometh to Simon Peter: and Peter saith to him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know after this.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter saith to him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter saith to him, Lord, not my feet only, but also {my} hands and {my} head.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not except to wash {his} feet, but is wholly clean: and ye are clean, but not all.

column.name: text
column.value: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

column.name: text
column.value: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was seated again, he said to them, Know ye what I have done to you?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for {so} I am.

column.name: text
column.value: If I then, {your} Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I tell you before it cometh, that, when it hath come to pass, ye may believe that I am {he}.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that receiveth whomever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say to you, that one of you shall betray me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, to ask who it should be of whom he spoke.

column.name: text
column.value: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith to him, Lord, who is it?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped {it}. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave {it} to Judas Iscariot, {the son} of Simon.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus to him, What thou doest, do quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spoke this to him.

column.name: text
column.value: For some {of them} thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said to him, Buy {those things} that we have need of for the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

column.name: text
column.value: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, when he had gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

column.name: text
column.value: If God is glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall immediately glorify him.

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said to the Jews, Where I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

column.name: text
column.value: A new commandment I give to you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: By this shall all {men} know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where goest thou? Jesus answered him, Where I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter said to him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say to thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me three times.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser.

column.name: text
column.value: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every {branch} that beareth fruit, he trimmeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

column.name: text
column.value: I am the vine, ye {are} the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man abideth not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast {them} into the fire, and they are burned.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done to you.

column.name: text
column.value: In this is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

column.name: text
column.value: These things have I spoken to you, that my joy may remain in you, and {that} your joy may be full.

column.name: text
column.value: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatever I command you.

column.name: text
column.value: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard from my Father I have made known to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and {that} your fruit should remain: that whatever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hated me before {it hated} you.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember the word that I said to you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

column.name: text
column.value: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

column.name: text
