column.value: If I had not come and spoken to them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

column.name: text
column.value: If I had not done among them the works which no other man hath done, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: But {this cometh to pass}, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send to you from the Father, {even} the Spirit of truth, who proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify concerning me:

column.name: text
column.value: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

column.name: text
column.value: In my Father's house are many mansions: if {it were} not {so}, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you to myself; that where I am, {there} ye may be also.

column.name: text
column.value: And where I go ye know, and the way ye know.

column.name: text
column.value: Thomas saith to him, Lord, we know not where thou goest; and how can we know the way?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no man cometh to the Father, but by me.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

column.name: text
column.value: Philip saith to him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou {then}, Show us the Father?

column.name: text
column.value: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak to you I speak not from myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

column.name: text
column.value: Believe me that I {am} in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater {works} than these shall he do; because I go to my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

column.name: text
column.value: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

column.name: text
column.value: At that day ye shall know that I {am} in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Judas, not Iscariot, saith to him, Lord, how is it that thou wilt reveal thyself to us, and not to the world?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered and said to him, If a man loveth me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our abode with him.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but that of the Father who sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: These things have I spoken to you, being {yet} present with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Comforter, {who is} the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatever I have said to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give to you: not as the world giveth, give I to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have heard that I said to you, I go away, and come {again} to you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go to the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I have told you before it cometh to pass, that, when it hath come to pass, ye may believe.

column.name: text
column.value: After this I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

column.name: text
column.value: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

column.name: text
column.value: These words spoke Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

column.name: text
column.value: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is life eternal, that they may know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

column.name: text
column.value: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thy own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

column.name: text
column.value: I have manifested thy name to the men whom thou gavest to me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they have known that all things whatever thou hast given me are from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have given to them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received {them}, and have known surely that I came from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

column.name: text
column.value: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them whom thou hast given to me; for they are thine.

column.name: text
column.value: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thy own name those whom thou hast given to me, that they may be one, as we {are}.

column.name: text
column.value: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest to me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: I have given to them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

column.name: text
column.value: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

column.name: text
column.value: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified through the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also who shall believe on me through their word;

column.name: text
column.value: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, {art} in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the glory which thou gavest to me I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

column.name: text
column.value: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

column.name: text
column.value: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given to me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given to me: for thou didst love me before the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I have declared to them thy name, and will declare {it}: that the love which thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where was a garden, into which he entered, and his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas also, who betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus often resorted there with his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Judas then, having received a band {of men} and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that were coming upon him, went forth, and said to them, Whom seek ye?

column.name: text
column.value: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith to them, I am {he}. And Judas also, who betrayed him, stood with them.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon then as he had said to them, I am {he}, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he asked them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am {he}: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

column.name: text
column.value: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of them whom thou gavest to me, I have lost none.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

column.name: text
column.value: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

column.name: text
column.value: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, who was the high priest that same year.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Caiaphas was he, who gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and {so did} another disciple: that disciple was known to the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter stood at the door outside. Then went out that other disciple, who was known to the high priest, and spoke to her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith the maid that kept the door to Peter, Art not thou also {one} of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

column.name: text
column.value: The high priest then asked Jesus concerning his disciples, and concerning his doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Why dost thou ask me? ask them who heard me, what I have said to them: behold, they know what I have said.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers who stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

column.name: text
column.value: Now Annas had sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

column.name: text
column.value: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore to him, Art not thou also {one} of his disciples? He denied {it}, and said, I am not.

column.name: text
column.value: One of the servants of the high priest, being the kinsman of him whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

column.name: text
column.value: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crowed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate then went out to them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

column.name: text
column.value: They answered and said to him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Pilate to them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said to him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

column.name: text
column.value: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said to him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing from thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thy own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee to me: what hast thou done?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from here.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate therefore said to him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate saith to him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and saith to them, I find in him no fault.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have a custom, that I should release to you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release to you the King of the Jews?

column.name: text
column.value: Then they all cried again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

column.name: text
column.value: These things have I spoken to you, that ye should not be offended.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

column.name: text
column.value: And these things will they do to you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

column.name: text
column.value: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not to you at the beginning, because I was with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But now I go to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Where goest thou?

column.name: text
column.value: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I depart, I will send him to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

column.name: text
column.value: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

column.name: text
column.value: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

column.name: text
column.value: I have yet many things to say to you, but ye cannot bear them now.

column.name: text
column.value: But when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but whatever he shall hear, {that} shall he speak: and he will show you things to come.

column.name: text
column.value: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall show {it} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore I said, that he shall take of mine, and show {it} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said {some} of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith to us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

column.name: text
column.value: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said to them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that which I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

column.name: text
column.value: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

column.name: text
column.value: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say to you, Whatever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give {it} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Until now ye have asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

column.name: text
column.value: These things have I spoken to you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak to you in proverbs, but I shall show you plainly concerning the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not to you, that I will pray the Father for you:

column.name: text
column.value: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

column.name: text
column.value: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: His disciples said to him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

column.name: text
column.value: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the hour cometh, and, is even now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I have spoken to you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put {it} on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith to them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus came forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And {Pilate} saith to them, Behold the man!

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore the chief priests and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify {him}, crucify {him}. Pilate saith to them, Take ye him, and crucify {him}: for I find no fault in him.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

column.name: text
column.value: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith to Jesus, Where art thou from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith Pilate to him, Speakest thou not to me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me to thee hath the greater sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And from then on Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: Whoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

column.name: text
column.value: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down on the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith to the Jews, Behold your King!

column.name: text
column.value: But they cried out, Away with {him}, away with {him}, crucify him. Pilate saith to them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then therefore he delivered him to them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led {him} away.

column.name: text
column.value: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called {the place} of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

column.name: text
column.value: Where they crucified him, and two others with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

column.name: text
column.value: And Pilate wrote a title, and put {it} on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

column.name: text
column.value: Many of the Jews then read this title: for the place where Jesus was crucified was near to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, {and} Latin.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also {his} coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

column.name: text
column.value: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the {wife} of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith to his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her to his own {home}.

column.name: text
column.value: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a sponge with vinegar, and put {it} upon hyssop, and put {it} to his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

column.name: text
column.value: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath, (for that sabbath was a great day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and {that} they might be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came the soldiers, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they broke not his legs:

column.name: text
column.value: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and immediately came out blood and water.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that saw {it} bore witness, and his witness is true: and he knoweth that he speaketh truth, that ye may believe.

column.name: text
column.value: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

column.name: text
column.value: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

column.name: text
column.value: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave {him} leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came also Nicodemus, who at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound {weight}.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they took the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, in which was never man yet laid.

column.name: text
column.value: There they laid Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation {day}; for the sepulchre was near at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: The first {day} of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, to the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: So they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: And he stooping down, saw the linen cloths lying; yet he went not in.

column.name: text
column.value: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen cloths lying {there},

column.name: text
column.value: And the cloth, that was about his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went in also that other disciple, who came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

column.name: text
column.value: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples went away again to their own home.

column.name: text
column.value: But Mary stood outside of the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, {to look} into the sepulchre,

column.name: text
column.value: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

column.name: text
column.value: And they say to her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she had thus said, she turned herself around, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith to him, Sir, if thou hast borne him away, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith to him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to her, Touch me not; for I have not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say to them, I ascend to my Father, and your Father; and {to} my God, and your God.

column.name: text
column.value: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and {that} he had spoken these things to her.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the same day at evening, being the first {day} of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and saith to them, Peace {be} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had so said, he showed to them {his} hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace {be} to you: as {my} Father hath sent me, even so I send you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had said this, he breathed on {them}, and saith to them, Receive ye the Holy Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose sins ye remit, they are remitted to them; {and} whose {sins} ye retain, they are retained.

column.name: text
column.value: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

column.name: text
column.value: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

column.name: text
column.value: And after eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas with them: {then} came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace {be} to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach here thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach here thy hand, and thrust {it} into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

column.name: text
column.value: And Thomas answered and said to him, My Lord and my God.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed {are} they that have not seen, and {yet} have believed.

column.name: text
column.value: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

column.name: text
column.value: But these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye may have life through his name.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Jesus showed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and in this manner did he show {himself}.

column.name: text
column.value: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the {sons} of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter saith to them, I am going fishing. They say to him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a boat immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the morning had now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Jesus saith to them, Children, have ye any fish? They answered him, No.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith to Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt {on his} fishermen's coat, (for he was naked,) and cast himself into the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other disciples came in a little boat; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

column.name: text
column.value: As soon then as they had come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on them, and bread.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and although there were so many, yet the net was not broken.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to them, Come {and} dine. And none of the disciples dared ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: This is now the third time that Jesus showed himself to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith to him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith to him, Feed my lambs.

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith to him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith to him, Feed my sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: He saith to him the third time, Simon, {son} of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said to him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith to him, Feed my sheep.

column.name: text
column.value: Verily, verily, I say to thee, When thou wast young, thou didst gird thyself, and didst walk where thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry {thee} where thou wouldest not.

column.name: text
column.value: This he spoke, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith to him, Follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; who also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, who is he that betrayeth thee?

column.name: text
column.value: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what {shall} this man {do}?

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus saith to him, If I will that he shall tarry till I come, what {is that} to thee? follow thou me.

column.name: text
column.value: Then this saying went abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not to him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he shall tarry till I come, what {is that} to thee?

column.name: text
column.value: This is the disciple who testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

column.name: text
column.value: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

column.name: text
column.value: Until the day when he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Spirit had given commandments to the apostles whom he had chosen:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom also he showed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen by them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

column.name: text
column.value: And, being assembled with {them}, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, {saith he}, ye have heard from me.

column.name: text
column.value: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit not many days from now.

column.name: text
column.value: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye shall receive power, after the Holy Spirit is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses to me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and to the uttermost part of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And while they looked steadfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

column.name: text
column.value: Who also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up to heaven? this same Jesus, who is taken from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come in, they went into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James {the son} of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas {the brother} of James.

column.name: text
column.value: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of the names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

column.name: text
column.value: Men, brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit by the mouth of David spoke before concerning Judas, who was guide to them that took Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was known to all the dwellers at Jerusalem; therefore that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell in it: and his office let another take.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore of these men who accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

column.name: text
column.value: Beginning from the baptism of John, to that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

column.name: text
column.value: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, who knowest the hearts of all {men}, show which of these two thou hast chosen,

column.name: text
column.value: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

column.name: text
column.value: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared to them cloven tongues as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak in other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because every man heard them speak in his own language.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these who speak Galilaeans?

column.name: text
column.value: And how do we hear every man in our own language, in which we were born?

column.name: text
column.value: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

column.name: text
column.value: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

column.name: text
column.value: Cretes and Arabians, we hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

column.name: text
column.value: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said to them, Ye men of Judaea, and all {ye} that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known to you, and hearken to my words:

column.name: text
column.value: For these are not drunk, as ye suppose, seeing it is {but} the third hour of the day.

column.name: text
column.value: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

column.name: text
column.value: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will, in those, days pour out of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

column.name: text
column.value: And I will show wonders in heaven above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

column.name: text
column.value: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} whoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

column.name: text
column.value: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

column.name: text
column.value: For David speaketh concerning him, I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou allow thy Holy One to see corruption.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

column.name: text
column.value: Men, brethren, let me freely speak to you concerning the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us to this day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn to him with an oath, that from the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

column.name: text
column.value: He seeing this before spoke of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither did his flesh see corruption.

column.name: text
column.value: This Jesus hath God raised up, of which we all are witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

column.name: text
column.value: For David did not ascend into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

column.name: text
column.value: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they heard {this}, they were pricked in their heart, and said to Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men, brethren, what shall we do?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said to them, Repent ye, and each one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, {even} as many as the Lord our God shall call.

column.name: text
column.value: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this perverse generation.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added {to them} about three thousand souls.

column.name: text
column.value: And they continued steadfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

column.name: text
column.value: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that believed were together, and had all things {in} common;

column.name: text
column.value: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all {men}, as every man had need.

column.name: text
column.value: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, ate their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

column.name: text
column.value: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, {being} the ninth {hour}.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

column.name: text
column.value: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked alms.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave heed to them, expecting to receive something from them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have I give thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted {him} up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

column.name: text
column.value: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

column.name: text
column.value: And they knew that it was he who sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened to him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as the lame man who was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Peter saw {it}, he answered to the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

column.name: text
column.value: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let {him} go.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted to you;

column.name: text
column.value: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; to which we are witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, brethren, I know that through ignorance ye did {it}, as {did} also your rulers.

column.name: text
column.value: But those things, which God before had shown by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall send Jesus Christ, who before was preached to you:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses truly said to the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up to you of your brethren, like me; him shall ye hear in all things whatever he shall say to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And it shall come to pass, {that} every soul, who will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, and all the prophets also from Samuel and those that follow, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold these days.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: To you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away each one of you from his iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they were speaking to the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

column.name: text
column.value: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And they laid hands on them, and put {them} in custody to the next day: for it was now evening.

column.name: text
column.value: But many of them who heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass on the next day, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

column.name: text
column.value: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

column.name: text
column.value: If we this day are examined concerning the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made well;

column.name: text
column.value: Be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, {even} by him doth this man stand here before you in good health.

column.name: text
column.value: This is the stone which was rejected by you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is no other name under heaven given among men, by which we must be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And beholding the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them {is} apparent to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: But that it may spread no further among the people, let us strictly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter and John answered and said to them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to hearken to you rather than to God, judge ye.

column.name: text
column.value: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all {men} glorified God for that which was done.

column.name: text
column.value: For the man was over forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was performed.

column.name: text
column.value: And being released, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou {art} God, who hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that is in them:

column.name: text
column.value: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

column.name: text
column.value: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For in truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

column.name: text
column.value: To do whatever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant to thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

column.name: text
column.value: By stretching forth thy hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any {of them} that any of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things {in} common.

column.name: text
column.value: And with great power the apostles gave witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither was there any among them that was needy: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

column.name: text
column.value: And laid {them} down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made to every man according as he had need.

column.name: text
column.value: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, {and} of the country of Cyprus,

column.name: text
column.value: Having land, sold {it}, and brought the money, and laid {it} at the apostles' feet.

column.name: text
column.value: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples, and said, It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

column.name: text
column.value: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

column.name: text
column.value: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid {their} hands on them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: And Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and miracles among the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called {the synagogue} of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

column.name: text
column.value: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spoke.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they secretly induced men, who said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and {against} God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon {him}, and caught him, and brought {him} to the council,

column.name: text
column.value: And set up false witnesses, who said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

column.name: text
column.value: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered to us.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that sat in the council, looking steadfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

column.name: text
column.value: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

column.name: text
column.value: And kept back {part} of the price, his wife also knowing {of it}, and brought a certain part, and laid {it} at the apostles' feet.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thy heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back {part} of the price of the land?

column.name: text
column.value: While it remained, was it not thy own? and after it was sold, was it not in thy own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thy heart? thou hast not lied to men, but to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and died: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And the young men arose, wrapped him up, and carried {him} out, and buried {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter answered to her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter said to her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them who have buried thy husband {are} at the door, and shall carry thee out.

column.name: text
column.value: Then she fell down immediately at his feet, and died: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying {her} forth, buried {her} by her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the rest dared no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

column.name: text
column.value: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

column.name: text
column.value: So that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid {them} on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

column.name: text
column.value: There came also a multitude {out} of the surrounding cities to Jerusalem, bringing sick persons, and them who were afflicted with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

column.name: text
column.value: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

column.name: text
column.value: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

column.name: text
column.value: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard {that}, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the elders of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, The prison truly we found shut with all safety, and the keepers standing outside before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they were greatly perplexed about them as to what would come of this.

column.name: text
column.value: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had brought them, they set {them} before the council: and the high priest asked them,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Did we not strictly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter and the {other} apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

column.name: text
column.value: Him hath God exalted with his right hand {to be} a Prince and a Saviour, to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And we are his witnesses of these things; and {so is} also the Holy Spirit, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard {that}, they were cut {to the heart}, and took counsel to slay them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then stood up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little time;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do concerning these men.

column.name: text
column.value: For before these days rose Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

column.name: text
column.value: After this man rose Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away many people after him: he also perished; and all, {even} as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I say to you, Stay away from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work is from men, it will come to nothing:

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is from God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest perhaps ye be found even to fight against God.

column.name: text
column.value: And to him they assented: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten {them}, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Haran,

column.name: text
column.value: And said to him, Depart from thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall show thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he came from the land of the Chaldeans, and dwelt in Haran: and from there, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, in which ye now dwell.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave him no inheritance in it, no, not {so much as} to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when {as yet} he had no child.

column.name: text
column.value: And God spoke in this way, That his offspring should sojourn in a foreign land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and oppress {them} four hundred years.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that they shall come forth, and serve me in this place.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so {Abraham} begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac {begat} Jacob; and Jacob {begat} the twelve patriarchs.

column.name: text
column.value: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

column.name: text
column.value: And delivered him from all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there came a famine over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the second {time} Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known to Pharaoh.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Joseph sent, and called his father Jacob to {him}, and all his kindred, seventy and five souls.

column.name: text
column.value: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: And were carried over into Shechem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor {the father } of Shechem.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the time of the promise drew near, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: Till another king arose, who knew not Joseph.

column.name: text
column.value: The same dealt treacherously with our kindred, and oppressed our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

column.name: text
column.value: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished in his father's house three months:

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And seeing one {of them} suffer wrong, he defended {him}, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

column.name: text
column.value: For he supposed his brethren to understand that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the next day he showed himself to them as they were fighting, and would have constrained them to be at peace again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

column.name: text
column.value: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

column.name: text
column.value: Wilt thou kill me, as thou didst the Egyptian yesterday?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Moses fled at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And when forty years had passed, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

column.name: text
column.value: When Moses saw {it}, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold {it}, the voice of the Lord came to him,

column.name: text
column.value: {Saying}, I {am} the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and dared not behold.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

column.name: text
column.value: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

column.name: text
column.value: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send {to be} a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

column.name: text
column.value: He brought them out, after he had showed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: This is that Moses, who said to the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up to you of your brethren, like me; him shall ye hear.

column.name: text
column.value: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on the mount Sinai, and {with} our fathers: who received the living oracles to give to us:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust {him} from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for {as for} this Moses, who brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.

column.name: text
column.value: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

column.name: text
column.value: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices {for} forty years in the wilderness?

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Molech, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

column.name: text
column.value: Our fathers had the tabernacle of testimony in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking to Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

column.name: text
column.value: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Joshua into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David;

column.name: text
column.value: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

column.name: text
column.value: But Solomon built for him an house.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

column.name: text
column.value: Heaven {is} my throne, and earth {is} my footstool: what house will ye build for me? saith the Lord: or what {is} the place of my rest?

column.name: text
column.value: Hath not my hand made all these things?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Spirit: as your fathers {did}, so {do} ye.

column.name: text
column.value: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them who showed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

column.name: text
column.value: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with {their} teeth.

column.name: text
column.value: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

column.name: text
column.value: And cast {him} out of the city, and stoned {him}: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon {God}, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul was consenting to his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: And devout men carried Stephen {to his burial}, and made great lamentation over him.

column.name: text
column.value: As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering into every house, and dragging off men and women committed {them} to prison.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they that were scattered went every where preaching the word.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people with one accord gave heed to those things which Philip spoke, hearing and seeing the miracles which he was performing.

column.name: text
column.value: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed and many sick with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was great joy in that city.

column.name: text
column.value: But there was a certain man, called Simon, who before in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, saying that he was some great person:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And to him they had regard, because that for a long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and was amazed, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent to them Peter and John:

column.name: text
column.value: Who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: (For as yet he had fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then they laid {their} hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said to him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

column.name: text
