column.value: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thy heart may be forgiven thee.

column.name: text
column.value: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and {in} the bond of iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goeth down from Jerusalem to Gaza, which is desert.

column.name: text
column.value: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem to worship,

column.name: text
column.value: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Isaiah the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

column.name: text
column.value: And Philip ran to {him}, and heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he besought Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

column.name: text
column.value: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so he opened not his mouth:

column.name: text
column.value: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

column.name: text
column.value: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached to him Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they went on {their} way, they came to a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, {here is} water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

column.name: text
column.value: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thy heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

column.name: text
column.value: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,

column.name: text
column.value: And desired from him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shone around him a light from heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: {it is} hard for thee to kick against the goads.

column.name: text
column.value: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord {said} to him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

column.name: text
column.value: And the men who journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

column.name: text
column.value: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought {him} into Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was three days without sight, and neither ate nor drank.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I {am here}, Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord {said} to him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for {one} called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

column.name: text
column.value: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting {his} hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

column.name: text
column.value: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord said to him, Go: for he is a chosen vessel to me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: For I will show him what great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And Ananias went, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, {even} Jesus, that appeared to thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mayest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight immediately, and arose, and was baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had received food, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But all that heard {him} were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them who called on this name in Jerusalem, and came here for that intent, that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?

column.name: text
column.value: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews who dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And after many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

column.name: text
column.value: But their laying in wait was known to Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples took him by night, and let {him} down by the wall in a basket.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

column.name: text
column.value: But Barnabas took him, and brought {him} to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And he spoke boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

column.name: text
column.value: {Which} when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, were multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all {quarters}, he came down also to the saints who dwelt at Lydda.

column.name: text
column.value: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had kept his bed eight years, and was sick with the palsy.

column.name: text
column.value: And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ healeth thee: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, who by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid in an upper chamber.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Lydda was near to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent to him two men, desiring {him} that he would not delay to come to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter put them all out, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave her {his} hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

column.name: text
column.value: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian {band},

column.name: text
column.value: {A} devout {man}, and one that feared God with all his house, who gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always.

column.name: text
column.value: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying to him, Cornelius.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Thy prayers and thy alms are come up for a memorial before God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now send men to Joppa, and call for {one} Simon, whose surname is Peter:

column.name: text
column.value: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the angel who spoke to Cornelius had departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had declared all {these} things to them, he sent them to Joppa.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, as they were going on their journey, and drew near to the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

column.name: text
column.value: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

column.name: text
column.value: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending to him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

column.name: text
column.value: In which were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: And the voice {spoke} to him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, {that} call not thou common.

column.name: text
column.value: This was done three times: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while Peter greatly perplexed in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men who were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

column.name: text
column.value: And called, and asked whether Simon, who was surnamed Peter, lodged there.

column.name: text
column.value: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said to him, Behold, three men seek thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Arise therefore, and go down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter went down to the men who were sent to him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what {is} the cause for which ye have come?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words from thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called them in, and lodged {them}. And on the next day Peter went with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the next day they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that had come together.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Ye know that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come to one of another nation; but God hath shown me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I came {to you} willingly, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

column.name: text
column.value: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thy alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Send therefore to Joppa, and call here Simon, whose surname is Peter; he lodgeth in the house of {one} Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou hast come. Now therefore we are all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee from God.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Peter opened {his} mouth, and said, In truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

column.name: text
column.value: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

column.name: text
column.value: The word which {God} sent to the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

column.name: text
column.value: That word, {I say}, ye know, which was proclaimed throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

column.name: text
column.value: That God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed by the devil; for God was with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

column.name: text
column.value: Him God raised the third day, and showed him openly;

column.name: text
column.value: Not to all the people, but to witnesses chosen before by God, {even} to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify that it is he who was ordained by God {to be} the Judge of the living and the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: While Peter was yet speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all them who heard the word.

column.name: text
column.value: And they of the circumcision who believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For they heard them speak in tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

column.name: text
column.value: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we?

column.name: text
column.value: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then they requested him to tarry certain days.

column.name: text
column.value: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Peter had come to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter went over {the matter} from the beginning, and expounded {it} by order to them, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, like a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Upon which when I had fastened my eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice saying to me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

column.name: text
column.value: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, {that} call not thou common.

column.name: text
column.value: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come to the house where I was, sent from Caesarea to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

column.name: text
column.value: And he showed us how he had seen an angel in his house, who stood and said to him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall tell thee words, by which thou and all thy house shall be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch then as God gave them the same gift as {he did} to us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance to life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now they who were dispersed upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but to the Jews only.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then tidings of these things came to the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

column.name: text
column.value: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would continue with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and many people were added to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Barnabas departed to Tarsus, to seek Saul:

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught many people. And the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

column.name: text
column.value: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem to Antioch.

column.name: text
column.value: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be a great famine throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief to the brethren who dwelt in Judaea:

column.name: text
column.value: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth {his} hands to afflict certain of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had apprehended him, he put {him} in prison, and delivered {him} to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after the Passover to bring him forth to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing by the church to God for him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon {him}, and a light shone in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise quickly. And his chains fell off from {his} hands.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith to him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went out, and followed him; and knew not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

column.name: text
column.value: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leadeth to the city; which opened to them of its own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and immediately the angel departed from him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Peter had come to himself, he said, Now I know with certainty, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and {from} all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had considered {the thing}, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

column.name: text
column.value: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid came to answer, named Rhoda.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told that Peter stood before the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: And they said to her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then they said, It is his angel.

column.name: text
column.value: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened {the door}, and saw him, they were astonished.

column.name: text
column.value: But he, beckoning to them with the hand to hold their peace, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go show these things to James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that {they} should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and {there} abode.

column.name: text
column.value: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's {country}.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the people gave a shout, {saying, It is} the voice of a god, and not of a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten by worms, and died.

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled {their} ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

column.name: text
column.value: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

column.name: text
column.value: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, Separate for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid {their} hands on them, they sent {them} away.

column.name: text
column.value: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Spirit, departed to Seleucia; and from there they sailed to Cyprus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John as {their} helper.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had gone through the isle to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name {was} Barjesus:

column.name: text
column.value: Who was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Saul, (who also {is called} Paul,) filled with the Holy Spirit, set his eyes on him,

column.name: text
column.value: And said, O full of all deceit and all mischief, {thou} child of the devil, {thou} enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord {is} upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, Men, brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with {his} hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, listen.

column.name: text
column.value: The God of this people Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm he brought them out of it.

column.name: text
column.value: And about the time of forty years he bore their manners in the wilderness.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

column.name: text
column.value: And after these things, {which took} about four hundred and fifty years, he gave {to them} judges, until Samuel the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had removed him, he raised up to them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the {son} of Jesse, a man after my own heart, who shall fulfil all my will.

column.name: text
column.value: Of this man's seed hath God according to {his} promise raised up to Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: After John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not {he}. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of {his} feet I am not worthy to loose.

column.name: text
column.value: Men, brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

column.name: text
column.value: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the words of the prophets which are read every sabbath, they have fulfilled {them} in condemning {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: And though they found no cause of death {in him}, yet they desired Pilate that he should be put to death.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had fulfilled all that was written concerning him, they took {him} down from the tree, and laid {him} in a sepulchre.

column.name: text
column.value: But God raised him from the dead:

column.name: text
column.value: And he was seen many days by them who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And we declare to you the glad tidings, that the promise which was made to the fathers,

column.name: text
column.value: God hath fulfilled the same to us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And as concerning that he raised him from the dead, {now} no more to return to corruption, he said in this way, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he saith also in another {psalm}, Thou shalt not allow thy Holy One to see corruption.

column.name: text
column.value: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell asleep, and was laid to his fathers, and saw corruption:

column.name: text
column.value: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

column.name: text
column.value: Be it known to you therefore, men, brethren, that through this man is preached to you the forgiveness of sins:

column.name: text
column.value: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken in the prophets;

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall by no means believe, though a man declare it to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Jews had gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the next sabbath came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spoke against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

column.name: text
column.value: Then Paul and Barnabas became bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first be spoken to you: but seeing ye reject it, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: For so hath the Lord commanded us, {saying}, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation to the ends of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the word of the Lord was proclaimed throughout all the region.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and drove them out of their land.

column.name: text
column.value: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

column.name: text
column.value: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

column.name: text
column.value: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: A long time therefore they abode speaking boldly in the Lord, who gave testimony to the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

column.name: text
column.value: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use {them} despitefully, and to stone them,

column.name: text
column.value: Being aware of {it}, they fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding region:

column.name: text
column.value: And there they preached the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who had never walked:

column.name: text
column.value: The same heard Paul speak: who steadfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

column.name: text
column.value: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercury, because he was the chief speaker.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the priest of Jupiter, who was before their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

column.name: text
column.value: {Which} when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard {of}, they tore their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach to you that ye should turn from these vanities to the living God, who made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are in them:

column.name: text
column.value: Who in times past allowed all nations to walk in their own ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

column.name: text
column.value: And with these sayings they scarce restrained the people, from doing sacrifice to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came there {certain} Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew {him} out of the city, supposing him to be dead.

column.name: text
column.value: But, as the disciples stood around him, he rose, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and {to} Iconium, and to Antioch,

column.name: text
column.value: Confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had ordained for them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

column.name: text
column.value: And from there sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended from to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come, and had gathered the church together, they reported all that God had done with them, and that he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And there they abode a long time with the disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

column.name: text
column.value: And Paul, as his manner was, went in to them, and on three sabbaths reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

column.name: text
column.value: Opening and alleging, that it was needful that Christ should suffer, and rise again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach to you, is Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Jews who believed not, moved with envy, took to them certain wicked fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city in an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren to the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down have come here also;

column.name: text
column.value: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, {one} Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the others, they let them go.

column.name: text
column.value: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night to Berea: who coming {there} went into the synagogue of the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women who were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached by Paul at Berea, they came there also, and stirred up the people.

column.name: text
column.value: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timothy abode there still.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that conducted Paul brought him to Athens: and receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy to come to him with all speed, they departed.

column.name: text
column.value: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he disputed in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoics, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? some others, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached to them Jesus, and the resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: And they took him, and brought him to Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine is, of which thou speakest?

column.name: text
column.value: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

column.name: text
column.value: (For all the Athenians and strangers who were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

column.name: text
column.value: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, {Ye} men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are very religious.

column.name: text
column.value: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I to you.

column.name: text
column.value: God that made the world and all things in it, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

column.name: text
column.value: And hath made of one blood all nations of men to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

column.name: text
column.value: That they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might grope after him, and find him, though he is not far from every one of us:

column.name: text
column.value: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

column.name: text
column.value: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like gold, or silver, or stone, formed by art and man's device.

column.name: text
column.value: And the times of this ignorance God overlooked; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

column.name: text
column.value: Because he hath appointed a day, when he will judge the world in righteousness by {that} man whom he hath ordained; {of which} he hath given assurance to all {men}, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again concerning this {matter}.

column.name: text
column.value: So Paul departed from among them.

column.name: text
column.value: But certain men joined themselves to him, and believed: among whom {was} Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper regions came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

column.name: text
column.value: He said to them, Have ye received the Holy Spirit since ye believed? And they said to him, We have not so much as heard whether there is any Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to them, Into what then were ye baptized? And they said, Into John's baptism.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people, that they should believe on him who should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: When they heard {this}, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Paul had laid {his} hands upon them, the Holy Spirit came on them; and they spoke with tongues, and prophesied.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the men were about twelve.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But when some were hardened, and believed not, but spoke evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

column.name: text
column.value: And this continued for the space of two years; so that all they who dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

column.name: text
column.value: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

column.name: text
column.value: So that from his body were brought to the sick, handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

column.name: text
column.value: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them who had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were seven sons of {one} Sceva, a Jew, {and} chief of the priests, who did so.

column.name: text
column.value: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

column.name: text
column.value: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

column.name: text
column.value: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

column.name: text
column.value: And many that believed came, and confessed, and showed their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Many also of them who practised magic brought their books together, and burned them before all {men}: and they counted the price of them, and found {it} fifty thousand {pieces} of silver.

column.name: text
column.value: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

column.name: text
column.value: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered to him, Timothy and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

column.name: text
column.value: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

column.name: text
column.value: For a certain {man} named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain to the craftsmen;

column.name: text
column.value: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods, which are made with hands:

column.name: text
column.value: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they heard {these sayings}, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great {is} Diana of the Ephesians.

column.name: text
column.value: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Paul would have entered in to the people, the disciples permitted him not.

column.name: text
column.value: And certain of the chief of Asia, who were his friends, sent to him, beseeching {him} that he would not venture himself into the theatre.

column.name: text
column.value: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the greater part knew not why they had come together.

column.name: text
column.value: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence to the people.

column.name: text
column.value: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great {is} Diana of the Ephesians.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the townclerk had quieted the people, he said, {Ye} men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the {image} which fell down from Jupiter?

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing then that these things cannot be denied, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye have brought here these men, who are neither robbers of temples, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen who are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them accuse one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause by which we may give an account of this riotous gathering.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

column.name: text
column.value: And certain men who came down from Judaea taught the brethren, {and said}, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain others of them, should go to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

column.name: text
column.value: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy to all the brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the church, and {by} the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But there rose certain of the sect of the Pharisees who believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command {them} to keep the law of Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: And the apostles and elders came together to consider of this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose, and said to them, Men, brethren, ye know that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

column.name: text
column.value: And God, who knoweth the hearts, bore them witness, giving to them the Holy Spirit, even as {he did} to us;

column.name: text
column.value: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

column.name: text
column.value: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the multitude kept silence, and hearkened to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought by them among the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they held their peace, James answered, saying, Men, brethren, hearken to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Simeon hath declared how God at the first visited the Gentiles, to take from among them a people for his name.

column.name: text
column.value: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

column.name: text
column.value: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again its ruins, and I will set it up:

column.name: text
column.value: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Known to God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore my judgment is, that we trouble not them, who from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

column.name: text
column.value: But that we write to them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and {from} immorality, and {from} things strangled, and {from} blood.

column.name: text
column.value: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath.

column.name: text
column.value: Then it pleased the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; {namely}, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

column.name: text
column.value: And they wrote {letters} by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren {send} greeting to the brethren who are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain who went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, {Ye must} be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no {such} commandment:

column.name: text
column.value: It seemed good to us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

column.name: text
column.value: Men that have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell {you} the same things by mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye abstain from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from immorality: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

column.name: text
column.value: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

column.name: text
column.value: {Which} when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

column.name: text
column.value: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And after they had tarried {there} a time, they were sent away in peace from the brethren to the apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: However it pleased Silas to abide there still.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

column.name: text
column.value: And some days after Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, {and see} how they do.

column.name: text
column.value: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

column.name: text
column.value: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed to Cyprus;

column.name: text
column.value: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being commended by the brethren to the grace of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he came to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a certain woman, who was a Jewess, and believed; but his father {was} a Greek:

column.name: text
column.value: Who was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

column.name: text
column.value: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those quarters: for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they went through the cities, they delivered to them the decrees to keep, that were ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to preach the word in Asia,

column.name: text
column.value: After they had come to Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit allowed them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

column.name: text
column.value: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, beseeching him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

column.name: text
column.value: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us to preach the gospel to them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next {day} to Neapolis;

column.name: text
column.value: And from there to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, {and} a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

column.name: text
column.value: And on the sabbath day we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was accustomed to be made; and we sat down, and spoke to the women who resorted {there}.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, who worshipped God, heard {us}: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended to the things which were spoken by Paul.

column.name: text
column.value: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought {us}, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide {there}. And she constrained us.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain maid possessed with a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

column.name: text
column.value: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, who show to us the way of salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: And this she did many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew {them} into the marketplace to the rulers,

column.name: text
column.value: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

column.name: text
column.value: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

column.name: text
column.value: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates tore off their clothes, and commanded to beat {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast {them} into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

column.name: text
column.value: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

column.name: text
column.value: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises to God: and the prisoners heard them.

column.name: text
column.value: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had fled.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

column.name: text
column.value: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

column.name: text
column.value: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

column.name: text
column.value: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

column.name: text
column.value: And they spoke to him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed {their} stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, without delay.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had brought them into his house, he set food before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the officers, saying, Let those men go.

column.name: text
column.value: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

column.name: text
column.value: But Paul said to them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast {us} into prison; and now do they thrust us out privately? nay verily; but let them come themselves and bring us out.

column.name: text
column.value: And the officers told these words to the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

column.name: text
column.value: And they came and besought them, and brought {them} out, and desired {them} to depart out of the city.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went out of the prison, and entered into {the house of} Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

column.name: text
column.value: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

column.name: text
column.value: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and he came to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And because he was of the same trade, he abode with them, and worked: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

column.name: text
column.value: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Silas and Timothy had come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in spirit, and testified to the Jews {that} Jesus {was} Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they opposed them, and blasphemed, he shook {his} raiment, and said to them, Your blood {be} upon your own heads; I {am} clean: from henceforth I will go to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And he departed from there, and entered into the house of a certain man named Justus, {one} that worshipped God, whose house was next to the synagogue.

column.name: text
column.value: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the Lord spoke to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

column.name: text
column.value: For I am with thee, and no man shall lay hands on thee to hurt thee: for I have many people in this city.

column.name: text
column.value: And he continued {there} a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, This {man} persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

column.name: text
column.value: And when Paul was now about to open {his} mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked crimes, O {ye} Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

column.name: text
column.value: But if it is a question of words and names, and {of} your law, look ye {to it}; for I will be no judge of such {matters}.

column.name: text
column.value: And he drove them from the judgment seat.

column.name: text
column.value: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat {him} before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

column.name: text
column.value: And Paul {after this} tarried {there} yet a good while, and took his leave of the brethren, and sailed from there into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn {his} head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

column.name: text
column.value: When they desired {him} to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

column.name: text
column.value: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return to you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and greeted the church, he went down to Antioch.

column.name: text
column.value: And after he had spent some time {there}, he departed, and went over {all} the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

column.name: text
column.value: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, {and} mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spoke and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

column.name: text
column.value: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him, and expounded to him the way of God more perfectly.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he had come, helped them much who had believed through grace:

column.name: text
column.value: For he mightily convinced the Jews, {and that} publicly, showing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the uproar had ceased, Paul called to {him} the disciples, and embraced {them}, and departed to go into Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

column.name: text
column.value: And {there} abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timothy; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

column.name: text
column.value: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

column.name: text
column.value: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came to them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: And upon the first {day} of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached to them, ready to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

column.name: text
column.value: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, having fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing {him} said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

column.name: text
column.value: When he had come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

column.name: text
column.value: And we went before to a ship, and sailed to Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so he had appointed, intending himself to go on foot.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

column.name: text
column.value: And we sailed from there, and came the next {day} opposite Chios; and the next {day} we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next {day} we came to Miletus.

column.name: text
column.value: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hastened, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

column.name: text
column.value: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they had come to him, he said to them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

column.name: text
column.value: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and trials, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

column.name: text
column.value: {And} how I kept back nothing that was profitable {to you}, but have shown you, and have taught you publicly, and from house to house,

column.name: text
column.value: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

column.name: text
column.value: Except that the Holy Spirit testifieth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions await me.

column.name: text
column.value: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received from the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I testify to you this day, that I {am} pure from the blood of all {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have not shunned to declare to you all the counsel of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed therefore to yourselves, and to all the flock, over which the Holy Spirit hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know this, that after my departure grievous wolves shall enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: Also from your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them who are sanctified.

column.name: text
column.value: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered to my necessities, and to them that were with me.

column.name: text
column.value: I have shown you all things, that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

column.name: text
column.value: And they all wept bitterly, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

column.name: text
column.value: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spoke, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him to the ship.

column.name: text
column.value: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence {which I make} now to you.

column.name: text
column.value: (And when they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

column.name: text
column.value: I am verily a man {who is} a Jew, born in Tarsus, {a city} in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, {and} taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, being zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

column.name: text
column.value: And I persecuted this way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

column.name: text
column.value: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the council of the elders: from whom also I received letters to the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them who were there bound to Jerusalem, to be punished.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, as I was on my journey, and had come near to Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light around me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

column.name: text
column.value: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said to me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spoke to me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said to me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee concerning all things which are appointed for thee to do.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews who dwelt {there},

column.name: text
column.value: Came to me, and stood, and said to me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: For thou shalt be his witness to all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

column.name: text
column.value: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that, when I had come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

column.name: text
column.value: And saw him saying to me, Make haste, and depart quickly from Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

column.name: text
column.value: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

column.name: text
column.value: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting to his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Depart: for I will send thee far away to the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: And they hearkened to him until this word, and {then} lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a {fellow} from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they cried out, and cast off {their} clothes, and threw dust into the air,

column.name: text
column.value: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the barracks, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know for what cause they cried so against him.

column.name: text
column.value: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said to the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

column.name: text
column.value: When the centurion heard {that}, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

column.name: text
column.value: Then the chief captain came, and said to him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum I obtained this freedom. And Paul said, But I was {free} born.

column.name: text
column.value: Then immediately they departed from him who were about to examine him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

column.name: text
column.value: On the next day, because he would have known the certainty why he was accused by the Jews, he loosed him from {his} bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.

column.name: text
column.value: And it came to pass, that after we were separated from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course to Coos, and the {day} following to Rhodes, and from there to Patara:

column.name: text
column.value: And finding a ship sailing over to Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

column.name: text
