column.value: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

column.name: text
column.value: Then {cometh} the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

column.name: text
column.value: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

column.name: text
column.value: The last enemy {that} shall be destroyed {is} death.

column.name: text
column.value: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under {him, it is} evident that he is excepted, who did put all things under him.

column.name: text
column.value: And when all things shall be subdued to him, then shall the Son also himself be subject to him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Else what shall they do who are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

column.name: text
column.value: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

column.name: text
column.value: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

column.name: text
column.value: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantage is it to me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not deceived: evil company corrupteth good habits.

column.name: text
column.value: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak {this} to your shame.

column.name: text
column.value: But some {man} will say, How are the dead raised? and with what body do they come?

column.name: text
column.value: {Thou} fool, that which thou sowest is not made alive, except it die:

column.name: text
column.value: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, perhaps of wheat, or of some other {grain}:

column.name: text
column.value: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed its own body.

column.name: text
column.value: All flesh {is} not the same flesh: but {there is} one {kind of} flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, {and} another of birds.

column.name: text
column.value: {There are} also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial {is} one, and the {glory} of the terrestrial {is} another.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for {one} star differeth from {another} star in glory.

column.name: text
column.value: So also {is} the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

column.name: text
column.value: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

column.name: text
column.value: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

column.name: text
column.value: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam {was made} a living spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: However that {was} not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

column.name: text
column.value: The first man {is} from the earth, earthy: the second man {is} the Lord from heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: As {is} the earthy, such {are} they also that are earthy: and as {is} the heavenly, such {are} they also that are heavenly.

column.name: text
column.value: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I show you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

column.name: text
column.value: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

column.name: text
column.value: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal {must} put on immortality.

column.name: text
column.value: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

column.name: text
column.value: O death, where {is} thy sting? O grave, where {is} thy victory?

column.name: text
column.value: The sting of death {is} sin; and the strength of sin {is} the law.

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks {be} to God, who giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye steadfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

column.name: text
column.value: Upon the first {day} of the week let each one of you lay by him in store, as {God} hath prospered him, that there be no collections when I come.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I come, whomever ye shall approve by {your} letters, them will I send to bring your liberality to Jerusalem.

column.name: text
column.value: And if it be proper that I should go also, they shall go with me.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I will come to you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I am to pass through Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: And it may be that I will abide, and even winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey wherever I go.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

column.name: text
column.value: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

column.name: text
column.value: For a great door and effectual is opened to me, and {there are} many adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: Now if Timothy come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also {do}.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come to me: for I look for him with the brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: As concerning {our} brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come to you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

column.name: text
column.value: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, acquit yourselves like men, be strong.

column.name: text
column.value: Let all your things be done with charity.

column.name: text
column.value: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and {that} they have devoted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

column.name: text
column.value: That ye submit yourselves to such, and to every one that helpeth with {us}, and laboureth.

column.name: text
column.value: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

column.name: text
column.value: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

column.name: text
column.value: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: The salutation of {me} Paul with my own hand.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man loveth not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: My love {be} with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. {{The first {epistle} to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus and Timothy.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy {our} brother, to the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} to you and peace from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

column.name: text
column.value: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them who are in any trouble, by the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

column.name: text
column.value: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And whether we are afflicted, {it is} for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we are comforted, {it is} for your consolation and salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: And our hope of you {is} steadfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so {shall ye be} also of the consolation.

column.name: text
column.value: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, so that we despaired even of life:

column.name: text
column.value: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raiseth the dead:

column.name: text
column.value: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver {us};

column.name: text
column.value: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift {bestowed} upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have conducted ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

column.name: text
column.value: For we write no other things to you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

column.name: text
column.value: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also {are} ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And in this confidence I intended to come to you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

column.name: text
column.value: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again from Macedonia to you, and by you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

column.name: text
column.value: When I therefore was thus minded, did I do it lightly? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

column.name: text
column.value: But {as} God {is} true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, {even} by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the promises of God in him {are} yea, and in him Amen, to the glory of God by us.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he who establisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, {is} God;

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I call God for a witness upon my soul, that to spare you I have not as yet come to Corinth.

column.name: text
column.value: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

column.name: text
column.value: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same who is made sorry by me?

column.name: text
column.value: And I wrote this same to you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them by whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is {the joy} of you all.

column.name: text
column.value: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly to you.

column.name: text
column.value: But if any hath caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not burden you all.

column.name: text
column.value: Sufficient to such a man {is} this punishment, which {was inflicted} by many.

column.name: text
column.value: So that on the contrary ye {ought} rather to forgive {him}, and comfort {him}, lest perhaps such an one should be swallowed up with too much sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I beseech you that ye would confirm {your} love toward him.

column.name: text
column.value: For to this end also I wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye are obedient in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: To whom ye forgive any thing, I {forgive} also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave {it}, for your sakes {I forgave it} in the person of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to {preach} the gospel of Christ, and a door was opened to me by the Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from there into Macedonia.

column.name: text
column.value: Now thanks {be} to God, who always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are to God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

column.name: text
column.value: To the one {we are} the savour of death to death; and to the other the savour of life to life. And who {is} sufficient for these things?

column.name: text
column.value: For we are not as many, who corrupt the word of God: but as from sincerity, but as from God, in the sight of God we speak in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some {others}, epistles of commendation to you, or {letters} of commendation from you?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read by all men:

column.name: text
column.value: {Forasmuch as ye are} manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not on tables of stone, but on fleshly tables of the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: And such trust we have through Christ toward God:

column.name: text
column.value: Not that we are sufficient by ourselves to think any thing as from ourselves; but our sufficiency {is} from God;

column.name: text
column.value: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

column.name: text
column.value: But if the ministration of death, written {and} engraven on stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not steadfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which {glory} was to be done away:

column.name: text
column.value: How shall not the ministration of the Spirit be more glorious?

column.name: text
column.value: For if the ministration of condemnation {was} glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

column.name: text
column.value: For if that which was done away {was} glorious, much more that which remaineth {is} glorious.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

column.name: text
column.value: And not as Moses, {who} put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not steadfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

column.name: text
column.value: But their minds were blinded: for until this day the same veil remaineth untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which {veil} is done away in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But even to this day, when Moses is read, the veil is upon their heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless when one shall turn to the Lord, the veil shall be taken away.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord {is}, there {is} liberty.

column.name: text
column.value: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, {even} as by the Spirit of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

column.name: text
column.value: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But if our gospel is hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them who believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine on them.

column.name: text
column.value: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

column.name: text
column.value: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shone into our hearts, to {give} the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not from us.

column.name: text
column.value: {We are} troubled on every side, yet not distressed; {we are} perplexed, but not in despair;

column.name: text
column.value: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

column.name: text
column.value: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be made manifest in our body.

column.name: text
column.value: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

column.name: text
column.value: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus shall raise us also by Jesus, and shall present {us} with you.

column.name: text
column.value: For all things {are} for your sakes, that the abundant grace may through the thanksgiving of many abound to the glory of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man is perishing, yet the inward {man} is renewed day by day.

column.name: text
column.value: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh out for us a far more exceeding {and} eternal weight of glory;

column.name: text
column.value: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen {are} temporal; but the things which are not seen {are} eternal.

column.name: text
column.value: For we know that if our earthly house of {this} tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

column.name: text
column.value: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed with our house which is from heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

column.name: text
column.value: For we that are in {this} tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not because we would be unclothed, but clothed, that mortality might be swallowed up in life.

column.name: text
column.value: Now he that hath wrought us for this very thing {is} God, who also hath given to us the earnest of the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore {we are} always confident, knowing that, while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

column.name: text
column.value: We are confident, {I say}, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted by him.

column.name: text
column.value: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things {done} in {his} body, according to what he hath done, whether good or bad.

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest to God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

column.name: text
column.value: For we commend not ourselves again to you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to {answer} them who glory in appearance, and not in heart.

column.name: text
column.value: For whether we are beside ourselves, {it is} to God: or whether we are of sound mind, {it is} for your cause.

column.name: text
column.value: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} he died for all, that they who live should not henceforth live to themselves, but to him who died for them, and rose again.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore henceforth we know no man according to the flesh: though indeed, we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now henceforth we know {him} no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if any man {is} in Christ, {he is} a new creation: old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.

column.name: text
column.value: And all things {are} from God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

column.name: text
column.value: That is, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, not imputing their trespasses to them; and hath committed to us the word of reconciliation.

column.name: text
column.value: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech {you} by us: we pray {you} in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For he hath made him {to be} sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

column.name: text
column.value: We then, {as} workers together {with him}, beseech {you} also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I helped thee: behold, now {is} the accepted time; behold, now {is} the day of salvation.)

column.name: text
column.value: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

column.name: text
column.value: But in all {things} commending ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

column.name: text
column.value: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

column.name: text
column.value: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, by sincere love,

column.name: text
column.value: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

column.name: text
column.value: By honour and dishonour, by bad report and good report: as deceivers, and {yet} true;

column.name: text
column.value: As unknown, and {yet} well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

column.name: text
column.value: As sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and {yet} possessing all things.

column.name: text
column.value: O {ye} Corinthians, We have spoken openly to you, our heart is wide open.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are not restrained by us, but ye are restrained by your own affections.

column.name: text
column.value: Now in return for the same, (I speak as to {my} children,) open wide your {hearts} to us.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

column.name: text
column.value: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

column.name: text
column.value: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in {them}; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean {thing}; and I will receive you,

column.name: text
column.value: And I will be a Father to you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak not {this} to condemn {you}: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with {you}.

column.name: text
column.value: Great {is} my boldness of speech toward you, great {is} my glorying concerning you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

column.name: text
column.value: For, when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without {were} fightings, within {were} fears.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

column.name: text
column.value: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation with which he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though {it was} but for a season.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might suffer loss through us in nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

column.name: text
column.value: For behold this very same thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what diligence it wrought in you, yea, {what} clearing of yourselves, yea, {what} indignation, yea, {what} fear, yea, {what} vehement desire, yea, {what} zeal, yea, {what} avenging of wrong! In all {things} ye have proved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, though I wrote to you, {I did it} not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: and exceedingly the more we rejoiced for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I have boasted any thing to him concerning you, I am not ashamed; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which {I made} before Titus, is found to be true.

column.name: text
column.value: And his affection is more abundant toward you, while he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all {things}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence {am} base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

column.name: text
column.value: But I beseech {you}, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, with which I think to be bold against some, who think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh:

column.name: text
column.value: (For the weapons of our warfare {are} not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

column.name: text
column.value: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: And having in a readiness to punish all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trusteth to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he {is} Christ's, even so {are} we Christ's.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

column.name: text
column.value: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

column.name: text
column.value: For {his} letters, say they, {are} weighty and powerful; but {his} bodily presence {is} weak, and {his} speech contemptible.

column.name: text
column.value: Let such a person think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such {will we be} also in deed when we are present.

column.name: text
column.value: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

column.name: text
column.value: But we will not boast of things without {our} measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For we stretch not ourselves beyond {our measure}, as though we reached not to you: for we are come as far as to you also in {preaching} the gospel of Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Not boasting of things without {our} measure, {that is}, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

column.name: text
column.value: To preach the gospel in the {regions} beyond you, {and} not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

column.name: text
column.value: For as concerning the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

column.name: text
column.value: For I know the readiness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath stirred up very many.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

column.name: text
column.value: Lest if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before to you, and make up beforehand your bounty, of which ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as {a matter of} bounty, and not {of} covetousness.

column.name: text
column.value: But this {I say}, He who soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he who soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

column.name: text
column.value: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, {so let him give}; not grudgingly, or by necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

column.name: text
column.value: And God {is} able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all {things}, may abound to every good work:

column.name: text
column.value: (As it is written, He hath dispersed; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Now may he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for {your} food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

column.name: text
column.value: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings to God;

column.name: text
column.value: While by the proof of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection to the gospel of Christ, and for {your} liberal distribution to them, and to all {men};

column.name: text
column.value: And by their prayer for you, who long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

column.name: text
column.value: Thanks {be} to God for his unspeakable gift.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

column.name: text
column.value: That in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.

column.name: text
column.value: For to {their} power, I bear witness, and even beyond {their} power {they were} willing of themselves;

column.name: text
column.value: Begging us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift, and {take upon us} the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: And {this they did}, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us by the will of God.

column.name: text
column.value: So that we urged Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, as ye abound in every {thing, in} faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and {in} all diligence, and {in} your love to us, {see} that ye abound in this grace also.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the diligence of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

column.name: text
column.value: And in this I give {my} advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be willing a year ago.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore finish the doing {of it}; that as {there was} a readiness to will, so {there may be} a performance also out of that which ye have.

column.name: text
column.value: For if there is first a willing mind, {it is} accepted according to what a man hath, {and} not according to what he hath not.

column.name: text
column.value: For {I mean} not that other men should be eased, and you burdened:

column.name: text
column.value: But by an equality, {that} now at this time your abundance {may be a supply} for their want, that their abundance also may be {a supply} for your want: that there may be equality:

column.name: text
column.value: As it is written, He that {had gathered } much had nothing over; and he that {had gathered } little had no want.

column.name: text
column.value: But thanks {be} to God, who put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more diligent, of his own accord he went to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise {is} in the gospel throughout all the churches;

column.name: text
column.value: And not {that} only, but who was also chosen by the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and {to show} our ready mind:

column.name: text
column.value: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

column.name: text
column.value: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have often proved to be diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which {I have} in you.

column.name: text
column.value: If {any do enquire} concerning Titus, {he is} my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren {be enquired of, they are} the messengers of the churches, {and} the glory of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore show ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: O that ye could bear with me a little in {my} folly: and indeed bear with me.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present {you as} a chaste virgin to Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his craftiness, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or {if} ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with {him}.

column.name: text
column.value: For I suppose I was not a bit behind the very greatest apostles.

column.name: text
column.value: But though {I am} rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been thoroughly made evident among you in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God without charge?

column.name: text
column.value: I robbed other churches, taking wages {of them}, to do you service.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I was present with you, and in need, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren who came from Macedonia supplied: and in all {things} I have kept myself from being burdensome to you, and {so} will I keep {myself}.

column.name: text
column.value: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

column.name: text
column.value: Why? because I love you not? God knoweth.

column.name: text
column.value: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them who desire occasion; that in what they glory, they may be found even as we.

column.name: text
column.value: For such {are} false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And no wonder; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore {it is} no great thing if his ministers also are transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

column.name: text
column.value: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

column.name: text
column.value: That which I speak, I speak {it} not according to the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye bear with fools gladly, seeing ye {yourselves} are wise.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye bear with it, if a man bringeth you into bondage, if a man devoureth {you}, if a man taketh {from you}, if a man exalteth himself, if a man smiteth you on the face.

column.name: text
column.value: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. But in whatever respect any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they Hebrews? so {am} I. Are they Israelites? so {am} I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so {am} I.

column.name: text
column.value: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool ) I {am} more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths often.

column.name: text
column.value: From the Jews five times I received forty {stripes} less one.

column.name: text
column.value: Three times was I beaten with rods, once I was stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

column.name: text
column.value: {In} journeyings often, {in} perils of waters, {in} perils of robbers, {in} perils by {my own} countrymen, {in} perils by the heathen, {in} perils in the city, {in} perils in the wilderness, {in} perils in the sea, {in} perils among false brethren;

column.name: text
column.value: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

column.name: text
column.value: Besides those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is led into sin, and I am not incensed?

column.name: text
column.value: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern my infirmities.

column.name: text
column.value: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

column.name: text
column.value: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

column.name: text
column.value: And through a window in a basket I was let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

column.name: text
column.value: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: I knew a man in Christ fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such one caught up to the third heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

column.name: text
column.value: How he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

column.name: text
column.value: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in my infirmities.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but {now} I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me {to be}, or {what} he heareth from me.

column.name: text
column.value: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

column.name: text
column.value: For this thing I besought the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

column.name: text
column.value: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended by you: for in nothing am I behind the very greatest apostles, though I am nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: For what is it in which ye were inferior to other churches, except that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I am loved.

column.name: text
column.value: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

column.name: text
column.value: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent to you?

column.name: text
column.value: I urged Titus, and with {him} I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? {walked we} not in the same steps?

column.name: text
column.value: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves to you? we speak before God in Christ: but {we do} all things, dearly beloved, for your edification.

column.name: text
column.value: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and {that} I shall be found by you such as ye would not: lest {there be} debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, conceits, tumults:

column.name: text
column.value: {And} lest, when I come again, my God may humble me among you, and I shall bewail many who have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and immorality and lasciviousness which they have committed.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the third {time} I am coming to you. By the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

column.name: text
column.value: I told you before, and foretell, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them who have sinned before, and to all others, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

column.name: text
column.value: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, who toward you is not weak, but is mighty in you.

column.name: text
column.value: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

column.name: text
column.value: Examine yourselves, whether ye are in the faith; test your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye are disqualified?

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not disqualified.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we may seem disqualified.

column.name: text
column.value: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, {even} your perfection.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: All the saints greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit, {be} with you all. Amen. {{The second {epistle} to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, {a city} of Macedonia, by Titus and Luke.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Then fourteen years after I went again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with {me} also.

column.name: text
column.value: And I went by revelation, and communicated to them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them who were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

column.name: text
column.value: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in secretly to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed {to be somewhat} in conference added nothing to me:

column.name: text
column.value: But on the contrary, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed to me, as {the gospel} of the circumcision {was} to Peter;

column.name: text
column.value: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

column.name: text
column.value: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given to me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we {should go} to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

column.name: text
column.value: Only {they would} that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was diligent to do.

column.name: text
column.value: But when Peter had come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

column.name: text
column.value: For before that certain came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles: but when they had come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them who were of the circumcision.

column.name: text
column.value: And the other Jews likewise were hypocrites with him; so that Barnabas also was carried away with their hypocrisy.

column.name: text
column.value: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter before {them} all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

column.name: text
column.value: We {who are} Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we may be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

column.name: text
column.value: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, {is} therefore Christ the minister of sin? By no means.

column.name: text
column.value: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

column.name: text
column.value: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I may live to God.

column.name: text
column.value: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

column.name: text
column.value: I do not set aside the grace of God: for if righteousness is {gained} by the law, then Christ hath died in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle, (not from men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

column.name: text
column.value: And all the brethren who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} to you and peace from God the Father, and {from} our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I marvel that ye are so soon turning from him that called you into the grace of Christ to another gospel:

column.name: text
column.value: Which is not another; but there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach any other gospel to you than that which we have preached to you, let him be accursed.

column.name: text
column.value: As we said before, so I say now again, If any {man} preacheth any other gospel to you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

column.name: text
column.value: For do I now seek the favour of men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But I make known to you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached by me is not according to man.

column.name: text
column.value: For I neither received it from man, neither was I taught {it}, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye have heard of my former manner of life in time past in the Jews' religion, that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

column.name: text
column.value: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

column.name: text
column.value: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called {me} by his grace,

column.name: text
column.value: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did I go to Jerusalem to them who were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again to Damascus.

column.name: text
column.value: Then after three years I went to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

column.name: text
column.value: But I saw no other of the apostles, except James the Lord's brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I lie not.

column.name: text
column.value: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

column.name: text
column.value: And was unknown by face to the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: But they had heard only, That he who persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they glorified God in me.

column.name: text
column.value: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been clearly set forth, crucified among you?

column.name: text
column.value: This only would I learn from you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

column.name: text
column.value: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

column.name: text
column.value: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if {it is} yet in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, {doeth he this} by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

column.name: text
column.value: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Know ye therefore that they who are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles through faith, preached before the gospel to Abraham, {saying}, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

column.name: text
column.value: So then they who are of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed {is} every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

column.name: text
column.value: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, {is} evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live by them.

column.name: text
column.value: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed {is} every one that hangeth on a tree:

column.name: text
column.value: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though {it is} but a man's covenant, yet {if it is} confirmed, no man setteth it aside, or addeth to it.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And this I say, {that} the covenant, that was confirmed before by God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot set it aside, that it should make the promise of no effect.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the inheritance {is} by the law, {it is} no more by promise: but God gave {it} to Abraham by promise.

column.name: text
column.value: What purpose then {serveth} the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; {and it was} ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

column.name: text
column.value: Now a mediator is not {a mediator} of one, but God is one.

column.name: text
column.value: {Is} the law then against the promises of God? By no means: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

column.name: text
column.value: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

column.name: text
column.value: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up to the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the law was our schoolmaster {to bring us} to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: But after faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye are all children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye {are} Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I Paul say to you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

column.name: text
column.value: Christ is become of no effect to you, whoever of you are justified by the law; ye have fallen from grace.

column.name: text
column.value: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye did run well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?

column.name: text
column.value: This persuasion {cometh} not from him that calleth you.

column.name: text
column.value: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

column.name: text
column.value: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be not otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whoever he may be.

column.name: text
column.value: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then hath the offence of the cross ceased.

column.name: text
column.value: I would they were even cut off who trouble you.

column.name: text
column.value: For, brethren, ye have been called to liberty; only {use} not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

column.name: text
column.value: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, {even} in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one by another.

column.name: text
column.value: {This} I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the works of the flesh are evident, which are {these}; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

column.name: text
column.value: Idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousy, wrath, contention, seditions, heresies,

column.name: text
column.value: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of which I tell you before, as I have also told {you} in time past, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

column.name: text
column.value: Meekness, self-control: against such there is no law.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

column.name: text
column.value: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

column.name: text
column.value: Now I say, {That} the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he is lord of all;

column.name: text
column.value: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed by the father.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

column.name: text
column.value: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,

column.name: text
column.value: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

column.name: text
column.value: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: However then, when ye knew not God, ye did service to them which by nature are no gods.

column.name: text
column.value: But now, after ye have known God, or rather are known by God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, to which ye desire again to be in bondage?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

column.name: text
column.value: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I {am}; for I {am} as ye {are}: ye have not injured me at all.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye know that in infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel to you at the first.

column.name: text
column.value: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, {even} as Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: What then was the blessedness ye spoke of? for I bear you witness, that, if {it had been} possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

column.name: text
column.value: They zealously seek you, {but} not for good; for, they would exclude you, that ye may seek them.

column.name: text
column.value: But {it is} good to be zealously sought always in {a} good {thing}, and not only when I am present with you.

column.name: text
column.value: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

column.name: text
column.value: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my tone; for I stand in doubt of you.

column.name: text
column.value: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondwoman, the other by a freewoman.

column.name: text
column.value: But he {who was} of the bondwoman was born according to the flesh; but he of the freewoman {was} by promise.

column.name: text
column.value: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which beareth children for bondage, which is Hagar.

column.name: text
column.value: For this Hagar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

column.name: text
column.value: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is written, Rejoice, {thou} barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she who hath an husband.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

column.name: text
column.value: But as then he that was born according to the flesh persecuted him {that was born} according to the Spirit, even so {it is} now.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

column.name: text
column.value: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye who are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

column.name: text
column.value: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For if a man thinketh himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

column.name: text
column.value: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

column.name: text
column.value: For every man shall bear his own burden.

column.name: text
column.value: Let him that is taught in the word share with him that teacheth in all good things.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that soweth to his flesh shall from the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall from the Spirit reap life everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

column.name: text
column.value: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good to all {men}, especially to them who are of the household of faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye see how large a letter I have written to you with my own hand.

column.name: text
column.value: As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: But may it never be that I should glory, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

column.name: text
column.value: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace {be} on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

column.name: text
column.value: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. {{To {the} Galatians written from Rome.}}

column.name: text
column.value: And you {hath he made alive}, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

column.name: text
column.value: In which in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

column.name: text
column.value: Among whom also we all had our manner of life in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

column.name: text
column.value: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

column.name: text
column.value: Even when we were dead in sins, hath made us alive together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

column.name: text
column.value: And hath raised {us} up together, and made {us} sit together in heavenly {places} in Christ Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: That in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in {his} kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: {it is} the gift of God:

column.name: text
column.value: Not by works, lest any man should boast.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore remember, that ye {being} in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

column.name: text
column.value: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

column.name: text
column.value: But now in Christ Jesus ye who once were far off are made near by the blood of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition {between us};

column.name: text
column.value: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, {even} the law of commandments {contained} in ordinances; to make in himself of two one new man, {so} making peace;

column.name: text
column.value: And that he might reconcile both to God in one body by the cross, having by himself slain the enmity:

column.name: text
column.value: And came and preached peace to you who were afar off, and to them that were near.

column.name: text
column.value: For through him we both have an access by one Spirit to the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and aliens, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

column.name: text
column.value: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner {stone};

column.name: text
column.value: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth to an holy temple in the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom ye also are built together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

column.name: text
column.value: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me on your account:

column.name: text
column.value: That by revelation he made known to me the mystery; (as I wrote before in few words,

column.name: text
column.value: By which, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ )

column.name: text
column.value: Which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

column.name: text
column.value: That the Gentiles should be joint-heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

column.name: text
column.value: Of which I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effectual working of his power.

column.name: text
column.value: To me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: And to make all {men} see what {is} the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: To the intent that now to the principalities and powers in heavenly {places} might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

column.name: text
column.value: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

column.name: text
column.value: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

column.name: text
column.value: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

column.name: text
column.value: May be able to comprehend with all saints what {is} the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

column.name: text
column.value: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye may be filled with all the fulness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

column.name: text
column.value: To him {be} glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation by which ye are called,

column.name: text
column.value: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

column.name: text
column.value: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

column.name: text
column.value: {There is} one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

column.name: text
column.value: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

column.name: text
column.value: One God and Father of all, who {is} above all, and through all, and in you all.

column.name: text
column.value: But to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he saith, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.

column.name: text
column.value: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: He that descended is the same also that ascended far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

column.name: text
column.value: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

column.name: text
column.value: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a perfect man, to the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: That we {henceforth} be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, {and} cunning craftiness, by which they lie in wait to deceive;

column.name: text
column.value: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, who is the head, {even} Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body to the edifying of itself in love.

column.name: text
column.value: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

column.name: text
column.value: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

column.name: text
column.value: Who being past feeling have given themselves over to lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have not so learned Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: If indeed ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye put off concerning the former manner of life the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

column.name: text
column.value: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

column.name: text
column.value: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

column.name: text
