column.value: Therefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither give place to the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with {his} hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace to the hearers.

column.name: text
column.value: And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, by whom ye are sealed to the day of redemption.

column.name: text
column.value: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

column.name: text
column.value: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly {places} in Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

column.name: text
column.value: Having predestinated us to the adoption of children to himself by Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of his will,

column.name: text
column.value: To the praise of the glory of his grace, in which he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

column.name: text
column.value: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

column.name: text
column.value: In which he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

column.name: text
column.value: Having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

column.name: text
column.value: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; {even} in him:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

column.name: text
column.value: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: In whom ye also {trusted}, after ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after ye believed, ye were sealed with that Holy Spirit of promise,

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, to the praise of his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I also, having heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love to all the saints,

column.name: text
column.value: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

column.name: text
column.value: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

column.name: text
column.value: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

column.name: text
column.value: And what {is} the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

column.name: text
column.value: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set {him} at his own right hand in the heavenly {places},

column.name: text
column.value: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

column.name: text
column.value: And put all {things} under his feet, and gave him {to be} the head over all {things} to the church,

column.name: text
column.value: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

column.name: text
column.value: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

column.name: text
column.value: But immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not befitting: but rather giving of thanks.

column.name: text
column.value: For this ye know, that no immoral, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye not therefore partakers with them.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye were once darkness, but now {are ye} light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

column.name: text
column.value: (For the fruit of the Spirit {is} in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

column.name: text
column.value: Proving what is acceptable to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove {them}.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.

column.name: text
column.value: But all things that are reproved are made visible by the light: for whatever doth make manifest is light.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

column.name: text
column.value: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

column.name: text
column.value: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord {is}.

column.name: text
column.value: And be not drunk with wine, in which is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

column.name: text
column.value: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

column.name: text
column.value: Giving thanks always for all things to God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so {let} wives {be} to their own husbands in every thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

column.name: text
column.value: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

column.name: text
column.value: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

column.name: text
column.value: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

column.name: text
column.value: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

column.name: text
column.value: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless let each one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife {see} that she reverence {her} husband.

column.name: text
column.value: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

column.name: text
column.value: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

column.name: text
column.value: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Servants, be obedient to them that are {your} masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

column.name: text
column.value: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that whatever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive from the Lord, whether {he be} bond or free.

column.name: text
column.value: And, ye masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

column.name: text
column.value: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high {places}.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore take up the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

column.name: text
column.value: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

column.name: text
column.value: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

column.name: text
column.value: Above all, taking the shield of faith, with which ye shall be able to put out all the fiery darts of the wicked.

column.name: text
column.value: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

column.name: text
column.value: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching for this purpose with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

column.name: text
column.value: And for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

column.name: text
column.value: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: But that ye also may know my affairs, {and} how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that ye may know our affairs, and {that} he may comfort your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: Peace {be} to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen. {{To {the} Ephesians written from Rome, by Tychicus.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from God our Father, and {from} the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

column.name: text
column.value: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

column.name: text
column.value: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

column.name: text
column.value: Being confident of this very thing, that he who hath begun a good work in you will perform {it} until the day of Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Even as it is right for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

column.name: text
column.value: For God is my witness, how greatly I long after you all in the affection of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and {in} all judgment;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

column.name: text
column.value: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things {which happened} to me have fallen out rather to the furtherance of the gospel;

column.name: text
column.value: So that my bonds in Christ are known in all the palace, and in all other {places};

column.name: text
column.value: And many of the brethren in the Lord, being more confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

column.name: text
column.value: Some indeed preach Christ even from envy and strife; and some also from good will:

column.name: text
column.value: The one preach Christ from contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

column.name: text
column.value: But the other from love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: What then? Only {that in} every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I in this do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: According to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but {that} with all boldness, as always, {so} now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

column.name: text
column.value: For me to live {is} Christ, and to die {is} gain.

column.name: text
column.value: But if I live in the flesh, this {is} the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I know not.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am in a strait between the two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh {is} more needful for you.

column.name: text
column.value: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

column.name: text
column.value: That your rejoicing for me may be more abundant in Jesus Christ by my coming to you again.

column.name: text
column.value: Only let your conduct be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

column.name: text
column.value: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

column.name: text
column.value: For to you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

column.name: text
column.value: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear {to be} in me.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed {is} not tedious, but for you {it is} safe.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are the {true} circumcision, who worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath reason to trust in the flesh, I more:

column.name: text
column.value: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, {of} the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; with respect to the law, a Pharisee;

column.name: text
column.value: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; with respect to the righteousness which is by the law, blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea doubtless, and I count all things {to be} loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them {to be} dung, that I may win Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: And be found in him, not having my own righteousness, which is from the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith:

column.name: text
column.value: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable to his death;

column.name: text
column.value: If by any means I may attain to the resurrection of the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I press on, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended by Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but {this} one thing {I do}, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forward to those things which are before,

column.name: text
column.value: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye are otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless, to what we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them who walk even as ye have us for an example.

column.name: text
column.value: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, {that they are} the enemies of the cross of Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose end {is} destruction, whose God {is their} appetite, and {whose} glory {is} in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

column.name: text
column.value: For our citizenship is in heaven; from which also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall change our lowly body, that it may be fashioned like his glorious body, according to the working by which he is able even to subdue all things to himself.

column.name: text
column.value: If {there is} therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

column.name: text
column.value: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, {being} of one accord, of one mind.

column.name: text
column.value: {Let} nothing {be done} through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

column.name: text
column.value: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

column.name: text
column.value: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

column.name: text
column.value: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient to death, even the death of the cross.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

column.name: text
column.value: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of {things} in heaven, and {things} on earth, and {things} under the earth;

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ {is} Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

column.name: text
column.value: For it is God who worketh in you both to will and to do of {his} good pleasure.

column.name: text
column.value: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

column.name: text
column.value: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

column.name: text
column.value: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

column.name: text
column.value: For all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

column.name: text
column.value: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

column.name: text
column.value: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because ye had heard that he was sick.

column.name: text
column.value: For indeed he was sick near to death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: I sent him therefore the more eagerly, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

column.name: text
column.value: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

column.name: text
column.value: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, not regarding his life, to supply the want of your service toward me.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, {my} dearly beloved.

column.name: text
column.value: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And I entreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women who laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and {with} other my fellowlabourers, whose names {are} in the book of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice in the Lord always: {and} again I say, Rejoice.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your moderation be known to all men. The Lord {is} at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: Be anxious for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brethren, whatever things are true, whatever things {are} honest, whatever things {are} just, whatever things {are} pure, whatever things {are} lovely, whatever things {are} of good report; if {there is} any virtue, and if {there is} any praise, think on these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

column.name: text
column.value: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; in which ye were also concerned, but ye lacked opportunity.

column.name: text
column.value: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatever state I am, {with that} to be content.

column.name: text
column.value: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

column.name: text
column.value: I can do all things through Christ who strengtheneth me.

column.name: text
column.value: However ye have done well, that ye did share with my affliction.

column.name: text
column.value: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church shared with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

column.name: text
column.value: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again to my necessity.

column.name: text
column.value: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received from Epaphroditus the things {which were sent} from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

column.name: text
column.value: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to God and our Father {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren who are with me greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: All the saints greet you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen. {{To {the} Philippians written from Rome, by Epaphroditus.}}

column.name: text
column.value: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and {for} them at Laodicea, and {for} as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

column.name: text
column.value: That their hearts may be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

column.name: text
column.value: And this I say, lest any man should deceive you with enticing words.

column.name: text
column.value: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, {so} walk ye in him:

column.name: text
column.value: Rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.

column.name: text
column.value: Beware lest any man make a prey of you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye are complete in him, who is the head of all principality and power:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Buried with him in baptism, in which also ye are risen with {him} through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he made alive together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

column.name: text
column.value: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

column.name: text
column.value: {And} having disarmed principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man therefore judge you in food, or in drink, or in respect of a feast day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbaths:

column.name: text
column.value: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body {is} of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

column.name: text
column.value: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore if ye are dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

column.name: text
column.value: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

column.name: text
column.value: Which all are to perish with the using;) according to the commandments and doctrines of men?

column.name: text
column.value: These things have indeed a show of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy {our} brother,

column.name: text
column.value: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ who are at Colosse: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

column.name: text
column.value: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love {which ye have} to all the saints,

column.name: text
column.value: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, of which ye have heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

column.name: text
column.value: Which is come to you, as {it is} in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as {it doth} also in you, since the day ye heard {of it}, and knew the grace of God in truth:

column.name: text
column.value: As ye also learned from Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause we also, since the day we heard {it}, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may walk worthy of the Lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, to all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

column.name: text
column.value: Giving thanks to the Father, who hath made us qualified to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated {us} into the kingdom of his beloved Son:

column.name: text
column.value: In whom we have redemption through his blood, {even} the forgiveness of sins:

column.name: text
column.value: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation:

column.name: text
column.value: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are upon earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

column.name: text
column.value: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

column.name: text
column.value: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all {things} he may have the preeminence.

column.name: text
column.value: For it pleased {the Father} that in him should all fulness dwell;

column.name: text
column.value: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things to himself; by him, {I say}, whether {they are} things on earth, or things in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And you, that were once alienated and enemies in {your} mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

column.name: text
column.value: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

column.name: text
column.value: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and {are} not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, {and} which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; of which I Paul am made a minister;

column.name: text
column.value: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

column.name: text
column.value: Of which I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

column.name: text
column.value: {Even} the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is revealed to his saints:

column.name: text
column.value: To whom God would make known what {is} the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

column.name: text
column.value: For which I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians {which is} in God the Father and {in} the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

column.name: text
column.value: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election by God.

column.name: text
column.value: For our gospel came not to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: So that ye were examples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

column.name: text
column.value: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

column.name: text
column.value: For they themselves show of us what manner of entrance we had to you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

column.name: text
column.value: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, {even} Jesus, who delivered us from the wrath to come.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

column.name: text
column.value: And sent Timothy, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

column.name: text
column.value: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed to this.

column.name: text
column.value: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter may have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

column.name: text
column.value: But now when Timothy came from you to us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also {to see} you:

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brethren, by your faith we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress:

column.name: text
column.value: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;

column.name: text
column.value: Night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

column.name: text
column.value: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all {men}, even as we {do} toward you:

column.name: text
column.value: To the end he may establish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye then were raised with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

column.name: text
column.value: When Christ, {who is} our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; immorality, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

column.name: text
column.value: For which things' the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

column.name: text
column.value: In which ye also walked once, when ye lived with them.

column.name: text
column.value: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Lie not one to another, seeing ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

column.name: text
column.value: And have put on the new {man}, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

column.name: text
column.value: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond {nor} free: but Christ {is} all, and in all.

column.name: text
column.value: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, tender mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

column.name: text
column.value: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man hath a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also {do} ye.

column.name: text
column.value: And above all these things {put on} charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

column.name: text
column.value: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever ye do in word or deed, {do} all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

column.name: text
column.value: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Husbands, love {your} wives, and be not bitter against them.

column.name: text
column.value: Children, obey {your} parents in all things: for this is well pleasing to the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Fathers, provoke not your children {to anger}, lest they be discouraged.

column.name: text
column.value: Servants, obey in all things {your} masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever ye do, do {it} heartily, as to the Lord, and not to men;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that from the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

column.name: text
column.value: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance to you, that it was not in vain:

column.name: text
column.value: But even after we had suffered before, and were shamefully treated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God with much contention.

column.name: text
column.value: For our exhortation {was} not from deceit, nor from uncleanness, nor in guile:

column.name: text
column.value: But as we were allowed by God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who trieth our hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God {is} witness:

column.name: text
column.value: Nor from men sought we glory, neither from you, nor {yet} from others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

column.name: text
column.value: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted to you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear to us.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and toil: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable to any of you, we preached to you the gospel of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye {are} witnesses, and God {also}, how devoutly and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

column.name: text
column.value: As ye know how we exhorted and encouraged and charged each one of you, as a father {doth} his children,

column.name: text
column.value: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you into his kingdom and glory.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause also we thank God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard from us, ye received {it} not {as} the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things from your own countrymen, even as they {have} from the Jews:

column.name: text
column.value: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

column.name: text
column.value: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

column.name: text
column.value: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we would have come to you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

column.name: text
column.value: For what {is} our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? {Are} not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

column.name: text
column.value: For ye are our glory and joy.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort {you} by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received from us how ye ought to walk and to please God, {so} ye would abound more and more.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the will of God, {even} your sanctification, that ye should abstain from immorality:

column.name: text
column.value: That each one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

column.name: text
column.value: Not in the lust of passion, even as the Gentiles who know not God:

column.name: text
column.value: That no {man} go beyond and defraud his brother in {any} matter: because the Lord {is} the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

column.name: text
column.value: For God hath not called us to uncleanness, but to holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given to us his Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But concerning brotherly love ye need not that I write to you: for ye yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren who are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

column.name: text
column.value: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are outside {the church}, and {that} ye may have need of nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them who are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others who have no hope.

column.name: text
column.value: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also who sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

column.name: text
column.value: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive {and} remain to the coming of the Lord shall not precede them who are asleep.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

column.name: text
column.value: Then we who are alive {and} remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is befitting, because your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of each one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

column.name: text
column.value: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

column.name: text
column.value: {Which is} a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing {it is} a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

column.name: text
column.value: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

column.name: text
column.value: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

column.name: text
column.value: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired by all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed ) in that day.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of {this} calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of {his} goodness, and the work of faith with power:

column.name: text
column.value: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write to you.

column.name: text
column.value: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are all children of light, and children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let us not sleep, as {do} others; but let us watch and be sober minded.

column.name: text
column.value: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that get drunk are drunk in the night.

column.name: text
column.value: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

column.name: text
column.value: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

column.name: text
column.value: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them who labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

column.name: text
column.value: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. {And} be at peace among yourselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: See that none render evil for evil to any {man}; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all {men}.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray without ceasing.

column.name: text
column.value: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

column.name: text
column.value: Quench not the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: Despise not prophesyings.

column.name: text
column.value: Examine all things; hold fast that which is good.

column.name: text
column.value: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and {I pray God} your whole spirit and soul and body may be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Faithful {is} he that calleth you, who also will do {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, pray for us.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

column.name: text
column.value: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read to all the holy brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you. Amen. {{The first {epistle} to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and {by} our gathering together to him,

column.name: text
column.value: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ has come.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man deceive you by any means: for {that day shall not come}, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

column.name: text
column.value: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

column.name: text
column.value: And now ye know what restraineth that he might be revealed in his time.

column.name: text
column.value: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now restraineth {will do so}, until he be taken out of the way.

column.name: text
column.value: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

column.name: text
column.value: {Even him}, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

column.name: text
column.value: And with all deception of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

column.name: text
column.value: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

column.name: text
column.value: That they all may be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brethren beloved by the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

column.name: text
column.value: To which he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

column.name: text
column.value: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, who hath loved us, and hath given {us} everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

column.name: text
column.value: Comfort your hearts, and establish you in every good word and work.

column.name: text
column.value: Masters, give to {your} servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

column.name: text
column.value: At the same time praying also for us, that God would open to us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

column.name: text
column.value: That I may make it clear, as I ought to speak.

column.name: text
column.value: Walk in wisdom toward them that are outside {the church}, redeeming the time.

column.name: text
column.value: Let your speech {be} always with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

column.name: text
column.value: All my state shall Tychicus declare to you, {who is} a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that he may know your circumstances, and comfort your hearts;

column.name: text
column.value: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is {one} of you. They shall make known to you all things which {are done} here.

column.name: text
column.value: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner greeteth you, and Mark, sister's son to Barnabas, (concerning whom ye received commandments: if he should come to you, receive him;)

column.name: text
column.value: And Jesus, who is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only {are my} fellowworkers to the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Epaphras, who is {one} of you, a servant of Christ, greeteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For I bear him witness, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them {that are} in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

column.name: text
column.value: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet the brethren who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

column.name: text
column.value: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the {epistle} from Laodicea.

column.name: text
column.value: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

column.name: text
column.value: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace {be} with you. Amen. {{Written from Rome to Colossians by Tychicus and Onesimus.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have {free} course, and be glorified, even as {it is} with you:

column.name: text
column.value: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all {men} have not faith.

column.name: text
column.value: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and keep {you} from evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received from us.

column.name: text
column.value: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nothing; but wrought with labour and toil night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

column.name: text
column.value: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an example to you to follow us.

column.name: text
column.value: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

column.name: text
column.value: For we hear that there are some who walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

column.name: text
column.value: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man obeyeth not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet count {him} not as an enemy, but admonish {him} as a brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord {be} with you all.

column.name: text
column.value: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen. {{The second {epistle} to the Thessalonians was written from Athens.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, {who is} our hope;

column.name: text
column.value: To Timothy, {my} own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

column.name: text
column.value: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: {so do}.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and {of} a good conscience, and {of} a sincere faith:

column.name: text
column.value: From which some having swerved have turned aside to vain talking;

column.name: text
column.value: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor concerning what they affirm.

column.name: text
column.value: But we know that the law {is} good, if a man useth it lawfully;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

column.name: text
column.value: For immoral men, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for kidnappers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there is any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

column.name: text
column.value: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

column.name: text
column.value: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

column.name: text
column.value: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and an insolent man: but I obtained mercy, because I did {it} ignorantly in unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

column.name: text
column.value: However for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them who should believe on him to life everlasting.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, God the only wise, {be} honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: This charge I commit to thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies made before concerning thee, that thou by them mayest war a good warfare;

column.name: text
column.value: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered to Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

column.name: text
column.value: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, {and} giving of thanks, be made for all men;

column.name: text
column.value: For kings, and {for} all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

column.name: text
column.value: For this {is} good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

column.name: text
column.value: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For {there is} one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

column.name: text
column.value: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

column.name: text
column.value: For which I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, {and} lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

column.name: text
column.value: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

column.name: text
column.value: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with reverence and sobriety; not with braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

column.name: text
column.value: But (which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

column.name: text
column.value: But I permit not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

column.name: text
column.value: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

column.name: text
column.value: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

column.name: text
column.value: However she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} a true saying, If a man desireth the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

column.name: text
column.value: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober minded, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

column.name: text
column.value: Not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

column.name: text
column.value: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

column.name: text
column.value: (For if a man knoweth not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

column.name: text
column.value: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he must have a good report of them who are outside {the church}; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise {must} the deacons {be} grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy for money;

column.name: text
column.value: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

column.name: text
column.value: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being {found} blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so {must their} wives {be} grave, not slanderers, sober minded, faithful in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

column.name: text
column.value: For they that have used the office of a deacon well, purchase to themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: These things I write to thee, hoping to come to thee shortly:

column.name: text
column.value: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen by angels, preached to the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

column.name: text
column.value: Rebuke not an elder, but exhort {him} as a father; {and} the younger men as brethren;

column.name: text
column.value: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

column.name: text
column.value: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: But if any widow hath children or nephews, let them learn first to show piety at home, and to repay their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

column.name: text
column.value: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: And these things command, that they may be blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: But if any provideth not for his own, and especially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

column.name: text
column.value: Let not a widow be taken into the number under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

column.name: text
column.value: Well reported of for good works; if she hath brought up children, if she hath lodged strangers, if she hath washed the saints' feet, if she hath relieved the afflicted, if she hath diligently followed every good work.

column.name: text
column.value: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to grow wanton against Christ, they will marry;

column.name: text
column.value: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

column.name: text
column.value: And at the same time they learn {to be} idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

column.name: text
column.value: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, rule the house, give no occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

column.name: text
column.value: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man or woman that believeth hath widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the grain. And, The labourer {is} worthy of his reward.

column.name: text
column.value: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

column.name: text
column.value: I charge {thee} before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

column.name: text
column.value: Lay hands hastily on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

column.name: text
column.value: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thy frequent infirmities.

column.name: text
column.value: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some {men} they follow after.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also the good works {of some} are clearly evident beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of demons;

column.name: text
column.value: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

column.name: text
column.value: Forbidding to marry, {and commanding} to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving by them who believe and know the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For every creature of God {is} good, and nothing to be refused, if it is received with thanksgiving:

column.name: text
column.value: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: If thou shalt put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished by the words of faith and of good doctrine, to which thou hast attained.

column.name: text
column.value: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself {rather} to godliness.

column.name: text
column.value: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

column.name: text
column.value: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, especially of those that believe.

column.name: text
column.value: These things command and teach.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conduct, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

column.name: text
column.value: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

column.name: text
column.value: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed to thyself, and to thy doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: To Timothy, {my} dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank God, whom I serve from {my} forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

column.name: text
column.value: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

column.name: text
column.value: When I call to remembrance the sincere faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that {is} in thee also.

column.name: text
column.value: For which cause I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the laying on of my hands.

column.name: text
column.value: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Who hath saved us, and called {us} with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

column.name: text
column.value: But has now been revealed by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

column.name: text
column.value: To which I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: For which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed to him until that day.

column.name: text
column.value: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: That good thing which was committed to thee keep by the Holy Spirit who dwelleth in us.

column.name: text
column.value: This thou knowest, that all they who are in Asia are turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus; for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

column.name: text
column.value: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found {me}.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered to me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

column.name: text
column.value: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and {his} doctrine may not be blasphemed.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise {them}, because they are brethren; but rather do {them} service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man teacheth otherwise, and agreeth not to wholesome words, {even} the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the doctrine which is according to godliness;

column.name: text
column.value: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, from which cometh envy, strife, railings, evil suspicions,

column.name: text
column.value: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing gain to be godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

column.name: text
column.value: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

column.name: text
column.value: For we brought nothing into {this} world, {and it is} certain we can carry nothing out.

column.name: text
column.value: And having food and raiment with these let us be content.

column.name: text
column.value: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and {into} many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

column.name: text
column.value: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some have coveted, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou, O man of God, flee from these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

column.name: text
column.value: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

column.name: text
column.value: I command thee in the sight of God, who maketh alive all things, and {before} Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

column.name: text
column.value: That thou keep {this} commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Who in his times he shall show, {who is} the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

column.name: text
column.value: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom {be} honour and power everlasting. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

column.name: text
column.value: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to share;

column.name: text
