column.value: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane {and} vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

column.name: text
column.value: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace {be} with thee. Amen. {{The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And the things that thou hast heard from me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of {this} life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

column.name: text
column.value: And if a man also striveth for masteries, {yet} is he not crowned, except he striveth lawfully.

column.name: text
column.value: The farmer that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

column.name: text
column.value: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

column.name: text
column.value: In which I suffer trouble, as an evildoer, {even} to bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} a faithful saying: For if we are dead with {him}, we shall also live with {him}:

column.name: text
column.value: If we suffer, we shall also reign with {him}: if we deny {him}, he also will deny us:

column.name: text
column.value: If we believe not, {yet} he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

column.name: text
column.value: Of these things put {them} in remembrance, charging {them} before the Lord that they contend not about words to no profit, {but} to the subverting of the hearers.

column.name: text
column.value: Study to show thyself approved to God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

column.name: text
column.value: But shun profane {and} vain babblings: for they will increase to more ungodliness.

column.name: text
column.value: And their word will eat as doth a gangrene: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

column.name: text
column.value: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth firm, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

column.name: text
column.value: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man therefore will cleanse himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honour, sanctified, and fit for the master's use, {and} prepared to every good work.

column.name: text
column.value: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

column.name: text
column.value: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they produce quarrels.

column.name: text
column.value: And the servant of the Lord must not quarrel; but be gentle to all {men}, apt to teach, patient,

column.name: text
column.value: In meekness instructing those that oppose him; if God perhaps will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

column.name: text
column.value: And {that} they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

column.name: text
column.value: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

column.name: text
column.value: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

column.name: text
column.value: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

column.name: text
column.value: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Having a form of godliness, but denying its power: from such turn away.

column.name: text
column.value: For of this sort are they who creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with various lusts,

column.name: text
column.value: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, rejected as concerning the faith.

column.name: text
column.value: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be evident to all {men}, as theirs also was.

column.name: text
column.value: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

column.name: text
column.value: Persecutions, afflictions, which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of {them} all the Lord delivered me.

column.name: text
column.value: And, all indeed that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

column.name: text
column.value: But evil men and seducers shall become worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

column.name: text
column.value: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing from whom thou hast learned {them};

column.name: text
column.value: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: All scripture {is} given by inspiration of God, and {is} profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

column.name: text
column.value: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished to all good works.

column.name: text
column.value: I charge {thee} therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

column.name: text
column.value: Preach the word; be diligent in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap up to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall turn away {their} ears from the truth, and shall be turned to fables.

column.name: text
column.value: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: I have fought a good fight, I have finished {my} course, I have kept the faith:

column.name: text
column.value: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but to all them also that love his appearing.

column.name: text
column.value: Do thy diligence to come shortly to me:

column.name: text
column.value: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and hath departed to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

column.name: text
column.value: Luke only is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

column.name: text
column.value: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring {with thee}, and the books, {but} especially the parchments.

column.name: text
column.value: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom beware thou also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

column.name: text
column.value: At my first defence no man stood with me, but all {men} forsook me: {I pray God} that it may not be laid to their charge.

column.name: text
column.value: However the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and {that} all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve {me} to his heavenly kingdom: to whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

column.name: text
column.value: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus I have left at Miletum sick.

column.name: text
column.value: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord Jesus Christ {be} with thy spirit. Grace {be} with you. Amen. {{The second {epistle} to Timothy, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.}}

column.name: text
column.value: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

column.name: text
column.value: That the aged men be sober minded, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

column.name: text
column.value: The aged women likewise, that {they be} in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

column.name: text
column.value: That they may teach the young women to be sober minded, to love their husbands, to love their children,

column.name: text
column.value: {To be} discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

column.name: text
column.value: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

column.name: text
column.value: In all things showing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine {showing} integrity, gravity, sincerity,

column.name: text
column.value: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say concerning you.

column.name: text
column.value: {Exhort} servants to be obedient to their own masters, {and} to please {them} well in all {things}; not answering again;

column.name: text
column.value: Not pilfering, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

column.name: text
column.value: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

column.name: text
column.value: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

column.name: text
column.value: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify to himself {his own} special people, zealous of good works.

column.name: text
column.value: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

column.name: text
column.value: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, {but} gentle, showing all meekness to all men.

column.name: text
column.value: For we ourselves also were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, {and} hating one another.

column.name: text
column.value: But when the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

column.name: text
column.value: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Spirit;

column.name: text
column.value: Whom he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

column.name: text
column.value: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: {This is} a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they who have believed in God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.

column.name: text
column.value: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

column.name: text
column.value: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that he who is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned by himself.

column.name: text
column.value: When I shall send Artemas to thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

column.name: text
column.value: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing may be wanting to them.

column.name: text
column.value: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.

column.name: text
column.value: All that are with me greet thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace {be} with you all. Amen. {{It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is according to godliness;

column.name: text
column.value: In hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before the world began;

column.name: text
column.value: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed to me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

column.name: text
column.value: To Titus, {my} own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

column.name: text
column.value: For this cause I left thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

column.name: text
column.value: If any is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of dissipation or rebellion.

column.name: text
column.value: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money;

column.name: text
column.value: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober minded, just, holy, temperate;

column.name: text
column.value: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convict {those who} contradict.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are many rebellious and vain talkers and deceivers, especially they of the circumcision:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for the sake of dishonest gain.

column.name: text
column.value: One of themselves, {even} a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians {are} always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.

column.name: text
column.value: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

column.name: text
column.value: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: To the pure all things {are} pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving {is} nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

column.name: text
column.value: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny {him}, being abominable, and disobedient, and to every good work disqualified.

column.name: text
column.value: God, who at many times and in many ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,

column.name: text
column.value: Hath in these last days spoken to us by {his} Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

column.name: text
column.value: Who being the brightness of {his} glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

column.name: text
column.value: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

column.name: text
column.value: For to which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

column.name: text
column.value: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

column.name: text
column.value: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: But to the Son {he saith}, Thy throne, O God, {is} for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness {is} the sceptre of thy kingdom.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, {even} thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy companions.

column.name: text
column.value: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thy hands:

column.name: text
column.value: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall become old as doth a garment;

column.name: text
column.value: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

column.name: text
column.value: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thy enemies thy footstool?

column.name: text
column.value: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall inherit salvation?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let {them} slip.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

column.name: text
column.value: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by them that heard {him};

column.name: text
column.value: God also bearing {them} witness, both with signs and wonders, and with various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

column.name: text
column.value: For to the angels he hath not put in subjection the world to come, concerning which we speak.

column.name: text
column.value: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

column.name: text
column.value: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou didst crown him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing {that is} not made subject to him. But now we see not yet all things made subject to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

column.name: text
column.value: For it was befitting for him, for whom {are} all things, and by whom {are} all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

column.name: text
column.value: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified {are} all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, I will declare thy name to my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise to thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

column.name: text
column.value: Since then the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

column.name: text
column.value: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: For verily he took not on {him the nature of} angels; but he took on {him} the seed of Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore in all things it behoved him to be made like {his} brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things {pertaining} to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

column.name: text
column.value: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to help them that are tempted.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

column.name: text
column.value: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses {was faithful} in all his house.

column.name: text
column.value: For this {man} was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath built the house hath more honour than the house.

column.name: text
column.value: For every house is built by some {man}; but he that built all things {is} God.

column.name: text
column.value: And Moses verily {was} faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken later;

column.name: text
column.value: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore (as the Holy Spirit saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

column.name: text
column.value: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

column.name: text
column.value: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always err in {their} heart; and they have not known my ways.

column.name: text
column.value: So I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

column.name: text
column.value: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

column.name: text
column.value: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end;

column.name: text
column.value: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

column.name: text
column.value: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: yet not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

column.name: text
column.value: But with whom was he grieved forty years? {was it} not with them that had sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

column.name: text
column.value: And to whom did he swear that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

column.name: text
column.value: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left {us} of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

column.name: text
column.value: For to us was the gospel preached, as well as to them: but the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: For we who have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: For he spoke in a certain place of the seventh {day} on this wise, And God rested the seventh day from all his works.

column.name: text
column.value: And in this {place} again, If they shall enter into my rest.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter into it, and they to whom it was first preached entered not because of unbelief:

column.name: text
column.value: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

column.name: text
column.value: For if Joshua had given them rest, then he would not afterward have spoken of another day.

column.name: text
column.value: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that hath entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God {did} from his.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

column.name: text
column.value: For the word of God {is} living, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and {is} a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

column.name: text
column.value: Neither is there any creature that is hidden in his sight: but all things {are} naked and opened to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that hath passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast {our} profession.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have not an high priest who cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but who was in all points tempted as {we are, yet} without sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

column.name: text
column.value: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things {pertaining} to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

column.name: text
column.value: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is beset with infirmity.

column.name: text
column.value: And by reason of it he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

column.name: text
column.value: And no man taketh this honour to himself, but he that is called by God, as {was} Aaron.

column.name: text
column.value: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said to him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

column.name: text
column.value: As he saith also in another {place}, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears to him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

column.name: text
column.value: Though he was a Son, yet he learned obedience by the things which he suffered;

column.name: text
column.value: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation to all them that obey him;

column.name: text
column.value: Called by God an high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

column.name: text
column.value: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need of one to teach you again which {are} the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

column.name: text
column.value: For every one that useth milk {is} unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

column.name: text
column.value: But solid food belongeth to them that are of full age, {even} those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy {our} brother, to Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

column.name: text
column.value: And to {our} beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

column.name: text
column.value: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

column.name: text
column.value: That the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the hearts of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, though I might be very bold in Christ to command thee what is befitting,

column.name: text
column.value: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech {thee}, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

column.name: text
column.value: Who in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, my own heart:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the gospel:

column.name: text
column.value: But without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

column.name: text
column.value: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

column.name: text
column.value: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, especially to me, but how much more to thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

column.name: text
column.value: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

column.name: text
column.value: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth {thee} any thing, put that on my account;

column.name: text
column.value: I Paul have written {it} with my own hand, I will repay {it}: although I do not say to thee that thou owest to me even thy own self besides.

column.name: text
column.value: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote to thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

column.name: text
column.value: But at the same time prepare for me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given to you.

column.name: text
column.value: There greet thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

column.name: text
column.value: Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellowlabourers.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with your spirit. Amen. {{Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus a servant.}}

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on to perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

column.name: text
column.value: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of the resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: And this will we do, if God permit.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} impossible for those who have been once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and have been made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,

column.name: text
column.value: If they shall fall away, to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put {him} to an open shame.

column.name: text
column.value: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh often upon it, and bringeth forth herbs useful for them by whom it is tilled, receiveth blessing from God:

column.name: text
column.value: But that which beareth thorns and briers {is} rejected, and {is} close to being cursed; whose end {is} to be burned.

column.name: text
column.value: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

column.name: text
column.value: For God {is} not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shown toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

column.name: text
column.value: And we desire each one of you to show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope to the end:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

column.name: text
column.value: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he swore by himself,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

column.name: text
column.value: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation {is} to them an end of every dispute.

column.name: text
column.value: In the same way God, willing more abundantly to show to the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed {it} by an oath:

column.name: text
column.value: That by two immutable things, in which {it was} impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

column.name: text
column.value: Which {hope} we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and {one} which entereth into that within the veil;

column.name: text
column.value: Where the forerunner hath for us entered, {even} Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

column.name: text
column.value: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

column.name: text
column.value: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

column.name: text
column.value: Now consider how great this man {was}, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

column.name: text
column.value: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, from their brethren, though they come from the loins of Abraham:

column.name: text
column.value: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes from Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

column.name: text
column.value: And without any dispute the less is blessed by the better.

column.name: text
column.value: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he {receiveth them}, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: And as I may say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

column.name: text
column.value: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchizedek met him.

column.name: text
column.value: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need {was there} that another priest should rise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

column.name: text
column.value: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} evident that our Lord sprang from Judah; of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchizedek there ariseth another priest,

column.name: text
column.value: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

column.name: text
column.value: For he testifieth, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

column.name: text
column.value: For there is verily a setting aside of the former commandment on account of its weakness and unprofitableness.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope {did}; by which we draw near to God.

column.name: text
column.value: And inasmuch as not without an oath {he was made priest}:

column.name: text
column.value: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said to him, The Lord swore and will not repent, Thou {art} a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek:)

column.name: text
column.value: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

column.name: text
column.value: And they truly were many priests, because they were not allowed to continue by reason of death:

column.name: text
column.value: But this {man}, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come to God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

column.name: text
column.value: For such an high priest was befitting for us, {who is} holy, blameless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

column.name: text
column.value: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law maketh men high priests who have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was after the law, {maketh} the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

column.name: text
column.value: Now of the things which we have spoken {this is} the sum: We have such an high priest, who is seated on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

column.name: text
column.value: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

column.name: text
column.value: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices: therefore {it is} of necessity that this man should have somewhat also to offer.

column.name: text
column.value: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

column.name: text
column.value: Who serve to the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished by God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, {that} thou make all things according to the pattern shown to thee in the mount.

column.name: text
column.value: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

column.name: text
column.value: For if that first {covenant} had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

column.name: text
column.value: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

column.name: text
column.value: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: For this {is} the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

column.name: text
column.value: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

column.name: text
column.value: In that he saith, A new {covenant}, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and groweth old {is} ready to vanish away.

column.name: text
column.value: Then verily the first {covenant} had also ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, in which {was} the lampstand, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the sanctuary.

column.name: text
column.value: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

column.name: text
column.value: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which {was} the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

column.name: text
column.value: And over it the cherubim of glory shadowing the mercy seat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

column.name: text
column.value: Now when these things were thus prepared, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service {of God}.

column.name: text
column.value: But into the second {went} the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and {for} the errors of the people:

column.name: text
column.value: The Holy Spirit thus signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet revealed, while the first tabernacle was yet standing:

column.name: text
column.value: Which {was} a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

column.name: text
column.value: {Which stood} only in meats and drinks, and various washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed {on them} until the time of reformation.

column.name: text
column.value: But Christ became an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption {for us}.

column.name: text
column.value: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctify to the purifying of the flesh:

column.name: text
column.value: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

column.name: text
column.value: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions {that were} under the first testament, they who are called may receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

column.name: text
column.value: For where a testament {is}, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

column.name: text
column.value: For a testament {is} of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

column.name: text
column.value: Hence even the first {testament} was not dedicated without blood.

column.name: text
column.value: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, This {is} the blood of the testament which God hath commanded you.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover he sprinkled likewise with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

column.name: text
column.value: And almost all things are by the law cleansed with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

column.name: text
column.value: {It was} therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ hath not entered into the holy places made with hands, {which are} the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

column.name: text
column.value: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

column.name: text
column.value: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And as it is appointed to men once to die, but after this the judgment:

column.name: text
column.value: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and to them that look for him he shall appear the second time without sin to salvation.

column.name: text
column.value: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, {and} not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers to {them} perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once cleansed should have had no more conscience of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: But in those {sacrifices there is} a remembrance again {made} of sins every year.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

column.name: text
column.value: In burnt offerings and {sacrifices} for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

column.name: text
column.value: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

column.name: text
column.value: Before when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and {offering} for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure {in them}; which are offered by the law;

column.name: text
column.value: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

column.name: text
column.value: By that will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once {for all}.

column.name: text
column.value: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

column.name: text
column.value: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

column.name: text
column.value: From henceforth waiting till his enemies are made his footstool.

column.name: text
column.value: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

column.name: text
column.value: {Of this} the Holy Spirit also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

column.name: text
column.value: This {is} the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

column.name: text
column.value: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

column.name: text
column.value: Now where remission of these {is, there is} no more offering for sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

column.name: text
column.value: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

column.name: text
column.value: And {having} an high priest over the house of God;

column.name: text
column.value: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us hold fast the profession of {our} faith without wavering; (for he {is} faithful that promised;)

column.name: text
column.value: And let us consider one another to stir up to love and to good works:

column.name: text
column.value: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves, as the manner of some {is}; but exhorting {one another}: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

column.name: text
column.value: For if we sin wilfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

column.name: text
column.value: But a certain fearful expectation of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

column.name: text
column.value: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

column.name: text
column.value: Of how much more severe punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, by which he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite to the Spirit of grace?

column.name: text
column.value: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance {belongeth} to me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

column.name: text
column.value: {It is} a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

column.name: text
column.value: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

column.name: text
column.value: Partly, while ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, while ye became companions of them that were so used.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the plundering of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

column.name: text
column.value: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye may receive the promise.

column.name: text
column.value: For yet a little while, and he that is coming will come, and will not tarry.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the just shall live by faith: but if {any man} shall draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But we are not of them who draw back to perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

column.name: text
column.value: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

column.name: text
column.value: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

column.name: text
column.value: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which are visible.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained the testimony that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

column.name: text
column.value: But without faith {it is} impossible to please {him}: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and {that} he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Noah, being warned by God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when he was called to move into a place which he should later receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing where he was going.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as {in} a foreign country, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

column.name: text
column.value: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker {is} God.

column.name: text
column.value: Through faith also Sarah herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore there sprang even from one, and him as good as dead, {so many} as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

column.name: text
column.value: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of {them}, and embraced {them}, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

column.name: text
column.value: And truly, if they had been mindful of that {country} from which they came, they might have had opportunity to return.

column.name: text
column.value: But now they desire a better {country}, that is, an heavenly: therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten {son},

column.name: text
column.value: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

column.name: text
column.value: Accounting that God {was} able to raise {him} up, even from the dead; from which also he received him in a figure.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, {leaning} upon the top of his staff.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months by his parents, because they saw {he was} a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith Moses, when he had come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

column.name: text
column.value: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

column.name: text
column.value: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt: for he had respect to the recompence of the reward.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

column.name: text
column.value: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry {land}: which the Egyptians trying to do were drowned.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

column.name: text
column.value: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, after she had received the spies with peace.

column.name: text
column.value: And what more shall I say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gideon, and {of} Barak, and {of} Samson, and {of} Jephthah; {of} David also, and Samuel, and {of} the prophets:

column.name: text
column.value: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

column.name: text
column.value: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

column.name: text
column.value: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

column.name: text
column.value: And others had trial of {cruel} mockings and scourgings, and, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

column.name: text
column.value: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

column.name: text
column.value: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and {in} mountains, and {in} dens and caves of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

column.name: text
column.value: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore seeing we also are surrounded with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset {us}, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

column.name: text
column.value: Looking to Jesus the author and finisher of {our} faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For consider him that endured such hostility by sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh to you as to children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked by him:

column.name: text
column.value: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye are without chastisement, of which all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

column.name: text
column.value: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh who corrected {us}, and we gave {them} reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

column.name: text
column.value: For they verily for a few days chastened {us} after their own pleasure; but he for {our} profit, that {we} might be partakers of his holiness.

column.name: text
column.value: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness to them who are exercised by it.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

column.name: text
column.value: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

column.name: text
column.value: Follow peace with all {men}, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble {you}, and by it many be defiled;

column.name: text
column.value: Lest there {be} any immoral, or profane person, as Esau, who for one meal sold his birthright.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye know that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye are not come to the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor to blackness, and to darkness, and tempest,

column.name: text
column.value: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which {voice} they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

column.name: text
column.value: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with an arrow:

column.name: text
column.value: And so terrible was the sight, {that} Moses said, I exceedingly fear and tremble:)

column.name: text
column.value: But ye are come to mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

column.name: text
column.value: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, who are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

column.name: text
column.value: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than {that of} Abel.

column.name: text
column.value: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spoke on earth, much more {shall not} we {escape}, if we turn away from him that {speaketh} from heaven:

column.name: text
column.value: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And this {word}, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

column.name: text
column.value: For our God {is} a consuming fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Let brotherly love continue.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for by this some have entertained angels unawares.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; {and} them who suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

column.name: text
column.value: Marriage {is} honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

column.name: text
column.value: {Let your} manner of life {be} without covetousness; {and be} content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

column.name: text
column.value: So that we may boldly say, The Lord {is} my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember them who have the rule over you, who have spoken to you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of {their} manner of life.

column.name: text
column.value: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Be not carried about with various and strange doctrines. For {it is} a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied in them.

column.name: text
column.value: We have an altar, of which they have no right to eat who serve the tabernacle.

column.name: text
column.value: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered outside the gate.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us go forth therefore to him outside the camp, bearing his reproach.

column.name: text
column.value: For here we have no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

column.name: text
column.value: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of {our} lips giving thanks to his name.

column.name: text
column.value: But to do good and to share forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that {is} unprofitable for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

column.name: text
column.value: But I beseech {you} the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

column.name: text
column.value: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

column.name: text
column.value: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom {be} glory for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beseech you, brethren, bear with this word of exhortation: for I have written a letter to you in few words.

column.name: text
column.value: Know ye that {our} brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy greet you.

column.name: text
column.value: Grace {be} with you all. Amen. {{Written to the Hebrews from Italy, by Timothy.}}

column.name: text
column.value: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, {the Lord} of glory, with respect of persons.

column.name: text
column.value: For if there come into your assembly a man with a gold ring, in fine apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

column.name: text
column.value: And ye have respect to him that weareth the fine clothing, and say to him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

column.name: text
column.value: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

column.name: text
column.value: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

column.name: text
column.value: Do they not blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

column.name: text
column.value: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convicted by the law as transgressors.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one {point}, he is guilty of all.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou committest no adultery, yet if thou killest, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

column.name: text
column.value: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shown no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: What {doth it} profit, my brethren, though a man saith he hath faith, and hath not works? can faith save him?

column.name: text
column.value: If a brother or sister is naked, and destitute of daily food,

column.name: text
column.value: And one of you saith to them, Depart in peace, be {ye} warmed and filled; but ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what {doth it} profit?

column.name: text
column.value: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

column.name: text
column.value: But, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: show me thy faith without thy works, and I will show thee my faith by my works.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the demons also believe, and tremble.

column.name: text
column.value: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

column.name: text
column.value: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

column.name: text
column.value: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

column.name: text
column.value: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed to him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye see then that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent {them} out another way?

column.name: text
column.value: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

column.name: text
column.value: From where {come} wars and fightings among you? {come they} not from this, {even} from your lusts that war in your members?

column.name: text
column.value: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume {it} upon your lusts.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?

column.name: text
column.value: But he giveth more grace. Therefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

column.name: text
column.value: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse {your} hands, {ye} sinners; and purify {your} hearts, {ye} double minded.

column.name: text
column.value: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and {your} joy to heaviness.

column.name: text
column.value: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

column.name: text
column.value: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of {his} brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judgest the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

column.name: text
column.value: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

column.name: text
column.value: Come now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

column.name: text
column.value: Though ye know not what {shall be} to morrow. For what {is} your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

column.name: text
column.value: Instead of that ye {ought} to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

column.name: text
column.value: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth {it} not, to him it is sin.

column.name: text
column.value: My brethren, be not many teachers, knowing that we shall receive the greater judgment.

column.name: text
column.value: For in many things we all offend. If any man stumble not in word, the same {is} a perfect man, able also to bridle the whole body.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold also the ships, which though {they are} so great, and {are} driven by fierce winds, yet they are turned about with a very small helm, wherever the pilot willeth.

column.name: text
column.value: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

column.name: text
column.value: And the tongue {is} a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire from hell.

column.name: text
column.value: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of creatures in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed by mankind:

column.name: text
column.value: But the tongue can no man tame; {it is} an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

column.name: text
column.value: With it we bless God, even the Father; and with it we curse men, who are made after the similitude of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

column.name: text
column.value: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet {water} and bitter?

column.name: text
column.value: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? or a vine, figs? so no fountain {can} yield both salt water and fresh.

column.name: text
column.value: Who {is} a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him show by a good behaviour his works with meekness of wisdom.

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but {is} earthly, sensual, demonic.

column.name: text
column.value: For where envying and strife {is}, there {is} confusion and every evil work.

column.name: text
column.value: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, {and} reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by them that make peace.

column.name: text
column.value: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes who are scattered abroad, greeting.

column.name: text
column.value: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into various temptations;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing {this}, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

column.name: text
column.value: But let patience have {her} perfect work, that ye may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing.

column.name: text
column.value: If any of you lacketh wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all {men} liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given to him.

column.name: text
column.value: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

column.name: text
column.value: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing from the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: A double minded man {is} unstable in all his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

column.name: text
column.value: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

column.name: text
column.value: For the sun hath no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and its flower falleth, and the grace of its fashion perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

column.name: text
column.value: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted by God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

column.name: text
column.value: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

column.name: text
column.value: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

column.name: text
column.value: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

column.name: text
column.value: Of his own will he hath begotten us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

column.name: text
column.value: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore put away all filthiness and all that remains of wickedness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

column.name: text
column.value: For if any is a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like a man beholding his natural face in a mirror:

column.name: text
column.value: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth away, and immediately forgetteth what manner of man he was.

column.name: text
column.value: But he who looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth {in it}, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man among you seemeth to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion {is} vain.

column.name: text
column.value: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, {and} to keep himself unspotted from the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Come now, {ye} rich men, weep and wail for your miseries that shall come upon {you}.

column.name: text
column.value: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
