column.name: text
column.value: Your gold and silver is rusted; and its rust shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped up treasure for the last days.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped your fields, which is by you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them who have reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Hosts.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye have condemned {and} killed the just; {and} he doth not resist you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receiveth the early and the latter rain.

column.name: text
column.value: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth near.

column.name: text
column.value: Murmur not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

column.name: text
column.value: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, we count them happy who endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and {your} nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

column.name: text
column.value: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any cheerful? let him sing psalms.

column.name: text
column.value: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

column.name: text
column.value: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he hath committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

column.name: text
column.value: Confess {your} faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of the righteous man availeth much.

column.name: text
column.value: Elijah was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

column.name: text
column.value: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, if any one of you should err from the truth, and one should convert him;

column.name: text
column.value: Let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

column.name: text
column.value: As newborn babes, desire the pure milk of the word, that ye may grow by it:

column.name: text
column.value: If indeed ye have tasted that the Lord {is} gracious.

column.name: text
column.value: To whom coming, {as to} a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, {and} precious,

column.name: text
column.value: Ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

column.name: text
column.value: To you therefore who believe {he is} precious: but to them who are disobedient, the stone which the builders rejected, the same is made the head of the corner,

column.name: text
column.value: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, {even to them} who stumble at the word, being disobedient: to this also they were appointed.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye {are} a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a special people; that ye should show forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

column.name: text
column.value: Who in time past {were} not a people, but {are} now the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

column.name: text
column.value: Dearly beloved, I beseech {you} as sojourners and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

column.name: text
column.value: Having your behaviour honest among the Gentiles: that, though they speak against you as evildoers, they may by {your} good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

column.name: text
column.value: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

column.name: text
column.value: Or to governors, as to them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

column.name: text
column.value: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

column.name: text
column.value: As free, and not using {your} liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

column.name: text
column.value: Honour all {men}. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

column.name: text
column.value: Servants, {be} subject to {your} masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the perverse.

column.name: text
column.value: For this {is} thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endureth grief, suffering wrongfully.

column.name: text
column.value: For what glory {is it}, if, when ye are buffeted for your faults, ye bear it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer {for it}, ye bear it patiently, this {is} acceptable with God.

column.name: text
column.value: For even to this were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

column.name: text
column.value: Who committed no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

column.name: text
column.value: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed {himself} to him that judgeth righteously:

column.name: text
column.value: Who himself bore our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live to righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

column.name: text
column.value: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned to the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

column.name: text
column.value: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the sojourners scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

column.name: text
column.value: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, to obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you, and peace, be multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {be} the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again to a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

column.name: text
column.value: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

column.name: text
column.value: Who are kept by the power of God through faith to salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

column.name: text
column.value: In this ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through various temptations:

column.name: text
column.value: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though tried with fire, might be found to praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see {him} not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

column.name: text
column.value: Receiving the end of your faith, {even} the salvation of {your} souls.

column.name: text
column.value: Of this salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace {that should come} to you:

column.name: text
column.value: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ who was in them did signify, when he testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

column.name: text
column.value: To whom it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to us they ministered the things, which are now reported to you by them that have preached the gospel to you with the Holy Spirit sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

column.name: text
column.value: But as he who hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all {your} behaviour;

column.name: text
column.value: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

column.name: text
column.value: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning {here} in fear:

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, {as} silver and gold, from your vain way of life {received} by tradition from your fathers;

column.name: text
column.value: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

column.name: text
column.value: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for you,

column.name: text
column.value: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

column.name: text
column.value: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit to a sincere love of the brethren, {see that ye} love one another with a pure heart fervently:

column.name: text
column.value: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: For all flesh {is} as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and its flower falleth away:

column.name: text
column.value: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached to you.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, ye wives, {be} in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the behaviour of the wives;

column.name: text
column.value: While they behold your chaste behaviour {coupled} with fear.

column.name: text
column.value: Whose adorning let it not be that outward {adorning} of arranging the hair, and of wearing gold, or of putting on apparel;

column.name: text
column.value: But {let it be} the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, {even the ornament} of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

column.name: text
column.value: For after this manner in former times the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

column.name: text
column.value: Even as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any terror.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with {them} according to knowledge, giving honour to the wife, as to the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

column.name: text
column.value: Finally, {be ye} all of one mind, having compassion one for another, love as brethren, {be} pitiful, {be} courteous:

column.name: text
column.value: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but on the contrary blessing; knowing that ye are called to this, that ye should inherit a blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him restrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

column.name: text
column.value: Let him turn away from evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and pursue it.

column.name: text
column.value: For the eyes of the Lord {are} over the righteous, and his ears {are open} to their prayers: but the face of the Lord {is} against them that do evil.

column.name: text
column.value: And who {is} he that will harm you, if ye are followers of that which is good?

column.name: text
column.value: But if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy {are ye}: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

column.name: text
column.value: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and {be} ready always to {give} an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

column.name: text
column.value: Having a good conscience; that, though they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good behaviour in Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: For {it is} better, if the will of God is so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

column.name: text
column.value: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive by the Spirit:

column.name: text
column.value: By whom also he went and preached to the spirits in prison;

column.name: text
column.value: Who at one time were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was preparing, in which few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

column.name: text
column.value: The like figure to which {even} baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

column.name: text
column.value: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

column.name: text
column.value: That he no longer should live the rest of {his} time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time past of {our} life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, drinking parties, and abominable idolatries:

column.name: text
column.value: In which they think it strange that ye run not with {them} to the same flood of dissipation, speaking evil of {you}:

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.

column.name: text
column.value: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober minded, and watch to prayer.

column.name: text
column.value: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover a multitude of sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

column.name: text
column.value: As every man hath received the gift, {even so} minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man speaketh, {let him speak} as the oracles of God; if any man ministereth, {let him do it} as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened to you:

column.name: text
column.value: But rejoice, seeing ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, happy {are ye}; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

column.name: text
column.value: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or {as} a thief, or {as} an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet if {any man suffereth} as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

column.name: text
column.value: For the time {is come} that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if {it} first {beginneth} with us, what shall {be} the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?

column.name: text
column.value: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls {to him} in well doing, as to a faithful Creator.

column.name: text
column.value: The elders who are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

column.name: text
column.value: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight {of it}, not by constraint, but willingly; not for dishonest gain, but from a ready mind;

column.name: text
column.value: Neither as being lords over {God's} heritage, but being examples to the flock.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves to the elder. Yea, all {of you} be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

column.name: text
column.value: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

column.name: text
column.value: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

column.name: text
column.value: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

column.name: text
column.value: Whom resist steadfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: But the God of all grace, who hath called us to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, establish, strengthen, settle {you}.

column.name: text
column.value: To him {be} glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: By Silvanus, a faithful brother to you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which ye stand.

column.name: text
column.value: The {church that is} at Babylon, elected together with {you}, greeteth you; and {so doth} Mark my son.

column.name: text
column.value: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace {be} with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

column.name: text
column.value: And through covetousness they shall with deceptive words exploit you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their destruction slumbereth not.

column.name: text
column.value: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast {them} down to hell, and delivered {them} into chains of darkness, to be reserved to judgment;

column.name: text
column.value: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth {person}, a preacher of righteousness, bringing the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

column.name: text
column.value: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned {them} with an overthrow, making {them} an example to those that afterwards should live ungodly lives;

column.name: text
column.value: And delivered just Lot, grieved with the immoral behaviour of the wicked:

column.name: text
column.value: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, tormented {his} righteous soul from day to day with {their} unlawful deeds;)

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust to the day of judgment to be punished:

column.name: text
column.value: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous {are they}, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

column.name: text
column.value: Though angels, who are greater in power and might, bring not a railing accusation against them before the Lord.

column.name: text
column.value: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

column.name: text
column.value: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, {as} they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots {they are} and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

column.name: text
column.value: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: they have an heart exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

column.name: text
column.value: Who have forsaken the right way, and gone astray, following the way of Balaam {the son} of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

column.name: text
column.value: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb donkey speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: For when they speak great swelling {words} of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, {through much} wantonness, those that are just escaping from them who live in error.

column.name: text
column.value: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for by whom a man is overcome, by the same is he brought into bondage.

column.name: text
column.value: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known {it}, to turn from the holy commandment delivered to them.

column.name: text
column.value: But it hath happened to them according to the true proverb, The dog {is} turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

column.name: text
column.value: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

column.name: text
column.value: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

column.name: text
column.value: According as his divine power hath given to us all things that {pertain} to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

column.name: text
column.value: By which are given to us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

column.name: text
column.value: And besides this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

column.name: text
column.value: And to knowledge self-control; and to self-control patience; and to patience godliness;

column.name: text
column.value: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

column.name: text
column.value: For if these things are in you, and abound, they make {you that ye shall} neither {be} barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purified from his old sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

column.name: text
column.value: For so an entrance shall be ministered to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know {them}, and are established in the present truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Indeed, I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting {you} in remembrance;

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing that shortly I must put off {this} my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shown me.

column.name: text
column.value: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

column.name: text
column.value: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

column.name: text
column.value: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

column.name: text
column.value: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him on the holy mount.

column.name: text
column.value: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; to which ye do well that ye take heed, as to a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

column.name: text
column.value: For prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke {as they were} moved by the Holy Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: This second epistle, beloved, I now write to you; in {both} which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

column.name: text
column.value: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as {they were} from the beginning of the creation.

column.name: text
column.value: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

column.name: text
column.value: By which the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

column.name: text
column.value: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved to fire for the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

column.name: text
column.value: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day {is} with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

column.name: text
column.value: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering toward us, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

column.name: text
column.value: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are in it shall be burned up.

column.name: text
column.value: {Seeing} then {that} all these things shall be dissolved, what manner {of persons} ought ye to be in {all} holy conduct and godliness,

column.name: text
column.value: Looking for and hasting to the coming of the day of God, when the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, in which dwelleth righteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found by him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

column.name: text
column.value: And account {that} the longsuffering of our Lord {is} salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given to him hath written to you;

column.name: text
column.value: As also in all {his} epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as {they do} also the other scriptures, to their own destruction.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know {these things} before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own steadfastness.

column.name: text
column.value: But grow in grace, and {in} the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him {be} glory both now and for ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

column.name: text
column.value: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Grace be with you, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

column.name: text
column.value: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is love, that we walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

column.name: text
column.value: For many deceivers have entered into the world, who confess not Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

column.name: text
column.value: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: If any one cometh to you, and bringeth not this doctrine, receive him not into {your} house, neither wish him greetings:

column.name: text
column.value: For he that wisheth him greetings is partaker of his evil deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: Having many things to write to you, I would not {write} with paper and ink: but I trust to come to you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

column.name: text
column.value: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

column.name: text
column.value: By this ye know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ hath come in the flesh is from God:

column.name: text
column.value: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not from God: and this is that {spirit} of antichrist, of which ye have heard that it should come; and even now already it is in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

column.name: text
column.value: They are of the world: therefore they speak from the world, and the world heareth them.

column.name: text
column.value: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is from God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

column.name: text
column.value: In this was revealed the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

column.name: text
column.value: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son {to be} the propitiation for our sins.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

column.name: text
column.value: By this we know that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son {to be} the Saviour of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

column.name: text
column.value: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

column.name: text
column.value: In this is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

column.name: text
column.value: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

column.name: text
column.value: We love him, because he first loved us.

column.name: text
column.value: If a man saith, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

column.name: text
column.value: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

column.name: text
column.value: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

column.name: text
column.value: (For the life was revealed, and we have seen {it}, and bear witness, and show to you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us;)

column.name: text
column.value: That which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship {is} with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And these things we write to you, that your joy may be full.

column.name: text
column.value: This then is the message which we have heard from him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

column.name: text
column.value: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

column.name: text
column.value: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us {our} sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

column.name: text
column.value: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

column.name: text
column.value: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

column.name: text
column.value: And ye know that he appeared to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever abideth in him sinneth not: whoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God appeared, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

column.name: text
column.value: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil: whoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the message that ye have heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

column.name: text
column.value: Not as Cain, {who} was of that wicked one, and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

column.name: text
column.value: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not {his} brother abideth in death.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

column.name: text
column.value: By this we perceive the love {of God}, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down {our} lives for the brethren.

column.name: text
column.value: But he who hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his compassions from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

column.name: text
column.value: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

column.name: text
column.value: For if our heart condemneth us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, if our heart doth not condemn us, {then} have we confidence toward God.

column.name: text
column.value: And whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And by this we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit who he hath given to us.

column.name: text
column.value: My little children, these things I write to you, that ye sin not. And if any man sinneth, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

column.name: text
column.value: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for {the sins of} the whole world.

column.name: text
column.value: And by this we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But whoever keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: by this we know that we are in him.

column.name: text
column.value: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

column.name: text
column.value: Brethren, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

column.name: text
column.value: Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

column.name: text
column.value: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

column.name: text
column.value: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is no cause for stumbling in him.

column.name: text
column.value: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not where he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

column.name: text
column.value: I write to you, fathers, because ye have known him {that is} from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write to you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: I have written to you, fathers, because ye have known him {that is} from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

column.name: text
column.value: Love not the world, neither the things {that are} in the world. If any man loveth the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

column.name: text
column.value: For all that {is} in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not from the Father, but is from the world.

column.name: text
column.value: And the world passeth away, and its lust: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist cometh, even now are there many antichrists; by which we know that it is the last time.

column.name: text
column.value: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would {no doubt} have continued with us: but {they went out}, that they might be shown that they were not all of us.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

column.name: text
column.value: I have not written to you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: {(but) he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also }.

column.name: text
column.value: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, {even} eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: These {things} have I written to you concerning them that seduce you.

column.name: text
column.value: But the anointing which ye have received from him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man should teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you concerning all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

column.name: text
column.value: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

column.name: text
column.value: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

column.name: text
column.value: Whoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten by him.

column.name: text
column.value: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

column.name: text
column.value: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not burdensome.

column.name: text
column.value: For whoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, {even} our faith.

column.name: text
column.value: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

column.name: text
column.value: This is he that came by water and blood, {even} Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

column.name: text
column.value: For there are three that bear witness in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit: and these three are one.

column.name: text
column.value: And there are three that bear witness on earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

column.name: text
column.value: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he hath not believed the testimony that God gave of his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the testimony, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath the Son hath life; {and} he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

column.name: text
column.value: These things have I written to you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

column.name: text
column.value: And if we know that he heareth us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired from him.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man shall see his brother sin a sin {which is} not to death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not to death. There is a sin to death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

column.name: text
column.value: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not to death.

column.name: text
column.value: We know that whoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

column.name: text
column.value: {And} we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

column.name: text
column.value: And we know that the Son of God hath come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, {even} in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: The elder to the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

column.name: text
column.value: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

column.name: text
column.value: Who have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou shalt bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

column.name: text
column.value: Because for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

column.name: text
column.value: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellowhelpers to the truth.

column.name: text
column.value: I wrote to the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content with that, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth {them} out of the church.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

column.name: text
column.value: Demetrius hath good report by all {men}, and by the truth itself: and, we {also} bear witness; and ye know that our witness is true.

column.name: text
column.value: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write to thee:

column.name: text
column.value: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace {be} to thee. {Our} friends greet thee. Greet the friends by name.

column.name: text
column.value: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him, to show to his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified {it} by his angel to his servant John:

column.name: text
column.value: Who bore witness of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {is} he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written in it: for the time {is} at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace {be} to you, and peace, from him who is, and who was, and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

column.name: text
column.value: And from Jesus Christ, {who is} the faithful witness, {and} the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. To him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

column.name: text
column.value: And hath made us kings and priests to God and his Father; to him {be} glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they {also} who pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send {it} to the seven churches which are in Asia; to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamos, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands;

column.name: text
column.value: And in the midst of the seven lampstands {one} like the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the breasts with a golden band.

column.name: text
column.value: His head and {his} hairs {were} white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes {were} as a flame of fire;

column.name: text
column.value: And his feet like fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance {was} as the sun shineth in his strength.

column.name: text
column.value: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying to me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

column.name: text
column.value: I {am} he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

column.name: text
column.value: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be after this;

column.name: text
column.value: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lampstands which thou sawest are the seven churches.

column.name: text
column.value: To the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden lampstands;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and that thou canst not bear them who are evil: and thou hast tried them who say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

column.name: text
column.value: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

column.name: text
column.value: Nevertheless I have {somewhat} against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember therefore from which thou hast fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come to thee quickly, and will remove thy lampstand out of its place, except thou repent.

column.name: text
column.value: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, who was dead, and is alive;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich ) and {I know} the blasphemy of them who say they are Jews, and are not, but {are} the synagogue of Satan.

column.name: text
column.value: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast {some} of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful to death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt by the second death.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he who hath the sharp sword with two edges;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, {even} where Satan's throne {is}: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days in which Antipas {was} my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

column.name: text
column.value: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit {acts of} immorality.

column.name: text
column.value: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

column.name: text
column.value: Repent; or else I will come to thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth except he that receiveth {it}.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet {are} like fine brass;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last {to be} more than the first.

column.name: text
column.value: However I have a few things against thee, because thou allowest that woman Jezebel, who calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit {acts of} immorality, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

column.name: text
column.value: And I gave her time to repent of her immorality; and she repented not.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he who searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give to each one of you according to your works.

column.name: text
column.value: But to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and who have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you no other burden.

column.name: text
column.value: But that which ye have {already} hold fast till I come.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works to the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

column.name: text
column.value: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give him the morning star.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, {and} called:

column.name: text
column.value: Mercy to you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

column.name: text
column.value: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write to you concerning the common salvation, it was needful for me to write to you, and exhort {you} that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered to the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: For certain men have crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angels who kept not their proper abode, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness to the judgment of the great day.

column.name: text
column.value: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to gross immorality, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

column.name: text
column.value: Likewise also these {filthy} dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

column.name: text
column.value: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

column.name: text
column.value: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

column.name: text
column.value: Woe to them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and run greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.

column.name: text
column.value: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds {they are} without water, carried about by winds; late autumn trees, without fruit, twice dead, plucked out by the roots;

column.name: text
column.value: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

column.name: text
column.value: To execute judgment upon all, and to convict all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have impiously committed, and of all their hard {speeches} which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

column.name: text
column.value: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling {words}, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

column.name: text
column.value: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

column.name: text
column.value: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

column.name: text
column.value: These are they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

column.name: text
column.value: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying by the Holy Spirit,

column.name: text
column.value: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

column.name: text
column.value: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

column.name: text
column.value: And others save with fear, pulling {them} out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: Now to him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present {you} faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

column.name: text
column.value: To God the only wise, our Saviour, {be} glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

column.name: text
column.value: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

column.name: text
column.value: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

column.name: text
column.value: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

column.name: text
column.value: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go out no more: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, {which is } new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and {I will write upon him} my new name.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

column.name: text
column.value: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

column.name: text
column.value: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

column.name: text
column.value: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and {that} the shame of thy nakedness may not appear; and anoint thy eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

column.name: text
column.value: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man shall hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

column.name: text
column.value: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me on my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father on his throne.

column.name: text
column.value: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

column.name: text
column.value: After this I looked, and, behold, a door {was} opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard {was} as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up here, and I will show thee things which must be after this.

column.name: text
column.value: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and {one} sat on the throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that sat was in appearance like a jasper and a sardius stone: and {there was} a rainbow around the throne, in sight like an emerald.

column.name: text
column.value: And around the throne {were} four and twenty thrones: and upon the thrones I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and {there were} seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And in front of the throne {there was} a sea of glass like crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and around the throne, {were} four living beings full of eyes before and behind.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first living being {was} like a lion, and the second living being like a calf, and the third living being had a face as a man, and the fourth living being {was} like a flying eagle.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four living beings had each of them six wings about {him}; and {they were} full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, who was, and is, and is to come.

column.name: text
column.value: And when those living beings give glory and honour and thanks to him that is seated on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

column.name: text
column.value: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

column.name: text
column.value: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose its seals?

column.name: text
column.value: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look on it.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the elders saith to me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose its seven seals.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four living beings, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had taken the book, the four living beings and four {and} twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

column.name: text
column.value: And hast made us to our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne and the living beings and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

column.name: text
column.value: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

column.name: text
column.value: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, I heard saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, {be} to him that sitteth upon the throne, and to the Lamb for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four living beings said, Amen. And the four {and} twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four living beings saying, Come and see.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given to him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second living being say, Come and see.

column.name: text
column.value: And there went out another horse {that was} red: and {power} was given to him that sat on him to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given to him a great sword.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third living being say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four living beings say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and {see} thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living being say, Come and see.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given to them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

column.name: text
column.value: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

column.name: text
column.value: And white robes were given to every one of them; and it was said to them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they {were}, should be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

column.name: text
column.value: And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, even as a fig tree casteth its untimely figs, when it is shaken by a mighty wind.

column.name: text
column.value: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and isle were moved out of their places.

column.name: text
column.value: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every slave, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

column.name: text
column.value: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

column.name: text
column.value: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

column.name: text
column.value: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the number of them who were sealed: {and there were} sealed an hundred {and} forty {and} four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Judah {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad {were} sealed twelve thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Asher {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Naphtali {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasseh {were} sealed twelve thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Simeon {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar {were} sealed twelve thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: Of the tribe of Zebulun {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph {were} sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin {were} sealed twelve thousand.

column.name: text
column.value: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

column.name: text
column.value: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God who sitteth upon the throne, and to the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: And all the angels stood around the throne, and {about} the elders and the four living beings, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, {be} to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, Who are these that are arrayed in white robes? and where did they come from?

column.name: text
column.value: And I said to him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they who came out of the great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

column.name: text
column.value: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

column.name: text
column.value: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them to living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

column.name: text
column.value: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the seven angels who stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

column.name: text
