column.value: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given to him much incense, that he should offer {it} with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And the smoke of the incense, {which came} with the prayers of the saints, ascended before God out of the angel's hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast {it} upon the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

column.name: text
column.value: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mixed with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

column.name: text
column.value: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

column.name: text
column.value: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so that the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

column.name: text
column.value: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven to the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

column.name: text
column.value: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men who have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment {was} as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

column.name: text
column.value: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the shapes of the locusts {were} like horses prepared for battle; and on their heads {were} as it were crowns like gold, and their faces {were} as the faces of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as {the teeth} of lions.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings {was} as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power {was} to hurt men five months.

column.name: text
column.value: And they had a king over them, {who is} the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew language {is} Abaddon, but in the Greek language he hath {his} name Apollyon.

column.name: text
column.value: One woe is past; {and}, behold, there come two woes more after this.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, Loose the four angels who are bound in the great river Euphrates.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four angels were loosed, who were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, to slay the third part of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the number of the army of the horsemen {was} two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

column.name: text
column.value: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses {were} as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

column.name: text
column.value: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

column.name: text
column.value: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails {were} like serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

column.name: text
column.value: And the rest of the men who were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

column.name: text
column.value: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their immorality, nor of their thefts.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow {was} upon his head, and his face {was} as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

column.name: text
column.value: And he had in his hand a little scroll open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and {his} left {foot} on the earth,

column.name: text
column.value: And cried with a loud voice, as {when} a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

column.name: text
column.value: And swore by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that are in it, and the earth, and the things that are in it, and the sea, and the things which are in it, that there should be delay no longer:

column.name: text
column.value: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

column.name: text
column.value: And the voice which I heard from heaven spoke to me again, and said, Go {and} take the little scroll which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I went to the angel, and said to him, Give me the little scroll. And he said to me, Take {it}, and eat it; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

column.name: text
column.value: And I took the little scroll out of the angel's hand, and ate it; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, Thou must prophesy again concerning many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was given me a reed like a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship in it.

column.name: text
column.value: But the court which is outside the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given to the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty {and} two months.

column.name: text
column.value: And I will give {power} to my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred {and} sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

column.name: text
column.value: These are the two olive trees, and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

column.name: text
column.value: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

column.name: text
column.value: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

column.name: text
column.value: And their dead bodies {shall lie} in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

column.name: text
column.value: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not permit their dead bodies to be put in graves.

column.name: text
column.value: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them who saw them.

column.name: text
column.value: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying to them, Come up here. And they ascended to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were killed of men seven thousand: and the remnant were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: The second woe is past; {and }, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become {the kingdoms} of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four and twenty elders, who sat before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, who art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward to thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them who destroy the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his covenant: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gained the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, {and} over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous {are} thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true {are} thy ways, thou King of saints.

column.name: text
column.value: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for {thou} only {art} holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are revealed.

column.name: text
column.value: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

column.name: text
column.value: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden bands.

column.name: text
column.value: And one of the four living beings gave to the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

column.name: text
column.value: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

column.name: text
column.value: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

column.name: text
column.value: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman who was ready to be delivered, to devour her child as soon as he was born.

column.name: text
column.value: And she brought forth a son, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up to God, and {to} his throne.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared by God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred {and} sixty days.

column.name: text
column.value: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

column.name: text
column.value: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, who deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out upon the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, who accused them before our God day and night.

column.name: text
column.value: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives to the death.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore rejoice, {ye} heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down to you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman who brought forth the son.

column.name: text
column.value: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

column.name: text
column.value: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away by the flood.

column.name: text
column.value: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the dragon was enraged with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, who keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

column.name: text
column.value: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were as {the feet} of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his throne, and great authority.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

column.name: text
column.value: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power to the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who {is} like the beast? who is able to make war with him?

column.name: text
column.value: And there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given to him to continue forty {and} two months.

column.name: text
column.value: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

column.name: text
column.value: And it was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

column.name: text
column.value: If any man hath an ear, let him hear.

column.name: text
column.value: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

column.name: text
column.value: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke as a dragon.

column.name: text
column.value: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

column.name: text
column.value: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by {the means of} those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and lived.

column.name: text
column.value: And he had power to give life to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

column.name: text
column.value: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

column.name: text
column.value: And that no man might buy or sell, except him that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number {is} Six hundred and sixty {and} six.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Zion, and with him an hundred {and} forty {and} four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

column.name: text
column.value: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred {and} forty {and} four thousand, who were redeemed from the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: These are they who were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they who follow the Lamb wherever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, {being} the firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

column.name: text
column.value: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

column.name: text
column.value: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her immorality.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worshippeth the beast and his image, and receiveth {his} mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

column.name: text
column.value: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

column.name: text
column.value: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receiveth the mark of his name.

column.name: text
column.value: Here is the patience of the saints: here {are} they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, Write, Blessed {are} the dead who die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works follow them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud {one} sat like the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

column.name: text
column.value: And another angel came out from the altar, who had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast {it} into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even to the horses' bridles, by the space of a thousand {and} six hundred furlongs.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a foul and loathsome sore upon the men who had the mark of the beast, and {upon} them who worshipped his image.

column.name: text
column.value: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead {man}: and every living soul died in the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, who art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

column.name: text
column.value: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard another from the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous {are} thy judgments.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, who hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the throne of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

column.name: text
column.value: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and its water was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs {come} out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

column.name: text
column.value: For they are the spirits of demons, working miracles, {which} go forth to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed {is} he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

column.name: text
column.value: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

column.name: text
column.value: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

column.name: text
column.value: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as hath not been since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, {and} so great.

column.name: text
column.value: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

column.name: text
column.value: And every isle fled away, and the mountains were not found.

column.name: text
column.value: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, {every stone} about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for its plague was exceeding great.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came one of the seven angels who had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying to me, Come; I will show to thee the judgment of the great harlot that sitteth upon many waters:

column.name: text
column.value: With whom the kings of the earth have committed {acts of} immorality, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her immorality.

column.name: text
column.value: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her immorality:

column.name: text
column.value: And upon her forehead {was} a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great wonder.

column.name: text
column.value: And the angel said to me, Why didst thou wonder? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.

column.name: text
column.value: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

column.name: text
column.value: And here {is} the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.

column.name: text
column.value: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, {and} the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short time.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, who have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

column.name: text
column.value: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength to the beast.

column.name: text
column.value: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him {are} called, and chosen, and faithful.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to me, The waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

column.name: text
column.value: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the harlot, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

column.name: text
column.value: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

column.name: text
column.value: And the woman whom thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: In the midst of its street, and on each side of the river, {was there} the tree of life, which bore twelve {kinds of} fruits, {and} yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree {were} for the healing of the nations.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall see his face; and his name {shall be} in their foreheads.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall be no night there; and they need no lamp, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, These words {are} faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show to his servants the things which must shortly be done.

column.name: text
column.value: Behold, I come quickly: blessed {is} he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.

column.name: text
column.value: And I John saw these things, and heard {them}. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who showed me these things.

column.name: text
column.value: Then saith he to me, See {thou do it} not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them who keep the words of this book: worship God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to me, Seal not the words of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

column.name: text
column.value: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he who is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

column.name: text
column.value: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward {is} with me, to give to every man according as his work shall be.

column.name: text
column.value: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed {are} they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

column.name: text
column.value: For outside {are} dogs, and sorcerers, and immoral persons, and murderers, and idolaters, and whoever loveth and maketh a lie.

column.name: text
column.value: I Jesus have sent my angel to testify to you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, {and} the bright and morning star.

column.name: text
column.value: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is thirsty come. And whoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

column.name: text
column.value: For I testify to every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add to these things, God shall add to him the plagues that are written in this book:

column.name: text
column.value: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and {from} the things which are written in this book.

column.name: text
column.value: He who testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

column.name: text
column.value: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ {be} with you all. Amen.

column.name: text
column.value: And after these things I heard a great voice of many people in heaven, saying, Hallelujah; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, to the Lord our God:

column.name: text
column.value: For true and righteous {are} his judgments: for he hath judged the great harlot, who corrupted the earth with her immorality, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And again they said, Hallelujah. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And the four and twenty elders and the four living beings fell down and worshipped God who sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Hallelujah.

column.name: text
column.value: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Hallelujah: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

column.name: text
column.value: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.

column.name: text
column.value: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

column.name: text
column.value: And he saith to me, Write, Blessed {are} they who are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith to me, These are the true sayings of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said to me, See {thou do it} not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him {was} called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

column.name: text
column.value: His eyes {were} as a flame of fire, and on his head {were} many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

column.name: text
column.value: And he {was} clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

column.name: text
column.value: And the armies {which were } in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

column.name: text
column.value: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.

column.name: text
column.value: And he hath on {his} vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together to the supper of the great God;

column.name: text
column.value: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all {men, both} free and bond, both small and great.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

column.name: text
column.value: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

column.name: text
column.value: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which {sword} proceedeth out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

column.name: text
column.value: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was made bright with his glory.

column.name: text
column.value: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of demons, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

column.name: text
column.value: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed {acts of} immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have become rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

column.name: text
column.value: For her sins have reached to heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

column.name: text
column.value: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double to her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.

column.name: text
column.value: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived luxuriously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

column.name: text
column.value: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong {is} the Lord God who judgeth her.

column.name: text
column.value: And the kings of the earth, who have committed {acts of} immorality and lived luxuriously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

column.name: text
column.value: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.

column.name: text
column.value: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

column.name: text
column.value: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all kinds of vessels of ivory, and all kinds of vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

column.name: text
column.value: And cinnamon, and incense, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and bodies, and souls of men.

column.name: text
column.value: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after have departed from thee, and all things which were luxurious and splendid have departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.

column.name: text
column.value: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

column.name: text
column.value: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

column.name: text
column.value: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

column.name: text
column.value: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What {city is} like this great city!

column.name: text
column.value: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, in which were made rich all that had ships in the sea by her wealth! for in one hour is she made desolate.

column.name: text
column.value: Rejoice over her, {thou} heaven, and {ye} holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.

column.name: text
column.value: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast {it} into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be no more found.

column.name: text
column.value: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be no more heard in thee; and no craftsman, of whatever craft {he be}, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be no more heard in thee;

column.name: text
column.value: And the light of a lamp shall shine no more in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.

column.name: text
column.value: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

column.name: text
column.value: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, who is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

column.name: text
column.value: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them: and {I saw} the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and who had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received {his} mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

column.name: text
column.value: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This {is} the first resurrection.

column.name: text
column.value: Blessed and holy {is} he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

column.name: text
column.value: And when the thousand years have ended, Satan shall be loosed from his prison,

column.name: text
column.value: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom {is} as the sand of the sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.

column.name: text
column.value: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet {are}, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is {the book} of life: and the dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

column.name: text
column.value: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

column.name: text
column.value: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

column.name: text
column.value: And whoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away; and there was no more sea.

column.name: text
column.value: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

column.name: text
column.value: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God {is} with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, {and be} their God.

column.name: text
column.value: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things have passed away.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said to me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

column.name: text
column.value: And he said to me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to him that is thirsty of the fountain of the water of life freely.

column.name: text
column.value: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

column.name: text
column.value: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and immoral persons, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

column.name: text
column.value: And there came to me one of the seven angels who had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come, I will show thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.

column.name: text
column.value: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

column.name: text
column.value: Having the glory of God: and her light {was} like a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

column.name: text
column.value: And had a wall great and high, {and} had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are {the names} of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

column.name: text
column.value: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

column.name: text
column.value: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

column.name: text
column.value: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and its gates, and its wall.

column.name: text
column.value: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and its height are equal.

column.name: text
column.value: And he measured its wall, an hundred {and} forty four cubits, {according to} the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

column.name: text
column.value: And the building of its wall was {of} jasper: and the city {was} pure gold, like clear glass.

column.name: text
column.value: And the foundations of the wall of the city {were} garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation {was} jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

column.name: text
column.value: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

column.name: text
column.value: And the twelve gates {were} twelve pearls; each one of the gates was of one pearl: and the street of the city {was} pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

column.name: text
column.value: And I saw no temple in it: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

column.name: text
column.value: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God lightened it, and the Lamb {is} its lamp.

column.name: text
column.value: And the nations of them who are saved shall walk in its light: and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honour into it.

column.name: text
column.value: And its gates shall not be shut by day: for there shall be no night there.

column.name: text
column.value: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

column.name: text
column.value: And there shall by no means enter into it any thing that defileth, neither {whoever} worketh abomination, or {maketh} a lie: but they who are written in the Lamb's book of life.
